title: Subarashiki Hibi ~Furenzoku Sonzai~
title_original: 素晴らしき日々～不連続存在～
description: One day, Minakami Yuki witnesses a stuffed toy falling through the air. Battered and worn, how many times has this doll fluttered downwards, released as an attempted offering to the sky? An offering made to find the "day we return to the sky"—a ritual passed down in this town since times gone by. Those efforts shall come to fruition in the place where the girls of earth and sky meet. Vega and Altair—Orihime and Hikoboshi—two points of light separated by the vast Milky Way. Together with Deneb, crown of the Northern Cross, they make up the Summer Triangle. Evoking the concept of the Trinity, this formation is also known as the "Heavenly Triangle." When this Heavenly Triangle shines overhead, the world and the sky will meet. Takashima Zakuro, Wakatsuki Kagami, Wakatsuki Tsukasa, and our heroine, Minakami Yuki, set off in search of that place where the points of the divine triangle cross—wh

characters.name: Takashima Zakuro
characters.description: Yuki's schoolmate from a neighbouring class, Zakuro, is the protagonist of the "Looking-glass Insects" chapter. She has a tendency to get lost in her thoughts and frequently spaces out. Due to her timid and soft-spoken nature, [spoiler]she is often a target of tasteless pranks and bullying. She considers her classmate Kimika to be her only friend, though their relationship appears to be occasionally ambiguous. [Edited from Wikipedia]

characters.name: Mamiya Takuji
characters.description: Yuki's classmate, Takuji, is the protagonist of "It's My Own Invention" chapter. He is a reclusive boy from an otaku subculture who's always stammering while speaking with others. Takuji rarely attends class as he spends most of his time secluded in his secret hideout that he had constructed under the school’s old drained swimming pool. [spoiler]His personality will go through a profound transformation after the death of Takashima Zakuro. [Edited from Wikipedia]

characters.name: Yuuki Tomosane
characters.description: Tomosane is the protagonist of the "Jabberwocky I & II" chapters. He is considered to be the strongest fist-fighter in the school and he rules over its most unsavory elements by fear. Tomosane is also a source of dread for Takuji, whom he brutalizes and extorts money from frequently. Other than that, [spoiler]he works part-time as a piano player at a transvestite bar, and has a tumultuous friendship with Minakami Yuki. His secret hobby is playing retro video games. [Edited from Wikipedia]

characters.name: Mamiya Hasaki
characters.description: Takuji's younger sister, Hasaki, is the protagonist of the "Which Dreamed It" chapter. She's a shy and timorous girl, who carries a stuffed rabbit doll around with her everywhere she goes. [spoiler]Hasaki is very attached to her older brother and often visits him at his school, though she doesn't attend the said school herself. She works at the same bar as Tomosane by helping out and cooking in the kitchen. [Edited from Wikipedia]

characters.name: Tachibana Kimika
characters.description: Kimika is Zakuro's classmate and her closest friend, though she considers that she betrayed their friendship and because of that she often treats her coldly in an attempt to alienate her. Kimika's an explosive girl who dabbles in chemical science and it's no surprise she became a 39th president of the Kita High Science Club. She also joined the Track and Field Club in order to improve her poor reflexes. [spoiler]Just like Zakuro, she is also the frequent target of bullying. After Zakuro's death, she'll become one of the most devoted followers of Takuji. [Edited from Wikipedia and Kickstarter page]

characters.name: Otonashi Ayana
characters.description: Ayana is a mysterious girl who gets encountered by all five protagonists; for the first time typically on the school's rooftop. She speaks enigmatically, in riddles, and frequently makes literary references and strange jokes that others find more unsettling than amusing. Her conversations are often about "The End Sky" (終ノ空 - Tsui no Sora), a concept that only she herself seems to truly understand. [Edited from Wikipedia]

characters.name: Minakami Yuki
characters.description: Yuki is the protagonist of the "Down the Rabbit-Hole I & II" chapters. She is a habitual truant with a taste for cigarettes who considers herself antisocial, but in fact has an aptitude for getting along with other girls (and for intimidating boys as well). Besides that, Yuki is a fan of classical literature and she spends much of her time reading on the school's rooftop. As a result of her grandfather's stewardship of a kobudo dojo, she became skilled in ancient form of martial arts. [Edited from Wikipedia]

characters.name: Wakatsuki Tsukasa
characters.description: Yuki's childhood friend, Tsukasa, is a gentle girl who acts as the mediator between Yuki and Tsukasa's older twin sister, Kagami. Also, Tsukasa is a member of the school's disciplinary committee and she is a fan of the Romance of the Three Kingdoms. [Edited from Wikipedia]

characters.name: Wakatsuki Kagami
characters.description: Kagami is Yuki's childhood friend that acts as a stereotypical tsundere. She frequently argues with Takuji in school as well and is fiercely protective of her younger twin sister Tsukasa. [Edited from Wikipedia]

characters.name: Mamiya Tomosane
characters.description: [spoiler]Tomosane is the older brother of Takuji (real Takuji's body) and Hasaki. He took on the original Takuji's personality after Takuji's death seven years before the beginning of the story. After killing his brother, Tomosane's real personality was all but totally erased, only to resurface again 6 years later in the form of a new personality, Yuuki Tomosane. Tomosane later regains control of his body.

characters.name: Akasaka Megu
characters.description: A classmate of Zakuro. She is cunning and sly. Her family is apparently quite wealthy, and she receives an allowance of 300,000 yen every month. [Edited from Wikipedia]

characters.name: Iwata Miu
characters.description: A girl in Yuki's class and a member of the science club with Kimika. She's also friends with Ayana.

characters.name: Kitami Satoko
characters.description: A classmate of Zakuro. She is a former leader of a motorcycle gang. She is a large woman and has studied karate since childhood, so she has strong arms and is feared by the boys. She is violent, but more decent than Megu. [Edited from Wikipedia]

characters.name: Kiyokawa Asumi
characters.description: A homeroom teacher at Kita high.

characters.name: Minakami Toshio
characters.description: The bar owner is a cross-dresser and a master of ancient martial arts.

characters.name: Senagawa Yui
characters.description: A teacher at Kita High. Oversees the astrology club.

characters.name: Shiroyama Tsubasa
characters.description: A student who bullies Mamiya Takuji. Megu's boyfriend.

characters.name: Iida
characters.description: The history teacher of Yuki, Kagami, and Tsukasa.

title: Neko Para Vol.3 Neko-tachi no Aromatize
title_original: ネコぱら Vol.3 ネコたちのアロマティゼ
description: Patisserie "La Soleil", run by Kashou Minazuki, is flourishing thanks to the help of two catgirls: Maple, full of pride and a little on the haughty side, and Cinnamon, an impulsive daydreamer. These two are especially close among among the rest of the sisters. One day, Maple encounters something that shakes her belief in attaining her dream. Cinnamon, unwilling to see Maple suffer, wishes to help her in any way possible... but she can't figure out how. This story is a heartwarming cat comedy about their ambitions and the bonds between family members... with a little ecchi on the side, too. [From Steam]

characters.name: Chocola
characters.description: Feline species: Mix Youngest catgirl of the Minazuki family and Vanilla's twin sister. Loves Kashou as her master. She is one of Sayori's personal mascot characters.

characters.name: Vanilla
characters.description: Feline species: Mix Youngest catgirl of the Minazuki family and Chocola's twin sister. She follows Chocola wherever she goes. She is one of Sayori's personal mascot characters.

characters.name: Maple
characters.description: Feline species: American Curl The 2nd oldest catgirl sister of the Minazuki family.

characters.name: Cinnamon
characters.description: Feline species: Scottish Fold The middle catgirl sister of the Minazuki family.

characters.name: Azuki
characters.description: Feline species: Munchkin Oldest catgirl sister of the Minazuki family.

characters.name: Coconut
characters.description: Feline species: Maine Coon The 2nd youngest catgirl sister of the Minazuki family.

characters.name: Minazuki Shigure
characters.description: Kashou's real sister, also the owner of the cats.

characters.name: Minazuki Kashou
characters.description: Eldest son of the Minazuki family. He dreams of running a patisserie shop.

title: Sono Hanabira ni Kuchizuke o
title_original: その花びらにくちづけを
description: The first installment of the series, this particular game follows Oda Nanami who is a new freshman in high school. However on the first day, she ends up in an accident in which a senior student from the school comes to her rescue. Ever since that meeting with Matsubara Yuna, Nanami just cannot get her mind off of her and later decides to join the student council. But one day…Nanami catches Yuna doing something very strange, while also calling out Nanami’s name. [Edited from the blog White Butterly]

characters.name: Matsubara Yuuna
characters.description: A second-year high school student. She is smart, attractive, popular and rich girl who is admired by the students of St. Michael's. Yet she falls in love with the clumsy and average Nanami. [Edited from Wikipedia]

characters.name: Oda Nanami
characters.description: A first-year high school student. Despite being a pretty average girl with bad luck, she has caught the attention of the famous Yuuna. [From Wikipedia]

title: FLOWERS -Le volume sur printemps-
description: Suou: "Is it wrong if I fall in love with a girl?" Surrounded by immense walls in the middle of a forest, lies the prestigious all-girls school, Saint Angraecum Academy. It's a school that prides itself on growing bright and cultured young women. The school's Amitié program is designed to help foster new friendships that will last a lifetime. This is why Suoh Shirahane, a painfully shy girl with a mysterious past, has enrolled. As her first year of high school begins, she is filled with hopes of a new life. Follow her as she navigates her new friendships and attempts to unravel the many mysteries at the academy, including occult rituals and the mysterious disappearance of fellow students, all while trying to pass her classes. As spring warms into summer, so does Suoh's friendships until they too blossom into a love that is something more. More importantly, who will she choose? [Taken fro

characters.name: Shirahane Suou
characters.description: A quiet, anxious, timid girl— However, she is misunderstood; her beauty, which sets her apart from the herd, and her silence is seen as cool, and the timidity that prevents her from mixing with everyone is seen as independence. Before she came to the academy, she went to live with her grandfather due to her family situation, and was homeschooled, therefore she is not good at interacting with people. However, it is not because she hates people; her desire to make friends is double that of most people. Also, she is extremely shy, and this in combination with her anxiety means that she always blushes when she gets nervous. Because books and movies are her friends, she has a habit of quoting lines from books and movies in her conversations. Her Amitie partners are Mayuri and Rikka. Her interests are literature, music, and film. [From Jast USA]

characters.name: Kousaka Mayuri
characters.description: Although she doesn’t show it, she is a hard worker who can achieve surprising things when she puts her mind to it. It was her own wish to enter the academy, but this wish stemmed from certain woes. She is quite social but takes care even with her Amitie partners so as not to let her troubles be known. Her interests are making sweets and art appreciation She is one of Suou’s Amitie partners. [From Jast USA]

characters.name: Hanabishi Rikka
characters.description: A very serious, calm girl who is good at taking care of others. She is like the mother of the class; she is not only kind but when someone does something bad, she will say so, like a mother who is kind yet strict. Cherished for her thoughtfulness toward others, she stands at the heart of class with Mayuri Kousaka in terms of influence. Because she was the top scoring student on the entrance exam, along with her caring and her ability to make things happen, she was named the class president. She takes pride in the fact that she can handle all that is expected of her, takes initiative, and devotes herself to the role. [From Jast USA]

characters.name: Sasaki Ichigo
characters.description: A troublemaker brimming with curiosity. It isn’t that she intentionally brings on disaster; her sheltered life means that she knows nothing, and so she naturally invites misunderstandings and trouble. She started life at the boarding school with her twin sister, and overall is satisfied with all the novelty at the academy. She is cheery, so she speaks openly with the people around her, and gets along well with her classmates. She is especially close with Mayuri Kohsaka. Her interests are the latest fashions and collecting frog memorabilia. [From Jast USA]

characters.name: Sasaki Ringo
characters.description: She is often thought to be the laidback opposite of her bubbly sister... but in truth she is just a bit lazy. People who know her for a long time come to see her eccentric personality. Perhaps because she is an eccentric and is not afraid of anything, she speaks freely with Suoh, who most people regard as unapproachable, and the two quickly became acquaintances. Perhaps they are drawn to each other because of their love of books… Her interests are reading and ghost stories. [From Jast USA]

characters.name: Yatsushiro Yuzuriha
characters.description: Eccentric and dynamic. Because of her way of speaking and the randomness of the things she says, she is thought to be strange, but that is her world. She is thought to be egotistic, but perhaps because she is the president of organizations, she is good at looking out for and taking care of others. Though her words and actions are theatrical, her position as the president of the Council of Nicaea gives her a kind of dignity. She is well trusted by all students at the academy. She is childhood friends with Nerine Komikado, the vice president of the Council of Nicaea, whom she calls Neri. Although she belongs to the cooking club, she is terrible at cooking. Her interests are sports and photography. [From Jast USA]

characters.name: Komikado Nerine
characters.description: A virtuous and gentle Catholic girl who is good with people. Her otherworldly beauty and the fact that she is half-European builds a natural wall around her, making her a bit unapproachable. She likes to be spoiled but she does not show this side to just anybody. She is the vice president of the Council of Nicaea and childhood friends with the Council’s president, Yuzuriha Yatsushiro. Their closeness is such that at one point there were unsubstantiated rumors that she and Yuzuriha Yatsushiro were in a relationship. She belongs to the choir and is the club president. She is a soprano. Her interests are scary stories and walking while eating. She is a bottomless pit when it comes to sweets. [From Jast USA]

characters.name: Dalia Basquiat
characters.description: One of the nuns at Saint Angraecum Academy. She is a mild and tolerant teacher, and is more like a laidback older sister than a mother. Because she is a strict follower of Catholicism, she has a tendency to apply her religion to things that have nothing to do with it. She is in charge of the ballet lessons for the first year students and is well trusted by them. Thinking that she should turn her attention toward something other than religion, she has recently been raising her namesake flower, the dahlia, in the greenhouse and creating new varieties by her own hand. Her interests are ballet and gardening. [From Jast USA]

characters.name: Yaegaki Erika
characters.description: A strange, asocial girl. She talks like a man, but this is her way of building a wall between herself and others. Generally she likes to be by herself, though she will speak to others to tease them. Her whimsical cat-like character makes her elusive. What part will she play in the tale… She is known as the girl in the wheelchair. Unable to move her legs due to illness, she lives her life in a wheelchair. Her interests are reading and finding people’s weak points. [From Jast USA]

title: Analogue: A Hate Story
description: Back in the 25th century, Earth launched a generation ship into deep space, with the goal of establishing the first interstellar colony. It dropped out of contact and disappeared, never reaching its destination. Thousands of years later, it has finally been found. Uncover the mystery of what happened to the final generation aboard the generation ship Mugunghwa by reading through its dead crew's logs, with the help of a spunky AI sidekick! Two pursuable characters. Five endings. A dark visual novel that further extends the non-linear style of Digital: A Love Story in a mystery featuring transhumanism, traditional marriage, loneliness, and cosplay. Welcome to the future.

characters.name: *Hyun-ae
characters.description: An AI on the Mugunghwa. A helpful girl with a romantic mindset who also enjoys cosplay. She does have her own secrets though. [spoiler] Her real name is Kim Hyun-Ae, also called the Pale Bride. She was a girl who downloaded her mind into a computer (nearly killing *Mute) to avoid her complete death when she completely wiped out the entire population of the Mugunghwa in an act of revenge. She was a very sick girl in life so her father put her into stasis until a future where she could be treated was made. It didn't work out.

characters.name: *Mute
characters.description: The security AI for the Mugunghwa who was created on Earth. She was the Councillor of Security, and thus in charge of the security forces of the Mugunghwa, until an incident caused things to change. Remained in charge of security even after the incident though. She's more than 1600 years old. After the incident with the Pale Bride, many years after the first incident, she has had to spend the many years since then shut down due to damage she took. [spoiler]She tried to overthrow the Mugunghwa Council, which she was part of, when she felt that they were jeopardizing the ship's security and stability, but she failed and her memory was wiped as a result.

title: Okujou no Yurirei-san
description: Kokonotsuboshi Girls' Academy of Commerce, a school built on the site of an old castle, nicknamed "Shirojo." One day, the timid Toomi Yuna, who had been living a quiet life at this school, suddenly met two ghosts on the roof during lunch: Enoki Sachi, who died in an accident before the war, and Nagatani Megumi, who died of illness 30 years ago. The two "kindred spirits" died with unrequited feelings in their hearts, met, and fell in love. They ardently wish to experience their "first time" together before their eternal rest. ...But they don't know how. The two who are bound to the site of the school enlist Yuna to help them create more "yuri" couples at the school so that they can glean some sexual insight from observing them, and to assist the girls struggling with their hidden feelings. [From MangaGamer]

characters.name: Toomi Yuna
characters.description: A timid girl who limits her social interaction to the absolute minimum, she often eats lunch alone on the roof, gazing off into the distance. Yuna is methodical, a thorough planner, and quite skilled at cooking. She does most of the chores at home. She meets the two "kindred spirits" and ends up helping them. All she knows of homosexuality boils down to roughly "I guess those sort of people exist too, huh?" Strength: Good with her hands Weakness: Absolutely no skill in any game with a ball Hobbies: Cooking Skills: All housework, following recipes, smart shopping [Taken from the English official website]

characters.name: Ano Fuji
characters.description: One of Yuna's few friends at Shirojo. A princess-like girl with long, flowing hair. With all sorts of hobbies and an easygoing personality, her social circles are rather large. She'll help Yuna out in a pinch. She understands the yuri genre, but doesn't want anything to do with real life romance. She'd be perfect if she wasn't ridiculously forgetful. Strength: Sixth Sense Weakness: Forgetfulness Hobby: Anime, games, manga, the internet Skill: Overactive imagination, singing, piano, violin [Taken from the English official website]

characters.name: Komano Hina
characters.description: A first-year student, Yuna's underclassman and childhood friend. Always in a tracksuit. A track and field team member whose popularity is on the rise thanks to her "wild" cuteness. Rarely talks, but can be surprisingly forthcoming when she has something to say. Strong, sturdy, and fast. And loves food and meat. Don't get her started on tracksuits. Strength: Easy to sleep, easy to rise, flexible Weakness: All housework, fashion Hobby: Exercise, running, collecting tracksuits Skill: All exercise, eating a lot [Taken from the English official website]

characters.name: Enoki Sachi
characters.description: A student who died in an accident before the war. A sort of upper... upper... upperclassman to Yuna and everyone else. Mature, composed, and gentle, though somewhat mischievous and full of curiosity. After her death, she returned as a ghost and now watches over the students from the roof. Seeing girls pursue the feelings hidden in their hearts is her joy. When she meets Yuna, she decides that helping is even better than watching. Strength: Good listener Weakness: Modern slang Hobbies: Learning new things, observing maidens Skills: Making requests that are difficult to refuse [Taken from the English official website]

characters.name: Nagatani Megumi
characters.description: A student who died of illness 30 years ago. She hasn't been there quite as long as Sachi, but she's still Yuna's senpai. At least as far as she's concerned. She loves Sachi from the bottom of her heart and they're always together. For the sake of Sachi's plan to make the school into a "yuri paradise" and to deepen their relationship, Megumi works hard with Yuna to help the students struggling with their feelings. Strength: Knowledgeable about fashion Weakness: Tone-deaf Hobbies: Enoki Sachi, poetry Skills: Crocodile tears, Coercion [Taken from the English official website]

characters.name: Aihara Miki
characters.description: A third-year student. Vice president of the beautification committee. Famous around school for her benevolent personality. She can't say no to a request, so she's always busy with someone else's work. Her dedication this role has earned her the nickname "Saint," but to her… The type who wants her lover to lead her by the hand. Strengths: Easily remembers names and faces, all school subjects Weakness: Slight fear of heights Hobbies: Gardening, crafts, helping people find their way, collecting accessories Skill: Cleaning [Taken from the English official website]

characters.name: Maki Seina
characters.description: A first-year who fell in love with her kind upperclassman, Aihara Miki, after their first meeting. A dreamy girl who prioritizes the "mood" of things, like enrolling at Shirojo just because "It's so cool that it was built in a castle!" Like a new student should, she appears reserved, but she can actually be quite pushy. The type who wants to leap into the arms of her lover. Strength: Stronger than she looks Weakness: Unbalanced diet Hobbies: Collecting accessories, shopping Skill: Carpentry [Taken from the English official website]

characters.name: Sonou Tsukuyo
characters.description: A classical lit. teacher. She's cheerful and energetic, but small and frail. She tends to develop fevers and nosebleeds after hard work, and frequents the nurse's office. Still, she gives her all to everything she does. It's only her height that resembles a student's, and she treats them as a professional should. Students who don't take her seriously are in for a long, long lecture. Sometimes she takes on too much work, and may need Kiri's help to finish it all. The type who wants her lover to watch over her. Strengths: Quicker than she looks, can be very sprightly Weaknesses: Doesn't like carbonated drinks or math Hobbies: Education, driving Skill: Driving [Taken from the English official website]

characters.name: Koba Youka
characters.description: A second-year student. A good-for-nothing rocker who's in a band outside of school. She's energetic and tends to act "bad," but beneath all that she's actually a pretty serious student. However, she's been tardy a lot lately. And for a reason: she's fallen head-over-heels in love with Aki, a member of the disciplinary committee. Youka now arrives at the very last minute every morning, hoping to catch Aki's attention by the gate. The type who wants her lover to rock. Strength: Rock! Weakness: Rock! Hobby: Rock! Skills: Rock!, guitar [Taken from the English official website]

characters.name: Tsurugimine Kiri
characters.description: A second-year student. The science type, Kiri has a weakness for cute things. Her fondness for everything cute sprang from a complex she developed about her intimidating name and imposing height. Ever since starting school at Shirojo, she's been a fan of the tiny lit. teacher, Tsukuyo, and finds no shortage of opportunities to remind Tsukuyo of this fact. The sole member of the math club, Kiri had been delighted to spend time alone with Tsukuyo, the club advisor, but the moment she realized her true feelings... The type who's too scared to make a move on her lover. Strength: Sciences and mathematics Weakness: Classical lit (Too mesmerized by Tsukuyo to pay attention in class) Hobbies: Collecting cute things, games Skill: Puzzles [Taken from the English official website]

characters.name: Ichiki Umi
characters.description: A second-year student. A cheerful girl in the broadcasting club. She leads a carefree life playing around with Sasa and Nena, her best friends, also in the broadcasting club. Honest and direct to an almost dangerous degree, there's nothing Umi values more than friendship. The type who wants to have fun with her lover. Strength: Projecting her voice Weaknesses: Humidity, scared of ghosts Hobbies: Fortune-telling, new experiences Skills: Live broadcasting, improvisation [Taken from the English official website]

characters.name: Futano Sasa
characters.description: A second-year student. A member of the broadcasting club with a wicked tongue. She's been stuck with Umi and Nena for a while now. When Umi's out of control it's Sasa's job to bring her back down to earth. Kind of a goth. The type to want to pin her lover down. Strength: Has more energy at night Weaknesses: Mornings, not good with heat and sun Hobbies: Dark fashion, watching movies Skills: Reading aloud, imitating famous voices, abusive language [Taken from the English official website]

characters.name: Ariu Aki
characters.description: A second-year student. An intimidating member of the disciplinary committee, known throughout the school as the Gate Guard. Kokonotsuboshi Academy is pretty lax in its regulations, but she is the guardian of the one strict rule: punctuality. Usually reserved in the pursuit of her own hobbies, she takes an interest in Youka's impulsive nature. The type who wants to thoroughly devote herself to her lover. Strength: Punctuality Weakness: Strange sense of humor Hobbies: Late night radio (she records it), western music Skill: Sampling ice creams [Taken from the English official website]

characters.name: Amishima Matsuri
characters.description: A third-year student. The captain of the track and field team and their short- and middle-distance ace. Half of a veteran yuri couple, she's been dating Miyu for four years. The dominant type who's honest about her desires. Loves Miyu and often gets excited, always wanting to hold Miyu a second longer and a millimeter closer. They're planning to live together after graduation. The type who likes to cling to and flirt with her lover. A kissing demon. Strength: All sports Weakness: Poor planning Hobby: Appreciating girls aesthetically Skill: Kissing [Taken from the English official website]

characters.name: Miyama Nena
characters.description: A second-year student. The Sleeping Beauty of the broadcasting club. She finds most things bothersome and would rather sleep all day if she could. She's getting through life somehow with the support of her friends Umi and Sasa. Now and then she'll say some pretty smart things. The type who doesn't want her lover to disturb her sleep. Strength: Good observer Weakness: Can't swim Hobby: Sleeping Skills: Eating spicy food, knitting [Taken from the English official website]

characters.name: Inamoto Miyu
characters.description: A third-year student. The vice captain of the track and field team. Half of a veteran yuri couple. A cool and collected realist. Demands a cautious relationship, fearing her strict parents would separate them if they found out. She loves Matsuri so much she's decided she'd die if they couldn't be together. The type who wants to marry her lover. Strength: Excels at both sports and studies Weakness: Not good with cats Hobby: Making sweets Skills: Physical conditioning, creating training programs [Taken from the English official website]

full_description: Kokonotsuboshi Girls' Academy of Commerce, a school built on the site of an old castle, nicknamed "Shirojo." One day, the timid Toomi Yuna, who had been living a quiet life at this school, suddenly met two ghosts on the roof during lunch: Enoki Sachi, who died in an accident before the war, and Nagatani Megumi, who died of illness 30 years ago. The two "kindred spirits" died with unrequited feelings in their hearts, met, and fell in love. They ardently wish to experience their "first time" together before their eternal rest. ...But they don't know how. The two who are bound to the site of the school enlist Yuna to help them create more "yuri" couples at the school so that they can glean some sexual insight from observing them, and to assist the girls struggling with their hidden feelings. [From MangaGamer]

title: Daibanchou -Big Bang Age-
tags: Consensual Group Sex of One Female and Several Males
description: In the year 200X, a giant hole erupted in the middle of Japan. Called the Hell Hole, its appearance caused the sea to split and the lands to bend. The entirety of Japan was twisted out of shape, and dark B-crystals appeared everywhere, bestowing special powers to some people, mostly the younger generation. Special Students, as those people were soon called, became the object of fear. Japan became ruled by violence and terror and was cut off from the rest of the world. A year after the appearance of the Demonic Hole, a Special Student with extraordinary strength and will managed to unite the Special Students throughout Japan. He formed the Student Union (S.U.) to bring order back to Japan, and Japan entered a peaceful time, but it was not meant to last. Now, the land is more split than ever between the military of the PGG, the horrifying vampires of the Nightmare Eyes, the disciplined nin

characters.name: Zanma Rouga
characters.description: Rouga is a man with a strong sense of justice who enjoys a good fight and fine women. With a strong body and great reflexes, he seeks to dominate the entire nation. He was trained by his older brother, Zanma Gou. And while Rouga often is annoyed by Gou's antics and tend to punch him into oblivion, he does heed his brother's advice and show a degree of respect for him. Rouga is betrothed to Tenrou Kunagi, and cares quite a bit for her. Although that does not seem to stop him from loving other women as well. [Edited from Alice Soft wiki]

characters.name: Zanma Gou
characters.description: "That's right.... when people talk about "the weakest man on earth", they mean me!" Rouga's older brother. His battle abilities are about equal to nothing, but he's almost unnaturally good at gathering information. His role in the Rouga army is one of preparation and planning. Battle quote - "Ah, you dare to challenge me? You coward!" Special Battle quote - "O being of evil! Disappear!" [From Alice Soft wiki]

characters.name: Hibiki Sanae
characters.description: "Fight with me, and defeat the gang leader of this school!" The class chairperson of Seijou School. Rouga calls her "Chairperson". She's the type that's too serious and feels the call of duty strongly, as well as being meddlesome and careful about appearances, but she aims to catch Rouga through battle. She was never any good at battle, but she trains hard every day in order to protect the peace of the school and to remain at Rouga's side. Battle quote - "I will not forgive those who go against discipline!" [From Alice Soft wiki]

characters.name: Tenrou Kunagi
characters.description: "If you're the sort of man that gives up halfway, then I will abandon you." Kunagi is one of the two main heroines of Big Bang Age. Rouga's strong willed fiancee. She's the sort of person who says what she thinks. Because of that, there are many people who she's not good with. She says strict things to Rouga as well, but she believes in him more than anyone. She looks younger than her actual age. In the game, she makes her appearance in a strange form. Battle quote - "I won't spare you." [From Alice Soft wiki] [spoiler]She is Kamui's younger sister

characters.name: Kyoudou Senna
characters.description: "I understand. I will become Rouga's girl~" At the beginning of the game, she is a female swordsman entrusted by a certain someone to a temple shrine. She has no memories before meeting Rouga, and her lineage is a mystery. Her behaviour and manner is very elegant and refined. Normally she is a very street-smart, bright girl, but when in battle shows a cold warrior's face and outstanding battle skills. She does incredible things while smiling. Battle quote - "Well than, shall we dance..." [From Alice Soft wiki]

characters.name: Sion
characters.description: "Ai. Shion is Shion. Pleased to make your acquaintance." A puppet girl. Her reply is "ai". Because she's a being created by an alchemist, she doesn't know how to display her emotions, but she has a human's heart deep in her chest. She calls Rouga "Master", and longs for a pure heart. As she appears, she excels as a maid but also possesses skill as a battle maid, and excels at removing her master's enemies. Battle quote - "Shion shall destroy all those who seek to defeat her master." [From AliceSoft Wiki]

characters.name: Takabane Sae
characters.description: "Zanma Rouga... prepare yourself!" A female ninja who carries out all orders. She believes what people say without question. She is from the Kanga Ninja School, which was merged with the Iga due to falling membership. She is on a secret mission to stay with Rouga, but.... Her breasts and butt are rather large in comparison to her height. She pours her heart and soul into carrying out the orders of her masters. Battle quote - "I shall show you here.... the skill of a ninja." [From Alice Soft wiki]

characters.name: Himenomiya Kaen
characters.description: "Huh. Males are all such savages." An obstinate, high class young lady. A year ago, she took the seat of her older brother, Himenomiya Kouhi, who was the general president of the School League. She is doing her best carrying out inspections all over the country and proceeding with negotiations with every group, but so far her efforts haven't borne any fruit. She is stubborn in excess of her station, and more than she needs to be, but she really is a lonely, pampered child. She is a burakon, and not good with the opposite sex but feels that Rouga looks like her older brother, and begins to fall for him. [From Alice Soft wiki]

characters.name: Francine Yamabuki
characters.original: フランシーヌ 山吹
characters.description: She is a health teacher and a nurse of the Saintly Castle school. She seem to have forbidden love relationship... Battle quote - "Unless you're a cute little boy, get out of my way." [From Alice Soft wiki]

characters.name: Iori
characters.description: Futanari ninja girl, who serves NPC.

characters.name: Yunazawa Kei
characters.description: "ZANMA.... ROUGA...." The Gang Leader of the Defence Institute. A giant with super strength, "his" body is within the armour. Good friends with Gikyou. [From Alice Soft wiki]

characters.name: Nakanishi Kendou
characters.description: "Hehehe, it's getting colder!" A student at Seijou School and a member of the kendou club. She's stronger than all the guys. Wielding two shinais in her own style, she explodes on the battlefield. She loves her younger sister Kyuudou. Battle quote - "My sword strikes straight and true! Come if you don't fear for your life!" [From Alice Soft wiki]

characters.name: Nakanishi Kyuudou
characters.description: "I've got just a little bit closer to Sis's level... I think" A student at Seijou School, belonging to the kyuudou club. The younger sister of Nakanishi Kendou. A complete contrast to her outgoing older sister, she's humble and extremely shy, a very introverted girl. Battle quote - "My arrows fly straight and true... i, if you come close you'll get shot!" [From Alice Soft wiki]

characters.name: Jinnai Heita
characters.description: "I'm Jinnai Heita, the man aiming to be a man!" The self-styled "Man aiming for manhood". As you could tell from his looks, he isn't strong. Even if he's trying to act cool he gives out halfway through the third sheet. Battle quote - "I'm Jinnai Heita, the man who wants to be a MAN! I'm so hot you're gonna burn!" [From Alice Soft wiki]

characters.name: Ijuuin Tamari
characters.description: Chemistry teacher of the Saintly Castle school. He seem to have forbidden love relationship... Battle quote - "Fufufu... I don't know what could happen here..." [From Alice Soft wiki]

characters.name: Tsukuyomi Kinako
characters.description: "Hah... as I thought, magic is easier than curses" President of the Occult Research Society. None of the other members actually turn up. She immerses herself in strange research day and night. Her personality is strange as well. She speaks with a stupid expression. [From Alice Soft wiki]

characters.name: Yamamoto Burai
characters.description: "Zanma Rouga. These fists of mine, use them to make your will reality" The head of the Seijou School Boxing Club. Overly serious and stoic, Rouga gave him the nickname "the fine-eyed baron". He's not good with women or the occult. [From Alice Soft wiki]

characters.name: Doumoto Mizuki
characters.description: "This is destiny, you know~" A girl who loves fortune telling. She decided on entering the swimming club due to a fortune. She's always upbeat and never loses heart. [From Alice Soft wiki]

characters.name: Negishi Nanana
characters.description: "Ah... um, I... I'll do... my best..." An introverted girl. She's weak willed, and so can't argue if she's told something strongly. For example, if a guy at a certain school tells her something... Battle quote - "Um, I, ah, here I come!" [From Alice Soft wiki]

characters.name: Kamui
characters.description: Mysterious demon-looking guy, who helps Rouga and some other leaders but hides a lot of secretes. [spoiler] Antagonist of the story. Kamui was Kunnagi's older brother. But one day he tried to awake demon blood of Tenro family. This incident lead to Kunnagi's current state and created Hell hole. Kamui was killed by Gou Zanma and his current self is just merer body, possesed by demon.

characters.name: Senpuuji Kyouko
characters.description: "Huh, you going to do it or not?" A woman who won the name of the Legendary Ladies. She's an old friend of the head of Gokuren, Idagawa Ren, but due to certain circumstances their relationship is quite rocky. She's had many experiences in life, and is very mature. A widow. Battle quote - "That is something I cannot tolerate!" [From Alice Soft wiki]

characters.name: Naruse Yuuki
characters.description: "Hmm, I wonder if I could do 100 push-ups" A student at Seijou School. An expert with an air rifle. Rouga said he "would become more reliable than Heita". That face, those fingers, that neck... Really, he looks kinda like a girl... He wants to become strong and muscular like Rouga. Battle quote - "Umm, I wonder where I should aim for..." [Edited from Alice Soft wiki]

characters.name: Naruse Yuki
characters.description: Actually Yuuki is a girl. Her true gender could be discovered during the game so she could stop to hide it.

characters.name: Kuga Kyouichirou
characters.description: "My path... lies with you" Rouga's best friend. He's also old friends with Kunagi and Gou. Has a cool personality, and possesses the ability to manipulate shadows. He's known as the Sword of Silhouettes. Battle quote - "I won't let anyone stand in the way of our dreams!" [Edited from Alice Soft wiki]

characters.name: Amon Saito
characters.description: "We definitely have to have a match sometime!" Gyro-fighter Saito. Even today, he battles his rivals with the extremely popular toy "E Gyro". Parody on Yu-Gi-Oh main character. Battle quote - "Here I go, Ishtar! We'll show you our power here!" [From Alice Soft wiki]

characters.name: Miyazato Erika
characters.description: "Eri of the Chain never turns around!" A student at Seijou School, calls herself "Eri of the Chain". Along with her classmates Shouko and Saki, she's formed the Miyazato Army. They defy authority but are really good girls all round. Battle quote - "Hey hey hey! Eri of the Chain will kick you you know!" [From Alice Soft wiki]

characters.name: Asakura Yuma
characters.description: "...after all... I'm.... just something that you can't do anything about...." A girl being used by the PGG. She can manipulate the world of computers at will. She lives in the past. Gloomy. She's reconciled to her fate. Battle quote - "Target confirmed. Commencing... destruction..." [From Alice Soft wiki]

characters.name: Shouko
characters.description: Member of the Erika's gang

characters.name: Saki
characters.description: Member of the Erika's gang

characters.name: Kongoumaru Sanzou
characters.description: "In any case, now you have to face me, the Iron Wall of Kongoumaru" The head supporter, as well as Gang Leader of Tokyo's Sensouji School. His fighting power is so great he's called "the Iron Wall of Kongoumaru". Except, he is extremely weak when it comes to his sister Aya. His buckle is a mobile phone. [Edited from Alice Soft wiki]

characters.name: Kongoumaru Aya
characters.description: "I'll try to believe in you..." The executive officer of Sensouji School. Particular about discipline and thrift, she's known as "Iron Blood Kongoumaru". She has some trauma about her family name. [Edited from Alice Soft wiki]

characters.name: Hotta Daigo
characters.description: "FIIIIREEE!!" The Gang Leader of the Steel School. An acquantance with the Kongoumaru siblings, he's hopelessly in love with Aya. He's a hot headed guy, but tries to solve everything with force. "FIIIIREEE!!" [Edited from Alice Soft wiki]

characters.name: Idagawa Ren
characters.description: "The one to conquer the country... will be me, Idagawa Ren." He's the executive of 750 School in Tokyo, as well as the Gang Leader. He's the head of the largest biker gang in Kanto, Gokuren. He has the same goal as Rouga, conquering the nation. Battle quote - "I don't spare any who foolishly block my way..." [Edited from Alice Soft wiki]

characters.name: Hitani Mario
characters.description: "Fu... it seems that my turn has come" From Arashino School, he's a cool snob who doesn't listen to a word others say. It seems he's searching for the one who killed his lover, but... Battle quote - "Fu... have a listen. To my melody of revenge!" [Edited from Alice Soft wiki]

characters.name: Senpuuji Yuuna
characters.description: She is Kyouko's young daughter. She carries a toy duck with the wheels Battle quote - "Yuuna... will never lose!" [Edited from Alice Soft wiki]

characters.name: Ginjou Tomoka
characters.description: "I believe we need a new battle plan..." The president of the PGG. A talented, yet warm and humble woman. She doesn't know, but she has an innate loveliness to her. Battle quote - "Blitzkrieg, meaning strength through mobility." [Edited from Alice Soft wiki]

characters.name: Todoroki Yuu
characters.description: "I'm... no good" A former gang leader with a dark past. He's currently living away from human settlements. He won't open his heart. He's liked by spirits, and can manipulate vegetation. Battle quote - "It's already been decided... you can't run anymore." [Edited from Alice Soft wiki]

characters.name: Sonnet
characters.description: "Play..." An elf. Tender and gentle. She likes to play. She doesn't understand difficult things, but she likes to play so she wants Yuu to protect her. Battle quote - "Here I go..." [Edited from Alice Soft wiki]

characters.name: Cleo Aripa
characters.description: "Kuu-chan has the strength of a thousand men!" The third head of the Aripa family, who rule Touchou. She's extremely selfish, and constantly puts her servants in troublesome situations. She has a childish personality. Battle quote - "What are you looking at! Just because Kuu-chan's of royal blood!" [Edited from Alice Soft wiki]

characters.name: Misugi Ryoutarou
characters.description: "The path I walk... is filled with nothing but beauty" A beautiful man. His fascinating voice attracts the women of the world, be they young or old. "Sugi-sama! Kyakya!" Battle quote - "Fufu... beauty... is deceiving!" [From Alice Soft wiki]

characters.name: Mouri Sonken
characters.description: "I'll show you my knowledge" The executive of Three Nations School. Due to his brilliant mind, he is known as "The Wise Sage". Head over heels in love with Michiru. Battle quote - "My goodness... what a fool." [From Alice Soft wiki]

characters.name: Mouri Sonken
characters.description: Sonken's(Blue) hotblooded twin. He wields a guan dao and in red clothes. His interest in stronger fighters. Battle quote - "Hey hey hey hey! I've no interest in any but strong fighters!" [Edited from Alice Soft wiki] [spoiler]After some events he became Yuma Asakura's boyfriend.

characters.name: Abao Akuu
characters.description: Alien guy with afro. He came to Earth from a distant planet in search of adventures.

characters.name: Igarashi Koumi
characters.description: The head of a NPI-subordinate yakuza group, she is investigating the NPI's shady practices and is recruiting exiles from other factions to work for her.

characters.name: Koumei Michiru
characters.description: She is an idol of the Three Nations. Her charm attracts the students of the Three Nations, but in her true nature, she is a schemer. [From Wikipedia]

characters.name: Shirayuri Sayuri
characters.description: "Ah, um, er... I'll do my best" According to herself, "The Flowing Nurse". Her purpose in life is to heal the sick, she can be too forward and instead make their problems worse.

characters.name: Super Heita
characters.description: "I'm Jinnai Heita, the man aiming to be a man!" The self-styled "Man aiming for manhood". As you could tell from his looks, he isn't strong. Even if he's trying to act cool he gives out halfway through the third sheet. Battle quote - "I'm Jinnai Heita, the man who wants to be a MAN! I'm so hot you're gonna burn!" [From Alice Soft wiki]

characters.name: Yamizaki Akito
characters.description: Yamizaki "Agito" Akito is the gang leader of Seijou Academy. He gains great power after picking up a mysterious button, thus replacing the previous gang leader and ruling the school with violence.

characters.name: Azayama Kyouji
characters.description: One of Yamizaki's goons. When Rouga began to attack Yamizaki's office, he betrayed Yamizaki.

characters.name: Kakurai Jun
characters.description: A member of Sensouji Academy's ouendan and battle team leader. He has a strange habit of eating birds alive.

characters.name: Devil Daigo
characters.description: "FIIIIREEE!!" The Gang Leader of the Steel School. An acquantance with the Kongoumaru siblings, he's hopelessly in love with Aya. He's a hot headed guy, but tries to solve everything with force. "FIIIIREEE!!" [Edited from Alice Soft wiki]

characters.name: Zakimura Ryuuji
characters.description: One of Idagawa's goons. He leads a group of bousouzoku.

characters.name: Vice-Captain Murata
characters.description: PGG's vice leader. A stereotypical villain.

characters.name: Tsukiomi Kibito
characters.description: A researcher who created war golems for the Nightmare Eye vampire regime.

characters.name: Sakuradamon Chisa
characters.description: Wolf Fang jailer introduced by Gou.

characters.name: Toua Daizen
characters.description: A loan shark who lent money to Zanma Gou.

characters.name: Spahn
characters.description: A wealthy man who owns Hawaii and has an extreme obsession with elves.

characters.name: Broad Casuko
characters.original: ブロード キャス子

title: Sono Hanabira ni Kuchizuke o: Anata to Koibito Tsunagi
title_original: その花びらにくちづけを　あなたと恋人つなぎ
description: My name is Sawaguchi Mai. I always get myself involved with my classmate, Kawamura Reo. Reo is pretty short and has silky hair... In short, she's cute. But sometimes, she can be really obstinate. I'm trying to do my best to get her to get along with the rest of the class, but since we're both headstrong we always end up fighting. It's so frustrating, especially since she can't do anything without me around! But whenever I talk to her, Reo always acts like I'm bothering her. I wonder if she hates me... But then, just when I got all depressed Reo came up to me and told me, "You've got it all wrong! I love you, Mai! I love you so much!" Her confession completely took me by surprise. Could it be that I'm in love with Reo too!? The third in Fuguriya's yuri love comedy series! The creators have made sure to make this edition in the same spirit as the previous two productions. characters.description: An extremely shy and fairly nerdish girl. She is also Sara's cousin and is very protective of her. Second year student of St. Michael's Girl's Academy. She has been elected as class president two years in a row.

characters.name: Matsubara Yuuna
characters.description: A second-year high school student. She is smart, attractive, popular and rich girl who is admired by the students of St. Michael's. Yet she falls in love with the clumsy and average Nanami. [Edited from Wikipedia]

characters.name: Sawaguchi Mai
characters.description: A very responsible second year high school student who has some tomboy tendencies. She falls in love with Reo after getting to know a different side of her. [From Wikipedia]

characters.name: Kawamura Reo
characters.description: A short second year high school student. She is antisocial, a tsundere and in love with Mai. [Edited from Wikipedia]

title_original: その花びらにくちづけを わたしの王子さま
description: I am Kitajima Kaede, and I am not really good at dealing with people. I'm also the class rep. In school, I run into my cousin Sara, and suddenly I find myself sharing a passionate kiss with her! In the years that I haven't seen her, she's grown into a cute, outgoing girl who has become a famous model. Even fashion magazines know about her, and many in my school idolize her. She makes me look extra dull by comparison. And yet she calls me out from afar and clings to me, heedless of the stares people give us. Because I don't like to stand out, I instinctively act coldly towards Sara. But then she suddenly pushed me down. She whispers to me, "I want everything there is you." Such joy, such bliss and such embarrassment. What's to become of me? [From DLsite]

title: Highway Blossoms
description: Developed by Alienworks, Highway Blossoms is a short yuri story set in the American Southwest. After an old gold rush miner's journal is discovered, a nationwide craze begins as would-be prospectors try to solve the cryptic clues it contains and discover the miner's hidden treasure. Amber, couldn't care less. Wandering the Midwest in an inherited motorhome, she mourns the loss of her grandfather, totally unaware of the hunt taking place around her. It's not until she meets Marina, a young hitchhiker wandering through the deserts of New Mexico, that things start to look up. [From The Official Website]

characters.name: Senri Kanzaki
characters.description: Undoubtedly one of the strangest members of the group, Senri is a dedicated student with a passion for engineering, centered around robotics. Her self-assurance and strong beliefs often lead to arguments and conflict, exacerbated by her rather noticeable lack of interpersonal skills. Senri is forever curious, and delights in learning. She may seem difficult, but her motives are essentially good, and ultimately she just wants what she thinks is best for everyone - whether they like it or not. Her suspicions behind the motives of the Human Reignition Project have driven her to join the group, if only to see if she was right all along. [Taken from Kickstarter Character Bio]

characters.name: Amber Golley
characters.description: A quiet cynic with a short temper, Amber is a lifelong loner, wrestling with the recent death of her only real family, her beloved grandfather. To cope, she drives through the desert in her inherited RV, drifting towards a music festival with nothing but her memories to keep her company. But things start to take a turn when she stumbles upon a bubbly girl broken down on the side of the road. Amber is initially skeptical of her, but maybe by helping this strange girl search for treasure, Amber can find what she's looking for as well. [From Twitter]

characters.name: Marina Hale
characters.description: Marina was born and raised in the state of New Mexico, and until recently, was afraid she might die there too. But when the story of a gold miner's hidden treasure takes the nation by storm, she uses the opportunity to bring some excitement into her sheltered life. Bubbly and naïve, Marina might be in a bit over her head, but with the help of her new friend, Amber, she may just get the adventure she always wanted. [From Twitter]

characters.name: Mariah Pastorius
characters.description: An abrasive alcoholic and overall terrible human being, Mariah has devoted her entire miserable existence to finding the gold miner's mythical treasure. She claims to be the best treasure hunter around, but the only thing she seems to excel at is leaving a path of chaos and destruction in her wake. [From Twitter]

characters.name: Joseph Nowell
characters.description: One might think being the great-great-grandson of the famous gold miner would give Joe a vested interest in the hidden treasure, but that can't be further from the truth. Joe wants nothing more than to spend his days sinking into the couch and taking afternoon naps. Unfortunately, someone needs to be Mariah's wrangler, and as her lifelong (and only) friend, the responsibility falls to him. [From Twitter]

characters.name: Tess Pastorius
characters.description: Life isn't easy when you're Mariah's little sister - just ask Tess. When she's not getting dragged across the country to look for treasure, she's busy trying not to be swallowed whole by her sister's bombastic personality. Tess has learned to make the most of it though, choosing to quietly devote herself to crafts and her fascination with Americana. [From Twitter]

characters.name: Cassi Bell
characters.description: A cashier at a candy shop. After years of spinning her wheels, Cassi's decided to make a change in her life. Rather than be stuck at a cashier for a store she doesn't care about forever, she’s decided to follow her passion into sweetsmaking and try to make it on her own. When Amber and Marina walk in her door one day, Cassi's pretty sure it must be destiny. [Edited from official site]

characters.name: Gramps
characters.description: Amber's grandfather. Only appears in Goofball Mode.

characters.name: Zion
characters.description: Zion is the manifestation of Zion National Park. She has a deep, almost spiritual connection with nature, and often attracts a variety of animals to her location wherever she's at. Zion may seem meek and scared at first, but if one were to look deeper they'd realize her childlike appearance belies her serene wisdom. Memories and knowledge from times long ago echo in her head, but unlike Yosemite, Zion welcomes the change times brings to her. She has a sisterly bond with Yellowstone, and more often than not ends up taking care of her rather than the other way around.

plot_tags: Modern Day United States of America
full_description: Developed by Alienworks, Highway Blossoms is a short yuri story set in the American Southwest. After an old gold rush miner's journal is discovered, a nationwide craze begins as would-be prospectors try to solve the cryptic clues it contains and discover the miner's hidden treasure. Amber, couldn't care less. Wandering the Midwest in an inherited motorhome, she mourns the loss of her grandfather, totally unaware of the hunt taking place around her. It's not until she meets Marina, a young hitchhiker wandering through the deserts of New Mexico, that things start to look up. [From The Official Website]

title: FLOWERS -Le volume sur été-
description: Erika/Chidori: "Have you ever thought of wanting to do something for the one you love?" This is the all-age sequel to FLOWERS -Le volume sur printemps-. In the season of first meetings, a girl with a wounded heart, Suou, found a friend and lover who would accept her. However, this friend and lover left the school without telling her the reason at the end of spring. Suou was in denial about her loss, and fellow bookworm Erika was gravely worried and looked for a way to heal Suou’s broken heart. With the early arrival of summer, a girl named Chidori transferred into the school. She met Erika by accident when Erika was coming back to the dorm and told Erika that she was a coward for stalking her. It was the worst first meeting for the two who would end up becoming each other's "Amitié." [From Hau~ Omochikaeri!]

characters.name: Shirahane Suou
characters.description: A quiet, anxious, timid girl— However, she is misunderstood; her beauty, which sets her apart from the herd, and her silence is seen as cool, and the timidity that prevents her from mixing with everyone is seen as independence. Before she came to the academy, she went to live with her grandfather due to her family situation, and was homeschooled, therefore she is not good at interacting with people. However, it is not because she hates people; her desire to make friends is double that of most people. Also, she is extremely shy, and this in combination with her anxiety means that she always blushes when she gets nervous. Because books and movies are her friends, she has a habit of quoting lines from books and movies in her conversations. Her Amitie partners are Mayuri and Rikka. Her interests are literature, music, and film. [From Jast USA]

characters.name: Hanabishi Rikka
characters.description: A very serious, calm girl who is good at taking care of others. She is like the mother of the class; she is not only kind but when someone does something bad, she will say so, like a mother who is kind yet strict. Cherished for her thoughtfulness toward others, she stands at the heart of class with Mayuri Kousaka in terms of influence. Because she was the top scoring student on the entrance exam, along with her caring and her ability to make things happen, she was named the class president. She takes pride in the fact that she can handle all that is expected of her, takes initiative, and devotes herself to the role. [From Jast USA]

characters.name: Sasaki Ichigo
characters.description: A troublemaker brimming with curiosity. It isn’t that she intentionally brings on disaster; her sheltered life means that she knows nothing, and so she naturally invites misunderstandings and trouble. She started life at the boarding school with her twin sister, and overall is satisfied with all the novelty at the academy. She is cheery, so she speaks openly with the people around her, and gets along well with her classmates. She is especially close with Mayuri Kohsaka. Her interests are the latest fashions and collecting frog memorabilia. [From Jast USA]

characters.name: Sasaki Ringo
characters.description: She is often thought to be the laidback opposite of her bubbly sister... but in truth she is just a bit lazy. People who know her for a long time come to see her eccentric personality. Perhaps because she is an eccentric and is not afraid of anything, she speaks freely with Suoh, who most people regard as unapproachable, and the two quickly became acquaintances. Perhaps they are drawn to each other because of their love of books… Her interests are reading and ghost stories. [From Jast USA]

characters.name: Yatsushiro Yuzuriha
characters.description: Eccentric and dynamic. Because of her way of speaking and the randomness of the things she says, she is thought to be strange, but that is her world. She is thought to be egotistic, but perhaps because she is the president of organizations, she is good at looking out for and taking care of others. Though her words and actions are theatrical, her position as the president of the Council of Nicaea gives her a kind of dignity. She is well trusted by all students at the academy. She is childhood friends with Nerine Komikado, the vice president of the Council of Nicaea, whom she calls Neri. Although she belongs to the cooking club, she is terrible at cooking. Her interests are sports and photography. [From Jast USA]

characters.name: Komikado Nerine
characters.description: A virtuous and gentle Catholic girl who is good with people. Her otherworldly beauty and the fact that she is half-European builds a natural wall around her, making her a bit unapproachable. She likes to be spoiled but she does not show this side to just anybody. She is the vice president of the Council of Nicaea and childhood friends with the Council’s president, Yuzuriha Yatsushiro. Their closeness is such that at one point there were unsubstantiated rumors that she and Yuzuriha Yatsushiro were in a relationship. She belongs to the choir and is the club president. She is a soprano. Her interests are scary stories and walking while eating. She is a bottomless pit when it comes to sweets. [From Jast USA]

characters.name: Dalia Basquiat
characters.description: One of the nuns at Saint Angraecum Academy. She is a mild and tolerant teacher, and is more like a laidback older sister than a mother. Because she is a strict follower of Catholicism, she has a tendency to apply her religion to things that have nothing to do with it. She is in charge of the ballet lessons for the first year students and is well trusted by them. Thinking that she should turn her attention toward something other than religion, she has recently been raising her namesake flower, the dahlia, in the greenhouse and creating new varieties by her own hand. Her interests are ballet and gardening. [From Jast USA]

characters.name: Yaegaki Erika
characters.description: A strange, asocial girl. She talks like a man, but this is her way of building a wall between herself and others. Generally she likes to be by herself, though she will speak to others to tease them. Her whimsical cat-like character makes her elusive. What part will she play in the tale… She is known as the girl in the wheelchair. Unable to move her legs due to illness, she lives her life in a wheelchair. Her interests are reading and finding people’s weak points. [From Jast USA]

characters.name: Takasaki Chidori
characters.description: An eccentric ballet celebrity. Thought of as unapproachable since her emotions don't show on her face, she often causes unnecessary drama because of her tendency to ask questions about things she shouldn't. She'll express herself honestly when it comes to things she's interested in. Other than that, she doesn't do anything unnecessary. Before entering the academy, she was involved in the entertainment industry, predominantly theater, and so is one of the best in the school at ballet and singing She is assigned as Erika's Amitié partner, but their mutual eccentricities lead to them often being at odds with one another. Her hobbies are classical ballet and voice training. [Benichidori (Rosaceae family)] Language of Flowers: [How Lovely] [Refinement] [Nobility] [Devotion] [From English official page and Japanese official page]

She met Erika by accident when Erika was coming back to the dorm and told Erika that she was a coward for stalking her. It was the worst first meeting for the two who would end up becoming each other's "Amitié." [From Hau~ Omochikaeri!]

title: SaDistic BlooD
description: The Vampires Yuna and Shizuha come to the island city of Chisakura hoping to find refuge from the relentless pursuit of Vampire Hunters. However, it turns out that the Hunters are already lying in wait for them. Will the Vampire duo escape the Hunters' trap and live to see tomorrow, or will they meet a fate worse than death...? The two Vampires travel Japan together, evading the pursuit of Vampire Hunters in an attempt to live out their undead eternity in freedom. On the fateful night of their arrival in Chisakura, the full moon shines down upon the duo, intensifying their Vampiric impulses. The two attempt to slake their thirst for blood while remaining unnoticed. Little do they know that lying in wait for them in the island city is a Hunters' trap. Outnumbered by a party of dangerous biological weapons commanded by the vengeful Yuika, the two Vampires must now weigh their options. Do t

characters.name: Nanase Shizuha
characters.description: Nanase Shizuha is a vampire traveling across Japan together with Yuna. Bashful, passive, and meek, Shizuha only wishes to live in peace and obscurity, away from those who would hunt her kind. Despite her timidness, she digs in her heels and always refuses to consume human blood, even though it means weakening herself to the point of putting her and Yuna at a disadvantage to their pursuers. The only person she allows herself to feed on is Yuna, as she considers the act a confirmation of their bond. Her affection for Yuna makes Shizuha extremely dependent on her, a fact that Yuna finds both endearing and bothersome. [i]"...Don’t you think sometimes that you’d be better off being human? You wouldn't be running for your life right now if you weren’t a vampire..." [From JAST USA]

characters.name: Sonohara Yuna
characters.description: Shinohara Yuna is a vampire traveling across Japan together with Shizuha. Haughty, calculating, and sinister, she seeks to make the most of her eternal life by reveling in her vampiric nature. She sees humans as mere pawns, never hesitating to suck their blood and bend them to her will if she believes it will suit her ends. The only person she truly seems to hold dear is Shizuha, with whom she shares an intimate relationship. She does, however, find Shizuha's passive nature and adamant refusal to drink human blood to be bothersome. [i]"You should be a little more dignified about this. We're vampires, dear. We're not like those ordinary humans. We're a stronger, ageless, more elegant existence." [From JAST USA]

characters.name: Sakaki Yuika
characters.description: Sakaki Yuika is a vampire hunter affiliated with the Hunters' Association. While she is quiet and taciturn on the outside, her heart burns with hatred toward all vampires. Trained to do battle with creatures far stronger than she is and armed to the teeth, Yuika is ruthless in combat. Her signature weapon is a powerful pile bunker that can easily extinguish a vampire’s life with lethal efficiency. She commands a unit of three biological weapons developed to assist in hunting vampires. While Yuika remains loyal to the Association and will put its orders above her personal goals if need be, the same cannot be said for her subordinates. Keeping them in line is a constant source of concern for her. [i]"I will exterminate... every single vampire..." [From JAST USA]

title: Sakura no Toki -Sakura no Mori no Shita o Ayumu-
title_original: サクラノ刻－櫻の森の下を歩む－
description: Geniuses, the talented, and the ordinary. Weak gods and strong gods. A story that goes beyond happiness, and even further still. This, indeed, is the second act of the Sakura story. A genius chosen by the gods, a talented person abandoned by the gods, and an ordinary person who defies the gods. What is the charis that dwells in beauty? Why is its fruit given only to the chosen? “Where did we come from? Who are we? Where are we going?” A world bound by the light of causal exchange. Can artists, through beauty, answer that question? [spoiler] The story centers on Naoya Kusanagi after the events of Sakura no Uta, following the final landscape Naoya and Ai saw while descending from the slope overlooking the city of Yumihari. Until then, many untold stories remained. Two geniuses. The true story behind Kei Natsume and Naoya Kusanagi. Why do they continue to captivate people as artists, even a

characters.name: Misakura Rin
characters.description: Rin is protagonist's childhood friend, and is quite clumsy. She moved to the countryside, but then moved back, transferring to Naoya's class. She refers to Naoya as "Kusanagi-kun", but used to call him "Nao-kun" before she moved back. [From Wikipedia]

characters.name: Natsume Shizuku
characters.description: Shizuku is Ai and Kei's younger sister who rarely smiles. She is currently working as a model. [From Wikipedia] [spoiler] After her older brother death her personality completed changed, her thinking became sharper

characters.name: Natsume Ai
characters.description: Ai is Kei's and Shizuku's older sister, and Naoya's homeroom teacher. She is popular among the students, and is very short despite being twenty-four-years-old. After Naoya's father died, she invited him to live with her family. [From Wikipedia]

characters.name: Toritani Makoto
characters.description: Makoto is the president of the school's art club; she is a very bossy person. [From Wikipedia]

characters.name: Hikawa Rina
characters.description: Rina is an underclassman to Naoya. After Rin moved away, Naoya began to play with her. She looks up to Naoya as her big brother. [From Wikipedia]

characters.name: Kawachino Yuumi
characters.description: A freshman who hates men and loves women. She joined the Art Club in order to chase after Rina, the girl whom she pours all of her affection to.

characters.name: Kusanagi Naoya
characters.description: Naoya is the main protagonist of the story. He moved into the Natsume household after his father died. He cooks for the Natsume family since neither Ai, Kei, nor Shizuku can cook decent meals. [From Wikipedia] [spoiler]After graduating from Yumihari Gakuen, he went on to a national art university and worked as a part-time lecturer at Yumihari Gakuen. In this work, he becomes a full-time employee and becomes an art teacher. Together with the students, he revives the prestigious Yumihari Gakuen Art Club

characters.name: Natsume Kei
characters.description: Naoya's good friend whom he has known ever since junior high. [spoiler]After an eventful life, he enters the Natsume family. His personality gradually changes through encounters with Natsume Ai and a certain person. He still pursues Kusanagi Naoya, who broke his brush, as a goal. He believes in the genius of Kusanagi Naoya

characters.name: Takizawa Thomas Nagel Junpe
characters.original: タキザワ・トーマス・ネーゲル・ジュンペー

characters.name: Katagai Takumi
characters.description: Naoya's classmate. He is envious of Naoya's relationship with the transfer student.

characters.name: Marty Friedman
characters.original: マーティ・フリッドマン

characters.name: Onda Kirino
characters.description: [spoiler] She is Kei's real mother and the result from her illegitimate relationship with Nakamura Shouichi

characters.name: Nakamura Reika
characters.description: [spoiler] Her first appearance in Sakura no Uta is Honma Reika

characters.name: Nakamura Shouichi
characters.description: The head of a local prominent family. Toritani Saki's ex-husband, Makoto's father.
