title: Tokyo NECRO
title_original: 凍京NECRO＜トウキョウ・ネクロ＞
description: Nemo ante mortem beatus. "Nobody can be called happy before their death." (Herodotus, "Histories") - The era of "Necromancers" has come. In the future, the world has been engulfed in the bitter cold of an ice age. And yet, Tokyo is surviving with its use of geothermal heat pipes to keep the city habitable. The protagonists, Kibanohara Ethica and Nagaoka Souun, are young "Private Special Living Dead Stalkers", contract killers who spend their working days executing necromancers and their undead minions. By practicing a special kind of martial art called "Close Quarter Armed Martial Arts", both of them have achieved great heights in their career. Out on a mission one day, Souun becomes involved in a fierce battle and meets a mysterious young girl who had been kidnapped for unknown reasons. Remembering nothing but her name, "Hougyou Ilia", she has become the target of a mysterious group of

characters.name: Nagaoka Souun
characters.description: A Private Special Living Dead Stalker working for the Karasuzumi Living Dead Stalker Agency. The son of Nagaoka Takeyuki, legendary pioneer of Closed Quarters Armed Martial Arts. Wields dual pistols equipped with muzzle spikes known as [Url=https://www.nitroplus.co.jp/game/tokyonecro/img/weapon_re-eliminator_anim.gif]Re-Eliminators and fights using CQAMA, aided by his Ex-Brain. Calm and collected, but bad at expressing his emotions. His partner Ethica is known to needle him about this. [From the in-game profile]

characters.name: Kibanohara Ethica
characters.description: A Private Special Living Dead Stalker working for the Karasuzumi Living Dead Stalker Agency. [Spoiler]Birthed from Aso Yukari's womb using a fertilized egg created with induced pluripotent stem cells from Kibanohara Hokoyasu and Nagaoka Takeyuki. Raised together with Aso Kiriri like sisters. Acts based on her gut instinct; the type to shoot first, ask questions later. A lesbian who just can't get enough of pretty girls. Capable of wielding a wide variety of weapons like the [Url=https://www.nitroplus.co.jp/game/tokyonecro/img/weapon_ak50_anim.gif]AK-50 Kalashnikov and the [Url=https://www.nitroplus.co.jp/game/tokyonecro/img/weapon_aa24_anim.gif]AA-24 Custom, based on what a given combat situation demands. Her go-to is a portable chainsaw called [Url=https://www.nitroplus.co.jp/game/tokyonecro/img/weapon_rabbit-punch_anim.gif]Rabbit Punch. [Edited from the in-game profile]

characters.name: Hougyou Iria
characters.description: An amnesiac girl who claims to have the same name as a famous virtual environment designer. Extremely familiar with otaku culture from the late 20th and early 21st centuries, occasionally using slang that no one around her understands. [Spoiler]Was held in the Ikebukuro CPC as a child, used in human experiments. These experiments granted her enhanced empathy. While at the Ikebukuro CPC, she was close friends with Con Su (known as Risa at the time). After escaping from the Ikebukuro CPC, she lived with Sori Ayuka in The Fortress. She is the sole human able to make contact with Substance-Concept, due to her enhanced empathy. [From the in-game profile]

characters.name: Gijou Mitsumi
characters.description: A Living Dead Stalker belonging to the Gijo Living Dead Stalker Agency. Can be considered a rival of So'un and his comrades. Prideful to a fault, with a somewhat abrasive demeanor. Practitioner of the Advanced Taisha School. Her ultrasonic vibro-katana, [Url=https://www.nitroplus.co.jp/game/tokyonecro/img/weapon_shushimaru_anim.gif]Shoushimaru, sunders all in its path. [Spoiler]Lives with her undead brother Sumihiko, having sworn herself to revenge against Milgram. [Based on the in-game profile]

characters.name: Aso Kiriri
characters.description: A Major belonging to the Living Dead Countermeasures Division of the Organized Crime Department within the Public Order Bureau of the Military Police. Taken in by Kibanohara Hokoyasu at a young age. A dependable sister figure for Ethica. [From the in-game profile] [Spoiler]She is the biological daughter of Aso Yukari and most likely a "designer baby".

characters.name: Con Su
characters.description: Owner of the Frozen Nirvana, a junk shop located in the Hyper Ghetto. A highly-skilled hacker, her true face is that of an information broker. Frequently does business with the Karasuzumi Living Dead Stalker Agency. A complete shut-in who never leaves her store. [Spoiler]Was formerly held in captivity at the Ikebukuro CPC, where she was close friends with Hogyo Iria. Went to great lengths to search out Iria's whereabouts after the Ikebukuro CPC was dissolved; Iria's escape from The Fortress was facilitated by none other than Con Su. [From the in-game profile]

characters.name: Karasuzumi Ryouko
characters.description: Head of the Karasuzumi Living Dead Stalker Agency. [Spoiler]Married to Karasuzumi Ikkatsu until his untimely death. Has yet to remarry. Perhaps a little too sexy for her own good. Known to lounge about the agency clad only in underwear. [From the in-game profile]

characters.name: Milgram
characters.description: An infamous Necromancer and menace to society. The highest bounty in human history has been placed on his head. Proponent of the Antibiotic Front and spiritual leader of the Suicide Wannabes. Leads an elite group of Necromancers known as The Laboratory. [Spoiler]Resurrected Nagaoka Sakiko as a living dead at Nagaoka Takeyuki's behest. [From the in-game profile]

characters.name: Ichihara Tokitaka
characters.description: A Private Special Living Dead Stalker working for the Karasuzumi Living Dead Stalker Agency. Specializes in sniping using his [Url=https://www.nitroplus.co.jp/game/tokyonecro/img/weapon_ogasawara_anim.gif]Ogasawara TFD-20. [Spoiler]His father was a Necromancer killed by Karasuzumi Ikkatsu. A math fetishist with a sharp tongue. Not many people get along with him. [From the in-game profile]

characters.name: Karasuzumi Ikkatsu
characters.description: A former Living Dead Stalker and member of the Close Quarters Armed Martial Arts Training Unit. Died two and a half years ago, leaving behind Karasuzumi Ryoko as his widow. Nagaoka So'un and Ichihara Tokitaka's personal god, responsible for teaching them CQAMA. A vitally important figure in Kibanohara Ethica's life as well. His demeanor could best be described as rowdy. He had a penchant for armlocks and other types of grappling maneuvers. [Spoiler]Resurrected by Milgram as a living dead, modified into a centuar and equipped with a gas plant. [From the in-game profile]

characters.name: Kibanohara Hokoyasu
characters.description: Major General in the Tokyo Military Police. Head of the Public Order Bureau. Father to Kibanohara Ethica. Originally the leader of the Close Quarters Armed Martial Arts Training Unit, where he contributed greatly to both the development of the Ex-Brain and the refinement of CQAMA as a fighting style. [Spoiler]Fell deeply in love with Nagaoka Takeyuki. After Takeyuki's death, he extracted genetic information from his corpse and combined it with his own, creating a fertilized egg which Aso Yukari raised in her womb. Thus Kibanohara Ethica was born. Said to wear an iron mask, as his face never betrays even the slightest hint of emotion. [From the in-game profile]

characters.name: Nagisa Kazuma
characters.description: A Captain belonging to the Living Dead Countermeasures Division of the Organized Crime Department within the Public Order Bureau of the Military Police. Close friends with Aso Kiriri since their time together at the Higashinakano Military Police Academy. [From the in-game profile]

characters.name: Amachi Juichirou
characters.description: A legendary entrepreneur and premier figure in the world of military robot development. Founder of Amachi Robotic Industries. A super-elite who has hidden himself away from the outside world in The Fortress. [Spoiler]Behind the scenes, he runs a sexaroid business catering to VIPs. Created a miniature-scale mesh network within The Fortress and transferred his consciousness into it in an attempt to make contact with Sub-Con. [From the in-game profile]

characters.name: Sophia Kawarazaki
characters.description: CEO of the Empire Energy Corp. The driving force behind the Tokyo Rebirth Project and its most ardent proponent. Gives monthly presentations promoting it. [From the in-game profile]

characters.name: Yamanuma Kagekatsu
characters.description: Commanding officer of Empire Energy Corp's SAD. Absolutely loyal to Sophia Kawarazaki. [From the in-game profile]

characters.name: Sub-Con
characters.description: A mysterious girl who hijacks display devices throughout Tokyo to perform guerilla concerts. Considered by most to be a form of virtual idol. Commonly referred to as simply Sub-Con. [Spoiler]A consciousness which emerged from the mesh network and was given form by Hogyo Iria. [From the in-game profile]

characters.name: Olga
characters.description: "I'm staying here. Would you like to come with me?" A mysterious beauty who tried to contact Souun and Echika at Hotel Grande Silenzio. [From NITRO PLUS Official Site.]

characters.name: Sori Ayuka
characters.description: A Humanoid Operating Machine who serves Amachi Juichiro in The Fortress. [Spoiler]Contains the consciousness of the late Aso Yukari, transplanted by Kurushima Michiya. Taught programming to Iriya and helped her communicate with Sub-Con. [From the in-game profile]

characters.name: Gijou Sumihiko
characters.description: Mitsumi's older brother and heir to the Gijo house. [Spoiler]Killed two years ago only to be resurrected as a Living Dead by the Military Police in their research into necromancy.

characters.name: Tang Yunshan
characters.description: [Spoiler]The Necromancer responsible for the vice governor's abduction. Formerly a member of the Cheetah Special Operations group. Fights using military-style Chinese martial arts, with a high-voltage blade and langxian as his primary weapons. [From the in-game profile]

characters.name: Sukiyaki Daisuke
characters.description: A digital enka rapper popular in Tokyo. Heavily advertised. Leader of a group of assassins known as the Deconstruction Ninjas... or so his social media accounts would have you believe. [From the in-game profile]

characters.name: Pavlov
characters.description: A member of The Laboratory and Milgram's right-hand man. A formidable Necromancer in his own right. Despite his bulky frame, he is capable of extremely agile, unpredictable movement via the use of CNT wires. [From the in-game profile]

characters.name: Aso Yukari
characters.description: [Spoiler]Aso Kiriri's biological mother. Worked at the Busujima Laboratory. Became a living dead after being exposed to Lemures gas in an accident. Her consciousness was transferred to a Humanoid Operating Machine named Sori Ayuka by Kurushima Michiya. Fond of lotus-scented flavor capsules. [Edited from the in-game profile]

characters.name: Kurushima Michiya
characters.description: A former professor at Tokyo University. [Spoiler]Acted as the center chief at Ikebukuro CPC for 14 years. An expert in cognitive ethology, neuroscience, and brain science. Considered a prodigy during his time in the Busujima Laboratory. Most well-known for his New Generation Influencer Hypothesis. [Spoiler]So great was his love for Aso Yukari that he transferred her consciousness into a Humanoid Operating Machine after her untimely death. Thus Sori Ayuka came to be. [From the in-game profile]

characters.name: Nagaoka Takeyuki
characters.description: Nagaoka So'un's father. Formerly belonged to the Close Quarters Armed Martial Arts Training Unit. [Spoiler]Resurrected his wife Sakiko with Necromancy after she was killed by Milgram and his men. [From the in-game profile]

characters.name: Nagaoka Sakiko
characters.description: Nagaoka So'un's mother. The daughter of a wealthy businessman. Deeply loved her husband Nagaoka Takeyuki. [Spoiler]Assassinated by Pavlov, acting on Milgram's orders, at the end of the Sino-American War. Resurrected as a living dead by Milgram after Takeyuki begged him to give her back to him. [From the in-game profile]

full_description: Nemo ante mortem beatus. "Nobody can be called happy before their death." (Herodotus, "Histories") - The era of "Necromancers" has come. In the future, the world has been engulfed in the bitter cold of an ice age. And yet, Tokyo is surviving with its use of geothermal heat pipes to keep the city habitable. The protagonists, Kibanohara Ethica and Nagaoka Souun, are young "Private Special Living Dead Stalkers", contract killers who spend their working days executing necromancers and their undead minions. By practicing a special kind of martial art called "Close Quarter Armed Martial Arts", both of them have achieved great heights in their career. Out on a mission one day, Souun becomes involved in a fierce battle and meets a mysterious young girl who had been kidnapped for unknown reasons. Remembering nothing but her name, "Hougyou Ilia", she has become the target of a mysterious group of

title: SeaBed
description: SeaBed is a yuri-themed mystery visual novel told through the perspectives of three separate characters: Mizuno Sachiko, a designer plagued by hallucinations of her past lover; Narasaki Hibiki, Sachiko's friend and a psychiatrist researching the workings of human memories; and Takako, Sachiko's former lover who has been rapidly forgetting her past, including how or why the two women drifted apart despite being together since childhood. All three live in different worlds, but seek the same goal. To separate truth from illusion. To make sense of their own lives. ---- I saw a ghost in the living room. But as I was already used to the phenomenon, I did not let it interfere with the preparation of my evening meal. The ghost ate my fried egg and commended its taste. As I listened to her talk, my memories drifted back to the days we were still together. Back when we were in school, she asked me

characters.name: Mizuno Sachiko
characters.description: "At times, I'd wake up at night and hear all the sounds around me as if they were amplified. I'd feel like my head could burst at any second." Although she moved to Tokyo straight after graduating university in order to seek employment, Mizuno Sachiko soon quit her job to establish Clover Design with her childhood friend Takako, becoming its young CEO. Her main hobby is reading, but only because nothing else manages to interest her. Although Sachiko used to be quite an avid reader during her school years, finding a job means she now only opens a book every once in a while, whenever her schedule allows it. After meeting Takako – an inexhaustible source of enthusiasm, as well as a stark contrast to her own personality – during her childhood years, Sachiko’s interests began to shift to whatever the other woman was doing at a given time. [From Fruitbat Factory]

characters.name: Takako
characters.description: "This is as good a time as any, so let's check it out." Endlessly interested in and enthusiastic about the world, Takako gives the impression of a woman perpetually stuck in her childhood. She fell in love with Sachiko at first sight back when they first met at the age of five. However, she does not identify as a homosexual, stressing that Sachiko simply happened to be a woman. Takako discovers that she suffers from developmental amnesia, a condition that severely impairs her ability to recall many of her memories. [From Fruitbat Factory]

characters.name: Narasaki Hibiki
characters.description: "I just like observing people." A psychiatrist at Narasaki Mental Clinic. She was Sachiko's classmate and friend during her elementary school years, but the two drifted apart as they enrolled in different middle schools. After learning that Sachiko has been experiencing hallucinations, she takes it upon herself to treat her. She is extremely picky about her brand of coffee, perhaps because the beverage serves as her sole companion during those long hours spent immersed in research. Though not religious, she is a strong believer that everything happens for a reason, and all things have their place and order in the grand scheme of the world. [From Fruitbat Factory]

characters.name: Koma Mayuko
characters.description: "There are times when you feel you haven't forgotten anything, but it turns out to be just a short episode that wasn't really important." A nurse working for the Kunugihara Clinic. Mayuko is a super nurse who takes care of not only the patients but also of things to do with running the entire facility. She is a very kind and caring woman who loves gardening. [From Fruitbat Factory]

characters.name: Ichikawa Sanae
characters.description: "I like reading books, so I have everything I want right here." A patient at the Kunugihara Sanatorium. Sanae has stayed at the sanatorium since she was diagnosed with the same memory disorder as Takako. In addition to that, she has a weak constitution compared to most people. Sanae is an avid reader. No one except herself knows whether the reason why she spends all day in bed is because she doesn't feel well, or because she simply wants to read. From time to time, she works as a librarian at the library next door to the sanatorium, where she reads at the counter when no one else is around. [From Fruitbat Factory]

characters.name: Satou Kozue
characters.description: "It's like a crossword puzzle, right?" A middle high school girl who lives in a small village between mountains. For a girl of her age, Kozue has a clear goal for the future and every single day she works her hardest to accomplish it. On the other hand, she doesn't have any friends around her age to hang out with, which makes her a little different from the other kids. [From Fruitbat Factory]

characters.name: Akei Yurika
characters.description: "Well, there are things best left unknown, right?" A woman who helped to set up an inn in a seaport town. Lily is an amicable person who smiles all the time, but it is somewhat hard to figure out what she actually thinks. She is the inn's head chef, but the inn is always so deserted that she also works as a librarian at the library adjacent to the inn. [From Fruitbat Factory]

characters.name: Fujisaka Nanae
characters.description: "You gotta play dirty now and then to survive in the world." The young landlady of an inn in a seaport town. The western-style building used to be someone's private property before being renovated into the inn. Nanae doesn't seem too serious about her hotel business, considering the fact that they only have a couple of people in a year as guests at the inn. The inside of the building is adorned with antique furniture that she has personally purchased overseas. Treating everyone equally, she is loved by all the local kids. She met Sachiko by coincidence and discovered a good chemistry between them. [From Fruitbat Factory]

characters.name: Ooita Fumi
characters.description: "Are my plush toys a problem, too?" An employee at Clover Design. Fumi is Sachiko's junior from university and likes her very much, while she considers Takako her rival. She is such a big fan of stuffed animals that she both collects them and crafts them herself. Most recently, she's into sheep plushies. [From Fruitbat Factory]

characters.name: Inukai Takehiko
characters.description: "I've been here long enough to know better." A bespectacled highbrow guy. Takehiko is the only male employee at Clover Design. He is not very good with women, and there has never been anything more than work relations between him and any of his cowokers. He seems to have a secret crush on someone, but his shyness makes it impossible for her to become aware of it. [From Fruitbat Factory]

title: Rondo Duo -Yoake no Fortissimo- Punyu Puri ff
title_original: 輪舞曲Duo -夜明けのフォルテシモ- ぷにゅぷりff
description: A rumor was circulating about an after-school devil. Its true identity was students whose forbidden impulse is awaken. ""From a best friend to a best friend"". The desire was infectious. There is only one way to be free from it. That is to have a sexual intercourse and inject the seed of desire into the vagina. The want that comes from deep in the body. The ""new instinct"" arises. That is something that erects under the skirt. Its need for pleasure targets her close friends...!! Senior and junior students and best friends... all of the girls are captured and penetrated. And they wander in the school as the next after-school devil. The curse is all over the school. Most of the students experienced it by then. The order of the school was maintained only by their feeling of shame. Their sin was regarded as a rumor and their daily life continued as if nothing has happened... [From DLsite En

characters.name: Riko Flockheart
characters.original: リコ・フロックハート

title: Otome wa Boku ni Koishiteru
title_original: 処女はお姉さまに恋してる
description: One day, the heir to the prosperous Kaburagi Corporation, a soft-spoken yet cultured young man, received a visit from his family lawyer. He came to pass on the final wish of the boy's late grandfather: that he attend an all-girls school! With his childhood friend Mariya - a talented fashionista - to help him with the "transition," Mizuho enrolls in his new school. It's not long before a series of strange misunderstandings leads to him being elected the school's "Elder Sister," the idol of the entire student body! It's one wild event after another at this all-girls charm school! Can Mizuho make it through the year with his identity - and his dignity - intact? [Edited From MangaGamer]

characters.name: Kaburagi Mizuho
characters.description: Mizuho is a male protagonist who transfers to an all-girls school per his grandfather's will and must crossdress in order to attend. He already looks very androgynous, so the change thankfully isn't obvious to the other members of the school. However, Mizuho is always nervous about being found out and constantly worries that it will happen. In spite of this, he was well received on his first day at school and has already become very popular among the students. At first he was shocked when he found out about the will, but with the help of his childhood friend Mariya Mikado, who also attends the school, he was able to resign himself to transferring to the school. Despite making the change, he still uses language which is usually only used by males in Japan such as boku (僕), meaning "I". He is generally depicted in his school uniform wearing breast prostheses underneath. Mizuho had to use t

characters.name: Juujou Shion
characters.description: Shion is one of Mizuho's classmates who figures out that he is a boy almost immediately, after their second meeting, but tells him that she will keep it a secret from anyone else. She tends to have a silent demeanor and voice which helps to give her an appealing appearance to the rest of the students. The previous year, she actually had to leave school for a time soon after she was elected as the Elder due to an illness and had to spend her time in the hospital. In effect, she has come back this year in order to repeat her last year, though she still isn't fully recovered, as she will pass out if she exerts herself too much. She becomes an adviser and a female role-model for Mizuho. She has been engaged to Kazutaka Itsukushima who is Takako's older brother in Shion's path; Itsukushima family is upstart, and so Takako's father made Kazutaka to be engaged to Shion in order to get Juujou fa

characters.name: Mikado Mariya
characters.description: Mariya is Mizuho's first cousin and childhood friend who knows him very well. When it was decided that Mizuho would transfer to the all-girls school she also attends, she took it upon herself to transform him into a beautiful girl by use of makeup and seemed to have a lot of fun dressing him up. Mariya has a very spirited personality which she uses often to make sure Mizuho is acting feminine in every way: appearance, mannerisms, and even speech. This often includes using mild violence. Also, she has a temper, of which she has little control and which sometimes causes her to do unadvisable things or carry grudges to an extreme - such as her grudge against Takako. During most of the time that Mariya has known Mizuho, she has always been there as his support whenever he needed her, though later on in the series she finds that without her even realizing it, he has already managed to stand o

characters.name: Suouin Kana
characters.description: Kana is another one of the girls who lives in the same dormitory building as Mizuho, who becomes her onee-sama (お姉さま, meaning "Older sister"). Kana is more than happy to serve Mizuho any way she can, since she admires him immensely. Kana, who like Yukari is a first-year student, has been waiting for the chance to have an onee-sama as she has always been envious of Yukari having Mariya to fill that role. One of the defining features about her is that she often ends sentences with the phrase ~na no desu yo (roughly, "it's the case that..."). Kana wears a large pink ribbon in her hair which was given to her by the director of the orphanage she lived at for much of her life. Ultimately, the director, who loved Kana in place of her missing parents, died right after giving her the ribbon and due to this, she almost never takes the ribbon off. Kana has never seen her mother's or father's faces.

characters.name: Kamioka Yukari
characters.description: Yukari is one of the first year students at the school who lives in the same dormitory building as Mizuho and Mariya, who also is her onee-sama; it is a tradition for the underclassmen to serve their respective senpai any way they can. Much like Kana and Mariya, she is a very energetic girl, although unlike them, she is deathly afraid of ghost stories and anything scary - a fact which Mariya has often used for her own amusement and which initially caused some trouble when Yukari met Ichiko. Yukari is on the track and field team along with Mariya, though her main reason for joining was due to her older sister-in-law who had urged her to come to this school and who was also in track and field. However, Yukari soon comes to discover that she really does have a liking for track and field and continues activities in the club even after a time of losing much of her self-confidence. Her another

characters.name: Itsukushima Takako
characters.description: Takako is the student council president of the all-girls school where the story takes place. She tends to have a serious personality which compliments that of a student council president. As the president, she knows that she must be very decisive in her actions and thus cannot often hesitate with her decisions, since she knows the students would have trouble following her if she didn't act as such. As it is, Takako herself has stated how she almost never has confidence in herself. In contrast to her usual attitude, she has shown herself to have a more gentle side to her character. Eventually, she begins to form feelings for Mizuho, though while still under the belief that Mizuho is a girl, she is at first confused about what she has been feeling. She also has a high fear of ghosts. A few years back, Takako was invited to join the track and field team during the same time that the electio

characters.name: Takashima Ichiko
characters.description: Ichiko is, in fact, a ghost. Her story begins 22 years ago: a previous Elder (actually Mizuho's mother) had a close relationship with an underclassmen who had a weak body. When that underclassman was in hospital, she could not wait to see the Elder. The underclassman got away from the hospital, went to the Elder's room, and waited, but she died before she had the chance to talk with the Elder. That room has been deemed the "closed room" ever since, until Mizuho arrived and started living in it, according to his grandfather's will. She is very energetic and hyperactive, often talking very fast. She took some time to understand that she is a ghost, and by that, dead. She says that Mizuho looks very much like her previous Elder love interest. Although she can touch people, she cannot pick up objects and she slips through walls. Invisible barriers prevent her from leaving the dorm, but her m

characters.name: Kajiura Hisako
characters.description: Hisako is Mizuho's homeroom teacher of his class (3-A) and is one of the few people in the entire school who knows that Mizuho is in fact a boy, other than Mariya, the headmistress, the deputy head teacher and later Shion and Ichiko. She has a helping personality and even told Mizuho to come to her if anything was bothering him. She often gives out candy to her students. She was a student of Seio Girls' Academy several years ago, but she had to transfer to another school because of her father's job. She became a sister and a teacher at the school because of Shiori's death after her changing school. [spoiler]Later, she resigns from the teacher, becomes a novelist and wrote a novel filled with memories about Shiori under the pen name Hisa Kamimura. Therefore she is a novelist, she is Chitose's homeroom teacher and the acting principal at the school because and Sawe (a sister at the academy

characters.name: Takanashi Kei
characters.description: Kei is a strange girl in Mizuho's class who usually has a quiet voice and doesn't show much emotion which often gives her a creepy visage. She is the director of the drama club and during times on stage she has to be very forceful in order to get a good response out of her actors. A character with the same name and similar appearance,Takanashi Kei, appears in Alicematic, a game made by Caramel Box (the same studio that created Otoboku).

characters.name: Takane Michiko
characters.description: Michiko is also in Mizuho's class and is a good friend of Kei's as they are constantly seen hanging out together. Unlike Kei, Michiko usually has a smile on her face and is a fairly social person. Voiced by: Hina Kamimura (PC), Yukari Fukui (PS2/PSP) [Taken from Wikipedia.]

characters.name: Hasegawa Shiori
characters.description: Shiori was Hisako's kouhai at Seio Girls' Academy in her school days. She was good at the piano and was a scholarship student of the music class at the school. [Taken from Wikipedia.]

characters.name: Sugawara Kimie
characters.description: Kimie is a treasurer of the student council and as such, she follows Takako around almost all the time. When they are not together, Kimie will go around investigating various matters and report back to Takako. Much like Takako, she has a very serious personality and would not stop at sticking up for Takako when need be. [spoiler]She becomes the student council president for the next term in Takako's path. She is the seventy-third elder sister and her another name is Kaguya no Kimi. [Taken from Wikipedia.]

characters.name: Mikura Sawe
characters.description: Sawe is a sister and a principal at Seio Girls' Academy. She admitted Mizuho to the school, which makes her one of the few people who knew that Mizuho is a boy from the beginning. Voiced by: Hitomi Aoi

characters.name: Ukitsu Kanako
characters.description: Kanako, is same grade with Yukari and Kana, is a secretary of student council in the first and second grades, and the vice-president in the third grade. She speaks in a slow tone. She has a younger sister named Sayoko, who appears in Otoboku's sequel, Futari no Elder. [Taken from Wikipedia.]

characters.name: Kadokura Youko
characters.description: Youko is in the same grade as Kimie, she the student council's vice-president at the school and has a cool personality. She becomes the student council vice-president, or the president, depends on the route. She is called "Mikado no Kimi" in the third grade. [Taken from Wikipedia.]

characters.name: Kouhara Kayano
characters.description: Kayano is the head of the flower arrangement club. She is Mariya's flower arrangement tutor, and she is personally acquainted with Shion. [Taken from Wikipedia.]

characters.name: Kaburagi Yoshiyuki
characters.description: Yoshiyuki is Mizuho's father and is the president of the Kaburagi financial group. [Taken from Wikipedia.]

characters.name: Hisaishi
characters.description: Hisaishi was a family lawyer of Mizuho's grandfather Mitsuhisa. He was presented Mitsuhisa's surprising will to Mizuho along with Mariya. [Taken from Wikipedia.]

characters.name: Miyanokouji Sachiho
characters.description: Mizuho's deceased mother. Was once Elder Sister back when she was alive. Went to Seio 22 years before Mizuho did and was a close friend of Ichiko. Is described to have looked almost exactly like Mizuho. Died when Mizuho was very young.

characters.name: Juujou Sumire
characters.description: Shion's mother.

title: don't take it personally, babe, it just ain't your story
description: A spiritual successor of sorts to Digital: A Love Story, set in a prestigious private high school and on the social networks of 2027. Seven students, three endings, one eavesdropping teacher. A full length visual novel about the erosion of privacy, young sexuality, queerness, and the perils of contemporary online life in a high school literature class.

title: Fatal Twelve
description: Shishimai Rinka was a highschooler who ran a small café named Lion House in place of her grandmother. She lived her life much like any other person her age, but one day, she was caught up in an explosion while returning home on the train alongside her friend, Hitsuji Naomi. In an attempt to save her friend's life, she shields her on instinct the moment the explosion goes off, losing her life in the process. However, before she knew it, she was back at Lion House, happily chatting with her friends as if nothing had happened in the first place. A few days later, she found herself in a strange world. Here she met Parca, an odd girl claiming to be a goddess. It turns out that she had somehow become a participant in Divine Selection, a ritual carried out over twelve weeks by twelve people, which allowed them to compete in order to undo their deaths. What shocked Rinka most of all, however, wa

characters.name: Shishimai Rinka
characters.description: She currently runs a small café named Lion House in place of her grandmother, who returned to the countryside temporarily to take care of a relative. The blonde streaks in her hair are natural, but have caused her peers to label her as a delinquent. To that effect, she rarely speaks to anyone there other than her friends Miharu, Mao and Naomi. This fact doesn't particularly bother her however, especially as she's not one for keeping up with trends and adjusting her attitude to those around her. Ironically she's also seen as cool and aloof thanks to that, when in reality she cares for her friends deeply. She has no particular hobbies to speak of, though she does enjoy shopping and reading shoujo manga. Black coffee is a favorite of hers, though she dislikes anything either too bitter or too sweet. One day while returning home with Naomi, she dies while shielding Naomi from an explosion, b

characters.name: Goddess Parca
characters.description: An odd girl who claims to be a goddess. She oversees Divine Selection, and only interacts with Rinka and the other participants within the strange dream world it takes place in. Unlike the participants, she can also move around freely in this space. She feels absolutely nothing over the events that take place during Divine Selection. Her white dress and wool-like hair provide a fantastical air to her appearance, and while she may speak like a lady from the upper echelons of society, she has little issue saying some rather horrible things. Very little is known about her, including her preferences or even how she spends her time when not overseeing Divine Selection. [From Sekai Project's site] [spoiler]She was known as Dianna, sister of Linda, great-great-grandmother to Rinka while alive

characters.name: Hitsuji Naomi
characters.description: Rinka's underclassman at Amecha Girls' University High School. Shy and introverted most of the time, though she has no issues talking to those she gets along with. Came to know Rinka through certain circumstances, and eventually became friends with Mao and Miharu through her. A bookworm at heart, she also enjoys making sweets often. Dark places and scary stories are two of her biggest weaknesses. She has a solid relationship with her parents. Her tendency to keep her feelings to herself lead to her classmates assigning her as head of the committee for the cafe they plan on opening during the culture festival, but her dedication to doing the best possible job leads to her learning how to brew coffee from Rinka. The events of Rinka's death haunt her dreams despite said events having been erased due to Divine Selection, possibly because she was present at the time. While not a participant,

characters.name: Mishima Miharu
characters.description: A student at Amecha Girls' University High School, and one of Rinka's classmates. While beautiful with the brains to match, others consider her difficult to approach, which results in her being avoided much like Rinka. As one would imagine, studying is her specialty, to the point where she can go for long hours without any breaks once she gets into it. Her eating habits would indicate that she isn't fussy in the slightest, but in reality she simply doesn't care much for taste in the first place. She works part-time at a certain restaurant, but apparently she's yet to ask Rinka and Mao to come along at some point. While typically level-headed, she sometimes speaks her mind without hesitation, leading to some harsh takes now and then. Her circumstances while growing up seem to be somewhat complicated, but not even Rinka knows much about it. Her feelings for Rinka surpass the boundaries of

characters.name: Oguma Mao
characters.description: Rinka's classmate and the mood maker of the group. Seemingly has little interest in her classmates other than Rinka and Miharu, though unlike them she does have other friends. She loves shopping like no other, to the point that her first priority at amusement parks is to hit up the gift stores. Rinka makes it a point not to tell her about Divine Selection, though she has noticed that something isn't quite right. [From official site]

characters.name: Chan Chan
characters.description: A young and cheerful lady. Both her and her husband died in an accident while on their honeymoon, but Divine Selection made it so that both of them returned home safe and sound. To this effect, her elimination would result in her husband's death as well, leading her to desperate measures. [From official site]

A mysterious child who crossed paths with Rinka and Naomi as they were making their way home. Gender unknown; Rinka thinks female, while Naomi thinks male. While later revealed to be a participant in Divine Selection, further details are unknown. [From official site] [spoiler]Though he was never given a birth name, he later adopts the name, Yu, after Shigetsugu gives it to him.

characters.name: Strange Man
characters.description: An androgynous man who appeared in Rinka's dreams. He seems to live in the dream world, but it's unknown if he has any ties to Parca. Rinka has no recollection of meeting him. [From official site] [spoiler]He's Lethe the cat, which Rinka takes care of and named Leo when Dianna was still alive.

characters.name: Sofiya Priessnitz Alexeievna
characters.original: ソフィア・プリズニェツィ・アレクセーエヴナ
characters.description: A girl from Russia who boldly confronts Rinka in the real world despite being a participant in Divine Selection. What could she be planning…? [From official site]

characters.name: Scale Jones
characters.original: スケール・ジョーンズ
characters.description: A man with an upbeat mentality. He calmly observed the situation during the beginning of the Divine Selection and little he gets involved in gathering information on Divine Selection. He scrutinizes every action as good or evil and has stated that if the last one standing in Divine Selection is someone of justice, he'd gladly give up the right to be that person. He's been seen drinking at the bar with Federico and Odette but what exactly is his relationship with those two...? [From official site]

characters.name: Alan Scorpion
characters.original: アラン・スコーピオン
characters.description: An Indian man of little words. His personality makes his actions hard to predict, though it's apparent that he has every intention of eliminating every other Divine Selection participant without mercy. What motivates him is unknown, but there's certainly more to him than meets the eye. [From official site]

characters.name: Federico Carminati
characters.original: フェデリーコ・カルミナーティ
characters.description: The Italian Stallion. Seemingly a member of the mafia until he stirred up a certain incident, resulting in his death and participation in Divine Selection. Develops something of a friendly rivalry with Odette, another participant, and they agree to help each other until they're the final two left. Incredibly proud of his homeland, and convinced that no other country boasts food better than Italy. This leads to plenty of disputes with Odette. His main priorities when it comes to women are their appearance and chest size. While rather happy go lucky most of the time, he's known to display his mafioso side when the circumstances call for it. [From official site]

characters.name: Odette Malencon
characters.original: オデット・マランソン
characters.description: A French woman blessed with an incredible physique. Apparently the representative for a shipping company affiliated with the underworld who were known for taking on illegal work. This led to her clashing with pirates and military forces often, much to her delight as a fighting nut. Formed a friendlky rivalry with Federico not long after Divine Selection began, agreeing to help one another become the last two participants. Has a very larger than life attitude, but boasts an impeccable perception and capacity for reasoning. To this effect, she rarely lets Federico handle important tasks, opting to work on her own. [From official site]

characters.name: Ro Chanho
characters.description: A well-built middle aged man from China. Apparently works for one of the country's most influential companies. [From official site]

characters.name: Kamebuchi Keiko
characters.description: A woman of many misfortunes, her weak condition seemingly led to her being hospitalized for a long period of time. While a participant in Divine Selection, Alan acquires her name card immediately after the ritual began. [From official site]

characters.name: Ushizuka Shigetsugu
characters.description: Seemingly the oldest participant in Divine Selection. His attitude in the dream world makes him difficult to read, though this could be a façade in order to keep his emotions hidden. [From official site]

full_description: Shishimai Rinka was a highschooler who ran a small café named Lion House in place of her grandmother. She lived her life much like any other person her age, but one day, she was caught up in an explosion while returning home on the train alongside her friend, Hitsuji Naomi. In an attempt to save her friend's life, she shields her on instinct the moment the explosion goes off, losing her life in the process. However, before she knew it, she was back at Lion House, happily chatting with her friends as if nothing had happened in the first place. A few days later, she found herself in a strange world. Here she met Parca, an odd girl claiming to be a goddess. It turns out that she had somehow become a participant in Divine Selection, a ritual carried out over twelve weeks by twelve people, which allowed them to compete in order to undo their deaths. title: Sono Hanabira ni Kuchizuke o: Anata o Suki na Shiawase
title_original: その花びらにくちづけを　あなたを好きな幸せ
description: Reo fails her classes and Mai helps her to pass. To reward Reo for passing her quiz, Mai agrees to go on a date with Reo. One day during class, Reo is called to the school office. She returns acting strangely. After a lot of worrying and probing, Mai still does not know what has happened. This results in a huge fight between Reo and Mai, because Mai feels that Reo does not trust in her enough to share her problems… They eventually make up and ends in love. [From a review by Yi]

characters.name: Kitajima Kaede
characters.description: An extremely shy and fairly nerdish girl. She is also Sara's cousin and is very protective of her. Second year student of St. Michael's Girl's Academy. She has been elected as class president two years in a row.

characters.name: Kitajima Sara
characters.description: A popular teen model who has return from overseas to attend St. Michael's to be with her cousin Kaede. Sara has harbored feelings for Kaede ever since childhood. [Edited from Wikipedia]

characters.name: Sawaguchi Mai
characters.description: A very responsible second year high school student who has some tomboy tendencies. She falls in love with Reo after getting to know a different side of her. [From Wikipedia]

characters.name: Kawamura Reo
characters.description: A short second year high school student. She is antisocial, a tsundere and in love with Mai. [Edited from Wikipedia]

full_description: Reo fails her classes and Mai helps her to pass. To reward Reo for passing her quiz, Mai agrees to go on a date with Reo. One day during class, Reo is called to the school office. This results in a huge fight between Reo and Mai, because Mai feels that Reo does not trust in her enough to share her problems… They eventually make up and ends in love. [From a review by Yi]

title: FLOWERS -Le volume sur automne-
description: Yatsushiro Yuzuriha, president of the school's Council of Nicaea, knows the truth hidden within the school. The silver-haired beauty seeks to prevent Suou from reaching it by giving her what seems like an impossible task—take over the role of president and she'll hand over the key to what she desires. However, Yuzuriha is harboring her own secret, buried deep within herself... As the leaves turn and strange incidents continue to plague the isolated Saint Angraecum Academy, interweaving threads of emotion tangle together in an intricate story of love and truth. This is the third game in the Flowers visual novel series from Innocent Grey, renowned for its beautiful artwork, engaging stories, and complex characters. [Taken from Steam]

characters.name: Shirahane Suou
characters.description: A quiet, anxious, timid girl— However, she is misunderstood; her beauty, which sets her apart from the herd, and her silence is seen as cool, and the timidity that prevents her from mixing with everyone is seen as independence. Before she came to the academy, she went to live with her grandfather due to her family situation, and was homeschooled, therefore she is not good at interacting with people. However, it is not because she hates people; her desire to make friends is double that of most people. Also, she is extremely shy, and this in combination with her anxiety means that she always blushes when she gets nervous. Because books and movies are her friends, she has a habit of quoting lines from books and movies in her conversations. Her Amitie partners are Mayuri and Rikka. Her interests are literature, music, and film. [From Jast USA]

characters.name: Hanabishi Rikka
characters.description: A very serious, calm girl who is good at taking care of others. She is like the mother of the class; she is not only kind but when someone does something bad, she will say so, like a mother who is kind yet strict. Cherished for her thoughtfulness toward others, she stands at the heart of class with Mayuri Kousaka in terms of influence. Because she was the top scoring student on the entrance exam, along with her caring and her ability to make things happen, she was named the class president. She takes pride in the fact that she can handle all that is expected of her, takes initiative, and devotes herself to the role. [From Jast USA]

characters.name: Sasaki Ichigo
characters.description: A troublemaker brimming with curiosity. It isn’t that she intentionally brings on disaster; her sheltered life means that she knows nothing, and so she naturally invites misunderstandings and trouble. She started life at the boarding school with her twin sister, and overall is satisfied with all the novelty at the academy. She is cheery, so she speaks openly with the people around her, and gets along well with her classmates. She is especially close with Mayuri Kohsaka. Her interests are the latest fashions and collecting frog memorabilia. [From Jast USA]

characters.name: Sasaki Ringo
characters.description: She is often thought to be the laidback opposite of her bubbly sister... but in truth she is just a bit lazy. People who know her for a long time come to see her eccentric personality. Perhaps because she is an eccentric and is not afraid of anything, she speaks freely with Suoh, who most people regard as unapproachable, and the two quickly became acquaintances. Perhaps they are drawn to each other because of their love of books… Her interests are reading and ghost stories. [From Jast USA]

characters.name: Yatsushiro Yuzuriha
characters.description: Eccentric and dynamic. Because of her way of speaking and the randomness of the things she says, she is thought to be strange, but that is her world. She is thought to be egotistic, but perhaps because she is the president of organizations, she is good at looking out for and taking care of others. Though her words and actions are theatrical, her position as the president of the Council of Nicaea gives her a kind of dignity. She is well trusted by all students at the academy. She is childhood friends with Nerine Komikado, the vice president of the Council of Nicaea, whom she calls Neri. Although she belongs to the cooking club, she is terrible at cooking. Her interests are sports and photography. [From Jast USA]

characters.name: Komikado Nerine
characters.description: A virtuous and gentle Catholic girl who is good with people. Her otherworldly beauty and the fact that she is half-European builds a natural wall around her, making her a bit unapproachable. She likes to be spoiled but she does not show this side to just anybody. She is the vice president of the Council of Nicaea and childhood friends with the Council’s president, Yuzuriha Yatsushiro. Their closeness is such that at one point there were unsubstantiated rumors that she and Yuzuriha Yatsushiro were in a relationship. She belongs to the choir and is the club president. She is a soprano. Her interests are scary stories and walking while eating. She is a bottomless pit when it comes to sweets. [From Jast USA]

characters.name: Dalia Basquiat
characters.description: One of the nuns at Saint Angraecum Academy. She is a mild and tolerant teacher, and is more like a laidback older sister than a mother. Because she is a strict follower of Catholicism, she has a tendency to apply her religion to things that have nothing to do with it. She is in charge of the ballet lessons for the first year students and is well trusted by them. Thinking that she should turn her attention toward something other than religion, she has recently been raising her namesake flower, the dahlia, in the greenhouse and creating new varieties by her own hand. Her interests are ballet and gardening. [From Jast USA]

characters.name: Yaegaki Erika
characters.description: A strange, asocial girl. She talks like a man, but this is her way of building a wall between herself and others. Generally she likes to be by herself, though she will speak to others to tease them. Her whimsical cat-like character makes her elusive. What part will she play in the tale… She is known as the girl in the wheelchair. Unable to move her legs due to illness, she lives her life in a wheelchair. Her interests are reading and finding people’s weak points. [From Jast USA]

characters.name: Takasaki Chidori
characters.description: An eccentric ballet celebrity. Thought of as unapproachable since her emotions don't show on her face, she often causes unnecessary drama because of her tendency to ask questions about things she shouldn't. She'll express herself honestly when it comes to things she's interested in. Other than that, she doesn't do anything unnecessary. Before entering the academy, she was involved in the entertainment industry, predominantly theater, and so is one of the best in the school at ballet and singing She is assigned as Erika's Amitié partner, but their mutual eccentricities lead to them often being at odds with one another. Her hobbies are classical ballet and voice training. [Benichidori (Rosaceae family)] Language of Flowers: [How Lovely] [Refinement] [Nobility] [Devotion] [From English official page and Japanese official page]

title: Sugar's Delight
description: When Ichigo’s parents realize their daughter’s dream is to own and run a bakery they do everything they can to force her away from such a career and toward a more prestigious calling. However, in a fit of determination and frustration, Ichigo moves out and on her own with the desire to prove just how serious she is about her sweet passion. After a brief amount of time, Ichigo stumbles upon Sugar’s Delight; a small bakery owned by the somewhat oblivious, but mature and incredibly kind “Chocoa”. In no time at all, Ichigo is working her dream job and learning everything there is to know about running a bakery, and things hardly seem like they could get any better… That is, until Ichigo begins obtaining more than just lessons about how to bake the most delicious of strawberry cakes. title: Katahane
description: The story takes place in a world with 3 kingdoms, the Red, White, and Blue Kingdom. In this world, they have highly-advanced dolls with some closely resembling humans. These dolls occasionally need maintenance which is done by a “tuner”. A young playwright named Wakaba writes a controversial play about a traitor named Ein who killed a ruler of the White Kingdom, Christina. In Wakaba’s play, she presumes that Ein did not betray Christina, but was actually her loyal supporter. When Wakaba’s friend Cero needs to make a trip to get Coco, a doll that lives with him, maintenance, Wakaba and her brother Light travel with him. Wakaba travels in the hopes of finding some actors for her play. Along the way, they meet a beautiful doll with one wing named Belle and an aspiring actress named Angelina. The story takes place in 2 parts: 1) Shirohane - the main story with Wakaba and gang 2) Kurohane - t

characters.name: Angelina Rocca
characters.original: アンジェリナ・ロッカ
characters.description: A girl from Blew, the Blue Capital. Angelina lives in an ophanage and works as a butcher. She aims to become a stage actress and auditioned for the role of Princess Cristina before, but she did not pass the audition. Later she was invited by Wakaba to stand on the stage in Moosgrun's theatre festival.

characters.name: Belle
characters.description: A doll from Silberg created by the famous doll engineer Rein. Belle looks like a human girl, except for the white wing in her back. She likes singing but she cannot sing in public. [spoiler]She was one of the experimental prototypes in project of returning Efa to life so she looks exacly the same.

characters.name: Coco
characters.description: A child-like doll that lives in Moosgrun with Cero. Unlike Bell, she has visible ball joints and a wind-up key on her back, giving her the appearance of a real doll. Coco acts in a very childish manner and usually shortens long names.

characters.name: Wakaba Faure
characters.description: An aspiring novelist from Moosgrun. She begins to write a play, an adaptation of the famous story "The Angel's Guidance", but portraying the villain, Ein, as a good person. Wakaba travels with Cero to find actors to perform her play for Moosgrun's theatre festival. [spoiler]Actually Wakaba's family is distant relatives of Dorn family and pendant "Dorn's Memory" is their heirloom treasure.

characters.name: Dua Carlstedt
characters.original: デュア・カールステッド
characters.description: Captain of castle guards in Christina's castle and the First knight. The only heiress of the Karlstedt family. [spoiler]It's hinted that she has love interest in Ein

characters.name: Valery Jacquard
characters.original: ヴァレリー・ジャカール
characters.description: Ambassador of the Blue Kingdom. [spoiler]The main mastermind behind the plan of ending the reign of Christina. Was killed by Ein closer to the end of kurohane story.

characters.name: Cero Sahade
characters.description: Student of the History faculty of Moosgrun university. Best friend and love interest of Wakaba, same as Coco's caretaker. Cero took the passion for history from his deceased father. Always patient and polite he still could be quite stubborn and bold than necessary.

characters.name: Christina Dorn
characters.original: クリスティナ・ドルン
characters.description: Last princess of the White Kingdom and master doll engineer. [spoiler] She fell in love with Efa which lead to her death but her memories still resides in Efa's Memory stone.

characters.name: Efa
characters.description: Actress Sister from Red Kingdom who visited Dornstein castle to participate in memorial play with Coco and princess Christina.

characters.name: Coco
characters.description: New type doll from Blue Kingdom who visited Dornstein Castle to participate in memorial play with Efa and princess Christina.

characters.name: Ein Romberg
characters.description: Major-dome of the White Kingdom. Officially he killed princess Christina and betrayed his kingdom. But...

characters.name: Light Faure
characters.description: Wakaba's brother and Coco's best friend. He argues with his sister a lot but they still get along quite right.

characters.name: Silvia Perez
characters.description: Female Doll engineer and swindler. Wakaba and company met her in White capital. [spoiler]Silvia was born in a rich family and was quite a spoiled child. But than the Sister which she was friends with broken, Silvia changed and decided to became a Doll engineer. She is in love with Tonino but can't confess to him honestly because of her personality.

characters.name: Tonino Starabba
characters.original: トニーノ ストラブーバ
characters.description: Wondering journeyman. He could do any legal(or even a bit illegal) job for the money. Silvia's partner, hopelessly in love with her. [spoiler]Tonino was raised in the same orphanage as Angelina but left it to meet his father who were professional actor. But he left him too because of strict actor trainings.

characters.name: Hans Brant
characters.description: The ambassador of the White Kingdom in Blue Kingdom. Accomplice of the lord Jussi and Valery Jacquard.

characters.name: Jussi Osbourne
characters.description: Former minister of White kingdom. And the accomplice of Valery Jacquard.

characters.name: Flora
characters.description: One of the Belle's alarm clock dolls. [spoiler]She was created by Rein's crush, Doll engineer Rooth.

characters.name: Lulu
characters.description: A honorable child from Nicola's orphanage. Lulu's gender is unknown in the story (when Coco asked Lulu about that she just got "it's a secret" as an answer).

characters.name: Paula
characters.description: A child from Nicola's orphanage. She got Angelina's room after her leaving.

characters.name: Fabio Grey
characters.description: Famous theatrical actor. Quite eccentric man outside the scene.

characters.name: Marion Curie
characters.description: Famous theatrical actress. Angelina's friend, mentor and former crush. Married with Fabio.

characters.name: Red Kingdom's Ambassador
characters.description: The leader of the Red Kingdom's delegation.

characters.name: Nicola Rocca
characters.description: The director of the orphanage there Angelina was raised. Strict but kind woman with some past.

characters.name: Rein Helmer
characters.description: The greatest Doll engineer of the modern time owning the title of National treasure. Cero's caretaker and the creator of Belle who always calls him "Father". [spoiler]His real name is Ein Ronberg which caused him a lot of trouble in the past. Ein was former illusionist so he took his stage name "Rein Helmer" as main. He was one of the lead researchers in the "Efa resurrecting project" but retired after a few failures and falling in love with his colledge, dollmaker Rooth.

title: Love Ribbon
description: "Love Ribbon" is a yuri (girl x girl) visual novel about forbidden love between two sisters. The story follows Iris, a girl who learns that her younger sister is transferring to her school, and will be living with her for the rest of the semester. Even though she has never met her sister before, Iris is determined to make up for lost time by becoming friends, and more importantly, to show off her dependable nature as the older sister of the household. Unfortunately for Iris, however, things don't go as planned. Zoey, Iris's younger sister, is a tall young woman who isn’t afraid to ditch class and badmouth others. Zoey shows little respect for authority, especially when it comes to her "older sister's" attempts to play nice. And if things couldn't get any worse, a confusing sexual tension blooms between them... [From Steam]

characters.description: A second-year high school student. She is smart, attractive, popular and rich girl who is admired by the students of St. Michael's. Yet she falls in love with the clumsy and average Nanami. [Edited from Wikipedia]

characters.name: Oda Nanami
characters.description: A first-year high school student. Despite being a pretty average girl with bad luck, she has caught the attention of the famous Yuuna. [From Wikipedia]

characters.name: Sawaguchi Mai
characters.description: A very responsible second year high school student who has some tomboy tendencies. She falls in love with Reo after getting to know a different side of her. [From Wikipedia]

title: missed messages.
description: "goth gf's iPhone" airdrops you a photo. Accept or decline? A romance / horror story about life, death, and memes. A shift in perspective can change everything. [From itch.io] Created for Ludum Dare #44 (theme: "your life is currency").

characters.name: You
characters.description: The protagonist doesn't feel embarrassed in stating she is lesbian or that she likes Madoka Magica. Lives with May, her roomate and best friend. She has a problem focusing on work and studing. Her dream is to become a video game developer or video game artist.

characters.name: May
characters.description: The protagonist's roomate. It seems she has a few problems with her parents. A little shy but kind, she doesn't want to cause any troubles to the people around her. She was the only person who remembered her friend's birthday.

characters.name: Amy
characters.description: A bored girl who doen't have a problem in chatting with extrangers. She feels lonely after she had to part ways with her old friends when she had to move out. Currently, Amy is looking for new friends and, if possible, a new romance. She loves using expensive makeup and hates the rain and crying.

title: Heart of the Woods
description: Traveling to a remote village in the woods, Maddie and Tara have low expectations. The two run a popular online show focusing on the supernatural, but thus far it’s been nothing but smoke and mirrors. When they receive an invitation to the antiquated village of Eysenfeld, they’re expecting more of the same. But it soon becomes apparent that the locals are hiding a secret. Maddie sees unnatural beasts in the forest that she’s sure are products of her imagination. Lights in the woods flicker and sparkle but disappear if she gets too close. In time she learns that the lights come from a girl named Abigail. Well, the ghost of a girl. She was sacrificed hundreds of years ago by the villagers to appease the god of the forest. Maddie devotes her time in Eysenfeld to getting to know Abigail, and eventually promises to break the curse that binds her to the woods. [From Official site]

characters.name: Tara Bryck
characters.description: One of the world's most popular paranormal vloggers (according to her), Tara is unfailingly charismatic and bursting with limitless energy. She's brash, intrepid, and always seeking something new. That often makes her a magnet for trouble: whether it's from relentless flirting, minor criminal activities or just plain pig-headedness, things around Tara have a tendency to end in chaos. Hobbies: Photography, party planning Likes: Likes, comments, subscribers Dislikes: Horses, Brussels sprouts, instruction manuals Fun fact: Has been arrested for trespassing four times in four different states [From press kit]

characters.name: Abigail Dalsing
characters.description: For the last two centuries, the ghost of a young woman has haunted the forests of Eysenfeld. That ghost is Abigail, a kind and playful soul forcibly bound to the forest as part of an ancient curse. Two hundred years of wishing for a life cruelly denied to her have led to a feeling of crushing loneliness and one overwhelming desire: to finally have someone to talk to. Hobbies: Painting, singing Likes: Animals, snowy days, little cheek kisses Dislikes: Silence, fire, sudden loud noises Fun fact: Absolutely terrified of ghost stories [From press kit]

characters.name: Morgan Fischer
characters.description: A loyal Taranormal viewer and the daughter of Eysenfeld's mayor, Morgan is...different. When not running her small and mostly empty antique shop, she's known to disappear into the woods for days at a time. That, combined with her resistance to traditional social standards, has caused her to develop a bit of a notorious reputation in the village. However, this resistance is not just an act of rebellion: Morgan knows that there's something sinister deep within Eysenfeld, and she's not going to stop until she tears it out at the roots. Hobbies: Wandering, horseback riding Likes: Cats, fairy tales, camping Dislikes: Antiques, maps, dial-up Fun fact: Drinks at least 5 cups of coffee every day. Still always tired. [From press kit]

characters.name: Madison Raines
characters.description: A part-time manager, part-time video editor, and full-time babysitter, Maddie has the thankless job of handling the absolute whirlwind that is her best friend Tara. She's professional, meticulous and intellectual; the first person to turn to when a problem needs solving. But when their investigation entangles her in an ancient curse, she's forced to confront phenomena beyond her comprehension, and more importantly, her own self-doubt. Hobbies: Film analysis, piano Likes: Succulents, day planners, peace and quiet Dislikes: Cold weather, quinoa, flip flops Fun fact: Still tortured by her teenage goth phase [From press kit]

characters.name: Geladura
characters.description: Cat of an unknown origin, who has been keeping Morgan's company throughout her life.

characters.name: Evelyn Fischer
characters.description: Morgan's mother, and the mayor of Eysenfeld. With a frigid personality that borders on terrifying, she commands respect from those she encounters. Not that her daughter ever offers it. It's clear from the beginning that she's not happy about Maddie and Tara's visit to her town. But Morgan claims that Evelyn is worse than she seems. Much worse. [From Kickstarter]

characters.name: The Fairies
characters.description: Fluttering and skittering about the trees, fairies are content to keep to themselves for the most part. However, their queen has been missing for a very, very long time. So they wait, in hopes that she will return someday, or that a suitable replacement may present herself...

characters.name: The Fairy Queen
characters.description: Queen of the fairies, and an important part of the forest. However, it's been decades since she was last seen.

full_description: Traveling to a remote village in the woods, Maddie and Tara have low expectations. The two run a popular online show focusing on the supernatural, but thus far it’s been nothing but smoke and mirrors. When they receive an invitation to the antiquated village of Eysenfeld, they’re expecting more of the same. But it soon becomes apparent that the locals are hiding a secret. Maddie sees unnatural beasts in the forest that she’s sure are products of her imagination. Lights in the woods flicker and sparkle but disappear if she gets too close. In time she learns that the lights come from a girl named Abigail. Well, the ghost of a girl. She was sacrificed hundreds of years ago by the villagers to appease the god of the forest. Maddie devotes her time in Eysenfeld to getting to know Abigail, and eventually promises to break the curse that binds her to the woods. [From Official site]

title: Aoishiro
tags: Heroine Based on a Mythological Character
description: The Seijou Girls’ Academy Kendo Club is traveling to Shoushinji for a Summer training camp. Near there is an island, Urashima, where legend has it a demon extermination took place long ago. They arrive around the time of a festival which honors a god that is worshipped by the people of Urashima; it celebrates the onitaiji and ensure another year of health for the people. Around the time of the festival, the weather around Urashima worsens and storms will come. A few days into their training, Osanai Shouko finds a girl washed up on the shores near the location of the training camp. She cannot speak and doesn’t seem to know much about herself... [From Wikipedia]

characters.name: Osanai Shouko
characters.description: Protagonist of the story, a 2nd year student at Seijou Academy. Her nickname is "Osa". She's the well-liked, ace of the kendo team who takes on the role of captain after the former 3rd year captain retires. Since she is the serious and hardworking type, she often gets teased and is on the receiving end of jokes. [From Solelo website]

characters.name: Aizawa Yasumi
characters.description: A first year student at Seijou Academy. A delicate girl who is the manager of the kendo team. Though she doesn't have any particular illness, she has much less stamina than normal people so it's hard for her to do any strenuous exercise. On the other hand, she's extremely determined and diligent about her job as a manager and helps contribute to the team's success. Her hobbies are reading and cooking. Though she'll randomly read all genres, after becoming manager, she's increased the type of material that pertains to kendo such as "Continuing Kendo! ~From cradle to grave~" and "Snacks for each of the Three Meals a Day for a Sports Player". [From Solelo website] [spoiler]Her former name is Nekata Yasumi. She is younger daughter of Nekata family and Nami's twin-sister; their father is Munetsugu Nekata. Has a crush on Shouko and in fact joined the Kendo Club due to said crush.

characters.name: Nami
characters.description: The young girl who washed up on the shores near the location of the training camp. Main heroine of the story. Looks to be about 10 to 12 years old. Her name and age are all unknown. The first impression of her is that of a mermaid or a doll. She doesn't seem to know who she herself is either. The first ones she saw when she woke up were Shouko and Yasumi, so it seems she became attached to them, much like a chick imprinting. Her normal mode is to be spaced out. [From Solelo website] [spoiler]Her real name is Tsunami Nekata, she is Yasumi's older twin-sister and barer of Yaobikuni's spirit. Her father is Munetsugu Nekata.

characters.name: Kiyan Migiwa
characters.description: Role: Underling Oni Slayer A young girl who is staying over at Shoushinji, the same location as the training camp. She arrived there earlier than Shouko and the others. She's fundamentally a genius. Looking at her, there's not doubt that she's stylish either. If she just kept quiet, she'd already be a rather beautiful girl, so along with her outstanding athletic ability, she has rather high specs and is a praiseworthy person. She's got a light carefree personality. Perhaps it's because she was raised in the South, but she's seems rather loose with deadlines. However, her movement pattern regarding the tides indicates that might not be the case? [From Solelo website]

characters.name: Kaya
characters.description: She is the sword-wielding oni who stole the sealed《Sword》from the Suten Group of the Onikiribe (Demon Extermination Organization), and is currently headed to a place where she has a strong karmic bond. [From Solelo website] [spoiler]In fact, she is Shouko's mother's cousin, Kaya Narumi, who Shouko respects a lot. She was killed while trying to save her and resurrected as oni[spoiler]

characters.name: Kohaku
characters.description: The pretentious speech doesn't match the youthful looks. A person of many mysteries who has a dignified presence. The sword at the waist is 2 shaku 7 sun long (~81 cm). The left eye is constantly closed. Age and gender are unknown. [From Solelo website] [spoiler]It confirms later that Kohaku is female and couple of hundred years old. She had a twin-brother in past. She is the foster daughter of Rouryuu.

characters.name: Akita Momoko
characters.description: Seijou Girls Academy first year student. Belongs to the kendo team. Though she only started kendo in high school and has only been learning for not even half a year, because of her high, natural athletic ability, strong determination, and the will the win, those three pillars of strength have her pegged as the next ace. She has many varied, passing interests in a variety of things but is a bit bothersome about a certain genre of music. When she entered high school, it was vital for her to join the light music (rock) club, but since it didn't exist, she abandoned the idea and followed Yasumi into joining the kendo team. She's a dorm student and is Yasumi's roommate. [spoiler]She also has a unrequited crush on Yasumi. [From Solelo website]

characters.name: Aoi Hanako
characters.description: The advisor to the Seijou Girl's Academy kendo team. A new teacher who became the advisor to the kendo team after the previous advisor retired. She's really fired up about her work since she considers her profession her calling, and wants to be seen as dependable by the students. The truth is, she's completely hopeless at kendo, likes drinking sake, has a complex about her name, wears glasses, and since she's had more life experiences than the students, it seems she's been through a lot. [From Solelo website] She is friends with the reporter Sakuya.

characters.name: Sakurai Ayashiro
characters.description: A 2nd year student at Seijou Girls Academy. Belongs to the Kendo Team. Just like her appearance, she is a gentle ojou-sama type. As the Vice-Captain, in combination with her classmate Shouko, the two function as a "Sweet and Whip" (carrot and stick) policy. Her abilities are rather good, but because she is weak-willed, she's the type that can never give her all in matches. On the other hand, her form is extremely pretty. Her parents (especially her father) are really overprotective, so she was the person who had the hardest time getting approval for this time's summer training camp, and has an obligation to call home in the mornings and evenings. [From Solelo website]

characters.name: Suzuki Yuukai
characters.description: The Chief Priest of Shoushinji. Both his voice and height are large, and he is the hearty type. Since he drinks alcohol, he's somewhat of a corrupt monk. His splendid physical build-up is suitable for being a fighting monk. When he was young, he made quite a sensation in the kendo world. He uses an old-school style of sword-fighting. Since he and Aoi Hanako's father were both old war-horses and comrades in arms, that connection between them is what led to Shoushinji being picked as the location for the training camp. Because the temple is poor and has few parishioners, he wouldn't be able to earn enough to eat if that were his full-time job, so he also has a side-job. [From Solelo website]

characters.name: Asama Sakuya
characters.description: Role: Reportage writer and photographer A beautiful woman of unknown age who appears to be in her mid-twenties, with a distinctly non-Japanese style of living. As Kei's late mother's best friend, for whatever reason, she has taken it upon herself to look after Kei's well-being. She is frank and humorous, with the composure of an elder sister, but also has an "old-timer" side to her befitting (?) of her age. She likes alcoholic beverages and salty things. She dislikes Uzuki. [Taken from Zohar's site.]

characters.name: Barouryuu
characters.description: Main antagonist of the story. 800 years ago Rouryuu came to the island where Nekata's family took it for god. [spoiler]He is Kohaku's adoptive father.

characters.name: Nekata Munetsugu
characters.description: The priest on the island and Rouryuu's accomplice. A few years ago Munetsugu had to sacrifice his oldest daughterTsunami. After Shouko found out that, he tried to kill her, but Kaya prevented it in the cost of her life. [spoiler]He is Yasumi and Nami's father.

title: Sono Hanabira ni Kuchizuke o: Amakute Hoshikute Torokeru Chuu
title_original: その花びらにくちづけを　あまくてほしくてとろけるちゅう
description: The 7th installment in the popular SonoHana yuri eroge series. This game introduces a new couple: Suminoe Takako, a young and still inexpert teacher at the elementary department of St. Michael's School for Girls, and one of her students, the daring ojousama Houraisen Runa.

characters.name: Houraisen Runa
characters.description: A fifth/sixth grade primary school student and recent transfer at St. Michael's. Smart, mature and highly charismatic for her age, Runa has won many fans in her class but she is very interested with her teacher Takako and declares she belongs to her. [spoiler]Runa harbors resentment over her older sister Rena, yet unseen in the story, who frequently leaves her alone while she goes out on business trips. Runa's older sister is Takako's former crush, which leads to the relationship between Runa and Takako once they meet for the first time in St. Michael's. [Edit from Wikipedia]

characters.name: Suminoe Takako
characters.description: A former graduate of St. Michael's who is now a teacher at the school's primary division. Takako is very embarrassed that Runa can easily dominate her while stealing her first kiss. [spoiler]She was once in love with Runa's older sister, Rena. [Edit from Wikipedia]
