It is a new media homage to Asian cinema and Hong Kong’s golden age of entertainment. [From The Official Site]

title: Hustle Cat
tags: Both Male and Female Love Interests
description: You finally got a job in the big city. But your coworkers at this cat cafe disappear at weird times, and there’s something peculiar about your new boss, too... You are Avery Grey, the newest employee at a popular cat cafe called A Cat’s Paw. The coffee’s good and the staff is friendly (and kinda cute!) but mysterious. One day, you find a strange book in the basement, with letters you can’t quite read... You’ll work hard at A Cat’s Paw, but there’s still time to get to know your new coworkers! Who’s your favorite? The brusque, but devoted cook Mason? Or maybe Reese, the fashion-obsessed waiter who knows more than he says? And there’s always your strange-eyed boss, the enigmatic Graves.

characters.name: Reese
characters.description: The bossy Assistant Manager, Reese, always has something to prove. Can you break through to his gentle side and help him achieve something that’s always been out of his grasp? [From Kickstarter] [spoiler]Reese has been practicing magic his entire life and has always known he is a witch. He practices drawing magic even though he isn't good at it. He actually has transportation magic where he cuts a seam into the air, opening up a portal, and he can bewitch clothing. Both of his abilities are related to sewing

characters.name: Hayes
characters.description: Nervous barista Hayes feels more comfortable around coffee and cats than he does around people, but can you reach his heart and help him blossom? [From Kickstarter] [spoiler]Hayes' magic is voice based. Whatever actions he describes when he reads poetry happen in real life. The quality of the poem doesn't matter so long as Hayes has conviction behind his words.

characters.name: Finley
characters.description: Finley, the joyful social media intern, has a lot of energy to share with everyone. Can you keep up with her and her love of Internet cats? [From Kickstarter] [spoiler]Finley has voice activated magic. Whenever she says an action like "block," it will cause that action to happen to the opponent. "Block" causes the opponent to be unable to move. However, her words have to be words known by the opponent as someone who does not know what "blocking" someone on the internet means would not be impacted by the word.

characters.name: Mason
characters.description: Taciturn chef Mason is full of contradictions- she seems like she could take you in a fight, but also like she’d spoil you with pastries. Can you become sweethearts with this sweets maker? [From Kickstarter] [spoiler]Mason is an "adept," someone who is born with magic related to a trait rather than their magic being formed based on their life circumstances and personality. She has fire magic.

characters.name: Landry
characters.description: Landry, your friendly co-waiter and the de-facto cafe carpenter, is great with his hands. His smile brightens everyone's day, but is he using it to hide something? [From Kickstarter] [spoiler]Landry knew he was a witch before coming to A Cat's Paw. Landry is an "adept," someone who is born with magic related to a trait rather than their magic being formed based on their life circumstances and personality. He has lightning magic. However, he tries to hide his magic due to not liking magic in general.

characters.name: Graves Serling
characters.description: Your odd-eyed boss Graves seems like he’d be more suited to running a vampire RPG than a cat cafe. He’s got a strange tendency to quote Edgar Allen Poe, a dark past, and a mysterious motivation to protect A Cat’s Paw, and you. [From Kickstarter] [spoiler]Graves has two known forms of magic, metal and cat magic. He is also skilled at ward magic. With his metal magic, Graves could create sculptures out of metal. Now that Nacht has taken his metal magic, he can no longer do so, and Nacht also limited some of Graves' speech, making it so he has a coughing fit when he tries to tell Avery about the situation with Nacht. His cat magic allows him to turn himself and others into cats. He turned his workers into cats to pose as familiars because witches often like to kill new witches for fun.

characters.name: Avery Grey
characters.description: Avery is known for having a very messy apartment, but is dependable, just not with cleaning. [spoiler]Avery's magic is trash magic. At one point they say it feels like trash is just drawn to them, and it actually is. They can manipulate discarded objects, being able to pull them together and pull them apart. Due to the vague nature of their magic, things left on the street like a discarded bicycle would also count as trash.

characters.name: Nacht
characters.description: [spoiler]The main villain of the story who has a close relationship with Graves. He claims to have a lot of patience, but is shown to be good at fighting both with fists and magic. Nacht's original magic is paper magic, but he stole part of Grave's metal magic, causing the metal magic to become rust.

characters.name: Kaz
characters.description: [spoiler]A sound witch that cursed Landry because Landry caught him in a bar while underage, getting him kicked out.

characters.name: Mochi
characters.description: Avery's cat. [spoiler]Mochi was going to be a romanceable character if the game's Kickstarter reached the stretch goal. He would have been revealed to be a human who got cursed to be a cat. Since Avery sometimes says they hear Mochi speak, that could be why.

characters.name: Gina
characters.description: A local cop who helps out when things get rough. Friends with Finley.

title: Manakashi no Yuri wa Akaku Somaru
title_original: 真愛の百合は赤く染まる
description: After relocating to a new town, Manami becomes captivated by a classmate who, intriguingly, shares her name. She tries to keep her feelings under wraps. However, the truth finds its way out, leading to an unexpected confession: ".....I'm into girls too." With their mutual sentiments revealed, the two draw closer. Yet their relationship gradually morphs into something unsettling. How far will one Manami go to match the other's steps? Soon enough, their private world draws others into its orbit, taking turns neither could have foreseen... [Translated from the official website]

characters.name: Honjou Manami
characters.description: An ordinary schoolgirl who just transferred to a local school. Since she has only recently moved and doesn’t know much about her surroundings, she learns various things from Manami. She has a rather unassertive personality and tries not to stand out in class. In truth, she is a lesbian and feels drawn to her classmate Manami, but lacking the courage to confess, she interacts with her only as a normal friend.

characters.name: Kanzaki Manami
characters.description: A female student attending a local school. An excellent student who excels in both academics and sports, handling everything with ease. She doesn’t have any particularly close friends and gives off a somewhat distant, hard-to-approach aura. However, she takes the initiative to speak to Manami, the transfer student sitting next to her, and tries to help her adjust to school life.

characters.name: Yuuko
characters.description: A person who has some sort of connection to Manami. She always wears gothic lolita-styled clothes and is friendly towards Manami. [spoiler]After learning that his sister only likes girls and wouldn't date her own brother, he started to crossdress and pretend he wasn't her brother.

characters.name: Yoshizawa
characters.description: The homeroom teacher of Manami’s class. Kind and caring, he looks after Manami, the new transfer student, and is well-liked among students.

title: Written in the Sky
description: After stalking a suspicious figure through the night, Azure stumbles across an odd, black box, bearing alien writing. And within that box she finds a small ring, just her size, with writing matching that of the box. Without thinking, Azure picks up the ring, and the moment she does, footsteps appear behind her. This ring changes her future drastically making each day action packed. [Excerpts from Steam]

title: The Sad Story of Emmeline Burns
description: Toma Andrews, aged 14, has always felt like an outsider. She enjoys spending time in graveyards, and feels more comfortable among the dead than the living. That is, until Toma meets a strange girl in her local graveyard who might be a real ghost. The girl asks Toma if she will stay for a while and listen to a story. A story about a girl called Emmeline Burns, who died a tragic death back in 1851. Toma is compelled to listen, but at the same time, she feels uneasy. After all, what can she do? How could she ever hope to help somebody who has already died? [From official site]

characters.name: Toma Andrews
characters.description: The heroine. Toma's mother intended to call her Amelia, but this plan was scuppered after Aunt Kathryn 'stole' that name for her own daughter. As such, Toma was named after her Grandfather, Thomas. Toma dislikes her name, and is jealous of her cousin, Amelia, for taking her 'real' name. She seems to believe that her ill-fitting name is the reason for her introverted nature, and often wonders how different her life would be if she had been called Amelia instead. Toma enjoys spending time in graveyards, perhaps because of her mother's obsession with family history, and seems to instinctively 'know' where to find specific graves. This skill made her very useful during her mother's search for the final resting places of their long-dead relatives. [From official site]

characters.name: Emily
characters.description: A strange girl Toma meets at the local graveyard. She speaks in an ornate manner that would befit a person from another time period, and her dress sense is much the same. Though she seems rather quiet and pensive, she has a more playful side, and likes to give people cute nicknames. [From official site]

characters.name: Emmeline Burns
characters.description: A young girl living in the early nineteenth century. The daughter of a successful and wealthy family. Has a crush on her friend Cornelia. [spoiler] When her family went bankrupt, her father Phillip choked her to death and set their house alight. After being resurrected as a ghost, she eventually re-united with Cornelia in the present day.

characters.name: Cornelia Linton
characters.description: Emmeline's neighbour and teenage crush. [spoiler] She was crushed by Emmeline's death, and eventually married to a man she didn't love at the behest of her family. In the present day, she possesses her descendant, Toma, and reunites with Emmeline in the afterlife.

characters.name: Hattie
characters.description: Toma's best (and only) friend, whom she has a crush on.

A story about a girl called Emmeline Burns, who died a tragic death back in 1851. Toma is compelled to listen, but at the same time, she feels uneasy. After all, what can she do? How could she ever hope to help somebody who has already died? [From official site]

title: Liar Liar 2
description: The story continues one year after the previous game left off. Yukari and Miho are now high schoolers, who are now dating and spend their leisure time together holding hands, kissing, and murdering the occasional boy or two. On one particular day that was just like any other, a new transfer student arrives to Yukari’s school. It’s Koshi Tanaka! But wasn't he dead? Apparently not. The goal of the game is to figure out the mysterious circumstances of Tanaka’s revival and most importantly, staying alive.

title: Sono Hanabira ni Kuchizuke o: New Gen!
title_original: その花びらにくちづけを　にゅーじぇね！
description: At the Saint Michael Girls' School... festivities erupted among the girls of the annex. The reason for their celebration is the Best Couples poll being held at the main campus. The students at the annex, who look up to the girls from the main campus, decided, "Let's have our own Best Couples!" ...It was always inevitable. And so, the fairest and most intimate couples were nominated... The first couple is a pair of childhood friends, Misawa Nagisa and Takahata Rina. The second couple is a pair of twin sisters, Kimishima Ai and her younger sister Aya. And finally... The transfer student who saw this whole thing as no concern of hers, Onohara Hazuki, is shocked to hear that she too, was chosen to be among the Best Couples. Moreover, her partner is the sheltered young debutante, Suoh Manami. Actually, Hazuki has secretly been crushing on the impeccable Manami... But the truth is, they're far

characters.name: Kimishima Aya
characters.description: A second-year student of the annex building who transferred from public school, she and Ai are twin sisters. With a bright and cheerful disposition, she has a little bit of a submissive streak.

characters.name: Kimishima Ai
characters.description: Aya’s elder twin sister, and the class mascot. While typically meek and docile, she’s actually very willful, and won’t budge once she’s set her mind on something.

characters.name: Misawa Nagisa
characters.description: The star of the track and field team, who’s always surrounded by fans. She and Rina have been best friends since they were little, and they can often be spotted together.

characters.name: Takahata Rina
characters.description: A spoiled and pushy princess. But for some reason, everybody loves her. In class, she’s treated like an actual princess. She has a particular fondness for Nagisa.

characters.name: Onohara Hazuki
characters.description: A transfer student who was admitted in the second term. She makes no attempts to hide her humble roots. She’s well-liked by everyone.

characters.name: Suou Manami
characters.description: A sheltered girl with an air of grace and refinement.[spoiler] Her true personality comes out through her internet idol persona “MANA”, where she’s cruel and abusive.

title: Ne no Kami - Kyou no Miyako to Futari no Hime Kishi
title_original: ねのかみ 京の都とふたりの姫騎士
description: ~At dawn, the moonlight illuminates the old capital enveloped in fog. Guided by fate, bound by their thoughts, the maidens dance. Amid a spiral of despair, the beloved princess and her guardian knight overcome their fear. Gazing up at the dawn sky, the princess of the earth gently averts her eyes. Descended from the heavens, bearing her dreams. Scooping up the ripples from the water's surface. The princess of the sun gazes, and contemplates. Light dwelling in their cerulean eyes, and with a will that can break down the wall of fate. The dancing maidens of the old capital become the princess knights.~ A large earthquake rocks Kyoto at its core, unsettling the balance of the world. Through television and radio, news of absurd behaviors and emergence of cults became frequent, and demons sightings were reported all throughout Japan. But with the passage of time, society's belief in the super

characters.name: Sarume Shinonome
characters.description: "...Pfch, I can't believe I just got talked down to by some shorty from the flat chest clan." A member of the Kunai Organization's Capital Branch, who have been clashing with the ayakashi since ancient times. She lives in the Capital Branch's hidden village, located nearby Uji. She lacks a bit of common sense due to not setting foot outside the village much. Ren's childhood friend and the same age as her, they both used to play together often. A wielder of one of the village's Divine Swords, which grant their wielder abilities far beyond what any regular human can achieve. Rarely gets too excited, but can be prone to goofing off now and then. Also a fan of calling Ren out whenever possible. [From the official IndieGoGo page]

characters.name: Ese Len
characters.description: "Divine Swords sure are amazing. I wonder if they can make your breasts bigger?" Your average student. 140 cm tall with a small frame. Certain circumstances brought her into possession of a Divine Sword, granting her abilities far beyond what any regular human can achieve. Reuniting with her childhood friend Shinonome leads to her very idea of normality being crushed without remorse. While healthy as one can be under normal circumstances, she has a habit of throwing up over the slightest of things. She was born with the particular ability to "see" people's presence. [From the official IndieGoGo page]

characters.name: Sarume Uzume
characters.description: Uzume is the older sister of Shinonome and Len's childhood friend. She is the latest in the long line of white haired Sarume family members who bare the name and powers of Uzume. To maintain these powers, Uzume has been forced to live her entire life inside the sanctuary located in the village. She has an almost unhealthy obsession towards Len whom she is madly in love with. Normally she acts like a mature onee-sama to the other girls in the village, but when she sees Len, she starts acting like a little puppy who gets to see her master again.

characters.name: Himemishi Ruka
characters.description: A pretty, almost princess-like girl and Shinonome's lover living in the Kunai Organization Central Branch's village with her uncle. She is tasked with handling all sorts of supporting tasks for the organization because her frail body isn't well suited for fighting. [spoiler]Ruka's true identity is Mirukashi Hime, The chieftain of Mirukashi clan, one of the Tsuchigumo people who face discrimination and have been segregated from the rest of the society because of their Ayakashi ancestry. She works for Tsuchimikado who has forced her to commit horrendous acts such as torture and genocide.

characters.name: Mokose Alissa
characters.description: Alissa is a first-year student at the Academy. She received the mark of Aries, becoming one of the Angels of the Zodiac. A cheerful and energetic young lady, she always lights up the room. She fell in love with Hitsuji after the latter kissed her out of nowhere during their first meeting (!?). The two started going out on the spot (!?!?). Alissa is proactive to the point of defying common sense. She acts like the protagonist of a gag manga. [Based on the description provided by the author.]

characters.name: Suou Hitsuji
characters.description: Hitsuji is a first-year transfer student from Kyoto. She gives off an unfriendly air, which she is well aware of. Bothered by the fact, she is left acting a bit meek and reserved. On her first day at the Academy, Hitsuji messed up and kissed Alissa out of nowhere, which led to the two of them going out. She's been acting clingy and dependent towards her girlfriend ever since. [Based on the description provided by the author.]

characters.name: Haku
characters.description: A shy but friendly Ayakashi who sees Ren as a friend. Although she is extremely skilled, she strives for a neutral stance in the war against humans and prefers to avoid combat.

characters.name: Yata Hime
characters.description: Second year Advanced Course student, 17 years old. She's a covert asset for the Agency who's been infiltrating the Academy ever since she was enrolled in it's elementary school divison. Mindful of the need to blend in, she tries not to stand out too much. Her relationships with other students are kept superficial as a result. She always keeps a poker face, but beneath it all she's actually quite playful. [spoiler]To keep her disguise from being blown, Hime started a fake relationship with Hikari, who ended up accidentally charming her with her powers. Unbeknown to her pretend lover, she's been looking for a way to break the spell, but... [Translated from the author's Twitter.]

characters.name: Tsuchimikado
characters.description: An Agency operative. He is tasked with relaying communications from Headquarters to the Capital Branch, as well as with assuming operational command over the group. Allegedly a descendant of the legendary Abe no Seimei, he nevertheless lacks any ability as an Onmyouji. Due to this powerlessness, he avoids engaging in combat personally. If you ask the man himself, he's just a part of the Agency's middle management. [spoiler]In contrast with his cheerful demeanour, Tsuchimikado also has a cold-hearted side to him. He sees Uzume as little more than just another tool at his disposal. [Based on two separate descriptions provided by the author.]

characters.name: Inari
characters.description: The kitsune who exercises military control over the Ayakashi. Unlike the rest of her brethren, she has lived since the Age of the Gods. She led the Ayakashi as they marched down the streets of Kyoto in ancient times, and was the one who orchestrated the Great Incident almost a century ago. [spoiler]She regards humanity with indifference. However, she has taken a keen interest in Len, who seems able to act contrary to anyone's expectations. [Based on two separate descriptions provided by the author.]

characters.name: Sana
characters.description: The youngest girl in the village. When Len first showed up, Sana was unsure how to talk to her and ended up acting coldly. Despite that, Len kept treating her like a friend. Having lived her whole life in an isolated village filled with older people, this was something Sana never had the opportunity to experience before. She is now finding herself inceasingly drawn to the older girl. Shinonome, Ruka and Uzume spoil her like she were their own younger sister. [Translated from the official description.]

characters.name: Tsuchigumo
characters.description: A towering giant of a man who is over two meters tall. The cultists treat him as a living god. He is a descendent of the Tsuchigumo - the people who in ancient times refused to submit themselves to the rule of the Imperial Court, and were driven off their lands into the depths of Japan's mountains. It is said that they survived to become the Sanka, and now live impoverished and marginalised lives. Calling himself the King of a forsaken people, Tsuchigumo stands in the way of Len and her comrades. [Translated from the official description.]

characters.name: Mitsurugi
characters.description: A Divine Sword wielder. Mitsurugi's strength and ability exceed even what one might expect given the effects of her weapon. She can run up a mountain trail without so much as losing her breath, and her competence with the sword impresses even her senior colleagues. Although Len could've sworn looked like she was just shy of thirty, Mitsurugi is actually well in her forties. [spoiler]Unexpectedly given her personality, she likes buying teddy bears. [Based on two separate descriptions provided by the author.]

characters.name: Yoshimura
characters.description: A Divine Sword wielder. Together with Morita, Yoshimura is a part of the village's senior squad. They were already fighting the Ayakashi as early as 1923. She is over a century old, but thanks to the Divine Sword's effects, her aging has been significantly slowed down. As such, she still wields immense power and is able to go toe to toe with the kitsune. [spoiler]A long time ago, she fought alongside Utano, the previous wielder of Len's Divine Sword. She still detests the kitsune who took her comrade's life. [Based on two separate descriptions provided by the author.]

characters.name: Morita
characters.description: A Divine Sword wielder. Together with Yoshimura, Morita is a part of the village's senior squad. They were already fighting the Ayakashi as early as 1923. He is over a century old, but thanks to the Divine Sword's effects, his aging has been significantly slowed down. As such, he still wields immense power and is able to go toe to toe with the kitsune. [spoiler]A long time ago, he fought alongside Utano, the previous wielder of Len's Divine Sword. He still detests the kitsune who took his comrade's life. [Based on two separate descriptions provided by the author.]

characters.name: Miyata
characters.description: A member of the Agency's Capital Branch. She acts as the commander of its regular forces.

characters.name: Cultist
characters.description: A member of the cult that worships the sealed god and Tsuchigumo. The cult is led by those calling themselves priests, and has members all across Japan. It's understood that it already existed a century ago, but it's present methods differ significantly from what was the case back then. The cult's activity has seen a sharp increase these last few years. [Translated from the official description.]

characters.name: Kitsune
characters.description: One of the kitsune who serve Inari. Their strength is considered impressive even among the Ayakashi. Without the aid of the Divine Swords, it's impossible to so much as injure them. During the incident that took place a century ago, one of them took the the life of Utano, the previous wielder of Len's sword. They inflicted severe casualties on the Capital Branch. [spoiler]Divine Sword wielders have hunted these Ayakashi to near extinction. Excluding Inari, only two one-tailed kitsune remain. [Based on two separate descriptions provided by the author.]

full_description: ~At dawn, the moonlight illuminates the old capital enveloped in fog. Guided by fate, bound by their thoughts, the maidens dance. Amid a spiral of despair, the beloved princess and her guardian knight overcome their fear. Gazing up at the dawn sky, the princess of the earth gently averts her eyes. Descended from the heavens, bearing her dreams. Scooping up the ripples from the water's surface. The princess of the sun gazes, and contemplates. Light dwelling in their cerulean eyes, and with a will that can break down the wall of fate. The dancing maidens of the old capital become the princess knights.~ A large earthquake rocks Kyoto at its core, unsettling the balance of the world. Through television and radio, news of absurd behaviors and emergence of cults became frequent, and demons sightings were reported all throughout Japan. But with the passage of time, society's belief in the super

title: Fuyukara, Kururu.
description: "Eh? What do you mean that Shihon-chan might die? Eeh? Shihon-chan's head has gone missing?" It seems Shihon-chan's headless body was found in the meditation room. A murder isn't unusual, after all, there's at least one bloodthirsty killer at school. Murdering people is fine and all but it's considered a taboo that must be never violated to decapitate and hide their head because one can never be revived if so. If her head isn't found within two days, she'll really kick the bucket! A boarding system school isolated from the outside world, and there do the immortal girls live. The time it takes for them to become an adult is the same time it takes for them to deage and become a baby, they grow up until they become an adult once more and then do they deage again⁠—a cycle that's being repeated. There's only one condition in order to graduate from school: one needed to be deemed a prodigy by

characters.name: Soraoka Yuuhi
characters.description: She’s not exactly a stunning beauty, nor does she have a particularly charming personality, yet for some reason, she’s incredibly popular with the students at her school. She’s easily flustered by all sorts of things, but she’s surprisingly decisive and tends to act on impulse.

characters.name: Shimoyuki Shihon
characters.description: Soraoka Yuuhi’s partner. Although she has a self-centered personality, she’s so good at being cute that she’s practically unstoppable, allowing her to get things done exactly as she wants. She’s obsessively attached to Soraoka Yuuhi and is always eager to be lovey-dovey with her. [spoiler]She is murdered by an unknown assailant, her neck is severed, and her head is hidden somewhere.

characters.name: Mizuna Torineko
characters.description: The assistant to Soraoka Yuuhi, who has become a famous detective. She excels at all sports, is loyal to her friends, is straightforward, and is decisive. Although she has a likable personality, her careless words and actions sometimes leads to conflict. She has no interest in sexual matters and looks down on students who are in heat, but she is actually a secret masochist... something she doesn’t even realize herself.

characters.name: Ugajima Yukari
characters.description: The school’s serial killer, who's still a student. She casually stabs people with a knife, but since she can bring the victims back to life, it isn’t murder in the true sense of the word. She offers advice from the perspective of a serial killer to Soraoka Yuuhi, who is working to solve the case that has to potential to turn into a real murder investigation.

characters.name: Ugajima Berlin
characters.description: Ugajima Yukari's identical twin. As the leader of the Relief Squad, which is responsible for quickly locating and resuscitating students who have died, she is very knowledgeable about corpses. [spoiler]She keeps Shimoyuki Shihon's headless corpse cryogenically preserved in the first-aid room. There is a stark contrast between her laid-back tone of voice and what she actually says.

characters.name: Hoshito Chiemi
characters.description: The student council president at the academy. She is self-conscious about her childlike figure and flies into a rage whenever anyone points it out. Contrary to her appearance, she has a serious and strict personality. Although she doesn’t have much faith in Soraoka Yuuhi, she grants her permission to conduct her detective work.

characters.name: Kikuma Touko
characters.description: She is Hoshito Chiemi's partner, and acts as a sort of vice president, assisting her. She is intelligent and personable, but has a tendency to unconsciously manipulate others through how she talks. If you let your guard down while talking to her, the conversation may lead to a completely unexpected and outrageous direction. She is well-versed in school affairs.

characters.name: Okibi Yodomi
characters.description: A student who always seems timid and skittish, like a small animal. She always seems to be afraid of something, but when the topic of murder comes up, she suddenly becomes bold and at times maniacal. She is one of the few people capable of challenging or attacking the serial killer Ugajima Yukari.

characters.name: Tsukikadojima Vika
characters.description: President of the Handicrafts Club II. For some reason, students who join the Handicrafts Club II often disappear from the school after they graduate. All of the club members, except Tsukikadojima Vika herself, have already graduated. She has a peculiar aura about her and is seen as the school’s “big sister” figure. [spoiler]She was found dead with her head missing the day before Shimoyuki Shihon died.

title: Kanojo to Kanojo to Watashi no Nanoka -Seven Days With the Ghost-
title_original: 彼女と彼女と私の七日 -Seven days with the Ghost-
tags: Modern Day Setting in a Fictional World
description: This is the modern era where magic exists alongside science. Ayako Orihara is a student and a member of the Occult Research Club at Keisei Academy. Despite the flourishing of magic alongside science, the popularity of the occult is significantly low, and thus Ayako is not only the head of the club but is also its only member. Ayako is told that the Occult Research Club will be closed down if more members don’t join so she does whatever she can to attract interest in order to save her club. To do so, she attempts to explore the legendary “Seven Wonders of the Academy.” However, each wonder she seeks out only results in failure. Finally, she tries the only thing that’s left, the Seventh Wonder: “Get kicked by a horse and die,” which turns out to be more than outrageous– She accidentally digs her own grave out of curiosity, and finds something strange. These are the strange, fun, and— preci

title: Loren The Amazon Princess
tags: Both Male and Female Love Interests
description: Queen Karen has disappeared! Join the Amazon Princess Loren in her journey to find what happened to her mother. Play as Saren or Elenor, fight monsters, discover new places, find romance and defeat the evil Fost!

characters.name: Saren
characters.description: A slave of the Amazons. Valued for his incredible healing skills, making him a valuable ally on the battlefield.

characters.name: Loren
characters.description: The Amazon Princess, heir to the throne. She is beautiful and deadly, determined and apparently without time for romance. Romanceable by Saren or Elenor.

characters.name: Dora
characters.description: Don't call Dora the dwarf a thief, since she might be offended! She will join the group for the sake of adventure.

characters.name: Ramas
characters.description: A dwarf merchant-warrior, robbed by bandits, will join Loren's group after falling in love with Dora.

characters.name: Draco Firestarter
characters.description: A bizarre Mage Elementalist. Often mocked by the other party members, don't underestimate the power of his spells. Romanceable by Saren.

characters.name: Apolimesho
characters.description: The Archwizard of Grimoire is a powerful old mage who will ask Loren's help to retrieve a special item.

characters.name: Amukiki
characters.description: The Champion of the Arena, Amukiki is the most renowned gladiator of Grimoire. He will pledge his loyalty to Loren. Romanceable by Saren or Elenor.

characters.name: Karen
characters.description: The Amazon Queen, she mysteriously disappeared from the Amazon Citadel. What are the secrets behind her disappearance? Romanceable by Elenor.

characters.name: Rei
characters.description: The Assassin Rei is one of the best elven marksmen, and a notorious womanizer. Romanceable by Elenor.

characters.name: Myrth
characters.description: One of the Elder Druids of GrandTree, she is one with nature and will seek Loren's help to fight the dark elves. Romanceable by Saren.

characters.name: Sauzer
characters.description: The leader of the Disciples Of Truth, he has a strong sense of honor and fights unarmed.

characters.name: Chambara
characters.description: Can the apparently selfish witch Chambara, adept of the death magic, be trusted? Romanceable by Saren or Elenor.

characters.name: Mesphit
characters.description: After mixing his blood with demons, can he still be saved or is his soul lost forever? Romanceable by Saren or Elenor.

characters.name: Elenor
characters.description: A slave of the Amazons. Valued for her incredible healing skills, making her a valuable ally on the battlefield.

characters.name: Breza
characters.description: Amazon Captain of the guards.

characters.name: Trouble
characters.description: An inferno hound adopted as a pet.

characters.name: Jul
characters.description: A succubus; servant of Fost.

characters.name: Tobaar
characters.description: Dark Elf chief.

characters.name: Krul
characters.description: Barbarian warrior.

characters.name: Khan
characters.description: Alpha Golem.

characters.name: Grob
characters.description: Goblin sorcerer.

characters.name: Zeal
characters.description: Death Knight.

characters.name: Mother Morte
characters.description: Necromancer.

characters.name: Raven
characters.description: Witch hunter.

characters.name: Sauzer
characters.description: Sauzer's Death Knight form.

title: REFLEXIA Prototype ver.
description: The protagonist spends her days cooped up inside, sinking countless hours into eroges. She would've ended up bored to death eventually, if one day she wasn't teleported into a visual novel! Of course, something like this isn't exactly a good situation for the young lady. Not only will you be privy to all of her shameful thoughts, you'd also demand entertainment from her. Isn't that why you came to read this story? Seems like she will now, at the very least, need to go outside to buy groceries... Because no matter where she goes, the plot will await her! [From Steam]

characters.name: Protagonist
characters.description: A bland girl in an empty world.

title: Akai Ito
description: To arrange the inheritance because of the loss of her mother, Hatou Kei heads for her fathers house in Hemizuka. In the train on the way there, Kei has a mysterious dream of a huge tree and a woman who seems to be lost in sadness. In the land of Hemizuka, Kei learns the secret concealed in her own blood through various meeting with an Oni Slayer, a friend of her late mother, a young girl accompanied by a white fox, and even the mysterious girl from her dreams. [Edited from Wikipedia]

characters.name: Hatou Kei
characters.description: Protagonist of the story. Because she's a nice and carefree person, people who get to know her often wind up having the urge to take care of her. Although her favorite phrase is "always be prepared," she tends to be rather careless and forgetful. She lost her father in a fire as a child, and this summer, she lost the only other person she could call "family": her mother. Having learned of her father's house being left to her by inheritence, she uses the summer break to visit Hemidzuka. She is particularly fond of Japanese cuisine, samurai dramas and adages. [Taken from Zohar's site.]

characters.name: Yumei
characters.description: The mysterious girl that appears in Kei's dreams and begins to speak to her as she comes closer to her father's house. Accompanied by swarms of pale blue butterflies that shine as if gathered from the light of the moon. [Taken from Zohar's site.]

characters.name: Wakasugi Tsuzura
characters.description: Tsuzura had settled in at Kei's Father's house. Perhaps in the spirit of her family tradition, "survival of the fittest," a girl of young body and stature on a journey by herself. Even at an age nearly half of Kei's, she is remarkably level-headed. Currently living her tough-as-nails lifestyle with her partner, the white fox Obana, in Kei's father's uninhabited house. [Taken from Zohar's site.]

characters.name: Asama Sakuya
characters.description: Role: Reportage writer and photographer A beautiful woman of unknown age who appears to be in her mid-twenties, with a distinctly non-Japanese style of living. As Kei's late mother's best friend, for whatever reason, she has taken it upon herself to look after Kei's well-being. She is frank and humorous, with the composure of an elder sister, but also has an "old-timer" side to her befitting (?) of her age. She likes alcoholic beverages and salty things. She dislikes Uzuki. [Taken from Zohar's site.]

characters.name: Senba Uzuki
characters.description: Role: Oni Slayer A girl with beautiful posture, conduct, and black hair, who came to Hemidzuka on the same train as Kei. Carrying an ancient katana - Ito - within a golden sheath, she is thought by those at the hotel to be connected with the Ohashirasama festival that will be happening soon in Hemidzuka. [Taken from Zohar's site.]

characters.name: Nozomi
characters.description: Nozomi is the arrogant twin sister of Mikage. When Kei came to Hemidzuka, these twin oni appeared at her side with the ringing of bells. They hold the power to manipulate dreams, and are the direct antagonists of Yumei. [Taken from Zohar's site.]

characters.name: Kei
characters.description: A mysterious male, later known as [spoiler]Kei's twin brother, Hatou Hakuka.

characters.name: Nushi
characters.description: Main antagonist of the story. A former demon fighter. Nushi is a Snake God, so he can control snakes.

characters.name: Mikage
characters.description: Mikage is the timid twin sister of Nozomi. When Kei came to Hemidzuka, these twin oni appeared at her side with the ringing of bells. They hold the power to manipulate dreams, and are the direct antagonists of Yumei. [Taken from Zohar's site.]

title: Chasing Tails -A Promise in the Snow-
description: Trying to get away from trouble, June moves to a small town... to find even more trouble! Oh my, why do these embarrassing situations just keep on happening?! It appears June's new house is haunted! And if that wasn't bad enough, seems like she's being pursued by a female stalker! The strange girl is sure looking good, but what about her intentions? And what's up with those strange dreams June started seeing since she moved in? And, most importantly, are there fox-girls involved?! [From [URL=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1555110/]Steam]

title: Hakuisei Ren'ai Shoukougun
description: The story follows Sawai Kaori who almost died in a traffic accident at the age of 10 but was revived by hospital staff. Ever since then, Kaori became determined to take up ‘nursing’ as her means of saying thanks to the doctors who rescued her. And so at the age of 21, she begins her journey as a nurse…

description: An angel summons a demon, and they end up... in love?! [From itch.io]

characters.name: Kamilla
characters.description: She tries to act like a proper demon, but isn't very good at it. [From itch.io]

characters.name: Eleni
characters.description: An angel who loves demons... Her favorite animal is bunny rabbits. [From itch.io] [spoiler]She's actually a witch pretending to be an angel.

characters.name: Olog
characters.description: Kamilla's older brother and supervisor.

characters.name: Mazaal
characters.description: One of Kamilla's coworkers.

title: Yumeutsutsu Re:Master
description: Dreams and Reality Re:Master is a bubbly-cute girls love adventure game about game developers. Our last two games in the Nurse Love Addiction series focused on professional life with nurses and nursing students at a hospital. This game continues that focus, putting the spotlight on the people in a game development office, creating a story much like the life our team experiences daily. The game is set at Yuriica Software, a small game development company tucked away in Koenji, a neighborhood not far from the center of the capital city Tokyo. To this day it remains wrapped in the kindness of its working class residents. Our protagonist Ai is a simple girl from the country who makes the leap alone to see her younger sister Kokoro, currently a game company employee. The sisters had lived apart a long time due to their parents’ separation. Unused to working as a game developer, Ai finds herse

characters.name: Ootori Ai
characters.description: Assistant Director (Trainee) Ai adores her younger sister, Kokoro. She's meek and diligent, but thinks she's a boring person. She has a gloomy, negative temperament, but is a bit of an airhead. People around her think she's interesting. When she gets excited, her hometown accent colors her speech. She used to enjoy making art, but she fell into a slump and currently isn't drawing. Following her sister, she moved to Tokyo alone and got hired by Eureka Software. [From Official site]

characters.name: Yanagiya Kokoro
characters.description: Game Director Back when she was still in her hometown with her older sister Ai, before she joined Eureka Software, she was a cheerful, friendly, puppy-like girl. Now that she's become an adult, Kokoro is cool young woman who says whatever is on her mind. It's unclear why she's so harsh toward her sister Ai. As she's still a novice director, her job is demanding day-in and day-out, leaving her constantly in a bad mood. [From Official site]

characters.name: Mugendou Saki
characters.description: Narrative Writer Eureka Software's lead narrative writer. Always wearing headphones, Saki is a self-centered girl who doesn't listen when people talk to her and goes about things the way she feels like. She always wears a track suit and looks younger than she is due to her short height and cute looks. She was the writer for the original version of Dreams and Reality - Nie, the Witch, and the End of the World that they are remaking now and is a veteran of Eureka Software. She's always going "roar!!" so people call her Tinysaurus. [From Official site]

characters.name: Tachibana Nana
characters.description: Office Staff (Voice Actor) Part-time worker who does administrative work other than Eureka Software development, like answering phones and making tea. Nana is actually a struggling voice actor who can't pay the bills yet on acting alone. She creates a pleasant atmosphere at Eureka. Her bright personality lets her join in on any fun and she's friendly and open with everyone. A self-professed "Banana Maid." Cosplaying is just her hobby. [From Official site]

characters.name: Marie Mahler
characters.description: Illustrator/Keyframe Artist A Greek illustrator who ended up working at Eureka Software. A straightforward person with unwavering conviction. She has the wits to quickly grasp the true essence of any matter. Her military clothes are her "uniform." Marie loves Japanese culture. [From Official site]

characters.name: Daigo Honoka
characters.description: President and Programmer and Marketing A gentle boss who is like an older sister to her staff. When she starts drinking, however, she gets a little out of hand. She founded Eureka Software and started development on a commercial remake of the doujin game Dreams and Reality - Nie, the Witch, and the End of the World. Possessing a shrewd hidden side, she is called various disquieting nicknames in the game business world. [From Official site]

characters.name: Banako
characters.description: Vice President A St. Bernard that is basically the mascot of Eureka Software. Banako is Honoka's dog, but she often leaves her behind when heading out of the office, so Ai is mainly in charge of walks. She has an energy drink for Saki hanging from her neck, but as of yet it hasn't been drunk. [From Official site]

characters.name: Nie
characters.description: Fictional character in the game-within-a-game, Nie Witch (ニエと魔女と世界の焉わり). Her original name is Shuka (シュカ) but was renamed as Nie (meaning sacrifice or offering) by the Witch.

characters.description: Fictional character in the game-within-a-game, Nie Witch (ニエと魔女と世界の焉わり).

title: Kudan no Folklore
title_original: クダンノフォークロア
description: Gossips around town spoke of a Folklore (urban legend) called 'Kudan' It is said that 'Kudan' takes the form of a woman wearing Western mourning dress. She lacks a right wrist, and her face is hidden behind a black veil. It is predicted that those who lay eyes on 'Kudan', within 7 days calamity will befall them. Through strange coincidence, 16 years old Kudan Sakuya meets cooking class instructor Shima Touko. ---As they come in contact with each other, faint feelings grow between the two. However, as Touko happened to come across the fearful 'Kudan', her peaceful everyday life came to an end. As each day passed, 'Kudan' kept creeping closer to her. Sakuya tries her best to protect her and attempts to find countermeasures. At Kudan Girls High School, there's a club that focused on studying folklore. Together with the Mystery Research Club president, Akinashi Koto, Sakuya will take on the

characters.name: Kudan Sakuya
characters.description: A second-year student of Physical Education at Kudan Women's Academy. Sakuya is a scholarship student and star of the kendo club. Add to that stunning looks and a charming disposition, and you have yourself the most popular girl in school. She's bold and decisive, with a rigid moral compass that demands accountability, regardless of status. These personality traits can lead to her being seen as a fearsome figure, but she's actually a very kind and caring person. Sakuya has been best friends with Karen Azuma since elementary school, where they were on the baseball team together before she turned to kendo and Karen to softball. Her two older sisters got her into nerdy interests such as manga, retro gaming, and niche novels. Her unruly hair stresses her out something awful. [i]"Might be nice to have a destiny I chose for myself." [From SukeraSparo]

characters.name: Shima Touko
characters.description: A culinary arts teacher living in Kudan. Descendant of a wealthy family that earned its fortune in forestry and shipbuilding, Touko runs a culinary school out of a fancy building near the station. She's sweet and gentle, but also sharp as a tack and quick to follow a line of thinking to its logical conclusion. However, her proclivity for caution leads to indecisiveness, and she tends to keep her calculated judgments to herself. She admires Sakuya's ability to make quick decisions and take instant action, and the two become friends. Although she hasn't been acquainted with her personal assistant, Sawako Iwai, for too long, she hopes they can become friends one day, too. [i]"These eggs with the golden yolks are just perfect for carbonara. They'll give your sauce some real depth." [From SukeraSparo]

characters.name: Akinashi Koto
characters.description: A first-year General Studies student at Kudan Women's Academy. Going by her fashionable style, you wouldn't expect her to be into ghosts and urban legends, but Koto is a huge occult nerd and president of the Academy's Occult Studies Club. She actively investigates those mysteries that spark her interest and publishes the results in a magazine that combines objective analysis with personal opinion. She strives to maintain the reputation of the organization; contrary to her looks, she's actually the serious, intellectual type. She knows how to act with propriety, but once you really get to know her she'll drop the polite act and speak casually. She knew of Sakuya already—who at the academy doesn't—but since they belong to different departments she never expected their paths to cross. However, after Sakuya rescues her from a certain incident, they become friends. Her hobbies are watching ho

characters.name: Azuma Karen
characters.description: A second-year Physical Education student at Kudan Women's Academy. Karen is on the softball team and attends the Academy on a scholarship program. While this covers her tuition and confers various other benefits, it's all dependent on her results. Lively and boyishly good-looking, she doesn't speak as roughly as Sakuya, but her general personality is more masculine. She has two younger brothers who are also into sports, which further encourages her not to worry too much about maintaining a ladylike manner or appearance. Still, she can turn on the charm when she has to. Her hobbies include dining out at her favorite curry places and being a know-it-all when it comes to movies and video games. [i]"So, what, you're trying to scare me? You do know my favorite movie genre is horror, right?" [From SukeraSparo]

characters.name: Iwai Sawako
characters.description: An assistant in the employ of the Shima family, Sawako is currently assigned as Touko's PA and takes care of everything from her secretarial work to managing the family home. She's always cool, calm, and collected. A woman of few words, she says only what's necessary and tends to keep her expression neutral; while she of course has emotions, they can be hard for other people to figure out. She previously served the Shima family matriarch, Touko's grandmother, but has now been asked to take care of Touko. Because of how well the family treats her, she is far more dedicated to Touko than she would be any other employer. Her hobbies are classical music and obtaining professional qualifications. During her free time, she's usually studying for various exams. [i]"I am in the employ of the Shima family and have been instructed to take care of the young lady." [From SukeraSparo] [spoiler]Her re

full_description: Gossips around town spoke of a Folklore (urban legend) called 'Kudan' It is said that 'Kudan' takes the form of a woman wearing Western mourning dress. She lacks a right wrist, and her face is hidden behind a black veil. It is predicted that those who lay eyes on 'Kudan', within 7 days calamity will befall them. Through strange coincidence, 16 years old Kudan Sakuya meets cooking class instructor Shima Touko. ---As they come in contact with each other, faint feelings grow between the two. However, as Touko happened to come across the fearful 'Kudan', her peaceful everyday life came to an end. As each day passed, 'Kudan' kept creeping closer to her. Sakuya tries her best to protect her and attempts to find countermeasures. At Kudan Girls High School, there's a club that focused on studying folklore. Together with the Mystery Research Club president, Akinashi Koto, Sakuya will take on the

title: Spirited Heart
tags: Both Male and Female Love Interests
description: Spirited Heart is a fantasy life simulation game. Create your fantasy alter ego choosing between an apparently normal human, a cute elf and a wicked demoness. Every character has different starting attributes that will greatly influence the gameplay. They also behave differently in the various dialogue choices you'll encounter during the game. Once the game start you'll be able to run your life in a virtual fantasy world: choose a job from the 20 different ones available, but carefully check the minimum requirements. Each starting job will improve some of your basic character skills, giving you the possibility to unlock more advanced jobs once you have trained your character long enough. Can you win their hearts and maybe, one day, marry one of them? Play with your character for 10 in-game years in which you have to do your best! The full game has 20 normal endings plus 6 special marriag

title: Asphyxia
description: Samantha is depressed. She’s been depressed for a long time, almost as long as she can remember, but it’s slowly been getting worse. She thought Lillian was her friend, her best friend. Perhaps she even thought of her as more than that. Why, then, did their relationship have to fall apart? Was it really her fault? She didn’t do anything wrong. At least, she didn’t intend to. Now, three months later, Samantha finally has her chance. Forced together on their geography field trip to the Lake District, will she finally be able to repair her relationship with Lillian – or will it collapse all over again? [From Lemma Soft Forums]

characters.name: Samantha Taylor Coleridge
characters.description: Based on Samuel Taylor Coleridge. A girl who enjoys talking, but often gets carried away with her own ideas. Conversations with her have a tendency of becoming rather one-sided. She’s been depressed lately, and has been a lot quieter than usual. Her reasoning is, what's the point in performing when Lillian isn't there to appreciate it? She has low self-esteem and can be very clingy – unhealthily so. Maybe this is a side effect of being the youngest daughter of such a large family. [From Lemma Soft Forums]

characters.name: Lillian Wordsworth
characters.description: Based on William Wordsworth. An aloof girl who doesn’t get too close to others – not even to her supposed ‘best friends’. She is mature for her age and dispenses good advice to others, but often does it so bluntly those she tries to help get upset. That never seems to bother Lillian, however. She is incredibly close to her younger brother, Theodore, whom she hasn't seen in several years. [From Lemma Soft Forums]

characters.name: Tabitha De Quincey
characters.description: Based on Thomas De Quincey. Lillian’s self-proclaimed biggest fan, De Quincey is a strange girl who follows Lillian around like an over-eager puppy. She has fairly macabre interests, and often talks about serious subject matters in a disconcertingly offhand manner. She has a good deal in common with Samantha, and the two are rather close friends – or at least, they were. Now, after an unfortunate incident Samantha would rather not recall, Samantha tries to avoid her. [From Lemma Soft Forums]

characters.name: Roberta Southey
characters.description: Based on Robert Southey. One of Samantha’s oldest, closest friends. Roberta is a sensible girl who places a great deal of faith in the rules, and invariably gets angry when people break them. She often gets frustrated with Samantha, but cares for her a great deal. She tries to act as cool and aloof as Lillian, but always caves in and gets angry/embarrassed when people (particularly Georgia) start making fun of her. [From Lemma Soft Forums]

characters.name: Georgia Byron
characters.description: Based on Lord Byron. A general nuisance who derives great pleasure from making other people (particularly Roberta) unhappy. She says all kinds of outrageous things she doesn’t truly believe just to offend other people, so it’s often difficult to tell what she really thinks. She is a genuine lady, coming from a well-connected family, and takes great pride in this fact. Sadly, her title is nothing more than mere decoration, as her family is almost destitute. [From Lemma Soft Forums]

characters.name: Persephone Shelley
characters.description: Based on Percy Shelley. A girl who, at first glance, seems to be shy and softly spoken. However, when brought onto the topics of women’s rights, the meat industry, or police brutality, she can become very outspoken. She’s an optimistic do-gooder who attempts to convert others to her own ideals, often without success. Nevertheless, she refuses to give in – which is nothing short of a miracle, considering the cynical and misanthropic Georgia is her best, perhaps only, friend. She used to be bullied quite badly but now, given her friendship with Georgia, nobody dares to say a bad word against her. Not to her face, anyway. [From Lemma Soft Forums]

characters.name: Alexandra Pope
characters.description: Based on Alexander Pope. A bitter English teacher who bemoans the fact she has to act as a chaperone on the year 12's geography trip. Why? She doesn’t even teach geography. Miss Pope is incredibly, unusually short, but more than makes up for her lack of height with her gleeful sadism and caustic comments. Why she became a teacher is something of a mystery, but most assume she did it in order to make as many of her students' lives as miserable as possible. [From Lemma Soft Forums]

title: Uso kara Hajimaru Koi no Natsu
description: “Love can so easily turn people into liars.” On a hill overlooking the sea is Minatocho’s Aoba Dai-ichi High School. One night, 2nd year student, Tachibana Kaoru is completely heartbroken by her middle school homeroom teacher, Shimotsuki Mirei. That scene is also seen by Minagi Shiori, a model student who is also in Kaoru’s class. In state of despondence, Kaoru opens up to Shiori about her past with Mirei. After listening intently to Kaoru’s story, Shiori, with a mysterious air about her, poses a question. “Instead of forgetting someone you cared about… do you think it’s possible to simply overwrite those memories with different ones?” “I’m not sure if it’s truly possible or not, but I might have to try something like that if I’m going to get over her.” With that, Shiori suddenly makes a surprising request to Kaoru: “I need you to help me forget about my older brother.” It is a request t

characters.name: Shishimai Rinka
characters.description: She currently runs a small café named Lion House in place of her grandmother, who returned to the countryside temporarily to take care of a relative. The blonde streaks in her hair are natural, but have caused her peers to label her as a delinquent. To that effect, she rarely speaks to anyone there other than her friends Miharu, Mao and Naomi. This fact doesn't particularly bother her however, especially as she's not one for keeping up with trends and adjusting her attitude to those around her. Ironically she's also seen as cool and aloof thanks to that, when in reality she cares for her friends deeply. She has no particular hobbies to speak of, though she does enjoy shopping and reading shoujo manga. Black coffee is a favorite of hers, though she dislikes anything either too bitter or too sweet. One day while returning home with Naomi, she dies while shielding Naomi from an explosion, b

characters.name: Tachibana Kaoru
characters.description: The protagonist of this story. A second-year student at Aoba First Municipal High School. She has an elusive personality, but at heart she is honest and straightforward. She often says random things that leave those around her exasperated, but she's also a bit of a scatterbrain, and it's frequently hard to tell if she's serious or joking. She has a superficial interest in everything, and her hobbies are wide-ranging and shallow, including fashion, cosmetics, stuffed animals, and smartphone games. Kaoru's feelings for Shimotsuki Mirei, her first love, are special. Therefore, although she is often confessed to by both boys and girls at school, she has never accepted a confession and doesn't even consider them. Mirei was Kaoru's homeroom teacher in middle school. Kaoru fell in love with Mirei after a runaway incident that occurred when she was in her third year of middle school. Although th

characters.name: Minagi Shiori
characters.description: She is a second-year student at Aoba Municipal High School and Kaoru's classmate. A beautiful and academically excellent student. However, there is a thick invisible wall between her and those around her, and her true feelings are always kept hidden inside. In front of Riku, who has been her friend since middle school, she shows her absent-minded and stubborn side. Although she was in the same class as Kaoru, she had hardly ever spoken to her. However, after a certain incident, they began to build a friendship, and she started to show an unexpected side of herself in front of Kaoru. She tries to follow the same career path as her accomplished older brother and imitates his interests. She even goes so far as to declare to herself that "life has no value unless I become like my brother," which is almost to the point of being obsessive. She adores a character named "Ushimocha," and her eyes

characters.name: Inohara Riku
characters.description: She's been Shiori's friend since middle school and is a second-year student at Aoba Municipal High School. She's shy and energetic, often playing the straight man to everyone's antics, and frequently gets dragged into trouble by Kaoru and Shiori. However, she has an abnormal love for donuts, and when faced with donuts, she completely transforms and loses all sense of normalcy. She is good at all kinds of sports and is a member of the swimming club. While it's not a top-tier team, she is dedicated to her club activities. Although she doesn't show it often, she is a hard worker when it comes to studying, and her grades are among the top. She is confused by the fact that Kaoru and Shiori became close friends after a certain incident, and she is always worried about the two of them. She harbors romantic feelings for Shiori that go beyond friendship, but she has been unable to confess her fee

characters.name: Shimotsuki Mirei
characters.description: Kaoru's former homeroom teacher from middle school. She taught art. She appears to be a cool, mature woman at first glance, but in reality, she has a carefree personality that is quite unlike a typical teacher, as she loves alcohol and cigarettes (e-cigarettes these days). Following a runaway incident that occurred when Kaoru was in her third year of junior high school, she resigned from her job at a private junior and senior high school. After a period of unemployment, she now works as an instructor at an art school run by an acquaintance. They reconnected after Kaoru entered high school, and although Kaoru still calls her "Sensei," their relationship remains somewhere between friends and lovers. [From official website]

characters.name: Asahi Kayo
characters.description: The homeroom teacher of Class 2B, to which Kaoru, Shiori, and Riku belong. Her subject is modern Japanese literature. This is her third year working at Aoba High School. Perhaps because of her somewhat laid-back and slightly clumsy personality, she's not just close to the students, but often gets teased by them. One of her goals is to be a proper teacher, and her desire to be someone students can rely on and confide in is evident in her words and actions, which may be one of the reasons she gets teased. However, when students actually seek her advice, she faces them directly and does everything she can to help, earning her the deep trust of some of them. She likes alcohol and isn't particularly weak to it, but she tends to misjudge her pace. It seems she interacts with Mirei through alcohol. [From official website]

title: A Little Lily Princess
description: Newly arrived at a boarding school in Victorian England, Sara Crewe uses her love of books and storytelling to build new relationships. But what happens to a fairy-tale princess when she loses everything?

characters.name: Sara Crewe
characters.description: A dreamer who loves stories.

characters.name: Lavinia Herbert
characters.description: The reigning queen bee.

characters.name: Ermengarde St. John
characters.description: Struggles with her schoolwork.

characters.name: Jessie Abbot
characters.description: Lavinia's best friend.

characters.name: Lottie Leigh
characters.description: Adorable but somewhat bratty.

characters.name: Mariette Dumas
characters.description: Sara's personal maid.

characters.name: Becky
characters.description: The timid scullery girl.

characters.name: Maria Minchin
characters.description: The stern headmistress.

full_description: Newly arrived at a boarding school in Victorian England, Sara Crewe uses her love of books and storytelling to build new relationships. But what happens to a fairy-tale princess when she loses everything?

title: Starlight Vega
description: After moving into her grandfathers old house, Aria and Melody accidentally unleash the flirtatious demon, Lyria, who spent the past fifty years in a stone. A yuri visual novel with three romantic routes and different endings (including a harem end) based on your in-game choices.

characters.name: Aria Reid
characters.description: The protagonist of the story. She and her mother just recently moved into her grandfather’s creepy old house, which she isn’t happy about.

characters.name: Lyria
characters.description: A demon who spent the past 50 years trapped in a stone. She is eccentric, flirtatious and somewhat of a mystery.

characters.name: Melody Rococo
characters.description: Aria’s best friend and classmate. She is very smart, but also rather shy, and often worries about what others think of her.

characters.name: Scherza
characters.description: Queen of the demon realm. She has a very icy personality and a dislike for humans.

characters.name: Rhiannon
characters.description: Scherza's witch consular.

title: Lip Trip ~Boss wa Watashi no Genetsuzai~
title_original: リップ・トリップ～編集長（ボス）はわたしの解熱剤～
description: In the Omegaverse, everyone is born into one of three secondary genders: Alpha (α), Beta (β), or Omega (Ω). The majority of the population are Betas, while Alphas sit at the apex of society with their superior looks and abilities. Meanwhile, Omegas have a special characteristic: they periodically go into heat, at which time they become irresistible to Alphas. Rino is an Omega, and a new recruit working for a digital travel magazine. Chizu is an Alpha, and Rino's boss. "Um, Boss! It's my first day, and..." The moment Rino hears her boss's voice, she suddenly goes into an off-cycle heat! Chizu respects the fact that Rino doesn't want to quit her job just because of her natural urges as an Omega and makes a decision to help her. "Just bear with it. I'll get it over with soon." Entranced by her cool fingers and sweet scent, Rino gives her body over to Chizu. Fate begins to toy with the two a

characters.name: Maiguma Rino
characters.description: [i]"Having an Alpha for a boss feels like a microcosm of society as a whole." Editorial assistant in NK Publishing's digital media department. An Omega new recruit to the editorial division of the digital magazine Fuller. Her hobbies are traveling and trying delicious foods. As an Omega, she has always attracted many Alphas of both genders, but she lives life on her own terms. Although she knows she's been employed to meet the company's Omega quota, she's determined to demonstrate her competence. And while she receives a cold reception from her Alpha boss, she can't fight her innate instincts... [Taken from Official website]

characters.name: Kiyotsu Chizu
characters.description: [i]"I would've liked to keep going." Editor-in-Chief of NK Publishing's digital media department. A young female Alpha, she's Fuller's top talent and Editor-in-Chief. She's into women, and her hobbies are ceramic art and herbal tea. As is usual for an Alpha, she's incredibly smart and extremely skilled. She has a mild and pleasant temperament and is well-liked and respected among her staff. Although she obligingly helps Rino calm down when she goes into heat, for some reason, she keeps pushing the other woman away... [Taken from Official website]

title: Oshi no Love yori Koi no Love ~Love or Die~
title_original: 推しのラブより恋のラブ ～ラブ・オア・ダイ～
description: "A shotgun wedding?! Will the brides make it down the aisle?!" The distant sound of bells chime through a pure white chapel... She never thought it would happen to her, but this is even more than she dreamed of... Unlucky otaku Akuru Hayahoshi could never pull her husbando in the gacha game she's obsessed with, no matter how much money she threw at it-- Until one day, she ran into the garishly gorgeous and freakishly lucky Ren Furutachi. A series of misunderstandings led to a proposal, and Ren started to full-on pursue Akuru... Until they ended up dating for real! It's been a year since the couple started living together in blissful cohabitation. One day, Akuru catches a glimpse of Ren's plans for after she graduates: "Number 1 life goal: Marry Akuru!" Of course, Akuru's not interested in marriage... But one day, struck by a fit of jealousy over Ren's long-time friend, Aira Udou, she end

characters.name: Hayahoshi Akuru
characters.description: An office worker who spends her days pursuing her 2D husbando. Yet somehow she has the worst luck, and he's the only one she never brings home. She's so obsessed with the gacha game, she's heading toward financial ruin... But a chance meeting with Ren sets her life tumbling down a totally different path.

characters.name: Furutachi Ren
characters.description: She loves cute things, shiny things--basically anything she can squeal over. When she meets Akuru it's love at first sight--this woman is totally her type! In an attempt to win her heart, she ends up pushing her way into Akuru's home. [spoiler]Her real name is Love, writen with the same Kanji as 'Ren' (恋).

characters.name: Nishiki Shino
characters.description: Akuru's childhood friend, coworker, and fellow otaku. She's a hardcore fujoshi who's in three doujin circles and is a terrible influence on Akuru. From Ren's point of view she's an annoyance who keeps trying to hook Akuru up with gross guys, but she's actually quite enjoying the whole drama.

characters.name: Udou Aira
characters.description: "You'll look fabulous in whatever dress you pick, Ren..." Ren's senpai from middle school. She's a sucker for the ladies and will always turn on the charm around them. But there's something about her that has Akuru watching her back... [Edited from Steam]

title: Hana to Otome ni Shukufuku o
description: The protagonist Tsukioka Akira is a normal guy living his usual life, except for one thing. His twin sister is sickly and is in the hospital and can’t go to school. Problem is that she’s been sick for too long and she may have to repeat the year, or worse drop out of school. So their parents being the most clever people in the world, decided to send him, the splitting image of his sister, over to the all-girls prestigious school to go undercover as his sister, and live her life for a while so that when she comes back, she can take his place without dropping out of school or repeating. Of course it’s a stupid idea and he resisted, but him, being someone who is easily swept away, gave in. So thereon starts his incredible life in an all girls school. [From Accany's Review]

characters.name: Tsukioka Akira
characters.description: Grade: 2nd year, Sakura Group Affiliation: The gardening club Akira is a pretty average guy, with the exception of his feminine looks. He is kind, a donkan and also very hilarious, as sometimes he get’s toyed with by everyone because of his submissive demeanor. Akira's twin sister Akiko is sickly and is in the hospital, so she can’t go to school. The problem is that she’s been sick for too long and she may have to repeat the year, or even drop out of school. So his parents decided to send him, the splitting image of his sister, over to the all-girls prestigious school to go undercover as his sister, and live her life for a while so that when she comes back, she can take his place without dropping out of school or repeating a year. Since he gets easily swept away by the situation, he gave in to his parents' idea and he becomes more and more of a girl deeper in the story because of his att

characters.name: Tsukioka Akiko
characters.description: Grade: 2nd year, Sakura Group Affiliation: The gardening club Akira's sickly younger twin sister. Since Akira did go to replace her in her school without her permission, every time he makes a mistake she shouts at him through the phone. Akiko appears only a few times in the game. She loves flowers a lot so she became a member of her school's gardening club. [Edited from Accany's review]

characters.name: Nagishiro Miyako
characters.description: Grade: 2nd year, Sakura Group Affiliation: The gardening club Miyako is Akira and Akiko’s osananajimi and the latter's classmate. She’s a flower freak just like Akiko, and also is a member of the gardening club. Miyako is a tsundere, so she gets especially hostile towards Akira, the person she is fond of. Not so to the other people though. She’s also from a rich family. [Edited from Accany's review]

characters.name: Houshou Seika
characters.description: Grade: 3rd year, Tsubaki Group Affiliation: Student Council President The richest and most powerful ojousama in the story. She’s the head of the student council and she has set her eyes on Akira on being the next head of the student council. Needless to say she bulldozes over Akira’s rejection and somewhat forces him to join her. She’s very bad in terms of communication, taking always the logically correct route of action but logically correct doesn’t mean it doesn’t hurt people’s feelings. A loner character. [Edited from Accany's review]

characters.name: Kashima Shizuru
characters.description: Grade: 2nd year, Sakura Group Affiliation: Art Club Shizuru is one of Akiko's friends as well as her classmate. She's kind of the silent and clever type, but she's a little weird sometimes and she ain't what she seems. Shizuru's an excellent artist, but that’s to artists though. [Edited from Accany's review]

characters.name: Aina Inori
characters.description: Grade: 1st year, Yuzuki Group The cute kouhai character in the story. She’s cute, but communication-wise she isn’t exactly top class and therefore she’s a little lonely because she thinks she doesn’t have friends. She supports Akira a lot in the story. [Edited from Accany's review]

characters.name: Sagami Kaoru
characters.description: Grade: 3rd year, Momiji Group Affiliation: Track Club, Student Council Vice President The vice president of the student council who is a playgirl. She likes making fun of Akira since his reactions are always cute and amusing. Behind that playgirl mask though is quite the mysterious character. [Edited from Accany's review]

characters.name: Yamamoto Mayako
characters.description: Grade: 1st year, Yuzuki Group Mayako’s a cute little girl who is a friend and classmate of Inori’s. She’s very active and bright and a little clumsy, but that can be overlooked because she always smiles in the end. [Edited from Accany's review]

characters.name: Tenhouin Ayane
characters.description: Grade: 2nd year, Kiri (Paulownia) group Affiliation: Archery club. [spoiler]Her real name is Tenhouin Ayato (天法院 綾斗).

characters.name: Usami Sae
characters.description: Grade: 3rd year, Kiri (Paulownia) Group Affiliation: The gardening club's president

characters.name: Sensei
characters.description: Homeroom teacher of Akiko's class; a young women in her late 20's. As a teacher she is a little a little unreliable, she often sighs. She gives out the impression of her having a low confidence. [Translated from the official site.]

characters.name: Yamauchi-san
characters.description: A maid in Nagishiro Miyako's house, a young women in her late 20's. [Translated from the official site.]

characters.name: Principal
characters.description: An old cheerful woman in her 50's who dresses like a nun and always wears friendly smile. She always thinks about her students. [Translated from the official site.]
