title: TARANORMAL
description: Long ago, on a dark and stormy night…just like this one… A young, brave, charming, funny, successful, attractive, courageous, and currently available woman came up with an idea for the single greatest supernatural investigation show of all time: TARANORMAL. Who was that woman, you might ask? It was ME! (and Maddie(but mostly me)) Since then, it’s been our mission to bring you the most in-depth, in-teresting, and in-credible paranormal videos on the web! And what better way to celebrate the supernatural than an extra special Halloween livestream? It is the very best day of the year, after all. So kick back, relax, and enjoy as me and Maddie celebrate this most wonderful of days with an awesome treat for all of you. I’m sure you’re all dying to see more of me, after all. Get it? Dying? I’m so funny.

characters.name: Tara Bryck
characters.description: One of the world's most popular paranormal vloggers (according to her), Tara is unfailingly charismatic and bursting with limitless energy. She's brash, intrepid, and always seeking something new. That often makes her a magnet for trouble: whether it's from relentless flirting, minor criminal activities or just plain pig-headedness, things around Tara have a tendency to end in chaos. Hobbies: Photography, party planning Likes: Likes, comments, subscribers Dislikes: Horses, Brussels sprouts, instruction manuals Fun fact: Has been arrested for trespassing four times in four different states [From press kit]

characters.name: Abigail Dalsing
characters.description: For the last two centuries, the ghost of a young woman has haunted the forests of Eysenfeld. That ghost is Abigail, a kind and playful soul forcibly bound to the forest as part of an ancient curse. Two hundred years of wishing for a life cruelly denied to her have led to a feeling of crushing loneliness and one overwhelming desire: to finally have someone to talk to. Hobbies: Painting, singing Likes: Animals, snowy days, little cheek kisses Dislikes: Silence, fire, sudden loud noises Fun fact: Absolutely terrified of ghost stories [From press kit]

characters.name: Morgan Fischer
characters.description: A loyal Taranormal viewer and the daughter of Eysenfeld's mayor, Morgan is...different. When not running her small and mostly empty antique shop, she's known to disappear into the woods for days at a time. That, combined with her resistance to traditional social standards, has caused her to develop a bit of a notorious reputation in the village. However, this resistance is not just an act of rebellion: Morgan knows that there's something sinister deep within Eysenfeld, and she's not going to stop until she tears it out at the roots. Hobbies: Wandering, horseback riding Likes: Cats, fairy tales, camping Dislikes: Antiques, maps, dial-up Fun fact: Drinks at least 5 cups of coffee every day. Still always tired. [From press kit]

characters.name: Madison Raines
characters.description: A part-time manager, part-time video editor, and full-time babysitter, Maddie has the thankless job of handling the absolute whirlwind that is her best friend Tara. She's professional, meticulous and intellectual; the first person to turn to when a problem needs solving. But when their investigation entangles her in an ancient curse, she's forced to confront phenomena beyond her comprehension, and more importantly, her own self-doubt. Hobbies: Film analysis, piano Likes: Succulents, day planners, peace and quiet Dislikes: Cold weather, quinoa, flip flops Fun fact: Still tortured by her teenage goth phase [From press kit]

title: Yuuki Yuuna wa Yuusha de Aru S
title_original: 結城友奈は勇者であるS
description: Released as a bonus with the anime's sixth DVD and Blu-ray Disc volume. This is a short, fan disc-like game that takes place following the end of the anime. Contains ten short scenarios.

characters.name: Yuuki Yuuna
characters.description: A second-year in middle school and member of the Hero Club. She prides herself on being a hero, helping out others in needs and always remaining optimistic.

characters.name: Miyoshi Karin
characters.description: An experienced, but somewhat stubborn hero who transfers into Yuuna and Mimori's class and joins the Hero Club to supervise the other heroes.

characters.name: Tougou Mimori
characters.description: Yuuna's best friend and fellow classmate and club member who lives next door to her and often prefers to be called by her family name. Mimori takes pride in her national heritage and is always ready to defend her country and protect its people. She had lost the use of her legs, along with some of her memories, allegedly due to a car accident. [spoiler]Two years ago, Mimori was scouted by Taisha to become a Hero, and went under the name of Washio Sumi. However, after using her Mankai form, she got paralyzed and lost her memory.

characters.name: Inubouzaki Fuu
characters.description: A third-year in middle school and the president of the Hero Club. She is the older sister of Itsuki, who she has been looking after following the death of their parents. She is knowledgeable about Shinju and the Vertex and was the one who gave her fellow members the app needed to fight against the Vertex.

characters.name: Inubouzaki Itsuki
characters.description: A first-year in middle school and member of the Hero Club. She is Fuu's younger sister and respects her dearly.

characters.name: Nogi Sonoko
characters.description: Mimori's classmate from elementary school.

title: AIRIS
tags: Both Male and Female Love Interests
description: Ever since Aliya joined Airis' Vassals as a warrior, she has been devoted to her cause of protecting her country from the creatures that, having lost their senses due to a strange plague, started attacking the cities years ago. Constantly training in dungeons and working to improve herself, she believes she can become one of the best warriors in the kingdom. Unfortunately, there is just one little problem — lately, Aliya has been suffering from blackouts, waking up in different locations with no memory of what happened. Fearful of what this means and what may be happening to her, Aliya is determined to get to the bottom of her strange condition. During her search for a cure for her affliction, she might just discover more than she expected — about her friends, her beloved country and the plague that threw the country into chaos in the first place. [from Official site]

characters.name: Aliya
characters.description: Possessing a strong sense of justice and desire to protect the weak, Aliya is a devoted warrior, hard-working and determined. Due to her impulsive nature, she often jumps headfirst into battle without considering the consequences, so it isn't unusual to see her sporting wounds all over and having to repair her armor yet again. Despite her bubbly and cheerful personality, Aliya has many anxiety issues and negative feelings that she has yet to deal with and just suppresses and covers up with a smile. [From itch.io]

characters.name: Kylan
characters.description: Claiming to be a retired vassal, Kylan is a mysterious person who likes to poke his nose in other people's business. With a brilliant, inquisitive mind and a thirst for knowledge that is never satisfied, Kylan spends his days researching into magic, science and the like. Perhaps partly due to his terrifying intellect, which gives him the ability to analyze people to a great degree of accuracy, Kylan can be very charismatic and manipulative when he wants to be. Despite his charm, Aliya can't quite shake off the feeling that he isn't what he appears to be. What could this eccentric inventor be hiding? [From itch.io]

characters.name: Lyall
characters.description: A fellow vassal and guildmate, Lyall has been Aliya's best friend for years. They're gentle and kind, even passive; they'd much rather yield and agree with others than spend any longer than a few seconds defending their position. Even so, they show an unparalleled sense of devotion and determination regarding Airis and her people. Lately, however, Lyall has been acting somewhat skittish and worried, although they try in vain to act otherwise, and their eyes sometimes fill with a sense of knowing acquiescence that they refuse to explain. Could they know something more than most about the plague or the blackouts? But how? And if so, why haven't they told Aliya? [From itch.io]

characters.name: Everea
characters.description: A fellow vassal, the sassy Everea has been close friends with Aliya for several years. Though she goes through brief, spontaneous periods of air-headedness, she's generally a determined, intelligent girl who loves nothing more than a good fight, both physical and verbal. Those who haven't long known her tend to even think her cold as a result of her penchant for sarcasm and the way she seems to have little sympathy towards the injured and the dead, whether they be a fellow warrior or an especially cute monster. Perhaps this is a result of something in her past, which she refuses to say a word about. [From itch.io]

characters.name: Teddy
characters.description: Teddy is Aliya's animal companion, who sometimes accompanies her on escort quests or in battles. Rescued by Aliya a year ago after her mother was killed by the creatures when she was still a bear cub, Teddy is unwaveringly loyal to Aliya, though she'd never admit it. Thanks to Lyall's magic, Teddy's words can be understood by both Aliya and Lyall, and Teddy never fails to use this power to tell Aliya off for being overly touchy and reckless. Despite her grumpiness and prickly nature, Teddy shares a close bond with Aliya and would go to great lengths to protect her. [From itch.io]

characters.name: King Lio
characters.description: The king of Airis.

title: The Tower of Five Hearts
description: Tsukiware’s second major title, Tower of Five Hearts, is a yuri tale of several maids in service to their princess, all hoping to become her bride for the sake of their respective kingdoms. With artwork by Ryle, you can enjoy fox girls, dog girls, lamia, bunny girls, and catgirls all competing for one lucky woman’s hand in marriage. From MangaGamer

title: Lucky Me, Lucky You
description: Okada Nanami is in a serious slump. Her super cute girlfriend just broke up with her, without any explanation, and she's at her wit's end trying to figure out why. Enter her best friend, Ryo. In an attempt to cheer her up, Ryo invites Nanami over to his apartment to eat ice cream and watch dodgy porn. What begins as a perfectly ordinary night, however, soon takes an unexpected turn, when Nanami discovers one of the actresses is none other than Morishita Misae – a has-been pinup model, and Nanami's first crush. Impulsive as always, Nanami decides to go on a journey with an (unwilling) Ryo to find Misae, and confess to her her feelings – but can her dreams ever hope to live up to reality?

title: Minagoroshi no Otome.
description: — A revenge tragedy of the black-haired noblewoman, who burns sins to ashes with black flames — Suddenly appearing, the invaders known as "Celestial Beings" pushed humanity to the brink of extinction. These grotesque and massive beings ignored all calls for help and brought destruction everywhere. Human cities were burned one after another, and Earth was ruthlessly ravaged. Forests were burned, fields were poisoned, and the seas became a death world covered in an oily film. In that moment of despair, a light appeared to save humanity. "Magical Heart" A miraculous gem that only the chosen maidens can possess. With its power, these maidens, who defeated the Celestial Beings, came to be known as the "Jewel Princesses." Eventually, the academy city "Seika Renaissance Polis Fukkou," symbolizing the revival of humanity, was completed. Known as "Fukkou Academy," it became a new light illuminati

characters.name: Misogigahara Towa
characters.description: Owns the Magical Heart "Serendibite" The discoverer of the "Magical Heart," which became the key to saving humanity, and the founder of the academy city, lost both her beloved sister, with whom she had a close relationship, and her mother due to the ambitions of a single traitor. Since then, she has sworn revenge and infiltrated the academy city, "Seika Renaissance Polis Fukkou (commonly known as Fukkou Academy)," disguised as a transfer student. Holding the Magical Heart left behind by her sister, she transforms into the Black Jewel Princess. Wielding the whip "Barthory," enveloped in jet-black flames, she fights with unmatched skill and versatility. Having lived with the word "revenge" engraved in her heart, she strictly disciplines herself. To survive, she has had to become highly suspicious of others. However, her true nature is kind-hearted and somewhat naive. She meets Shizune Daon

characters.name: Shizune Daonault
characters.description: A student at Fukkou Academy, commonly known as Dee. She has large, curious eyes reminiscent of a cat and brown skin. Her appearance is the spitting image of Towa's sister, who tragically died in the past. Towa meets Dee on her first day as a transfer student, and they quickly become close. Dee, who is sincere and genuine, gradually earns Towa's trust. Eventually, they are drawn to each other, and even after becoming lovers, they maintain a refreshing innocence. Because Dee closely resembles her late sister, she becomes the most precious person to Towa.

characters.name: Akatsukinomiya Eris
characters.description: Owning the Magical Heart "Moonstone" She possesses an overwhelming power that surpasses other Magical Hearts. She is the daughter of the chairman of the academy city "Seika Renaissance Polis Fukkou" and serves as the "Student Council President." Pure and beautiful, she always wears a loving smile and is adored and revered by everyone at the academy, akin to a saint. To Towa, however, she is the daughter of her nemesis and a sworn enemy who has inherited all of her power and ambition. Since childhood, she has been in a romantic relationship with her maid, Yuzuki Celestina, whom she adores like an older sister.

characters.name: Yuzuki Celestina
characters.description: Owning the Magical Heart of "Rubellite" She is an impenetrable guardian who protects her master from all disasters. A loyal maid serving Eris. Rather than being merely a servant, she is like an older sister who is trusted wholeheartedly. Her personality is elusive and unpredictable, often wearing a subtle smile that gives the impression that she might be the one in control. She possesses a maternal, voluptuous figure and is known for her nurturing presence. She also has a deep love for novels and stories and is a member of the literature club.

characters.name: Tsukikage Reika
characters.description: Possessing the Magical Heart "Lapis Lazuli" She wields twin swords named "Shamsheer Zomorodnegarl." At Fukkou Academy, she serves as the Vice President of the Student Council. Her dashing demeanor makes her popular within the academy, and she holds a prince-like position. She comes from an old and prestigious family, which she takes great pride in. As a result, she harbors a strong sense of rivalry and complex towards Eris, the President. Despite having a personality that is the complete opposite, she strangely gets along well with Senbazuru Izuna. They share a peculiar distance, having been physically close many times but never quite becoming lovers. She is sometimes teased by Izuna for having a smaller chest than Eris.

characters.name: Senbazuru Izuna
characters.description: Possessing the Magical Heart "Citrine" She becomes a Jewel Princess who alternates between using a large cannon and a short handgun similar to a derringer. With a hedonistic personality, she is an unconventional presence who hardly seems like a member of the Student Council. Often wearing a mocking smile, she frequently engages in provocative behavior. She is small and agile, displaying a so-called "bratty" demeanor. While she does not actively support Reika's ambitions, she sometimes cooperates with her, either out of whim or affection.

characters.name: Prince
characters.description: --The white prince with eyes filled with sorrow.

characters.name: Witch
characters.description: -The crimson witch stained with hatred.

characters.name: Ayumu Tokikawa
characters.description: The head of Fukkou Academy's Literature Club. She is usually calm and collected, but once she starts talking about old literary works she can't stop. She is a third-year student like Towa, but has already earned her credits and seems to be devoting herself to literary activities. The club has two members: Dee and Serena.

characters.name: Eri
characters.description: One of Reika's entourage. Sent by the Tsukikage Clan, she is Reika's loyal servant. Together with her partner Miri, she always accompanies Reika like a shadow.

characters.name: Miri
characters.description: The second member of Reika's entourage. She rarely shows any emotion and always obeys Reika's commands. She is always seen together with Eri.

characters.name: Guardian
characters.description: The knights who protect the "Seika Renaissance Polis Fukkou" (Fukkou Academy). With their massive, inhuman frames, they wield long spears and shields. They mercilessly annihilate any threats to the academy city, including the likes of the "Celestial Specters." Their willingness to sacrifice themselves makes them a reassuring presence for the academy students, but they are a troublesome obstacle for Towa.

characters.name: Celestial Specters
characters.description: They are the wicked legacy of the Celestials, a "calamity" forever etched into human history. Their grotesque and malevolent forms are said to resemble the Celestials themselves. There are several variations of them, and they attack the cities where the remaining humans have survived, often in swarms. Even the academy cities, protected by the "Jewel Princesses" and Guardians, are not exempt from their assaults.

title: Sono Hanabira ni Kuchizuke o: Yuririn
title_original: その花びらにくちづけを　ゆりりん
description: Risa, her weight in extremely (beep) condition due to all those delicious snacks and tea, has resolved to go on a diet! However… cutting sweets out of your diet is extremely hard, so seeing how much Risa is suffering, Mai recommends a cycling diet. Hearing how Mai already successfully lost five kilograms, Risa is extremely interested! [From Petals' Garden]

characters.name: Sawaguchi Mai
characters.description: A very responsible second year high school student who has some tomboy tendencies. She falls in love with Reo after getting to know a different side of her. [From Wikipedia]

characters.name: Kawamura Reo
characters.description: A short second year high school student. She is antisocial, a tsundere and in love with Mai. [Edited from Wikipedia]

characters.name: Azumi Risa
characters.description: Class Representative of the Year 1 "Snow" class, and a classmate of Miya's. Has an earnest and hardworking personality. As a hard-nosed person, she often finds herself in leadership positions. She’s what you might call a high-class tsundere girl. While she naturally does well academically and has common sense, whenever she gets into it with Miya, she always gets outreasoned and frequently stomps her feet. Having an unusually strong sense of shame, she gets flustered and briefly digs herself into a hole when thrust into a romantic relationship. The half-Japanese daughter of a foreign company with a British mother. Built like a model, and the owner of enormous breasts. [Translated from Getchu and Yurin Yurin]

characters.name: Ayase Miya
characters.description: A student of the Year 1 "Snow" class, and a classmate of Risa's. A prominent genius on campus, but has difficulty in social situations. Doesn’t really take issue with people other than Risa, and socializes as little as possible. Whenever she speaks with Risa it's always abusive, but she's actually covering her own embarrassment. Her speech and behavior always keep others at a distance. She rarely shows her soft side and is unflappable. When she does show her soft side, she becomes timid and casts nervous glances from beneath her lashes. Although you wouldn’t guess it from the way she talks, her behavior is actually quite ladylike. Possessing one of the most prominent intellects on campus, she has been offered the chance to study abroad and even skip grades, but she hates interacting with others, so she enrolled in the not particularly academically demanding school for high-class girls, S

characters.name: Ishigami Satsuki
characters.description: A brilliant, but frank and aloof girl with boyish tendencies. What you would call an aloof mystery. Up front and self-assured. She always speaks in a masculine way. Although she’s never had much interest in eating, Yuuno has been using her home cooking to draw her out more, so that she’ll be straightforward with her expressions of affection, regardless of their surroundings. [Translated from Yurin Yurin]

characters.name: Shinozaki Rikka
characters.description: A first-year student who was accepted into the escalator school of St. Michael's through taking outside entrance exams. Shortly after enrolling, she set a new national record in the 100 meter dash and became an instant celebrity on campus. She has a kind disposition, and has to intervene when she sees someone in trouble. Because of that tendency, she's earned the nickname, "Sir Knight" (騎士様). She serves as vice-representative of her class, and was chosen along with class representative Sayuki as one of the academy’s Best Couples. [Translated from post with info from Dengeki Hime]

characters.name: Shirakawa Sayuki
characters.description: A classmate of Rikka's. Serving as class representative, she lives with her grandfather, who is apparently descended from samurai who once defended a castle. Her name combined with her noble lineage has earned her the nickname "Snow White" (白雪姫). Additionally, being both beautiful and brilliant, a scholar and an athlete, she’s been touted by many as the second coming of "The Perfect Lady". In no time at all after her enrollment, these abilities result in her being entrusted with the role of Chairman of the Environmental Improvement Committee, which is essentially the academy's student council. [Translated from post with info from Dengeki Hime]

title: Kimi to Kanojo no LILYVAGANZA
title_original: 君と彼女のリリィヴァガンザ
description: This is a Story of "Love" One day, Hitomi Tadehara, the best friend of Ichika Shinonome, committed suicide right before her eyes. "I'm sorry for hurting you so much, Ichika-chan." "If I could start over with you, I'd like to have a normal romance this time." Though Hitomi should have taken her own life, one day she naturally reappeared in front of Ichika. From that day on, Ichika began to be consumed by Hitomi's twisted affection. Classmates who interfered with Ichika's love were killed by Hitomi, and Ichika herself was gradually tainted by Hitomi's warped desires. Can Ichika accept Hitomi's love? [From itch.io]

characters.name: Tadehara Hitomi
characters.description: The heroine. Her parents passed away, so she lives with her grandmother. Calm and kind of an airhead. Right as she was set to debut as a voice actress for anime, she died from suicide. Her final words were a wish to fall in love normally with Ichika. She is the only one who knows Ichika's secret.

characters.name: Shinonome Ichika
characters.description: Protagonist. The daughter of a doctor father and secretary mother who often have to travel for work, leaving her alone. As class president, she is well-liked, and has a reputation as a serious student who intends on following in her father's footsteps and becoming a doctor. Her life is thrown into disarray following the discovery of her close friend Tadehara Hitomi's body following her suicide.

characters.name: Ayase Nanao
characters.description: One of Ichika and Hitomi's classmates. She is in a trio friend group with Mutsuki Mizuno and Otonashi Haruka. She works as a reader model outside of school and is stated to have good looks as well as fashion.

title: I Want to Pursue the Mean Side Character!
description: Beatrix is used to being misunderstood by her fellow peers. With her sharp eyes, tall height, and ringlets, she looks like the mean villain straight from a novel. Thus, she decided that if she was forever going to be seen as the mean bully, she might as well reside herself to the role. However, things change when she becomes fast friends with the new commoner transfer student, to everyone’s surprise including her own. And more weirdly, how this new transfer student can seem to understand her better than anyone else and can see her for her true self rather than the part she had been reluctantly forced to play! [From itch.io]

characters.name: Beatrix Clermont
characters.description: Our easily misunderstood narrator. Has only one friend. Current concern is her height. She is engaged to be married to the prince, Edvard.

characters.name: Lily Abbot
characters.description: Beatrix's best and only friend. Says weird things sometimes like "tsundere" and "moe." Current concern is how to stop running into males randomly.

characters.description: Beatrix's fiancé, the prince.

title: Rising Angels
description: Rising Angels is the story of Faye Moonfallow, her squad of somewhat loveable misfits, and their dreams of becoming officers in the Katajion Defense Force. However, before they can get there, they have to first pass the rigorous Space Sector Academy. Life is rough, non-stop, and the danger of getting the boot is ever-present. Can Faye and her squad overcome the challenges posed to them or will the group destroy itself in chaos? [From [URL=http://www.idhasstudios.com/?p=217]official site]

characters.name: Sol Hackett
characters.description: A fighter pilot who has spent the last couple years fighting in the war. After losing the love of his life to a non-human, Sol’s bitter hatred for non-humans has only amplified. While fighting in the war, Sol’s constant loss of loved ones and friends has led him to become pessimistic and depressed. Tough on his fellow pilots, Sol knows it is only a matter of time before they leave him as well.

title: Forest Guardian
description: What would you do if you met a fox girl in a forest? After collapsing in a forest while trying to make it to the local port before winter sets in, a lone merchant, Anna, wakes up in a pristine shrine. It doesn't appear as though anybody else is there, with the exception of the caretaker, a kitsune who introduces herself as Mayu. Being the guardian of the forest, Mayu laments the fact that, with the exception of Anna, she has not had any visitors to her shrine in many, many years. Yet duty calls, and she is a very diligent fox girl. As thanks for saving her, Anna wants to help Mayu bring visitors back to her shrine, but what she learns in the meantime may end up making her change her mind. Confronted with Mayu's past, what will Anna do? [From Itch.io]

title: Trouble Comes Twice
tags: Both Male and Female Love Interests
description: Trouble Comes Twice features two playable protagonists, twins Jace and Hazel. Already halfway through their university years, the twins realize neither of them have ever been in love before. Like any other not-so-rational person, the twins decide to turn finding love into a competition. Whoever gets into a relationship first wins. May the best twin win!

characters.name: Jace
characters.description: The male protagonist. A self-proclaimed "rational narcissist" because he strongly values honesty and the truth is he's pretty hot. A social butterfly, Jace has breezed through life so far thanks to his good looks and confident charm. Unwilling to date anyone he's not genuinely interested in, Jace never crosses the line past flirting with anyone. [From itch.io]

characters.name: Hazel
characters.description: The female protagonist. An ambitious, assertive perfectionist who has dedicated her entire life to her piano and pretty 2d characters (but we don't talk about that part). Her competitive nature might not always be so easy to deal with, but Hazel will go above and beyond for her few who do stick around. [From itch.io]

characters.name: Stephanie
characters.description: Stephanie is a skilled violonist who, surprisingly, admires Hazel a lot. What Stephanie lacks in confidence, she makes up for it in talent. Though her sheltered upbringing has shaped her into a gentle and graceful young girl, she's determined to grow out of her timid shell now that she's at college. [From itch.io]

characters.name: Adrian
characters.description: Jace's friend since basically forever, Adrian is a cool-headed and dependable introvert armed with plenty of deadpan jokes. Adrian is also one of the few people who can endure this twins' never ending shenanigans and though he might not seem like the type, he has plenty of his own mischievows moments too. [From itch.io]

characters.name: Zoe
characters.description: Hazel and Jace's next door neighbour. Also Hazel's only real friend, though they still can't seem to agree on which one of them is the sidekick. Zoe often gets mistaken for an airhead because of her playful and bubbly attitude, but she's also quick-witted, clever and most definitely not a girl to be trifled with. [From itch.io]

characters.name: Cameron
characters.description: A snarky, boisterous guy Jace plays basketball with sometimes. Cameron's got a bad boy reputation at campus, but no one's sure where the rumours came from. Ignoring how he never seems to take off his sunglasses, Cameron drives a motorcycle and owns the world's cutest dog - what more could you with for in a guy? [From itch.io]

For several years, she’s been drifting between low-paid part-time jobs, while living with her parents: her nagging mother and her kind-hearted father. Mayo is unmotivated and lazy at the best of times, but she does have a passion: namely, Princess Luluna from the popular light novel series, The Forest of the Elves and the Pressured Princess, written by one Tsuchimi Rui. Mayo’s love for Princess Luluna is so great, her room is full of Elf Forest merchandise. Her walls are covered in posters of Luluna’s smiling face, and she owns several Luluna figures, much to the bemusement of her best friend, Nina. Despite Mayo’s intense, borderline obsessive love for Elf Forest, she’s content to pine after her fictional waifu from afar – that is, until one day, when a friend of her family

characters.description: A loud and boistrous girl who gives everything her all. She smiles all the time, so everybody assumes she's perpetually cheerful - but she is far more critical of herself than people realize. She hates sitting still for too long, thanks to all those boring fishing trips with her dad when she was little. Surprisingly, she has a soft spot for girly romance manga.

title: Watashi-tachi Marriage 1
description: Spring. Hoshino Hikari is a new transfer student to the prestigious St. Leanne Girl’s Academy. But she’s no ordinary student, as she’s been sent there as an agent by the “Agency”, who are interested in the secrets hidden within the school. While her transferring in is quite extraordinary, everyone is more interested in the ritual that takes place before the opening ceremonies. During this ritual, some students manifest signs of the zodiac, and then are given an angelic title and a blessing. These students are known as the Angels of the Zodiac, and are given the role of bringing fortune to the student body. Hikari, who is trying to not stand out in order to root out the school’s secrets, is bestowed with the grace of Virgo during the ceremony and becomes known as “Exousia”. This is of no consequence to Hikari who simply wishes to make friends with the student body as soon as possible to n

characters.name: Mokose Alissa
characters.description: Alissa is a first-year student at the Academy. She received the mark of Aries, becoming one of the Angels of the Zodiac. A cheerful and energetic young lady, she always lights up the room. She fell in love with Hitsuji after the latter kissed her out of nowhere during their first meeting (!?). The two started going out on the spot (!?!?). Alissa is proactive to the point of defying common sense. She acts like the protagonist of a gag manga. [Based on the description provided by the author.]

characters.name: Hoshino Hikari
characters.description: A first-year student in the Standard Course. She's cute, and she knows it. 16 years old. Hikari is the sort of person who's nice to everyone, and gets roped into everyone's troubles as a consequence. In reality, she's an Agency spy who's been enrolled into St. Leanne Girl's Academy with a mission to uncover the plans of its Principal. Having taken part in a ritual held before the school's opening ceremony, she was, to her surprise, bestowed with the grace of Virgo, becoming one of the Twelve Angels of the Zodiac. [spoiler]Her mission only kept going off rails from there. She was thrown a year into the past, and ended up accidentally charming her fellow agent Hime with her zodiac powers. It's increasingly looking like Hikari has found herself dancing to [i]someone else's tune. [Translated from the author's Twitter.]

characters.name: Saginomiya Konoe
characters.description: A second-year student in the Pillar, Konoe is the older of the two Saginomiya sisters. She has received the blessing of Leo. She won a surprise victory in the last year's election, breaking the ruling clique's grip on the student council. This upset came to be known as 'the Leonine Revolution'. During the election, she kept her younger stepsister Homare at arm's length. The reason for that was... [spoiler]Following the wishes of her family, she is currently aiding Hikari with her covert activities in the Academy. [Based on three separate descriptions provided by the author.]

characters.name: Saginomiya Homare
characters.description: A first-year student in the Advanced Course. She's currently serving as the student council secretary. Homare ended up leading her beloved stepsister Konoe to victory in the last year's student council election. She is extremely capable and always acts with her sister's best interests at heart. At the time, however, Konoe refused her attempts to help, leading Homare to look for the reasons why. [spoiler]She and Hikari became best friends over the course of the election. [Based on three separate descriptions provided by the author.]

characters.name: Yata Hime
characters.description: Second year Advanced Course student, 17 years old. She's a covert asset for the Agency who's been infiltrating the Academy ever since she was enrolled in it's elementary school divison. Mindful of the need to blend in, she tries not to stand out too much. Her relationships with other students are kept superficial as a result. She always keeps a poker face, but beneath it all she's actually quite playful. [spoiler]To keep her disguise from being blown, Hime started a fake relationship with Hikari, who ended up accidentally charming her with her powers. Unbeknown to her pretend lover, she's been looking for a way to break the spell, but... [Translated from the author's Twitter.]

characters.name: Ikaruga Gargouille Risette
characters.original: 斑鳩 ガルグイユ・リゼット
characters.description: A third-year student in the Pillar. She is marked with the sign of Cancer. Last year, Risette made a bid for the presidency of the student council as a candidate of St. Leanne's [i]de facto ruling Blood Pact Party, only to be defeated by her rival Konoe. She is currently serving as the council's vice president under the older Saginomiya's leadership. [Based on two separate descriptions provided by the author.]

An unknown entity that's making Hikari dance to it's own tune using [i]something. That [i]something in turn guides Hikari by summoning letters out of thin air. [Translated from the official description.]

characters.name: Tsuchimikado
characters.description: An Agency operative. He is tasked with relaying communications from Headquarters to the Capital Branch, as well as with assuming operational command over the group. Allegedly a descendant of the legendary Abe no Seimei, he nevertheless lacks any ability as an Onmyouji. Due to this powerlessness, he avoids engaging in combat personally. If you ask the man himself, he's just a part of the Agency's middle management. [spoiler]In contrast with his cheerful demeanour, Tsuchimikado also has a cold-hearted side to him. He sees Uzume as little more than just another tool at his disposal. [Based on two separate descriptions provided by the author.]

description: When the previous owner of Locker 1224 mysteriously disappeared, you were left holding the only clues. As a new student to the truly bizarre Weasel Heights, you must navigate the school’s social landscape through your decisions and conversations. Make new friends and face old enemies to work out exactly what happened - and if there’s anything you can do to put it right. If you work up the nerve to ask your crush on a date, there are five romanceable characters in LongStory: Two girls, two boys, and one… well, you’ll have to wait and see. It's gonna be a long story. [From Google Play]

description: After hearing about a number of student couples forming at her school, Himeka Uchida decides to look for a girlfriend of her own. As she gets wrapped up in the daily lives of her friends and classmates at Solana Academy, will she find the romance she seeks? [From Steam]

characters.name: Himeka Uchida
characters.description: The main viewpoint character of Blooming Nightshade and Flowering Nightshade. Himeka is a second-year high school student. She's cheerful and friendly, but sensitive about her height. She has become good friends with Izumi and Kiyomi in the year and a half since starting high school. Even so, she has started to daydream about romance lately. [From Itch.io]

characters.name: Izumi Kawano
characters.description: A second-year high school student. The reliable captain of the volleyball team, though she doesn't share much about herself. While she is good friends with Himeka and Kiyomi, Izumi doesn't share much about her home life with them. She keeps things focused on others, rather than letting anyone focus too heavily on her. [From Itch.io]

characters.name: Kiyomi Ito
characters.description: A second-year high school student. A track team member who always wears a jacket or hoodie. One of Himeka and Izumi's friends. She comes off as more serious about her studies than they are, but she's not actually much more intelligent than her friends. However, her more stable demeanor can lead others to unconsciously depend on her. [From Itch.io]

characters.name: Nanami Kobayashi
characters.description: A first-year high school student. A bashful member of the cooking club that tends to minimize her achievements. Having been "spoiled" for most of her childhood, Nanami feels unprepared for the challenges of high school life. Given the chance to spend time with a friendly elder schoolmate like Himeka, Nanami is willing to jump at the chance to be guided through her first year. [From Itch.io]

characters.name: Atsuko Aoki
characters.description: Atsuko is a first-year high school student. Blind in one eye, and doesn't socialize much with others. Often mistaken for quiet or demure, Atsuko has become jaded by the way others treat her. So when someone like Himeka decides to take notice of her, Atsuko is caught off-guard. But it'll take more than a study session or two to change Atsuko's mind about what people expect from her. [From Itch.io]

characters.name: Kiku Moritani
characters.description: A third-year high school student. She looks younger than she is, and is known to be skilled with many musical instruments. As the president of the school's Music Club, Kiku is as much a teacher as she is a student and performer. While she wishes she could overcome the reluctance of students like Himeka in regards to learning to play music, she is willing to share the beauty of music with anyone who will listen. [From Itch.io]

characters.name: Shiori Goto
characters.description: A third-year high school student. She has a regal figure and reputation, particularly due to her long hair. While Shiori's princess-like beauty is known by many, she actually doesn't seem to have many friends that know her well. Outside of classes, meals, and studying, it's almost like she disappears from the school. [From Itch.io]

title: Sapphism no Gensou
description: Story takes place on a fanciful, all-girl educational institution that floats along the oceans. Despite the complete absence of men, there have been incidents of rape amongst the passengers and crew. No one knows who it is just yet, but there are three candidates that carry the high probability of being the next target. Suspense and mystery await as the women suspect one another to be the perpetrator, and who will be next victim. You play as an idol--a female--of the student body who joins in the hunt for finding who did it. The rub lies in the fact that the ship will disembark in three weeks, and the culprit will have gotten away with it by then. [From White Masq]

title: Serafina's Saga
tags: Both Male and Female Love Interests
description: Young Serafina has spent her entire life alone in the jungle with only her guardian, a mysterious man named Arken, as company. When Arken is captured by a group of soldiers and carried away, Serafina must venture outside the forest to save him. On her journey to the heart of the kingdom, Serafina discovers a whole new world beyond the shadows of the jungle. She will also learn the dark truth of Arken's past and thus her own. How she chooses to use this knowledge will change the fate of the entire kingdom. [From Official site]

characters.name: Arken Jeridar
characters.description: In appearance, Arken is a kind guardian to Serafina who has protected her from the perils of the Darzian jungle and, more importantly, taught her how to overcome them herself. But Arken staunchly refuses to let Serafina leave the boundaries of the jungle, and will tell her nothing of his former life, nor of Serafina's own origins. [From official site]

characters.name: Belatrix Grandil
characters.description: The Grandil family is well respected for its long history of honorable and trustworthy members. Belatrix is no exception. Fierce, noble, and beautiful, Belatrix is only a hairsbreadth away from taking the throne herself. The Royal Duma will likely elect her to rule after Kallias. But Belatrix values her honor to a fault. Nothing matters to her so much as keeping her word and serving Kallias faithfully. [From official site]

characters.name: Jezu Grandil
characters.description: Jezu proudly serves as General of the Royal Guard under his sister, Belatrix. He's also known to be the best swordsman in Castle Krondolee. Like most members of the Grandil family, Jezu is highly dignified and values his honor above his life. However, he's known to make unorothodox decisions from time to time due to his senstive temperament. He has a strong sense of compassion and is more forgiving than Belatrix. title: Fragile Feelings
description: Ann Clements is terminally ill. Born with an inoperable tumour in her temple, numerous doctors told her during her childhood that she wouldn’t survive into her adulthood. Ann’s parents, regarding their frail and sickly young daughter as a hindrance, sent her away to a fancy all-girls’ boarding school, St Cecilia’s, located in the countryside at an early age: ostensibly so the country air could rejuvenate her but, in actuality, to get rid of her. Ann’s future looked like a bleak, desolate thing – but, by some miracle, she defied both her doctors’ prognoses and her parents’ pessimism. Ann is now nineteen years old, and her condition seems to have stabilised, despite her frequent headaches. Ann spent so much of her childhood, however, convinced that she would die before her eighteenth birthday that she has no plans, goals, or dreams, and no idea what to do with what remains of her life. Fee

Will she take the romance slow or just get straight to juicy bits. [From Official webpage]

characters.name: Fumiko Fujimoto
characters.description: Fumiko is a sweet girl, who loves to watch movies on Netflix. She's more assertive than she appears to let on. [From official site]

characters.name: Rei Yukimura
characters.description: Despite her confident appearances she is actually really shy and tends to fumble her words sometimes. She's outgoing and doesn't mind taking risks to have a little fun. [From official site]

characters.name: Aika
characters.description: Aika is a tough shell to crack. She hides her feelings and insecurities by making excuses related to her status as class president or politician's daughter. She just needs someone to help her loosen up a bit. [From official site]

characters.name: Misaki
characters.description: Misaki is the quiet glasses girl who sits by the window in class. She doesn't say much, but there seems to be more on her mind than she is letting on. [From official site]

characters.name: Suzu
characters.description: Suzu is a very chatty cheerful girl who loves to have fun. She's loves dressing up in cat headbands. You'll often hear her talk about her sister a lot who she adores. [From official site]

characters.name: Yukino Akigawa
characters.description: President of the anime and manga club in our college. Cheerful and self-confident girl, gets along well with all students. [From Steam]

characters.name: Ajka Kashinava
characters.description: Newcomer in college. Transferred due to move into new city. A kind and intelligent girl. Loves to read manga and drink juice. [From Steam]

characters.name: Eva Tanigashimi
characters.description: In life, insecure and quiet girl. Was unable to find any new friends in college. Immersed in a manga, suffers from loneliness. [From Steam]

title: Roomie Romance
description: Your start at a new job was always going to be hard, a new city, a new place to fit in. But it is made far worse when you fall at first sight with your new housemate and Senpai at work. The game follows the growing relationship between Mira and her new Senpai over the course of a year, in true visual novel style gameplay your decisions will determine not only the events that occur throughout the game, but who you meet along the way, how you interact with them and what ending (from several) you will receive. [From Steam]

characters.name: Jasmin
characters.description: Favorite undies: Chemise Favorite season: Summer Hobby: Dancing Favorite Color: Orange Jasmin is the oldest of the new applicants to work at the store. Unlike the others, she has been working for the past couple of years as a dancer and is currently not enrolled in college. Jasmin however wants to move on with her life, get a new job, and find a better balance between her passions and work. [Taken from Character Bio Sheet]

characters.name: Emily

In spite of that, she is a shrewd business woman. [Taken from Character Bio Sheet]

characters.description: A human and ex-mercenary working as a tavern owner in the Elven Kingdom of Eiredagh. She tries to stay above water financially while dealing with culture clash (between herself and the elves) and her attractive co-workers.

title: Dreamy Planet
tags: Protagonist's Childhood Friend as a Heroine
description: Haruka and Shiina used to be inseparable. They grew up together, went to school together, and ardently believed that they would always be best friends. That was before Haruka’s breakdown, however. Worn down by her demanding job as a nurse, Haruka abandons her old life, and her old best friend, and moves back in with her parents. Believing herself to be a failure, and too ashamed to see Shiina again, Haruka retreats into herself and her depression, and despairs. It isn’t until almost five years later that Haruka and Shiina reunite. At Shiina’s behest, the pair of them make an impromptu trip to a favourite haunt of theirs from their youth: an outdated theme park on the outskirts of Nara called Dreamy Planet. title: Sakura Forest Girls
tags: Protagonist's Childhood Friend as a Heroine
description: Yaya, Aiyana, and Koko were childhood friends. Born in the same village, they spent their days in peace, and they vowed to always stay together. This all changed on one fateful night, however, when an army of strange monsters attacked their village. Families were scattered and, in the chaos, Yaya and Aiyana were parted from Koko. Three years later, on Yaya's twenty-first birthday, she and Aiyana vow to find the missing Koko. They leave their village and wander the dense forest that surrounds it, searching for a sign of their friend's whereabouts. After several months, their travels lead them to a mysterious witch, Maia, who claims to be all-powerful. Maia says she can help Yaya and Aiyana, but her help comes at a cost. Before Maia will consider lifting a finger for their sakes, she has Yaya and Aiyana prove their loyalty to her through a series of menial chores and embarrassing tasks. Ya

characters.name: Yaya
characters.description: Yaya is the main character of the story. Her parents were both hunters, and she prides herself on her skills with her spear. Cheerful and optimistic, Yaya is unfailingly certain that she'll find Koko again. She is fiercely protective of Aiyana, and will challenge anybody who dares make her uncomfortable - even a powerful witch like Maia.

characters.name: Aiyana
characters.description: Aiyana is a shy, softly-spoken girl born to a family of shamans. Her hair is pure white, which is unusual in the village from where she hails. As a result of her strange looks, she was often bullied during her youth. Aiyana has no fighting prowess, and has a weak constitution. She tires easily, and often needs to rely on Yaya, to her embarrassment. She worries frequently about burdening Yaya, but Yaya is quick to reassure her. Unbeknownst to Aiyana, it is because of her steadfast support that Yaya is able to remain so eternally optimistic.

characters.name: Maia
characters.description: Maia is a sneaky, devious witch of an indeterminable age. She speaks rarely of her past, and is shrouded in mystery, which makes her hard to trust. She is exceedingly powerful (or so she claims), and can accomplish truly impressive feats with her magic... But that is only if she feels like it. Maia loves flirting with cute girls more than anything, and she's very hands-on. She and Yaya often butt heads over this, and they can often be found bickering.

characters.name: Koko
characters.description: Koko is Yaya and Aiyana's childhood friend. She's a kind, considerate girl who cares a good deal for her friends, and she's sensitive about the feelings of others. Koko is gifted at cooking and cleaning, but she's similarly skilled with a bow and arrow. Gentle though she is, she has no hesitation when it comes to hunting, and her skills might even rival those of Yaya's. She has something of a stubborn streak despite her sweet face, and she used to act as a mother figure to Yaya, chastising her whenever she made a nuisance of herself. [Edited from Steam]

characters.name: Mika
characters.description: Mika is a traveling merchant who roams the land selling her wares. Talkative and cheery, she's rarely seen without a wide smile upon her face, and nothing seems to perturb her. Mika is in a dedicated relationship with Koko, whom she dotes upon. She often calls Koko silly pet names, such as 'my little cocoa bean' – a fact which Koko finds incredibly embarrassing. She has a bit of a past with Maia, who seems to regard her with mild disdain. Mika, meanwhile, is impervious to this, and loudly proclaims that she and Maia are the best of friends. [From Steam]

title: April was a Fool
tags: Both Male and Female Love Interests
description: Two years ago, six heroes were tasked with saving the world. So they did. However, once again the world is under threat from an evil force, and once again, these six heroes are called on by their Kingdom to stand up against it. This is their story. A story of action. A story of romance. A story of a handful of idiots dawdling around and somehow managing to save the world. Again. Meet May, a young girl who wants nothing more than to become an adventurer. Nothing in life is free, however, and she's working her first job as a Barmaid in one of Castle City's many pubs. Imagine her shock when five of her customers are Legendary World-Class Heroes who had saved the world from destruction a couple of years ago! Not only that, they seem to have taken an interest in her. Guide May through five unique plotlines centred around five unique people in their journey to save the world, clear up the past

characters.name: Blake Embers
characters.description: | LV: 23 | Warrior | In the ashy ruins of the Embers' Estate stands a stone tablet. On it, Blake's Hero Prophecy is scrawled: "The first son born with hair of flames is destined for greatness." Needless to say, that puts a lot of pressure on the young boy, but no outside pressure can ever be as powerful as the internal one he puts on himself. (Taken from Lemma Soft thread)

characters.name: Erwin Gates
characters.description: | LV: 80 | Rogue | Erwin Gates is a lot of things. The richest and, perhaps self-proclaimed, smartest man alive, the mayor of the illustrious Perk City, a business man, and a World-Class Hero. He's other things too, but he doesn't like talking about those. Actually, it seems he's hiding a lot behind that smile and wink. (Taken from Lemma Soft thread)

characters.name: Gabby Embers
characters.description: | LV: 75 | Mage | A powerful mage who has a nasty habit of burning down entire villages and cities, to the point where she was wanted across the known land. Thankfully, assisting in the defeat of the Evil Overlord helped clear her criminal record, but with a temper as fiery as her magic, it's anyone's guess how long it will stay that way. (Taken from Lemma Soft thread)

characters.name: Gunn Rose
characters.description: | LV: 80 | Priest | Gunn lives and works at his parents' church, using his time spent there to increase his skills as a healer. His enthusiasm for healing is often taken the wrong way, making first impressions not his best skill, but he shrugs that, and most other things, off pretty easily. (Taken from Lemma Soft thread)

characters.name: Kent Kentson Son Of Kent
characters.description: | LV: 58 | Berserker | A peace-loving boy from the North, Kent is rarely seen without a smile or his companion, Foxy. He has a lot of respect for the peace keeping union, the Utopia Makers, and for his father, a powerful chief, but talking about both sometimes leave him strangely nervous. (Taken from Lemma Soft thread)

characters.name: May
characters.description: May is a young girl who has moved away from her parents' farm to Castle City, where the job prospects are endless. After securing a job as a barmaid, she's only worked there for a few days before strange events flip her life around. According to the other characters, she bears a strong resemblance to someone they once knew. (Taken from Lemma Soft thread)

title: Gacha Memories
description: The Gacha World is safe. You, the heroic summoner, saved everyone from the evils of corruption. Now, three months after your big adventure, you are living peacefully as a normal student on Earth. Everything seems perfect, as you spend each day with your beloved friends from the Luniverse. Yet… this happiness does not last for long. Mysterious disappearances have been occurring across the globe. Strange anomalies are appearing in your city. This time, the real world is the one in danger. Can you protect the memories of the ones you love? Find out now in Gacha Memories! [From Google Store]

title: Sakura Knight 2
description: Taking place after the events of Sakura Knight, Estelle continues her quest to become a famous knight like her mother, Cressida. With her mother's sword retrieved and a party of pretty and capable women to support her, our plucky young heroine tries to make a name for herself in Grimoire, Lemuria's biggest city. Together with the ditzy elf Felicia, the mischievous catgirl Tart, and the affectionate wolfgirl Rune, Estelle takes on quests at Grimoire's guild, fights off hordes of wicked plant and slime monsters, and hones her swordplay. Though her journey got off to a rocky start, things are finally starting to look up for Estelle. Perhaps she'll be able to accomplish her dreams after all! ...It would be a lot easier, though, if Rune and Tart would stop arguing every five seconds. characters.name: Estelle
characters.description: Though a young adult in her early twenties, Estelle has spent most of her life sheltered and coddled by her overprotective parents. She dreams of being a knight like her mother, the famous Cressida, who defeated the wicked demon queen, Gunhild. She wants to become a brave knight, but her clumsiness often gets the better of her. Estelle wants dearly to be brave and strong, but she's a shy girl with self-esteem issues. Kind-hearted to a fault, she puts others before herself, and often works herself up unnecessarily. She's naïve and a little too trusting, but has a great capacity for love, and is surprisingly good at settling arguments. [Edited from Steam]

characters.name: Felicia
characters.description: Felicia is a seductive elven princess who hails from the land of Gris. As per elven custom, Felicia must travel across the land and help those in need, in order to prove herself as a worthy successor to her mother’s throne. Felicia comes from a vast family with dozens of siblings. As the oldest, she’s also the loudest, and she almost never stops talking. She’s perpetually cheerful and optimistic, and more than a little airheaded, but her skills with a sword are impeccable. [From Steam]

characters.name: Rune
characters.description: Rune is a wolfgirl who lives deep in the Lemurian forest. Her grasp of common Lemurian is somewhat shaky, and she finds it hard to communicate, but her passion always shines through. Serious and dutiful, Rune is a good ally to have. Like a guard dog, she’ll fiercely defend those she considers her comrades – but if you get on her bad side, she’ll hold a grudge for years. [From Steam]

characters.name: Tart
characters.description: Tart is a self-proclaimed 'magical cat witch'. Though she looks sweet and unassuming, she possesses incredible magical powers. Tart is mischievous and deceptive by nature. She makes a living through thievery, swindling, and stealing. She particularly loves taking advantage of cute girls – especially if she gets to see them cry. [From Steam]

title: Royal Order
tags: Both Male and Female Love Interests
Past Setting in a Fictional World
description: The Sval, pirates of the utmost north, are wreaking havoc all over the continent of Igrith. Vowing to bring an end to their endless plundering, three kingdoms send forth their royal heirs to the High Council, a powerful and influential faction of magicians, to plead for their help during this time of crisis. The High Council oblige, creating the Royal Order, and the heirs remain; however, political tensions are high as old grudges resurface between the three kingdoms. And, as the pirates continue to have their way, they are determinedly bound to reach their breaking point. Play as Aarya, the newest member of the High Council, and help manage the Royal Order. Can you put an end to the Sval’s pillaging while keeping the kingdoms at peace? Or will you bring nothing but war upon them? [From itch.io]

characters.name: Nerifiel Daevaris
characters.description: The High Garrison's Executive. Nerifiel is the protagonist's childhood friend. His arrival in Eskia is to chase after a slave-trader who captured a Rosenkreuz child. He has taken care of the protagonist from their early years; someone very kind, although not very honest about his feelings.

characters.name: Beringer Daevaris
characters.description: This child is a peasant boy saved by Nerifiel from a slave shipement. Shortly after his rescue, he experienced a late Awakening to magic to become a Rozenkreuz. The kid is easily spooked, shy, and impossibly easy to coax with hot rolls and milk.

characters.name: Aarya De Chabenet
characters.description: MAGIC AFFINITY: UNSPECIFIED The House of Chabenet is known for their unique and mysterious Deviant powers since ancient times; however, Aarya seem: to be an exception to them, being the sole elemental mage born in generations. Despite this, nobody will dare deny their powerful magical abilities. With a gentle smile always gracing their lips, Aarya hides an unyielding personality, tenacious vitality, and perhaps a touch of something much, much more.... [From Kickstarter]

characters.name: Emrys Of Sheorya
characters.description: Magic Affinity: None The royal family of Sheorya is said to be evasive, unpredictable, and ruthless. In proper fashion, Emrys is boasted as the incarnation of all these traits. For generations, the Crown Prince is the only one in the royal family that has shown himself in public, which has brought about many rumors even among his people. Although poisonous in both his words and actions, it's a well-known fact that Emrys is not able to use any kind of magic. Still, you'd better think twice before crossing him. You may not live to regret it. [From Kickstarter]

characters.name: Darryl Of Ilsenova
characters.description: Magic Affinity: Fire, Wind, Light Although he has been present on the High Council for only a short time, the second prince of Ilsenova is known for his undeniable benevolence and gentleness. For, despite the heavy responsibilities that come with tending to the matters of his own kingdom, you can often find Darryl in town taking care of the downtrodden. Nonetheless, as amiable as he is, Darryl also possesses high magical abilities, garnering the respect of his servants and peers alike. [From Kickstarter]

characters.name: Iris Of Yutaine
characters.description: Magic Affinity: Water A few words come to mind at first sight of Yutaine's second princess: elegance, grace, and beauty. Beyond initial impressions, Iris comes off as detached and cold with rumors about her past conduct isolating her even further from the social scene. Regardless of her supposed behaviors, she is an incredible alchemist in her own right. Calm and steadfast, Iris performs well on any task assigned to her. As well, under that icy surface, you may find a surprisingly kindhearted soul. [From Kickstarter]

characters.name: Odette Josserand
characters.description: ◆ The only daughter of a humble guardsman, Odette decided at a young age that she and her father deserved better. She worked thrice as hard as everyone else to be recognized by the High Council and takes a lot of pride in being recruited. ◆ Her seniors believe that her fighting style would be best suited to bludgeoning weapons such as mauls or battle axes, but Odette personally would like to wield something a little more elegant. ◆ Odette doesn’t particularly care to talk to nobles, but tailing her father gave her a knack for speaking with just about anyone. In fact, she’s pretty popular with everyone, not including a certain self-proclaimed rival. [From Kickstarter Spotlight]

characters.name: Shawn
characters.description: ◆ Shawn is an excellent listener, but despite popular belief, most of the advice he gives is a little… too literal, to say the least. Asking him for advice on how to pick up boys, for example, might be met with the suggestion to lift them from the knees. ◆ Perhaps fittingly, Shawn enjoys knitting and crocheting in his free time. Most of his creations are baskets and cutesy accessories for Lilith; Darryl jokes that her wardrobe is easily twice the size of his own. [From Kickstarter Spotlight]

characters.name: Lilith
characters.description: ◆ Homunculi are not known to be particularly expressive, and Shawn is no different. Instead, Lilith seems to have taken it upon herself to ‘react’ for him, and she tends to become especially expressive whenever her caretaker feels unusually strongly about something. [From Kickstarter Spotlight]

characters.name: Lucius
characters.description: ◆ Lucius has made it his personal mission to become taller and claims that his growth spurt just hasn’t happened yet. It’s anyone’s guess as to if it ever will. ◆ He’ll deny it feverously if it’s brought up, but Lucius secretly likes having his head patted. ◆ An inquisitive sort, Lucius likes to explore new places whenever he gets the chance to travel. There’s been weeks at a time where he’s seemingly gone missing, but he always finds a way to return to Aarya’s side. [From Kickstarter Spotlight]

plot_tags: Both Male and Female Love Interests
Past Setting in a Fictional World
full_description: The Sval, pirates of the utmost north, are wreaking havoc all over the continent of Igrith. Vowing to bring an end to their endless plundering, three kingdoms send forth their royal heirs to the High Council, a powerful and influential faction of magicians, to plead for their help during this time of crisis. The High Council oblige, creating the Royal Order, and the heirs remain; however, political tensions are high as old grudges resurface between the three kingdoms. And, as the pirates continue to have their way, they are determinedly bound to reach their breaking point. Play as Aarya, the newest member of the High Council, and help manage the Royal Order. Can you put an end to the Sval’s pillaging while keeping the kingdoms at peace? Or will you bring nothing but war upon them? [From itch.io]

title: Aoi Umi no Tristia
title_original: 蒼い海のトリスティア
description: Tristia was a beautiful seaside town which slowly fell to ruin and dilapidation, following the invasion of the dragon ten years ago. The people of the town tried rebuilding the city in the hopes of attaining its former glory, but they failed. Hopeless, the people decided to send for Prospero Flanca, a legendary inventor who was well-known for revivifying many cities that were dying out. They received an answer from Prospero, but to their confusion, it was a girl who arrived to the port of the town. That girl was Nanoca, Prospero's granddaugther, and she is the one who was assigned to do the renovation project. [From Wikipedia]

characters.name: Nanoca Flanca
characters.description: She is the granddaughter of the renowned inventor Prospero Flanca. Prospero's name was well-known all over the world as an inventor and builder, and she is keen to uphold the name. She came from the Imperial Capital with Stuka, an artificial creature, and Tenzan, a mech-styled golem.

characters.name: Faury Carat
characters.original: フォーリィ・キャラット
characters.description: The young chairperson of the Carat Firm. She is known as an unyielding and carefree person. She has been into many troubles since Nanoca came to town.

characters.name: Rafarew
characters.description: The mysterious girl who was found in a casket recovered from the sea in the vicinity of Tristia. Nothing much is known about her.

characters.name: Nene Hampden
characters.description: A rich girl, classmate of Nanoca in the Imperial Capital Youth Academy. She came from the Hampden clan, a wealthy capitalist family from the capital. Nene adores Nanoca very much, and is the one who recommended Nanoca to the town for the mission.

characters.name: Reygurett Kutanie
characters.original: レイグレット・クタニエ
characters.description: The head priest in the Ryunant temple in the city of Tristia. She noticed the talent of Nanoca upon her arrival.

title: Sono Hanabira ni Kuchizuke o: Revolution! Rinagisa
title_original: その花びらにくちづけを　れぼりゅーしょん！ りなぎさ
description: A continuation of the story from Sono Hanabira ni Kuchizuke o: New Gen!, Circumstances have left Rina very upset with Nagisa. She's tried everything to talk it through, but Rina won't listen. "I'm sure...... if we could just talk properly, she'd understand." With an odd yuri couple like Nagisa with her worldly maturity and selfish princess Rina, things heat up after a lover's quarrel. [Edited From DLsite English]

characters.name: Shinozaki Rikka
characters.description: A first-year student who was accepted into the escalator school of St. Michael's through taking outside entrance exams. Shortly after enrolling, she set a new national record in the 100 meter dash and became an instant celebrity on campus. She has a kind disposition, and has to intervene when she sees someone in trouble. Because of that tendency, she's earned the nickname, "Sir Knight" (騎士様). She serves as vice-representative of her class, and was chosen along with class representative Sayuki as one of the academy’s Best Couples. [Translated from post with info from Dengeki Hime]

characters.name: Shirakawa Sayuki
characters.description: A classmate of Rikka's. Serving as class representative, she lives with her grandfather, who is apparently descended from samurai who once defended a castle. Her name combined with her noble lineage has earned her the nickname "Snow White" (白雪姫). Additionally, being both beautiful and brilliant, a scholar and an athlete, she’s been touted by many as the second coming of "The Perfect Lady". In no time at all after her enrollment, these abilities result in her being entrusted with the role of Chairman of the Environmental Improvement Committee, which is essentially the academy's student council. [Translated from post with info from Dengeki Hime]

characters.name: Kimishima Ai
characters.description: Aya’s elder twin sister, and the class mascot. While typically meek and docile, she’s actually very willful, and won’t budge once she’s set her mind on something.

characters.name: Misawa Nagisa
characters.description: The star of the track and field team, who’s always surrounded by fans. She and Rina have been best friends since they were little, and they can often be spotted together.

characters.name: Takahata Rina
characters.description: A spoiled and pushy princess. But for some reason, everybody loves her. In class, she’s treated like an actual princess. She has a particular fondness for Nagisa.

full_description: A continuation of the story from Sono Hanabira ni Kuchizuke o: New Gen!, Circumstances have left Rina very upset with Nagisa. She's tried everything to talk it through, but Rina won't listen. "I'm sure...... if we could just talk properly, she'd understand." With an odd yuri couple like Nagisa with her worldly maturity and selfish princess Rina, things heat up after a lover's quarrel. [Edited From DLsite English]

title: The Stargazers
tags: Combat with Laser and Beam Firearms
description: The 1042nd Stargazers Squadron of the A.D.F.S (Allied Defence Force Signals) Stargazers Squadron. A group of 3 pilots stationed in deep space on the outer rim of one of the arms of the Milky Way Galaxy. The Signals are always first on the scene! It’s the role of the Signals to be the spearhead into every new operation, laying the ground work for future missions. By now humans have explored much of the inner Milky Way galaxy but not much of it’s outer reaches. Their mission is to patrol along an uncharted rim of the Milky Way Galaxy, to chart, explore, establish telecommunications, and a foothold between the outer galaxy and the inner galaxy. Not much happens in this reigon of space, but when the Stargazers are nearby it doesn’t take long for them to find some trouble! [From Official site]

title: Mermaid Splash! Passion Festival
description: It's one month before the famous Passion Festival and CiCi the mermaid needs your help! One of CiCi's dreams has been to enter into the Passion Festival, but she always lacked the focus to choose her favorite hobby to showcase! It's up to you to help CiCi hone her skills--and maybe even find love?! Let's splash! [From itch.io]

characters.name: CiCi
characters.description: Hobbies: All of them! A young mermaid whose lack of focus has kept her from choosing which passion to pursue further. Will she finally be able to decide...? [From itch.io]

characters.name: Angie
characters.description: Hobbies: Art A passionate webcomic artist who has been friends with CiCi since high school. She's excitable but also extremely sensitive! [From itch.io]

characters.name: Delora
characters.description: Hobbies: Dance CiCi's elegant and gossipy friend from dance class. Delora loves dancing but for some reason isn't committed to pursuing it professionally... [From itch.io]

characters.name: Maka
characters.description: Hobbies: Gardening A shark completely obsessed with gardening. She's so entranced by gardening that she barely knows anything else she might like! [From itch.io]

characters.name: Bea
characters.description: Hobbies: Fighting! A spunky martial arts student who will do anything for her dream of owning a dojo. She's competitive to a fault but always means well! [From itch.io]

description: Blacktea With Moon is a visual novel style fan game of Touhou Project. The main story line of the game will deep into the love story of the two main protagonists who are Sakuya and Remilia. Players will play as both Sakuya and Remilia in the game and the story begins and focus on the day after Sakuya arrived Scarlet Devil Mansion. [From Steam]

title: Apprehend;Girlfriend
description: Rikka lives in a Share House in Tokyo, making a living by working as a freelance artist. Since the third tenant moved out recently, it's a good opportunity for her to get closer to her House Mate Sena. They just started as normal friends, but with the time passing, they get closer and closer. Soon there was no doubt left, that Rikka and Sena felt more for each other than friendship. Will Rikka fall in love with another woman, besides being a woman herself?!

characters.name: Kishihara Rikka
characters.description: A hikikomori living as a roommate in a shared house, making a living by creating commissioned anime artwork while secretly writing and drawing her own yuri manga.

characters.name: Sawatari Sena
characters.description: Rikka's roommate and best friend, who is attending college with the goal of becoming a teacher. Sena is also the daughter of the landlord and often uses his credit card, so she can focus on her studies and not worry about employment.

characters.name: Momozono Wakana
characters.description: Sena's online friend from Okinawa, who is visiting Tokyo during her last summer break before starting college.

characters.name: Takamura Nene
characters.description: Rikka and Sena's former roommate who recently moved out to live with her boyfriend.

characters.name: Sena's Father
characters.description: Sena's father and the landlord of the house where Sena and Rikka live.

title: Sakura MMO Extra
description: Several months have passed since Viola and her ragtag party saved the realm of Asaph from impending destruction. Now left with little else to do, Viola whiles away her time accepting quests from the guild in Lynton, but none of them pose a challenge. Viola's life in Asaph might be perfect, what with her harem of cute girls to dote on her, but it's also perfectly boring. Dissatisfied with a lack of strong enemies to fight, Viola turns her attention to a business proposal brokered by Lynton's guild mistress, Maidie. Maidie plans to start up a maid café in Lynton, and she wants Viola, Neve, Fion, and Eleri to lend her a helping hand! Viola agrees to her offer, despite Neve's nay-saying, and a brand new chapter of Viola's life in Asaph begins. Join Viola as she works as a maid, choose which member of her harem to dote upon, and watch her embark upon a brand new adventure. [From Steam]

characters.name: Viola
characters.description: Viola is the name Kotone gave to her character in Asaph Online. Upon awakening in Asaph, Kotone inherits Viola’s appearance, her magical powers, and her name. Viola is a dark witch with unimaginable powers, who is feared by everybody in Asaph. Many have tried to challenge her, but none have emerged victorious. She enjoys grinding people down beneath her heel (sometimes literally), and treats those around her as little more than playthings. She’s a deeply sadistic, dangerous woman… but even she has a soft side.

characters.name: Neve
characters.description: Neve is Viola’s trusted most trusted maid, who would do anything to help her mistress. Neve is a member of the darkling race, which is reviled throughout Asaph as being savage and hostile, but Neve eschews these unfair perceptions. She is a diligent, loyal, industrious girl – but she may be a touch too devoted. She adores Viola, and becomes irrationally angry at any perceived slights against her beloved mistress. Self-sacrificing and hard-working though she is, Neve can be rather scary when she wants. If she were to fight seriously, she may even be able to defeat demons.

characters.name: Fion
characters.description: Fion is a young, put-upon lass from a huge family, who works hard to ensure all her brothers and sisters have enough food to eat. At least, that’s what she says, but Neve isn’t entirely convinced. Fion might look like a sweet, innocent thing, looks can be deceiving, and she’s far craftier than she initially appears.

characters.name: Eleri
characters.description: Eleri is a noble knight who believes deeply in playing fair, and will never try to take advantage of her opponents – often to her own detriment. Though Eleri seems cool and competent, she gets flustered quite easily, and reacts poorly to being teased. She’s quite fun to bully, really – and Viola often derives pleasure from her embarrassed reactions. Though Neve and Fion believe Eleri to be a resident of Asaph, much like them, she actually comes from Japan, much like Viola. Eleri was brought to Asaph in the same way Viola was, and now the pair of them are working together to see if they can return home. [From Steam]

characters.name: Maidie
characters.description: Maidie is the guild mistress at Lynton. Cheery and irreverent, she's an incorrigible lover of gossip. She's often thinking up get rich quick schemes, and has a particular interest in maids. [From Steam]

characters.name: Holly
characters.description: Fion's older sister.

description: Varsha is a young witch who has just graduated high school. While their friends were off jet setting and travelling around the world, Varsha had to go back to their hometown Lynnsdale to take care of their grandparents who ran a small magic store. There were two major issues though: one, magic is strictly banned and two, their grandparents store is on the verge of bankruptcy. title: Chinmai Kyuuketsuki no Ojou-sama ni Torawareta Ore wa, Nyotaika Saserarete Juujun na Imouto Maid ni Choukyou Sareteshimau Sou Desu
title_original: ちんまい吸血姫のお嬢様に囚われた俺は、女体化させられて従順な妹メイドに調教されてしまうそうです。
description: Yokomizo Mitsuru becomes stranded on a snow-covered mountain during a blizzard. While searching for help, he collapses, only to awaken in a mysterious forest. At its center stands a solitary mansion, where he encounters two vampires: Chris and Kanon. Just when he thinks he’s been rescued, Chris drinks his blood, and his body transforms into that of a girl. Now renamed Maron, she is made to work as a maid in Chris’s mansion. As she grows accustomed to her new body and surroundings, her sense of identity gradually begins to change. [From NookGaming.com]
