characters.name: Kintarou Arisugawa
characters.description: A classmate of Yumi's brother (Yuuki) at Hanadera Academy, "Alice" Born as a male but assumes feminine manners, pronouns and has androgynous looks. Alice is a good-natured and lively young girl whose only issue is that her inner, feminine identity is at odds with her male biological body and typically virile first name, Kintarou. She is a great fan of Sachiko's, and dreamed to be born as biologically female to enter Lilian High School just to be Sachiko's petite sœur. She seems to be good friends with Yuuki, and as a member of the Hanadera Student Council, gets to interact with the Yamayurikai for their respective school festivals. Sachiko's decision to switch the player's genders in the schoolplay at the Lilian Culture Festival overjoys her Alice, since it gives the opportunity for her to act a female part.

characters.name: Yumi Fukuzawa
characters.description: She is the main character of the series. In the beginning of the series, Yumi is bashful beyond words, very timid and unsure of herself. She first met Sachiko, the star of Lillian School and had her tie fixed by Sachiko, which mortified Yumi. Yumi's friend, Tsutako Takeshima, took a cute picture of this and wanted to display it in the school festival. Tsutako got Yumi to ask permission from Sachiko. Other characters often comment on how her emotions 'show on her face'. ~!After Yumi first meets Sachiko, Sachiko is arguing with the Roses in the Rose Mansion. The Roses say that Sachiko cannot object to their plan, as she did not have a petite sœur. Sachiko runs out of the meeting and knocks Yumi over. She asks if Yumi has a grande sœur, and promptly offered Yumi her rosary. Sachiko thought that if she had a petite sœur, the Yamayurikai could not force her to play Cinderella alongside a male

characters.name: Rei Hasekura
characters.description: Rei, Yoshino's grande soeur, appears very tomboyish and "bishounen" on the outside but is in fact quite gentle despite her appearances. Her favourite books are shoujo, her favourite word is "sincerity" and her hobby is sightseeing. She is involved in kendo, but obsessively cares about Yoshino and prefers the domestic arts, like cooking. In the first season, Rei is Rosa Foetida en bouton, and her grande soeur was Torii Eriko. Her petite soeur is Shimazu Yoshino. In the second season, Rei becomes Rosa Foetida. (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Touko Matsudaira
characters.description: A distant relative and fan of Sachiko. She arrives at Lillian during Yumi's second year. Touko is a member of the Drama club, and nicknamed Mechanical Drill by Satou Sei for her corkscrew pigtails. In the beginning of her first year Touko causes some strain in the relationship between Yumi and Sachiko. ~! However, it is apparent later on in the year that she may become Yumi's petite soeur.!~ (Source: Wikipedia) ~!Touko later wins the second card hunt when she half-accidentally makes Yumi uncover her card, thus winning the date with Yumi. She does so by basically asking Yumi to make her a petite soeur, and the recurring date practically ensures that Touko will become just that. In the same episode, we learn that Touko is also not the real daughter of the Matsudaira family, which made her the target for a lot of harsh words from the other close families. Despite this, her adopted

characters.name: Noriko Nijou
characters.description: A young girl with a fascination with Buddhist statues and art. She enters Lillian Academy (a strictly Catholic institution) by mistake. She has a fierce temper that contradicts her calm exterior and becomes Shimako's petite soeur as Shimako enters her second year. (Source: Wikipedia) In the second season, Noriko becomes Rosa Gigantea en bouton, her grande soeur being Toudou Shimako.

characters.name: Sachiko Ogasawara
characters.description: Prim and elegant, Sachiko has a rough side and a very sweet side. She is very protective over Yumi and cares deeply about her. However, Sachiko often has the same problem as Yumi does — she does not share most of her problems with her sœur, causing many misunderstandings. Sachiko is slated to marry her cousin and fiancé Suguru after she graduates. This has caused her some distress since, because although she initially cared deeply for him, he did not reciprocate. They now have a complicated relationship. Sometimes, Yumi must teach Sachiko how to live informally, for example, helping her select her first pair of jeans. Despite her sometimes stern appearance, Sachiko has her own share of insecurities regarding her relationship with Yumi, not to mention emotional insecurities rising from her home life; both her father and grandfather openly have mistresses, unabashedly dividing their time b

characters.name: Yoshino Shimazu
characters.description: In the beginning of the series, Yoshino is a girl who was very ill and cared for constantly by her grande soeur, Rei. Yoshino, however, is very independent and in some ways tomboyish, despite her sickly status and feminine appearance. ~!After her heart surgery, she becomes more energetic through out the series. !~ In addition to being Rei's petite soeur, Yoshino is also her cousin and next-door neighbor. Theirs is a somewhat rocky relationship, since Yoshino is eager to spread her wings, whereas Rei would like to protect her from the world's hardships. In the first season, Yoshino is Rosa Foetida en bouton petite soeur, her grande soeur being Hasekura Rei. ~!In the second season, Yoshino becomes Rosa Foetida en bouton. She has no petite soeur yet. !~ (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Eriko Torii
characters.description: Rei's grande soeur; one of the most well-respected of the Yamayurikai. She is very gifted and good at almost everything, although she is also enigmatic and eccentric. She has a large forehead, which Sei made fun of when they were young, which began their rivalry. She said once that she chose Rei as her sœur to see if anything interesting would happen. She often has friction with Yoshino, as the younger girl is jealous of her bond with Rei. Eriko has four older brothers. After leaving Lillian, she studies Arts. She hates the dentist above all else. (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Shimako Toudou
characters.description: Prim, proper and very beautiful, Shimako is the most admired of the first-years. She is the petite soeur of Satō Sei at the beginning of the story and later her successor. Underneath Shimako's quiet, mannerly exterior lies a surprisingly strong resolve. However, Shimako is perhaps the most gentle of the three girls of her year in the Yamayurikai. In the first season, Shimako is Rosa Gigantea en bouton, her grande soeur being Satou Sei. In the second season, Shimako becomes Rosa Gigantea, her petite soeur being Nijou Noriko. (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Yuuki Fukuzawa
characters.description: The brother of Yumi (born one year apart), he loves her very much and tries to help her in everything he can. He has good relations with the students of Lillian and is somewhat popular. At the beginning of the series, he did not empathize with Suguru, but Suguru invites Yuuki to stay over for new year's in his house; subsequently Suguru begins to perturb Yuuki by giving him the nickname "Yukichi". Yuuki becomes the president of the Student Council of Hanadera due to his neutral personality. (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Kanako Hosokawa
characters.description: A big fan of Yumi Fukuzawa, who only made a brief cameo appearance in the second season of the anime. She is 178 cm tall, and referred to by Marimite fans as Denpa. She is presented as one of the girls who may become Yumi's petite s�ur. She is introduced in the fourteenth novel, Suzukaze Satsusatsu. (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Sei Satou
characters.description: The exact opposite of most of the characters in the show: loud, rough-around-the-edges, she loves doing what she can to push other peoples' buttons. She enjoys mercilessly teasing or being mischievous, conducting most of her antics around Fukuzawa Yumi. Despite being a non-conformist in the ranks of the regular girls in Lillian Jogakuen, Sei is one of the wisest and caring characters on the show. Though seeming to have a playful and laid-back attitude, she has experienced many tragedies in her life, especially in her second year. Sei is known for doing things at her own pace, and dislikes being pressured into making decisions and taking action. She took Toudou Shimako as her soeur while in her third year. Her relationship with the first year is seen to one of mutual understanding and selective support. Sei however has an especially close relationship with Yumi. Sei becomes a source of co

title: Majuu Jouka Shoujo Utea
description: Karen AKA Utea Charm and Mizuki AKA Utea Grace signed a contract with a mysterious creature, Kurio, to fight against beasts as magical warriors. One day, the girls transform into Utea to purify a magical beast that appears in the school, but Mizuki gets captured by the beast's tentacles. The furious Karen tries to crush the beast with a special move, but she gets transported to another dimension. In this dimension, Mizuki is found being humiliated and molested by the tentacles of the beast, which Karen thought she had already defeated. Despite her shock, Karen, after hearing Kurio's advice, takes on the monster's tentacles to save Mizuki... (Source: Coolmic)

characters.name: Karen Towamizu
characters.description: A student from Saint Casablanca Academy who is also a best friend of Mizuki Tomonoin. Both she and Mizuki have double identities which being magical girls called an Utea. They got this brand new power after being converted into one by a familiar called Clio. Karen's Utea's alias is Utea Charm.

characters.name: Mizuki Tomonoin
characters.description: A student from Saint Casablanca Academy who is a best friend of Karen Towamizu. She and Karen have double identities which are magical girls called an Utea. The power of Utea was granted by them by a familiar called Clio in order to defeat and purify magical beasts. Mizuki's Utea alias is Utea Grace.

title: G-taste
description: Volume #1: A Taste of Honey (Eps #1-3) Although she tries hard, lovely office worker Moe bungles her assignments more often than not. She'd fare better if she spent more time working and less time playing with the office equipment, but it wouldn't be near as much fun. Nana's so cute in her maid's outfit that it's easy to see why everyone wants a piece of her. And while domineering Mai is used to being the boss, she's going to discover the joys of humiliation. A taste will only leave you wanting more, so obey your sweet tooth. Volume #2: Heat Wave (Eps #4-6) Sayaka is trying to be a prim and proper teacher, but every time she steps in front of a classroom she gets hot... And turning up the air conditioner isn't going bring her temperature down one bit. Misuzu may be a world-class swimmer, but the cold water in the practice pool only heats things up. She's one bathing beauty who doesn't need a sauna to make things steamy. The heat index will soar as these two lovely ladies do their best to set the screen on fire. (Source: AniDB)

She has a short fuse and it is always her classmate Konatsu who gets to be on the receiving end of her tantrums, however she greatly fears her elder sister Saya and Kaname the school nurse whom are both feared bosozoku gang members. Even thought Aya fears Kaname, she would often loiter around her clinic, because Kaname is always not around. Only Minami can match her mean-girl attitude and it is suggested that the two may have some feelings for each other.

Despite of it all she still admires her greatly, there is a running gag that she's easily attracted to cute little things such as puppies, kittens and butterflies.

She practices all forms of mysticism that ranges from fortune telling to black magic. It is suggested that she has feelings for Aya as well.

characters.name: Kaname Oku
characters.description: She is a school nurse in Gokurakuin Academy where Aya is studying , she also has a notorious reputation as a bosozoko top dog and infact she would be seen riding a Harley Davidson with Saya Akabane as her frequent passenger. The two form a fearsome duo who would always duke out with other bosozoko gangs and occasionally would roam the streets to cause mayhem, sometimes dragging Aya into their gigs. She also has a habit of barging into Aya's house to eat, since she and Aya's elder sister Saya are in a relationship, much to Aya's chagrin and just like Saya she is also feared by Aya whenever she's around.

characters.name: Minami Kurihashi
characters.description: __Class:__ 2-B She was introduced in episode 8 as a returning transfer student from Los Angeles California. She has a habit of looking down on everyone of her classmates, often referring to each and everyone of them as "Potato Girl." She was selected by the teacher to be the class health officer and establishes her so called headquarters in Kaname's clinic much to Aya's chagrin. It is suggested that she may have some feelings for Aya, despite having engage her in some petty quarrel.

description: Kazuya is a high school student. He is forced to move to a school dormitory because his parents have gone abroad on business, and they sold their house before leaving Japan. But, his school has no boys' dormitory, so he begins to live at a girls' dormitory. One day, he secretly peeks into the school sick-room while girls are under regular physical checkup, and he is surprised at their erotic breasts. He makes a vow to get their bodies and breasts....

description: Naoto is a university student. One day, he meets Ayane, his old friend, by chance after an interval of several years. Also, Chika, his old friend as well, suddenly appears in front of him. She tells him to become her tutor and they start living together but will Naoto resist the temptation of those delicious big boobs?

characters.name: Chika Hayakawa
characters.description: Naoto's Childhood friend. She has had a crush on Naoto since she was a little girl and feels sad when he reappears with her other childhood friend, Ayane. She will do anything for his love.

The bearer of this licence is able to create a field within which any manner of indecent or immoral acts seem normal. It is the ultimate permit for licentiousness. Within the confines of a train car, the girls have nowhere to run. At the moment when their resistance dies, their despair changes to pleasure...

title: Bousei no Volicia
title_original: 忘星のヴァリシア 第一章：劫火
description: The anime takes place in 2006, and centers on Akio Hoshigami, who due to a leg injury is forced to give up on her dream of being a track-and-field star. Akio and her friend Ayano Umisoe move on to high school together. Amidst new activities and meeting new friends, Akio gradually starts acting like herself again. Then one day Ayano suddenly disappears. (Source: Anime News Network)

characters.name: Akio Hoshigami
characters.description: A former member of the track and field team, who considered running her reason for living but retired due to an injury. After being chosen by Ayano's soul, she jumps into battle to protect the Fire of Life.

characters.name: Ayano Umisoe
characters.description: She was raised to be spiritual fuel for the celestial machines, but Akio caused a miracle which let her survive. She is grateful for Akio giving her a future, and in love with her.

characters.name: Honoka Satou
characters.description: A member of the track and field club. She is called a wild child, but is more perceptive of others than she appears. She has a one-sided rivalry with Ayano and Akio, and is dating Sora.

characters.name: Shiori Aratae
characters.description: Geology teacher and older sister of the other Shiori. Also works as supervisor of the miko team and head of the maintenance department for the celestial machines.

characters.name: Hoshi no Sadame
characters.description: A self proclaimed observer who has observed everything on this planet and knows about this battle.

characters.name: Kasumi Yamabe
characters.description: Vice president of the astronomy club and assistant to the captain of the miko team. She is Shiori's childhood friend and tries to support her as much as possible as a best friend. She is talented with anything related to machines.

characters.name: Sora Yamada
characters.description: A member of the track and field club. She gives off a sociable and soft impression, but she used to be withdrawn and overconfident. She is dating Honoka.

characters.name: Shiori Aratae
characters.description: President of the astronomy club and captain of the miko squad. In public she plays the part of a dunce. She was the original pilot for the celestial machine who was given the mission to fight as Ayano's partner.

title: Kao no nai Tsuki
description: Suzuna is the only daughter of the Kuraki family. She is training hard to become a priestess. Tomomi bings her to the house of her husband-to-be. The mansion is under a strange spell, releasing the sexual desires of everyone inside.

characters.name: Suzuna Kuraki
characters.description: A typical high school student, Suzuna Kuraki is the protagonist of the series. She is a delicate young woman, training to become a priestess of her Shinto ancestry so that she may properly consecrate her family shrine; a job traditionally bestowed upon the women of her lineage. Outside of her religious services, Suzuna generally behaves in a very aristocratic, conceited and fastidious manner, even though she is in fact the most apprehensive and solicitous person in the house. Suzuna is the obligatory fiancée of Koichi Hayama by arranged marriage, sister of Mizuna and daughter of Yuriko. (Wiki)

characters.name: Kouichi Hayama
characters.description: Koichi Hayama is the fiancé of Suzuna Kuraki. He was subconsciously chosen as her fiance and subsequently brought to the estate to live while the Tsukimachi ceremony approaches. A tall and handsome university student, Koichi tends to clash with Suzuna, but this can be regarded as evidence of a tsundere love affair. By the effects of an unexplained illness, he is unable to recollect any of his past, including his childhood or parents. He also could not recognize the faces of women before coming to the Kuraki estate. Koichi is a frequent smoker and has a elongated scar across his chest. (Wikipedia)

characters.name: Mizuna Kuraki
characters.description: Suzuna's older twin sister. She hypnotizes Koichi many times. For reasons unknown, she seems unable to talk. She is a Shrine Maiden and carries a ball. She was raised underground. Mizuna is many times mistaken with another character because she's identical to the character Fuu, from Moonlight Lady's spin-off anime, Touka Gettan. However, the two don't share any connection.

characters.name: Tomomi Harukawa
characters.description: The Kuraki's faithful servant. She is described as a container for Yuriko's Lust and subsequently has had intercourse with everyone in the mansion (even though her exploits with Yuriko and Sayaka are merely hinted at). Tomomi is the first person to show Suzuna the 'Forbidden fruit' and later in the series, falls in love with her. She is rejected by Suzuna and humbly bows to Koichi, opting to be her best friend and maid instead. She is present for the Expecting Moon Ceremony where her and Sayaka are Subjected to a grotesque Bukkake scenario. Her whereabouts are unknown at the finale, but it is hinted at in the 4th episode that her and Sayaka will be alright after all the events are done and over with. Info from: Wikipedia

characters.name: Sayaka Kurihara
characters.description: The second maidservant of the household, Sayaka Kurihara is roughly the opposite of Tomomi in that she is upbeat, playful, talkative, and at times childish. Although she is unable to ever clearly remember, Sayaka did in fact used to be a renown promotional model and actress by the name of Ruri Yamato; acquired when she was found wondering the estate grounds by Gohei Harukawa. She is one of only two characters to have an ear piercing. (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Yuriko Kuraki
characters.description: Mother of Suzuna and Mizuna.

title: Floating Material
title_original: Floating Material (フローティングマテリアル)

Now older, Amari tends to always worry about how her peers view her, and she tries to hide her embarrassing things before anyone can find them. She is easily flustered and is a bit skittish and shy. wiki_extract: 《終將成為妳》（日語：やがて君になる）是仲谷鳰的日本漫畫。作者榮獲第21回電擊漫畫大賞金賞，本作是作者自出道以來第一部連載漫畫作品。第1冊發售後立即再版，在2019年11月最终卷的第8卷發售时，系列累计发行量已经超过100万部。 2015年於《月刊Comic電擊大王》（KADOKAWA）連載。故事以「遠見東高中」為舞台，主軸為不會對他人產生特殊好感與因自我厭惡不會接受別人善意的兩位少女之間的故事。 2018年4月26日宣佈改編同名電視動畫。2019年1月26日宣布改编同名舞台剧。 == 故事大綱 == 小糸侑憧憬少女漫畫中的愛情，但某天因為同班三年的男生朋友的初次告白，卻因沒有那種特別的悸動而躊躇不決。在侑高中入學後的某天，於前往學生會室的途中意外見到燈子婉拒他者告白，發現燈子因沒有心動的感覺而拒絕告白，這也讓侑決定向燈子詢問到底該如何拒絕那位男生。詢問之後，侑理解自己了躊躇的原因，在燈子的加持下拒絕了該男生，同時燈子卻發現自己對侑心動，突如其來向侑告白。 在燈子的請求下侑成為了燈子的選舉負責人，並在助選演說上表示自己想加入學生會成為燈子的助力。燈子當選後，侑成為學生會幹部。在學生會室時，燈子提議要讓學生會在文化祭時表演的舞台劇傳統復活，會中止舞台劇的原因是燈子的姐姐（曾是學生會長）在七年前發生車禍導致其死亡而中止。雖然一開始並沒有受到侑的支持，但經過了多次商討終於被侑給接受。 侑則請託其想當作家的友人叶曆為劇本執筆。暑假時全體學生會成員外宿集訓來練習戲劇。在集訓中指導的老師-市之谷（曾是學生會幹部，認識燈子的姐姐）指出燈子與其姐姐並不相像。這使得自姐姐死亡以來就一直努力模仿姐姐的燈子因此大為動搖。侑為了讓燈子不再這麼累的生活下去，與小曆一同修改了劇本的內容，不過也因此讓兩人之間的關係降溫。所幸在後來兩人將話給講開，燈子也稍微打開了心結並且更加願意去相信侑為她所做的一切。 侑在幫助燈子的過程中漸漸有心動的感覺，無法壓抑，最後決定向燈子坦白自己打破了當初「不會喜歡上燈子學姐」的約定。燈子不知如何是好，兩人因此疏離。在2年級生的修學期間，佐伯向燈子告白，但燈子無法答應，並意識起自己對侑的真心。燈子約侑在學生會辦見面，兩人確認了真心，發展成真正情投意合的戀人關係，並在燈子演完戲不久後在她家發生性行为。幾年後，侑與燈子持續交往，並接納彼此在選擇出路時的決定。侑的手上套著戒指，兩人在星空下攜手邁向今後的人生。 == 登場人物 == === 遠見東高中 === ==== 學生會 ==== 小糸侑（小糸 侑（こいと ゆう）） 配音：高田忧希／金元壽子（漫画宣传片） 演員：河内美里 本作主角。高中1年級，学生会的成员。入学时因为老師的建議去參觀了學生會，並在那結識了燈子等人。性格開朗，但也有怕麻煩的一面。 老家外婆經營一家「藤代書店」，燈子、沙彌香也經常光顧。 沒有談過戀愛，對誰都不會抱有「特殊」的情感。把這件事傾訴給燈子後，在回家的路上被燈子奪走了初吻。即使如此也沒有燈子抱有特殊的感情，本想拒絕了燈子的告白，但對方以「不要喜歡我」作為條件繼續接受她的好意。雖然侑在比誰都更接近燈子的時間中內心開始發生改變，但為了與燈子的約定於是決定隱藏自己的真心與燈子交際。 雖然在最初的時候被燈子佔有主導權的場合很多，但從故事中盤開始主動誘勸燈子的場合也在逐漸增加，到故事終盤則是侑對燈子掌握主導權。 在作品中，稱呼燈子幾乎都是叫「七海前輩」，正式開始交際時雖然是用「燈子前輩」和敬語稱呼對方，但在最終話時改用「燈子」，也不再使用敬語。 在學生會會劇中出演護士。最初的劇本中只是配角，但在侑和曆修改劇本後，變成了需要改變主人公（燈子）想法的要角。和把自己跟劇中主人公重疊的燈子一樣，侑也把自己與劇中的戀人重疊，最終在這樣下去可能和燈子的關係就要結束的焦慮感驅使下和燈子告白了。 在最終話中成為大學生並解下了自己高中時代的辮子。和燈子還在繼續交往這件事沒有給除姊姊以外的家人說明。做出選擇很困難這件事上還是沒有改變，升學與就職相關的煩惱會與燈子商量。 七海燈子（七海 燈子（ななみ とうこ）） 配音：壽美菜子 演員：小泉萌香 本作女主角，高中2年級，生日為2月19日。身高163厘米。在1年級時就加入學生會工作，成為2年級生後便當選學生會長。是一個人美且文武雙全的才女。和侑雖然是前輩與後輩的關係，但是兩人是同年出生，燈子比侑早兩個月出生而已，在最終話兩人都是16歲。 家人有雙親和在七年前當時是遠見東學生會長因事故而去世的姐姐澪。本來是內向膽小的性格所以經常藏在姐姐身後，在澪死後，因為被身邊的人寄予強烈的期待，決定作為澪的代替而努力。實際的燈子和在學校展示的別人看的燈子有相當大的差異，作品中知道此事的除了雙親以外本只沙弥香一人，但在和侑兩人親密獨處時對侑展示了原本的自我。 是一個不論是隱藏起來的自我還是展示給別人看的自我都厭惡、無法自我肯定的少女，在侑說了那樣的自己「無法讓自己喜歡」後逐漸被這特別的思緒吸引。雖然最初固執地拒絕了侑的勸說繼續演著姊姊的姿態，但在和侑交往及學生會會劇成功的影響下變得會展現自己本來普通平凡的生活，身邊的人也接受了原本的燈子。 在學生會會劇中出演失憶的主人公。因為出演這齣劇讓燈子第一次認識到自身被評價的感覺而感動到流淚。在這之後被市民劇團的演出家留意，意識到自己不是作為姊姊而是作為自己本身向著演員的目標邁進。 最終話中成為大學生離開父母獨自生活，參加大學的演劇社團另一方面作為專業的舞台演員活動著。雖然容貌沒有變化，但已不再扮演姊姊而生活。在高中時代雖然都是燈子把玩侑，但現在已被侑逆轉。 佐伯沙彌香（佐伯 沙弥香（さえき さやか）） 配音：茅野愛衣 演員：礒部花凜 2年級生，燈子的好友。成績年級第2，在學生會輔佐著燈子，之後就任副會長。對燈子抱有好感，但向灯子表白时被拒。成为大学生后与一名叫做阳的女孩交往。 和燈子結識已久，燈子想再次舉辦學生會公演的內情有一定程度的了解。 槙聖司（槙 聖司（まき せいじ）） 配音：市川太一、松田颯水（小學生） 演員：石渡真修（初演）／伊崎龍次郎（朗讀劇）／瑞野史人（encore） 1年級生。自願加入學生會，亦認為自己較適合支援他人的工作，小學時代在運動社團也都擔任經理，在國中時代也參加學生會。 在有兩個姊姊和一個妹妹環境中長大。不可思議地經常有女生與其商談煩惱，自身也非常喜愛戀愛話題。 堂島卓（堂島 卓（どうじま すぐる）） 配音：野上翔 演員：小田川颯依 1年級生。久瀨國中時代的社團學弟，經由久瀨的介紹加入學生會。性格開朗，在1年級生裡，唯一一個積極參與學生會公演的人。 箱崎理子（箱崎 理子（はこざき りこ）） 配音：中原麻衣 演員：田上真里奈 女老師。擔任學生會的副顧問。 與遠見東高中附近的咖啡廳「Echo」的女店長兒玉都（聲：森奈奈子；演：立道梨绪奈（初演）／北原侑奈（encore））交往中。 ==== 其他學生 ==== 日向朱里（日向 朱里（ひゅうが あかり）） 配音：寺崎裕香 演員：五十岚晴香（初演）／大石夏摘（encore） 侑的同班同學。為了學長而加入籃球社，在第4話向侑告知被學長以想集中精神在籃球上的理由拒絕了。 性格開朗，即使失戀也不想讓他人看見自己失落的樣子。 叶曆（叶 こよみ（かのう こよみ）） 配音：小原好美 演員：春咲暖 侑的同班同學。不喜歡可愛的東西，也因這個理由即使知道違反校規，穿著制服時也堅持不繫上蝴蝶結。 喜歡讀書，夢想是成為作家。平時情緒起伏低，一旦提到喜歡的作家情緒便會高漲。 吉田愛果（吉田 愛果（よしだ まなか），聲：芳野由奈） 2年級生，燈子和沙彌香的同班同學。一起去校外教學。 五十嵐綠（五十嵐 みどり（いがらし みどり），聲：櫻井浩美） 2年級生，燈子和沙彌香的同班同學。一起去校外教學。 == 出版書籍 == === 漫畫 === 單行本 官方漫畫精選集 === 小說 === 小說版《終將成為妳 關於佐伯沙彌香》由入間人間負責執筆，佐伯沙彌香擔任主角。〈電擊文庫〉 == 電視动画 == 于2018年10月播放。 === 制作人员 === === 主題曲 === 片頭曲《君にふれて》（第2話－第12話） 作詞、作曲：Bonjour鈴木，編曲：鈴木Daichi秀行，歌：安月名莉子 第1話用作片尾曲，第13話未使用 片尾曲《hectopascal》（第2話－第12話） 作詞：中村彼方，作曲：本多友紀，編曲：脇真富，歌：小糸侑（高田憂希）、七海燈子（壽美菜子） 第1話、第13話未使用 === 插曲 === 《rise》（第9話） 作詞：安月名莉子、RUCCA，作曲、編曲：濱田貴司，歌：安月名莉子 《好き、以外の言葉で》（第13話） 作詞、作曲、編曲：白神真志朗，歌：小糸侑（高田憂希）、七海燈子（壽美菜子） === 各话列表 === === 播放电视台 === === BD / DVD === === 網路廣播 === 以《終將成為妳～我好像會喜歡上這個廣播～》為標題，2018年10月4日至2019年4月18日於音泉隔週星期四更新，全12回。主持人為高田憂希（飾演小糸侑）和壽美菜子（飾演七海燈子）。收錄了廣播第1－5回和第6－12回的CD分別於2019年1月39日和5月29日發售。 == 舞台剧 == === 初演 === 依照原作漫画剧情改编的舞台剧于2019年5月3日至12日在东京的全劳济会馆SPACE ZERO公演，共14场。演出期间，饰演小糸侑与七海灯子的河内美里与小泉萌香连续多次的吻戏成为话题，官方统计两人在14场公演加一场彩排中共接吻90次。 同年8月，制作方在网站BOOSTER上发起了目标金额为200万日元的众筹，以筹集资金来制作两位主演河内美里与小泉萌香的水族馆约会影片，并作为舞台剧BD&DVD的附赠特典，最终筹得850万日元。BD&DVD于2019年11月14日发售，除了舞台剧本篇和上述特典以外还收录了后台花絮与After Talk，并在池袋HUMAX电影院举办了两场上映会。 ==== 制作人员 ==== 原作：仲谷鳰 脚本、演出：铃木智晴（剧团东京都铃木区） 制作、主办：Trifle Entertainment ==== BD/DVD ==== === 朗讀劇 === 終將成為妳舞台剧原本预定于2020年10月29日至11月8日在品川王子大酒店的Club eX会场重新公演，并根据原作漫画结局修改剧情。但是，受COVID-19疫情影响，因此主办方在2020年8月23日举行直播宣布推迟本次公演。作为替代，入间人间执笔的外传小说《终将成为你 关于佐伯沙弥香》将被舞台剧班底改编为朗读剧，在原定的公演时间和场所上演。 同年11月14日，在DMM.com直播朗讀劇的重播。 BD及DVD於2021年5月1日發售。 ==== 制作人员 ==== 小説著者：入间人间 漫畫原作、小説插畫：仲谷鳰 演出：葛木英 脚本：铃木智晴（剧团东京都铃木区） 制作、主办：Trifle Entertainment ==== BD/DVD ==== === encore === 原定于2020年10月，根据原作漫画结局修改剧情的重新公演，最終推遲至2022年11月25日至12月4日，於品川王子大酒店的Club eX会场演出。 BD及DVD定於2023年5月5日發售，同日將會於池袋HUMAX电影院舉辦三場發售紀念活動，與演員一同觀賞演出和特典。 ==== 制作人员 ==== 原作：仲谷鳰 演出：上野友之 脚本：铃木智晴（剧团东京都铃木区） 制作、主办：Trifle Entertainment == 註釋 == == 參考資料 == == 外部連結 == 終將成為妳 | 月刊Comic電擊大王官方網站 title: Tensei Shitara Slime datta Ken
title_original: 転生したらスライムだった件
title_en: That Time I Got Reincarnated as a Slime
description: As players of Monster Hunter and Dungeons & Dragons know, the slime is not exactly the king of the fantasy monsters. So when a 37-year-old Tokyo salaryman dies and wakes up in a world of dragons and magic, he's a little disappointed to find he's become a blind, boneless slime monster. (Source: Kodansha USA)

characters.name: Rimuru Tempest
characters.description: __Species:__ Human (past life) → Slime __Kind:__ Reincarnated, Otherworlder Rimuru Tempest, formerly known as Satoru Mikami, is the main protagonist of Tensei Shitara Slime Datta Ken. They are the founder and King of the monster country Tempest, situated in the Great Jura Forest, and the partner and sworn friend of Storm Dragon, [Veldora Tempest](https://anilist.co/character/128034/Veldora-Tempest).

characters.name: Shion
characters.description: "War Lord" Shion is Rimuru’s first servant to be in charge of his care as his personal secretary. She is also the leader of the Yomigaeri and also one of Rimuru's strongest fighters and is coveted by many of the Demon Lords who have met her.

characters.name: Veldora Tempest
characters.original: ヴェルドラ＝テンペスト
characters.description: __Height:__ 210 cm (human form), 100 m (dragon form) __Species:__ True Dragon __Blessing / Divine Protection:__ Storm Dragon's Grace, Demon Lord's Ally __Disaster Rank:__ Catastrophe Veldora Tempest is the youngest of the four strongest dragons (True Dragons). He is connected with [Rimuru](https://anilist.co/character/123962) by an agreement and was known to rampage here and there. He was the one to name Rimuru and Rimuru gave him his last name, since they share the same last name, Rimuru could technically be classified as Veldora's adoptive brother.

characters.name: Ranga
characters.description: "Star Lord" Ranga is a Wind Spirit Wolf and a loyal follower of [Rimuru](https://anilist.co/character/123962/Tempest-Rimuru). The leader of the Star Wolf Clan, and the son of the previous boss of the Direwolves. He is also one of Rimuru's Twelve Patrons who has been given the title of a "Lord".

characters.name: Milim Nava
characters.description: __Kind:__ Inhabitant "Destroyer" Milim Nava is one of the oldest and strongest Demon Lords. She is a Dragonoid. Her nickname, Destroyer, is not just for show. She is a demon lord one should never fight against.

characters.name: Shizu
characters.description: Shizu was the companion of the previous Hero and a Japanese Summoned One. She is also known as the "Explosive Monarch", an A ranked Adventurer of the Freedom Association's Headquarters, and the formal homeroom teacher of the Freedom Academy's S Class students. She was also the mentor of several excellent pupils whom became important figures of society.

characters.name: Benimaru
characters.description: Benimaru is one of the third group of subordinate Monsters to be named by [Rimuru Tempest](https://anilist.co/character/123962/Tempest-Rimuru). Originally an Ogre, he was uncertain of his servitude and intended for it to be temporary, but after being named, he evolved into a Kijin, immediately becoming Rimuru's most powerful subordinate for a time, and decided to serve him permanently. He lives in the Capital city of the Jura Tempest Federation: Rimuru City. Soon after, and became Commander-in-Chief, giving him direct command over Tempest's military forces. Upon Rimuru's ascension to a True Demon Lord, Benimaru evolved into a Fair Oni and reached the strength of a Disaster-Class Monster.

characters.name: Souei
characters.description: __Height:__ 180 cm (Kijin), 190 cm (Ogre) Souei is an Ogre that was among the third group of subordinates to be named by [Rimuru Tempest](https://anilist.co/character/123962/Tempest-Rimuru). He is Rimuru's faithful shadow and the leader of the Shadow Squad of the Jura Tempest Federation.

characters.name: Shuna
characters.description: Shuna is one of the third group of subordinate Monsters to be named by [Rimuru](https://anilist.co/character/123962), evolving her from an Ogre to a Kijin. She was originally the princess of the Ogre tribe and even though she had the talent for using Magic, she was a sheltered girl, but quickly got along with the Goblinas Shuna is the daughter of the late ogre chieftain and she is also [Benimaru](https://anilist.co/character/128038)'s younger sister, which is why she's nicknamed "Oni Princess" by Rimuru. Very skilled and knowledgeable in domestic matters, she essentially becomes Rimuru's chief economic advisor together with [Rigurd](https://anilist.co/character/129348).

characters.name: Daikenja
characters.description: Unique Skill Great Sage is one of the first two Unique Skills (the other being Predator) that [Rimuru Tempest](https://anilist.co/character/123962/Rimuru-Tempest) had upon being born into his new world. It had evolved from Extra Skill Sage during his death, as he thought since he was approaching his forties as a virgin, he must be something much greater than a mere wizard. ~!During Rimuru's evolution into Demon Lord this Unique Skill evolved into the Ultimate Skill: Wisdom King Raphael.!~ ~!Rimuru gave her a name and she evolved into a manas with the name Ciel!~

characters.name: Rigurd
characters.description: Formerly the chief of the goblin village [Rimuru](https://anilist.co/character/123962/Tempest-Rimuru) comes across. He's now the acting prime minister of the Jura Tempest Federation. He evolved into a hobgoblin when Rimuru named him.

characters.name: Rigur
characters.description: Rigur was named after his late elder brother. Rigur, after making [Gobta](https://anilist.co/character/129350/Gobta) the garrison squad leader, has been supporting his father [Rigurd](https://anilist.co/character/129348/Rigurd).

wiki_title: 關於我轉生變成史萊姆這檔事 (動畫)
wiki_extract: 《關於我轉生變成史萊姆這檔事》（日語：転生したらスライムだった件）是伏瀨所撰同名輕小說改編動畫。現已改編成電視動畫和劇場動畫。 == 電視動畫 == === 製作 === 2018年10月至2019年3月起播放同名電視動畫第1季，全25話（本篇23話+外傳1話+總集篇1話），於東京都會電視台、日本BS放送等電視台首播，特別篇放送5話。第2季於2021年1月（上半部）和2021年7月6日（下半部）分割播放。而外傳漫畫《轉生史萊姆日記》也宣布動畫化，2021年4月開始放送。劇場版《紅蓮之絆篇》於2022年11月25日於日本放送，台灣將於2022年12月9日播放。官方於2022年11月9日宣布製作第3季，於2024年4月5日播映。第3季播完後，宣布製作第4季，於2026年4月至9月播出兩季度。外傳作品「克雷曼重生復仇」以及第三季度，分別預計明年4月＆7月播出。 === 登場人物 === === 製作人員 === === 主題曲 === ==== 本篇主題曲 ==== ==== 衍生作品主題曲 ==== === 各話列表 === === 播放平台 === ==== 日本國內 ==== ==== 日本國外 ==== ===== 第1季 ===== ===== 第2季 ===== === 網路播放 === ==== 日本國外 ==== ===== 第1季 ===== ===== 第2季 ===== ===== 日記 ===== === BD / DVD === ==== BD ==== ==== DVD ==== == 劇場動畫 == === 劇場版 關於我轉生變成史萊姆這檔事 紅蓮之絆篇 === 劇場版動畫《劇場版 關於我轉生變成史萊姆這檔事 紅蓮之絆篇》（日語：劇場版 転生したらスライムだった件 紅蓮の絆編）於2022年11月25日上映。 ==== 製作人員（紅蓮之絆篇） ==== === 劇場版 關於我轉生變成史萊姆這檔事 蒼海之淚篇 === 電視動畫第3季播完後，宣布製作第2部劇場動畫。2025年7月15日，宣布劇場版動畫《劇場版 關於我轉生變成史萊姆這檔事 蒼海之淚篇》（日語：劇場版 転生したらスライムだった件 蒼海の涙編）於2026年2月27日上映。 == 腳註 == === 註釋 === === 來源 === == 外部連結 == 電視動畫第1季官方網站 - 8bit（日語） 電視動畫第2季官方網站 - 8bit（日語） 電視動畫外傳官方網站 - 8bit（日語） 劇場版動畫紅蓮之絆篇官方網站 - 8bit（日語） 電視動畫的X（前Twitter）账号（日語）

title: Ki ni Natteru Hito ga Otoko ja Nakatta
title_original: 気になってる人が男じゃなかった
title_en: The Guy She Was Interested In Wasn't a Guy at All
description: Fashionable and upbeat high schooler Aya falls head over heels for an employee at a local CD shop. He's got an air of mystery about him, great style, and an impeccable music taste. Little does she know—this supposedly male employee is actually her female classmate Mitsuki! Mitsuki generally keeps to herself, but since her seat is right next to Aya's, she can't help but be extremely aware of the other's crush. Revealing the truth is out of the question for Mitsuki—but perhaps getting closer to Aya wouldn't be so bad... (Source: Yen Press)

characters.name: Aya Oosawa
characters.description: Part of the popular crowd, her grades aren't great but she has good communication skills and has a lot of friends. Popular with the guys at school but she takes no interest in them.

characters.name: Mitsuki Koga
characters.description: Has a quiet and reserved personality, her classmates mistake her for an anime otaku. She can be a little airheaded in certain circumstances.

characters.name: Megumu Narita
characters.description: In the same class as [Aya](https://anilist.co/character/282093/Oosawa-Aya) and [Mitsuki](https://anilist.co/character/282094/Koga-Mitsuki). An easygoing and refreshing stud (self- proclaimed) who is popular and admired by many. He's reasonably well-liked by the ladies, so when he encounters a girl he can't easily charm, he can't get her out of his head (currently, he can't get Mitsuki and Aya out of his head, but more in the sense that he's watching over them). If someone says something mean to him, he'll smile while actually getting depressed on the inside. However, he bounces back ridiculously fast. As far as his club activities go, he's in the soccer club (but he's probably the type who gets invited to all kinds of clubs).

characters.name: Joe
characters.description: Mitsuki's uncle. He doesn't have children of his own, so he's all-in on loving his niece. The ultimate doting uncle. He's always pursued what he loves, so he wants Mitsuki to be true to herself as well. When he was young, he worked hard to make a living from music, but now he's the owner of a run-down CD shop.

characters.name: Kanna
characters.description: [Joe](https://anilist.co/character/305502/Joe)'s ex-girlfriend. She works as a stylist in L.A. Mitsuki looks up to her because she focuses on the things she wants to do and pushes hard towards them.

characters.name: Mao
characters.description: Mao is another girl from Aya's inner circle. She always follows Chizuru wherever she goes and is secretly interested in Narita.

characters.name: Chizuru
characters.description: Chizuru, along with Mao, used to be Aya's best friend. She doesn't like that Aya spends so much time with Mitsuki lately.

wiki_title: 我在意的對象並不是男人
wiki_extract: 《我在意的對象並不是男人》（日語：気になってる人が男じゃなかった）是由新井すみこ創作的日本漫画。 最初是2021年7月到9月新井すみこ在Twitter上發佈的短篇故事，於2022年4月開始每週連載，之後與2023年4月在Pixivコミック上連載。同月角川書店出版了第一卷。 獲得「下一部人氣漫畫大賞2023」網路漫畫類別第一名，「這本漫畫真厲害！ 2024」女生篇第二名。，2025年，本作的漫畫版在該年度日本博覽會獲頒年度最佳愛情漫畫獎。 2025年2月宣布改编成为电视动画。 == 概要 == 大澤綾最近對她常去的CD店的店員產生了好感。但她不知道到店員就是她的同學古賀美月。漫畫講述了綾和美月之間萌芽的關係和她們在高中生活中對音樂的共同熱愛。 == 登場人物 == 大澤綾（大沢 綾（おおさわ あや），聲：鬼頭明里（廣播劇CD、電視動畫）） 對搖滾音樂有興趣的女高中生。經常光顧一家CD店，並對在CD點兼職的神祕「帥哥」產生了好感，卻不知道神祕「帥哥」就是她的同學美月。 古賀美月（古賀 美月（こが みつき），声：伊瀬茉莉也（廣播劇CD、電視動畫）） 高中女生，綾的同學。對搖滾音樂感興趣。在叔叔的CD店兼職，爲了在工作時匿名穿上了中性的衣服，帶上口罩和隱形眼睛，導致她被誤認爲是男性。 讓（譲（じょー），声：津田健次郎（廣播劇CD、電視動畫）） 美月的叔叔。 環奈（カンナ，聲：野村麻衣子） 讓的前女友。 成田惠（成田 恵（なりた めぐむ），声：畠中祐（廣播劇CD、電視動畫）） 綾的同學。 千鶴（ちづる，聲：天海由梨奈） 綾的同學。 真緒（まお，聲：菲魯茲·藍） 綾的同學。 == 出版書籍 == === 漫畫 === === 其他 === Apple Music和Spotify發佈了官方播放列表，其中包括綾和美月收聽的歌曲。 廣播劇CD於2024年03月27日發售。 == 參考資料 == == 外部連結 == 新井すみこ『気になってる人が男じゃなかった』特設サイト （页面存档备份，存于互联网档案馆）（日語） 気になってる人が男じゃなかった【公式】的X（前Twitter）账号（日語）

title: Mieruko-chan
description: One day, she could see…everything. What’s a girl to do when hideous monsters appear no matter which way she turns? And on top of that, nobody else can see them! Obviously, there’s only one thing that makes sense—ignore them. Kinda hard to put theory into practice, though, when the ghosts know she’s watching… (Source: Yen Press)

characters.name: Miko Yotsuya
characters.description: __Height:__ 160cm __Family:__ [Mamoru Yotsuya](https://anilist.co/character/250703/Mamoru-Yotsuya) (Father), [Touko Yotsuya](https://anilist.co/character/199025/Touko-Yotsuya) (Mother), [Kyousuke Yotsuya](https://anilist.co/character/199026/Kyousuke-Yotsuya) (Younger Brother) Miko has the ability to see frightening supernatural things that most people can't, but she pretends that she can't see them to avoid conflict. Her Spiritual-Awareness power overpowers her sight, like the reflection in glass is overpowering and you're unable to see what lies beyond it. She tries to have a stoic exterior when confronted with spirits, but is internally frightened by them. She also cares deeply for her friend [Hana Yurikawa](https://anilist.co/character/139632/Hana-Yurikawa), using her power to protect her in various ways, such as diverting her from certain routes with spirits and bringing her food whe

characters.name: Hana Yurikawa
characters.description: __Height:__ 156cm [Miko's](https://anilist.co/character/139631) close friend. She is clueless of the supernatural terrors that afflict her friend, but she does unknowingly attract a lot of them due to her unusual amount of life energy.

characters.name: Yulia Niguredou
characters.description: __Height:__ 140cm An aspiring spirit medium who believes she's somewhat special because she has the power to see spirits. However, she doesn't know that she can only see lesser spirits, and misinterprets [Miko's](https://anilist.co/character/139631) attempts to protect her from the greater dangers she cannot see as acts of malice.

characters.name: Touko Yotsuya
characters.description: Mother of [Miko](https://anilist.co/character/139631) and [Kyousuke](https://anilist.co/character/199026).

characters.name: Kyousuke Yotsuya
characters.description: [Miko's](https://anilist.co/character/139631) younger brother. Kyousuke is a young boy with short black hair. He is very protective of Miko, even going far enough to assume she has a boyfriend to be wary of.

characters.name: Romm Shindou
characters.description: __Powers-&-Abilities:__ High-Level Spiritual Awareness, Aura Awareness __Etymology:__ Romm's surname Shindou means "prodigy, wonder child" (神童). He can see spirits and humans simultaneously, like one's reflection in glass and the scenery behind it. He sells many items which interact with the far shore. He was given the name "Romm" by his former master, Mitsue Takeda, as part of the tradition of adding a 2nd name to apprentices. Romm has been seen to be very bold, running a business geared only to those adapted to seeing spirits. Even though many have called him a fraud, Yuria Niguredou believes in his ways and has been roped into buying some of his products. He is also very mischievous, taking amusement in the unpredictable actions made by Miko Yotsuya. He enjoys teasing Mitsue Takeda. ~!Shindou was brought to Mitsue as a child, and she took him in as her apprentice. She trained him in t

characters.description: Father of Miko and Kyousuke. ~!Already deceased.!~

characters.description: School nurse.

wiki_extract: 《陰陽眼見子》（日語：見える子ちゃん）是泉朝樹創作的日本漫畫，最初於2018年在作者的個人Twitter發表，同年11月2日開始在漫畫網站「ComicWalker」連載。2019年8月，獲得下一部漫畫大獎網路漫畫第10名。入圍2021年電子漫畫大賞（電子漫畫大獎）（みんなが選ぶ!!電子コミック大賞）男性部門提名名單。 改編電視動畫於2021年10月3日至12月19日播映，共12集。 == 故事簡介 == 某日，女高中生四谷見子突然變得可以看見那些普通人看不見的鬼怪。面對這一突如其來的變化，她選擇對各種鬼怪「視而不見」，假裝看不見那些東西來生活下去。 == 登場人物 == 以下聲優如無特殊說明，均為電視動畫聲優。 === 主要人物 === 四谷見子（四谷 みこ（よつや みこ），聲：雨宮天／種崎敦美（第2卷發售紀念有聲漫畫），演：原菜乃華） 主人公。原本是普通的女高中生，但從某天開始突然變得可以看見普通人看不見的鬼怪，選擇以「視而不見」的方式去面對。 對鬼怪的靈視能力非常強大，甚至超越了身為專業靈能力者的三枝。但對鬼怪以外的事物便與常人無異，例如看不到其他靈能力者所能看到的靈氣，像是華所蘊含的大量生命能量，只能從鬼怪的聚集判斷她是容易招引鬼怪的體質。 因鬼怪的事情，時常找三枝或洛姆諮詢。從洛姆口中得知，父親的亡故似乎與某個可疑靈體有關。 百合川華（百合川 ハナ（ゆりかわ -），聲：本渡楓／伊藤彩沙（第2卷發售紀念有聲漫畫），演：久間田琳加） 見子的朋友，個性開朗、少根筋，食慾旺盛。 雖然沒有靈視能力，卻具備強大的能量氣場，因此容易吸引鬼怪，也因能量強大，一般的鬼怪也影響不了她。但如果鬼怪等級高或數量過多，容易消耗能量，甚至會餓到沒力氣。生病時能量會變弱，容易被鬼怪吸取能量陷入生命危險，可透過大量進食增加防禦力。以自身的能量氣場，在不自覺的情況下破除神社結界。 二暮堂幽里亞（二暮堂 ユリア（にぐれどう -），聲：佐倉綾音，演：NAENANO） 小學生體型的高中生。有基礎靈能力及靈視能力，能看到華的能量氣場，單方面視見子為對手。 很崇拜神靈媽媽，想拜其為師，學習除靈、占卜等技能，夢想成為專業靈能者。靈視能力不如見子，造成兩人所見的景象有落差，加上她先入為主的將見子視為強大的靈能者，引發不少誤會。參加洛姆主辦的靈異景點一日遊，才察覺可能有自己看不到的鬼怪。被未知瑠半強迫的要求提供見子的資訊。 目前與見子、小華、未知瑠(?)等人關係友好，時常一起行動。 === 見子的家人 === 四谷恭介（四谷 恭介（よつや きょうすけ），聲：花守由美里） 見子的弟弟，小學5年級。有点傲娇属性、和見子关系特别好、會經常在一起。注意到姊姊身上發生了變化，對此感到擔心。非常保護姊姊，曾經誤會見子交了男朋友，還被對方欺負，想教訓對方，是個可愛的好弟弟。 四谷透子（四谷 透子（よつや とうこ），聲：生天目仁美） 見子的母親。 四谷真守（四谷 真守（よつや まもる），聲：鳥海浩輔） 見子的父親。已故、之前因吃了見子的布丁吵過一次架、去世後靈魂依然留在家中與家人同住，身邊跟著一隻長相可怕的野獸型鬼怪，疑似守護靈之類的存在。 === 靈能者 === 武田三枝（タケダ ミツエ，聲：谷育子／野津山幸宏（第2卷發售紀念有聲漫畫）） 以前人稱「老街神靈媽媽」的占卜師。雖然在做詐欺師一般的行徑，卻是正牌的靈能者。即使使用全盛期的力量亦未能祛除纏上見子的惡靈，深感自身能力的極限而停業。 回歸老家後一邊務農一邊修練，直到弟子洛姆將見子與華的照片寄過來，發現兩人正遭遇非常大的麻煩後立即趕回，成為見子第一個能相談鬼怪的對象。 目前在照顧洛姆(因調查與見子父親亡故有關的靈體，不慎受到侵害)，使用相識靈能者(某間可疑古董店老闆)提供的茶葉治療當中。 神童洛姆（神童 ロム（しんどう ロム）） 年幼時便顯現靈能資質，但被父母懼怕、視為不祥而遭遺棄，後被岡遠子收留。 三枝的弟子，靈能者，外表可疑的男子。雖然看起來很可疑，但卻是正牌的靈能者，擁有與見子同等級的靈視能力。 在小時候便受到岡遠子(三枝的師父，已故)認證，其靈能力甚至超越自己與三枝。 平時作為網路紅人活動，藉由影片推銷以自身靈力製作的能量道具，如石頭、鹽、水、首飾...等等，價格不斐。看起來像詐騙商品，卻真具有驅邪功用，可驅趕一般等級的鬼怪；遇等級高的則有保護配戴者、爭取逃跑時間的作用，見子、幽里亞等人都親眼見證過。另外還很擅長運用現代科技，會利用無人機與與重金屬音樂來除魔。 見子找他商量未知瑠的事情，他說未知瑠跟章魚型靈體可能不是"附身與被附身"的關係，然後請見子想辦法多給他一些未知瑠的照片調查。不知為何，他無法看到未知瑠的章魚型靈體。後來得知章魚靈體為森林精靈一類的存在，並告知見子。 調查與見子父親亡故有關的靈體(在見子眼中是個大叔，但在洛姆眼中似乎不是)，過程中不甚遭受侵害，導致身體虛弱，目前由三枝照顧治療中。 岡遠子（岡 トワ子（おか トワコ）） 三枝婆婆的師傅。「老街神靈媽媽」的命名人。在一個很厲害的靈異節目中作為通靈者出演。 對三枝有人情味的性格抱有好感。把照顧洛姆的事情託付給了三枝。為了幫助被山之神邀請去神社的洛姆而犧牲了自己，被變成了狐狸妖怪的模樣成為了神社的從神。 在神社的結界崩壞後，再度出手救贖被拘禁於神社中的人牲，並一起走上成佛之路。 === 其他人物 === 遠野善（遠野 善（とおの ぜん），聲：中村悠一、寺崎裕香（幼時）） 在見子與華尋找棄貓的新飼主時提出希望領養貓的男子，但見子發現他身邊聚集著貓的怨靈而拒絕了他。後來在見子的班級導師休產假時臨時擔任班導。對人不感興趣，不擅長記住別人的名字。周圍被貓的怨靈包圍，一開始被見子警戒著，在後來得知是因為去調查虐貓案件、找到貓屍，所以被貓的怨靈跟上，解除誤會。之後見子利用狐狸式神，將附身其身上的媽媽鬼魂消滅，讓他脫離媽媽鬼的控制。 察覺未知瑠和她姊姊的關係，將未知瑠的身影與小時候的自己重疊在一起，給了一些勸告和建議。 在未知瑠與姊姊關係改善之後，似乎與姐姐(一条葉)成為貓友。 一條未知瑠（一条 みちる（いちじょう みちる），聲：早見沙織（第9卷發售紀念有聲漫畫）） 在「神社篇」完結的第39話最後首次登場。穿著全黑水手服和黑色手套的高個子美少女，轉校生、與見子同班。亦是「CHAOSTEEN」專屬模特兒。 因外型亮眼，相當引人注目。但在見子眼裡，頸部以上覆蓋著有許多觸手、形似章魚的靈體，無法得知長相。而靈體的型態變化、觸手的行動模式能反映出本人的內在情緒。莫名的對見子很感興趣，有病嬌傾向。對外保持著親切但有距離感的微笑，基本上喜怒不形於色，但對見子會展現較多的情緒。 有飼養一隻綠毛蟲當寵物，外觀類似鳳蝶幼蟲，取名小P。對與見子關係很好的小華懷有強烈敵意。與小華談判(?)之後，感受到小華的善意而釋懷，但還是會有類似吃醋、爭寵的行為出現。 第64話結尾，及時拉住被靈體引誘，差點遭遇事故的見子，但反被靈體侵害而昏過去。 一條葉（一条 葉（いちじょう よう）） 未知瑠的姐姐兼經紀人。於漫畫第46話結尾初登場，名字於第47話出現。 推測雙親已不在世，與未知瑠相依為命。對未知瑠似乎有很強的控制欲，以經紀人與家人的名義對她的生活與人際關係加以干涉，例如覺得見子等人帶壞她，便要求換班級。 雖然未知瑠沒有表現出來，但從章魚靈體的變化來看，未知瑠似乎很討厭她。 因未知瑠開始出現一些“異常”行為（如沒接她電話、關掉手機定位、在朋友家過夜，等），而有過激的反應。 後來得知因父母早亡、未知瑠的特殊性格等因素，而產生了過度保護的心理。在未知瑠與小華談判(?)的事件結束後，心態上終於釋懷。似乎與遠野老師成為貓友。 荒井（荒井（あらい），聲：佐藤花） 見子的班級導師，因為休產假而由遠野善繼任。 豪塚（豪塚（ごうづか），聲：伊丸岡篤） 從見子與華之處領養了棄貓的男子，面相兇惡，卻是個愛貓人士。將領養的貓起名為「喵助」。身邊跟著兩隻貓和自己妻子（聲：櫻井浩美）的守護靈。 在SNS上的賬號名為「豪塚@ 喵助」。 木戶（木戸（きど），聲：櫻井浩美） 保健教師。巨乳，吸引到好色的鬼怪。漫畫中，好色鬼怪被香水的成分消滅。 蟒蛇穴熊（アナコンダ穴熊，聲：佐佐木義人） 摔角選手。見子多次因他的緣故從鬼怪的糾纏中脫身，這也令見子變得十分崇拜他。 善的母親（[空／未定义]，聲：中原麻衣） 已逝。疑似遭丈夫拋棄，性格變得扭曲，用斯巴達教育支配幼年時期的善，對兒子有著病態的控制欲，死後化身成蜘蛛型態的鬼怪，附身於善的身上。後來被狐狸式神消滅。 聰（サトル，聲：興津和幸、大地葉（幼時）） 善唯一的朋友，小學的舊識。職業是獸醫，治療了善保護的貓，也幫忙尋找肯收養貓的飼主。 繁（シゲさん，聲：佐佐健太） 三枝占卜館對面的老爺爺，鞋店的老闆。告訴拜訪占卜館的幽里亞傳達了神母引退的消息。擔任與神母的溝通的角色。他相當關心神母，死後也憑藉著最後一絲的執念在此等候並出現在神母面前，告訴她洛姆似乎想利用見子達成什麼企圖。 === 神社相關的角色 === 山之神（山の神様，聲：山根雅史） 「給三次願望」神社起源的神社主人。神靈媽媽說來歷不明的可怕存在，作為實現願望的代價，要求發願者給予回報。本身似乎是由人性和大量的怨念、信仰所混合而成的怪物，由於過去資料全無因而無法判定。 狐狸妖怪（狐の怪，聲：松田利冴、松田颯水） 山之神的兩名僕從。幫助陷入危機的見子。 == 創作、出版 == 作者泉朝樹稱，創作本作的契機發生在2018年9月，他看到身邊的漫畫家在Twitter發表漫畫作品後都在網上引起話題，於是也想畫些甚麼東西，跟着在網上引起話題，甚至連載化和推出單行本。他想了幾個構想，在跟妻子討論後，妻子從中挑選了「女高中生無視很糟糕的東西」的主題，漫畫名稱也是由她所取的。首篇漫畫於2018年9月6日發表，共4頁，網上反應熱烈，有約5萬次轉推和16萬次讚好。 他發表第1話後，便收到多家出版社的聯絡，其中他感受到KADOKAWA字裏行間充滿誠意，就決定接受KADOKAWA的邀約。泉朝樹在後記中稱，距離首篇發表僅兩個星期即確定連載。KADOKAWA的負責編輯在訪問中談及選擇本作的原因時，讚賞作者的畫功，認為很少漫畫家能兼顧繪畫可愛的女孩子和恐怖的怪物；也說到雖然每話都是單獨故事，但也看到貫穿整篇漫畫的主題，故認為本作故事能夠擴展寫下去。女主角的名字「見子」到第4話才初次出現，姓氏「四谷」則到第3卷才登場。 == 出版書籍 == == 電視動畫 == 2021年3月18日，宣佈改編電視動畫將於2021年首播，並公開前導視覺圖、前導宣傳影片，以及主要製作人員陣容，製作公司為Passione。7月16日，宣佈動畫將在10月於TOKYO MX、BS日視、AT-X等電視台首播，並公開第1條宣傳影片和第2張前導視覺圖，以及3名主要角色的聲優。7月28日，在「KADOKAWAanime」YouTube頻道播映怪談特別直播節目，雨宮天、本渡楓出席，由怪談家ぁみ主持。8月13日，公開第3張前導視覺圖。8月31日，宣佈首播日期為10月3日。9月30日，公開主視覺圖，以及多名配角的聲優。 網絡電台節目由2021年10月1日起在音泉上播出，每月一集，雨宮天主持。 === 製作人員 === === 主題曲 === 片頭曲《我才看不見呢！？》（見えないからね!?） 作詞、作曲：齊藤信治（Dream Monster），編曲：高木龍一（Dream Monster），主唱：四谷見子（雨宮天） 片尾曲《看到吧？ 看見了吧？？ 你正在看吧？？？》（ミタナ？ ミタヨネ？？ ミテルヨネ？？？） 作詞：烏屋茶房，作曲、編曲：本田正樹（Dream Monster），主唱：四谷見子（雨宮天） === 集數列表 === === 播映平台 === === BD / DVD === == 真人電影 == 於2025年6月6日上映。由原菜乃華主演。 === 角色列表 === 四谷見子：原菜乃華 百合川華：久間田琳加 二暮堂幽里亞：Naenano 權藤昭生：山下幸輝 荒井老師：堀田茜 遠野典子：吉井怜 四谷透子：高岡早紀 遠野善：京本大我 四谷真守：瀧藤賢一 === 製作團隊 === 原作：泉朝樹《陰陽眼見子》（KADOKAWA刊） 劇本・導演：中村義洋 配樂：堤博明 主題曲：BABYMONSTER「Ghost」（Sony Music Labels Inc.） 攝影：川島周 燈光：本間大海 音效：小川武 美術：久渡明日香 裝飾：大熊雄己 剪輯：松竹利郎 製作人：天馬少京、星野秀樹 title: Tonikaku Kawaii
description: First comes marriage, then comes an earthbound love that is out of this world! From the day his parents named him, Nasa Yuzaki has been destined for outer space…or so he believes. But while trying to join the space program, he is thrown for a loop when an accident introduces him to Tsukasa, a mysterious girl with strange powers. Is she an alien, a moon goddess or something else? Since she insists on marrying him, Nasa has plenty of chances to find out! (Source: VIZ Media) Notes: The 16th volume includes the 4 chapter prequel "FLY ME TO THE MOON".

characters.name: Nasa Yuzaki
characters.description: __Height:__ 169.5 cm __Likes:__ Math, Physics, Finances Kindhearted, charismatic, and intelligent, albeit only in certain areas. Nasa Yuzaki decided he had no need for a high school education, and, well, he was mostly right. He is the type of person who would worry if his friends got hurt when they tripped over a pebble, while he ended up falling down a cliff. He is very in love with his wife.

characters.name: Tsukasa Yuzaki
characters.description: **Height**: 154 cm **Relatives**: [Tokiko Tsukuyomi](https://anilist.co/character/188292/Tokiko-Tsukuyomi) (grandaunt), [Enishi Yuzaki](https://anilist.co/character/190386/Enishi-Yuzaki) (father-in-law), [Kanoka Yuzaki](https://anilist.co/character/190388/Kanoka-Yuzaki) (mother-in-law) Tsukasa Yuzaki is the wife of [Nasa Yuzaki](https://anilist.co/character/130944/Nasa-Yuzaki). Not much is known about her, but what is known is that she's mysteriously cute. Tsukasa has long pink hair with a clasp on the back and pink-red eyes. She wears elegant clothing and a skirt. While at home she is usually seen wearing modern clothing. During her trip to Kyoto, she wore a floral Yukata. Tsukasa comes across as calm and level-headed; seemingly unsurprised by Nasa's rash and illogical actions. Despite this, she agreed to marry him and love him dearly. She gets embarrassed easily whenever Nasa proclaims

characters.name: Kaname Arisugawa
characters.description: She's been helping the bathhouse for a long time. Despite being young, she is very mature and always gives good suggestions to [Nasa](https://anilist.co/character/130944/Nasa-Yuzaki) to help him out with his couple life. Like her mom, she really likes dirty jokes and apparently, she has no fear of cleaning the males' bath while Nasa is in there. She isn't shy and prefers a direct approach.

characters.name: Aya Arisugawa
characters.description: She is [Kaname](https://anilist.co/character/137513/Kaname-Arisugawa)'s older sister. She is a lazy ditz but, [Kaname](https://anilist.co/character/137513/Kaname-Arisugawa) considers her on the "genius side" for her great learning capacity. In contrast with that, she usually misunderstands important things and she gets really confused in the blink of an eye. Her favorite hobby is probably playing video games and she usually nags [Kaname](https://anilist.co/character/137513/Kaname-Arisugawa) into playing with her.

characters.name: Chitose Kaginoji
characters.description: Apparently, [Tsukasa](https://anilist.co/character/131106/Tsukasa-Yuzaki) saved her from falling off a cliff when they were children. Chitose wants to use her own life for the sake of [Tsukasa](https://anilist.co/character/131106/Tsukasa-Yuzaki) to pay her back. She obviously doesn't want [Tsukasa](https://anilist.co/character/131106/Tsukasa-Yuzaki) falling into [Nasa](https://anilist.co/character/130944/Nasa-Yuzaki)'s hands. She has two maids: [Aurora](https://anilist.co/character/137516/Aurora) and [Charlotte](https://anilist.co/character/137517/Charlotte). Chitose has a personality that quickly bends from being strong to whining. She considers [Tsukasa](https://anilist.co/character/131106/Tsukasa-Yuzaki) her sister. (Source: Tonikaku Kawaii Wikia)

characters.name: Aurora
characters.description: She is one of [Chitose](https://anilist.co/character/137515/Chitose-Kaginoji)'s maids. She is usually serious and cold-minded. Probably the exact opposite personality of [Charlotte](https://anilist.co/character/137517/Charlotte): the second maid of [Chitose](https://anilist.co/character/137515/Chitose-Kaginoji). She always appears with [Charlotte](https://anilist.co/character/137517/Charlotte) and she usually tries to stop her from being too impulsive. (Source: Tonikaku Kawaii Wikia)

characters.name: Charlotte
characters.description: She is one of [Chitose](https://anilist.co/character/137515/Chitose-Kaginoji)'s maids. She quickly changes her personality from being simple-minded and innocent to going berserk with a giant sword in her hands. However, she is always happy with a big smile on her face. She will probably do everything [Chitose](https://anilist.co/character/137515/Chitose-Kaginoji) tells her to do without hesitation.

characters.name: Naoko Yanagi
characters.description: She is a teacher from the middle school that [Nasa](https://anilist.co/character/130944/Nasa-Yuzaki) had frequented. She is always super busy with work and doesn't have much time for her life. However, once she sees how happy [Nasa](https://anilist.co/character/130944/Nasa-Yuzaki)'s marriage is, she becomes more open to future relationships. She considers herself a boring person.

characters.name: Kyuuma Kagami
characters.description: She is Kaname's classmate and is always looking for her. She lacks logic and always draws queer conclusions. In a word: a klutz. (Source: Tonikaku Kawaii Wiki)

characters.name: Ouka Nakiri
characters.description: She was Nasa's classmate in middle school and is the same age as him. She currently owns an electronics store and apparently, she doesn't have any clear desire for affective relationships. (Source: Tonikaku Kawaii Wiki)

characters.name: Kaguya Gekkou
characters.description: __Height:__ 143 cm She is a senior high school student and has very long hair. She is very clever. Indeed, she can easily compute the trajectory of a rocket heading for the moon. She can be described as a sociopath since she doesn't really care about or understand people's morals or emotions. Everything can be explained by logic.

characters.name: Ginga Onimaru
characters.description: He is not a Yakuza, but everything about him recalls one. Indeed he always dresses as such and often changes normal terms with words more shadier and fishy. Besides that, he is a high school student and Nasa's cousin. (Source: Tonikaku Kawaii Wiki)

wiki_extract: 《總之就是很可愛》（日語：トニカクカワイイ，Tonikaku Kawaii，英語：Fly Me to the Moon） 是畑健二郎的日本漫画作品，於《週刊少年Sunday》（小學館）2018年12號開始連載至今。截止2025年12月，單行本累計發行超過700萬冊。漫畫相關工作人員將其簡稱為「トニカワ」（Tonikawa）。 與許多男女主角珠聯璧合便代表著故事已到尾聲的戀愛漫畫不同，本作故事一開始男女主角就兩情相悅，並且結為連理，以講述夫婦之間的愛情為特色。作為彩蛋，故事中時常還會有畑健二郎另外一部作品《旋風管家》中的角色出現。 == 故事概要 == 學業優秀、正在備考高中入學考試的由崎星空，在一個雪夜中偶遇在街對面小憩的少女月讀司，並對她一見鍾情。正當星空跨過街道打算向司搭訕時，迎面卻駛來了一輛卡車。幸得司捨身相救，星空得以保住性命，但司卻沒有留下名字便轉頭離去。害怕司會像輝夜姬一樣就此和自己永別的星空，不顧身上的重傷起身奮力追趕司，並對其告白。司告訴星空「如果你願意和我結婚，那我就跟你交往」，星空當即答應，隨後昏倒在地。 之後，在病房裡甦醒的星空，每日都在進行復健和唸書，在重讀一年中三後在高中入學考試中奪得榜首。但對司念念不忘的星空放棄入學，心懷與司重逢的期望搬出父母家開始了獨自生活，每天都全身心投入到各類打工中，但工作數年卻依然未能找到司。在星空滿18歲那年的某天晚上，司突然造訪星空的住處，來意正是要兌現在那個雪夜中與星空的承諾。星空雖然對此感到一頭霧水，但仍然與司辦理了結婚登記，互不了解的兩人，在婚後的共同生活中感情日漸加深。 == 登場人物 == === 主要人物 === 由崎司 （日語：由崎 司／ゆざき つかさ，羅馬化：Yuzaki Tsukasa，聲：鬼頭明里） 生日是4月3日，血型O型，白羊座。身高154公分。 在星空遭遇車禍時捨身相救，面對星空的告白時以結婚為前提答應和星空交往，在2年後某晚出現在星空的公寓門前，兌現承諾與他結婚。 舊姓「月讀」（月読／つくよみ），婚後改從夫姓為「由崎」。 被星空稱為「宇宙最可愛的我的老婆」，得知星空也曾向他的父母如此描述自己時非常害羞。喜欢星空的原因是其正向思考、积极言论及不轻易放弃的特质。一開始被星空稱作「司小姐」（司さん），婚后星空对其称呼改为「小司」（司ちゃん）。 在被星空示爱时虽会感到害羞，但内心十分开心。对于星空积极的示爱行为，她虽会表现出害羞的反应，但并不反感。 乍看之下是個冷艷無口屬性的美少女，但其实意外地对电视节目、电影、动画及游戏非常热衷，且性格不服输，不仅对影视、动画涉猎广泛，玩游戏也较为熟练，因此對星空的家裡沒有電視感到相當震驚。此外，她还展现出对生活事物好奇心旺盛的一面。故事中期也可得知是個十分害怕寂寞的人。 睡相很差，但睡前有将头发绑成包包头的习惯。此外，还有睡眠中途起床补水的习惯。 曾多次因意外受伤但都快速恢复。；她曾提及自己身体不易生病受伤且一直保持着十六岁的状态。。 对于已逝去的日本历史其实不太感兴趣，但能清晰记得历史进程及星空提及的历史人物过往。有着不符外表年龄的老年人式举止，比如对现代科技3C产品不熟悉，相比机械更倾向于自己动手做事。會自己穿和服，還能夠熟練使用緣的日本刀。 漫画第一部結尾處正式揭露其真實身分是竹取物语中，奉天皇命令銷毁輝夜姬贈送的不老藥的使者岩笠（つきの岩笠）的女兒。眼看着女儿重病垂危，于是岩笠将不老药给女儿喝下，使其获得了不老不死之身。在得到不死身后逃出村子，忘记了之前的名字，后被圣德太子命名为“司”。因不死身被视为怪物，且重视的人都一一逝去，承受了千年孤独。希望能找到輝夜姬讓自己變回人類，以結束這趟無盡的旅途。 曾离开日本周游列国，期间见证了多项重大发明与建筑。二戰時回到日本，在京丸的深山有一处房子作为隐匿处，数百年来还协助藏匿过许多历史上下落不明的人物。。阿波罗计划后万念俱灰时，曾一度居家不出。直到发现时子时日无多，为不耽误对方，才决定离家出走。 由崎星空 （日語：由崎 星空／ゆざき なさ，羅馬化：Yuzaki Nasa，聲：榎木淳弥、庄司宇芽香（兒時） 生日是5月5日，18歲，血型A型，金牛座。身高169.5公分，该身高为作者有意设计——“绝妙地不到170公分”。。） 對自己寫作「星空」卻讀作「NASA」的名字相當不滿，因此立志成為比NASA更厲害的人，是個實幹家。口頭禪是「我是比NASA還要更接近光速的男人」。其学历受到身边人的认可，但課業之外的知識卻是壓倒性地不足。 對司一見鐘情，即使遭遇车祸身负重伤，仍奋力起身追求司。在答應完司的要求後因傷勢過重昏迷並失去部分記憶。出院後努力讀書與復健，恢復健康後因不及參加高中考試而重讀一年中學，毕业后为见到司选择不升学，便找了许多面向群众的工作，试图与司重逢，最终未能如愿。之後在滿18歲那年的某一天與司重逢，星空虽对此情况感到困惑，但仍当即与她签署了结婚申请书。被司稱呼為「老公大人」（だんな様）。 理科生頭腦與性格，個性外向，社交及溝通能力極強。打从心底深爱着司，坚信司十分可爱。也展现出青春期男子的一面，例如会拍摄司的相片，或期待与司有更亲密的相处。在這段感情中非常積極但還未適應，與司相擁或接吻時仍會面紅耳赤。 頭腦聰明，但在感性方面與常人迥異。譬如因已将贵重物品存至银行、重要数据备份到云端，便称“就算房子被烧毁也无所谓”；生活中也有缺乏常识的表现，且日常饮食只考虑营养与性价比，每天都吃同一种调味的火锅；不知道洗衣袋為何物；只考慮營養和性價比，而每天都在吃相同調味的火鍋等。 被司认为长得有点像圣德太子，自己也曾以圣德太子的视角做梦。。 之后回想失去部分的記憶，他在遭遇车祸追上司并答应其要求后倒地失去知觉，因大雪导致救护车无法抵达，司为救他让他喝下自己的血，使其恢复了些许知觉。其后司解释结婚只是试探，还告知自己是1400年前的人且拥有不老不死之身，希望能前往月亮找到辉夜姬或变回普通人，他听完这番说法后并未动摇，依旧答应了司的要求。 === 有栖川家族 === 有栖川要 （日語：有栖川 要／ありすがわ かなめ，羅馬化：Arisugawa Kaname，聲：芹澤優） 星空国中时的学妹，也是星空家附近钱汤老板的女儿。高中一年級，15歲。喜歡講黃色笑話。個性較星空認真，經常對星空提出各種成熟的建議，特別是在戀愛方面。 本来误以为星空性冷感，会一直单身，甚至曾设想他长期单身的场景，直到星空与司结婚才感到惊讶。 时常会在星空做出奇怪举动或洗澡时偶遇，对男澡堂内洗澡的星空并无特殊感觉，据其所述，是因常打扫男澡堂时突然进入，早已习惯。 稱呼星空為「學長」，稱呼司為「阿司」（つかっさん）。 有栖川綾（日語：有栖川 綾／ありすがわ あや，羅馬化：Arisugawa Aya，聲：上坂堇） 星空的国中同学，也是星空家附近钱汤老板的女儿、有栖川要的姐姐。外表非常漂亮，喜歡星空，但是是暗戀。个性十分天然呆，其程度之深，连要都有明显感受。 由於是暗戀的關係，因此始終沒有跟星空表白，而星空本人亦不知情，直到母親直接了當的跟她說「星空已經跟司結婚了」，這才注意到司和星空的姓氏相同是因為結婚改夫姓的關係，因而大受打擊。：失恋后决定以YouTube博主“绫P”的身份出道，其频道拥有一定知名度。 重度遊戲玩家，一開始以為司是星空的妹妹之類的家人，知道真相後為檢驗司是否配得上星空，向司挑戰玩電玩遊戲，比試結束後兩人互相認同、萌生了出友情。 喜歡的偶像是安室透。 有栖川姊妹的母親（聲：久川绫） 有栖川姊妹的母亲，為澡堂「草津温泉風湯布院」的經營者。 因曾有婚姻挫折，所以她认为绫对失恋的伤心程度并不深重。 偶尔会给星空一些交往中亲密接触的建议，也和要一样好奇星空与司的新婚生活。 有栖川姊妹的父亲 title: Dead Dead Demon's Dededededestruction
title_original: デッドデッドデーモンズデデデデデストラクション
description: The Japan Self-Defense Forces are still looking for a way to combat the alien threat, but so far conventional weapons have had no effect. Maybe it’s time to try something unconventional. Meanwhile, Kadode Koyama and her best friend avidly track the aliens’ movements on social media and less enthusiastically study for college entrance exams. When the end of the world looms overhead, you learn to take things one step at a time. (Source: VIZ Media) Notes: - Winner of the 66th Shogakukan Manga Award in the general category. - Includes one extra chapter.

characters.name: Ouran Nakagawa
characters.description: A girl in her third year of high school. She is [Kadode](https://anilist.co/character/88566/Koyama-Kadode)'s best friend. She has long black hair, which she often wears in twintails, secured by skull-shaped hairties. Ouran has an older brother, [Hiroshi](https://anilist.co/character/89578/Nakagawa-Hiroshi) who is a NEET. She likes to play video games along with Kadode. Ouran is a very flamboyant character. She often rambles on about her goal to enslave mankind or lead the human race to destruction. However, despite her seemingly flamboyant and sociable personality, Ouran tends to only show her true self to her friends and family.

characters.name: Kadode Koyama
characters.description: A girl in her third year of high school. She loves the iconic manga character [Isobeyan](https://anilist.co/character/208124/Isobeyan). She also has a crush on [her teacher](https://anilist.co/character/89581/Watarase-Naoki). [Her dad](https://anilist.co/character/208125/Koyama-Nobuo) went missing during the initial appearance of the alien mothership over Japan. She appears to have a rocky relationship with [her mother](https://anilist.co/character/89585/Koyama-Manami), who's constantly worried about her own health and the A-Rays that were released when the aliens invaded.

wiki_extract: 《數碼寶貝03馴獸師之王》（日語：デジモンテイマーズ，英語：Digimon Tamers），于2001年4月1日-2002年3月31日，全51话，每周日09:00-09:30（UTC+9）在富士电视台系列播映的电视动画，是數碼寶貝电视动画系列第三作，原企划标题为《數碼寶貝大冒險EVO》（日語：デジモンアドベンチャー EVO，英語：Digimon Adventure EVO）。中国大陆搜狐视频2015年版权到期后，转由爱奇艺网络播映。 《数码宝贝30周年：我们选择的最佳冒险》（日語：デジモン30th 僕らが選んだベストアドベンチャー，英語：Digimon 30th: The Best Adventure We Chose），全称《数码宝贝30周年纪念：我们选择的最佳冒险》（日語：デジモン30周年 僕らが選んだベストアドベンチャー，英語：Digimon 30th Anniversary: The Best Adventure We Chose），通称《数码宝贝：我们选择的最佳冒险》（日語：デジモン 僕らが選んだベストアドベンチャー，英語：Digimon: The Best Adventure We Chose）或《我们选择的最佳冒险》（日語：僕らが選んだベストアドベンチャー，英語：The Best Adventure We Chose），简称《最佳冒险》（日語：ベストアドベンチャー，英語：The Best Adventure），于2026年10月4日-2027年，每周日09:00-09:30（UTC+9）在富士电视台系列播映的电视动画，是数码宝贝电视动画系列的精选集，也是东映动画创立70周年纪念作品。香港、澳門、台灣、新加坡、马来西亚等由Digimon官方YouTube频道同步日本网络播映，中国大陆由哔哩哔哩、小红书、抖音、快手等同步日本网络播映。 == 剧情 == 故事發生在現實世界，2001年，數碼獸存在於電子遊戲、交換卡片遊戲還有動畫系列。五年級的小學生松田啟人因熱愛數碼寶貝卡片遊戲（Digital Monster Card Game）設計出了一隻數碼獸，因為對真正數碼獸的無比嚮往，某天刷卡器吸收了自己設計的數碼獸草图，而他的刷卡器變成了真正的数码器——“D-Ark”，之後又認識了李健良和牧野留姬，他們遇到了自己的搭档數碼獸，與來到現實世界的數碼獸戰鬥。最初的冒險在現實世界展開，然而數碼世界四聖獸之一的朱雀獸為了保護他們的進化之光，不斷派遣帝魔（十二隻以十二神將為原型的數碼獸）來到現實世界，而後又把古樂獸帶走，啟人他們為了救它，帶了博和、樹莉以及健太，決定進入數碼世界。在數碼世界中，啟人一行人又遇到了傳說中的馴獸師——秋山遼。而後又遇到了被傳送至數碼世界的健良的妹妹——小春。他們8個人在得到了四聖獸的認可後，帶著古樂獸回到現實世界。但是在消滅真正的敵人「数码死神（D-Reaper）」之後，因為程式的關係，使得基爾獸他們必須要返回數碼世界。在離別前基爾獸和啟人約定：「之後還是要一起玩喔，要記得喔。」在數碼獸們都回去後，馴獸師們又再度開始了還沒有遇見數碼獸時的生活。但是有一天啟人經過基爾獸曾經住的地方，到裡面察看時，發現了現實世界和數碼世界的大門又打開了…… == 概要 == 本作原企划标题虽和《数码宝贝大冒险》系列有關聯，但在更改标题後，劇情和设定也變的和大冒险系列沒有關係而是成為了「平行世界」和「剧中剧」。本作開始加入交換卡片遊戲的要素，讓故事變得更多元，同時也給万代發售的數碼寶貝卡片遊戲（Digital Monster Card Game）进行了联动宣传。而矩陣進化（Matrix Evolution）這點則為第四作的設定預先鋪路。 並沒有被選召的孩子們：本作中，主角们認為数码兽不是出於它們自己的意志，並致使牠們進行冒險。相对于其他几作，消極地強加給孩子们让其接受冒险，尤为不同。 首次加入交換卡片遊戲的要素：由於有著卡片遊戲的要素，所以馴獸師刷卡加強数码兽的戰鬥能力，甚至可以使用前作数码兽的必殺技。 不是代理戰鬥的戰鬥——究極體一體化：在前两作，戰鬥高潮如下：暴龙机將傳遞“能量”給数码兽，它們的作用在数码兽進化後就結束了。之後，戰鬥將在数码兽之間展開，孩子們僅僅表現對戰鬥的反應，或是為数码兽加油。而這一系列，作為英雄化的数码兽成為究極體時，孩子們必須成為数码兽的一部分。這個設定亦啓發了後作《數碼寶貝無限地帶》，人類沒有数码兽作爲搭档，直接進化成数码兽。 数码兽不會復活：無論在前作還是後作，数码兽死後會變回數碼蛋然後復活，但本作不會，儘管数码兽都是由數據組成，但他們死後會粉碎，變回數據，被其他的数码兽吃掉，成為食糧，情況與自然界的弱肉強食一樣。 數碼世界是層狀的，而不是其他作品般是球狀的，整個數碼世界都是怪怪的，看似上方的地方其實是在下方，而且不時出現龍捲風（巨大光柱，可以把人吹到不同的地方）。 数码兽進化：数码兽與前作和後作一樣都會在戰鬥過程中進化。不同之處是，前作和後作進化戰鬥完後（無論戰勝還是戰敗）都會自動退化为成長期，但本作戰鬥完後数码兽並不會即時退化，而需要特定環境或者情況才會退化为成長期。 最高收视率：11.6%，最低收视率：7.3%，平均收视率：9.9%。万代总玩具销售额78亿日元。 2026年6月26日，举办「全球票选数码宝贝动画4部作品的最佳单集」（世界が選ぶデジモンアニメ4作品ベストエピソード投票）活动。2026年6月26日-7月10日，征集票选。2026年8月1日，发表《數碼寶貝大冒險》、《數碼寶貝大冒險02》、《数码宝贝驯兽师之王》、《数码宝贝无限地带》票选结果。2026年10月4日-2027年，每周日09:00-09:30（UTC+9）在富士电视台系列播映《数码宝贝30周年：我们选择的最佳冒险》（デジモン30th 僕らが選んだベストアドベンチャー）。 === 克苏鲁神话色彩 === 文部科学省设立的机密机关、情报管理局的室长山木满雄，制作了监视、追踪不正信息流动的系统“许普诺斯”、消除程序“犹格斯”、“夏盖”。他将想要出现在现实世界的数据视为危险源，并称呼他们为“野生小组（Wild One）”。山木本身也设定为喜欢古生物及克苏鲁神话的科学家，可能隐射了小中千昭的爱好。 犹格斯 “犹格斯（Yuggoth）”的命名源自克苏鲁神话中的犹格斯星。犹格斯可能是矮行星冥王星。是洛夫克拉夫特所创造的真菌，“米·戈（Mi-Go）”的主要殖民地或称基地。米·戈被分类为下级独立种族。 夏盖/歼灭计划 “夏盖（Shaggai）”的命名源自克苏鲁神话中的夏盖星。夏盖星是由双子绿色太阳组成的双星系统上运行的行星，可能位于仙女座星系。它在宇宙中比犹格斯更为遥远。可能正是夏盖虫族（Insect from Shaggai）的母星。夏盖星在8个世纪前被毁灭，据说是由于外神格赫罗斯（Ghroth）的到来，使某种不明生命体苏醒而造成的。 许普诺斯 “许普诺斯”的名字来源很容易让人联想到希腊神话中的睡眠之神，但洛夫克莱夫特将他导入自己的作品中，并且已经完全融入了克苏鲁神话。许普诺斯在克苏鲁神话中是一位古神，形象不明。 野生小组（Wild One） 在英语中，“One”可用来替代名词所指的很明确的人、物。旧日支配者使用的原文为“Great Old One”、作为下级仆从种族的深潜者在原文中也用“Deep One”表示。而古神在早期的小说故事中也有用“Old One”进行称呼。山木满雄将在网络上自主活动引起的错误和事故的数码兽称为“Wild One”，可能只是单纯的英语用法，也可能是隐射了克苏鲁神话中“旧日支配者”等名词的命名方式。 密斯卡托尼克大学 密斯卡托尼克大学（Miskatonic University）是克苏鲁神话中霍华德·菲利普斯·洛夫克拉夫特的作品中多次出场的一所虚构学校，位于美国马塞诸塞州。 内原户哲夫 这一人名在小中千昭1998年为《迪迦奥特曼》写的短篇《深渊漫步者》也有出场。但在外形的描述上与第44话中差别很大，是一个浅黑肤色有着缝隙般眼睛的男人。而名字本身可能也有隐射。 奈亚拉托提普（Nyarlathotep）是外来神之一，在以克苏鲁神话为背景的小说中经常出现的一个角色。人类化身通常是一个皮肤黝黑，身形瘦高，面带爽朗笑容的男子。奈亚拉托提普是外神们在地上的信使和代言人，它尤其服从于阿撒托斯；亦不同于大多数对人类不感兴趣的外神，奈亚拉托提普总是热衷于欺骗、诱惑人类，并以使人类陷入恐怖与绝望为其最高的喜悦。在克苏鲁神话中，它的形象最接近于传统“魔鬼”的概念。 梅菲斯兽 剧场版《数码宝贝驯兽师之王 冒险者的战斗》的BOSS梅菲斯兽，其同样在胸口处有刻记五角星的“古神之印”（Elder Sign）的变形。，是由奥古斯特·威廉·德雷斯在《居于户口之物（The Lurker at the Threshold）》中首次设计的。 === 大事年表 === == 登場角色 == == 特別用語 == D-Ark（數碼方舟機/弧光機） 连结数码兽与驯兽师的小型装置。可以解析遇到的数码兽，还可以通过数码兽卡片对搭档数码兽发出指示。过去被野生小组在数码兽构想中称作「方舟」，设计成是孩子们通过它与数码兽们交流，从网络上的数据库中提取信息的道具。 Blue Card（藍卡） 偶爾會出現的進化卡片，超越数码兽和网络世界的框架而构想的一种算法，数码精灵将其化为卡片形态。 Red Card（紅卡） 被製造來帮助数码兽进入数码死神而不受影响的卡片，原理是将数码兽的波长改变使之接近数码死神。 Ark（方舟） 數碼世界裡的交通工具，主角等人返回現實世界時也是搭乘此物，後被修改為Grani。 ZERO-ARMS Grani（人工怪獸「零」：格拉尼） 由方舟修改而來人工合成的戰鬥支援用武器，能夠和公爵兽合體，成為公爵兽深红形态；ARMS是Artificial Monsters（人工製成怪獸）的簡稱；Zero指首架同類武器（零号武器）；Grani譯為「格拉尼」，最早是源自於北歐史詩「費爾森家族的薩加」，是史詩中後期男主角西古德（Sigurd）所獲得的「天馬後代」。 數碼侏儒（DigiGnome/Digital Gnome） 在数码世界生息的，区别于数码兽的另一种人工智能完成独立进化的生命体，由野生小组的涩果子（Shibumi）命名。不会说话，不过随着和人和数码兽进行交流，想要通过实现愿望来表达自己的想法。除了回应青龙兽的愿望将「数码生命原理」化为古乐兽的样子，还从启人的记事本中创造了名为基尔兽的全新数码兽，让带有涩果子构想的蓝卡和数码方舟器出现在了现实世界。 数码死神（D-Reaper） 从数码兽诞生以前就存在的原始程序，沉睡在数码世界四圣兽领域的更深的部分，但因为数码兽们的进化而活性化并开始侵蚀数码世界。 代理数码死神（Agent D-Reaper） 简称ADR。依据攻击或迎击等不同目的，D-Reaper产生了各种各样的形态。然则其单个分身并不具备独立意志，所有活动全部依据单一意志。在D-Reaper占领区（D-Reaper Zone）之外，他们通过线与母体相连。 == 作品中出现的实物和地名 == 本作以东京都新宿区西新宿周边为舞台，再现了西新宿榉树桥大道商店街、新宿中央公园、新宿站前周边、大江户线等 新宿区立西新宿小学：主人公启人就读的小学的原型（校舍是淀桥第六小学） 新宿中央公园：第7话中出现的公园地下通道（第二、十二社干线）实际上是存在的。只不过放映的时候当时还在施工中，现已完工 国立霞丘陆上竞技场（旧国立竞技场）：现已拆除重建为新国立竞技场 花园神社 熊野神社 東京都厅舍 秋葉原電器街 新宿站 歌舞伎町 都营大江户线 区立角筈图书馆 首都高速4号新宿线 新宿西口站 牛込神乐坂站 都厅前站 若松河田站 三鹰站 八王子站 松本站 本乡三丁目站 文化学园大学 东京歌剧城 日本自卫队 B-2幽灵战略轰炸机 == 製作人員 == === TV动画版 === 原案：本乡昭由 連載：「V Jump」（集英社） title: Ao no Flag
description: High school senior year, spring—one of life's important forks in the road. Taichi Ichinose finds himself in the same class as Futaba Kuze, who he feels strangely averse to, and his popular childhood friend, Touma Mita. One day, Futaba confides in him her love for Touma, and asks him for help. How will Taichi respond? This new “pure” love story begins as the three are colored in the emotions of youth. (Source: MANGA Plus)

characters.name: Futaba Kuze
characters.description: An impossibly naive girl who fell for Touma. She ends up befriending Ichinose in an attempt to learn more about him, but they end up becoming close friends with each other and Touma as well. She is very sweet and tries her hardest, but her natural clumsiness and naivete make it hard for her to befriends others in her class.

characters.name: Masumi Itachi
characters.description: Kuze's best friend. She is a dark and mysterious girl who is very protective of her smaller best friend. She is in a separate class but is often seen hanging around with the rest of the main characters. She intends to become a veterinarian.

characters.name: Touma Mita
characters.description: Ichinose's childhood friend and the most popular boy in their school, loved by everyone for his niceness, looks and being the school's baseball team's ace and captain. He gets close to Ichinose and Kuze once they end up in the same class. He is very kind-hearted and loud and cares deeply for his new found friends. His dream is of playing in the grounds of Koushien Stadium and become a professional baseball player.

characters.name: Taichi Ichinose
characters.description: An ordinary high school student. Ichinose used to be Mita's best friend, but they drifted apart during high school. They get closer again when they end up in the same classroom. He is usually shy and meek, but is known for being extremely nice.

characters.name: Mami Yagihara
characters.description: A girl that is within Touma's group of friends and grows upset with his newfound interest in hanging out with Futaba and Taichi instead of her. She is interested in Touma, but he does not reciprocate her affection.

characters.name: Seiya Mita
characters.description: Touma´s elder brother.

characters.name: Akiko Mita
characters.description: Touma's former tutor and current sister in law, married to his brother Seiya. She is a very cheerful and nice woman. She is really happy about Taichi and Touma being close again and also acts as Masumi's confidant.

characters.name: Shingo Niimura
characters.description: Mami's friend.

characters.name: Yokki
characters.description: Taichi's friend.

characters.name: Mon
characters.description: Taichi's friend.

title: Tamen De Gushi
description: Sun Jing has a massive crush on a girl she sees at the bus station—feminine, blonde, and absolutely adorable, Qiu Tong is everything Sun Jing desires. But the tomboyish, outgoing Sun Jing cannot bring herself to utter a single word in Qiu Tong's presence. Once she musters up the courage, however, Sun Jing successfully introduces herself and secures a friendship with the cute girl. Although they are only friends for now, Sun Jing will do anything to see Qiu Tong smile; and with her genuine kindness, she might just win Qiu Tong's heart. (Source: MAL Rewrite)

wiki_extract: 金准韓（韓語：김준한，1983年3月29日—），另译金準韓、金俊翰，韩国男演员、电影导演及编剧。代表作品《朴烈》、《她们的故事》、《时间》及《機智醫生生活》。 == 早年经历 == 金准韩在庆尚道马山市出生长大，是家中的独生子，父母是小学教师，入行前他曾在百货商场做过分发样品的兼职。 == 演艺经历 == 金准韩2003年作为鼓手加入摇滚乐队izi，2005年发行首张专辑正式进入演艺圈，4年后退出乐队并入伍服役。在话剧演员赵云的影响下，金准韩发现演戏需要研究人生和自己的性格很适合，于是28岁服完兵役后开始参演戏剧，初期主要参演短片。金准韩将演员高俊视为自己的演技老师，两人在2015年共同执导短片《贤道歌》（현도가）。 在共同参演《軍艦島》的演员金仁友推荐下，金准韩于2017年参演李濬益执导的电影《朴烈》后被大众熟知，这是他首次在商业长片中饰演有较大比重戏份的角色，观众对他在片中出色的演技和日语实力好评如潮。金准韩凭借该片入围第54屆大鐘獎、第38屆青龍電影獎、第54屆百想藝術大獎等大型颁奖礼的最佳新人男演员，他也因此接连获得电影邀约，分别参演与导演李濬益二度合作的《边山》、宋康昊主演的《麻藥王》和慰安妇题材电影《她们的故事》。 2018年金准韩首次参演电视剧《機智牢房生活》，在剧中饰演小迷糊（李奎炯饰）的同性恋人，给观众留下深刻印象，部分观众给他起了“奔驰男友”的绰号。同年，金准韩除了在电视剧《时间》中首次担纲主演外，仅下半年就连续确认参演电影《抓住稻草的野兽》、《王的文字》和电视剧《神之测验：重启》，他也凭借电影《她们的故事》获得第2届韩中国际电影节最佳男配角。 2020年金准韩在电视剧《機智醫生生活》中饰演神经外科医生安治弘，对上级副教授蔡颂华（田美都饰）的一片丹心令不少观众动心，金准韩的知名度也因该剧得到大幅提升。同年，因与鄭雨盛在电影《抓住稻草的野兽》中结下的缘分，金准韩演艺生涯首次作为主演参演郑雨盛的导演处女作《监护人》。 金准韩2022年在剧集《安娜》中饰演一个为了目标不择手段的企业家，细致描绘出角色逐渐变化过程中体现的温度差让他获得“穿上了合适的衣服”、人生角色的称赞。 == 影視作品 == === 电影 === === 短篇电影 === === 剧集 === == 提名與獲獎列表 == == 参考资料 == == 外部链接 == 金准韩的Instagram帳戶 金准韩在NAVER上的资料（韓文） 金准韩在Daum上的资料（韓文） 金准韩在韩国电影数据库（KMDb）上的資料（韓語） 金准韩在互联网电影资料库（IMDb）上的資料（英文） 金准韩在豆瓣上的资料（简体中文） 金准韩在HanCinema的頁面（英文）

title: Shimanami Tasogare
title_en: Our Dreams at Dusk: Shimanami Tasogare
description: Not only is high schooler Tasuku Kaname the new kid in town, he’s also terrified that he’s been outed as gay. Just as he’s contemplating doing the unthinkable, Tasuku meets a mysterious woman who leads him to a group of people dealing with problems not so different from his own. In this realistic, heartfelt depiction of LGBT+ characters from different backgrounds finding their place in the world, a search for inner peace proves to be the most universal experience of all. (Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

characters.description: Tasuku Kaname is a high school student at Shimanami High, who is troubled by his sexual orientation and his affection for his schoolmate Touma Tsubaki.

characters.name: Touma Tsubaki
characters.description: Touma Tsubaki is a character from the manga Shimanami Tasogare, the ace of the Shimanami High volleyball club and Tasuku Kaname's crush. He and Tasuku are on the Health Committee together.

characters.name: Chaiko
characters.description: Chaiko is an older gentleman who often hangs out around the lounge and enjoys playing classical music. ~!Chaiko is gay, and his partner of 30 years is in the hospital for terminal cancer.!~

characters.name: Anonymous
characters.description: Anonymous is the mysterious founder and owner of the Lounge. They are asexual and, as Kamatani Yuuki has stated, of indeterminate gender identity.

characters.name: Shuuji Misora
characters.description: Misora is in sixth grade and prefers to dress as a girl whenever he's at the lounge. He is unsure about what gender he identifies as. He has multiple older sisters and is called Shuuji at home.

title: Innocent
description: In the 18th century, seeking "freedom and equality," the event that gave birth to modern French society, the French Revolution, began. There was one protagonist that lived within the darkness, Charles-Henri Sanson. He was the fourth-generation head of the Sanson family, and the executioner of Paris. This is the story of a man nobly facing his harsh fate... (Source: Shueisha, translated) Notes: - Nominated for the 18th Tezuka Osamu Cultural Prize "Reader Award" in 2014 - Nominated for the 8th Manga Taishou Award in 2015.

characters.name: Charles-Henri Sanson
characters.original: シャルル＝アンリ・サンソン
characters.description: Charles-Henri Sanson is one of the main characters and protagonist of Innocent series. Born in 1739 to Charles Jean-Baptiste Sanson and his first wife Madeleine Tronson, he was the fourth in a six-generation family dynasty of executioners. Charles is described as a beautiful young man with straight long dark hair. Older Charles has longer and wavy hair that is usually always shown to be slicked back. He resembles his father more with large shoulders and rib cage, but still has soft facial features and hands. His complexion, hair reflexions and eye color is odd and changing from volume to volume but are generally a ghostly greyish, bluish, purplish shade except for two examples where it is white with green or brownish shadows. ~!Charles was shown as man of pure and kind nature, who respects life, which was considered an unusual trait for a person who was born into a family of executioners

characters.description: Marie-Josèphe Sanson is the younger half-sister of [Charles-Henri Sanson](https://anilist.co/character/89944/Sanson-CharlesHenri) and one of the two main characters of the series. Born in 1751 to [Charles Jean-Baptiste Sanson](https://anilist.co/character/131350/Sanson-CharlesJeanBaptiste) and Jeanne-Gabrielle Berger Sanson. Her looks are considered to be too unladylike as she tends to style her sun-blond hair in buzzcut and undercut styles. Usually shaving left side of her head or both sides. She even completely shaved her hair once. Despite her tomboyish appearance Marie is considered as a very beautiful young woman with blonde hair and piercing blue eyes. She has strong physical resemblance to her older brother Charles-Henri Sanson. ~!Marie becomes a Prévôté de L'hôtel at the age of 11. wiki_extract: 成为小说家吧（日語：小説家になろう／しょうせつかになろう，羅馬化：Shōsetsuka ni Narō）是日本的一個用戶生成內容網站，由株式会社HINA PROJECT所營運。登錄為作者即可在其上公開發表免費小說。 == 概要 == 該網站為刊載大量作品的小說投稿網站。 和其他同類網站相比，有著可輕鬆在網頁上寫作，及手機也可使用（寫作或閱讀）的特點。 投稿作品可於閱讀網站讀小說吧（小説を読もう）（一般向作品、PC使用）、讀小說（小説を読む）（一般向作品、手機使用）、LoveNovel（ラブノベ）（戀愛小說、手機使用）、NocturneNovels（ノクターンノベルズ）（男性向18禁小說、PC手機皆可使用）、MoonLightNovels（ムーンライトノベルズ）（女性向18禁小說、PC手機皆可使用）瀏覽。文章會根據執筆者投稿時設定的類別、年齡限制自動分區。 === 二次創作 === 開站初期接受了大量二次創作作品，出於著作權方對二次創作加強限制的要求，於2010年8月設立網站二次Fan（にじファン）（二次創作、PC使用）、NOS（二次創作、手機使用）。 但由於著作權方對二次創作加強限制的要求不斷，最終於2012年3月15日，公告將刪除明令禁止二次創作作品之相關作（同年4月9日起逐步實施）。最終於2012年7月15日關閉二次Fan等網站，更變為除運營側許可的少量作品之外，禁止一切二次創作投稿的模式。 === 針對刪減版進行刪除 === 2016年6月開始變更使用規範，針對已出版書籍後的不完整版本進行刪除。 === 其他 === 由於手機版書庫功能的使用率下降，該服務於2019年1月29日終止。 == 主要功能 == 可投稿、閱讀連載小說 收藏小說、獲取其更新信息（需註冊登錄） 發表對作品的評論、感想 與縱書小說網（タテ書き小説ネット）（PC使用）合作，可將小說轉換為縱書PDF（刊載中的小說） 可下載小說的TXT檔 註冊用戶間可發送私信 可使用旁註標記（假名標注）功能。 與畫像網站Mitemin（みてみん）合作，实现设置插画功能。 == 作品一覽 == 中文版已出版書目 == 累計排名作品 == 以下為小說作家吧公布累計閱覽前一百名的作品，並隱藏一百零一名以下的名單，幾乎都是已文庫化的有名小說。排名會隨時變化（此排名為2026年10月初變更，往後每個月初更新排名）。 == 影像化作品 == === 動畫化作品 === ==== 電視動畫 ==== ==== 劇場動畫 ==== ==== Web動畫 ==== === 動畫化預定（含企劃階段） === === 真人化作品 === == 批評 == 自2016年Re:從零開始的異世界生活動畫取得空前成功後，「成為小說家吧」逐漸成為動畫化的主要來源之一，雖然不乏知名作品，但大部份輕改動畫，不論是劇情還是畫風都過於千篇一律引發部份動畫迷不滿，蔑稱「成為小說家吧」為動畫廁紙製造機，而「なろう系」亦成為了這一類型小說的代稱。 == 相關條目 == 異世界 (日本作品類型)：该平台中最常见的作品题材 這本WEB小說真厲害！ 網路作家 網路小說 小說投稿網站 == 注釋 == == 參考文獻 == == 外部連結 == 成為小說家吧（日語） 讀小說吧（日語） 成為小說家吧的X（前Twitter）账号 YouTube上的成為小說家吧【官方】頻道

title: My Broken Mariko
title_original: マイ・ブロークン・マリコ
description: Tomoyo Shiino has stood by her friend Mariko through years of abuse, abandonment, and depression. However horrific her circumstances, their friendship has been the one reassuring constant in Mariko's life-and Tomoyo's too. That is, until Tomoyo is utterly blindsided by news of Mariko's death. In life, Tomoyo felt powerless to help her best friend out of the darkness that ultimately drove her over the edge. Now, Tomoyo is determined to liberate Mariko's ashes for one final journey together... to set free her dear, broken Mariko. (Source: Yen Press) Notes: - Includes the one-shot "YISKA". - includes the extra "Home Sweet Home!".
wiki_extract: 《假面騎士MY-TH》（日語：仮面ライダーマイス），是由日本東映製作的《假面騎士系列》第8部令和系列特攝作品，亦是《假面騎士系列》誕生55週年紀念作品，於2026年（令和8年）9月6日起每週日上午9時（JST）在朝日電視台首播。 == 作品特色 == 為《令和假面騎士系列》第八部作品，亦為《假面騎士系列》誕生55週年紀念作品。 為《假面騎士系列》首部以「神話」作為主要題材的作品。「MY-TH（マイス）」一詞即蘊含神話之意，描寫主角逐漸成為神話般存在的過程。 敵對組織以生肖地支為概念設計，並添加「貓」取代「鼠」位置的設定。 繼《假面騎士ZEZTZ》後，主角假面騎士的驅動器同樣採用配戴於胸前的設計。此外，本作也是《假面騎士系列》首度引入「胸前驅動器」與「腰部驅動器」互相對決之設定的作品。 為荒川稔久繼《假面騎士空我》之後，時隔26年第二度為假面騎士電視劇擔任主要編劇人員。 繼《假面騎士Fourze》、《假面騎士REVICE》、《假面騎士GOTCHARD》之後，設定女主角為學生。 == 故事簡介 == 很久很久以前，守護人類免於「不可思議」襲擊的十二支同盟，為了迎接與它們的決戰而陷入長達百年的沉睡。 時至今日，身為瑞生家專屬Meister的音澄宙，為了瑞生家的千金大小姐瑞生優菜，變身成假面騎士 MY-TH，投身於與「不可思議」的戰鬥中。 圍繞著「不可思議」，宙與十二支同盟產生衝突與對立。全新的假面騎士神話，就此揭開序幕。 == 設定 == === 背景 === 不可思議事件研究會（不可思議事件研究会） 瑞生優菜於天櫻學園高等部創立的社團，專門調查該怪物「不可思議」引發的事件，和研究、對抗此怪物。 十二支同盟（十二支同盟） 本作的敵對組織，為守護人類避免受到「不可思議」襲擊的組織，現首領為嶺高華武利。 成員為100年前的大正時代生活的人，因沉睡100年後於現代甦醒，衣著與現代人有所差異。 十二支同盟本部設施的設計由田嶋秀樹所創作。 === 用語 === X蛋（エグズ，X-EGGS） 封入各式各樣生物力量的蛋型道具，本作假面騎士的變身道具。 分為寄宿兩種生物力量的駕馭X蛋（ライドエグズ，RIDE X-EGGS），和寄宿一種生物力量的物種X蛋（シードエグズ，SEED X-EGGS）。 駕馭X蛋（ライドエグズ，RIDE X-EGGS） 凝縮生物誕生情報的未知道具，在MY-TH驅動器上使用可取用內部所包含的生物資訊。 存在著複數同種的道具，為了保持力量的平衡，內部同時包含表、裏兩種生物資訊，但「裏之力」的發動條件目前尚不明確。 物種X蛋（シードエグズ，SEED X-EGGS） 凝縮生物誕生情報的未知道具，在MY-TH驅動器上使用可取用內部所包含的生物資訊。 存在著複數同種的道具，擁有完全使用後會消滅此道具的特性。 不可思議（不可思議，FUKASHIGI） 本作的怪人，會捕食人類的未知生命體。 每個個體體內存在著複數顆物種X蛋。 == 登場角色 == == 登場假面騎士 == === 假面騎士MY-TH === 變身者：音澄宙（替身演員：中田裕士、CV：秋谷郁甫） 原文：仮面ライダーマイス / Kamen Rider MY-TH 名稱由來：老鼠和神話的變體詞。 形態 === 假面騎士DATT === 變身者：DATT（替身演員：宮澤雪、CV：安藤奈奈子） 原文：仮面ライダーダット / Kamen Rider DATT 名稱由來：脫兔。 形態 === 假面騎士RID === 變身者：麻尾達臣（替身演員：永德、CV：安宅波颯） 原文：仮面ライダーリド / Kamen Rider RID 名稱由來：狸奴，同時擁有「除去」的意思。 形態 === 假面騎士JYAO === 變身者：JYAO（替身演員：縄田雄哉、CV：坪倉康晴） 原文：仮面ライダージャオ / Kamen Rider JYAO 名稱由來：蛇王。 形態 === 假面騎士VANKEN === 變身者：VANKEN（替身演員：永德、CV：岩永丞威） 原文：仮面ライダーヴァンケン / Kamen Rider VANKEN 名稱由來：日文詞彙「番犬」。 形態 === 假面騎士MUTN === 變身者：MUTN（替身演員：宇佐見紗風、CV：長谷川霞） 原文：仮面ライダームトン / Kamen Rider MUTN 名稱由來：法文綿羊的變體詞。 形態 === 假面騎士MAOU === 變身者：嶺髙華武利（替身演員：繩田雄哉、CV：東啓介） 原文：仮面ライダーマオウ / Kamen Rider MAOU 名稱由來：貓和日文魔王的變體詞。 形態 == 輔助工具 == === 變身道具 === MY-TH驅動器（マイスドライバー，MY-TH DRIVER） 音澄宙和十二支同盟成員所使用的變身腰帶。音澄宙為繫於胸前使用；十二支同盟成員則繫於腰上，並搭配帶扣使用。 能激發出裝填的駕馭X蛋和物種X蛋所蘊含的力量。 切誕帶扣（スラッシュボーンバックル，SLASH BORN BUCKLE） MY-TH驅動器的形質轉換裝置，假面騎士DATT和假面騎士TIGRE所使用的帶扣。 裝置在MY-TH驅動器上來控制力量，以圓鋸切割裝填的駕馭X蛋和物種X蛋來強制釋放所蘊含的力量。 錘誕帶扣（ハンマーボーンバックル，HAMMER BORN BUCKLE） MY-TH驅動器的形質轉換裝置，假面騎士RID和黑色假面騎士MY-TH所使用的帶扣。 裝置在MY-TH驅動器上來控制力量，以鐵錘敲擊裝填的駕馭X蛋和物種X蛋來強制釋放所蘊含的力量。 咬誕帶扣（バイトボーンバックル，BITE BORN BUCKLE） MY-TH驅動器的形質轉換裝置，假面騎士JYAO和假面騎士MUTN所使用的帶扣。 裝置在MY-TH驅動器上來控制力量，以尖牙咬碎裝填的駕馭X蛋和物種X蛋來強制釋放所蘊含的力量。 射誕帶扣（ショットボーンバックル，SHOT BORN BUCKLE） MY-TH驅動器的形質轉換裝置，假面騎士KEI和假面騎士VANKEN所使用的帶扣。 裝置在MY-TH驅動器上來控制力量，以射擊貫穿裝填的駕馭X蛋和物種X蛋來強制釋放所蘊含的力量。 MAOU驅動器（マオウドライバー，MAOU DRIVER） 假面騎士MAOU的形質轉換裝置。 從四個裝置發出紅蓮之炎來部分解放裝填的駕馭X蛋和物種X蛋所蘊含的力量，當四道火焰合而為一時，可從而高效提取出生物誕生時所擁有的爆發性能量。 === 專屬武裝 === MY-TH刀（マイスエッジ，MY-TH EDGE） 假面騎士MY-TH的可變武器，能變形為切斬者和射擊者兩種模式。 以吸收MY-TH驅動器供給的能量，進行量子收束後形成光刀或產生光彈。 兔子劍（ラビットソード，RABBIT SWORD） 假面騎士DATT的武器。 劍身輕量且獨特形狀，能在一擊攻擊中造成多次斬擊。 蛇鐮（スネークサイズ，SNACK SCYTHE） 假面騎士JYAO的武器。 特殊形狀的刀身，能像纏繞著目標般施展斬擊。透過投擲會產生升力與陀螺效應，也能夠像迴旋標一樣使用。 犬銃（ドッグガン，DOG GUN） 假面騎士VANKEN的武器。 ​銃身透過能量的充填量與速度，能夠交替運用從長距離精密射擊到近距離連射等各種射擊方式。 綿羊鐵錘（シープハンマー，SHEEP HAMMER） 假面騎士MUTN的武器。 擁有極高的硬度與沉重的質量，具備足以將傷害滲透至內部的威力。 MAOU劍（マオウブレイド，MAOU BLADE） 假面騎士MAOU的武器，可借與其他十二支成員使用。 將能量瞬間收束，可從銃口射出光彈，也可從刀刃使出纏繞著爆發性破壞力的斬擊。 === 其他道具 === MY-TH手機（マイスフォン，MY-TH PHONE） 音澄宙使用的通訊裝置。 除了有基本通訊功能外，也有識別駕馭X蛋和物種X蛋的功能。 報信貓頭鷹（ホーコクロウ，HOKOKUROU） 十二支同盟的秘密情報報告機械。 各成員將收集的情報或物品，秘密進行報告時所使用的裝置。在裝上物種X蛋後會具備飛行功能。 === 載具 === === X蛋（X-EGGS） === RIDE X-EGGS一覽 其他RIDE X-EGGS一覽 SEED X-EGGS一覽 == 製作團隊 == 原作：石之森章太郎 編劇：荒川稔久 導演：中澤祥次郎、田﨑龍太、葉山康一郎、杉原輝昭、柴﨑貴行
