Has a short cameo appearance in chapter 2 of Kotonoha no Miko to Kotodama no Mahou to. Also appears in chapter 1 of Iono-sama Fanatics when Eto and Iono meet at the Amber Teahouse.

characters.name: Sarasa Kotoori
characters.description: Kotoori Sarasa is 17 years old and an ordinary high school student. She likes black tea, as well as the Amber Teahouse and its proprietor, and has started working part-time there. She's serious and precise. She's good at taking care of others, and can't abandon a person when she sees they're in trouble. She worries about that aspect of her personality though. (Source: Character Introductions, Page 02, Chapter 01, Ameiro Kouchakan Kandan)

characters.name: Haru Shishio
characters.description: A friend of Sarasa's, and regular customer at the Amber Teahouse. She's 17 years old, and in her second year of high school. She loves having a blast with people, and teasing serious people. To her, Sarasa is both easy prey and a friend she quarrels with. She runs a website about jinxes. (Source: character introductions, chapter 1)

characters.name: Hinoka Shiratori
characters.description: A friend of Sarasa's, and regular customer at the Amber Teahouse. She's 16 years old, and in her second year of high school. She loves people she can have a blast with, and she enjoys watching Sarasa and Haru trade jibes. She constantly has a smile on her face, and she has a lot of friends. Her hobby is do-it-yourself carpentry; she's so good, she could put a professional to shame. (Source: character introductions, chapter 1)

characters.name: Sumire Amekawa
characters.description: A friend of Seriho's from high school. She studying cooking in France, and has a girlfriend. She's a go-getter and she's very responsible.

characters.name: Shiiko Nanjou
characters.description: A regular customer at the Amber Teahouse. It seems, that she's interested in Manaka's manga, as well as in Manaka herself.

characters.name: Manaka Saotome
characters.description: A mangaka and a regular customer at the Amber Teahouse.

title: HEN
description: Despite the title, Hen is NOT Hentai. It does have sex, strong language, yuri, and other elements that might make you think "Hentai". Chizuru Yoshida is not your typical high schooler and she's all too aware of it! She has a talent with getting what she wants from her male lovers and often comes across as cold and manipulative... In truth, despite her experiences with guys, she has never been in love. That's until the fateful arrival of newly-trasferred student, Azumi Yamada, at her school. It was love at first site for Chizuru--indeed an unexpected turn of events for the story's vixen! Not only was she in love but with all things another girl. Chizuru goes through a brief stage of anger and denial and tries to convince herself that she couldn't possibly be attracted to such a simple-looking, shy, and naive girl! To her despair she finds herself constantly thinking of Azumi, so she finally resolves to become friends with her, but it's not too long when she starts to push things along with Azumi... (Source: Manga Project)

characters.name: Chizuru Yoshida
characters.description: A beautiful and perfect student that excels in everything she does, Chizuru is every man's dream and she knows it. Playing men for whatever she wants, the young high school model has a great life until she meets her current fling's new neighbors. Instantly Chizuru, a girl who has never known love, falls heavily for the young female neighbor, Azumi Yamada. Chizuru, refusing to admit it at first, quickly comes to realize she must be with Azumi at any cost. Now living with her fake boyfriend, Hiroyuki, just one apartment away from Azumi, she puts forth every effort to constantly be around her crush. (wikipedia)

characters.name: Azumi Yamada
characters.description: Azumi is an innocent and average looking young high school girl. However, after moving from Kyushu to a new city and new apartment complex she meets Chizuru. At first the friendly Azumi tries to be nice to Chizuru, only to be harshly rejected. Eventually though, the two become friends, although Azumi fears that there might be something weird about Chizuru. Azumi, who wishes to become a screenwriter, one day attempts to join the drama club. There she befriends a young, amateur film maker named Ryuichi Kobayashi.

characters.name: Hiroyuki
characters.description: A young Japanese rockstar, living in his parents mansion (a large Japanese apartment considered to be more like a suite) and on their money, he was yet another fling of the beautiful Chizuru. However, when his new neighbors moved in with their daughter Azumi Yamada, Chizuru quickly claimed him as her boyfriend. Hiroyuki, realizing that Chizuru has a crush on Azumi, but truly believing that she loves him, has formed a plan to seduce and sleep with Azumi, ruining her for Chizuru. (Wikipedia)

characters.name: Sushiaki Karasawa
characters.description: Karasawa, who appears as the main character for several of the opening chapters, is a new teacher at Chizuru's high school. He quickly falls in love with her after recognizing her as a model. After a little effort, Karasawa is able to trick Chizuru into admitting she is a model, infuriating her. She then convinces Karasawa to let her sleep at his apartment for the night, where she enacts vengeance through teasing him to some degree or another throughout the night.

title: Twin Milf
description: Shinji Kanou is madly in love with his older married neighbour, Yumi Mishima. One day Yumi suddenly comes onto Shinji leaving him confused. The next day, he meets Yumi with her single twin sister, Nami.

characters.name: Shinji Kanou
characters.description: Shinji is the main character of the series. He has a crush on his upstairs neighbour Yumi.

characters.name: Yumi Mishima
characters.description: Yumi is Shinji's upstairs neighbour. She is a married woman who is the mother of a small child. She has a twin sister named Nami. Her maiden name is Yumi Ootake.

characters.name: Nami Ootake
characters.description: Nami is Yumi's twin sister. She is single, not a mother, and more adventurous. She moves in with her sister to help take care of the new baby, Yumi's nephew.

characters.name: Eriko
characters.description: Eriko is Naoto's flatchested girlfriend

characters.name: Mimiko Kimori
characters.description: Mimiko is a DVD starlet that Takazaki was focused on prior to the twins.

characters.name: Tatsuhiro Mishima
characters.description: Yumi's husband. He is often away. Yumi believes her husband is less attracted to her due to gaining pregnancy weight and having her already large breasts get even bigger. Yumi's sister Nami comments that she suspects Yumi's husband is a lolicon for not wanting her more.

characters.name: Ayu Mishima
characters.description: Ayu is the baby of Mr. Mishima and Yumi.

characters.name: Fumiko Miyagashi
characters.description: Fumiko is a teacher from a technical school that Takazaki was focused on prior to the twins.

characters.name: Naoto
characters.description: Naoto is Shinji's friend and Eriko's boyfriend. He briefly joined a large breast appreciation club, which upset his girlfriend, as she is flat.

characters.name: Takazaki
characters.description: Takazaki is a pedestrian at the end of chapter 7 who gets flashed by the twins.

title: Last Gender: Nanimono demo Nai Watashitachi
title_original: ラストジェンダー ～何者でもない私たち～
title_en: Last Gender: When We Are Nameless
description: Welcome to BAR California, a place for you to reveal your true self. People of different genders, propensities, and sexual orientations gather at a certain chic bar that's hidden from the public eye. While some come in search of themselves, others step into the establishment looking for sex and love. There are as many sexualities as there are people, and the patrons' stories intertwine as they struggle to find happiness. A bisexual trans woman who's been hurt by the voices of others wishes she had a "normal" relationship; a married, middle-aged salaryman secretly expresses his female side; and a pansexual cis guy is on the lookout for true love. (Source: Kodansha USA) Note: Includes the pilot one-shot "Watashi Ki, Oriori to (A Self for All Seasons)".

title: Ojou-sama wa Love Kome no Shujinkou ni Naritai!
title_original: お嬢様はラブコメの主人公になりたい！
description: Tsubaki Saionji is a second-year high school girl. Despite her grace and elegance, she hides an embarrassing secret - she absolutely loves mindless ecchi harem love comedies, and always wants to be in the protagonist’s shoes.

title: Joshi Daisei ga Goukon de Onee-san ni Mochikaerareru Hanashi
title_original: 女子大生が合コンでお姉さんに持ち帰られる話
description: College girl Kawada Rika gets roped into going to a mixer where she meets an older girl named Suda Natsuko and they are immediately enamored with each other. Notes: - Initially self published until chapter 13 and later serialized on Line Manga. - Includes 3 extra chapters.

title: 1×1/2: Ichi to Nibun no Ichi
title_en: 1 x ½ - My Half of You
description: Asuka is your almost typical teenage girl. She studies hard in school, gossips with her friends, and does her chores. The one thing that makes her different from everyone else is her crush. She's in love with someone close to her. Her mother. (Source: Sekai Project)

title: Renai Idenshi XX
description: A sci-fi story set in a future where men have died off. Women have been divided into two groups: Adams and Eves. Each has a set role in society. The protagonist, an Adam, has just entered Kingdom Academy. Romantic relationships between Adams are forbidden there, so I'm sure you can all guess where this is going... (Source: Lililicious)

characters.name: Aoi Koshiro
characters.description: "The new student: our hero." A new student who despite entering a month late, has shown superiority in both intelligence and physical skill, overwhelming those around her. She has the kind of personality that hates to lose.

characters.name: Sakura Kokonoe
characters.description: "The beautiful star of the academy." An academy student in the same year as Aoi and the second child of the current prime minister. With extraordinary reflexes and excellent grades, she is the school's top star.

characters.name: Mizuki Hyuuga
characters.description: "The tacturn sutdent in the same year." In the same class as Sakura, she has known Sakura and Matsuri since they were small children. Although she has a cool attitude and doesn't say much, she speaks up clearly if she thinks something is wrong.

characters.name: Matsuri Nanaho
characters.description: "The frivolous head of the dorm." Sakura and Mizuki's classmate. She is the head of the "Abel Dorm" that Aoi and company live in. She can get a bit carried away with things and also loves to joke around, but basically she is good at taking care of people.

characters.name: Ran Ebine
characters.description: A two stars etoile. It is implied 'he' is always late to meetings.

characters.name: Erika Suzuran
characters.description: She's Sakura's fiancée and Aoi's rival.

characters.name: Klara Hiroma
characters.description: An upbeat girl whose favorite food is meat.

characters.name: Momiji Yamato
characters.description: A shy girl who has a crush on Aoi.

title: RWBY: Official Manga Anthology
description: Ruby may be team leader, but she's got insecurities just like the rest of us. In fact, her worries run deep. These stories show how Ruby overcomes her shortcomings to be a true hero—and what drives her to do it! From a team of exciting new manga artists comes the first volume in a series of short story collections showcasing Ruby, Weiss, Blake and Yang! (Source: VIZ Media) Volume 1 "Red Like Roses" (2017/5/19) #Cover Illustration: Ein Lee #Illustrations: Izumi Sai, Esu, Miou Shiki, Tsukasa, Omutatsu 1. In the Case of the Hero - monorobu 2. Hunter Taru Mono (ハンターたるもの, As a Hunter ) - Ritsu Hayami 3. Dakara, Watashi wa Koko ni Iru. (だから、私はここにいる。, That Is Why I'm Here ) - Kuma 4. RWBY to Ruby (RWBYとルビー, RWBY and Ruby ) - KaTe 5. Akazukin, Minna de Fukushuu, Kowakunai (あかずきん、みんなでふくしゅう、こわくない, Who's Afraid of Little Red Riding Hood If We All Attack At Once? ) - Xily 6. Ruby's Note - Uri 7. Bara no Namae (薔薇の名前, Name of the Rose ) - Sora 8. Chocolate Chip Cookies - Amaya 9. Aibou (相棒, Partner ) - Mikanuji 10. Hair Like Rose. - Moromoimaru 11. Koi no Kajitsu wo Motomeshi Akazukin (恋の果実を求めし赤ずきん, Little Red Riding Hood Seeks the Fruit of Love ) - Kaogeimoai 12. Change! (ちぇんじ!) - Koko Siguma

characters.name: Weiss Schnee
characters.description: Weiss Schnee is a student of Beacon Academy and one of the four members of team RWBY. The heiress of the vastly influential Schnee Dust Company, Weiss made her first appearance in the "White" Trailer. After enrolling in Beacon against the wishes of her father, she becomes a member of Team RWBY alongside [Ruby Rose](https://anilist.co/character/126569/Ruby-Rose), [Blake Belladonna](https://anilist.co/character/132314/Blake-Belladonna), and [Yang Xiao Long](https://anilist.co/character/132223/Yang--Xiao-Long). Her weapon of choice is a Multi Action Dust Rapier (MADR) named Myrtenaster.

characters.name: Ruby Rose
characters.description: Ruby Rose is a student of Beacon Academy and the main protagonist of RWBY. She first appeared in the "Red" Trailer visiting the grave of her deceased mother, Summer Rose. After an invitation from Headmaster [Ozpin](https://anilist.co/character/268340/Ozpin) following an altercation with [Roman Torchwick](https://anilist.co/character/133837/Roman-Torchwick), Ruby attends Beacon Academy in order to become a Huntress. During her time at Beacon, she becomes the leader of Team RWBY, consisting of herself, [Weiss Schnee](https://anilist.co/character/126143/Weiss-Schnee), [Blake Belladonna](https://anilist.co/character/132314/Blake-Belladonna), and her half-sister [Yang Xiao Long](https://anilist.co/character/132223/Yang--Xiao-Long). Ruby's weapon of choice is her High-Caliber Sniper-Scythe known as Crescent Rose.

characters.name: Yang  Xiao Long
characters.description: Yang is the half-sister of [Ruby Rose](https://anilist.co/character/126569/Rose-Ruby), a member of team RWBY, and a huntress in training at Beacon academy. She claims to be a thrill seeker and states that is the main reason she is a huntress. One of her current, and biggest goals, is finding her mother who went missing shortly after Yang was born.

characters.name: Blake Belladonna
characters.original: ブレイク・ベラドンナ
characters.description: Blake is a fair skinned young woman with amber eyes and long, black hair. A ribbon is tied with a large bow on the top of her head, which acts as a cover for her Faunus heritage and disguises her black cat ears. She wears purple eyeshadow in catseye style. She wears a black buttoned vest with coattails and a single silver button on the front. Underneath this is a white, sleeveless, high necked, crop undershirt and white shorts with a zipper on the front of each leg, emblazoned with the YKK logo of the real-life Japanese zipper manufacturer. She also wears black low-heeled boots and full stockings with a color gradation of black to purple at her ankles. Her emblem is visible on the outside of both thighs just below her shorts in white. On her left arm is a detached sleeve with a silver cuff around her bicep, and black ribbons are wrapped around both forearms. A small, loose scarf is wrapp

characters.name: Adam Taurus
characters.description: One of the Main antagonists for two of the Main characters, Blake and Yang. His first appearance being in vol 2 when Cinder tries to get him to join her force. Later in Vol 3 makes a come back where he encounters two of the main characters. Becoming a huge part in Volumes 4 through 6.

characters.name: Pyrrha Nikos
characters.description: Pyrrha is a student of Beacon Academy, and a member of Team JNPR. She is a composed and collected individual who, despite being a celebrity, is modest and patient around other people, making her very sociable. Additionally, she tends to be quite formal. In addition to her impressive strength and vast range of combat abilities, she is a quick thinker, knowing her limits and assessing her opponents before acting. Her weapon of choice, called Miló, is a red-and-bronze spear-like weapon that can transform into a rifle or a short sword. She uses this alongside a shield called Akoúo̱, which resembles a classic hoplon. Pyrrha takes her studies and relationships equally seriously, making her a bit stubborn and emotionally sensitive. This comes from her loyalty toward her friends as well as her good intent. She is always willing to keep secrets and help friends in need, and is selfless and righte

characters.name: Roman Torchwick
characters.original: ローマン・トーチウィック
characters.description: Roman Torchwick is the cunning and charismatic leader of a band of thieves who operated in the city of Vale. He is a subordinate of [Cinder Fall](https://anilist.co/character/132316/Cinder-Fall), who had given him the mission to steal all of the Dust in the city, and later, a business partner of the White Fang. He often works alongside his associate, [Neopolitan](https://anilist.co/character/165118/Neopolitan). A robbery lead by Roman was thwarted by [Ruby Rose](https://anilist.co/character/126569) at the beginning of the story and he developed a deep resentment towards her for this.

characters.name: Jaune Arc
characters.description: __Race:__ Human __Weapon:__ Crocea Mors __Height:__ 185 cm Jaune Arc is a former student at Beacon Academy, the leader and one of the remaining members of Team JNPR, and a member of Team RNJR. His weapon of choice is Crocea Mors, which is a sword and a sheath that can expand into a shield. The weapon was handed down in his family from his great-great-grandfather, who used it to fight in the Great War.

characters.name: Nora Valkyrie
characters.original: ノーラ・ヴァルキリー
characters.description: __Weapon:__ Magnhild __Height:__ 155 cm Nora Valkyrie is a former student at Beacon Academy, a member of Team JNPR, and formerly Team RNJR, and one of the remaining members of Team JNPR. Her weapon of choice is Magnhild, a hammer that can transform into a grenade launcher.

characters.name: Lie Ren
characters.description: __Race:__ Human __Weapons:__ StormFlower, Father's Dagger __Height:__ 175 cm Lie Ren, more commonly referred to by his last name Ren, is a former student at Beacon Academy, a member of Team RNJR and one of the remaining members of Team JNPR. His weapons of choice are a pair of green, fully automatic pistols with sickle-like blades attached vertically under the barrels, named StormFlower.

characters.name: Penny Polendina
characters.original: ペニー・ポレンディーナ
characters.description: __Height:__ 165cm A mysterious girl who met [Ruby](https://anilist.co/character/126569/Ruby-Rose) while out on the town and is an admirer of hers. She has amazing abilities such as manipulating a large amount of swords as well as emitting high-power energy blasts.

title: Annyeong Eunhaseyo
description: Joy, an art teacher, has difficulty finding any solace in her life. She has never been at ease with her neighborhood, her family, or her job, and is always packed up and ready to go somewhere, but is always held back by life. Things start switching around with the appearance of an old crush, Aerie, who was the first breath of fresh air in her otherwise smothering life. Baby steps for the both of them, as they discover the value of companionship, proper relationships, and ultimately, a way to a truly Joyful Life! (Source: Pocket Comics)

title: Skeeter Rabbit!!
description: Usa Ayano is a middle-school girl who is kinda-sorta bad at physical activities. One day at gym class, she sees another girl in her grade, Hoshihara Chika, a transfer student who muddles through the dancing lesson like she couldn't care less. Ayano, intrigued by how mysterious Chika is, tries to approach the new girl, but gets pushed away. That is until she later discovers Chika's secret... Uran of the "Mujaki no Rakuen" fame brings you a story bringing together youth, JCs and dancing!

title: Bad Girl
description: What does one do when you have a crush on the president of the public morals club? Well, if you're first-year high school student Yuu, the answer is turning to a life of delinquency! In a bid for the president's heart, Yuu becomes a self-described "bad girl" hoping to thrill and excite her crush. But Yuu's adorableness (despite her best efforts) outshines any attempts to come off otherwise-and the president can't see past that tiny, adorable exterior. What's a girl got to do to get in trouble around here?! (Source: Yen Press)

characters.name: Yuu Yuutani
characters.description: A first year student with perfect attendance, good grades, and even the respect of teachers. However, in order to get the attention of her beloved [Atori](https://anilist.co/character/354134/Atori-Mizutori) she acts as a poor imitation of a rule breaker. Her poor acting skills make her behave suspiciously when talking to Atori.

characters.name: Atori Mizutori
characters.description: A third year student who is admired by everyone both inside and outside of school. Some people have even begun to see her as a god-like figure. She is the head of the moral committee at school, but often acts eccentrically. She thinks of [Yuu]( https://anilist.co/character/354133/Yuu-Yuutani) like a small animal.

characters.name: Suzu Suzukaze
characters.description: A first year student and [Yuu's](https://anilist.co/character/354133/Yuu-Yuutani) childhood friend. Her poor eyesight makes her squint and she has naturally blonde hair so she is often mistaken for a delinquent. She often doesn't take Yuu seriously, but still cares about her and gives advice.

characters.name: Rura Ruriha
characters.description: A second year student who uses her cute appearance as a weapon in her career as a beauty YTuber and model. She is popular and well known, even declaring herself the idol of the school, but has no friends.

characters.name: Kiyoraka Sumiki
characters.description: A friend of [Atori](https://anilist.co/character/354134/Atori-Mizutori) and head of the library committee at school. She is a beautiful and intelligent honor student, but she is also secretly known as a lady killer.

characters.name: Mizuka Mizutori
characters.description: [Atori's](https://anilist.co/character/354134/Atori-Mizutori) younger sister and a 1st year student. She has communication issues and a severe sister complex, which makes her wary of [Yuu](https://anilist.co/character/354133/Yuu-Yuutani) suddenly befriending her sister.

characters.name: Maria Komari
characters.description: Kindergartner at a primary school visited by [Atori](https://anilist.co/character/354134/Atori-Mizutori) and [Yuu](https://anilist.co/character/354133/Yuu-Yuutani) during student council activities. Within 10 minutes of meeting Atori, she became a fan of her and forms the other kindergarten girls into an "Atori Daisuki Club."

title: MAKA-MAKA
description: Some of the chapters are just about sex, often in public places, but that isn't all Maka-Maka is about. It's about having someone who tells you your skin looks beautiful in the moonlight, someone who looks out for you and wants you to look out for yourself by having safe sex. It's about having someone who calls you the night of your birthday, when you're feeling down because you just slept with a guy who turned out to be a jerk, and thanks you for being born because she's so happy to have met you. What is Maka-Maka about? It's about Jun and Nene.

characters.name: Nene
characters.description: Nene is a cute, well-endowed girl raised from a rich family and was spoiled as a child, but she doesn't let her looks or her affluency affect her personality. The daughter of a successful banker, she has no trouble attracting people due to her good looks and her friendly personality. Although she makes male friends easily and has many of them, she has difficulty trusting men outside of relationships due to an experience when she asked an upperclassman to view her sketches. Instead of viewing the work that she had invested her time into creating, her upperclassman ignored them and came onto her. She explains that even though she had planned to have sex with him during their time together, she really wanted her work to be viewed, analyzed and possibly even appreciated. Nene is outwardly needier than Jun and has a great need for human contact. She tends to be laid-back and never really seek

characters.name: Jun Yokomizo
characters.description: Jun is the youngest child of a family with two boys and three girls. Because she was the youngest of a relatively large family, her father was a salary-man and she was often picked on by both her siblings and her peers, she then started to gain an independent, cocky and self-assured personality. She often told herself, "The idiots are just jealous because I'm a genius." Jun began smoking, attending nightclubs and having sex at a young age since it made her feel more like an artist and gave her a sense of self-worth. Even though some of the activities she engaged in would be considered degrading by most, she feels that as long as doing those activities gives her that sense of self-worth she will continue to do them. Like Nene, she has difficulty trusting people, but unlike Nene, this includes both men and women because she never really had anyone to confide in. Jun will continue to do wha

title: Pocha Climb!
description: Tsugumi is a high school girl trapped between her desire to lose weight and her love for doughnuts. She has an unexpected reunion with Aira, her childhood friend, and joins the bouldering club with her to rekindle their (more than?) friendship. Note: Includes 1 extra chapter.

title: marking
description: A doujin sequel by the original author of Can't Defy the Lonely Girl that tells the story of Ayaka and Sora after they graduated from high school and started living together.

characters.name: Ayaka Sakurai
characters.description: __Height:__ 157 cm She is a model student with top-of-the-class grades, but she suffers from anxiety during tests, causing her to attend a lower-level high school than she hoped for. She is the class representative and has an outgoing, quiet, and guarded personality. She adores baby chick dolls and has an entire collection in her room.

characters.name: Sora Honda
characters.description: __Height:__ 154 cm She's a student who was persuaded to return to school on the condition that "[Ayaka](https://anilist.co/character/183577/Sakurai-Ayaka) listens to one of her requests every day." She has a quiet, clever, and introverted personality.

title: Watashi ni Karada, Utte Minai?
title_en: Want to Sell Me Your Body?
description: "That makes a grand total of 100 thousand dollars." After Tsukasa's mom is killed in a car accident, her dad becomes addicted to drinking and gambling. One day, he disappears, leaving Tsukasa with a debt of 30 thousand dollars. There's no way a student like Tsukasa could get her hands on that much money! Eventually, debt collector Reiko shows up, inviting herself into Tsukasa's home and telling her to pay up. She offers the young girl a way of getting cash fast: by selling herself to Reiko. "Want to sell me your body?" Tsukasa agrees without really understanding what that entails, and when Reiko moves in with her, their relationship suddenly takes an unexpected turn... (Source: Renta!)

title: LALA
description: Xia Yuxun's presence at school never fails to draw attention. She has a mature beauty about her, always poised, and exuding confidence in class. Being admired so much by her classmates, one would think she's a well-respected senior but in truth, it might be because she's a repeat student. Xia Yuxun has more to her elegant facade. (Source: Webcomics)

characters.name: Fan Gao
characters.description: President of the Martial Arts Club and a childhood friend of Lan Ruoxi.

characters.name: Yilin Fan
characters.description: An ordinary girl in her second year of high school. She's a good student, kind and outgoing, trusting of other people.

characters.name: Ruoxi Lan
characters.description: She colors her hair red for a special reason. Member of the Martial Arts Club. Playful with her friends, she is reliable and strong.

title: Danshi Kinsei Game Sekai de Ore ga Yaru Beki Yuiitsu no Koto: Yuri no Aida ni Hasamaru Otoko Toshite Tensei Shite Shimaimashita
title_original: 男子禁制ゲーム世界で俺がやるべき唯一のこと　百合の間に挟まる男として転生してしまいました

title: Strawberry Panic!
title_original: ストロベリー・パニック！
description: The setting is lush Astraea Hill, where three famous all-girls schools are built. It's the first day of school, and the cherry blossoms are scattering to the ground. Nagisa meets Hanazono Shizuma, the top student in the school, and her breath is taken away by her beauty. But when Shizuma takes a liking to Nagisa, love and chaos soon follow... (Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

characters.name: Shizuma Hanazono
characters.description: __Height:__ 164 cm (5’5’’) The current Etoile, she is a highly respected and much beloved person to most of the other students attending the three schools. She looks very mysterious and also seems to have a number of secrets to match this visage. This makes her a difficult person to figure out or to even talk to for someone just meeting her. She is very skilled on the piano and likes to play it constantly. Much of the time, she doesn't enjoy the dull work of the Etoile, so she often finds ways to skip on her duties, much to the annoyance of Miyuki Rokujō. However, Nagisa manages to persuade Shizuma to resume performing her duties.

characters.name: Nagisa Aoi
characters.description: __Height:__ 155 cm (5’1’’) Nagisa suddenly transfers to an all-girls school called St. Miator Girl's Academy because her parents went overseas for work, leaving Nagisa behind. Nagisa ended up transferring to Miator after her aunt, who is a past graduate of St. Miator, the oldest school of Astraea Hill, recommended she attend. She seems to have a peppy personality, which can usually cause her to get in trouble if it gets the best of her. At first, whenever Nagisa gazed into the eyes of Shizuma Hanazono, she was unable to move at all, as if she was completely paralyzed. Later on, she seems to have developed a strong attraction towards Shizuma; the Etoile may very well be Nagisa's first love. Other things about her include that Nagisa is easily frightened, making her tremble at even the slightest mention of something scary. This continues the theme that she tends to be more childi

characters.name: Tamao Suzumi
characters.description: Tamao is first introduced as Nagisa's roommate. She plays a major role in this anime, as she eventually falls in love with Nagisa. She is shown as overcheerful and takes a large interest in Nagisa. Tamao has a nice, helpful personality and sometimes enjoys gossiping about other people when it comes to matters of love and attraction. Highly literate, she is a member of the Literature Club and loves to write poems. She writes the script for Astraea's adaption of Carmen. She is well-regarded among her fellow Miator students; many of the first-years see her as a viable Etoile candidate.

characters.name: Kaori Sakuragi
characters.description: Kaori Sakuragi was a young girl who came to attend Miator starting off in her first year. Ever since she was young, Kaori has been physically weak due to an affliction which remains unnamed, but apparently affected her breathing and possibly her heart. She had a placid personality, and dealt with her condition with surprisingly good grace.

characters.name: Miyuki Rokujo
characters.description: Miyuki is the student council president of Miator, Miyuki tries her best at doing her job in keeping everything in line. Often, when Shizuma is neglecting her duties as the Etoile, she gets annoyed at her and scolds her about it, which makes them seem more like a mother-child pair than as classmates. The two have been rooming together since they arrived at Miator years earlier, but their "parent-child" roles were initially reversed. Nevertheless, the two seem to be friends and have considerable knowledge of and insight into each other. After the death of Kaori Sakuragi, Miyuki became Shizuma's assistant and has remained a confidante of some importance. (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Chiyo Tsukidate
characters.description: Chiyo is a young girl who recently arrived at Astraea Hill, where she quickly became the "room temp" for Nagisa and Tamao, which incidentally is exactly what she wanted. Chiyo tends to be a very shy girl who is unable to articulate herself forcefully enough most of the time and is also rather a klutz. Additionally, she too seems to have a crush on Nagisa, which can also be construed as a form of admiration and idolism on her part. Also, she is a member of the Library Club and works as a librarian in Astraea's Library. (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Hikari Konohana
characters.description: A rather shy and quiet girl most of the time, Hikari tends to not be very outspoken and it usually takes a lot for her to say what is really on her mind. Much like Nagisa Aoi, Hikari is also a transfer student, ariving at Spica in the second year. In that same year, she joined the St. Spica Choir (also known as the Saintly Chorus) with her best friend and roommate Yaya Nanto. Later, she starts to develop a crush on Amane Ohtori, and they begin showing intense feelings of attraction for one another. Hikari also seems to be very religious and can be seen praying within the church or at the Spica fountain with a statue depicting the St. Virgin Mary on the school grounds. (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Yaya Nanto
characters.description: Hikari's roommate. She is a somewhat forceful girl who also seems to look out for Hikari, who she is in fact in love with. Yaya is good friends with Hikari though they've only known each other for about a year once the story begins. Yaya got Hikari to join the St. Spica Choir the previous year, most likely in an attempt to give her more self-esteem which she seems to be lacking in, though Hikari did show interest in singing as well. Yaya is one of the most talented members of the choir, as noted by Tsubomi Okuwaka, though seems to need more dedication, as noted by Hikari. She also has a rebellious side, sometimes going against school rules or what is normally accepted. However, when it comes to matters of love, she seems to be very shy about her feelings, substituing words with actions, sometimes with adverse results. Also, she rather dislikes first year students - such as Tsubomi Okuwak

characters.name: Amane Ootori
characters.description: Amane appears to be a very loved and respected member of the school, much like Shizuma Hanazono, although she is more of a local celebrity of Spica. She is often seen riding a white horse named Star Bright, which makes her seem more like a prince (a title which Shizuma later marks her with) from a fairy tale. Furthermore, she looks very much like a guy and in effect, a lot of the students at St. Spica are her fans. She tends to have a silent demeanor, which also makes her seem intimidating, making her difficult to talk with or approach. She too has a crush on Hikari, showing her affection much in the way a man does for a woman. Amane, much like Yaya, looks out for Hikari and protects her when need be. (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Tsubomi Okuwaka
characters.description: Tsubomi tends to act mature for her age, and is often capable of cowing senior students by pure force of personality. She also seems to have a crush on Hikari, although she calls it pure admiration. Also, she often lectures Hikari and Yaya when they do something wrong in regards to their school work and responsibilities. She is a member of the St. Spica Choir and it is believed that the reason she joined was because of Hikari, though Tsubomi denies this. There are some very faint indications that Tsubomi may be developing an interest in Yaya, later in the series. Tsubomi sometimes gets embarrassed when around Hikari due to either what Hikari says or of what others say. She tends to get angry or flustered easily, giving her an outspoken and very expressive personality. In effect, she can be loud in her opinions of others. (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Shion Tomori
characters.description: The student council president of Spica, she is a very shrewd girl and is constantly scheming something. However, despite her initial demeanor, she is moderate in personality and rather disinclined towards extreme measures and outright obstructionism. This is in contrast to her associates Kaname Kenjō and Momomi Kiyashiki. After the current Etoile graduates, she would like very much for an attendant of Spica to become the next Etoile and is constantly pushing for this to take place. Her best bet right now is to try to convince Amane Ohtori to consider the position. (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Kaname Kenjo
characters.description: Kaname is a very domineering, forceful, and devious girl who is also on the student council for Spica. She often likes to take matters into her own hands when Shion - or Kaname herself - doesn't get her way. Kaname apparently considers herself irresistible and has no interest in objections to the contrary. Much like Amane, her appearance and personality make her seem more masculine than feminine. She is later revealed to be jealous of Amane, who has effortlessly defeated her at everything since she first came to Spica. It is also suggested that she felt an attraction to Amane at one point, or at least that her self-comparison to Amane has become a central factor of her life. Her main friend and ally is Momomi Kiyashiki, who is very much like Kaname in personality. They share a sexual relationship and seem to be in love with each other. Together, they are the closest thing to antagonists

title: Hitozuma to JK
description: A housewife and her daughter's friend have a little affair. Will they be caught or will it end as just "sex-friends"?

characters.name: Hinata Kishino
characters.description: A high school girl who seduced Mitsuki. She likes to toy with Mitsuki with her cool attitude.

characters.name: Mizuki Haneda
characters.description: Married with a daughter in high school. By chance, she became involved in a relationship with her daughter's friend Hinata.

characters.name: Hazuki Haneda
characters.description: Mitsuki's daughter and a Hinata's friend. She is a bright and innocent high school girl.

characters.name: Sanae Tsukahara
characters.description: Part of Hinata's friend group.

characters.name: Yuri Mukai
characters.description: Part of Hinata's friend group; complete airhead.

characters.name: Mao
characters.description: Mizuki's high school friend, who is going through a divorce with her current husband.

title: Kimi Meku Yoru ni Kogarete
description: At Seiruri Girls School, there are two opposing factions: the "Ruri Gumi," made up of respectable young ladies, and the "Ai Gumi," made up of delinquents with questionable behavior. Among the Ai-gumi students, Nanase Mitsuki is the one most feared by the Ruri-gumi because of her fierce appearance. Nanase has mixed feelings about her reputation, until one night when she sees one of the good girls, Yuka Hosho, wandering the streets alone at night…? This is a sweet and fleeting love story between two people who can only meet at night. (Source: Comic Amble, translated)

title: Omoi no Kakera
description: Mika, a high school student, has no doubts that she is a lesbian, few people around her know that though. She works at a cafe admiring the owner (she only has a thing for older women after all) and visits bars in the gay district. This story presents her life in pieces: from acquiring a surprising friend to helping a married woman discover herself and experiencing disheartening early love. All the while Mika is the confident young adult woman with an impressively mature mind.

characters.name: Mika Takaoka
characters.description: Mika Takaoka is a 16-year-old high school student who works in a cafe. Confident and mature for her age, she is a lesbian, and surprisingly secure in her sexuality. Source: (MAL)

characters.name: Mayu Harada
characters.description: Mayu Harada is the younger of the two Harada siblings, and Mika's junior. ~!Mayu is initially portrayed as a homophobe who had already discovered that her older brother was gay; however, after meeting Mika, and as the story progresses, she realizes she is confused about her own sexuality, and eventually admits to being gay and having feelings for Mika.!~ ~!Later on in the manga, Mayu confesses to Mika and gets turned down, but develops a stronger - albeit platonic - relationship with her as a result.!~

characters.name: Yoshiwara Sayaka
characters.description: Yoshiwara Sayaka is Mika's childhood tutor. She was hired to help Mika study for her entrance exams. ~!When Mika fell in love with her and tried to kiss her in her sleep, she returned the kiss and later asked her why she did it. She proceeds to make regular advances at a flustered but lovestruck Mika, until Mika catches her with another man. Yoshiwara defends herself by saying she's "just having fun", to which Mika responds that she no longer needs a tutor. Later in the manga, she goes with her new girlfriend to Mika's school for their culture festival, and runs into Mika. They resolve their differences peacefully and go their separate ways.!~

title: SHWD
description: The year is 20XX. Tough but idealistic Koga has just joined the Tokyo branch of SHWD, the Special Hazardous Waste Disposal unit responsible for eradicating mysterious biological weapons that were left behind after the great war. Her mentor is Sawada, a woman with a powerful psyche who complements Koga’s physical prowess. Something is sizzling between the two of them, and it’s more than just a shared mission. Together, these two badass women must team up to confront horrors beyond their wildest nightmares. (Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: Shuangjing
description: In the Republic of China, famous Shanghainese author Xu Youyi has everything anyone could want—until the day an anonymous letter arrives, revealing the truth behind her perfect life. Betrayed by both her best friend and her husband, she meets Yan Wei, the outwardly cold but inwardly warm owner of a photography studio. They click instantly, both independent yet in harmony with one another. Growing closer in the turbulent dangers that surround them, the two different women soothe the scars within each other's heart. Will they be able to save each other? (Source: Kuaikan, translated) Note: Chapter count includes a prologue.

characters.name: Youyi Xu
characters.description: Shanghai's best-selling female author, a young and beautiful lady who married into nobility—a shanghai gentlewoman in both name and fact. ~!"Only after meeting you, did i understand what it means to hold true, unchangins feelings." "It's always been you protecting me. Now I want to protect you too."!~

characters.name: Wei Yan
characters.description: Mellow, reserved, indifferent, owner of a nondescript photography studio, in reality a retired assassin prodigy. Agile, with a rich amount of experience in fighting. ~!"I used to think that I didn't need feelings, until I met you..." "I feel like I've become stronger because of you, but also weaker because of you."!~

characters.name: Wan Zhang
characters.description: Xu Youyi's best friend.

characters.name: Heng Zhou
characters.description: Xu Youyi's husband.

title: Oshi no Bishoujo ni Kokuhakusareru Hanashi
title_original: 推しの美少女に告白される話
description: Yuzu's classmate Rika Sasaki is a cool and beautiful girl, and Yuzu idolizes and admires her. Yuzu was hoping to take advantage of entering high school to transform herself and become more fashionable. But she wasn't having any success on her own, so she asks Rika, her idol, to be her fashion guru. However... (Source: Amazon.jp, translated)

title: Ano Musume to Me ga Au Tabi Watashi wa: Shakaijin Yuri Anthology
title_original: あの娘と目が合うたび私は 社会人百合アンソロジー
title_en: Whenever Our Eyes Meet...: A Women's Love Anthology
description: For those who devote themselves to their careers, love sometimes has to take a back seat. Yet, it can strike when you least expect it, whether it's with a coworker or a kindred soul at the bar after hours. What will tomorrow bring? Whether it's romance, loss, regret, or just another day at the office, these are the stories of women who find love as they follow their dreams. 1) "Masking Lady" by Harukawa Haru 2) "The Women at a Certain Company" by Mikanuji 3) "Everyone's Missing Out" by irua 4) "Fish and Water" by Kanarashi 5) "Stopped Meter" by Seta Seta 6) "Waiting at the Blue Bells" by Kuwabara 7) "You did Well" by Saya Fuyume 8) "Head-to-ead Reunion! Flirty Battle" by Esu Esu 9) "Rainy Day-dream" by Tamamushi Oku 10) "Oblivious You" by Mizu Aso 11) "In My Studio-Apartment Palace" by Satsumaage 12) "Saccharine Beauty" by Suzuki Senpai 13) "I Want to Make my Workplace Senpai Moan!" by Kurukuruhime 14) "Hand-delivered Love Letter" by Yuki Yukiko (Source: Yen Press, edited)

title: Futanari no Elf
description: Daily life of a Futanari Elf.

title: Real demo Shiawase ni Shite Kudasai ne?
title_original: 現実世界でも幸せにしてくださいね？
description: High school girl Machino, who longs for the "love of destiny," loves to play the dating-sim game "Celestia." Despite maximizing the affection with all of the girls in the game, she can't decide on which one to choose for the confession event. After agonizing over the decision for days, an explosion occurs just as a shooting star flies over her house, and when Machino opens her eyes, she finds herself face to face with Sofia, the main heroine of Celestia.... "Machino... I always wanted to say it... I love you." An isekai summoning yuri harem romantic comedy begins, as her highly affectionate heroines jump into the real world! (Source: Ichijinsha, translated)

title: Strawberry Shake SWEET
title_original: ストロベリーシェイクSWEET
description: Sixteen-year-old pop culture idol Julia Tachibana takes in the new talent Ran as part of her job, but ends up falling for the other girl almost immediately. Slapstick fun, hijinks and other extremely humorous situations follow as Julia tries her best to woo Ran but remain a professional idol!

characters.name: Julia Tachibana
characters.description: The sixteen-year-old main character of the manga. She is one of the top talents in the company "Shanghai Talent Limited". Because of that, she was initially jealous of Ran's potential, but eventually she fell in love with Ran. She can be very stubborn, exuberant, delusional and difficult, much to the annoyance of her manager, Saeki. She has a strong work ethic, going so far as to ensure that her career is never compromised due to her personal life. This is something which Ran admires. Julia envisions herself to be a lecherous wolf who needs to stay away from Ran lest she confess or act on her feelings. She is later shocked to realise, much to nobody else's surprise, that she is extremely incompetent when it comes to doing anything to or with Ran. She laments that she is the more submissive between the two of them. She is the president and sole member of the "We l

characters.name: Ran Asakawa
characters.description: Another member of Shanghai Talent Limited, and she is also sixteen years old. Ran is very laid-back, sometimes to the point of appearing "out of it". She is not a quick thinker and is very naive and earnest. Her sweet, considerate nature makes Julia fall quickly in love with her. During her interactions with Julia, Ran becomes more enthusiastic and confident in herself, striving to be just as hard-working as her mentor. Much to everyone's bewilderment and Saeki's relief, Ran is completely oblivious to Julia's feelings. Tables are turned when Ran begins to wonder if she's in love with Julia herself, and she ironically agonizes over it much in the way Julia had when she first realized that she loved Ran. She is half foreign and her past is mysterious. Saeki refers to her as an "airhead". Ran however becomes very calm, suave and charming when she&#039

characters.name: Ryouko Saeki
characters.description: Julia's manager. She knows about Julia's romantic feelings toward Ran, and is often less than pleased with the awkward situations that those feelings often cause. She is normally calm, but Julia's outgoing attitude frustrates her to no end. Kaoru is in love with her, but Saeki sees those feelings as a nuisance. She is twenty-seven years old.

characters.name: Kaoru Shinjou
characters.description: The owner of the Picaresque Beauty Salon. Kaoru used to be the hairdresser for the band ZLAY and claimed that she had sexual relations with one of the members, much to Julia's horror. She is a playful person and likes to stir up trouble, often going out of her way to make Julia and Ran upset. She is rather shocked that Ran is dense enough not to have any idea Julia is crazily and intensely in love with her. She seems to have a thing for Saeki, though most of this might just be her teasing. Kaoru often makes advances on Saeki, but is always pushed away. She seems to have some sort of entanglement with one of her customers, Haruna, although she does this to mercilessly tease the younger girl who clearly has a crush on Kaoru. For some reason, both Julia and Ran come to her for advice, though it's never useful and it rarely ever makes them feel better. It seems that Kaoru is amused

characters.name: Haruna Enomoto
characters.description: Another member of Shanghai Talent Limited, and she is a year younger than Julia and Ran. She is in love with Kaoru, but Kaoru prefers just teasing her endlessly. Haruna is easily embarrassed and occasionally becomes jealous of anyone who receives attention from Kaoru.

characters.name: Megumi Sudou
characters.description: Sudou is Saeki's kouhai at work. She sometimes aids Julia if Saeki is unable to be at the young talent's side, such as the instance where Saeki gets sick and is unable to work. Despite her denial of it, she has an intense crush on Saeki and is often in contention for her affections with Kaoru, of whom she is extremely jealous.

characters.name: Ryou
characters.description: The vocalist and leader of the visual band ZLAY. Ryou first appears when Julia is agonising over keeping her feelings for Ran personally and professionally separate. She easily figures out that Julia is in love and in love with a girl. In fact, Ryou prides herself on having excellent gaydar. She is an intense flirt and a self-proclaimed lady killer, as in many flashbacks, she is always surrounded by groupies or fangirls. However, the entire main cast seems immune to her "charms" and mostly find her to be irritating. According to Ryou herself, she has slept with hundreds of women and need to moderate how many she sleeps with since she can't possibly do them all. She is rather blunt, much to the chagrin of Reki, and always thinks that she knows best. She enjoys making songs about women and yuri. Ryou is best known for showing up when she is least expected (and wanted).

characters.name: Rena Souma
characters.description: A model. She is rather rough, curt and hostile, especially to Sera, with whom she has a history. It turns out that Rena is very much in love with Sera but, unable to express herself and unsure what the feeling was, she ended up spurning the photographer and pushing her away. Rena eventually comes to express herself and is seen to still be very forceful and insistent and commanding towards Sera. The two end up getting together and start a relationship.

characters.name: Mutsuki Sera
characters.description: A photographer who works alongside Ran and used to work with Souma Rena. Sera turns out the be Ran's "stalker" but it turns out all she wanted to do was talk to Ran; Julia drop kicks her assuming that she wanted to attack Ran when all Sera was doing was reaching for her business card. She eventually becomes closer to the idols and starts to photograph Ran. Eventually, she and Ran become confidantes. Sera realises that Ran is very much in love with Julia despite the younger girl having no clue. Ironically, she has no idea that her strained relationship with Rena is a result of unspoken their love for one another. Sera eventually ends up dating Rena after they reconcile.

characters.name: Sai
characters.description: A guitarist for the band ZLAY. She seems to be closest with Ritsu, though the nature of their relationship is never made explicit. In a gag, it seems they were talking about their sex life with one another, but it turns out they were talking about making music, not making love. She seems very friendly with the hairdresser and owner of the Picaresque Beauty Salon, Kaoru.

characters.name: Ritsu
characters.description: Another guitarist for the band ZLAY. She is closest with Sai, and it can be assumed that they are lovers, though it is never made clear. She is not as amorous as Ryou but she and Sai seem to have mutual interest in Kaoru, the hairdresser who once worked for them.

characters.name: Reki
characters.description: The least offensive, perverted, or aggressive member of ZLAY. She is the bassist. She has a very deadpan nature and is the only person who Ryou listens to or is afraid of. Reki often has to reprimand Ryou for her careless behaviour. She and Ryou seem to be a couple, but she lets Ryou flirt and fool around with (hundreds of) other women. Reki does not seem to mind this at all.

title: Strike or Gutter
title_original: ストライク・オア・ガター
description: Touka is an ordinary high school girl who loves bowling. Her father runs a bowling alley, she has a crush on her former coach, and she is a pro at the game. The only issue is that if anybody watches her bowl, she becomes extremely conscientious of her body and plays poorly. To ensure this doesn't happen, Touka's best friend tries to help her overcome her shyness while bowling.

title: Himari no Mawari
description: Aizawa Haruki, 16 years old, is in his 2nd year of high school, and likes to live efficiently. One day during summer vacation, a girl, Aizawa Himari, suddenly appears, calling him 'Onii-chan' and claiming that she's his little sister. As it turns out, Haruki's father recently remarried, and his new wife brought a daughter with her. However, since both of their parents are overseas, it'll only be the two of them living under the same roof. And for some reason, Himari seems very obstinate about spending as much time with Haruki as she can. (Source: Japanese Publisher, translated)

characters.name: Himari
characters.description: Himari is a klutz with an energetic personality. She is obsessed with spending time with her new step brother after their parents got remarried. She has admitted that she can get lonely quite easily, thus, she wants to spend a lot of quality time with her new step brother, Haruki, to make lasting memories.

title: Noe Iuseul Saranghara
description: Doyeon can’t sleep at night, and it’s all because of her mysterious neighbor. It’s not just the loan sharks constantly banging on the next door apartment, but it’s the crying that keeps her up at night… Despite knowing she should stay away, Doyeon can’t help but wonder about her lonely neighbor who cries herself to sleep. Then one day, when the loan sharks are just about to kick down her door, an older woman comes running out of there and Doyeon ends up hiding her in her apartment. They say “love thy neighbor,” but they didn’t tell you doing so would come at a price… (Source: Lezhin US)

characters.name: Do-Yeon Pah
characters.description: Pah Do-Yeon is the main protagonist in Love Thy Neighbor. She is a veterinary college student, who grew up on an orphanage and was adopted into a wealthy family and moves to the apartment next door to a sad housewife whose husband left her at the mercy of loan sharks.

characters.name: Geon-U Pyo
characters.description: Doyeon's childhood friend. Has a crush on Doyeon.

title: Sireohae
description: Ban Ji-Un is loved by all. No matter how chilly someone's exterior may seem, she always finds a way to break through. That is, until her classmate Lee Yu-Seon comes along. For some reason, Yu-Seon ignores Ji-Un’s every attempt to win her over. Ji-Un is dumbfounded that, despite her best efforts, she just can’t find a way to weasel her way into the standoffish student’s heart. But when the two have an unexpected encounter, they just might discover that it’s never when a girl is looking for love that she finds it. On the contrary…sometimes it comes from the place she least expects. (Source: Lezhin US, edited) Note: Includes two extra chapters.

title: Shoujo Shuumatsu Ryokou Koushiki Anthology Comic
title_original: 少女終末旅行 公式アンソロジーコミック
description: The Official Anthology of Shoujo Shuumatsu Ryokou. Volume 1 (2017/10/13) Cover illustration: Tsukumizu Color illustrations: Akima (あきま), aoi_zero (aoi_zero), Mochizuki Kei (望月けい), Yoshimura Yoshi, Atto 1. Shokuji Shuumatsu Jijou (食事終末事情, Meals' Last Issue) [Hatopopoko] 2. Majinai (まじない, Charm) [zinbei (zinbei)] 3. At the Ranch [Nannyaka] 4. Washiki (和式, Japanese Style) [Satuyo] 5. Kirin (キリン, Giraffe) [Tabayou] 6. Exploration Day [Natsuno Riku (夏野りく)] 7. Geijutsu (芸術, Art) [Tadano (タダノ)] 8. Sonzai Shoumei Mokushiroku (存在証明黙示録, Post-Apocalyptic Proof of Existence) [Yue Michitaka] 9. View [Asano] 10. Shoujo VS Shokuryouko (少女 VS 食料庫, Girls VS. Food Storage) [Kaneko Masaru] 11. Factory [Kikai] 12. Last Recipe [Soto] 13. Seishun (青春, Youth) [Moyazou (もや造)] 14. Kinenhi (記念碑, Commemorative Monument) [Nakamura Miryuu (中村ミリュウ)] 15. A Chain for Two People [Takanaga Kouhei] 16. Chiyu (治癒, Healing) [Shoukaki] 17. The Bathtub and the Last Engineer's Suffering [Fuufuu (フーフー)] 18. Girls' Last Tour Around the World [Komatsu Shinya] 19. Red and Blue Warning [Yoshida Satoru] 20. Eiga (映画, Movie) [Tsukumizu] Volume 2 (2020/02/28) Cover illustration: Tsukumizu Color illustrations: Amatou, Tadano Nats

characters.name: Chito
characters.description: She travels with [Yuuri](https://anilist.co/character/120890) on their Kettenkrad. She can read and write in the current language, but not in kanji or Latin alphabets, because they became old languages in this world. She loves reading and collecting books she finds during traveling.

characters.name: Yuuri
characters.description: Yuuri is a care-free, fun-loving girl. She is the direct foil and companion of [Chito](https://anilist.co/character/120889). She carries an Arisaka type 38 rifle and loves food more than anything else in the world.

characters.name: Ishii
characters.description: Woman with glasses who repaired Chito's and Yuri's vehicle and asked for help with plane construction in exchange. The last pilot in history. Like Yuuri, Ishii is also left-handed.

title: Kiniro Mosaic
description: Alice has just transferred to a school in Japan from England, and a whole world of adventures await with her new friends Shinobu, Aya, Karen, and Youko. Join the girls' daily school lives as they learn more about Japan's language and culture! (Source: Yen Press)

characters.name: Karen Kujou
characters.description: **Height:** 150 cm A half-British, half-Japanese girl who was Alice's friend back in England. She comes to Japan and enrols in Shinobu's school. Karen is generally a very energetic girl (even more so than Youko). She is very outgoing and not afraid to show her emotions. Karen has mentioned on multiple occasions that she "really really really loves" (大大大好き!) Shinobu, which makes Alice jealous sometimes. She gets along with everybody in her class, even to the point where they would give her lots of food if she ever forgot her lunch. It has been noted that Karen doesn't gain weight despite consuming lots of food. She calls Aya, "Ayaya", because of a small misunderstanding when they first met.

characters.name: Shinobu Oomiya
characters.description: A graceful and air headed 15-year old girl. She previously stayed over at Alice's home in England, although she herself is rather bad at English and has generally bad grades. Shinobu has taken a liking to the English language and often tries to find opportunities to act like an English person. She has tried reading English newspapers (though she doesn't, if not, barely understands any of it) and even tried to listen in on Alice and Karen's conversations when they are speaking in English.

characters.name: Alice Carteret
characters.original: アリス・カータレット
characters.description: An English girl who transfers into Shinobu's school and stays at her house. She loves Japanese culture. Alice is a cute petit girl who is fluent in both English and Japanese (though it is mentioned that during Shinobu's homestay in England, the both of them communicated with each other only using the words, "thank you" and "konnichiwa"). Alice is very close to Shinobu and often tries to catch her attention, even to the point where she would try to one-up herself from Karasuma-sensei so Shinobu could see that Alice's English is better than Karasuma's. Alice is one of the most level headed people in the group, though she often finds herself embarrassed or in strange situations whenever she tries to win over Shinobu's attention. Alice has shown slight jealousy towards Karen and even Karasuma-sensei because Karen often pushes herself onto Shinobu and Shinobu admires Karasuma-sensei. Neverthe

characters.name: Aya Komichi
characters.description: Aya is Shinobu's classmate. She has also been friends with Youko since middle school. Aya is bright and graceful, though at the same time, she is very shy, timid but still occasionally displays tsundere tendencies towards Youko. Aya usually has troubles reading the atmosphere, which often leads to comedic moments in the series, though despite this, she is still one of the most level headed people in the group. ~!Aya often gets teased and complimented by a dense Youko. This always leads to Aya having romantic cliche thoughts and sometimes results in her hitting Youko due to embarrassment.!~

characters.name: Youko Inokuma
characters.description: Youko is Shinobu's classmate and also Aya's friend since middle school. Youko often teases Aya, even going as far as telling the group that Aya would never leave her side in middle school because Aya was too shy to do anything alone (though Aya strongly denies this). While Youko is very energetic, athletic and high spirited, at the same time, she is one of the most level headed people in the group (the other ones being Aya and Alice). She has a few younger siblings that she loves to play with. It has been noted by Aya that Youko's little brother's voice sounds almost exactly like Youko's.

characters.name: Isami Oomiya
characters.description: Shinobu's older sister who is a fashion model.

characters.name: Sakura Karasuma
characters.description: Shinobu's English teacher.

characters.name: Akari Kuzehashi
characters.description: Karen's Home Economics teacher.

characters.name: Karen no Mama Kujou
characters.description: Karen's British mother. She once punished Karen by eating a piece of super yummy cake in front of Karen when she heard a rumor that Karen was causing trouble for her homeroom teacher.

title: Bongchongaksi
description: He bought me for 50 sacks of rice. Soongap is nearly beaten to death by his master when friendly giant Bongchun buys him and saves his life. Bongchun's blind mother is delighted, believing her son has finally brought home a bride. And the more Bongchun treats Soongap like his darling bride, the more things get heated... (Source: Manta) Note: Includes 18 extra chapters.

characters.name: Sun-Gap
characters.description: __Height:__ 170cm __Shoe size:__ 260mm __Favorite food:__ fish, braised food, pickled vegetables, rice Sun-Gap doesn't celebrate his birthday. He would have gotten some extra food from his grandmother back when she was alive, but now birthdays don't matter to him that much. He has a normal tolerance for alcohol and smiles a lot when drunk, but doesn't enjoy drinking much. Sleeps on his side. The quality of his sleep greatly improved after coming to Bong-Chun's house.

characters.name: Bong-Chun
characters.description: __Height:__ 205cm __Shoe size:__ 325mm __Favorite food:__ anything, as long as there's a lot of it Bong-Chun doesn't celebrate his birthday; the only thing he does is give his mother a special meal. He doesn't enjoy drinking, but is still capable of ingesting limitless amounts of alcohol. He's the same as usual when drunk, except that he eats a lot more. He sleeps on his back with his hands folded over his chest. He's a light sleeper and sleeps very quietly for a man of his size. He doesn't snore.

characters.name: Pil-Gyeon
characters.description: __Height:__ 185cm Pil-Gyeon likes alcohol. His face remains pale no matter what, even when he's completely wrecked. He says the same thing over and over when drunk. Sleeps on his belly or rolls around, kicking off the blankets. He falls asleep quickly.

title: Genkai OL to Joshi Daisei ga 〇〇 Suru Hanashi
title_original: 限界OLと女子大生が〇〇する話
description: Segawa-san is the star of the office who everyone depends on. But she's stretched thin, and the state of her apartment has gotten dire. After a fateful encounter, the college girl next door offers to lend a helping hand! Notes: - The chapter count includes one extra story. - Originally self-published on Twitter, it was picked up for commercial publication on 2023-09-23.

title: Nae Jasigui Sasaenghwal
description: A gay son and a lesbian daughter. Jin and Rin are best friends, and they each have a secret - they are both gay. Life turns upside down when both of their households find out about their sexual orientation. How will they survive despite their parents knowing? (Source: Manta)

title: Now Loading...!
description: Takagi Suzu has a lot of ups (and downs) working in the video game industry, but she’s about to level up: Sakurazuki Kaori, a powerful director in the company who made Takagi’s favorite game, has come to guide Takagi on her next mission. Sakurazuki can be a bit harsh, but she’s also an experienced leader who will help Takagi gain advanced skills–and the two women might just unlock a new romance along the way! (Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: Tsukarekitta Onna ga Shinuhodo Iyasareru Tame ni
title_original: 疲れきった女が死ぬほど癒やされるために
description: An angel suddenly descended upon my messy life! Chihiro Sakai, 32, is a novelist in the midst of a slump. Under the terrible pressure from her editor, she hasn't slept for three nights and can't even think straight or move her fingers.... "How am I supposed to write anything?" Chihiro was about to fall over from exhaustion, when she meets a stranger (26 years old) at the pet store and brings her home! It's the start of a life together between two women that will give your weak heart strength.... (Source: Pixiv Comics, translated)

title: Yoiko no Shouzou
description: Hana is a college girl lacking ambition and motivation, when she meets a beautiful woman named Yoiko, who calls her self a "vengeful spirit" and tells Hana, "You have been cursed and you will die." To lift the curse, Hana must investigate the mystery behind this beautiful ghost, and her only clue is a sooty painting. The more Hana looks into Yoiko's background, the more she falls under Yoiko's captivating spell. (Source: Kobunsha, translated)

characters.name: Hana
characters.description: A college student with a poor relationship with her parents.

characters.name: Yoiko
characters.description: A mysterious ghost who seeks the memories of her past.

title: Watashi wa Succubus to Kiss wo Shita
title_original: わたしはサキュバスとキスをした

characters.name: Konomi Nirasaka
characters.description: One succubus girl that had transfered schools recently

characters.name: Yukiko Ootsu
characters.description: A shy succubus.

characters.name: Fuwa Yanigahara
characters.description: Best friend of Yukiko since middle school

characters.name: Mirino Echigo
characters.description: Aki's best friend.

characters.name: Nozomi Ashiyama
characters.description: Works part-time at Yanigahara Fish Garden

title: Endroll no Ato ni wa Saikou no Tabi wo
title_original: エンドロールの後には最高の旅を
title_en: Have a Great Trip After the End Credits
description: Aino the Hero and Iro the Mage. After defeating the Demon King, the two women embark on a journey around the world to fulfill a promise they made long ago. This is their story after the end credits roll—the greatest adventure dedicated to each other. A heartrending, radiant road trip fantasy. (Source: Manga UP!)

title: Boku no Futatsu no Tsubasa
description: Hiromi has a cousin named Mako. When she arrives Hiromi receives a big shock, she clearly remembered her as being a male nine years ago. The female looking hermaphrodite learns about herself and sex through various relationships and the friends she makes. (Source: Anime News Network)

characters.name: Makoto Kashiwagi
characters.description: Makoto was raised by her grandfather as a boy because she possessed male genitalia. However, with the onset of puberty, Makoto also started to develop breasts and so learned that she is a fertile and fully functional hermaphrodite. At the start of the manga, Makoto looks, when fully clothed, like a tall, beautiful girl, and she has adopted female mannerisms—although she continues to use boku for "I", which is usually used only by boys and young men. Makoto is unusually strong and athletic, but somewhat naive because of her sheltered upbringing. She is caught unaware when she first develops physical attraction to other people, and her attempts to deal with her sexuality is played for both humor and drama.

characters.name: Hiromi Ishimaru
characters.description: Hiromi is, officially, Makoto's cousin. After her father died, she was adopted by her mother, the daughter of Makoto's grandfather, meaning that she and Makoto are actually not related by blood. Hiromi and Makoto knew each as young children, when Makoto was believed to be a boy, causing Hiromi some surprise when she meets Makoto as a teenager. After Makoto reveals her secret, Hiromi becomes Makoto's protector and tutor. She tries to protect Makoto's secret and steer her away from harm, but inevitably gets caught up in Makoto's entanglements. (source: Wikipedia)

title: Mo Xi Tuo
description: Cool and quirky runway model Simone and her witty lawyer lover Marissa were spotted KISSING on the street! Not only that, the photo is all over the internet and people will NOT stop talking about it!! Now their families, employers, and even the public are pressuring them to call it quits on their relationship. But despite their struggle to gain acceptance, Simone and Marissa are set on showing everyone that love is like a well-mixed drink; the sweeter the taste, the harder it is to put down. (Source: Tapas)

title: Koi ni Koisuru Koibito no Kankei
title_original: 恋に恋するコイビト関係
description: Asako Ichijou, the student council president at a prestigious girls' high school, has been racking her brain about how to discipline the unruly but popular Nagi Tenma. That's the sort of person Asako is, until Nagi discovers Asako has broken school rules, too, by bringing shoujo manga to school... Asako pleads with Nagi to keep it a secret, and Nagi agrees, but with the condition, "Become my lover." (Source: Takeshobo, translated) Note: Includes three extra chapters .

title: Hana to Uso to Makoto
description: Some time before the June of summer. One day, she suddenly died... "I" and the corpse of the girl who should have died, "Makoto", spent those false summer days in that apartment. The relationship between these two sad, distorted people slowly becomes clearer...

title: Daisuki na Shinyuu ga VTuber no Jibun ni Gachi Koishiteta Hanashi
title_original: 大好きな親友がVチューバーの自分にガチ恋してた話
description: Manga artist Oshiga Sukoya is in love with the Vtuber Doujima Taiga and constantly gushes about her to her best friend Hariyama Teruko. Little does Sukoya know that Teruko is A.) the person behind Doujima Taiga, and B.) secretly in love with Sukoya. Note: Originally self-published on Pixiv, it was collected for publication by Futabasha on 2023-09-21.

characters.name: Oshiga Sukoya
characters.description: A mangaka who gains energy from supporting her favorite and watches endless Vtuber streams while drawing. Will die if she stops drawing her favorite.

characters.name: Teruko Hariyama
characters.description: Doujima Taiga's true identity, who is keeping her V-activites a secret. At that age where she can't be honest with herself. Uses a voice changer as she can't stand her own cute voice.

title: "Hitokiri" Shoujo, Koushaku Reijou no Goei ni Naru
title_original: 『人斬り』少女、公爵令嬢の護衛になる
description: Shurine is a girl who has mastered the sword, raised to serve as a bodyguard. However, when she is falsely accused of an assassination attempt, she is forced to go on the lam. Driven into exile, Shurine meets Lutecia, a duke's daughter whose life is in danger, embroiled in a dispute over succession. When Lutecia is attacked by an assassin, Shurine makes her an offer. (Source: Micro Magazine-sha, translated)

characters.name: Lutecia Heilenberg
characters.original: ルーテシア・ハイレンヴェルク

title: Paros no Ken
description: The legends that speak of the Sword of Paros say that it can bestow either prosperity or ruin on its kingdom...depending on the heart of its wielder. The kingdom's current princess, the beautiful yet resentful Elminia, laments being treated as a soulless tool simply for being born in a woman's body. Accompanied by Count Yulias, Elminia rides as far away from the kingdom’s politics as possible. One day, Elminia meets a beautiful young girl named Fiona, and their lives and the kingdom are changed forever. (Source: Manga Mavericks)

characters.name: Fiona
characters.description: A sixteen year old laundry maid. She lives in hope that she may find the prince of her childhood again. (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Elminia
characters.description: The princess of Paros, she considers herself to have been "born with both a man's heart and a woman's body." She has just come of age, but she does not want to marry and only find worth in bearing a prince for Paros. She yearns for freedom and adventure.

title: Ane wo Suki na Onee-san to
title_original: 姉を好きなお姉さんと
description: Due to various reasons, Hishiro Kinome is looking for a place to live. To this end, her sister suggests that she lives... with a lady who likes her sister?! Note: Includes three extra chapters.

title: Usotsuki Hanayome to Dousei Kekkonron
title_original: 噓つき花嫁と同性結婚論
title_en: The Lying Bride and the Same-Sex Marriage Debate
description: Shigisawa Rei knows she’s out of step with society. While everyone around her is getting married and having babies, as a gay woman, Rei feels like those things will never happen for her. Instead of looking for romance, she’s thrown herself into her work and is content with that. That is, until she happens to run into Goto Saya, a former colleague. Saya is petite, cute, and has always been popular with men. So it’s no surprise that Rei used to have a crush on her, but she squashed those feelings when Saya got married. Now, however, Saya comes to Rei begging for help, saying she’s had a fight with her husband and has nowhere else to go. Rei quickly agrees to help her out, and soon her crush is back with a vengeance! Rei knows it’s a bad idea to fall for a married woman, but can she possibly resist Saya’s charms?! (Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: Yuzhou Diyi Cu Shen
description: The innocent starlet Xiao Fengyu got the chance to work with the cold-faced superstar He Yunhan in a variety show as mentor and trainee. It seems like a great chance for Fengyu to get in with the goddess, but how come it feels like she's always running into trouble with her?

characters.name: Fengyu Xiao
characters.description: Xiao is a bubbly and innocent 18 years old college student who's working as a trainee in order to become an actress. She has a bright, fun and outgoing personality. She loves eating and her favourite food is buns. Her hometown is Xiawa Village. She has a sister.

characters.name: Yunhan He
characters.description: A cool and collected award-winning star actress. She becomes Xiao's mentor in a reality show. She dislikes milk, sweet food and skewers. She often gets drunk when she drinks. ~!It seems that He doen't have a good relationship with her family, especially her mother.!~

characters.name: Wen Hui
characters.description: Huiwen is Xiao's manager.

characters.name: Juan
characters.description: Juan is Xiao's third roommate. She's older than Xiao.

characters.name: Min Su
characters.description: Su Min is Xiao's second roommate. She's older than Xiao.

characters.name: Xixi Lin
characters.description: Xiao Fengyu's senior. She became famous online because of her single "Qing Qian".

characters.name: Yu Yuan
characters.description: She's the second heiress of Qin Yi Entertainment.

characters.name: Misu
characters.description: Misu is a renowed dancer. She took place of mentor Ke Ermin due to family matters.

characters.name: Qin Su
characters.description: Su Qin is the director of Qinyi Entertainment.

title: Uchi no Maid ga Uzasugiru!
title_original: うちのメイドがウザすぎる！
title_en: UzaMaid: Our Maid is Way Too Annoying!
description: After the tragic loss of her mother, Misha Takanashi had all but shut herself away from the world. Her father desperately tried to hire new maids in order to take care of her and the housework while he’s busy with his own job, but it was to no avail as she manages to run them out of the position — all of them except one. ​Before she knows it, Misha finds herself the center of attention of one Kamoi Tsubame, an eccentric ex-JSDF master sergeant who isn’t fazed in the slightest by Misha’s attempts to drive her away. Enamored by the adorable little girl, Tsubame makes it her personal goal to get Misha to open up her heart to her (and maybe even get her to wear the cute clothes she makes as well.) ​While her intentions are (mostly) good, Tsubame has a habit of taking things to the extreme when it comes getting closer to Misha, leading to all sorts of crazy situations that exasperate her to no end. Now, the pressure is on as Misha tries to find a way to deal with a maid who’s just way too annoying! (Source: Kaiten Books) Note: Includes one extra chapter.

characters.name: Tsubame Kamoi
characters.description: An ex-Air Self-Defense Force soldier who becomes the Takanashi family’s maid. She claims to only be interested in girls who haven’t menstruated yet, forming a particular attachment towards Misha.

characters.name: Misha Takanashi
characters.description: A Russian girl who has become a rebellious recluse following her mother's death. She is fearful of Tsubame's behavior and often tries to find ways to get rid of her. (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Yasuhiro Takanashi
characters.description: Misha's father, who becomes over delighted when Misha shows her any kind of interest. (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Kumagorou
characters.description: Misha's pet ferret.

title: Teizokurei DAYDREAM
description: Ghost Talker's Daydream tells the story of Misaki Saiki, a young woman with a troubled past, who is a professional dominatrix in one of Tokyo's most exclusive S&M clubs. However, her real money is something she likes even less than being a dominatrix.
