Limitations are meant to be overcome, after all. With just a bit of elbow grease and know-how, this tin can is going to behave exactly how she wants it to. [From itch.io]

title: Calamity Cait
description: "You have to say the words. I can't say them for you." In a sleepy coastal town, Cait watches whales. It's her job, and she might even say she's good at it. But there's more to life than whales, and Cait is on a mission to find out exactly what that means. Her sights are set on Molly, a coworker and friend, or maybe something more. Cait is never really sure where things stand. There's only one way to know for certain. "Mhm. We're all unremarkable. What else?" Step into the shoes of Cait and experience a day of monotony, yearning, subtle glances, absurd conversations, self-loathing, binge-drinking, pub food, and so much more. "We were put on this earth to suffer, but we weren't meant to suffer alone." Littered throughout Cait's life are people with struggles of their own. Each has a story to tell, and Cait is always more than willing to listen. She'll take all the life advice she can get. From the Steam page: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4200450/Calamity_Cait/

tags: Protagonist's Childhood Friend as a Heroine
description: Based on the manga and anime series by Satoru Akahori of the same name. The game's story begins on the outset of summer vacation. Hazumu's homeroom teacher Namiko Tsuki suggests Hazumu and her friends take a one-week trip to a small mountain village with a hot spring resort. Hazumu's grandparents reside in this town, and are two new characters introduced to the story. Three other female characters are introduced as possible love interests for Hazumu; two are the same age as her, and the third is the older landlady of the resort. The goal of the game is to pair Hazumu up with one of the five female cast of characters. The gameplay's main system comes from Hazumu's indecisive personality. If the player shows more interest in a particular character, the other characters get annoyed that Hazumu is ignoring them, which is displayed in a tension meter. The more Hazumu ignores a particular character, the higher the tension between that character becomes. This ensures Hazumu stays good friends with the possible love interests. In order to view the ending of a particular character, a certain amount of tension will have to be between the other characters, but this cannot be too great or the ending will not show. [Edited from Wikipedia]

characters.description: Osaragi Hazumu is a student, born male, at Kashima high school in the fictional setting of Kashima ward in Tokyo, and is the main character in the series. Hazumu is very selfless, thinking of others before herself and worries about her friends greatly. One day Hazumu is pressured by his friends Tomari and Asuta to confess to Yasuna. She rejects him, which hurts Hazumu heavily. He goes up to Mt. Kashima, but while up there an alien spacecraft crash-lands on him, seriously injuring him. In order to rectify this mishap, and in accordance with his own laws, the alien resurrects Hazumu, but in the process unexpectedly changes his sex to be completely female, right down to the DNA level. Shortly after Hazumu's transformation, she is unsure on how to live life as a girl and is initially very clueless about typical female matters. [spoiler]Ever since she was born, Yasuna has had a unique affliction which makes her incapable of seeing males, and instead to her males are covered in a gray, hazy blur, which makes it extremely difficult for her to tell one male apart from another except through the sound of their voice. Due to this, she was never able to get along well with others; on top of not being able to see the boys in her class at school, the girls who would normally interact with them were different compared to Yasuna, which built up a divide between her and everyone else. She ended up staying alone for years, and she thought she did not mind it; she did not intend to befriend anyone anyway. characters.name: Kurusu Tomari
characters.description: Kurusu Tomari is a student at Kashima high school and is a classmate of Hazumu's in their second year. Tomari is also Hazumu's childhood friend. Hazumu would often get bullied as a child, and Tomari would have to come to his rescue, saying that she would protect him forever. Tomari is very athletic and competitive, so in high school she joined the track and field club. In contrast to Hazumu and Yasuna who are not athletes and rather feminine, Tomari is a tomboy who does not often partake in traditionally feminine things such as clothing, shopping, or cosmetics. At least two of Tomari's female friends on the track team consider her very masculine, and like her cool character; one of these friends even says that if Tomari were a boy that she would have a huge crush on her. [From Wikipedia.]

characters.name: Mari Ayuki
characters.description: Mari Ayuki is a student at Kashima high school and is a classmate of Hazumu's in their second year. As a child, she used to love watching caterpillars leave their chrysalises and turn into butterflies. However, she never once thought that she herself would want to be in a similar position—changing into something else—so she merely just enjoyed watching the transformation before her. That by itself is enough for her, she recounts to Hazumu. Using this as a metaphor, Ayuki tries to explain to Hazumu that watching her loved one from afar is its own variety of love, though Ayuki never explicitly states just who she admires from a distance. Ayuki is good friends with Tomari, and Ayuki will often give her, and others, advice and help in regards to relationships. Keeping with her stance on watching from afar, Ayuki continuously observes the ongoing development of the love triangle between Hazum

characters.name: Jan Pu
characters.description: Jan Pu is an artificial intelligence owned by Hitoshi Sora as the automatic pilot of his spaceship. [spoiler]Her first appearance has her in disembodied form as the navigator of Hitoshi's ship and she is responsible for the crash landing on Earth and for nearly killing Hazumu. When Hitoshi comes to Earth to live in Hazumu's house, he constructs a gynoid modeled after Hazumu's own new female body, so Jan Pu looks about the same age as Hazumu, and their faces bear a striking resemblance. Jan Pu has the unique ability of levitation, and is able to bend light around her so others cannot see her. Other than technically being an artificial being, she generally acts like a human child due to being enthusiastic about meeting new people and possessing little to no social skills for a girl who looks to be the age of seventeen. At home, Hazumu and Jan Pu have been known to take baths together and t

characters.description: Hazumu's mother.

characters.name: Tsuki Namiko
characters.description: Tsuki Namiko is an English teacher at Kashima high school, and is the homeroom teacher of Hazumu's class. As she often proclaims, she has lived for thirty-five years and has never had a single boyfriend. This has enabled her to devote most of her time and energy into her students at school, but she is still lonely. When Hitoshi starts to work as her coworker at school, she becomes instantly infatuated by him, and goes to extreme lengths to show her devotion and mania towards her precious Hitoshi Sora. Namiko's attraction towards Hitoshi borders on obsession as she hangs large pictures of him on her walls at her home, and constantly is thinking or dreaming about him. However, since Hitoshi's species cannot express emotions, the attraction is entirely one-sided. [From Wikipedia.]

characters.name: Soro Asuta
characters.description: Asuta Soro is a student at Kashima high school and is a classmate of Hazumu's in their second year. Asuta and Hazumu consider each other best friends, and Asuta is one of his friends that pressures him into confessing his love for Yasuna. After Hazumu's transformation into a girl, Asuta suddenly finds his good friend Hazumu very attractive, and cannot help himself when he starts thinking about Hazumu in a sexual way. [From Wikipedia.]

characters.name: Sora Hitoshi
characters.description: Sora Hitoshi is the space alien responsible for transforming Hazumu from male to female. He arrived to Earth via his spaceship run by an artificial intelligence named Jan Pu, but crash lands on the surface [spoiler] where Hazumu is, killing him instantly. Hitoshi rectifies this by regenerating Hazumu, but unexpectedly changes his physical sex in the process. This is a mystery to Hitoshi for some time until he is finally able to confirm that Hazumu's "life grain" count is slowly dissipating, and by the time Hitoshi confirms this, Hazumu only has one month left to live. Hitoshi originally came to Earth as a cultural anthropologist and to study the emotions of the human race since his species has long-since given up any emotion at all. title: Euphoric Create ~Stairs of Affection~
description: Set in the far, far future-- Due to the development of a drug that makes one's fantasies materialize called "DesireIn", the people of the world live their lives soaked in these fantasies, and the concept of social links between people has been lost. Paying attention only to their fantasies, being totally apathetic to others and living a solitary life has become the common sense of the world. The main character, Nadeshiko, is a government worker living in such a world. Unlike the government workers of past times, in this world they act as emotionless machines, caring only for the mechanical means of continuing society. People have no dreams for their lives; and would hardly even notice if they were to die. Nadeshiko lives her life in this world passively, without holding any great dissatisfaction. However, she did nonetheless hold a certain, if only latent, feeling of gloom every now and then. If only to have a certain sense of "living"-- Unconsciously thinking this, she goes through a process of trial and error every day. Eventually, this feeling, this excitement, she begins to feel to some small degree when the numbers of "Insane" people increase rapidly, and they are culled for the good of the state. Then on one such day, Nadeshiko meets a girl named Momo. Momo lives in a way totally idiosyncratic enough to be wholly contrary to this society; pushing through life with a vivacity and earnestness wholly her own. Almost the moment they meet, she gives Nadeshiko a confession of love. Being in contact with Momo to some extent feels like a bother to her; but she also gains a sense of living that far outshines the culling or anything else she knows. However, after this she also comes to that Momo holds a certain deep "darkness" inside of her -- which causes an even greater attraction towards her.

title: Baihe Hunyin Jieshaosuo
description: You're a girl who likes girls, walking into this Yuri dating agency to find yourself a date. Here, you will be able to get to know lots of girls, including a genius scientist, a filthy rich vampire, a cute apple, and more! Although they all want to find a girlfriend, it will still be anything but easy for you to get the ball rolling with them. Will you be able to win their hearts? Or will you get a reality check then continue to live a miserable single life? This is a speed dating simulator. Players will play as "I/me", the protagonist in the game and get to date with more than 7 characters. Some hidden lore will be discovered as the story progresses. After dating the characters, players will acquire the knowledge of the hidden details of each character. This game contains a large number of choices, and each option will lead to different endings. Enjoy all the possible choices in dates and the background stories coming with them! [From Steam]

title: Flowers Of Starlight
description: Aster's a simple girl, at her core. All she really wants to do is enjoy her new life at uni, join a club, and spend every possible waking moment playing Magica Fantasia Online (she's not addicted) with her online crush Starsiren. She's gonna tell her, OK? Just... when they meet up for MagiCon. Honest. However, a teeny tiny complication arises on her first day at uni, when Aster just so happens to bump into Maristela, the single prettiest girl she's ever seen in her entire life. And she's not just pretty. Mari's smart, she's funny, and Aster would happily listen to her ramble for hours about whatever the heck she wants to, if only she had a little more courage to do so. Torn between the friend she's loved forever, and the new girl who it feels like she's always known, Aster faces the toughest decision imaginable, and she's not even been here for a week! A game about love, new experiences, and the fact that nerdy neurodivergent girls are cute and you should date them. [From Itch.io]

title: Tell me tonight was real
description: A game about being honest to yourself, and about friends with benefits becoming lovers. Or something close to it. January 8th. A national holiday. The day of the People’s Freedom. It celebrates the end of the final battle between the old regime and the revolutionary army. Now, for most it doesn’t mean much, there isn’t much left of the revolutionary republic. It's just another day to celebrate with friends and to get off work early. And here today is where Curtis finds herself. Off work early and looking forward to spending the day with someone dear to the vampire. One miss Soledad. She wonders what today will bring her, and how she'll end the day, but one thing is certain. Soledad will make this day into a special one. Tell me tonight was real is a visual novel, about friends with benefits turning into lovers, vampires and their cruelty, mental health getting in the way of your drinking, and bars close to the beach. [From Itch.io]

title: Pillow talk at the end of all things.
description: A calm and quiet night in Rio de Janeiro. That is until you hear a shot. And another. And yet another one. The timing gets faster, with more shots, shots with different sounds. You wake up and realize something is happening in the favela nearby. Either gang violence or state violence, you never really know. That's the same situation where Lenon finds herself for the first time, and now it's up for her "friend" Graves to help her not to panic. It's just another night in Rio, and you know things will move on as always after that. Pillow Talk at the end of all things is a small yuri visual novel about trying to get calm during a time when violence is commonplace, and expected. Follow Lenon and Graves during what is just another night in the Cidade Maravilhosa. [From Itch.io]

title: Where the Anemones Bloom
description: Cordelia leads a life that most mermaids would envy. She has close friends and is part of a prominent pod, her future is all planned out. But Cordelia isn’t most mermaids. When her pod moves to the coast, she’s warned about the forbidden shallows and the dangers that lurk beyond. She’s heard all the rumours of course, but none of her friends will go near it. Curiosity gets the better of Cordelia, and she soon finds herself trembling at the fearful lights and hum of this strange city. However, something - someone actually - has also caught her eye. What starts as mere curiosity blossoms into something far more interesting. Soon Cordelia questions who she really is, and what she really wants. As she ventures further into uncharted territory, she gets closer to love but further from who she is and what she knows. Will she risk it all for a taste of the forbidden? [From Itch.io]

characters.description: Cordelia is a curious mermaid, not one to meticulously follow the rules. Her eagerness and enthusiasm make her well-liked within the pod. She’s easy to talk to and has a friendly casual nature that puts anyone at ease. Cordelia is frequently chosen for special tasks as she’s thought to embody a mermaids’ best qualities. She’s well liked within the pod, and that suits her perfectly for her role as a Revelier taking care of special events and social occasions. She loves pitching in to help out her pod. Yet while Cordelia is thought to embody core mermaid virtues, the truth is a little more complex. Cordelia’s curiosity and natural enthusiasm are part of a character trait that’s not so typical of mermaids: curiosity. This inquisitiveness has gotten her into trouble before. characters.name: Dunia
characters.description: Those that get to know Dunia find her very down-to-earth. She likes to take care of herself and surroundings, that includes cultivating friendships with people who share her interests. She’s open and honest with those that she cares about, and expects the same in return. She doesn’t have time for drama or people she doesn’t feel are being genuine with her - and she won’t hesitate to cut them out of her life. She also enjoys crafts, and even makes her own jewelry when the mood suits her. In her spare time she enjoys reading and practices meditation. title: Left Hand Magic
description: A talented Battlemage, you are struggling to find work for your type of magic in a post-industrial (Magitek/Magic Punk) world that no longer has much need for battle magic. To be fair, you were warned about this. Your parents, your friends, even your instructors at university all pointed out that Battle Magic, once the most important of all fields, has long lost its purpose. The monsters are all dead or uplifted to being civilized. Dungeons all long since discovered, looted, and destroyed. Even warfare is now dominated by magitek warmachines and tools, all the products of artificers and enchanters. But...battle magic was what you were good at, a prodigy by any measure. And you had a passion for wielding the elements in destructive ways anyway. Who doesn't want to light things of fire or fry bad guys with lightning?! You ignored them all and mastered your area of expertise, graduating from the most prestigious magical academy on the continent! Too bad that no one needs you now... Down on your luck, skipping from menial job to menial job, you're unexpectedly recruited by Left Hand Solutions, a company that's made up of similar people, each trying to find positive uses for their particular types of magic in the modern world. Given that those include Blood Magic, Necromancy, and Summoning...you wonder if they aren't just a little bit insane. Even so, the pay is good and the staff are all friendly...and female. Maybe this won't be so bad? [From Patreon]

title: Of Rose and Moon
description: A powerful dungeon lies in the depths of the earth, filled with lavish treasures. Enticed by the promise of wealth, many adventurers traverse the dangerous underground maze, only to be halted at the very last chamber where Callistra, the Final Boss, lies in wait. She is a powerful magic wielder and no one has yet to best her in battle. Many adventuring parties have given up trying to challenge Callistra at all, leaving the dungeons before reaching the Final Boss. In turn, Callistra has become terribly bored of her position and wishes to be free from it. Her monotonous life is finally broken up by Ruth, a brave knight that refuses to give up in defeating the Final Boss and defeating the dungeon once and for all. Both are evenly matched and should be wary of the other, but instead other emotions arise instead... [From itch.io]

title: The Rabbit
description: "You heard me, be my girlfriend." The words hit me like a sledgehammer, and my heart felt like it was going to burst out of my chest. "But why?" Her thumb stopped moving and she tilted her head to the side, considering me. "Why not? You're cute when you blush." "But Cinnamon, you're not serious, are you?" Her hand remained on my leg, her thumb resuming its gentle stroking. "Why wouldn't I be? You're pretty, you're friendly, and you're obviously into me." The Rabbit is a short, kinetic visual novel that focuses on Alice and her past before the events of REVERSE. [From Itch.io]

title: Hey, Girlie!
description: "Hey, Girlie!" is a free visual novel dating sim released on May 17, 2025 for International Day Against Homophobia, Transphobia and Biphobia. Play as chosen cleric Kristen Applebees and attempt to romance favorite sapphic characters from Fantasy High, including Tracker, Gertie, Kipperlilly, Fig, Lucy, and Naradriel.

characters.name: Kristen Applebees
characters.description: Kristen Applebees thought her senior year at the Aguefort Adventuring Academy was going perfectly. As senior class president, she just pulled off the best Valentine's Day dance the school has ever seen! But her high spirits are quickly brought down by none other than Principal Arthur Aguefort, who reveals to her that his contract with the celestial plane requires that he kill any clerics who fail to represent their god with a date at the Spring Fling. As it happens, Kristen is the only follower of Cassandra, so that responsibility rests solely on her.

characters.name: Figueroth Faeth
characters.description: Fig Faeth — well, Fig's fine with Kristen actually. Not only are they close friends in the same adventuring party living in the same house, Fig is the paladin for Kristen's deity's wife. Cassandra's only cleric and Ankarna's only paladin sounds like a match made in hell, except things are totally platonic between Fig and Kristen. Besides, Fig has Ayda!

characters.name: Tracker O'Shaughnessey
characters.description: Tracker O'Shaughnessey is Kristen's ex. Enough said. She's moving back into Mordred Manor and returning to her routine of being a regular at the Aguefort gym, so that will be... awkward to say the least.

characters.name: Naradriel
characters.description: Princess Naradriel of Fallinel is Tracker's ex. Enough said. And she just happens to be leaving Fallinel for Solace at the same time as Tracker. Something about learning Solesian customs from Elmville residents to improve Fallinelven-Solesian relations?

characters.name: Kipperlilly Copperkettle
characters.description: If Kristen calling Kipperlilly Copperkettle "four different dogs" the moment they met wasn't bad enough, Kristen's adventuring party also killed Kipperlilly and chose to leave her in hell. Rumor has it that Kipperlilly has been stuck doing community service since her return to the mortal plane.

characters.name: Lucy Frostblade
characters.description: Lucy Frostblade didn't have enough screentime for us to assume she and Kristen have bad blood, but surely she wouldn't be happy with someone whose adventuring party killed her adventuring party, even if her own adventuring party killed her first, right? Maybe they can make small talk about that in cleric class.

characters.name: Gertie Bladeshield
characters.description: Gertie Bladeshield was Kristen's rebound. Kristen left her heartbroken, so Gertie declared Kristen her nemesis. Enough said. Maybe Kristen can make amends at the Apiarists' Society after school, but that might not be the safest option.

Play as chosen cleric Kristen Applebees and attempt to romance favorite sapphic characters from Fantasy High, including Tracker, Gertie, Kipperlilly, Fig, Lucy, and Naradriel.

title: Paris no Sakura
description: Maeda Sakura, a columnist living in Tokyo, has just been dumped by her girlfriend of two years, Megumi, who claims that Sakura has problems committing. Realising that Megumi might have a point, Sakura meditates on this and concludes that her father abandoning her and her mother when she was a young child may have led to Sakura’s problems committing. A few days later, she helps her mother move from her home to an apartment and discovers a box labelled “Jean-Luc Dupont”. Inside the box she finds a photo of Jean-Luc, Sakura, and her mother from a few years back. Realising that Jean-Luc is her father and seeing that the box has plenty of clues that indicate that Luc moved back to Paris, she goes on a trip of a lifetime to Paris to confront her father. Along the way, she meets some beautiful women in Paris and perhaps she might even fall in love with one of them. [Edited from Steam]

title: Tales From The Under-Realm: Lilith
description: This dark fantasy yuri visual novel is the third and last game in the Tales From The Under-Realms trilogy. While there are a few references to the other two games, it can be enjoyed as a stand-alone story. In this installment, the enigmatic Nameless God tracks the odyssey of three heroines: Lilith, the half-demoness; Odette, a devout warrior-monk of the Goddess of Truth, Irijo; and Evelyn, a formidable half-elf pyromancer and familiar face from TFTU: After Midnight. As the tale unfolds, our trio finds themselves in dire straits, ensnared by ‘The Seven’—a cabal of sorcerers who have seized control of Grimoire and exert their will over much of the fantastical realm of Aravorn. Despite the grim outset, the combined valor and cunning of the heroines fuel a daring escape from Grimoire, toppling a swath of the wizardry dominion in their wake. Now fugitives, their sole beacon of hope lies in reaching Shacklesplit, a haven nestled across the ocean on the shores of Zoltar. The story will follow the adventures of Lilith, Odette and Evelyn, as they navigate through numerous challenges to achieve different potential outcomes. Set in a dark fantasy world, this game intensifies the tone established by its predecessors, offering a blend of joyous, sorrowful, and bittersweet moments and endings. [From Steam]

title_original: 甘い夢のしにがみさん
description: A yuri (girls' love) novel game where there is no such thing as a 100-point perfect happy ending — every ending is a bad ending. Kokomi is a high school senior harboring an unspoken, secret crush on Amami, her best friend from club activities. One night, Kokomi has a strange dream. In it, she and Amami seem to be lovers...? ――Choose. Between the real me, or the me in your dreams. The deadline given by the Amami in her dream happens to fall on the day of their final club activity. One week. As she moves back and forth between dream and reality, Kokomi searches for an answer she won't regret.

title: Flatline Girls
description: Nothing could make Adriane Rosencrutzk feel more self-assured than a ride in her custom chassis. Of course, what else would? She used to have an easy-going respectable life, full of doting lovers, where she never would have thought of stepping into a cockpit. Now, her towering steel body is her only refuge from a lonely existence of dwindling control in the face of ever-surmounting disability challenges and medical needs. She has been a corpse walking since one terribly fateful day, and her new non-combatant position only gives her dread at the thought of having the time to ruminate on her pitiful circumstances. Soon, however, the new riders she has been instructed to train—rejects from a secretive program which seems to have cost them their reason and moral faculties—begin to foster in her a new envy. The spectacle of their sadistic sweetings upon each other reach into the heights of agony and ecstacy, while pushing the envelope of what's even survivable. She can't bring herself to care they live as societal refuse, not when every embrace of theirs suffused with amor fati abundant curses her to be reminded of all she has lost. So why then, is a face that looks like hers staring back at her from their past photos? Who is this unsightly doppelganger of hers that they called their former ace, and how is this spectre from the past so possessed the confidence and connection she lacks that it feels as though it's taunting her? Who is this loathsome black mirror called Nisha Delacroix? [From itch.io]

title: Paraphrase
description: It’s been a year since Erin has gone to work. She barely leaves her apartment, and when she does, it’s for quick errands at most. The apartment itself is a mess, dishes piled in the sink and trash bags on the floor by her bed. She’s haunted by dreams of Gwen, her wife of 14 years, almost every night; around the apartment, she talks to herself out loud. It’s as though she can hear Gwen responding, saying all of the things she most fears Gwen would say to her. In a word, she’s stuck. She can barely take care of herself. Erin isn’t completely alone, however. She has a frequent visitor: Viv, a woman much younger than her. Viv helps Erin out around the house, picks up her medications, brings her food. If Viv weren’t here to help, things would surely be much worse for Erin. But Erin and Viv aren’t exactly friends. It’s only because of Gwen that they know each other at all. Their relationship goes back more than a decade, and for many of those years it was distant or strained. The terms of that relationship are more unstable than ever. If it changed, it’s not clear what it would change into — or whether that change would be good for the two of them at all. [From itch.io]

title: Strawberries for Salad
description: Naomi lives alone in an apartment in an old Victorian near the local university. She is preparing a salad in which strawberries are an important ingredient. To prepare the salad, they must be cut into thin slices of about equal size before being tossed with the rest of the salad. There’s an art to this: her babysitter taught her, when she was a kid. That’s why preparing this salad is special — a yearly ritual for when strawberries are back in season. Naomi did not always live in an old Victorian near the local university. She’s lived in many different houses and apartments since she came to town. She hadn’t even really wanted to move here, as best as she remembers. It’s just that things had been so difficult with her ex-girlfriend Faith, by the end, and before that… Well, maybe it would just be better to start from the beginning, to really get everything straight. [From itch.io]

description: Dear Mom: My Letter to You is a journey of loss, acceptance, and the bonds made along the way. The story stars high school student Ayame Kawasaki who blames herself for her mother's suicide. Having closed off her connections with her friends for a whole year, Ayame is finally restarting her life, repeating her second year at Yamada Hoshi High School. It's up to Ayame to build and maintain her relationships, new and old, while coming to terms with the reality of her mother's death. [From Steam]

characters.name: Ayame Kawasaki
characters.description: Likes: Drawing, Manga, Math, Curry Dislikes: Being alone, Rumors, Ghosts Quote: "Back into the Abyss..." Ayame has a big heart and loves food and manga almost as much as she loves her friends and family. However, her quirky and spontaneous personality has always made her an easy target for bullies. Ayame's depression and anxiety take a turn for the worse following her mother's suicide. After taking a year off, Ayame is finally ready to confront reality— for better or worse. [From Steam]

characters.name: Miamo Shirogane
characters.description: Likes: Singing, Crochetting, Cats Dislikes: Gossip, Snakes Quote: "You incurable idiot!" Miamo is the confident, charismatic, and high-achieving Student Council President of Yamada Hoshi High. Her reputation as a model student has led her to develop an ego and demanding lifestyle that often strains her relationships. A certain incident resulted in her falling out with Ayame, who once saw her as a dependable older sister figure. [From Steam]

characters.name: Perrine Finch
characters.description: Likes: Playing Guitar, Nature Walks Dislikes: People Bullying Ayame, Fighting Quote: "I'm so glad you're okay!" Perrine is Ayame and Miamo's childhood friend. She’s generally shy and reserved, but very energetic and lively around close friends. She believes in the goodness of others and can be too trusting of them. She finds herself in a new crowd after Ayame's year off from school, but Ayame still holds a special place in her heart. [From Steam]

characters.name: Miso Shizuki
characters.description: Likes: Cooking, Blogging, Taking Naps Dislikes: Ungrateful People, Cockroaches Quote: "Jeez, you're so weird..." Miso is Ayame's classmate and first friend after she returns to school. She’s a fun-loving, caring, and playful girl with zero tolerance for nonsense. She brings out the best in others and puts smiles on people's faces. Cooking is her life passion, and she loves sharing her food with others. She volunteers in her free time to help the poor. [From Steam]

characters.name: Chip Mizuhara
characters.description: Likes: Girls, Romance Visual Novels Dislikes: Being Single, Big Cwords Quote: "I'm really sorry!!!" Chip is Ayame's shy classmate who often isn't taken seriously by others. He's equally as sweet as he is awkward and is sensitive towards the feelings of others. There's just one problem— he's an absolute nervous wreck when it comes to girls. Luckily for him, an awkward encounter with Ayame may give him a chance to solve his "girl" problem. [From Steam]

characters.name: Ginta Kawasaki
characters.description: Ayame's older brother. Having a great sense of humor, he always teases his sister, whether it's making up stories or using a bucket load of memes.

characters.name: Akio Kawasaki
characters.description: Father of Ayame and Ginta. He's a hard-working individual in the mangaka industry. He tries to balance his time to better support his family.

characters.name: Nao Kawasaki
characters.description: Late mother of Ayame and Ginta, and wife of Akio. She had a warm and caring personality, as well as a knack for making funny (and most time non-sensical) jokes with her family.

tags: Both Male and Female Love Interests
description: A fandisc of Sumire no Tsubomi. Wedding Daisakusen features slice-of-life scenearios of your time together with the hero of your choosing. Unlike the original, instead of making selections to end up with the desired hero, players are able to choose which character stories they would like to view in a categorised list. Previously support-only characters have been given their own scenarios.

characters.name: Hayasaka Satsuki
characters.description: Satsuki is an unconfident, shy third-year high schooler afraid to fall in love (and of men to a small extent). Satsuki's negative attitude to romance was born from an event 5 years ago, during junior high school. She decided to pluck up her courage and confess her feelings to her first love and childhood friend, Kanade. However, she overhears Kanade saying to his classmate that he has no interest whatsoever in "a girl like her". To make matters worse, just before he was bound for Austria, Kanade told her that she was ugly and that she should keep her glasses on to hide her hideous face. In spite of her plain appearance, Satsuki has a great love for sewing and clothes. After seeing a Takarazuka (a Japanese musical where female actresses take on roles as male characters) performance, Satsuki is greatly moved by the show, and by Jun Hikari, whom acted as the male hero. Now an enthusiastic f

characters.name: Suzushiro Kanade
characters.description: The blunt and stand-offish childhood friend of Satsuki. The root of her aversion to romance, Kanade frequently called her ugly, and is the reason why she rarely removes her glasses. A gifted pianist, Kanade trained in Europe to further his skills. Out of the blue, he returns to Japan to perform in a concert, and seems to have changed very little, personality-wise. [Spoiler]After high school, he travels to Europe again to continue his musical studies. He becomes a famous pianist, under his performer alias, Tomokusa Sou

characters.name: Yanagi Touwa
characters.description: Touwa is the second-in-charge of the school's Theatre Club. Almost nothing like his loud and attention-seeking childhood friend, Sei'ichiro, Touwa is antisocial, blunt, stoic and somewhat of a sadist. His father is a well-respected director working for the Stella Theatre, where Jun Hikari performs. [spoiler]After high school, Touwa goes on to become a theatre director at the Stella Theatre.

characters.name: Azuma Seiichirou
characters.description: The president of the Theatre Club, although he passes on most of the administrative duties to Touwa. From a wealthy family, Seiichirou is somewhat spoiled, though not unpleasantly arrogant. Proud of his family's traditional Japanese roots, his likes and interests are all associated as such- e.g., Kabuki theatre, his preference for wearing Hakama (kimono for men) as opposed to western clothing (outside of school), and even commuting to school via a human-drawn carriage. [Spoiler]After high school, Seiichirou becomes a famous Kabuki actor, as well as a popular personality on a national quiz television show. His older cousin works alongside Jun Hikari as her Senpai

characters.name: Yuki
characters.description: A member of the Theatre Club, Yuki is energetic, friendly and positive, in direct contrast to most of its members. He openly shows his affection for Satsuki, though never laciviously. In spite of his child-like cheer, Yuki is surprisingly perceptive of everything that goes on around him. Since he works part time in the props department at the Stella Theatre during the day, he attends and studies at school in the evening. As a result, he can't attend the club as often as he'd like. He is self-conscious of his short height, and is quick to redeem himself as the physically strongest of the club. [Spoiler]Yuki suffered from memory loss, and was found by his current guardian. He later discovers that he is a partial entity of Misumi Kei, a scripwriter who is in a coma. Kei discovered that his master stole his script, and in despair, attempted to run away but fell off the stage. As a result of

characters.name: Kusakabe Haru
characters.description: Haru is a long-time member of the Theatre Club, and also Satsuki's classmate. Meek, quiet and very shy, Haru is a pacifist and tries to avoid directly stating his point of view- especially when Touwa and Sei'ichirou argue (though he finds himself getting involved anyway). He is the gentlest and kindest towards Satsuki and never orders her around. Haru enjoys creative writing, and does so at any spare moment he gets. Though from a vastly wealthy family, Haru has almost no interest in money or material possessions. In spite of his docile nature, everyone is careful not to overly upset Haru, as he is heavily hinted to be scary when he finally loses his patience. [Spoiler]After high school, Haru becomes a successful professional author. Beneath his gentle exterior lies a dark nature- deep down, Haru is dangerously possessive. His sexual desires are somewhat dark too, as he confesses to imagi

characters.name: Jun Hikari
characters.description: The handsome actress that inspired Satsuki to love theatre. Hikari is brave, confident and strong, but gentle and kind. Her popularity and rising talent threatens her senior acting peers, and as a result, Hikari is subject to their bullying. In spite of this, she remains strong and loves her job. [Spoiler]Her true name is Izumi Hikari. She intially enlists Satsuki to be her fan manager, but after Satsuki got her dream job of being in the costumes department, Hikari eventually re-enlists her as her stylist.

title: School Captain 2: Kai Ou o Nerae!
title_original: School Captain 2 会王をねらえ!
tags: Group Sex of One Male and Several Females
description: The best people will lead the best nation! I propose to give them the treatment they deserve. A huge nationwide selection competition is launched. In other words, the curtain rises on the National Student Body President Contest. This tournament to determine the true president, the "King of the Association"... The "Kaiou Battle" became known as the "Battle of the Kaious". There was a high school that won the "Kaiou Battle" for the first time in a row. St. Marduk Academy was created to produce the elites who would lead the true Japan. Among the fierce fighters who excelled in both literary and military arts gathered at this school from all over the country, there was one who was the first to win the "Kaiou Battle". Kanzaki Reika reached the pinnacle of student body president as a first-year student. However, the glory she had achieved through her personal power was lost upon her graduation. Then, an eccentric coach is assigned to the school. With the election of the student body president just around the corner, the coach immediately announces the members to be selected. "Wow, I'm going to be fighting against my sister?!" Tsurumi Mayu, whose guts and physical toughness seem to be her only merit, is assigned to the team. Do you have what it takes to defeat Kanzaki Reika and represent your school? Tsurumi, go for the king! The coach's passionate words call for a miracle!

characters.description: Riley was a sous chef for years, mistreated and underappreciated in the kitchen. The very day she was going to interview for a position as head chef at a fancy restaurant, she was in a plane crash and died. Or she would have been if she wasn't brought to the future. But in this world, cooking is a dying art, and she's the only one who can revive it. She decides to attempt being a professional chef again in an attempt to prove she can make a significant contribution to society. If she can't, however, the consequences could be far more severe than just having to go back to school.

characters.name: Max
characters.description: A historian from the year 2065. Her job is to travel back in time and investigate events that happened in the past without disrupting the future. She's a fun-loving woman who knows what she wants, and isn't afraid to go after it. Finding Riley has made no significant contributions to society, she decides to bring her into the future to allow her a second chance after hitting it off on the plane.

characters.name: Cecilia
characters.description: The head historian and a very strict, serious woman. She doesn't appreciate Max's nonsense and if the woman wasn't so good at her job Cecilia would have fired her long ago. She respects confidence and intelligence. Her outwardly frigid demeanor might make it hard for people to get a read on her, but Cecilia isn't afraid to speak her mind and make her thoughts known.

title: Entropic Float: This World Will Decay and Disappear
description: Entropic Float is a visual novel regarding the experiences of fourteen people who've been trapped inside a magical construct known as the Anomalous Clocktower. Missing memories of how they came to be there, certain aspects of their past life, and of course, every loop but the current one, can those who awakened inside the Anomaly find a way out? Step into the shoes of Rashmi Jamil, Kanatsun, and Amelie Macon at different times of day as you seek a resolution. In each loop, you'll also be challenged to make the right decisions to overcome Entropy, in the hopes that the protagonists' memories might make it through to another version of themselves if the loop doesn't end in tragedy. After finding all eighteen common endings, will the path to truth finally open before you?

characters.name: Amelie Maçon
characters.description: The Childhood Friend, a friendly and pretty standard heroine-type who seems very accommodating. Amelie is one of three playable protagonists in Entropic Float. She gives off a fairly typical vibe, but players will quickly come to understand that her 'girl next door' persona is riddled with holes.

characters.name: Kanatsune Ame
characters.description: An adult with an eclectic sense of style and a willingness to do whatever he needs for success. Kanatsun is one of three playable protagonists in Entropic Float. His role is that of the 'over-informed', the one character who has more information than all of the others. Unfortunately, this information won't quite prove to be enough...

characters.name: Rashmi Jamil
characters.description: A nonbinary young adult who is easily startled, but not perpetually afraid and actually quite prone to starting arguments. Rashmi is one of three playable protagonists in Entropic Float. They're rather cagey about their personal life, and seem intent on convincing everybody else that they're a flawless genius.

characters.name: Loam Arnault
characters.description: An enigmatic and friendly youth who wants the best for everybody stuck in the Clocktower. Works part-time as a hotel concierge.

characters.name: Malcolm Shingle
characters.description: A self-proclaimed has-been artist who spends his days doing whatever keeps him from getting bored in his middle age.

characters.name: Peri Dubois
characters.description: A sweet young girl, but she seems to view other people as ‘friends’ or ‘foes’ exclusively. If you can get through her shell, prepare for her to get attached.

characters.name: Stephanie McGermanotta
characters.description: A gloomy young woman who shows compassion to everybody but herself. She has a strange connection to the Anomaly, often able to predict things that haven't happened yet.

characters.name: Jasper Jasmine Jekyll
characters.description: A flamboyant young adult who likes to tease others and stir up drama. She doesn't seem altogether bothered about the situation, using the opportunity to work on her sociology thesis.

characters.name: Abel Moreau
characters.description: A boy of sophisticated heredity who tries his best not to behave like a wealthy jerk. Caught between the worlds of being raised as the 'perfect heir', wanting to be a kind person, and wanting to hold onto his his childhood interests.

characters.name: Touko Nozomi
characters.description: A devoted schoolgirl with no real direction. Her main goal is to ‘get a good job’, with no care to what field she might get it in. She's been searching for somebody dear to her, and as a result, hasn't spent much time developing interests.

characters.name: True Whitman
characters.description: A middle-aged person who seeks out oddities, and tries not to let on the fact that he’s fairly odd himself. Failed step one.

characters.name: JJ McGermanotta
characters.description: A quiet and awkward person who likes video games and sports. At least, if he doesn't trust you. When he does trust you, he becomes rather harsh and overconfident instead...

characters.name: Madeline Nenohara
characters.description: Your run-of-the-mill Office Lady, except for her obsession with rollercoasters and other high-adrenaline activities. She wears sneakers to work so that she's always ready to run!

characters.name: Shinjiro Nozomi
characters.description: An odd young man who believes his personal moral compass to be an objective truth. Considered by many to be the perfect cross between a bad boy and a pathetic little meow meow.

description: "Down the moor, there's a cursed place. Don't wander there if you cherish your life." You've come to the town - a little unnamed thing - in the first train you’ve managed to catch, with naught a plan to follow. In a hurry, you’ve severed all ties with your past, carrying the remnants of your old life in a portable suitcase. On the station, right where the horse carriages wait for the passengers, you found a note. "Opaline Manor is looking for aides: maid, servants, pages. Promised good pay, lodging, and weekly leave." Despite the rumors surrounding the manor, you took the note, and headed down the moor. [From Itch.io]

description: You are the chosen one of the deity of love, family and motherhood, dispensing blessings in her name. But you’re hardly blessed yourself. title: Dungeons and Don't Do It
description: Dungeons and Don't Do It is a DnD parody, or satire about DnD... Namely, how players always find a way to do something stupid and mess up the DM's world. (For those of you not familiar, DnD is a role-playing game, where players take on the role of an adventurer on a quest, and have great flexibility in choices while the DM- "Dungeon Master" creates the story for them.) While it is possible to play through this game seriously, it isn't the point! There are plenty of silly options and random generated results to go along with the theme and lead your character through a wacky adventure. Beware about the RNG, though! Some options are much more difficult to pass than others. [Edited from Itch.io]

title: Save The World
description: A thrilling sci-fi story about Ekiya, a young woman living in London who's struggling to make ends meet with her roommate, Sarah, in a world where all that matters is how much money you make. After a break-up and recent job change, Ekiya's life takes an even more drastic turn when she's kidnapped by aliens. Their leader introduces themself as Xen and explains that they are space travelers with the objective of saving the worlds they encounter. Xen asks Ekiya about the problems on Earth and all Ekiya does is answer seemingly innocent questions about the world including the uneven distribution of wealth. Little does she know, her answers will soon influence the fate of the entire world. The following day, Xen makes a proclamation: every day a progressively increasing number of the wealthiest individuals on Earth would be killed. At first, there are attempts to fight back. However, the superiority of the aliens' technology quickly becomes clear. The world is completely at their mercy-- and perhaps, Ekiya's. Xen seems to trust her judgement and continues listening to Ekiya's advice. Can Ekiya change Xen's mind? Convince them to leave? Or, if it comes to it, can Ekiya discover a way to destroy Xen and the rest of the aliens? This is exactly what Agent Castillo from MI6 asks her to do. As Ekiya, you must decide what to do. Do you prioritize humanity or will you look for a more peaceful way to settle things? Maybe this is your chance to better the world. Instead of destroying the aliens, perhaps you can use your influence to inact even more radical changes-- changes that will potentially help more than yourself and your roommate. After all, what have the rich ever done for you besides ignore your suffering? [From Steam]

characters.description: Zone is a tough bouncer and an even tougher older sister. No one messes with the "Velvet Devil" of San Mazo... maybe except for MJ.

characters.name: Debora Santoro
characters.description: Debora is not for everyone: she's a lady who knows what she wants and will do whatever is needed to get it. Good thing she seems to enjoy your donuts... Just make sure not to make too many mistakes.

characters.name: Nova
characters.description: Punk-ass Skateboarder by night, Mysterious Graffiti artist by... even later night. Brace yourselves, cos she's itching to give the San Mazo streets a taste of her art! But what lies behind all that angst? A softer side? A dark past? MORE ANGST? Probably a mix of all three! Originally a character from the game Crush Crush.

characters.name: Detective Fox
characters.description: When it comes to solving hard-boiled cases, no one does it better than Detective Fox. Right now, he's close to solving one of the biggest cases of his life - the hard-boiled case of the Donut Thief.

plot_tags: Both Male and Female Love Interests
full_description: In a world where you can literally eat your feelings, you work at The Hotbox, a special donut shop where every donut is infused with mood enhancers that can change your customers’ emotions. But people don’t always know what they need, so from flavors that give them courage to ones that lift their spirits, it’s up to you to choose the right mood and help each troubled customer. Listen to their stories, offer advice in the form of donuts, and help mend broken relationships. [From Steam]

title: TELLURICENE
description: Welcome, Researcher, As you may know, an emerging species is taking root—preternatural, highly intelligent, and swiftly spreading. Classified as the Vivus glomerorum, these new lifeforms threaten to infiltrate our resilient nation. It’s up to our bravest and brightest minds—like you—to investigate and decide: friend or foe? You have been selected to conduct objective scientific research (sensory testing, radiation resistance trials, developmental studies, and more) to piece together the truth behind the Vivus glomerorum. In the wake of a looming Telluricene, you will have an intensive two weeks to decide whether this new era comes to fruition... or is forever halted. Your great nation thanks you for volunteering in Project Sporesight. [From itch.io]

characters.name: Vivus Glomerorum
characters.description: Considered highly dangerous, subject VG-71122 demonstrates extreme adaptive intelligence and cunning. It seems to refine its behavior in direct response to your presence. Whether it intends to harm or simply understand you is still unclear. What answers will you find? [From Steam]

characters.name: Darío Vincelli
characters.description: Exhibiting sharp intuition, EPPA-98152 approaches everyone with a combative temperament. His true intentions are tightly guarded. He reveals little beyond what he chooses to show. His judgements are swift and often defensive, shaped by suspicion as much as observation. How far can you push before he lashes out? [From Steam]

title: Dear Pianissimo
description: Shu works at a pizza restaurant. When he is on his way to deliver, he sees Nagi, who wants to be a voice actress, practicing at a riverside. When he is on his way back to the restaurant, he sees Nagi again but they get involved in a truck accident and lose their lives... They come to a school located between this world and that world called "Conservatory". They wake up and find out the fact that there is a way to go back to this world. It is necessary to win a music contest done one-on-one. This means a winner can go back and a loser can't. Ironically, Shu is going to have a one-on-one match against Nagi, who is actually tone-deaf... Shu suggests that they practice together until the contest day... [From Himeya Shop] Beside the adventure parts that makes most of the game, Dear Pianissimo includes musical sequences. In which the player is required to press keys on the keyboard in correct timing to accompany the current song. These sequences can be turned to automatic if the player doesn't wish to participate.

characters.name: Kuresato Nagi
characters.description: A high school student who aims to become a voice actress. After dying in the accident together with Shuu, and ending up in "Conservatory", it is found out that Nagi is actually tone-deaf.

characters.name: The Fairy of Sound, Piano
characters.description: A fairy Shuu met at the school which they attend in Conservatory.

characters.name: Hanayamada Jasmine
characters.description: The teacher of Shuu and Nagi in the Conservatory. She is actually an angel.

tags: Group Sex of One Female and Several Males
description: A long time ago, a legendary hero defeated an evil dragon. He wore a magical bracelet that protected him during the battle. Years passed, and the memories of his heroic deeds, even his name, have faded away from people's minds. But a young girl named Rouge, who trains regularly in the art of sword-fighting, still dreams about a real hero - more precisely, imagines that she will marry one. [Edited from Mobygames]

title: Alluna and Brie
description: Play as Brie, a spunky pink haired girl who recently gained the ability to magically summon cheese sandwiches out of thin air. Everyone thinks Brie's magical girl powers are a joke, but the Magical Response Unit is in desperate need of her help. [From Steam]

characters.name: Lorilynn
characters.description: Hailing from the neighbouring town of Siren's Point, Lorilynn is a geneticist who was transferred to Magical Response Unit due to her experience in dealing with magical based threats. Oh, and did we mention that she's also a mermaid?

characters.name: Brie
characters.description: After failing to take a magical entity seriously, Brie sarcastically asked to be able to summon cheese sandwiches out of thin air. She could have asked for heat vision or the ability to fly or any other awesome power, but she thought the whole thing was a joke and now she's stuck with quite possibly the worst power set ever invented. Brie feels understandably ripped off about the whole situation, especially considering she can't even summon different types of sandwiches, they specifically have to be grilled cheese. She's still committed to fighting evil and saving the world, but she's going to need a hell of a lot of help if she's even going to stand a chance against these invading octopus girls.

characters.name: Alluna
characters.description: Alluna was a bit luckier in the powers department, and she was blessed with the power of the moon. She fights with divine based abilities, and can do everything from punching enemies with staggering force to leaping across the room in an instant. She's a damned good fighter too, which just makes Brie feel even more useless. Even though there's a massive difference in their skill levels, the two girls are great friends, and have been ever since they went to highschool together. But fighting tentacle monsters is stressful work, and there's bound to be some bumps in the road. Especially when there's guys involved...

title: Paper Roses
tags: Both Male and Female Love Interests
Protagonist's Childhood Friend as a Hero
description: In a world with kings and queens, and eyes that change colour when they meet their soulmate pair... to put it simply, Kira was just about average. She worked as an average artisan, boring grey eyes, never been in love and worked tirelessly on a valueless trade of selling paper engagement roses. The one thing that remained interesting in her life is her best friend, Robin. When everything she cares about is about to be stripped away, Kira is left to decide whether her own happiness is worth it at others' expense.

characters.name: Kira Brookheart
characters.description: Though sweet on the surface Kira can be rather sarcastic at times, especially to those she's comfortable around. Kira seems to be rather shy at first glance, usually due to her positive nature. When she turned eighteen, Kira took over her mother's papersmithing workshop and spends her days between crafting and selling her works. Living alone with her bird, Loveless, Kira spends a lot of time at her best friend's house or at her workshop. [From in-game]

characters.name: Robin Akiba
characters.description: Aside from being Kira's best friend, Robin makes an unbelievable latte. Robin works at the coffee brewery, and visits Kira on a daily basis. Robin is confident and playful but also cares deeply for his friends and family. After becoming friends many years prior, it can be said that Kira's feelings toward Robin may not be as simple as platonic connection. [From itch.io]

characters.name: Iris Aria
characters.description: Iris can be summed up as a spoiled princess any way you try to swing it. She's cares very little for those who are under her in class, and demands for things to happen her way. Iris is incredibly unexposed to the world, often proving to lack common knowledge like how to cook or pour tea. [From itch.io]

characters.name: Creed Akiba
characters.description: Creed is something of a scary looking 22 year old. As Robin's little brother, Creed starts living with him in order to start his life as an alchemist--as terrible as he may be. Creed appears to be cold, but happens to be afraid of everything--especially animal-shaped lanterns. [From itch.io]

characters.name: Luvina Jupiter
characters.description: Luvina is a seer that was sold to princess Iris at a young age. Luvina takes the world for what it is, and doesn't have much creativity or imagination. While not a love interest, Luvina is very invested in helping Kira to understand that they are more alike than they want to believe. [From itch.io]

title: Zhenshi Huanxiang
description: Started with a sneak shot accident, the university campus which is supposed to be a place for education has been being involved in a series of cases. As a journalist, you will use your superpower to find out the truths behind the conspiracy, for justice and for your dream. In order to collect news materials, you need to change your disguise by playing the dress-changing mini-game. With all the dangers ahead and the big responsibility on you, it is only your abilities and wisdom that can take you forward. Could you become the light that breaks through the smog surrounding all the complicated cases one linked with another? It’s all up to you. [From Steam]

tags: Both Male and Female Love Interests
description: In this visual novel, Ruby Rose is the long-lost princess of the Kingdom of Vale, and heir to the titular Summer Rose Court. She is discovered and pulled from her peaceful life in the desert, back to the kingdom’s capital of Beacon, where she must prepare for a war against the creatures of Grimm. Along the way she must recruit new allies, including Knight Commander Ser Weiss Schnee, mysterious faunus rebel Blake Belladonna, dragon tamer Yang Xiao Long, young and inexperienced soldier Jaune Arc, the warrior priestess Pyrrha Nikos, the acolyte Lie Ren, and the fearless sailor Nora Valkyrie. [From itch.io]

title: Desire & Decorum
tags: Both Male and Female Love Interests
description: It's court or be courted when you learn you're one of the most eligible heiresses in England! Does true love await you at the grand Edgewater Estate? [From Choices Wikia]

characters.name: Yusuf Konevi
characters.description: Yusuf Konevi is a member of the ton, making his first appearance in Book 1, Chapter 6. You first meet Mr. Konevi at your London debut in Mr. Sinclaire’s townhouse. He is polite and pleasant, and you see him teasing Mr. Chambers. It isn't until Book 1, Chapter 15 that you two are formally introduced to each other. [spoiler]If you decide to employ him as a barrister into your estate, you will also see him in Book 2. Prince Hamid says he has insight about the inner workings of London society. Mr. Konevi tells you how to sway Miss Bowman, Miss Holloway, and Mr. Chambers' opinions about you. [Edited from the Wiki]

characters.name: Theresa Sutton
characters.description: Theresa Sutton is [spoiler]Harry Foredale's wife as of Book 3, Chapter 18. She is first seen in Book 1, Chapter 2. Theresa is very talkative and bubbly. She is known to be a gossip, preferring to talk about superficial subjects. She is a bit insecure about this tendency to chatter, mentioning that her mother told her to be quiet during her debut, only for her to ruin it as she usually does by talking too much. She is often ditzy and tends to behave inappropriately, such as talking loudly about Mr. Sinclaire's late wife at his dinner party. Occasionally she says or believes silly things, once convincing herself that Edgewater was haunted when she heard voices; this was later revealed to be Your Character and Annabelle Parsons speaking down the hall. [spoiler]In Book 3, Chapter 18, her name changes to Viscountess Theresa to reflect her marriage to Harry. [Edited from the Wiki]

characters.name: Cordelia Parsons
characters.description: Cordelia Parsons is one of the ladies of Hazelvale and one of Annabelle Parsons's younger sisters. Although she is mentioned along with Annabelle's other sisters in earlier chapters, she is first seen in Book 3, Chapter 4. While Constance appears to be the more responsible twin, Cordelia comes off as more coquettish and lighthearted. Because Annabelle speaks frequently about Your Character, Cordelia and Constance immediately like Your Character and ask that she attend their upcoming birthday party. [spoiler]In Book 2, Chapter 6, when the Dowager Countess of Edgewater is forced to release Luke Harper from employment, Annabelle convinces her family to hire him as a manservant. From that point, Mr. Harper becomes acquainted with Miss Cordelia. At Your Character's engagement party, depending on the player's choices and if Your Character is not engaged to him, Cordelia flirts with Sir Luke, w

characters.name: Felicity Holloway
characters.description: Felicity Holloway is a rival debutante. She is first seen in Book 1, Chapter 6. Felicity is a proud and competitive woman. Even though she is the daughter of a viscount, she doesn't set her marriage prospects higher than Ernest Sinclaire. She pays compliments to Duke Richards and scolds Viscount Westonly for stepping on her foot, but doesn't pursue them aggressively. As soon as Your Character meets Felicity upon entering Mr. Sinclaire's London townhouse, she looks down on Your Character's being Vincent Foredale's natural daughter. If the player chooses to wear any premium dresses during the season, she will be envious and either mutter a compliment or try to criticize it (the second usually embarrasses herself in front of Your Character's grandmother). title: Wicked Willow
description: You're Willow, a wicked witch, trying to make her way in the world in 1993. Who is Willow? She's a judgy vegan. An Atheist who says she wears a cross "ironically." A sad soul with a tragic past. A brush with death has awakened Willow's powers, but don't expect her attitude to improve. Along for the journey is Avery, Willow's environmentalist best friend, Xarsi, a nun-turned-succubus, Tanya, a self-appointed mentor with a secret past, and Lydia, an Evangelical Christian whose cheery attitude puts her on Willow's bad side. Also, there's a talking cat named Shadow. He never shuts up.

characters.name: Willow
characters.description: Who is Willow? She's a judgy Vegan. An Atheist who says she wears a cross "ironically". A gifted student who barely bothers to show up to class. A sad soul with a tragic past. A brush with death awakens Willow's powers. But don't expect them to improve her attitude. [From the Kickstarter campaign].

characters.name: Tanya
characters.description: Transforming people without their knowledge? Messing with their memories? Turning back time? Willow's self-appointed mentor will do it and more if it means she can finally accomplish her grand plan. What is the plan? She's... not ready to tell you just yet. Try again tomorrow. [From the Kickstarter campaign].

characters.name: Xarsi
characters.description: What? Why are you looking at me like that? Do you think I'm sort kind of devilish monster? I'll have you know, I used to be a nun! But after a little taste of sin, well... let's say I converted. What's wrong with leading people down a path of temptation? Temptation leads to wonderful things. I don't eat people's souls. I set them free. [From the Kickstarter campaign].

title: Luoxuan Yuanwuqu
tags: Past Setting in a Fictional World
description: As the adopted girl of a family fallen from grace, you now have a chance to make your mark on high society. Through ballroom dancing and clever romancing, gather the information you need to restore your family’s name.

characters.name: Juven Sakan
characters.description: Viscount Juven Sakan is the head of the Sakan family. Besides being adept in the games of politics, he also authored the book "Finsel's Beauty", which tells about the flower shop girl, the Merc Corps, and even the stories that happened deep within the walls of the church nunnery... Somehow, he knows about all of these.

characters.name: Zoe Olineaux
characters.description: Zoe Olineaux is the Duke of the Olineaux family. He is known as the kindest of the four dukes, and since Hugh took control of the Amber Knights, Duke Olineaux has one less thing to worry about.

characters.name: Bai Xing
characters.description: Asteria is Finsel's strongest elf mage at the moment. She belongs to the Sakan family. People call her the Stars' Children due to her cosmic power, which is a great honor as elvish culture is known for the worship of stars. Although powerful, she is actually very gentle, and even a bit shy.

characters.name: Gonzalo Jorcastle
characters.description: Gonzalo is the second son of the Jorcastle family, and a popular guy in the Finsel social circles. At the request of his family, he studied to become a mage, but his interest in battle is almost nonexistent. Despite this, he is often seen fighting along side with Finsel's guardsmen. Perhaps there is someone in the guardsmen he wishes to protect?

characters.name: Alan
characters.description: Alan's family has lived in Finsel for a long time. The guardsmen call him a reliable captain, strict supervisor, and good friend. Besides that, he is also a poor civil servant, a beloved brother and an naive boy. His most shining point is a strong sense of justice--but he is not sure if it could count as a good trait.

characters.name: Magda Ellenstein
characters.description: The protagonist was born to common citizen parents from the Slum. After a fire killed her family, Eliza Ellenstein and Duke Sakan picked her out for her beauty and, after introducing herself, she was told to forget her name and was renamed Magda Ellenstein. [From Helix Waltz Wiki]

characters.name: Eliza Ellenstein
characters.description: Eliza Ellenstein was once a socialite herself in her youth until her family fell into disgrace. Ten years prior to the events of the game, Eliza took the protagonist out of the Slum after a great fire left Magda orphaned. Eliza renamed her newly adopted daughter Magda, and raised her to be a refined young lady with the help of Duke Sakan. Despite adopting her daughter for the purpose of re-establishing the Ellenstein family in the Senate, she loves and worries about her dearly. [From Helix Waltz Wiki]

characters.name: Lynna Jorcastle
characters.description: Illegitimate daughter of the Duke of Jorcastle, she was brought back to the declining family after her father's death. She has never been taken seriously by any of her relatives, so she started a life of luxury. Her character is domineering and she seems to see Magda as her imaginary enemy. [From Helix Waltz Wiki]

characters.name: Lawrence
characters.description: Servant to the Jorcastle family and loyal attendant to Miss Lynna. He accompanies Miss Lynna to wherever she may go. Any person who tries to do Miss Lynna harm will automatically become his enemy. Is there a possibility of befriending him? [From Helix Waltz Wiki]

characters.name: Nyx Bavlenka
characters.description: Nyx is the youngest daughter of Grand Duke Bavlenka. Although she is adopted, she has gained her father's favor. The duke wants her to be active in the social circles however, this shy bookish girl seems to have no clue about it. [From Helix Waltz Wiki]

characters.name: Demi
characters.description: Diane is a tailor who creates knock-off version of gowns of famous brands and serves the not-so-rich civilians. She is a very talented imitator.

characters.name: Barbara Sakan
characters.description: Barbara Sakan is the youngest member of the family. Her mother died a long time ago, and her father has been travelling the world ever since, so she has always been close with her brother, who is 7 years older than her. Barbara is about to turn 17 and is beginning to enter the social circles, but she isn't looking forward to it. She'd rather stay free to attack Sulla with her brother. Up until now, Barbara has chased away six suitors with her archery skills taught by her brother. Her marriage has become a big concern within the Sakan family. [From Helix Waltz Wiki]

title: Yonder World: Interview with the Void
tags: Both Male and Female Love Interests
description: Yonder World follows the story of Vellus, a young angel who has recently received her dream job in Heavens. After a series of disappointing and unfortunate events, she finds herself in a strange world, perpetually drenched in midnight moonlight, whose inhabitants consist of a singular mysterious and infinitely powerful entity, and her few "visitors". Help Vellus navigate a world full of lurking dangers and filled with melancholy, in her quest to find her way home. Perhaps along the way, she will learn to undo the knots in her heart and even others'. Or perhaps you will play a hand in plucking her fledgling wings and breaking her halo. [From Itch.io]

characters.name: Dethiral
characters.description: "You may allude to me as an Eldritch Being, for there is no explanation for my being that you might comprehend." Dethiral is the Mistress of Yonder World, or so you would come to understand. A literary enthusiast with a seemingly insatiable thirst for knowledge, the dark entity rules over an empty castle under a perpetual midnight. Alluring and terrifying, Dethiral possesses undeniable charms, yet exudes an air of melancholy in the melodic timbre of her voice. [From Itch.io]

characters.name: Aksan
characters.description: "I have lived a very long life. I have seen many start and complete their journey. You will just be another face, ultimately forgotten in the stream of Time." The Wandering Queen, Aksan, comes and goes from Yonder World for several purposes, one of which is to deliver new literary works to Dethiral. Glamorous, dangerous and resourceful, she carries many secrets in her confident strides. Aksan is a mystery that draws people's eyes, and a knife in the dark where none is looking. [From Itch.io]

characters.name: Cassius
characters.description: "It's cute you want to know me, but you should be careful who you let close. I'm a demon after all, there's a reason people fear us." Cassius, known as the Gilded Blade, seems no stranger to violence and dirty deeds. Still, this arrogant demon appears to have a scholarly side to him, as his visits to Yonder World are often spent alone in the laboratory. A sense of danger and intrigue lay behind Cassius' devilish smirk. [From Itch.io]

characters.name: Vellus
characters.description: "Me? I'm just your average angel, doing my part. I do love stories though... Don't tell anyone, but I'd love to write my own someday." Vellus is young for an angel, and has worked hard to prove herself and earn a high position amongst her kind. Still, an emptiness haunts her as she attempts to conform to the heavy expectations laid out for her. Sweet, naive Vellus, perpetually trapped in one way or another. [From Itch.io]

title: Tales Of Aravorn: An Elven Marriage
tags: Both Male and Female Love Interests
description: A few years after the events of Loren The Amazon Princess, a marriage is arranged between the princess of the moon elves, Lydia, and High Cleric Marian of Paqwana. The marriage is to be the first of its kind after many years, uniting an elf with a member of the Human Empire. Naturally, such an important marriage has the potential to attract enemies among the elves and within the Empire. But there are others who'd also like to see the marriage fail such as the succubus, Jul, and the Death Knight, Zeal. Concerned about the risks involved, the Council of Grimoire asks Apolimesho to once again seek out the help of Elenor/Saren and put them in charge of escorting Lydia on her journey to Triberg. It'll be their responsibility to make sure that she arrives there safely so that the marriage can proceed without issue. [From Steam]

title: summer haze/glory days
tags: Both Male and Female Love Interests
description: Return to the Summer of 2007... Once somewhat of a local legend in their hometown, Mallory turned down a record deal in favour of a scholarship a decade ago. To say that they felt a bit of regret would be an understatement; they spent the bulk of their university years watching their former band mates sell out shows and records, stewing in bitterness the whole time. After several years of rejection and struggling, they've finally gotten a second chance in their grasp — only to question whether it's something they even want anymore. [From Steam]

characters.name: Mallory Law
characters.description: After years of hard work, Mal has finally gotten everything they've always dreamed of: their band, No Prospects, landed a coveted spot on the 2007 Friends and Foes summer tour, and their latest single has been picked up by some big radio stations. So they should be happy, right? [From Steam]

characters.name: Emerson
characters.description: The bassist of The Fractured — the current band that's on the playlist of everyone who's in-the-know. Most would consider Emerson's quiet and withdrawn nature ill-suited for the spotlight, so it's fortunate that he seems to get overshadowed by the rest of his group. [From Steam]

characters.name: Di
characters.description: Mallory’s best friend from university who was dragged into No Prospects largely against her will. Despite her initial reluctance, ever-critical Di has since given her all in every single performance – and won’t hesitate to point out anyone she believes to be dead weight. [From Steam]

characters.name: Beckett
characters.description: An old friend of Mallory's from their teenage basement show years. Having spent the past decade turning down permanent positions in favour of juggling odd jobs with occasional freelance session work, Beckett surprised everyone when he joined No Prospects. [From Steam]

characters.name: Lucas
characters.description: A last minute addition to No Prospects after the abrupt departure of their previous guitarist, Lucas struggles to keep his head above water in a sea full of industry veterans. What he lacks in technical skill, he more than makes up for in pure enthusiasm. [From Steam]

title: Coalesce
description: "At the end of the day, I always blamed my weak body for it. There wasn't a single day where I didn't resent it." Asa Argyris woke up finding herself in a snow white room with nothing but a bed. All she remembered was her name and a man's death. There were scientists looking over her, watchful eyes constantly observing her every movement. She also found out that she couldn’t exactly die. That there was something planted inside of Asa. Whatever it was, it could prevent her from death. How exactly did she get herself into this predicament, Asa wondered. Nobody around her was trustworthy. The only thing she could safely rely on was herself and her lost memories. [From itch.io]
