characters.description: The best friend of Utsuya Madoka since the second year of middle school. Nitogi cherishes Utsuya, having feelings for her; however, she will not confess as she doesn't want to risk losing Utsuya as a friend. During her middle school years, she accidentally caused a fire that ended Utsuya's mother's life. Now, she does all she can to protect Utsuya, not wanting her to be hurt by anyone. ~!In order to protect Utsuya, Nitogi murders anyone who has the potential to hurt Utsuya.!~

characters.name: Utsuya Madoka
characters.description: A friend of Nitogi Amane since the second year of middle school. Utsuya is a kind person that enjoys her time with Nitogi. She's been picked on by others due to a couple students going missing, classmates saying she caused it. Her mother died in an accidental fire. ~!Utsuya has wanted revenge for her mother's death due to Nitogi's mistake. She knows Nitogi loves her, though she wishes for Nitogi to suffer in the flames of jealousy.!~

characters.name: Kanzaki
characters.description: A classmate of Utsuya and Nitogi. Kanzaki bullies Utsuya due to the students that went missing have a connection with her. ~!Kanzaki is later killed by Nitogi for being a nuisance.!~

title: Makoto no Momoka
description: A love story between two frustrating adult women. Note: Originally published in Comic Yuri-Hime November 2021 issue.

title: Koi yori Aoku
description: Takamine, who can't find anything that interests her, and Sakura, who loves books, met by chance and started spend their after-school hours together. Are they friends? Or is it another kind of youthful relationship that they are weaving together? (Source: COMIC OGYAAA!!, translated)

title: Asahi to Satsuki
description: Cool x Cool = Super Cute Rumor has it that there are two students at a high school's basketball team known as the "Top Two." (Source: Ichijinsha, translated)

title: Majo ga Koisuru 5-byoumae
description: The curse that can be loosened if kissed and the curse that cannot be resolved is just the kiss.

characters.name: Meg
characters.description: A witch nicknamed as "The Untouchable Sorceress". She's solitary, and likes to be mischievous and make trouble in the forest for Lilith.

characters.name: Lilith
characters.description: A top-class Witch Hunter.

title: Innocent Devil
title_original: INNOCENT-DEVIL イノセントデビル
description: Jack the Ripper; Ed Gein; Andrei Chikatilo; John Wayne Gacy; Jeffrey Dahmer - separate from these serial killers who shocked the world, there exist offenders known as "Innocent Devils", who murder without malice. A criminal psychologist and her beautiful assistant probe the depths their minds.

title: Lycoris Recoil Koushiki Comic Anthology: Reload
title_original: リコリス・リコイル 公式コミックアンソロジー リロード
title_en: Lycoris Recoil Official Comic Anthology: Reload
description: Missions, mixers, and midnight snack runs-there's never a slow day at Café LycoReco! Find out what's new on the menu for Chisato, Takina, and company in this official comic anthology! (Source: Yen Press)

characters.name: Takina Inoue
characters.description: Previously an exceptional Lycoris, but for some reason, she now works at Café LycoReco. A realistic person with a distaste for inefficiency, she can be dissatisfied with [Chisato](https://anilist.co/character/260329/Nishikigi-Chisato), who is not a typical Lycoris. She wants to see good results in her job at LycoReco.

characters.name: Chisato Nishikigi
characters.description: Chisato is said to be the strongest Lycoris of all time. She enjoys solving private-sector problems that the DA would not address. At Café LycoReco, she works joyfully and cheerfully as the self-proclaimed poster girl. ~!Chisato has an artificial heart which was developed by Alan Institute, and can be broken by applying high voltages directly to it.!~

characters.name: Mizuki Nakahara
characters.description: Previously a DA Intelligence Division member, she’s been with Chisato for a long time. In her desperate desire to marry, she took the job at the café in hopes of meeting her special someone. Her routine includes a nightly drink while reading wedding magazines.

characters.name: Kurumi
characters.description: A young runaway girl of unknown origins who loves all kinds of games. She’s a terrible employee who reluctantly works in exchange for lodging. She only looks forward to gaming parties with the café’s regulars come closing time. ~!In some later episodes, it is revealed that Kurumi is actually the hacker Walnut.!~

characters.name: Mika
characters.description: Lamenting the worsening of his eyesight as he grows older day after day, he is the surrogate parent gently overseeing his problematic employees. Ohagi mochi and coffee, Japanese clothing and a café. It’s all about expressing a mix of Japanese and Western styles. He is the manager of the café with a traditional Japanese twist, "Café LycoReco”. ~!In episode 7 of the anime, it is revealed that Mika is gay.!~

title: Witchcraft
description: On-going series of spells, magic, charms and curses...oh yeah and lots of sex as well. One Mochizuki Kaoru hides from bullies chasing him inside a fortunetelling shop owned by one Kagami Kyoko. Kyoko tries out one of the spells she's been studying on poor, meek Kaoru and the results brings out more than just Kaoru's aggresive persona. The charm's side-effects also makes Kaoru blessedly-equipped not to mention perpetually ready to keep on going. Kyoko uses and studies Kaoru under the guise as one of her "assistants".

title: You Xun Ran Shi Youxi Fei Zenmeban
title_original: 幼驯染是游戏废怎么办
description: The daily lives of a gamer and her girlfriend.

title: Dang E Yi Yu Dao Bing Jiao
description: A yuri story about a yandere commoner × villainess lady. When the arrogant noblewoman He Sha tried to bully the commoner girl Qiao Lin out of jealousy, the yandere Qiao Lin turned the tables and took her first kiss instead. At first, He Sha just wanted to get back at Qiao Lin by playing pranks on her, but eventually it became an excuse to try to attract Qiao Lin's attention… The more the villainess tries to mess with the yandere, the more the yandere returns the favor, which only makes the villainess more tsundere. (Source: Bilibili, translated)

title: Succubus ja Nai Mon!
title_original: サキュバスじゃないもん！
description: Adjusting to a new school is always rough, and that goes double for Sakura, a shy human who is transferred to an academy that’s monster girls only! Sakura’s new classmates include a kiss-curious harpy, a sarcastic lamia, a cyclops who has her eye on Sakura, and a plain-spoken centaur who treads cautiously down hallways full of lusty demons. Eager to blend in, and with a body that convinces, Sakura lies and declares herself a succubus. But can she keep up the ruse, and keep her new friends’ hands, claws, and scaled coils off her? It’s going to be one long, hot school year! (Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

characters.name: Sakura Yamamura
characters.description: Sakura Yamamura is a shy but cheerful girl. Previously couldn't attend school because of her sickly constitution. Now in better health, she enrolls as a first-year in a school meant only for Ajin students. Fearing that she might not be welcome as a human, she lies and tells her peers she is a succubus and as such, has to put on the facade that she is one!

title: Love Live! School idol project
title_original: ラブライブ! School idol project
description: Positioned in the midst of Akihabara, Kanda and Jinbocho, the traditional Otonokizaka Academy is on the brink of reorganization. Nine girls rise up to this school crisis! In order to save the school, the girls have decided to... become idols!? The girls' challenges start here... (Source: Kadokawa, translated)

characters.name: Rin Hoshizora
characters.description: __Height:__ 155cm Rin appears to be a bit of a tomboy, though with a girly streak. She likes sports and is arguably the most athletic member of μ's, on par with Eli. Like Honoka, Rin is very energetic, hard-working and active. One key difference between her and Honoka, however, is that Rin is known for being very mindful of other people's opinions, as she puts their feelings first before taking action into something.

characters.name: Kotori Minami
characters.description: __Height:__ 159 cm Kotori is known for having her head in the clouds. Despite this, she is μ's designer along with [Nico Yazawa](https://anilist.co/character/46163/Yazawa-Nico). Kotori has a very huge aptitude for fashion and is very good at drawing costumes for the group. Kotori is shown to be very kind and supportive to her friends and genuinely cares about them, especially their feelings. However, this can go too far as Kotori usually backs [Honoka](https://anilist.co/character/46171/Kousaka-Honoka) up when she is scolded by [Umi](https://anilist.co/character/46167/Sonoda-Umi). Kotori is also shown as the most indecisive person among all nine members and tends to have her friends make decisions for her. She also has a hard time expressing her feelings, since she always takes other people's feelings into consideration.

characters.name: Hanayo Koizumi
characters.description: __Height:__ 156 cm A shy girl who dreamed of being an idol since she was very young; Rin and Maki finally convince her to join µ's.

characters.name: Nico Yazawa
characters.description: __Height:__ 154 cm Nico has been observing [Honoka's](https://anilist.co/character/46171/Kousaka-Honoka) new Idol group for a while but eventually joins them. She has past experiences as an amateur school idol. At first, she was secretly the President of the school's unknown Idol Research Club, but after an incident, the club was later joined together with Honoka's Idol Club. She likes bossing people around and acting superior, but she also has an energetic and cheeky personality.

characters.name: Maki Nishikino
characters.description: __Height:__ 161 cm Maki Nishikino is a first-year​ high school student in Otonokizaka High School. She has a beautiful voice and loves jazz music more than anyone else in the group. At first, she didn't want to join µ's because she had decided to inherit their family's hospital and take up medicine in college, but after joining forces with Rin to push Hanayo to join, she decides to follow the same path and join along with her two fellow first years.

characters.name: Umi Sonoda
characters.description: __Height: __159cm Umi is normally a shy girl, but she has a strong will and some qualities of a leader. Despite this, she is content to stay reserved and always thinks logically. Umi is uncomfortable with wearing short skirts but gets used to it after their first live. Although Umi tends to be hard on others, she is especially hard on herself. She doesn't do anything criminal and despises laziness.

characters.name: Nozomi Toujou
characters.description: __Height:__ 159 cm Nozomi is the vice-president of Otonokizaka High School. She is the best friend of [Eli](https://anilist.co/character/46173/Ayase-Eli). She is also a Shrine Maiden in a temple because she believes that a shrine is the source of people's faith. Eventually she will join the school idol club with Eli and will be one of the most successful school idols. (Source: Character Book)

characters.name: Honoka Kousaka
characters.description: __Height:__ 157 cm Honoka is the main character, who is a second-year student at Otonokizaka Academy. Her family works in a japanese sweet shop named Homura. When Otonokizaka Academy is planned to be shut down due to lack of applicants, Honoka becomes determined to save it by starting up a school idol group. Honoka also has a knack for finding loose change on the ground. Since she was young, she has been friends with [Kotori](https://anilist.co/character/46013/Minami-Kotori), and she befriended [Umi](https://anilist.co/character/46167/Sonoda-Umi) after inviting her to play hide and seek. ~!In Season 2, she becomes the new Student Council President by everyone's recommendation.!~

characters.name: Eli Ayase
characters.description: __Height:__ 162 cm Eli Ayase is the student council president of the Otonokizaka High School. Along with her best friend, [Nozomi](https://anilist.co/character/46169/Toujou-Nozomi), they do plans so the closure of the school could be prevented. She is partly Russian because her grandmother is a Russian. Alongside Nozomi, they join the school idol group for the prevention of their schools closure.

characters.name: Tsubasa Kira
characters.description: A member of A-RISE.

characters.name: Yukiho Kousaka
characters.description: Yukiho is Honoka Kousaka's younger sister. She is best friends with Eli Ayase's little Sister Alisa and they are both in the same middle school class together.

characters.name: Anju Yuuki
characters.description: Anju Yuuki, is a girl with a sweet voice and has a princess look to her. She is member of A-Rise school idol group. (Source: Love-Live Wikia)

title: Yuri Moyou: Sakimiya 4-shimai no Koi
title_original: 百合もよう～咲宮4姉妹の恋～
description: The four Sakimiya sisters all have their own love lives to deal with when it comes to being in love with other women. The eldest Ryou is dating her student Hikari, the second sister Serina has feelings for one of her coworkers, the third sister Yuika likes her childhood friend Miu, and the fourth sister Mizuki is going out with Tachibana, her teammate on the basketball team. Chapter count includes two extras.

title: Aisarete mo Iinda yo
title_original: 愛されてもいいんだよ
description: Kimura Rin is a young office worker who's constantly harassed, bullied and otherwise spends her time at work suffering. With no future ahead of her, and nothing she wants to do, she wonders why the world hurts her this way... Until, after an incredible night with an incredible woman, she decides to become a lesbian escort.

title: Musume no Iede
description: The remarried mother. After their divorce, the father who lives with his "boyfriend". Living surrounded by such family, highschooler Mayuko is now at the height of her adolescence. Beginning from Mayuko's "runaway", intersecting various life, these are the runway story which will dye in to your heart.

title: 15-sai
description: Third year middle school student Anna has begun living with fourth year college student Ema, and is swung about by the tactless Ema. Drawn in by the romantic designs of Ema, the once perfectly ordinary Ema, is brought into the adult world. And then, she is shown the scene of a kiss between two girls...

title: Toumei na Usui Mizuiro ni
description: Ritsu is willing to do anything for her best friend Ichika, including the intimate act of cleaning her ears. But when Ichika starts dating a boy, Ritsu realizes that she wants to be more than friends. Will Ichika push her away when Ritsu reveals her innermost feelings? (Source: Seven Seas Entertainment) Note: Chapter count includes 2 extras.

title: Fujiyuu Sekai
description: Reo and Meiko were friends in high school. However, now Reo is serving as Meiko's slave, doing whatever Meiko requests. The story uncovers why their relationship turned out this way.

title: Tonari no Seki ga Suki na Hito Datta: Gakusei Yuri Anthology
title_original: 隣の席が好きな人だった 学生百合アンソロジー
description: New semester, seat change. If only I could be seated next to the girl I like... This yuri anthology is filled with the thrill of adolescence. All 8 stories are newly drawn originals! (Source: Ichijinsha, translated)

title: Mimi Mix!
description: In a not so distant future it's become a fashion boom to attach ears. This spring, after having become a high school student, Midorino Nono has finally convinced her parents to let her have her sought after Attached ears debut♪ However, a powerful unique effect happens~ A huge disaster! When she has rabbit ears attached, she gets taken over by their sexual desire and becomes very ecchi!? Mikan of the ear attaching shop, and Nono's desired Neon-chan who is also Mikan's childhood friend get caught up in this, and the curtain on Nono's crazy attached ear life is raised!!

characters.name: Nono Midorino
characters.description: Nono just got into high school and is looking forward to getting a set of animal ears. However, after taking a compatibility test she finds out she is unable to get a new pair because of the side effects it would cause.

characters.name: Neon
characters.description: Neon is an easily embarrased high school girl with bunny ears. She is the daughter of a Patissier, and as such has a lot of experience baking. She often delivers cakes and helps out at Petit Lapin

characters.name: Mikan
characters.description: Mikan is the daughter of the owner of Petit Lapin, a former doctors clinic turned into a cafe/animal ear surgery clinic. With her extensive knowledge on animal ears, she helps customers choose which ears to get.

characters.name: Chika Kaburagi
characters.description: Chika is the number one idol, and is resposible for the boom in popularity of animal ears.

title: Chosanggwon Juuibo
description: “It looks the same as the ideal type in your imagination!” One spring day when cherry blossoms are in full bloom, “Bo-Mi,” a freshman in high school who was alone in an empty art department, she pours all her ideals and draws a fictional character, surprised to learn that the person in my imagination looks the same as Hae-Yoon, a handsome, tall, athletic senior in the nation’s rankings for the practice test. Hae-Yoon appears in front of Bo-Mi, who is worried about the infringement of her portrait rights, and Bo-Mi is thrilled at Hae-Yoon's request to continue drawing herself... (Source: Peanutoon)

title: Unnie tte Yonde mo Ii desu ka?
title_original: オンニって呼んでもいいですか？
description: As a diehard K-pop fan, Natsuki has spent every day in tears since the main vocalist of her favorite girl group retired and vanished from social media. That is, until her coworker hits her with a truth bomb—is Natsuki really going to spend the rest of her life waiting for her idol to come back?! Filled with new energy, Natsuki downloads a dating app. Except the first woman she matches with…looks just like her fave?! (Source: Yen Press)

title: Souieba Sonna Koto
title_original: そういえばそんなこと
description: A girl secretly has feelings for Hinako Hanamura, a girl with big, beautiful eyes. She tries to talk to Hinako, but she can't get the courage to speak to her. But it is her classmate Airi who speaks to Hinako first. Seeing Hinako look so happy to be talked to, the girl who shows a lonely look on her face is sad.

characters.name: Airi Sezaki
characters.description: She places heavy importance on her social standing, and puts lots of effort into maintaining popularity and a clean image around her classmates. However, this behavior is mostly an act: she reveals her true self in private, where she puts Hinako through various degrees of suffering for her own amusement. She can be described as a perverted, sadistic and manipulative person. ~! Later, she sinks into a deep depression and becomes highly dependent on Hinako. She eventually runs away with Hinako and tries to commit double suicide with her. !~

title: Sabori nara Hokenshitsu de Douzo?
title_original: サボりなら保健室でどうぞ？
description: "Do you want to skip class with Sensei?" "I'm fine!" Miyake Mia has always worn the mask of an exemplary student. Recently, however, there is someone who draws a lot of attention to her. That's nurse Morikubo, who is rumored to be a "delinquent" within the school.... A pure love story between a high school student who hides her true self and a delinquent "nurse teacher"! (Source: Ichijinsha, translated)

title: Kuchibeta Shokudou
description: For five years, she's been eating at the same restaurant, but she doesn't feel comfortable saying anything to the restaurant owner, who wants to talk to that regular customer but doesn't know what to say. Their feelings are obvious, but they just can't find a way to express their love for each other yet. (Source: ComicWalker, translated) Note: Originally self-published on Twitter, it was picked up for commercial publication on December 10, 2021.

title: Sukeban Deka
description: Saki Asamiya is a fearsome high school delinquent imprisoned in an inescapable juvenile detention center. Her chance at freedom comes when she accepts a deal from the police: infiltrate Japan's elite schools to investigate crimes the cops can't touch, and her mother will be spared from execution. Undercover as a regular student, Saki sets off to unmask criminal conspiracies, wielding a custom steel yo-yo as she faces off against corrupt teachers and scheming students. (Source: Omoi)

characters.name: Saki Asamiya
characters.description: The bitter heroine of the story. Saki is a natural born fighter who enjoys getting into scuffles with various people. She never backs down and is very stubborn.

characters.name: Remi Mizuchi
characters.description: The eldest daughter, a beautiful blonde who is completely ruthless and sociopathic. When Remi first arrives at the high school, many of the students admire her because of her striking beauty. However, throughout the entire Sukeban Deka manga series, Remi serves as a deadly antagonist to Saki. She seems to be the least dangerous of the three but in fact is the most. ~!She is responsible for Junko's death, setting up Ayumi's death with a malfunctioning shotgun to fight Saki, and a brainwashed assassin to kill her father Gozo and sister Emi.!~ (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Ayumi Mizuchi
characters.description: The dark haired middle child of the Mizuchi family. She has four hulking bodyguards who follow her around for protection. Ayumi is a drug addict and dealer, and is extremely greedy. However, she is the least evil out of the Mizuchi sisters. Despite her cold demeanor, she is loyal to her father and sisters. ~!In the OVA she is betrayed and killed by Remi, who gives her a malfunctioning shotgun that backfires, and steals all her money.!~ (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Kyouichirou Jin
characters.description: Saki's mentor.

characters.name: Emi Mizuchi
characters.description: The youngest sister who is an artist. Emi is an egomaniac who sees herself as a great artist when at best her talent is borderline, which leads her to use her father's influence to bribe judges and copy the works of other artists. Emi steals Junko's work and copies from it to win an art contest. ~!In the OVA she is killed by a brainwashed assassin along with her father sent by Remi.!~ (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Sanpei Nowaki
characters.description: Saki's ardent admirer who follows her all over the school campus. (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Gouzou Mizuchi
characters.description: The patriarch of the antagonist Mizuchi crime family. (Source: Wikipedia)

title: Ebisu-san to Hotei-san
title_original: エビスさんとホテイさん
description: An office worker, Hotei, is not pleased when high-flyer Ebisu is transferred to her branch. (Source: Lililicious)

characters.name: Chizuru Hotei
characters.description: Chiizuru is a typical girl: She loves clothes, kids and- "Shrimp Mayo". She is a part time worker at a corporation where she meets the person se hates most in the world- Ebisu Mayo. Chiizuru, at first, is mean in any way, shape or form to Ebisu. Slowly she develops mysterious feelings for Ebisu that are practically cemented after Chiizuru starts to help take care of Hana, Ebisu's niece.

characters.name: Mayo Ebisu
characters.description: In the beginning of this manga, Ebisu was working at the main branch of the corporation that both she and Hotei were working under. However, due to obligations to her niece who, due to her sister's immaturity, cannot be taken in by anyone else and so Ebisu moves to a smaller branch to compensate. Ebisu is distant, talented and young, making her the butt of all jokes and hated among her co-workers. Eventually through kindess on both sides, Ebisu and Hotei start a relationship and move to Tokyo to care for all the girls' needs.

title: Ramen Daisuki Koizumi-san
title_original: ラーメン大好き小泉さん
description: Ramen and manga are two Japanese things that people love everywhere around the world. But no one's ever brought them together before—until now! Let cool, mysterious high school student Ms. Koizumi and her girlfriends show you around the authentic ramen culture of everyday Japan in this fun food manga. The noodles, the toppings, the broth—the street stalls, restaurants, and home cooking... and yes, cup ramen too! You'll slurp down a whole new knowledge of Japan's greatest fast food that even many Japanese don't know... but Ms. Koizumi does! (Source: Dark Horse)

title: Kannazuki no Miko
title_en: Kannazuki no Miko: Destiny of Shrine Maiden
description: Shy Himeko adores Chikane, the gorgeous and cool "princess" of their exclusive boarding school. She's been looking forward to their joint sweet sixteen birthday party for weeks. But on that fateful day, a shrine appears in the sky, giant robots ravage the school, and Himeko discovers that she is the reincarnation of the Solar Priestess--and Chikane is the reincarnated Lunar Priestess. As dark secrets unravel, one thing is clear: their lives will never be the same... (Source: VIZ Media)

characters.name: Chikane Himemiya
characters.description: The Lunar Priestess; in sharp contrast with Himeko, Chikane is a very commanding girl of the same age. She has a very noble and elegant aura, lives in a large mansion with many maids, and is considered to be of the highest standing at their school; she has a considerable fan following of both genders and is the frequent target of love confessions. She is a member of the prestigious kyudo (Japanese archery) club and frequently uses the bow as her weapon of preference during confrontations with the Orochi. Chikane is also exceptionally skilled in the areas of tennis and, more significantly, the piano; she apparently enjoys playing for Himeko, who enjoys listening to her perform. Many at school believe she has a relationship with Sōma, though this is proven to be untrue. ~! She has been in love with Himeko since they first met, although she does not reveal it until much later on. She eventu

characters.name: Himeko Kurusugawa
characters.description: The Solar Priestess, Himeko is a very shy, innocent girl, and the character that receives most of the anime's attention. At first, Himeko has affections for Sōma Ōgami, who is her childhood friend. She starts off considering Chikane a very close friend, although the two very rarely meet outside of secrecy. Himeko is an amateur photographer of some skill, a hobby she developed thanks to the support she receives from Chikane Himemiya. Himeko is initially a shy and timid girl, uncertain of her own worth and abilities. This is mainly because after the death of her birth parents, she was initially adopted by abusive relatives before being moved to other relatives. At school, Himeko seems to have only one friend (except Souma and Chikane), her dorm roommate Makoto.

characters.name: Souma Oogami
characters.description: The Seventh Neck (七の首, Nana no kubi), he is the only Orochi who was able to resist becoming completely evil. Sōma is the lone protector of Himeko and Chikane for most of the series and later plays a part in bringing the Orochi down. He has a very high social standing at their school, comparable to Chikane's, and most of their fellow students believe they are dating, though in truth they rarely interact until the Orochi events. ~!Like Chikane, he is in love with Himeko and is incredibly protective of her, fighting to keep her safe until he is overwhelmed by the Orochi curse and put out of action, though he is later rescued by his brother Tsubasa.!~

characters.name: Tsubasa
characters.description: The First Neck (一の首, Ichi no kubi), he is considered to be the leader and the most powerful of the Orochi. Tsubasa is a tall teal-haired bishōnen, as well as a (presumed) sociopathic criminal with a long record, starting with the murder of his abusive father, whom he killed in order to protect his younger brother. ~!Tsubasa is also Sōma's biological older brother, having left the young child in the care of the Ōgami family when he went on the run. When all the other necks failed at taking his brother down, Tsubasa was ultimately successful. Sōma has few memories of him, and Tsubasa is hesitant to harm him seriously when they first fight; he is more focused on totally "converting" Sōma to the Orochi cause than killing the Priestesses.!~

characters.name: Otoha Kisaragi
characters.description: Chikane's personal maid, Otoha is loyal and devoted to Chikane to the point where it is heavily implied that the former may be in love with the latter. ~!When Himeko comes to live with Chikane, Otoha immediately notices the bond between the pair and grows intensely jealous, angered at Himeko for taking Chikane away from her and hurting her mistress. Aside from playing a humorous role and some very weighty scenes of her own in the series, she is a support character who clarifies how Chikane reserved her feelings for Himeko alone.!~ (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Izumi
characters.description: Izumi is the leader of a group of girls who are Chikane's biggest fans at school. She is very jealous about Himeko's close relationship with Chikane and she and her group resort to bullying tactics when Himeko even gets to stay at the Himemiya mansion, although they initially stop after witnessing Chikane's quiet fury at what they had done. She and her friends all tend to address Chikane as "Miya-sama".

title: Laika no Hoshi
description: Tale of the Soviet space dog Laika, who after being launched into Space, takes her revenge on humankind. Note: Includes "Sayonara Rarabai", "Ai no Shoudo" and "Kaitei Chakuriku".

title: Shen Wei E Yi Nü Pei De Wo Yang Cheng Bingjiao Nüzhu Hen Zhengchang Ba?!
title_original: 身为恶役女配的我养成病娇女主很正常吧？!
description: Jiang Yang is a game artist out gathering material for the game she was working on when she fell off a cliff and transmigrated into a world of immortal cultivation. She diligently cultivated her way to immortality, and she was about to ascend and return to her own world when a mysterious glitch caused her to transmigrate again, this time into a world of magic (like the start of an otome game). She met the main heroine, who was being bullied by the villainess at the Magic Academy, and that was when Jiang Yang realized that this is the world of the game she was working on? Now her fate is tied to Xin Lu, the heroine of the game. Jiang Yang thought that if she just beat the game, she can finally return home. But as the story progressed, she remembered all the over-the-top plotlines made up by the lousy writers, and she can't stand seeing Xin Lu suffer through it anymore. So she steps in and helps Xin Lu reject the playboy prince, teaches her cultivation techniques to fight off the bullies, and even seduces Xin Lu herself! As they become more intimate with each other, Jiang Yang starts to realize that her fate might intertwine with Xin Lu more than she realized… (Source: Bilibili, tran

title: 2 Nyeon 4 Wol
description: Sena's built the perfect life for herself. She a has a caring boyfriend, a job she actually enjoys, and all the comforts she could hope for. But behind her happy facade, she hides a past marred by a past relationship with another woman. Jinri isn't thrilled to be working at an office, much less to be running a department her father set up for her. She's spent years living a carefree live and adding to a long list of casual relationships with men and women. When these two meet, they'll have to re-evaluate their lives as well as the men and women they share it with. (Source: Lezhin US)

title: Kyaba Jou Dakedo JD ni Otosaremashita
title_original: キャバ嬢だけどJDに落とされました
description: Izumimori Yuki, who works at a cabaret club in Tokyo, hates being poor due to an incident in her childhood, and spends her days earning money by using her own customer service skills. One day, after drinking too much at a work event, she wakes up in an old apartment... and the person she spent the night with was a poor college student named Hotaru Kitakata. Yuki is shocked to find out that she is with a girl, but she can't help but be attracted to the pure-hearted Hotaru... "I thought life was all about money after all...!" A yuri comedy about the struggles of a cabaret girl who is attracted to a poor college student!

title: Sileun Yeoja
description: The daughter of a famous actress, Sungha is glamorous, confident, and beautiful. However, her relationships never last longer than one month, and most of the attention she gets is from…women? In order to get in a serious relationship with Mr. Right, she decides that she needs to prevent all women from falling in love with her. So when Sungha first sees the new transfer student, Rahee, she wants to make some things clear. “You’re not already in love with me, are you?" “Don’t worry. You’re the kind of person I can’t stand." (Source: Lezhin US)

title: Cocytus
description: 1-2. Cocytus (コキュートス) 3-4. Moratorium (モラトリアム) 5. Moratorium: Itsuki Saide (モラトリアム-ITSUKI saide-)

title: 45 Cho
description: Siyeon, who returns home after studying abroad for college, finds out about the 'Understanding Wine' course that her younger sister has picked for her. It's very popular because it's about tasting wine, but Siyeon is a lightweight that can't drink alcohol! When she decides to correct the course and attended it, she is reunited with her high school friend Eunha... !? (Source: Bomtoon, translated)

title: Uri Jibeseo Nagajuseyo
description: Cha Hong just got her dream job, assistant director on the set of a real TV series! This show stars the nation’s top actress, Noh Seung-ah, so cool! But when the director’s relationship with Seung-ah reaches a boiling point, he recruits Hong to keep watch over her 24/7 so she doesn’t ruin his precious show! But this young diva is not interested in being told what to do. Plus, keeping an eye on her actually means…they have to live together?! Is trying to tame this wildcard going to drive her insane and make her run for the exits or will the experienced Hong have some of her own tricks up her sleeve...? (Source: Lezhin US)

title: Ruriiro no Yume
title_en: The Conditions of Paradise: Azure Dreams
description: 1. Ruriiro no Yume (瑠璃色の夢, Azure Dream) A sweet story about two OLs named Mikuni and Ruri. Ruri is an 'ordinary woman' at the age of 28, dreaming of getting married and having a child named after a gemstone like she is—that is, until Mikuni and she sleep together one night after drinking. 2. Princess of the Stars (星のお姫様) Takes a look at the realities of being in a relationship. 3. Honey & Mustard (ハニー&マスタード) 4. Nostalgia (追憶) 5. Virgin Season (20乙女の季節) The next story in the 20-Musumex30-Otome series. Emi and Keiko have trouble finding time to spend together. 6. Mangetsu no Yoru ni wa (満月の夜には, On a Night When the Moon is Full) Keiko and Emi go on a trip together. 7. Soft-Boiled Fujoshi (半熟腐女子, Hanjuku Joshi side story) "Soft-Boiled Fujoshi" is about a minor character from Hanjuku Joshi. Moe is more important to fujoshi than love is... or is it?

title: LOVE VIBES
description: Shouji has a girlfriend but is seeing Mako on the side. Unable to continue pretending she feels less for him than she does, she breaks it off with him. Shortly before that happens, Mako is hit on by Mika, who tells Mako that she's interested in both men and women. Mika wants to pursue a relationship with Mako, but is Mako's relationship with Shouji really over?

title: Kanojo to Himitsu to Koimoyou
title_original: カノジョと秘密と恋もよう
description: A yuri comedy between two girls who seem different but are actually quite similar, each with a secret of her own. (Source: Ichijinsha, translated)

title: Prison Town e Youkoso!
description: The manga tells the story of Akari who for some reason ends up in a Prison City, where she meets the shy and mysterious Mary. Their relationship changes as Akari approaches her mysterious colleague.

title: Shoujo Manga Shujinkou x Rival-san
title_original: 少女漫画主人公×ライバルさん
description: Kimura-san wants to get close to her crush Mizushima-kun, but the beautiful and confrontational Hiyama-san has a problem with that... though it's not the kind of problem you'd expect from this scenario. Note: this is the pre-serialization version posted on the author's twitter and later released in volumes by Gangan Joker.

characters.name: Yurina Hiyama
characters.description: A rival in love who is both intelligent and always with Mizushima, and gets involved with Kimura at every turn.

characters.name: Honoka Kimura
characters.description: She is a plain and inconspicuous girl, like the protagonist of a girl's manga. She is in love with Aoi Mizushima, who is in the next class.

characters.name: Aoi Mizushima
characters.description: A friendly and popular boy. Kimura is secretly in love with him.

title: Seitokai Tantei Kirika
description: Kirika Hijiribashi is the Executive Committee Treasurer managing a high school Student Council budget of 800 million yen. She is also the only committee member with an additional title: Student Council Detective able to sniff out amazing solutions to bizarre cases. Hikage Makimura, who recently transferred into the high school, finds himself not only tricked into joining the Student Council, but is now assigned as her assistant.

title: Watashi Datte Seishun Shitai desu yo, Hontou wa.
title_original: 私だって青春したいですよ、本当は。
description: Her hobbies are reading, and she's average at studying and sports. Otobe Murasaki is a high school student who lives a quiet life, thinking she's just a mob character, but she doesn't like Fujimi Akiko, who is always the center of attention in the class. However, as soon as she becomes a member of the gardening committee like Akiko, she quickly falls in love with her, as she talks to her in a friendly manner. Just as she is wondering if there's any way she can get closer to her, she happens to come across Akiko crying after a breakup... A girls' love comedy about a simple mob character and a sparkling girl with a difficult future ahead! (source: Ichijinsha, translated)

title: Gal to Iinchou ga Guuzen Saikai Suru Hanashi
title_original: ギャルと委員長が偶然再会する話
description: Marina is on her way home after a night out. However, at the bus stop, she runs into a drunken woman, the former class rep from her high school days. Marina figures she wouldn't remember her, but while Marina is taking care of her, she drunkenly says, "Why did you use to avoid me...," in a deeply meaningful way? (Source: Tonari no Young Jump, translated)

title: Itoshi Koishi
description: Hina is a high-school student who enjoys cooking and is very sweet and kind. Unbeknownst to any of her friends, she is going out with a neighbor – an older woman – named Yayoi. Yayoi works at home and it is Hina’s great joy to make Yayoi food and gently scold her about taking care of herself. Yayoi knows she wants to marry Hina one day, and make this arrangement formal. (Source: Okazu) Includes seven extras.

title: Yuri na Kataomoi-chan
description: Yuina and Maya have been friends since kindergarten. They both like each other, but...? Note: The main story has 61 chapters, but the book includes 3 other short stories inside it. Kamai Kamaware Yuri Shimai (12 chapters) Ano Futari to Yuri Shimai (5 chapters) Chiisana Yuri no Hanashi (15 chapters)

title: Konohana Kitan
description: Welcome to Konohanatei! Your guide is Yuzu, the newest of the fox girls who work at the hot spring resort for supernatural creatures. The staff here live by one belief: no matter who one may truly be, no matter what, anyone who is a guest is a god. Of course, that includes you. Let the hospitality of Yuzu and the staff of Konohanatei heal your tired soul. (Source: INKR)

characters.name: Yuzu
characters.description: __Height:__ 130 cm The protagonist of the story. An innocent and hardworking country fox. She was brought up by Bikuni, and has a rather extensive knowledge of things.

characters.name: Satsuki
characters.description: __Height:__ 145 cm Yuzu's fellow attendant at Konohanatei; chosen to act as her mentor by head attendant Kiri. She's also Yuzu's roommate.

characters.name: Kiri
characters.description: __Species:__ Kitsune __Height:__ 147 cm The head attendant at Konohanatei. She has a relatively down-to-earth disposition.

characters.name: Sakura
characters.description: __Height:__ 125 cm One of Yuzu's fellow attendants at Konohatei. She's the quiet type, and has an unconventional way of doing her job.

characters.name: Ren
characters.description: __Height:__ 130 cm One of [Yuzu](https://anilist.co/character/123777/Yuzu)'s fellow attendants at Konohatei. She's more cynical than she seems.

characters.name: Natsume
characters.description: __Height:__ 157 cm One of Yuzu's fellow attendants at Konohatei. She has the most lax attitude towards the job out of them all. The most energetic of the attendants, her appearance, body, personality and behavior are all boyish to the point where she is at times outright mistaken for a boy at first glance.

characters.name: Tsubaki
characters.description: The owner of Konohanatei.

title: Starting Gate!: Uma Musume Pretty Derby
title_original: STARTING GATE! ―ウマ娘プリティーダービー―
description: A manga part of the Uma Musume Project by Cygames, a game and an anime. It follows Special Week, an aspiring horsegirl athlete-idol, as she transfers in to the Traincent Academy to follow her dreams. But will she be able to withstand the competitive environment that awaits her there?

characters.name: Silence Suzuka
characters.description: __Height:__ 161 cm The silent runner aiming to break the sound barrier. An Umamusume seen as a prodigy who's always ahead of the pack, both figuratively and literally. She gets so absorbed with running that she comes off as aloof, but most know that she is dedicated. She is roommates with Special Week and many find themselves attracted to her authentic personality.

characters.name: Special Week
characters.description: __Height:__ 158 cm Rar'n to go! A pure-hearted girl focused on her dream. Born in Hokkaido, Special Week is a bright and cheery, hardworking Umamusume. After losing her birth mother, Special Week was raised by her mother's friend. Now, she hopes to make both her moms proud by fulfilling her promise of becoming Japan's top racer. Though she may falter along the way, her indomitable spirit ensures that she runs ever forward.

characters.name: Oguri Cap
characters.description: __Height:__ 167 cm A coolheaded dreamer from the countryside. Originally hailing from the countryside, she enrolled in Tracen Academy after dominating the racing scene back home. She works to make her hometown proud, but try as she might, her clumsy side always comes out. At the academy, she's known as a fearsome gourmand, able to empty an entire pot of rice in the blink of an eye.

characters.name: Toukai Teiou
characters.description: __Height:__ 150 cm Unbeatable and adorable! A happy hoppin' racer. A bright, bubbly Umamusume with a natural knack for racing. She's long looked up to the student council president, [Symboli Rudolf](https://anilist.co/character/140844/Symboli-Rudolf), and this admiration serves as her ultimate motivation in becoming the number one racer. Fans can't get enough of Teio's boundless confidence, and have lovingly dubbed her upbeat march the "Teio Step."

characters.name: Daiwa Scarlet
characters.description: __Height:__ 163 cm Beyond arrogant! This hothead hates to lose. Unyielding, strong-willed, and cheeky, she wants to be number one at everything she does. She usually plays the role of the perfect, mild-mannered honor student, but the truth is that she hates losing more than anything else. If it'll help her be number one, she'll go through any training—no matter how grueling. She sees her rather showy roommate Vodka as both her motivation and her rival.

characters.name: El Condor Pasa
characters.description: The North American Phantom Bird! A vivacious and quirky lucha libre. A masked luchadora, she's always hyped up and ready to wrestle. She has ultimate confidence that she's the world's strongest Umamusume, and loves to proclaim that fact to anyone who'll lend her an ear. Her mask is a present from her pro wrestler father and she insists on keeping it on all the timeーno matter what. Her best friend and roommate, Grass Wonder, constantly scolds her for being too reckless. ~!As a fast umamusume who came from America with winning streaks of six, she quickly earns a place as one of the favorites of the audiences. But she came to a first loss on her seventh race.!~ ~!Later on, she went overseas to train for an upcoming race. She unfortunately lost against Broye in the race which made her strive harder to get faster and train even more.!~

characters.name: Vodka
characters.description: __Height:__ 165 cm Headstrong and full of life! A roadster with a heart of gold. Dedicated to being the coolest, this Umamusume tries her best to act like a delinquent. She takes after her motorcycle-loving father, emulating his hobbies and attitudes down to the letter. Her grandstanding nature sees her charge daringly into any challenge, never afraid of what she might face. She has a bit of a cat-and-dog relationship with her roommate, Daiwa Scarlet.

characters.name: Mejiro McQueen
characters.description: __Height:__ 159 cm The crown jewel of the prestigious Mejiro clan. A classy and poised young lady. Born into a family of racing legends, Mejiro McQueen is a long-distance runner who is the envy of her peers. She has class and decorum befitting her prestige, and is determined to take first at the Tenno Sho, like many Mejiro racers before her. On her days off, she enjoys having afternoon tea with the many other residents of the Mejiro estate.

characters.name: Narita Brian
characters.description: __Height:__ 160 cm (5'3") Actions speak louder than words! A tough and stubborn lone wolf. A member of team Rigil. A lone wolf of few words and ample strength, Narita Brian is feared throughout the academy due to both her personality and her performance on the turf. She has little interest in anything besides running, which she does only to quench her own endless thirst. Off the racecourse, she is [Biwa Hayahide's](https://anilist.co/character/174851/Biwa-Hayahide) little sister and, for some reason, a student council vice president.

characters.name: Symboli Rudolf
characters.description: __Height:__ 165 cm The reigning Emperor. Her rule is absolute! Well-versed in both ways of racing and leadership through her work leading the student body, she serves as the evenhanded president of the student council at Tracen Academy. She seeks to be a model Umamusume, and as such, is keenly aware of the example that she sets. Her dream is to foster a new era in which all Umamusume can live in true happiness. She is especially admired by Tokai Teio.

characters.name: T.M. Opera O
characters.description: __Height:__ 156 cm The pompous star of the stage. Her laugh fills the room! Opera O's behavior is always over-exaggerated, sometimes loudly, and you will often hear her proclaiming her greatness in some way or other. She seriously believes that those who do not know their own beauty and strength are unhappy, and she works tirelessly every day to enlighten them. She's friends with and admired by [Meisho Doto ](https://anilist.co/character/211557/Meishou-Dotou). A member of Team Rigil as well as rival to [Narita Top Road ](https://anilist.co/character/273332/Narita-Top-Road) and [Admire Vega ](https://anilist.co/character/273331/Admire-Vega).

characters.name: Air Groove
characters.description: The coolly calculating Empress. Highly gifted and ambitious. The vice president of Tracen Academy's student council, known to the other students as the "Empress". The daughter of an accomplished racer, she constantly strives to live up to her mother's racing prowess and ability to guide others. To this end, she has joined her friend and confidant, Symboli Rudolf, in the student council. Despite her strict schedule, she still makes time to tend the flowers in the garden.

characters.name: Fuji Kiseki
characters.description: __Height:__ 168 cm Always at your service. The classiest racer around. A dashing performer who never hesitates to take another runner gently by the hand. You won't catch her flirting, however. Instead, she helps her dear ponies in her capacity as leader of Ritto Dormitory. As a runner, she hopes to captivate audiences just like her mother, a stage actress. Her ultimate stage: the Triple Crown. In Seasons 1-3, she is affiliated with Team Rigil. In The Beginning of the New Era, she trusts [Tanabe](https://anilist.co/character/330959/Tanabe-Trainer)'s skills as a trainer more than anyone else.

characters.name: Grass Wonder
characters.description: Neat and sweet. Japanese at heart, she's back home from the U.S. Though born in America, her parents' love of Japanese culture influenced her to also love all things to do with the country—to the point of being called the spitting image of the ideal Japanese beauty. She speaks in a friendly manner and is easy to get along with, but her will is firm. Her determination to win is second to none. She shares a room with her close friend, [El Condor Pasa](https://anilist.co/character/125303/El-Condor-Pasa).

characters.name: Hishi Amazon
characters.description: You wanna go? One-on-one! The dorm leader everyone knows and loves. A hot-blooded racer who loves nothing more than a one-on-one fight. Though seen by most as a fierce competitor, she has the good grace to congratulate her opponents should they win. She is the rather hot-tempered leader of Miho Dormitory, and is proficient at cooking, cleaning, and laundry. Although generally reliable in just about any situation, you probably shouldn't mention the notion of ghosts or thunder around her. In Uma Musume: Pretty Derby she´s member of Team Rigil.

title: Yumekuri
description: Yugami Makoto likes to travel to different Hot Springs. On his 100th visit to a Hot Spring he meets a beautiful foreign girl in the bath. Stunned by her beauty, he immediately falls for her. But there is more to the girl than meets the eye. And why is Makoto forced to work at the Inn afterward? Note: Includes seven extra chapters.

title: Mahou Shoujo Ikusei Keikaku
description: Sugar and spice--but not playing nice! The manga based on the hit novel series! Magical girls like Snow White and La Pucelle have dreamed of the day they'd become one of the lucky few chosen to protect N City. But their dreams quickly turn into a nightmare when the Magical Girl Raising Project Management Office issues a decree--there are simply TOO MANY magical girls! Oops! Time to cull the number by...half? Half sounds good. Don't worry, retirement just means...you die. Good luck, girls! (Source: Yen Press) Chapter count includes chapter 5.5

characters.name: Koyuki Himekawa
characters.description: A middle school girl who had always dreamed of becoming a Magical Girl, sharing that dream with her childhood friend Souta Kishibe. She vowed to be a righteous and pure Magical Girl after transforming for the first time. Her ability allows her to hear the voices of anyone under distress. ~!She survives the elimination game without killing anyone. However, her ideology is shattered as a result of what she had seen. She now desires strength in order to prevent large scale conflicts.!~

characters.name: Kano Sazanami
characters.description: A high school student who lives alone. She wears ninja-style attire as her Magical Girl outfit. Her ability allows her to never miss a shot with her shurikens. ~!She lives through the events of the exam as a result of killing both Swim Swim and Fav, but loses both her left eye and arm.!~

characters.name: Souta Kishibe
characters.description: Souta Kishibe is a childhood friend of Koyuki's. He moved away from her school and became invested in playing soccer. He shares her love of Magical Girls and secretly wanted to be one. One day, his wish was granted and was transformed into La Pucelle. His magical ability is to alter the mass and size of his sword at will. ~!He is the third magical to die after being severely beaten by Cranberry and pushed in front of an oncoming car.!~

characters.name: Ayana Sakanagi
characters.description: Ayana Sakanagi is a quiet, young schoolgirl who idolizes Ruler, her Magical Girl mentor. She aspires to one day be just like her and is extremely obedient. As Swim Swim, her ability is to go through the ground and swim through it like water. ~!She is the fourteenth and final magical girl to die, killed by Ripple.!~

characters.name: Sanae Mukuou
characters.description: Sanae Mukuou is a Magical Girl (known as Ruler) that presides over four other Magical Girls (Swim Swim, Tama, Yunael, and Minael) in a temple. She is very strict and commanding, but deep down inside, she truly cares for her subjects. Her ability is to give a command that one must obey. ~!She is the second magical girl to die after being betrayed by Swim Swim and placing last in the second ranking.!~

characters.name: Tsubame Murota
characters.description: A former delinquent in her youth, Tsubame Murota is a Magical Girl with the ability to travel at incredibly high speeds on her broomstick Rapid Swallow. She often confides in Ripple and is friendly and outgoing. ~!She is the eighth magical girl to die after being stabbed in the back by Swim Swim. Her unborn child died with her.!~

characters.name: Ako Hatoda
characters.description: A young Magical Girl, she was recently chosen and became the 16th Magical Girl of N-City. She wears an Alice in Wonderland-style dress, draped in black as her Magical Girl Outfit. Her ability lets her regenerate any damage taken, allowing her to survive even beheading or dismemberment. ~!She picked up what she thought was her real bunny doll, turning out that it was Minael disguised as it. They used that to find her information, she was then followed and killed in her untransformed state by Swim Swim. She is the tenth magical girl to die.!~

characters.name: Fav
characters.description: The mascot character of the Magical Girl Raising Project social game and the familiar spirit who oversees the magical girl project.

characters.name: Nana Habutae
characters.description: A veteran N-City Magical Girl and Weiss Winterprison's lover. In real life, she is a sweet girl who lives with Shizuku. She has dedicated her career to protecting the city and bringing a message of peace. She wears a nun-like dress as her Magical Girl outfit. Her ability allows her to enhance a person's physical capabilities. ~!Following Winterprison's death, she commits suicide by hanging, becoming the ninth magical girl to die.!~

characters.name: Shizuku Ashuu
characters.description: A powerful N-City Magical Girl, as well as Sister Nana's lover. She wears a thick winter coat as her Magical Girl outfit. Her ability lets her create walls of any form, depending on the terrain. ~!She is the sixth magical girl to die due to blood loss, after being stabbed by Yunaelle and having her arm sliced off by Swim Swim.!~

characters.name: Makoto Andou
characters.description: A robotic Magical Girl who tends to care more about financial gain than helping others. Her ability allows her to obtain a random futuristic gadget from her backpack once per day, but even she cannot predict what it will be, and at the end of the day, it disappears. ~!After attempting to kill Snow White, she is killed by Hardgore Alice, becoming the fourth magical girl to die.!~

characters.name: Naoko Yamamoto
characters.description: A Magical Girl hired by the N-City's criminal underground. She wears a cowboy hat and has a wild-west style attire as her Magical Girl outfit. Her ability allows her to magically enhance any weapon she uses. ~!She is the seventh magical to die when she shot a piece of glass that Ripple threw at her, causing her to be impaled by the glass shards (in the anime, the shards were a distraction and she was killed by taking a shuriken to the head).!~

characters.name: Yuna Amasato
characters.description: One of the two "Peaky Angels" twins. She and her sister are allied with Ruler. She wears an angelic-style dress, and has one wing for her outfit. Her ability, complementing Mina's, allows her to shapeshift into any living being. ~!She is the fifth magical girl to die after she is killed by Winterprison, her head being smashed into a wall, breaking her skull.!~

characters.name: Mori no Ongakuka Cranberry
characters.original: 森の音楽家クラムベリー
characters.description: A recluse living within the ruins in the outskirts of N-City. Her outfit is decorated with wildflowers and leaves, and her appearance is that of an Elf. Her ability lets her control sound waves. ~!It is revealed that Cranberry was once a part of a previous magical girl selection exam, relishing in the thought of killing others and becoming Fav's master, changing the rules of the exam into lethal ones. She is killed by Tama when Cranberry is distracted at finding out that Swim Swim is only a child. She is warped by Tama's ability, causing her upper body to explode. She is the twelfth magical girl to die after being killed by Tama.!~

characters.name: Nemu Sanjou
characters.description: An unemployed, lazy girl, who still enjoys helping people. She wears pajamas and has cloud-like creatures coming out of her hair as her Magical Girl outfit. Her ability allows her to enter other people's dreams, helping to fight off any nightmares, gaining her Magical Candies in the dream world. ~!When the first results are announced, Nemu ends up with the lowest score and is eliminated from the running, deciding to use her remaining time to visit one more dream, which is later revealed to be Swim Swim's. After her time runs out, however, Nemu is found dead by her mother. She is the first magical girl to die.!~

title: Clover
description: The Tachibana family has four sisters, each of whom have had at least one relationship that involves falling for another woman, or having one fall for them.

title: Natsu to Lemon to Overlay
title_original: 夏とレモンとオーバーレイ
description: Sayaka Konno, a stunning office worker for a large company, asks voice actress YUNIMARU , who struggles to find work in her day job, to read her will at her funeral. Despite her reservations, YUNIMARU is intrigued by the sum of money and accepts the invitation. Dreams, daily life, and the wealth of life... Two people from different "layers" spend only one summer together, touching each other's wounds. (Source: Ichijinsha, translated)

title: Yuri Hime Wildrose
description: Volumes of steamy yuri one-shots. Volume 1 : (2007/10/18) #Cover illustration : Monchi Kaori (門地かおり) #Illustration : CHI-RAN 1. Suki Tokidoki Kiss (好きときどきキス) [Miyashita Kitsune] 2. Arcadia: Rakuen no Hana (アーケイディア～楽園の花～, Arcadia ~Flowers of Paradise~) [Mizuno Touko] 3. Onshitsu no Majo (温室の魔女, The Greenhouse Witch) [Mikuni Hadime] 4. Hao! (好!) [CHI-RAN] 5. Onnnanoko Awase (女の子合わせ, Girls' Union) [Morishima Akiko] 6. Kuchibiru ni No-se-te (くちびるにの・せ・て, From Your L-I-P-S) [Jounouchi Nene] 7. Ichiban Suki na Hito (いちばんすきなひと) [Tokitsukaze Otoha] 8. Girls Study [Harumi Chihiro] 3. Tojitete ne, Kokoro (閉じててね、心, Keep Your Heart Closed) [Rokuroichi] 4. Yurete Hazunde (ゆれてはずんで, Bounce and Sway) [Gyuunyuu Linda] 5. Heart And Soul [Nanzaki Iku] 6. title: Kono Ai wo Owarasete Kurenai ka
title_original: この愛を終わらせてくれないか
description: Yuzu is Hayami Madoka's ardent fan. Having no friends or family that care for her, Madoka is her only solace. Being that Sachiko is Madoka's best friend, she is Yuzu's most hated existence. To vent, she opens a secret account where she posts malicious comments about Sachiko. When she discovers this, she instead attempts to befriend Yuzu and offers her a chance to talk to Madoka. However, an accident occurs and they end up switching bodies with Sachiko being left in coma.

title: Ane ni Naritai Ane VS Yuri ni Naritai Imouto
title_original: 姉になりたい義姉VS百合になりたい義妹
description: One day, Shio arrives home to find that her mother has gotten remarried and is going on a business trip with her new husband, leaving Shio with her new stepsister Kafka. Being only a day older than Kafka, Shio is concerned that Kafka will try to take the big sister position from her. Kafka, on the other hand, is determined to make Shio, who was her first love, fall for her.

title: Koisuru Asteroid
description: Astronomy and geology are fun…! Mira, who promised to “find an asteroid” with the boy she found at the campsite as a child. She tried to join the astronomy club, but from this year the “astronomy club” and the “geology research society” merged into the “earth sciences club”!? Let’s go search for the asteroid that we promised to look for that day. (Source: Manga Time Kirara Carat, translated)

title: Murdist: Shikeishuu Kazami Tazuru
title_original: マーディスト-死刑囚・風見多鶴-
description: Tazuru Kazami is a death row inmate who murdered 89 people in just a few years. With her murders gaining a reputation as beautiful "art," the number of copycat crimes has recently skyrocketed and become a social problem. In the midst of this, the imprisoned Kazami offers to hand over information about the copycats on the condition that she speak to a certain someone. The young man she chooses is a run-of-the-mill college student.

characters.name: Tazaru Kazami
characters.description: A mass murderer who killed 89 people and is currently on death row. Her corpses are regarded as "works of art" by many people, so she's begun being called a Mardist. She has gained a great number of followers since she started committing crimes. Two years ago she, for unknown reasons, turned herself in. Her age, birthplace, and citizenship are also unknown.b She works with police and Yuuki Otobito - a college student she asked to speak with as a condition for providing clues to a major incident - the latest copycat crime. She knows about his past and family, and makes it clear by suggesting that she personally knew Yuuki's sister that has been missing for 7 years. She has many connections in the underground and seems to know many murderers - especially those, who are her admirers. She is very smart, she likes to play with Yuuki's mind and manipulate the environment for pleasure and enter

title: Blattodea
description: Alice Fujii still isn't having much fun. She survived an assault of psychotic bug-themed assassins at her school, but all the battles, the truth behind her family, the two betrayals from false friends who ended up dead and the loss of her Kumoito knife-gun took a toll on her mental state. As such, she spends her days alone splitting open the heads of the rapist zombies who overran Japan since the aforementioned incident. The Organization wants to hire her as their new Boss, and elsewhere her allies Gokiburi and Kabutomushi are looking for her. What will become of all this?

characters.name: Alice Fujii
characters.description: After her mother commited suicide, she had been living with her abusive uncle. On the day that her uncle was killed, the assasin "Kumo" took her in and trained her to kill. She has a disorder called C.E.C (Congenital Excessive Concentration), which means ones she focuses on one thing she is unable to focus on anything else especially what happens around her. Because of this, she had been the subject of criticisms, abuse and often seen as "dull". When she is faced with life-threatening situations, however; her reflexes and judgments are improved. Alice is normally kind, however, when in this mode, she becomes violent and believes that "before they kill her, she has to kill them". After killing Kumo, she was chased out of the apartment which belonged to "the organization" and is now living in Yori's house. She is also constantly targetted by other organization members.

characters.name: Oki Megumi
characters.description: A student in Alice's class and also a member of the Organization. Like her nickname suggests, she can quickly sense an attack and move out of the way like a cockroach. She also uses this ability, which she calls "Air Direction", to sense certain objects such as Alice's Kumoito. She wears her hair in twin tails and has two antennas which are shown to move when she sense the flow of air. A sadomasochistic girl, she likes being hated as much as she loves to abuse others.

title: citrus Comic Anthology
title_original: citrus コミックアンソロジー
description: Official anthology of the popular yuri manga Citrus. A collection of 17 oneshots. Story 1 : be careful not to play games to much (Eku Takeshima) Story 2: ear-nimal pandemic (Neji) Story 3: the things i want to watch with you (Kayako) Story 4: taboo (Kiyoko Iwami) Story 5: if (Aoto Hibiki) Story 6 : hair arrange (kurakawa) Story 7 : imaginery wedding (Naoko Kodama) Story 8: sweet time (Haruka Kiriyama) Story 9 : Hydrangea’s floriography (Yuuki Goto) Story 10 : love scream (Ameno) Story 11: blast (Miyami Oomiya) Story 12: M.I.B. Mei in black (kurauko) Story 13 : two sisters (Mako Takahashi) Story 14 dead or love (kino kiyuki) Story 15: Hathews (yuki yukio) Story 16 : have a bite (fujieda) Story 17 : wait for sleep… (yayoi osawa)

characters.name: Mei Aihara
characters.description: __Height:__ 162 cm Mei Aihara is an honor student, the chairman's granddaughter, and the stern and cold student council president. She is often calm and composed but she can be rather sensitive and mature to some extent. At first, there is little to know about her and a bad impression of Mei washes over [Yuzu](https://anilist.co/character/83367/Aihara-Yuzu), which causes Yuzu to take interest for Mei later on. Though Mei seems to be hard to approach, she is rather sensitive and lonely which makes Yuzu want to care for Mei more.

characters.name: Yuzu Aihara
characters.description: __Height:__ 159 cm The self-proclaimed Gyaru and only child, Yuzu transfers to an all-girls school after her mother is remarried. Yuzu is outspoken, daring, and shameless to some extent. She is often seen wearing her uniform that runs against the rules thus far. Unfortunately for her, she is bothered by the Student Council President's dress code enforcement. Yuzu eventually comes home to hear that she is now the older sister of the Student Council President, [Mei Aihara](https://anilist.co/character/83209/Aihara-Mei). Despite showing irritation towards Mei, she becomes concerned for her in which transitions into infatuation and deep care. Though she is rebellious in school, she means well and is often acting on behalf of Mei in a sense of protection. Also, her closest friend in school is [Harumin](https://anilist.co/character/83387/Taniguchi-Harumi).

title: Cylcia = Code
description: Kanata and his friends must find a way to return to their original bodies after they're trapped in the real world as their game avatars. Note: Includes 2 extra chapters.

title: Shoujo Kakumei Utena: Adolescence Mokushiroku
title_original: 少女革命ウテナ～アドゥレセンス黙示録
title_en: Revolutionary Girl Utena: The Adolescence of Utena
description: Elegance is a way of life at Ohtori Academy. For close to one hundred years, the elite boarding school has valued tradition and ceremony above almost everything else. Into this academic milieu walks Utena Tenjou, a short-stressed teenage girl who favors trim-cut boys' clothing. Almost immediately, she finds herself embroiled in sword duels, knotty romantic entanglements and a string of shady alliances. A cloud of mystery hangs over the campus of Ohtori, and everyone Utena meets harbors a dark and twisted secret. (Source: VIZ Media)

characters.name: Utena Tenjou
characters.description: Utena is a tomboyish, courageous and naïve character who lives to emulate the idealized prince figure from her childhood. She is forthright, honest, and friendly, and nearly all the girls in school adore her.

characters.name: Anthy Himemiya
characters.description: __Height:__ 157 cm A mysterious and shy dark-skinned girl whose sometimes vapid expression and superficial politeness seem to mask something deeper. Many people project their wants or desires onto her, and she's often the target of their eventual rage or hate. Her "doormat" behavior belies a far more complex personality. Anthy appears to house the Sword of Dios within her own body. At the beginning of a duel, she slips into a trance and the Sword manifests, protruding from her chest so that her champion may draw it from her. This Sword is said to be a key to reaching the goal of Revolution, and in her position as the Rose Bride Anthy is said to be the key to obtaining it.

characters.name: Akio Ootori
characters.description: Anthy's older brother, the acting chairman of the academy. Although barely present in the first season of the show, he later plays a pivotal role in the second and third seasons. His given name derives from the Japanese name for Venus, the Morning Star, which is identified with Lucifer.

characters.name: Chuchu
characters.description: Anthy's pet (whom she will only refer to as friend, but may be more properly described as a familiar). He is a small marmoset who acts as comedic relief. However, he also acts as an omen of bad fortune in certain episodes. ChuChu is drawn much furrier by Chiho Saito in the manga than he is drawn in the anime, the anime itself making him look more like a mouse than a monkey.

characters.name: Miki Kaoru
characters.description: __Rose Color:__ Blue Rose Bride: Kozue Kaoru Sword: Épée Drive to Duel: To find "that which shines" Miki is a highly skilled and polite seventh grader who befriends Utena, despite their role as possible opponents in the duels. A piano player par excellence, Miki has fond memories of playing songs with his twin sister Kozue in his childhood, but her refusal to play with him in the present — the symbol of a much deeper rift — gives Miki a sense of loss. His crush on Anthy in the anime (but on Utena in the manga) develops when he realizes that they remind him of his estranged sister. In both adaptions, his drive to duel stems from a desire to find something to replace Kozue in his affections. All the females of the school, even older ones, idolize him, but Kozue threatens any girls who attempt to get too close to him. Likewise he is very protective of her, and so she tries to make him jealo

characters.name: Juri Arisugawa
characters.description: __Rose Color:__ Orange __Rose Bride:__ Ruka Tsuchiya __Sword:__ Rapier __(Anime) Drive to Duel:__ To disprove the power of miracles The captain of the academy's fencing team, Juri is one of Ohtori's most highly respected students, and even the teachers appear to be in awe of her.

characters.name: Touga Kiryuu
characters.description: President of the Student Council, Touga is an arrogant and handsome young man whose desire to be powerful drives him to cruel and unscrupulous deeds. Although he says that he wishes to be noble, he has little empathy towards anyone, and his powers of manipulation are second only to Akio. He also shares his playboy attiude and has many female conquests. He is a childhood friend of Saionji, although their relationship took a turn for the worse at a point in their childhood that is the centerpiece of their respective personal journeys. ~!Toward the end of the series, however, Touga's facade of chivalry is replaced with an apparently truer concern for Utena, to the extent that he very subtly attempts to substitute his head for hers on Akio's chopping block. Arguably, this is also an example of Touga's inability to see Utena as who she really is, rather than in a stereotypical feminine role.

characters.name: Kyouichi Saionji
characters.description: __Sword:__ Sword of Dios, Katana __Drive to Duel:__ To find something eternal, to claim Anthy as his Rose Bride, and to finally defeat Touga (Anime) Vice-president of the Student Council and captain of the kendo team, and is the first duelist Utena fights. He is temperamental, egotistic, prone to angry rages, often cruel, and extremely possessive of Anthy. His belief that they are destined to be together no matter what drive him to be physically violent towards her and continue to pursue her even after their engagement is broken. He and Touga practice kendo together, but Saionji is clearly very resentful of Touga, and especially cannot bear to be humiliated by him (a fact which Touga shamelessly exploits). Saionji is less perceptive, intelligent, and skilled as Touga, and despite his best efforts can never seem to best him. He is regardless affected by this estrangement from his childhoo

characters.name: Kanae Ootori
characters.description: ~!__Sword:__ Rapier Drive to Duel: To get rid of her superficialty.!~ Akio's fiancee, daughter of the school's Trustee Chairman. She is unnerved by Anthy, who deliberately distances herself from Kanae. ~!When Kanae enters the Black Rose interview, she reveals that she finds Anthy to be creepy and intolerable. Her distrust for Anthy drives Kanae's hatred during her Black Rose duel with Utena, starting the cycle of the Black Rose duels.!~ ~!In the Final Saga of the manga, Kanae becomes a "Body Without Soul"; she doesn't move or speak and is always with Akio.!~ ~!Kanae only appears briefly in the Utena movie. She is seen dancing with Akio and later appears grieving over his body when it is discovered in the rose garden. !~

characters.name: Wakaba Shinohara
characters.description: __Height:__ 154 cm ~! Sword: Saionji's Katana Drive to Duel: To become special and destroy those who already are special.!~ Utena's best friend. Wakaba's cheerful personality hides an enormous inferiority complex, and she attaches herself to Utena and other people to feel important. In the first episode ("The Rose Bride") she refers to Utena as her "boyfriend." Utena first dueled Saionji after he posted a love letter that Wakaba gave to him in order to humiliate her. ~!During the Black Rose Saga, it is revealed that she was harboring Saionji after his expulsion from school. When he returns due to his obsession with Anthy, she feels betrayed and seeks Mikage. Taking revenge, she pulls Saionji's katana out of his body to duel Utena. In the movie, Wakaba appears only briefly. In her first scene, she gives Utena a tour of Ohtori Academy. Towards the end of the m

characters.name: Dios
characters.description: The enigmatic prince from Utena's childhood. Dios's name, which means "God" in Spanish, as well as his presentation in the anime, suggest that he is to be considered Utena's guardian angel. During most of the duels, it is shown that his spirit enters Utena's body and aids her. This is an indication that Dios may have been a skilled swordsman before his imprisonment. Despite his limited screen time, Dios is a central figure in the anime and is at the center of the plot.

title: Yuusha no Mago to Maou no Musume
title_en: Hero's Granddaughter and Demon Lord's Daughter
description: The former world was shattered by the war between humans and demon-kin. The only surviving royal of the defeated demons is the Demon Lord's daughter, Daqne, who returns to these former demon-controlled lands with bitter memories. There she meets and helps a black-haired girl named Sakurako. But that girl is a descendant of the same hated hero that demolished Daqne's family...! Read this road-to-royalty fantasy, created by a talented writer/artist! (Source: Alpha Manga)

title: Ta De Shan, Ta De Hai
description: Chi Tang and You Yu are both shunned outcasts in Year 1 Class 2 of high school. They are desk-mates, roommates, and each other's salvation, keeping each other warm. Their relationship gradually grow, from just a feeling into something unforgettable, an epic story of young love. (Source: Kuaikan, translated)

title: Marie Alex
description: "The negligence is not the fault of the master but of the servant". Marie, who will be punished in place of the Lady Alex who has no head for studying! As the hem of her long skirt is lifted, her beautiful and porcelain legs are revealed, the whip slashing through the air leaves painfully red marks on Marie's thin legs. Don't hit poor Marie. I should be the one to stop it. Huh? What? Something's strange? Why is my heart pounding? (Source: Bomtoon, translated)

title: Shuuden niwa Kaeshimasu
description: 1. Hiragana-sen, Aiu-eki yori (ひらがな線、あいう駅より, From Aiu Station on the Hiragana Line) Asaki has her life all planned out: she is going to win a beauty contest, become a newscaster, and marry into wealth. One day she is helped by a delinquent-looking girl named Tsune on the train and her plans begin to change... 2. Shuuden ni wa Kaeshimasu (I’ll send her home on the last train) 3. Shoujo Planetarium (少女プラネタリウム, Girls Planetarium) 4. Ishuun no Asterism (一瞬のアステリズム) 5. Eien ni Shoujo (永遠に少女) A ghost named Mizuki returns to her old home to discover a family she does not know. There, she meets a child named Misao who is the only person who can see or interact with her. This is the story of their relationship as Misao grows up. 6. Otona no Kaidan no Shita (大人の階段の下, At the Bottom of the Stairway to Adulthood) Natsu has never had a good relationship with her older sister, Aki, or her friends she always brings home. One day Aki brings home a girl that is quite a bit different than all the others and Natsu immediately likes her. When she overhears Aki and her friends talking about the new girl behind her back Natsu thinks, "If only she was my friend instead..." 7. Shoujo Seizu (少女星図, Girls Star

title: Kyou kara Mirai
description: Kyoko and Miku are childhood friends attending the same high school. One day, Miku confesses to Kyoko that she loves her. Miku tells Kyoko that she doesn't have to respond right away, but she wants her to decide whether or not to have a serious relationship with they graduate. Until then, Kyoko can do or say whatever she wants to Miku. The story of Kyoko and Miku, a thrilling love experiment between two girls, begins...! (Source: INKR)

title: Ni De Weidao You Dian Tian
title_en: Your Scent is a Little Sweet
description: Due to past psychological trauma, Tang Chao never developed secondary sexual characteristics, so she lived life as a beta working as a magazine model. After an accidental one-night stand with an omega, she found out that she felt strongly attracted to that omega. The next day she met a new colleague Li Zhixu, who seemed to be that omega. But... this Li Zhixu was suppose to be a beta? (Source: Bilibili, translated)

title: Agassiui Sigtag
description: Louann, working as a maid of the mansion, accidentally finds out the lady of the house's scary secret on her first day of work and she's now invited to a strange meal...

title: Water.
description: 1. Flower 2. Color Color 3. Ikasu Onna (イカス女) 4. Drip Words 5. Polyethylene yori Ai wo Komete (ポリエチレンより愛を込めて) 6. Yoru to Haru to Love (ヨルとハルとラヴ) 7. Déjà vu (デジャヴー) 8. Flame 9. Aru Hitotsu no Mado no Naka ni (あるヒトツの窓の中に) 10. Aoiro ga Nokoshita Mono e (青色が遺したものへ) 11. Kuchizuke (くちづけ) 12. Kusare Onna (クサレ女) 13. Paint in Watercolor (ペイント イン ウォーターカラー) 14. Sugar 15. Boku no Naka ni Saku Marude Ga no Youna Hana (僕の中に咲くまるで蛾のような花) 16. Flower 17. Itaitashii Love II (痛々しいラヴ II) 18. Liquitex (リキテックス) 19. Water

title: Nyatto!
description: Yaneda Shigeru is a guy living alone with his cat Konbu until it turns mostly into a human (she keeps her cat tail and ears) for unknown reasons. Though to Shigeru, this isn't a problem; he has a cat-girl fetish. The problem is, his cat, Konbu, is stuck-up and wants everything to be elegant to fit her high-class tastes, even her name to be something more high-class.
