Volume 1 (Released 2017/09/15) #Cover illustration: Itou Hachi #Illustration : irua #Illustration : Kagawa Yuusaku 1. Aria no Tamago (アリアのたまご) [Itou Hachi] 2. Tomodachi no Imouto-san (ともだちのいもうとさん) [Namori] 3. Melon Melon (メロンメロン) [Takemiya Jin] 4. Otona desu kara! (おとなですから！) [Nonaka Yuu] 5. First Kiss no Aji (ファーストキスの味) [irua] 6. Super Maid ni Omakase Kudasai! (スーパーメイドにお任せください！) [Takeshima Eku] 7. Hime Kishi to Tsukaima (姫騎士と使い魔) [Takano Suka] 8. Ojou-sama wa Wagamama no Mama de (お嬢様はワガママのままで) [Homura Subaru] 9. Tenshi no Chuudokusei (天使の中毒性) [Ichigo Ichie] 10. Sono Kotoba ga Ureshikute (その言葉が嬉しくて) [Oui Pikachi] 11. Ano Ko ga Hoshii (あの娘がほしい) [Tamasaki Tama] Volume 2 (Released 2018/06/29) #Cover illustration: Maruino #Illustration : Miman #Illustration : Hitoto* 1. Yuuri no Sensei (ユーリのせんせい) [Takeshima Eku] 2. Momo-chan wa Mainichi Uchi ni Yatte Kuru (桃ちゃんは毎日うちにやってくる) [Meno] 3. Ochita yo Raredro-san (おちたよ★レアドロさん) [Fujieda Miyabi] 4. Onee-chan no Risei ga Taihen desu (おねえちゃんの理性がたいへんです) [Takano Saku] 5. Sensei! Oshiete? (先生！おしえて？) [Takemiya Jin] 6. Sensei! Onegai! (先生！おねがい！) [Takemiya Jin] 7. Kimi no Omoide ni

title: Ru Ni Suo Jian Zhe Shi Bai He Man
description: When the timid Wu You moves to a new high school, she quickly grows attached to her new deskmate, the gregarious Ye Yin. But there is more than meets the eye with Ye Yin, and as the days pass Wu You's feelings begin to deepen. A love story between two secondary school classmates.

title: Kyou wa Mada Futsuu ni Narenai
title_original: 今日はまだフツーになれない
description: Takahashi, a 27-year-old freelancer who likes cute girls, and Yamashita, a fast-paced but sensitive manga artist. At the end of their high school years, the two, who had no desire to find a job or go on to higher education, have been together ever since they got detention for their desired career path. Going on to higher education, getting a job, getting married...they are troubled by the "futsuu" they often encounter in their lives, but somehow manage to stay positive. Two girls. A just-right relationship that loosely fits their hearts. (Source: Ichijinsha, translated)

title: Koisuru Ookami to Millefeuille
title_original: 恋する狼とミルフィーユ
description: A drop of blood. The girl in red. The start of something extraordinary. Maaya Suho was known as Wolf Girl, but now she just wants to live an ordinary life as a high school girl. Until she found herself caught in a battle between the Little Red Riding Hood and the Wolves. A dark fairy tale begins now. Note: Includes 5 extra chapters.

title: Tabimiman
description: Harukawa, an an office worker, loves going on outings. Akiyama, a novelist, just wants to laze about in the house all day. This is the life of two women who live together in Shiga Prefecture, going on laid-back outings that are more relaxed than a trip, but more exciting than a stroll! (Source: Kadokawa, translated) Note: Includes 2 extra chapters.

title: Qiu Ni Yu Zhang Zhong
description: A bizarre murder case shattered Lan Zhiqing's sweet and peaceful life. Her forgotten past turned into living nightmares, coming for her step by step… Lan Zhiqing realized, to her surprise, that the most dangerous threat just might be the person lying next to her?! (Source: Bilibili, translated) Note: Chapter count includes one prologue and one bonus chapter.

title: Yuri Hyakkei
description: A full-color manga featuring 100 scenes of girls love! Featuring classmates, sempai and kouhai, teacher and student, sisters and childhood friends!

title: Dai Kyochuu Rettou
description: New enemies, new bugs and an even bigger island.

characters.name: Chitose Naruse
characters.description: Amami's best friend and class chairman. An ace who belongs to the brass band and kendo club. She led a survivor group apart from Amami's group.

characters.name: Mami Miura
characters.description: A 2nd year Houshou Private High School student and an Idol.

characters.name: Kazuhiko Kai
characters.description: A male student with naturally curly hair. He familiar with mechanics and perform power restoration in hospital facilities. Good at lock-picking.

characters.name: Mutsumi Oribe
characters.description: The main character of this work. Enrolled in the first class at Hoho Senior High School. Usually a quiet girl, but good at survival . He is also familiar with the ecology of insects, and when he encounters a giant insect, he quickly responds, but he has no resistance to killing insects. Don't let go of a waterproof rucksack called "Sesame husband" Insect knowledge was learned from Inaho, and was rather weak in the past.

characters.name: Kasumi Momosaki
characters.description: A 2nd year Houshou Private High School student.

characters.name: Nozomi Aoyama
characters.description: A 2nd year Houshou Private High School student.

characters.name: Ryouko
characters.description: She is part of the rescue team and the Japanese Coast Guard.

characters.name: Aoi Nakumo
characters.description: She is Nakumo Hyoue's ill sister and seemingly an influential person on the island.

characters.name: Kagami Nakasone
characters.description: She is an inhabitant of Tatsuno Kami Island.

characters.name: Hyoue Nakumo
characters.description: He's a good guy and is always accompanied by his pet dog.

characters.name: Kami Tatsuno
characters.description: She is a shrine maiden on the island.

title: Kirio Fanclub
description: What would you do if your crush had ear-splitting farts? For Aimi and Nami, the answer is to cry tears of joy for being able to pinpoint at a distance the object of their affections, Kirio, from a single toot. These are the kinds of deep, philosophical questions the two friends/rivals in romance pose to each other to prove their love for this boy who hardly seems to know they exist. That won’t stop them from conducting nightly rituals to entice him into their dreams, though, or listing out what exactly they like about him, down to the very last organ. But when push comes to shove, will they choose their hilarious friendship over a shot at love? Get ready for a rip-roaring romcom about the friendship behind what is fair in love and war! (Source: Kodansha USA)

title: Oukoku Monogatari
description: Purple-eyed Adarte, blue-eyed Adolte. One enveloped in light—the graceful son—and one shrouded in darkness—the prisoner. Even as their souls are drawn together, destiny would tear them apart. Elsewhere in the kingdom, a heroic king is served by an enigmatic aide from a faraway land. His path has torn him from his dearest kin and placed him in the halls of power—to what end...? (Source: Yen Press)

title: Zhiyao Bici Ai Guo Yici
description: Years later, after another call from her mother about getting married, Zhou Ruoheng couldn't help but think back on her school days—how, once upon a time, there had been someone she loved. (Source: Baiheverse)

title: Hinako Note
description: Hinako is a shy little girl whom animals are instinctively drawn to. Because of this, Hinako works as a scarecrow to keep said animals away from the crops in her neighbors fields. Thus the tale of the scarecrow girl begins! Note: Includes five extra chapters.

characters.name: Hinako Sakuragi
characters.description: __Height:__ 160 cm __Weight:__ 52 kg The protagonist. She's bad at dealing with other people but animals love her, so she used to work as a scarecrow in the countryside. She goes to Tokyo to enter a high-school theatrical club.

characters.name: Kuina Natsukawa
characters.description: She lives at the bookstore where Hinako is staying. Kuina eats books without realizing what she's doing. She is very absent minded, and will question things and do things without knowing.

title: Weile Rang Xuejie Guqi Ganjin Wo Jueding Xianchu Wo Ziji
title_original: 为了让学姐鼓起干劲，我决定献出我自己
title_en: For Her, I'd Give It My All
description: Jiaxia is a new editor for the comic company BliBli. Ever since high school she has admired comic artist Taiji-sensei, who inspired her to pursue a career in the 2D world. Although Taiji-sensei has a bad reputation in the publishing world for being lazy and troublesome, Jiaxia is determined to be her new editor. But will she be able to get Taiji-sensei to finally get motivated to draw a new comic? (Source: Bilibili Comics) Note: Include eight extras chapters.

title: Lily Marble
description: "Fitness Club LILY" is a nest for fit and beautiful women. They have the elegant yoga instructor, a boyish muscle female trainer, and the gossip-addict young girls at the reception desk. Not even mention the classy and energetic female customers. What kind of "naughty" relationship will be formed between them? "Lily Marble" is a light GL that covers multiple pairing, each with their own uniqueness and charm! Must read for every GL fans! (Source: Manga.Club)

title: Neko to Sugar Pot
description: Collection of stores by Yukiko with the tagline "not your average girls' love". 1. Neko ni Hanare Hito (猫に離人, Cat the Detached Observer) 2. Neko to Saezuri (猫と囀り, Cat and Whisper) 3. Neko ni Denwa (猫に電話, Call the Cat) 4. Sugar Pot wa Kowarenai (シュガーポットは壊れない, Sugar Pot Won't Break) 5. Tsurutsuru (つるつる, Silky) 6. Watashi no Osanajimi Wa... (私の幼なじみは…。, My Childhood Friend is...) 7. Gozen 1-ji no Koirandouri (午前１時のコインランドリー, Coin Laundry at 1:00 AM) 8. Choucho no Himatsubushi (蝶々の暇つぶし, A Butterfly's Spare Time) 9. Oni to Sanjin (鬼と山神, Demon and Mountain God)

title: Nogi Wakaba wa Yuusha de Aru
title_original: 乃木若葉は勇者である
description: The story of Nogi Wakaba wa Yuusha de Aru takes place 300 years in the past, in 2018, the first days of the Divine Era. The six main characters form the first ever Hero Team: Nogi Wakaba, Nogi Sonoko's ancestor; Uesato Hinata, Takashima Yuna, Koori Chikage, Doi Tamako and Iyojima Anzu.

characters.name: Wakaba Nogi
characters.description: __Height:__ 163 cm __Grade:__ 2nd Year of Middle School A second-year middle school student and one of the Heroes of the first Hero Team and the ancestor of [Sonoko](https://anilist.co/character/88641/Sonoko-Nogi). Wakaba is a serious, strong-willed girl that believes in rewarding favors. She seeks revenge on the Vertexes and is willing to take risks to get it. She is a natural, charismatic leader who is wildly popular with the general public. However, she is also a kindhearted girl who is dismayed that her serious exterior sometimes scares people off, and she has a hidden soft side which enjoys being spoiled by [Hinata](https://anilist.co/character/126245/Uesato-Hinata). As a Hero, Wakaba fights using a sword named Ikutachi. It can cut through Vertexes with ease, even if the user is not transformed. Ikutachi is one-handed, meaning she has no need to hold onto it with both hands.

characters.name: Yuuna Takashima
characters.description: __Height:__ 154cm __Grade:__ 2nd Year of Middle School One of the Heroes of the first Hero team. Yuuna is a bright and energetic girl and can be thought of as the "mood maker of the team". She thinks friends and family are two of the most important things, and she is sensitive to other's feelings. Yuuna is also selfless and will throw herself into battle for her friends, even to her own detriment. However, she has a habit of hiding her own emotions. When Yuuna is in Hero form, her weapon is the tekko. Hers, in particular, are imbued with a divine power called Ama-no-Sakate, a cursed from a land god with rage-filled hatred to destroy.

characters.name: Chikage Koori
characters.description: __Height:__ 159 cm __Grade:__ 3rd Year of Middle School A Hero of the first Hero team. Chikage is a shy, quiet and lonely girl who is not good at interacting with other people. She enjoys playing video games, like most introverts. Despite how mistrustful and silent towards others she seems, she is a good person at heart who only wishes for acceptance. She is seen bonding with [Yuuna Takashima](https://anilist.co/character/126201/Yuuna-Takashima) the most, but does care about other members of the team. ~!She was killed in action during a battle with the Vertexes, protecting Wakaba. Following her death, her record was erased by the Taisha.!~

characters.name: Tamako Doi
characters.description: __Height:__ 147 cm One of the Heroes of the first Hero team. Tamako is an energetic, emotionally-driven girl that is very fond of the outdoors. She tends to laugh a lot and gets angry easily. She is also fond of making puns with her own name, and refers to herself in third person. She is protective of her friends and tries to prevent them from being hurt. As a Hero, Tamako uses a retractable six-bladed shield named Kamuyatatehime to battle. It can be used as a weapon similar to a yo-yo because it can be thrown and returned, but it can also be used as a blade when swinging around.

characters.name: Anzu Iyojima
characters.description: __Height:__ 156 cm One of the Heroes of the first Hero team and the youngest of quintet. Anzu is a bookworm that is especially fond of romance novels. While she isn't the physically strongest fighter out of her team, she is very intelligent and is more knowledgeable than most of the team. She is very close with [Tamako](https://anilist.co/character/126241/Tamako-Doi), thinking of her as her senpai and being her best friend. Anzu is sometimes afraid to fight, which is a disadvantage when she needs to fight as a Hero. However, she is very protective and would fight for her friends until her death. As a Hero, Anzu wields a repeating crossbow in battle, named Kinkyusen. She is also very intelligent, which can help her think during battles.

characters.name: Hinata Uesato
characters.description: __Height:__ 150cm __Grade:__ 2nd Year of Middle School Uesato Hinata is one of the main characters of the light novel Nogi Wakaba Is a Hero. She, while not a hero, is a part of the first Hero Team.

characters.name: Yuuna Yuuki
characters.description: A second-year in middle school and member of the Hero Club. She prides herself on being a hero, helping out others in needs and always remaining optimistic. She fights the Vertex with her armored gauntlets and greaves. Her fairy familiar, Gyuuki, allows her to condense energy in her fist for her signature move "Hero Punch".

characters.name: Mimori Tougou
characters.description: [Yuuna](https://anilist.co/character/88636/Yuuna-Yuuki)'s best friend and fellow classmate and club member who lives next door to her and often prefers to be called by her family name. Mimori takes pride in her national heritage and is always ready to defend her country and protect its people. She has lost the use of her legs, along with some of her memories, allegedly due to a car accident. ~! Two years before the main story, Mimori was adopted by the Washio family because of her high aptitude as a Hero Candidate. She went by the name Sumi Washio for the entirety of her time adopted by the Washio family. After her Mankai caused her memory loss, she was promptly returned to the Tougou family and was conveniently relocated by the Taisha as a neighbor to Yuuna. !~

characters.name: Fuu Inubouzaki
characters.description: A third-year in middle school, president of the Hero Club, and older sister of [Itsuki](https://anilist.co/character/88639). She doesn’t bother with trivial issues, but she sees the big picture and inspires the others to follow her like a big sister. She loves her younger sister and friends very much. She is good at cooking and housekeeping, and loves eating. As a Hero, Fuu wields a large greatsword. The size of her blade allows her to use it as a shield just as often as a sword. She can also use the power of her fairy, Inugami, to increase her sword's size and attack a wide area.

characters.name: Itsuki Inubouzaki
characters.description: A first-year in middle school and member of the Hero Club. She is Fuu's younger sister and respects her dearly. Unlike her older sister, Itsuki is very shy and timid. However, she is very kindhearted and enjoys helping people. She also becomes less shy around people she knows, and can even be snarky at times. As a Hero, Itsuki fights with a tambourine-like ring lined with white flowers from which she can fire magical vines. These vines can ensnare and slice through enemies.

characters.name: Karin Miyoshi
characters.description: A second year in middle school, and member of the Hero Club. She is an experienced hero who transferred into [Yuuna](https://anilist.co/character/88636/Yuuki-Yuuna) and [Mimori](https://anilist.co/character/88637/Tougou-Mimori)'s class, joining the Hero Club to supervise the other heroes. Karin is depicted as a headstrong individual: stubborn, obstinate, and single-minded. She is very abrasive and finds it difficult when expressing her feelings towards others. However, she can't resist helping whenever someone is having trouble. She is rather self-confident and positive, initially believing her skills are far greater than the other members of the Hero Club. One could describe her as a "tsundere". As a Hero, Karin dual-wields twin katana. She is also able to throw her katana to strike at range while being able to generate new ones. Karin also has powerful physical abilities and can sense

characters.name: Sonoko Nogi
characters.description: __Height:__ 156 cm Sonoko Nogi is one of the three main characters of the light novel Washio Sumi is a Hero. At the time of the story taking place, she's an elementary school 6th-year student chosen by Taisha to fight Vertexes as a Hero, along with Gin Minowa and Sumi Washio. She is a very easygoing girl who has a habit of spacing out. However, her cloud cuckoo lander personality masks a truly staggering intellect, and she can formulate plans in mere seconds. Sonoko is also a successful novelist who specializes in romance novels, and she enjoys imagining her female friends in romantic situations with each other.

characters.name: Utano Shiratori
characters.description: __Grade:__ 6th __Height:__ 158 cm Utano Shiratori is a the main character of [Nogi Wakaba is a Hero](https://anilist.co/manga/99559/Nogi-Wakaba-wa-Yuusha-de-Aru/)'s Bonus Chapter, Shiratori Utano is a Hero. Utano is the world's first Hero to do battle against the Vertex invasion, as well as the sole protector of the Nagano region of Japan. Her Hero weapon, Fujidzuru, is a whip fashioned after a Wisteria vine, granted to her by a local god who maintains the protective barrier around Nagano. Utano finds great joy in farming, and is known by all to have an unshakeable positive attitude, often being credited with getting the people of Suwa back on their feet after the dread of the Vertex' invasion first set in over the populace, with the help of her mantra: "No matter what hardships may come our way, humanity will always get back on its feet!" This attitude, and the fact that she successfull

characters.name: Mito Fujimori
characters.description: __Grade:__ 2nd Year of Middle School (Presumed) __Height:__ 152cm __Favourite Food:__ Soba Fujimori Mito is a character in [Nogi Wakaba is a Hero](https://anilist.co/manga/99559/Nogi-Wakaba-wa-Yuusha-de-Aru/)'s Bonus Chapter, Shiratori Utano is a Hero. Mito is the Miko of [Utano Shiratori](https://anilist.co/character/136164/Utano-Shiratori). As a Miko, Mito is able to receive prophecies from their local deity in the form of environmental hints and symbols, or ideas. These oracles aid her Hero in predicting where danger will next appear in Nagano, the region that the two defend together. Although minor, her role is indispensable to Utano. Regardless of this, Mito laments not being able to do more for her Hero. Mito had a rocky relationship with her family due to her analytical and often gloomy personality, which resulted in her becoming a quiet, reserved, and timid girl, however, she car

characters.name: Masuzu Aki
characters.description: Aki Masuzu is from Ehime Prefecture, like prefecture as Iyojima Anzu and Doi Tamako. During the initial Vertex Invasion, she guided them with her Miko abilities in using their Hero powers to protect the evacuating citizens. They took refuge in a school building among other people, where the three got to know one another better. She is in constant contact with the Shinju but often complains about her duties (such as bathing in the waterfall to purify herself).

title: Kimi no Tame Dake no Kubiwa
description: "I like to be slapped sharply, by a woman's... soft, supple palm..." I unexpectedly picked up a high school girl who had fainted in front of my apartment building. Even though she had bruises on her face, I still had to ask myself, "I wonder if she is even real, such a beautiful girl..." That night after I took in the mysterious beauty for medical treatment, she turned up in my bed...? (Source: Comico, translated)

title: Maison de Maid
description: The lively yet clumsy new maid June does nothing right except cause trouble and yet, instead of berating June, the young and gracious madam forgives her and shows favoritism among the maids. Both have admiration and affection for one another, but will it turn into something more? (Source: Lezhin)

title: "Eiyuu" ni Akogareta Shoujo wa Kyuuketsuki ni Ochitemo "Eiyuu" wo Mezasu
title_original: 『英雄』に憧れた少女は吸血鬼に堕ちても『英雄』を目指す
description: "We kill all vampires. We share our own fallen ‘blood’ and use it as a weapon...!" The Arbitration Knight Order, which travels around the world to keep the peace. Rinslet, who has just become a regular knight, meets Yuri, a vampire girl with cool silver hair and crimson eyes. She kills her own kind by manipulating the power of her ‘blood suit’, which materialises blood into swords, bows and arrows, but Rinslet knows that she is an abomination, and her feelings for her are mutual. She becomes Yuri's kin in exchange for her life, and her goal is...?

title: G Joshi!
description: "If girls didn't masturbate, that place would smell." Two high school girls were shocked at the article which was written in a magazine. They have never done it, however, they are going to try. This story is such an energetic and erotic comedy! Note: Includes 2 extra chapter.

title: Benitsubaki
description: Kisshioin Tsubaki, a beautiful lady reporter of the occult, wants to satisfy her intellectual curiosity by having a hands-on experience with every Yokai she can find. Follow her in her travels, accompanied by her trusted cameraman Yokomizo-kun.

title: Zenbu Kimi no Sei da
description: Shiho is a troublemaking otaku aiming to create the most perfectly accurate costumes. Yotogi is a popular cosplayer with over 200,000 followers who is known for her revealing outfits. These girls are like fire and ice, clashing as they strive to become superstars in the world of cosplay!! (Source: Yen Press)

title: Unmei wa Yaku ni Tatanai
description: One day, red threads appeared on the fingers of all humans worldwide. Since those bound by that thread were destined for lasting relationships, it became known as the "red thread of fate," and a new era dawned where thread-based romance became the norm. While all this was happening, a red thread suddenly appeared on the finger of the protagonist, Tsumugi, who, incidentally, just happens to despise "thread-based love".... (Source: Manga Park, translated)

title: Futari to Futari
description: Ayumi and Sayako are roommates. Ayumi is dating Asami. Sayako is dating Keiko. What happens when Ayumi and Sayako both find out the other is dating another woman?

characters.name: Ayumi
characters.description: A very scatter-brained middle schooler who works a part time job. She recently started dating Asami, the manger at her job. She has feelings for her roommate Sayako but doesn't believe they will be returned. When around Asami she is very meek and submissive but tends to take charge when Sayako is involved.

characters.name: Sayako
characters.description: A very serious middle schooler who lives in a dorm with Ayumi. She comes of as somewhat cold but is really just trying to hide her feelings for Ayumi. She is in a relationship with Keiko who is best friends with Asami, Ayumi's lover. When with Keiko, she's very forceful and dominant, but with Ayumi, she is much more submissive. She can be very forceful when trying to get what she wants.

characters.name: Asami
characters.description: A women(whose age is left up in the air) that runs a convince store and is in love with Ayumi.She's very easy going but will take charge with Ayumi. She is friends with Keiko and they share a love for younger girls. She describes Keiko as looking into a mirror and that they have a special bond different form that of lovers. She is fairly ok with the fact that Ayumi begins sleeping with Sayako.

characters.name: Keiko
characters.description: A older women who like Asumi has her age unmentioned. Also like Asumi she is attracted to younger girls. She works as a web designer and frequently pulls all nighters. She is in a relationship with Sayako and is submissive and may be a bit of a masochist.. Like Asumi she is fine that Sayako is sleeping with her roommate. IN the end her and Asumi buy a house together.

title: Cheonsassiwa Agmanim
description: The story of angels who don't behave like angels and devils who are kinder than them. A new romance begins!

title: Ashita, Kimi ni Aetara
description: A 14-year-old is planning to confess to her upperclassmen who is graduating. The next morning, she wakes as a 29-year-old single woman, living with three sisters: a high schooler, a middle schooler and an elementary schooler.

title: Banana no Nana
description: On the world that consists of a single giant continent called Dokkanon, most people have some kind of special ability. Those who have a high-ranking ability, such as the ability to control water, are respected and granted much power. Those with low-ranking abilities, such as Nana, who controls bananas, and her best friend Ringo, who has super-powerful legs, have very little power in society. When Nana and Ringo were kids, they were awed by stories from Ringo's adventurer father about a land called Oz, where a god lived who could make any wish come true. Nana and Ringo swore that they would go adventuring together when they were adults. But as time went by, Ringo's father vanished while adventuring, and Ringo became much more aware of the social stigma associated with adventurers. Will the two of them find the strength and courage to follow through with their promise?

characters.name: Nana Ouba
characters.description: Ouba Nana is a 16-year-old girl on an adventure through the land of Dokkanon. Her special ability gives her limitless power over bananas and is regarded as a low rank ability. To use her ability fully, however, she needs to recharge it by eating an unpeeled banana for every banana she manipulates.

title: Yuri ni Hasamaru Otoko wa Shineba Ii!?
title_original: 百合にはさまる男は死ねばいい!?
title_en: Boys Gilding the Lily Shall Die!?
description: Chihaya Katagiri has always been the first trumpet in her school's brass band — until Hibiki Aikawa transfers from a prestigious school and takes the spot. Despite initial suspicions, the two quickly become close; Katagiri admires Aikawa's talent and enthusiasm for playing the trumpet, and Aikawa is struck by Katagiri's grounded treatment of her abilities, as well as her love for music. As their feelings for each other grow stronger, their lives become more complicated with the stress of classes, other relationships, and the last competition of their high school careers drawing near. (Source: TOKYOPOP)

title: Oni Ure Idol ga Kyou mo Watashi wo Oshitekuru
title_original: 鬼売れアイドルが今日も私を推してくる
description: Unpopular underground idol and actress, Enatsu Sayuki, faces her work diligently everyday to achieve her dreams of making it big in the world of acting. ...However, for some reason, the superstar idol Sera Touma—who should be her rival—becomes her biggest fan!! Adorable enough to make Sayuki jealous, Sera takes every chance to passionately declare her love, throwing Sayuki’s life into chaos. Will Sayuki be able to achieve her dreams? And what will become of the one-sided love(?) between Sera and Sayuki…!? The curtain rises on the clash between these young talents in the fierce age of idol showbiz—let the show begin!! (Source: Bunkasha, translated)

title: Riko to Haru to Onsen to Iruka
title_original: リコとハルと温泉とイルカ
description: The protagonist had to move to the countryside where her childhood friend lives. There, they try their best to enjoy the time together. It also happens that there's a hot spring in the Inn the protagonist is staying.

title: Hime to Onna Yuusha ga Musubareru tame no 12 no Seikoui
title_original: 姫と女勇者が結ばれるための12の聖行為
title_en: 12 Dirty Deeds to Unite the Princess and Her Heroine
description: When Princess Sephilia and the fearless heroine Lenaria were young, they pledged their futures to one another. But when Lenaria returns triumphant after slaying the demon lord, it’s not the princess’s hand in marriage she requests—it’s her royal panties! Cursed by the demon lord in its final moments, Lenaria must now perform twelve wildly perverted acts to lift the spell that threatens her very soul. (Source: Seven Seas Entertainment) Note: Chapter count includes one extra and one omake chapter.

title: Boikano
description: The psychotic lover Hime fell in love with Kazuki at first sight. Since then, they've been dating for 6 months, but Hime just found out that Kazuki is not a man.

characters.name: Hime
characters.description: Kazuki's girlfriend, she thought during the first six months of their relationship she Kazuki was a boy.

characters.name: Kazuki
characters.description: Hime's girlfriend. Hime thought she was a boy for the first six months of their relationship

characters.name: Mizuki
characters.description: Kazuki's older sister, she is an university student.

title: Rabbit Hole
description: Whatever her employer asks, Hee-Yeon, the maid, does it perfectly without any mistake. A beautiful yet twisted maid enters a complicated household. How far down the rabbit hole will Hee-Yeon go? (Source: Lezhin US)

title: Ijimekaeshi. Fukushuu no Calendrier
title_original: イジメカエシ。-復讐の31〈カランドリエ〉-
description: I was bullied by everyone, so in return I'm going to slaughter them all. Taking inspiration from the 31 days of the calendar, the uber popular girl group Calendrier was formed. Behind the bubbly appearance, in the shadows, there is one member that is bullied by the others on a daily face. "If you can't smile, then neither will the fans." She is willing to do anything to regain the smile that was robbed by her group mates. With 30 members as her opponents, this is the story of the crazy number 31. (Source: Square Enix, translated)

title: Himegami no Miko
description: Himeko Kurusugawa and Chikane Himemiya are two high-school girls at the prestigious Ototachibana Academy in the fictional Japanese village of Mahoroba. They are also the reincarnations of the solar and lunar mikos. When their ancient enemy the Orochi (the eight-headed Yamata no Orochi of Japanese folklore) rises once more the girls’ long-sealed personas awaken to defend the world! Note: Includes 3 extra chapters.

characters.name: Chikane Himemiya
characters.description: The Lunar Priestess; in sharp contrast with Himeko, Chikane is a very commanding girl of the same age. She has a very noble and elegant aura, lives in a large mansion with many maids, and is considered to be of the highest standing at their school; she has a considerable fan following of both genders and is the frequent target of love confessions. She is a member of the prestigious kyudo (Japanese archery) club and frequently uses the bow as her weapon of preference during confrontations with the Orochi. Chikane is also exceptionally skilled in the areas of tennis and, more significantly, the piano; she apparently enjoys playing for Himeko, who enjoys listening to her perform. Many at school believe she has a relationship with Sōma, though this is proven to be untrue. ~! She has been in love with Himeko since they first met, although she does not reveal it until much later on. She eventu

characters.name: Himeko Kurusugawa
characters.description: The Solar Priestess, Himeko is a very shy, innocent girl, and the character that receives most of the anime's attention. At first, Himeko has affections for Sōma Ōgami, who is her childhood friend. She starts off considering Chikane a very close friend, although the two very rarely meet outside of secrecy. Himeko is an amateur photographer of some skill, a hobby she developed thanks to the support she receives from Chikane Himemiya. Himeko is initially a shy and timid girl, uncertain of her own worth and abilities. This is mainly because after the death of her birth parents, she was initially adopted by abusive relatives before being moved to other relatives. At school, Himeko seems to have only one friend (except Souma and Chikane), her dorm roommate Makoto.

title: Maenbarui Nina
description: When shy and timid Eunseo was forced to transfer to the elite Stella Academy of the Arts, she expected lonely school days filled with cutthroat competition. So she's taken by surprise when the free-spirited Ina takes a sudden liking to her. The two girls become closer as they secretly meet on the rooftop after classes, and Eunseo's friendly admiration grows into something more. Luckily, Ina returns her feelings as well... but they seem to border on a dark obsession that grows larger by the day. What will happen when Eunseo discovers the hidden reason behind Ina's mysterious love? (Source: Tappytoon)

title: Futari Monologue
description: Hinata is an introverted geek who sits next to Mikage, a gal, in class. Hinata realizes that Mikage is a former friend from elementary school, and attempts to rekindle their friendship. Included chapters: 21.5, 35.5

title: Girls x Sekuha-Life
title_original: ガールズ×セクハライフ
description: Sawari likes to harass her childhood friend, Kiyoto. Sexually.

title: Hitogoto desu kara!
description: Ms. Komori is the ace of the Sales and Marketing Department, and she damned well knows it. With a smile that can convince anyone to do anything, she always goes well over her monthly quota – so imagine how surprised she is after finding out she’s getting transferred over to the dull, uptight Personnel Department! But little does she know that she may have more in common with her new coworker Ms. Yamanobe than she originally thought… (Source: Manga Planet) Note: Includes one extra chapter.

title: Hokenshitsu wa Futarikiri
description: What kind of secret love is going on in the infirmary today!? A caring class president and a delinquent who skips class. A kind intern teacher and a devoted member of the school infirmary committee. A serious student council president and her devilish vice president. The ace of the basketball team and her childhood friend, the manager. The story takes place in the infirmary of a high school for girls, Featuring girls who fall deeply in love with each other with all their heart, a sensational adolescent love story! (Source: MF Comics Flapper Series, translated) Note: Chapter count includes eight extras.

title: CottonCandy
description: Mii rides the same bus home everyday, always sitting across from the popular Hanako. Afraid of talking to her, Mii lets days go by in silence, until one day Hanako initiates a conversation with her.

title: Hanjip Du Sallim
description: Hara meets a beautiful girl at a club one night, and goes home with her. After a sweet rendezvous, Go-Eun wakes the next morning to find Hara in her bed. Shocked, she kicks Hara out, because she has no recollection of sleeping with her. So who was Hara sleeping with? A story about Hara, Go-Eun and another ‘Go-Eun’! (Source: Lezhin, translated)

title: G-Maru Edition
title_original: ジーまるえでぃしょん
description: Kaburagi Aruto, an average high school student, wishes to become a Shoujo manga artist. One day, she is visited by something from the future. He tells her that she now has to become an amazing ero-manga artist.

characters.name: Aruto Kaburagi
characters.description: Aruto Kaburagi is the main character of this Manga. An average highschool student who wishes to become a Shoujo Mangaka. Since she got a visit by Jimaru an incident after another occures... Of course she doesn't like the idea at all that she is an Ero Mangaka in the future. (Source: G-Maru Edition LiveJournal)

characters.name: G-Maru
characters.description: Jimaru "G-Maru" is the visitor from the future and a huge fan of Aragi's work. He wants Aragi to become an Ero Mangaka because he loves how she draw nipples and is a big trouble maker. (Source: G-Maru Edition LiveJournal)

characters.name: Hikaru Kamiya
characters.description: An Ecchi Mangaka. Aruto is his assistant, and got mistaken for a girl by her because he is extremely androgyn.

characters.name: Karin Tamazawa
characters.description: Karin Tamazawa is the class president and appears to be cold to everyone. She often bawls Aragi out because she is late for school many times. Despite this, she happens to look up to Aragi because she won a prize for her Manga and wishes to become a Mangaka too. Her goal is to become a Yuri Mangaka. (Source: G-Maru Edition LiveJournal)

title: Majo to Koisuru 5-byoumae
description: Sequel to 5 Seconds Before a Witch Falls in Love published in the magazine Yuri Hime's 100 issue.

characters.name: Meg
characters.description: A witch nicknamed as "The Untouchable Sorceress". She's solitary, and likes to be mischievous and make trouble in the forest for Lilith.

characters.name: Lilith
characters.description: A top-class Witch Hunter.

title: Joshi Kouishitsu
description: The love stories of young girls that takes place in the girls' changing room.

title: Sukidesu, Futte Kudasai!
title_original: 好きです、フッてください！
description: Kurata Hikaru has fallen in love with her classmate Kira Kairi at first sight. Now, she's too lovestruck to concentrate on her studies. Her plan? Get Kairi to reject her so she can focus again. Note: Originally published in Comic Yuri-Hime 2024 May issue.

title: Kimi wo Tsumugu
description: A heartwarmingly cute yuri manga about a seamstress and a zombie girl. What if your friend became a zombie? What if you were in love with that friend? Note: Includes two extra chapters.

title: Xian Chan Nu
description: Liu Shiqing is a playful daughter born to a family of armed escorts. One time while sneaking out on another one of her adventures, she finds herself kidnapped by bandits. Moments before it all seemed to be over, Xian Chan Nu suddenly shows up and swoops her off her feet, saving her and stealing her heart. This is a story of humans and demons, masters and slaves; a tale of revenge and a tale of loyalty only beginning to unfold. (Source: Bilibili Comics, edited) Note: Includes one extra chapter.

title: Black Black Lotus
title_original: ブラック・ブラック・ロータス
description: Renna, just transferred to Fuyou Girls School, meets Kyouko, who is called "Black Rose" and respected by everyone. Black Rose is beautiful, mysterious, and seems to know Renna. She tells that it's Renna's voice that attracts her, and that was why she saved Renna when they were in grade school. Suddenly Renna remembers...the reason why she had to change school and move to a remote place four years ago. It was something she forgot to protect herself. Renna is devastated when she knows that Black Rose is dead...she was supposed to see her on the day she was killed! When Renna receives a black card that invites her to "Black Black Lotus", a murder matching website, she finds out that someone who used her name killed Black Rose. Who is that!? (Source: BookWalker)

title: Mai-HiME
description: Yuuichi Tate is overjoyed: He gets to go to a brand new high school. Of course, then he just happens to find out the school he choose is under frequent attack by strange creatures called ''Orphans'', and the school set up a special task force of female members called ''HiME''s, using various elements as their powers, to battle these invaders. That's not all, though. Each member of the HiME task force has their own, unique ''Key'', another person whom, upon being discovered, can team up with the HiME to create a ''Child'', a combative unit specifically needed to effectively battle these Orphans. And with Yuuichi's luck, he just happens to find out he's not just the ''Key'' for one of the HiMEs, but for two... Two highly competitive, rival schoolgirls. And that's only the start of the trouble. (Source: TOKYOPOP)

characters.name: Mai Tokiha
characters.description: __Height:__ 157 cm Mai is a transfer student and new to the Fuuka Academy. Ever since both of her parents died, the main heroine has been taking care of her younger brother [Takumi](https://anilist.co/character/4052/Tokiha-Takumi) who is suffering from a heart condition. Mai hates to burden others with her troubles and therefore always tries to smile, hiding her own anxiety from her friends as well as from her brother. Her child is named Kagutsuchi, a flaming dragon with sword in the middle of its head. When involved into battles, both of them can control fire and use it for a number of attacks.

characters.name: Natsuki Kuga
characters.description: __Height:__ 160 cm __Child:__ Duran Natsuki is typically portrayed as a serious, rational blue-haired female, as a foil to the lighthearted Mai Tokiha. Natsuki's beauty is the target of several jokes, usually involving her becoming embarrassed in a situation. She usually has Shizuru Fujino as a close friend. Natsuki always uses some type of gun as her weapon and she is usually associated with wolves, silver and the element ice. She also has a habit of flicking her hair with her right hand. Running gags include her hobby of collecting lingerie, her fondness of mayonnaise, and her tendency to become irritated easily. Natsuki s relationship with Shizuru go deeper when time goes on. (wikipedia)

characters.name: Mikoto Minagi
characters.description: __Height:__ 147 cm A middle school student of questionable origin who was pulled from the sea by a passing ferry. She is quite attached to Mai, though her purpose for going to Fuuka Academy is to search for her brother. Her Element is a large jet-black claymore called Miroku, which responds to her calling whenever she is not near it. Miroku possesses several special powers including the ability to cut through almost any object, such as cruise ships without needing to be physically swung and the ability to summon energy blasts. When it uses these powers, glowing red eye-shaped markings appear on the blade. It is initially assumed that the sword itself is her Child, but her Child is later revealed to be a monstrous ogre-like creature which wields a gigantic spiked club, this also bears the name Miroku. This Child is called the protector of the Obsidian Lord and apparently seems to be under

characters.name: Yuuichi Tate
characters.description: Yuuichi is a member of the Fuuka Academy Student Council. He first appears in Episode One on the same ferry that Mai Tokiha is taking and the two quickly form bad impressions of each other. Shiho Munakata calls him her older brother even though they are not related by blood. He works with the Student Council doing odd jobs for them (prompting Mai to label him a "lackey") and sits next to Mai in class. Yuuichi used to be a member of the Fuuka kendo club and regularly made it into the nationals until he was suffered a severe injury to his knee at some point in the past, though the exact circumstances and nature of the injury are never explained in the anime. Masashi Takeda of the kendo club is seen looking sadly at Yuuichi's name card on the wall of the kendo dojo at one point during the anime. Disenchanted, after his injury Yuuchi became a feared delinquent, but Shiho manag

characters.name: Nao Yuuki
characters.description: __Height:__ 153 cm __Child:__ Julia A 14 year old schoolgirl delinquent who is also a HIME. She hates men and will flirt with them, only to rob when invited into their homes with the help of her child. She becomes an antagonist towards the other HIME after she is mistakenly accused of attacking [Yukariko](https://anilist.co/character/4055/Sanada-Yukariko) and loses an eye from the retaliation of the other HIME. Her element takes the form of claws that can create glowing "threads" which are strong enough to cut steel. Her child Julia is a giant spider with the upper body of a human and attacks with its webs and jaws.

characters.name: Shizuru Fujino
characters.description: __Height:__ 162 cm __Child:__ Kiyohime Not only that she's a senior at Fuuka Academy, Shizuru is also the President of the Fuuka Academy student council. She has her own fanclub that follows her everywhere, thanks to her cool yet inviting disposition and distinctive Kyoto accent which had made her quite popular with students of both genders.

characters.name: Midori Sugiura
characters.description: __Height:__ 157 cm __Child:__ Gakutenou Midori first appears as one of [Mai's](https://anilist.co/character/315/Mai-Tokiha) co-workers at the Linden Baum diner. She claims to be 17 years of age, even though she is really 24, and no one believes her. She is friends with school nurse [Yohko Sagisawa](https://anilist.co/character/4054/Youko-Sagisawa) from their college days and she eventually becomes a teacher at Fuka Academy. Though she appears to be goofy and more of a gung-ho justice fighter than a serious leader, she is actually the most experienced HiME, being the eldest of the group, and reveals herself to be a more than capable leader and far more intelligent than she lets on.

characters.name: Shiho Munakata
characters.description: __Height:__ 152 cm __Child:__ Yatagarasu

characters.name: Akane Higurashi
characters.description: **Height:** 156 cm **Child:** Harry A classmate of Natsuki's who works with Mai and Midori in the cafe.She has a crush on Kazuya, and tends to put her hair up in a short ponytail. When fighting her ponytail becomes undone and her hair becomes shoulder length. Her element takes the form of a pair of tonfa's which allow her to create wind attacks while her child Harry takes the form of a tiger and attacks by sucking an enemy into its mouth and shredding them. Akane was also the first to discover the consequences of a HiME losing a battle, and dissapeared with Kazuya during the school festival.

characters.name: Kazuya Kurauchi
characters.description: Kazuya is the boyfriend of Akane and a friend of Yuuichi.

characters.name: Miyu Glear
characters.description: __Miyu Glear DOB:__ 7/6 __Height:__ 156 cm Adopted daughter of Joseph Glear. She is very close to Alyssa. ~! She is actually an android, designed by the Searrs company to protect Alyssa Searrs and to guide her to the Golden Era. Her name is an acronym for Multiple Intelligencial Yggdrasil Unit.!~

characters.name: Alyssa Searrs
characters.description: __Searrs Alyssa DOB:__ 4/1 __Height:__ 122 cm ~!__Child:__ Artemis!~ Alyssa Searrs is a 10-year-old grade schooler who is well known for her amazing singing ability in the choir earning her the nickname "Golden Angel". She is commonly seen with her caretaker Miyu Greer. ~!Later on it's revealed that Alyssa is actually the product of the Searrs' genetic engineering program to design a "fake HiME". With her ability to manipulate higher-order matter Alyssa can control her Child Artemis, a satellite orbiting Earth with the ability to fire a devastating energy beam at a specific target and can even summon and control her own Orphans. Although she has the ability to control Artemis and Orphans, Alyssa cannot summon an Element to defend herself, which is made up for with the assignment of Miyu as her caretaker as well as protector.!~

characters.name: Akira Okuzaki
characters.description: __Height:__ 149 cm __Child:__ Gennai A well known artist in Fuka Academy, and roomate of Mai's little brother Takumi Tokiha. In fact he is a Kunoichi, a female ninja, who is also a HiME with the order to kill any who discover her secret of her father. Takumi discovers her secret when she summons Gennai to protect him from an orphan, but she decides to spare his life as Kazuki swears to keep it a secret. Her child Gennai is a giant frog, and it attacks by emitting light from his back where Akira throws a kunai into the enemy's shadow to leave them paralyzed as Gennai spits out his spiked tongue fast enough to completely pierce through an orphan.

characters.name: Haruka Suzushiro
characters.description: A member of the student council. Haruka is rather hot-headed and loudmouthed, but firmly believes in what is right and does what she can for the betterment of the school. She is extremely jealous of Fujino Shizuru and constantly tries to overshadow her or prove that she is an incompetent leader (this usually backfires). An ongoing gag is that Haruka uses words and phrases incorrectly all the time; Yukino constantly has to correct her. She and Yukino have been friends for a long time, and Yukino greatly admires and looks up to Haruka, who acts like her protector. Haruka has no idea that Yukino is one of the HiME. However, when she and Yukino catch Shizuru trying to kiss a sleeping Natsuki, they confront her and fight. It is revealed that Haruka is Yukino's most important person, thus she begins disappearing when Yukino loses against Shizuru. Not to go out without a fight, Haruka uses

characters.name: Yukino Kikukawa
characters.description: __Height:__ 154cm __Relatives:__ Diana Yukino appears as the secretary of the Fuuka Student Council and Haruka Suzushiro's best friend. She is in the same class as Mai Tokiha and Yuuichi Tate. She is frequently seen with her laptop and occasionally runs the communications network of the Executive Council. An introvert, Yukino frequently corrects Haruka's mispronounced or misspelled words as and attempts to calm the hot-headed Haruka down during crises. Yukino has been friends with Haruka since they were small children, and was often defended by Haruka when she was unable to defend herself from bullying. As such she feels great loyalty towards Haruka and often accompanies her during her (sometimes ill-planned) attempts to protect the school. ~!Yukino is revealed to be one of the 12 HiME after a vampire-like Orphan sent by the SEARRS foundation begins to attack girls on campus wh

title: Kao dake Ii Classmate ga, Yatara to Guigui Kuru Yuri no Hanashi.
title_original: 顔だけ良いクラスメイトが、やたらとグイグイ来る百合の話。
description: Ritsu Kaido has a boyfriend, whom she is dating just because they're both members of the popular crowd. On a summer day, she and her boyfriend were about to celebrate their one-year anniversary, her classmate Tsuzuri Yarai sees them about to kiss and intervenes......? The story is about an ordinary high school girl who falls in love with another girl who is energetic, kind, outgoing, and beautiful, too. (Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Roid
description: "I'm jealous of you..." A girl from a robot club in a wheelchair, Futagami Yui, looks up to heroes and wants to create one, so she enlists the help of an underclassman, the talented AI architect Kazumiya Reina, to build an android together. When it's almost finished and only the AI needs to be sorted out, someone kidnaps Reina. Yui curses her inability to do anything because of her legs and resolves to perform an illegal "mind copy" to save her junior... This is the log of adolescence of girls living in a world where humans and androids coexist.

title: Kakegurui (Kari)
description: A humorous 4-koma spin-off series of Kakegurui .

title: Seinaru Ken to TS Ganbou Yuusha
description: A hero has their wish granted and becomes a girl!

title: Tora to Hachidori
description: Two young women perfectly opposite, rather preppy one, the other a true "Yankee" who does not mince words. Despite their differences, they will team up to breathe new life into the Japanese styling industry!

characters.name: Matsuri Kitou
characters.description: A tiger-loving girl who was scouted by the owner while working part-time at an izakaya.

characters.name: Hajime Hayakawa
characters.description: She is the assistant manager of omne. She has a deep love for the store and its clothes, and works hard every day to create a unique shopping experience.

characters.name: Yamadera
characters.description: The staff member who is in charge of inventory management. Purchasing good things in moderation is his guiding principle. Married.

characters.name: Takahama
characters.description: The manager of omne. She is generally an easygoing mood-maker.

characters.name: Keita Fujishiro
characters.description: A college student and a part-time worker at omne. He can't help but buy clothes even if he has to cut back on his food expenses.

characters.name: Naruyuki Harumi
characters.description: Owner of selective boutique "omne." He is the one who convinced [Matsuri](https://anilist.co/character/307074/Kitou-Matsuri) to joining omne.

title: Haru yo, Koi
description: Mafuyu Sone was caught petting a girl at school and is sent to live with her brother Takashi in Tokyo. Takashi's hospitality is sorely tested when the other girl, Sae Shirai, also shows up. Sae has been disowned by her parents and has nowhere else to go. Just as Takashi is finally getting used to the situation, feelings cool between Mafuyu and Sae. Decency forces Takashi to act like a big brother for the distraught Sae, but he discovers this means trouble for his own relationship with Mariko Abe. (Source: Anime News Network) Note: Volume 11 contains two extra non-story chapters titled "Frills".

characters.name: Takashi Sone
characters.description: Takashi is the older brother of Mafuyu. He takes her in and helps her out after she is kicked out of school for having a relationship with Sae.

characters.name: Sae Shirai
characters.description: Sae was forced to leave her home after her parents found out about her affair with Mafuyu. She has now taken up residence with Mafuyu and her brother. She is currently looking for employment as the relationship has proven to be very troublesome for her in life.

characters.name: Misaho Matsuda
characters.description: Manager from headquarters that is sent around to increase sales at chains. Is raising her son alone because her husband died in an accident. Starts a relation with Sone reluctantly until and old friend come back and proposes to her which she accepts.

characters.name: Mafuyu Sone
characters.description: Mafuyu is the younger sister of Takashi. She faced so much trouble after getting caught with Sae in her relationship that she moved in with her brother. She is currently a student attending a new school.

characters.name: Ami Oostuka
characters.description: Works at the little store with Sone and Misaho. Likes to play with men. Leads them on and then dumps them. Interested in Sone after he rejects her.

title: Momoiro Montage
title_original: ももいろモンタージュ
description: Tamamon, a girl who loves painting, is aiming for the world's best pornographer! What makes a painting erotic? She is going to research this topic in depth.

title: Half and Half
title_original: ハーフ・アンド・ハーフ
description: Our heroine is girl named Hina-chan. She is in her 20s. Hina has a handsome boyfriend now, but she will always remember her first love, a boy named Itsuki. When other kids would tease Hina, calling her ugly, Itsuki would defend her, and try to cheer her up and make her feel better. He and some of his family eventually moved away, leaving Hina heartbroken. But the memory of her first love will always make Hina feel nostalgic and happy inside. Itsuki’s grandmother still lives next door to Hina, so she still has a connection to him, somehow. One day, Hina has a dream of Itsuki, and she is feeling especially nostalgic about him. She is just mentioning her dream to his grandmother, when they are interrupted by the arrival of a stranger. It is a tall, beautiful woman. Wait a minute… it’s Itsuki! Itsuki is not joking, either. He claims that he is really a woman on the inside, and now he is dressing that way on the outside. And yes, even though Itsuki now lives as a woman, Hina finds herself falling in love all over again, regardless of how Itsuki dresses. But Itsuki sees herself as a woman, and she only loves men. Will Hina end up heartbroken all over again?

title: Dream☆Jumbo☆Girl
title_original: ドリーム☆ジャンボ☆ガール
description: To secure her future financial and career success, studious high school student Chie aims to get accepted into the prestigious Tokyo University. Meanwhile her best friend, the air-headed goofball Kanae, just wants to enjoy her life in the moment. One day, Kanae buys a lottery ticket and ends up winning first prize! And how much money is that you may ask? A staggering 700 million yen! When the girls decide to split the winnings, Chie suddenly finds that the burden of being responsible for such a fortune is too much and she ends up flunking her entrance exams! With her planned-out future crumbling around her, Chie decides, “Screw it!”. If her life isn’t going to go the way she’d planned, then she’s going to use her newfound fortune to live the best life she ever could! (Source: Kodansha USA)

characters.name: Kanae Yumemura
characters.description: A former high school girl who wasn't good at studying. She's a huge spendthrift due to her impulsive, thoughtless actions.

characters.name: Chie Oono
characters.description: A former high school girl who excelled at studying. She has the talent to persevere through difficult times to relieve her anxieties. She is conservative when it comes to managing her money.

characters.name: Kirara Ishigami
characters.description: Kirara is an underground female idol. She is [Kanae](https://anilist.co/character/365497/Yumemura-Kanae Yumemura)'s favorite idol. Kirara is forced to retire due to slander from antis, but able to make a comeback as an underground idol after [Chie](https://anilist.co/character/365498/Oono-Chie) filed a disclosure request.

characters.name: Mei Miyamori
characters.description: Mei was about to be sold off as collateral for her father's 100 million yen debt, but [Chie](https://anilist.co/character/365498/Oono-Chie) paid it off and made her her personal maid. Her specialty dish is salt pasta.

characters.name: Nito Suenaga
characters.description: A dangerous woman who became [Chie](https://anilist.co/character/365498/Oono-Chie)'s pimp. ~!Actually, she writes novels, and her annual income last year was 10 million yen.!~

characters.name: Hitoha Kajino
characters.description: A girl who makes incredibly delicious donuts. She receives 30 million yen from [Chie](https://anilist.co/character/365498/Oono-Chie) as startup capital, but she's an outrageous woman who takes the money to the racetrack.

characters.name: Rika Hoshizaki
characters.description: Hoshizaki Rika, also known as her alternate name Mirika, is a popular virtual content creator on MeTube, and is persistently pursuing over [Naoya's](https://anilist.co/character/162887/Mukai-Naoya) affection for her. She is a first year high school student who attends the same school as [Saki Saki](https://anilist.co/character/162886/Saki-Saki) and Naoya.

title: Yuugai Muzai Gangu
description: Collection of one-shots: 1) Yuugai Muzai Gangu (有害無罪玩具) 2) Kyosuu Jikan no Asobi (虚数時間の遊び) 3) Kingyo no Ningyo wa Ningyo no Kingyo (金魚の人魚は人魚の金魚) 4) Bon ni Fukusui Bon ni Kaerazu (盆に復水 盆に帰らず)

title: Shoujo Junrei
description: Aiko moved to Tokyo out of an adoration for Shinonome Shion, a mangaka whose work touched her so greatly that she reveres them like a god. What she doesn't know is that Mao, her lonely, gloomy next door neighbor, is actually Shinonome-sensei herself. Their complicated relationship grows deeper as Mao tries to keep her identity a secret while struggling with the pedestal that Aiko has unknowingly put her on.

title: Ryuu to Ryuu no Kekkon
description: After a long war, Lycoris, a princess of the Wyvern Kingdom, and Raika, a princess of the Dragon Kingdom, are to be married as a sign of peace. Former enemies, the two begin a new life together… Lycoris has complicated feelings about the political marriage, but she can't help becoming attracted to Raika, who seems so lonely, despite her outward indifference. Two girls who do not know how to love, bond with each other as they heal each other's broken hearts. (Source: Shiori-on, translated)

title: Adabana no Yakusoku
description: Note: Published in Young Ace September 2025 issue.

title: Umi to Anata to Taiyou to
title_en: South Pacific Girlfriend -The Ocean, the Sun, and You...-
description: Nozomi is a normal girl working in Akihabara in Tokyo. A female foreigner, Kiara, from a southern island comes into the cafe she works at after a long day of shopping. The two decide to go to a bar together, and after Kiara gets drunk they go back to her hotel together. Nozomi begins to fall in love with Kiara and leaves Japan for Kiara's home island to be with her.

characters.name: Kiara
characters.description: Hardcore otaku and a bad drunk. Studied abroad in Europe, a well-bred young lady. (Skipped grades) Prefers bishoujo anime, addicted to collecting detailed figures. Her foreign otaku friends were like, "If you're going to Japan, beef bowls are quick, cheap, and nutritious," so she came to the recommended Ushiya. She was raised on the island she lives on, but her family moved to the main island. Works at local airport. Her schedule's all over the place because of the shifts. Acts like a different person at the workplace. She's got the brains and the looks, but her personality's horrible, so it balances out.

characters.name: Nozomi  Mochizuki
characters.description: A hardworking part-timer... until she stopped working because she couldn't get extended leave to come to the island. And without money, she had to move out of her apartment too. Her housewife skills passed down from her grandmother are top-notch. Good at Japanese cuisine, but bad at pasta or dressing fashionably. Has a smartphone, but canceled her contact, so now it's just a minicomputer. Usually a quiet person, but once she's decided on something she'll rush into it. ...It's really a shock for her friends

characters.name: Annie
characters.description: Manages the beach house. Offers souvenirs, sea bathing goods, snacks and drinks. Closes shop at sunset. Considered slender and petite among the locals. Dyes her hair blond for fashion, it's actually brown. Quite a bit older than she appears to be. Loves women, loves to fool around. She's a villain that even laid her hands on young Kiara. But she isn't possessive, and pushes Kiara to be able to stand on her own, so she's a good person to that extent. Grew up here, but she met Kiara in a lesbian bar on the main island.

title: Houmurareta Kimi e
description: In ten or so years, the moon will collide with the Earth, bringing with it the end of the world. Before the apocalypse happens, Nekuro confesses to her best friend Kiri. Kiri, seeing no hope for the future, takes her confession half-jokingly until one day, when Nekuro dies. (Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Aashi to Watashi. Gal x Yuri Anthology
title_original: あーしとわたし。ギャルｘ百合アンソロジー
description: A collection of Gal Yuri stories by various popular artists. Volume 2: ダチ越え?ピ越えだし by きいやん 良い子悪い子 by BirdHatter あたしの好きな香り by 桜木蓮 合コン行ったら ゲットされた話。 by かいばしら 語る指先 by 柚木がオ 針と深爪 by スズオ 抜間茶目は 駄目すぎる by ねる 逃げた先に あるものは by みかん氏

title: Todono Tsumarino Uchouten
title_original: とどのつまりの有頂天
description: Nekozaki Ren abused her powers as school council secretary to secretly set up a Miko Club in her school’s abandoned shrine. All of this so she could spend time with her crush, Yamada Mikoto, after school. But this wasn’t meant to last. Before long some people caught wind of their little club site, and with the school’s club building fully occupied, they saw themselves fit to use the shrine for their own club activities instead! Will Ren be able to reclaim her paradise?

characters.name: Mikoto Yamada
characters.description: **Height:** 155cm **Likes:** Hot milk **Dislikes:** Somen High School Freshman The founding member of the Miko Club, a miko from Kansai who moved away, to a new city, and now, in a new school, struggles to make friends.

characters.name: Ren Nekozaki
characters.description: **Height:** 169cm **Likes:** Sweets, caramel **Dislikes:** Fizzy drinks High School Freshman The secretary of the student council. Because of her crush on [Mikoto](https://anilist.co/character/139904/Mikoto-Yamada), she abused her power to set her up with a one-person club using the Uchouten Shrine as its clubroom.

characters.name: Yozora Usagida
characters.description: **Height:** 161cm **Likes:** Convenience store food **Dislikes:** Spicy food High School Freshman Usagida was a part of the Shut-In Club before joining The Uchoten Club. She skips most of her classes and spends her time in a sleeping bag but is rather cute when she's not wearing it

characters.name: Takuya Kumakura
characters.description: **Height:** 154cm Kumakura was a part of the Tokyo Fashion Club before becoming a part of The Uchoten Club. Apparently her stomach is the only strong part about her.

characters.name: Airi Shishimaru
characters.description: **Height:** 156cm **Likes:** Fizzy drinks, anything tasty **Dislikes:** None High School Freshman One of the two members of the former Showa Ballad Record Club. She's very selfish and has quite the mean streak, and constantly fights with her clubmate and roommate, [Pengin](https://anilist.co/character/155735/Ritsu-Pengin).

characters.name: Ritsu Pengin
characters.description: **Height:** 148cm One of the two members of the former Showa Ballad Record Club. She's cheery and outgoing, but constantly fights with her clubmate and roomate, [Shishimaru](https://anilist.co/character/155734/Airi-Shishimaru).

characters.name: Tsubaki Kobayashi
characters.description: **Height:** 162cm **Likes:** Fruit **Dislikes:** The gross chahan her mother makes High School Freshman. The treasurer of the student council and [Nekozaki](https://anilist.co/character/155733/Ren-Nekozaki)'s ornery roommate.

characters.name: Mashiro Fujishiro
characters.description: A tactless, trashy adult whose ethics have gone out the window. Refrains from smoking when [Tsubaki](https://anilist.co/character/213594/Tsubaki-Kobayashi) is around.

title: Yandere Meruko-chan wa Senpai ga Osuki
title_original: ヤンデレめる子ちゃんはせんぱいがお好き
description: I like you senpai ♡ I don't need anything else... Meru used to think love was a trifling matter, but then she met a petite "senpai" with a strong sense of justice and fell in love. She's very affectionate for senpai, but her love may be going a little bit overboard. (Source: Ichijinsha, translated)

title: Love Kome Style
description: Mimori Hibiki's goal was to find love, after leaving her backwater town for schooling in Tokyo. However, her grandmother's demand that she use her feminine wiles to lure a groom back to her hometown, combined with a fateful meeting with a young man, has complicated matters. Now she must attempt to juggle emotion and obligation as she attempts to carry out both of these tasks. (Source: Solaris-SVU)

title: Kakegurui Yorozu
description: Kakegurui - Yorozu: Official Comic Anthology is the exciting anthology edition spin-off of the popular gambling girls franchise, Kakegurui! With 32 of today’s best artists all bringing their unique skills to the table there’s even more fun to be had with this collection of original manga stories.

title: JS-san to OL-chan
description: Ryoka Ayase is a hardworking OL at a major snack company. She's great at her job, but at home she just wants to drink and be lazy. One day, she tried to go to work with a bad hangover but ended up collapsing outside her door. She was saved and comforted by a cute elementary school-girl who lived nearby. Can a forbidden relationship between JS X OL really work out!? (Source: Shodensha, translated) Note: Includes three bonus chapters.

title: Aru Hi Kareshi ga Onnanoko ni Natte Shimatta Couple no Nichijou
title_original: ある日彼氏が女の子になってしまったカップルの日常
description: A couple's daily life as they adjust to the boyfriend turning into a girl.

title: Koishigawa-san wa Nikushokukei
description: Koishigawa Akane is a cute, stylish gyaru with gray hair. But she's got a glare that gives a bad impression to most of her classmates, who now keep their distance. Nishimura Chika is the only one kind to her. Note: Chapter count includes 2 extras.

title: 2019 Rookie Danpyeonseon
description: Stories included: 1. Momo Cinnamon (모모 시나몬) [Yun-Su Lee] 2. Wangbi (왕비; Queen) [Yeong-Chae Hae] 3. Nancy wa Lara (낸시와 라라; Nancy and Lara) [Ri-Geon Lee] 4. Yeouhaegol (여우해골) [Su-Seong Yu] 5. Be my baby [Gon-Ji] 6. Eomma (엄마; Mom) [Samgueok] 7. Oraeorae Haengbokage Saratseumnida?! (오래오래 행복하게 살았습니다?!; Will We Live Happily Ever After?!) [Jep Park] 8. Najungmalgo Jigeum! (나중말고 지금!; Not Later, Now!) [SONNA] 9. Bimildongmaeng (비밀동맹; A Secret Alliance) [Du-O] 10. Immatchumeul Heoyonghagesseoyo (입맞춤을 허용하겠어요; I’ll Let You Kiss Me) [Seo-Yeon] 11. Ttangeseo Umteun Nalgae (땅에서 움튼 날개; Wings From the Ground) [Hyeon-Jeong Kim] 12. Eung, Ni Eolgul (응, 니 얼굴; Yeah, Your Face) [Nongyung10] 13. Boineungeot (보이는것; What You See) [Ga-Yeon Kim] 14. Eo Dark Sini-ui Sowon (어둑시니의 소원; The Dark Sini’s Wish) [ZQ] 15. Noineul Wihan Naraneun Eopda (노인을 위한 나라는 없다; There Is No Country for the Elderly) [ALTZ] 16. Going Home [Sin-Jin] 17. Goyangipyeonuijeom (고양이편의점; Cat Convenience Store) [So-Yeon Cha] 18. Gureume Garin Dal (구름에 가린 달; The Moon Hidden by Clouds) [Nagyeopbeoseot] 19. Myeolmanggwa Silheomui Huisaengyang (멸망과 실험의 희생양; The Scapegoat for Destruction and Experimentation) [Meotjinsegye] 20. Jjaksarang Jeonmun

title: Komada-san wo Komarasetai
title_original: 狛田さんを困らせたい
description: Komada-san is a petite high school girl who is easily flustered. Her junior, Kagai-san, who is big in many ways, is always teasing Komada-san and causing her trouble! There is only one reason for Kagai-san to be messing with her, because.... (Source: Comic Gamma Plus, translated)

title: Battle Club
description: When freshman transfer Mokichi arrives at Swan Academy High, he's got a chance to start over with a clean slate. He's got a plan, too. Kick the butts of the toughest guys in school, prove himself to be the baddest dude around, and run the whole shebang. Problem is, it's his butt that gets kicked that first day. Completely humiliated, Mokichi joins the Wrestling Club in hopes of learning to fight. There he meets unlikely allies, Tamako and Higuchi, two of the hottest battle babes to ever roll their sweaty bods over Swan Academy's gym mats. And Mokichi's gonna need all the friends he can get, what with the likes of the Karate Club looking to "break in" the new kid in the worst way possible. (Source: TOKYOPOP)

characters.name: Tamako Kaneda
characters.description: Tamako is a clutzy, full-figured student who focuses most of her time on wrestling. She takes after her mother, Tamami, who was the greatest wrestler to grace the sport. Tamami had an illness, and was told that unless she had an abortion, she would die. She refused, and died in childbirth. (Source: wikipedia)

characters.name: Mokichi Saito
characters.description: Mokichi is the main protagonist of the story. He is a bit of a loser and weakling. He is the only male member of the school wrestling club, (Taki doesn't count) which he does not mind at all. He enjoys the close wrestling moves and training with the girls, especially Tamako, on whom he has a crush. His drive to become stronger is topped only by his perverted nature, as he's been known to subconsciously outlast more powerful opponents in dangerously prolonged battles from time to time.

characters.name: Ichiyo Higuchi
characters.description: Vice-captain of the Wrestling Club and a lesbian who has the hots for Tamako. While a capable fighter, Higuchi, like Shiba with Tamako (whom Shiba is infatuated with.Takes any opportunity to grope the girl's proportions during wrestling practices. (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Shiba Ryoutarou
characters.description: At first an adversary of the wrestling club, but she quits the Karate Club after having lesbian fantasies of Tamako. She is Mokichi's rival in both love and battle. A powerful fighter in her own right, Shiba specializes in using ki-based moves that further enhance her physical attacks to incredible degrees. from: http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Battle_Club

title: Uchi no Musume ni Te wo Dasuna!: Oyako Heroine Funtousu
title_original: ウチのムスメに手を出すな! ―母娘ヒロイン奮闘す―
description: Meet “The Eighth Wonder”—a mother-daughter team of superheroes! Athena Haruka, the original Eighth Wonder, disappeared twenty years ago after a battle with the villainous organization, Blowjob. Now, Eighth Wonder has reappeared—but it's Athena's daughter, Clara, recruited to fill her mother's superhero shoes. When her daughter makes her debut as a superhero, Athena must leave the comforts of retirement, don her costume once again, and return to fighting crime so she can keep her daughter safe. But are the combined skills of these two super-powered women enough to combat what the world has in store for them? (Source: Seven Seas Entertainment) Included spin-off: Kitsuku! Daite Honey (キツク！ 抱いてハニー); Mebae Vol.1, 2 (2014)

title: Hametsu no Koibito
description: A young girl has her interest piqued by an enigmatic beauty whom she believes to be a witch.

title: Shiori wo Sagasu Page-tachi
title_original: しおりを探すページたち
description: The story of two girls with a shared love of books falling in love at the library.

title: Watashi to Kanojo no Kawaii Koi no Hajimekata
title_original: 私と彼女のかわいい恋のはじめ方
title_en: How My Cute Girlfriend and I Started a Love Story
description: Yoshiko Yokozawa is an office lady who loves cute things and being cute herself. Because of this, she is often not taken seriously and she is fed up with it. On the other hand, Chiaki Kurisu, a sales representative from a trading company, always seems very serious when she visits for business. For some reason, Kurisu suddenly invites Yokozawa to dinner!? Outside of work, Kurisu-san is completely different from her usual business-like behavior, being totally open and vulnerable...!? “This woman, is cuter than me!?” You can’t help but fall for her. ♡ Adult girls-love ♡ (Source: Kodansha, translated) Note: Includes eight extra chapters.

title: Yoshitomi Akihito Sakuhinshuu: BLUE DROP
title_original: 吉富昭仁作品集 BLUE DROP
description: A collection of five sci-fi one-shots from the creator of Eat-Man, set in a world where people are still dealing with the repercussions of a war fought with aliens many years ago. 1. KAMINOKO (神子 ～KAMINOKO～); Dengeki Comic Gao! 2005-02 2. BLUE DROP: Kowareta Tenshi (BLUE DROP ～壊れた天使～, BLUE DROP: Broken Angel); Dengeki Comic Gao! 2005-09 3. KAIJIN (海人 ～KAIJIN～); Dengeki Comic Gao! 2004-08 4. BLUE DROP: Tenshi no Yakusoku (BLUE DROP ～天使の約束～, BLUE DROP: The Angel's Promise); Dengeki Comic Gao! 2005-12 5. BLUE DROP: Tenshi no Sentaku (BLUE DROP ～天使の選択～, BLUE DROP: The Angel's Choice); Dengeki Comic Gao! 2006-02

characters.name: Yui
characters.description: Yui, the daughter of a human woman and an Arume, is a prominent member of the resistance in Japan in 3027, firmly opposing the Arume's millenium-long colonial occupation and the imposition of their values upon humanity. As a child, a girl that she loved was killed after being selected for the military's anti-Thought Condensing Weapon program, and as a result she feels especially strongly about rescuing those given the neutralization vaccines from their fates. Yui has a weakness for cute girls, and usually has very little regard for their personal boundaries. Voiced by [Nazuka Kaori](https://anilist.co/staff/95078/) in the radio drama adaptation of BLUE DROP.

characters.name: Shouko
characters.description: A high school senior who has been getting attention from the school's alien nurse, Misato-sensei. She is a friend of Yui, though hasn't seen her in two years. Voiced by [Nagata Ryouko](https://anilist.co/staff/95154/) in the radio drama adaptation of BLUE DROP.

characters.name: Misato
characters.description: An alien who works as a high school nurse in 3027. ~!She secretly works for the military, administering weapon remnant neutralization vaccines to particular school students to prepare them for use as sacrifices by the military. She is a firm believer in the Arume's values of self-sacrifice, a fact that led to her separation from Yui in the past.!~ Voiced by [Kosuge Mami](https://anilist.co/staff/101268/) in the radio drama adaptation of BLUE DROP.

characters.name: Ami Tagawa
characters.description: A high school student who, having been given the Thought Condensing Weapon neutralizing agent vaccine, is rescued by Yui moments before being deployed. Voiced by [Fukuen Misato](https://anilist.co/staff/95207/) in the radio drama adaptation of BLUE DROP.

characters.name: Kiyomi
characters.description: An ordinary human middle school girl in 3004. When she was around 11, her father adopted another girl, Rumi, and the two quickly became close friends. By the time they were both 13, however, Kiyomi had begun to grow jealous of Rumi's friendships with her own friends. Voiced by [Endou Aya](https://anilist.co/staff/95054/) in the radio drama adaptation of BLUE DROP.

characters.name: Rumi
characters.description: Kiyomi's adoptive sister, a friendly blue-eyed girl that gets along well with everyone. She is especially affectionate with Kiyomi, and has been in a particularly good mood lately. Voiced by [Hirohashi Ryou](https://anilist.co/staff/95111/) in the radio drama adaptation of BLUE DROP.

characters.name: Mami
characters.description: A somewhat nerdy high school first-year. She spends a lot of her time reading manga, and blames her own escapism for her having drifted away from her childhood friends Ryuuhei and Junko throughout elementary and middle school. She has had a strong crush on Ryuuhei for years, but believed him to be out of her league due to his popularity. Voiced by [Higasayama Tsugumi](https://anilist.co/staff/100862/) in the radio drama adaptation of BLUE DROP.

characters.name: Ryuuhei
characters.description: A classmate and childhood friend of Mami and Junko that has always been popular with girls. After his hair suddenly turned white in class, he became shunned as a "child of calamity" by the island's superstitious inhabitants. Around a week later, he showed up on Mami's doorstep, asking to stay at her house after being kicked out by his family. Voiced by [Nojima Hirofumi](https://anilist.co/staff/95341/) in the radio drama adaptation of BLUE DROP.

characters.name: Kurofuku no Otoko
characters.description: A member of the military in 3027 who has fought against Yui on multiple occasions. He is always seen dressed entirely in black. Voiced by [Kase Yasuyuki](https://anilist.co/staff/95801/) in the radio drama adaptation of BLUE DROP.

characters.name: Okamoto
characters.description: A classmate of Kiyomi and Rumi and a childhood friend of the former. Voiced by [Kirii Daisuke](https://anilist.co/staff/95114/) in the radio drama adaptation of BLUE DROP.

characters.name: Junko
characters.description: A childhood friend of Ryuuhei and Mami. She was dating Ryuuhei until his sudden hair color change. Voiced by [Kawaragi Shiho](https://anilist.co/staff/95465/) in the radio drama adaptation of BLUE DROP.

title: Re:Zero kara Hajimeru Isekai Seikatsu: Dai-5 Shou - Mizu no Machi to Eiyuu no Uta
title_original: Re:ゼロから始める異世界生活 第五章 水の都と英雄の詩
description: The 5th arc of the Re:Zero kara Hajimeru Isekai Seikatsu manga. Subaru and Emilia receive an invitation to a party from Anastasia and decide to go to Priestella, the city of the watergates.

characters.name: Emilia
