characters.description: **Height:** 164 cm (5'5") Emilia is a half-elf girl who is one of the candidates to become the next ruler in the royal election. [Subaru](https://anilist.co/character/88573/Natsuki-Subaru) first meets her when her insignia is stolen by [Felt](https://anilist.co/character/88574/Felt) as she needs to possess it to be eligible to participate in the election. She introduces herself as Satella when she and Subaru met during the first timeline before introducing herself by her real name when she got her insignia back. Emilia is good natured and likes to take care of others, though she herself refuses to admit it, instead thinking of it as her own selfishness. She is indifferent to her own appearance, leaving [Puck](https://anilist.co/character/90187/Puck) to take care of her clothes and hair. Because her appearance is similar to the [Witch of Envy](https://anilist.co/character/127242/Satella),

characters.name: Subaru Natsuki
characters.description: __Height:__ 173 cm (5'8") On the way home from the convenience store, he suddenly finds himself transported into another world. He has the ability that he calls "Return by Death" to go back in time when he dies. Despite being a hikikomori and gamer in his real world, Subaru does a bit of workout and seems to know basic hand-to-hand combat, making him not completely weak. While Subaru tends to not read the situation, he is loyal to those he holds dear, willing to help them, even if that means taking the thorny path. He has his resolve confirmed through the many situations and circumstances he faces in the fantasy world, originally having been one to always take the "easy" route. As a hikikomori, he is hopeful of the possibilities that being sucked into a new realm brings, but later realizes the realities of the predicament he is in. Ultimately, he resolves himself to be faithful and prote

characters.name: Anastasia Hoshin
characters.original: アナスタシア・ホーシン
characters.description: Anastasia Hoshin is the head of the Hoshin Trading Company and a candidate to become the 42nd King of Lugunica. Her knight is [Julius Juukulius](https://anilist.co/character/90183/Euclius-Julius). Despite her surname being "Hoshin", she's not directly related to Hoshin of the Wilderness. She chose the name because she was inspired by his legacy.

characters.name: Beatrice
characters.description: __Height:__ 140 cm (4'7") __Age:__ ~!400+ (Actual)!~ The caretaker of the library in [Roswaal](https://anilist.co/character/90182)'s mansion. She has a distinct way of speaking, adding "I suppose" and "in fact" at the end of some of her sentences. ~!Around 400 years ago, Beatrice was created by [Echidna](https://anilist.co/character/129330). She helped her with her experiments, such as the Sanctuary Barrier, though she wasn't told everything as she didn't know that [Ryuuzu Meyer](https://anilist.co/character/174072) would be sealed in a crystal. Sometime later, Echidna ordered her to stand guard over the library while she waited for "that person," an order which she diligently followed.!~ ~!After numerous and painful attempts to convince her to leave the library [Subaru](https://anilist.co/character/88573) succeeded, and Beatrice became his contract spirit.!~

characters.name: Otto Suwen
characters.original: オットー・スーウェン
characters.description: Otto Suwen is a merchant appearing in Re:Zero. His remarkable misfortune always takes him to dangerous situations, from which he escapes thanks to his wit. Otto has gray hair that is mentioned to be as long as a gal game protagonist. He is said to be somewhat handsome if he has a serious expression. However, he is usually either retorting, shouting, or panicking, ruining his looks. He has a medium build, but has trained himself since he used to work as a merchant.

characters.name: Garfiel Tinsel
characters.original: ガーフィール・ティンゼル
characters.description: Garfiel Tinsel is the former guardian of the Sanctuary and a member of the Emilia Camp. Introduced during Arc 4, he became one of the main supporting characters of the season. He's a half-beast human and [Frederica Baumann's](https://anilist.co/character/143378/Baumann-Frederica) half-brother. He can transform himself in a giant golden tiger that can deal powerful attacks but with a cost of losing his reason, so he uses this ability when he's pushed to the limit. ~!Garfiel and Frederica lived together until she left when he was around 4 years old and he hadn't seen her since until their reunion 10 years later during the Sanctuary incident. After seeing his mother's "death" during the trial at a young age, he began to fear the outside world, causing him to try and protect the Sanctuary.!~

characters.name: Mimi Pearlbaton
characters.description: __Height:__ 135 cm (4'5") Mimi is one of Anastasia Hoshin's followers and is one of three vice-captains of the mercenary group Fang of Steel.

characters.name: Joshua Euclius
characters.original: ヨシュア・ユークリウス
characters.description: __Age__: 19 (Arc 5+) Joshua is Julius Euclius' younger brother. Joshua is extremely well mannered and elegant but, unlike Julius, he can’t keep his composure and often gets flustered. Joshua was born sickly so he’s physically very weak and has a narrow point of view towards the world yet at the same time having a lot of respect for his brother.

title: Kamigette Sou Iu Koto desu ka
title_original: 神ゲーってそういうことですか
description: Senoo Anna recently got a job at a social game company called Kami Games, which turns out to be run by actual Gods. Sexy... a selfish idol... an alcoholic... someone who loves cute girls... various other Gods and... a black lily? Game development begins!

title: Home Center-goto Yobidasareta Watashi no Daimeikyuu Renovation!
title_original: ホームセンターごと呼び出された私の大迷宮リノベーション!

title: Dounika Naru Hibi
description: A collection of short stories that take a refreshing and humorous look at the sexual relationships between young people in Japan. Love is love. Someday, the pain of being in love will be an endearing memory. No matter who the feelings are towards, no matter what form it takes, all love and lifestyles have the same value. An omnibus anime tells the stories of "The wedding of an ex", "a student and a teacher at an all-boys' school" and "childhood friends whose bodies and hearts change with adolescence." (Source: Kotonoha, Digital Manga Guild)

title: Koi ni Koisuru Yukari-chan
title_original: 恋に恋するユカリちゃん
description: "Are Takagi-san and Nishikata-kun going out?" Grand prize winner in the Takagi-san cup! A girly (?) love comedy about Takagi-san's classmates. Written with the seal of approval from the original author, Souichirou Yamamoto.

characters.name: Mina Hibino
characters.description: Mina is an energetic, bubbly girl and always cheerful in the group. She is very playful at all times and always noisy. Mina also is bad at running and gets tired easily, such as when she was excited for the school marathon, yet got tired at the start.

characters.name: Sanae Tsukimoto
characters.description: Sanae Tsukimoto is one of [Nishikata](https://anilist.co/character/120799/Nishikata)'s and [Takagi](https://anilist.co/character/120800/Takagi)'s classmates and a close friend of [Mina](https://anilist.co/character/128608/Mina-Hibino) and [Yukari](https://anilist.co/character/128614/Yukari-Tenkawa). Sanae is a very blunt, yet caring and intelligent girl. Known for always having a very stoic expression and demeanor, Sanae likes to keep to herself. She is extremely athletic and is particularly adept at running and swimming. Underneath her typically expressionless exterior, Sanae is shown to care greatly for her two closest friends, Mina and Yukari. The three girls are constantly seen together, both in and out of school. Sanae may have a soft spot for animals. In one instance, Sanae was chasing a cat that had taken Yukari's snack. However, upon realizing that the cat had taken the snack in

characters.name: Nishikata
characters.description: __Height:__ 150 cm (4'11") Nishikata is a middle school student in class 1-2. He sits in the back of the classroom next to [Takagi](https://anilist.co/character/120800). He can't handle bitter things like black coffee, secretly watches/reads a romance titled "100% Unrequited Love", and gets frightened very easily. He does average academically.

characters.name: Takagi
characters.description: __Height:__ 150 cm (4'11") A middle schooler​ at an unnamed school. She sits at the back of class 1-2 next to [Nishikata](https://anilist.co/character/120799). Academically talented and physically capable, she claims her only weaknesses are her ticklish armpits and her inability to stop teasing Nishikata.

characters.name: Kyouko Fudatsuki
characters.description: Kenji Fudatsuki's younger sister and a Jiangshi. She requires blood in order to continue daily life, and she wears a large hair ribbon that acts to restrain her impulse to feed.

characters.name: Kenji Fudatsuki
characters.description: Kyouko Fudatsuki's older brother. Though misconstrued, he is well-known throughout their school as a delinquent and a siscon (sister complex).

title: Hagure Idol Jigoku-hen Gaiden: Princess Sarah
title_original: はぐれアイドル地獄変外伝 プリンセス・セーラ
description: A one-volume spinoff of Hagure Idol Jigokuhen, this calvacade of short stories focuses on "Princess" Sarah Goujima - a friend to main protagonist Misora Haebaru, and a full-time porn actress. You name it, she's done it - she's covered every fetish both legal and illegal, and the people she's made love to could easily fill a football stadium to the brim. She's lewd, crude, and will bang any dude.

title: Musanso Renai
description: Extra chapter from I Married My Best Friend to Shut My Parents Up.

title: Saji-chan no Yami Nikki
title_original: サジちゃんの病み日記
description: Saji has a girl that she likes. That pure feeling is not understood by others, but surely love is the truth. Take, steal, stab, take away... it is also love. (Source: Amazon, translated)

title: Tokyo Girls Destruction
title_original: トーキョー・ガールズ・デストラクション
description: In the 2020’s the Japanese female culture was extremely corrupted in the eyes of the first women prime minister. To bring back the beauty of Japanese femininity, she created the Amazon Academy, a girls-only school, on an artificial island isolated in the middle of the Pacific Ocean. Amesu Kumi just transferred into Amazon Academy to investigate the death of her older sister, Towa, who also attended the school until she died in a shroud of mystery. The only clue she has is the name Burai Sachiko left in Towa’a cell phone. How could Kumi have known that the school literally turns into a battlefield when classes are over; where petite girls beat each other senseless in order to survive. (Source: MangaHelpers)

characters.name: Kumi Amasu
characters.description: She's a kindhearted and a little naive girl who trusts people easily, but has a strong will. She transfers to Amazon Academy to find out who killed her sister. After coming to the school she makes friends with Burai Sachiko, two-faced Hinata Mineko and Sasarano Sara. She has one badge and tries hard to not let others steal it from her. She is protected by Burai, who was her sister's friend.

characters.name: Sachiko Burai
characters.description: She's a strong fighter, who was put in the cell because of collecting too much badges. She was a friend and a protector of Kumi's sister Towa, before she was killed. She saves Kumi from an attack and escapes from the cell the same day Kumi has transferred to Amazon Academy. After a short while she and Kumi will become friends, when Kumi tells she trusts her. She protects Kumi from the attackers.

title: Kanojo to Camera to Kanojo no Kisetsu
title_original: 彼女とカメラと彼女の季節
title_en: She, Her Camera and Her Seasons
description: Akari is a third-year student who has spent her high school career sticking to the straight and narrow...but her attention is caught by Yuki Sendo, the short-haired, standoffish girl in her class who seems to buck the trend. Akari can't seem to stop seeking Yuki out, and her feelings rapidly develop into something more than girlish friendship. But Yuki seems to have eyes only for her childhood friend, Rintaro Kagawa...who himself seems to have feelings for Akari. It's a mess...and one that threatens to grow even messier as Akari navigates between what she wants and what's expected of her... (Source: Kodansha USA)

characters.name: Mel
characters.description: A girl who lives in a mansion with her master and works as a maid.

title: Hachishaku Hachiwa Kerakumeguri: Igyou Kaikitan
title_original: 八尺八話快樂巡り ～異形怪奇譚～
description: 1. Hasshaku-sama (AKA Hachisakusama / Hachisaku-sama) 2. Yamanoke (Mountain Creature) 3. Mannequin 4. Kankandara 5. Shishinoke 6. Ushi no Kubi (Cow's Head) 7. Kunekune (Wriggling body) 8. Saruyume (Monkey dream)

title: Isekai Harem Paradise
title_original: 異世界ハーレムパラダイス
description: Moteuchi Kei is a shut-in who spends his life playing "Isekai Harem Paradise", an online fantasy game full of cute girls of various races, from succubi to elves and others. Alas, the game is set to shut down in a week, to Kei's dismay. What he didn't expect was to be summoned into the game's world by its characters, along (accidentally) with three of his classmates. He's now the only one who can save that fantasy world he knows so well… but the succubus Désir, who summoned him, seems to have other plans.

title: Mahou Shoujo Lyrical Nanoha ViVid
title_original: 魔法少女リリカルなのはViVid
description: The series takes place four years after the events of Mahou Shoujo Lyrical Nanoha StrikerS, during which Nanoha Takamachi rescued and adopted a young girl named Vivio, who is the reincarnation of the Sankt Kaiser, Olivie Segbrecht. After entering her fourth year of elementary school, Vivio is given her own intelligence device, Sacred Heart, and gains the power to transform using her adult Sankt Kaiser mode. She soon comes across a girl named Einhart Stratos who, similar to Vivio, is the descendant of another Sankt Kaiser ruler, Claus G.S. Ingvalt. As Einhart becomes determined to prove her fighting style is the strongest, Vivio befriends her and, together with her friends, enters a martial arts tournament where they fight against various opponents and learn more about their past lives. Included one-shot: Volume 2: 5th Anniversary Collaboration Comic: Fate/stay night x Mahou Shoujo Lyrical Nanoha

characters.name: Vivio Takamachi
characters.description: (StrikerS), 10 (ViVid) __Eye color:__ Green & Brownish red __Hair color:__ Golden Blond __Handedness:__ Right __Intelligent Device:__ Sacred Heart aka Cris After being found by Caro and Erio during their break, she was taken into Nanoha and Fate's care. Her most visible feature is heterochromia. Quattro has referred to her as the "Vessel of the Saints". Also has Nanoha as her mother and Fate as her step-mother who is really her Godmother.

characters.name: Einhart Stratos
characters.original: ハイデイ・E・S・イングヴアルト / アインハート・ストゥラトス
characters.description: A user of Kaiser Arts that has given herself the name of the previous Sankt Kaiser. She picked street fights in order to prove that Hegemon's strength is the greatest of all Belkan warriors, . Like Vivio, she has a child form and an adult form, though the latter is taxing on her mind, and she also has heterochromia. Her true identity is discovered by Nove and the Nakajimas, who decide to help her better understand everyone and become acquainted with Vivio. (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Rio Wezley
characters.description: **Intelligent Device:** [Solfège](https://anilist.co/character/220248/Solfge) (ソルフェージュ) One of [Vivio](https://anilist.co/character/4174/Vivio-Takamachi)'s best friends. Like Vivio, she attends St. Hilde Academy of Magic in Midchilda. Specialized in a mix of martial arts and close combat magic.

characters.name: Corona Timir
characters.description: (ViVid) Eye color: Light Blue Hair color: Light Brown Intelligent Device: Brunzell Vivio's best friend. She frequently studies and has a unique magic ability; she is a Golem Summoner.

characters.name: Fate Testarossa
characters.original: フェイト・テスタロッサ
characters.description: __Intelligent Device:__ [Bardiche](https://anilist.co/character/220250/Bardiche) Fate is introduced as an antagonist and rival to Nanoha Takamachi, she first encounters Nanoha during the Jewel Seed Incident while collecting the Lost Logia known as the Jewel Seeds on behalf of her abusive mother, Presea Testarossa. Despite their initial conflict, the two develop a close friendship that evolves into a lifelong partnership.

characters.name: Nanoha Takamachi
characters.description: __Intelligent Device:__ Raising Heart Excelion. Strike Cannon, Fortress __Rank:__ S+ __Rank (StrikerS):__ Captain of Stars Squad, part of the mobile sixth division __Code name (StrikerS):__ Stars 1 In Mahou Shoujo Lyrical Nanoha, Nanoha Takamachi is sweet if naive third-grader. However, she has always felt like she is missing something in her life: all the people around her have someone there​ are very close to but she lacks this. However, Nanoha is no longer an "ordinary" third grader when she meets and helps the wounded ferret, who just happens to be a mage from another planet, Yuuno Scrya. He has come to Earth to gather the "Jewel Seeds," mysterious artifacts containing great power. Nanoha agrees to help him, but the task seems harder than presented when she meets Fate Testarossa, another girl searching for the Jewel Seeds. In A's, six months after the first season, Nanoha still remai

characters.name: Signum
characters.description: __Nanoha A's__ Signum enters the story when Vita has attempted to steal Nanoha Takamachi's Linker Core (a mage's source of magic) for the Book of Darkness. Since the arrival of Nanoha's cavalry, Fate Testarossa and Yūno Scrya, Vita is cornered and Signum must come to her rescue with Shamal. The Wolkenritter overpower the TSAB troupe with their use of high-powered magical cartridges, and Signum manages to snap Fate's staff, Bardiche, in half. The battle ends with Shamal finally managing to get Nanoha's Linker Core and Nanoha breaking Vita's barrier. Signum refuses to take a bath that night for fear of Hayate seeing the injuries sustained in her battle with Fate. Signum may appear emotionless, but she is completely dedicated to Hayate, and as the leader of the Wolkenritter, fights for the others as well. The Wolkenritter attack mages to steal their Linker Cores, their sources of magic, to

characters.name: Vita
characters.description: __Vita in Mahou Shoujo Lyrical Nanoha A's__ Vita enters A's on a hunt with Zafila for strong Linker Cores to absorb into the Book of Darkness. She targets Nanoha Takamachi, which she deems to be a juicy target, unlike the usual TSAB "redshirts" which can barely fill up a single page of the Book of Darkness. Nanoha puts up a decent fight, but Vita tilts the deck with two cartridges (bullet shaped things that contain high-pressure magic) manages to overpower her, obtaining a power superiority so vast that she heavily damaged the Raising Heart. However, before she could get the Linker Core, Fate Testarossa and Yūno Scrya come to the rescue. Vita fights them off with her fellow Wolkenritter, Signum and Shamal, and they declare themselves enemies. The battle ends with Shamal finally managing to get Nanoha's Linker Core and Nanoha breaking Vita's barrier. ~! Vita fights for the sake of protect

characters.name: Hayate Yagami
characters.description: __Intelligent Device(s):__ Buch der Nachthimmel/Book of Darkness (Storage/Tome), Schwertkreuz (Rod), Reinforce II (Unison Device) A sweet and gentle orphan who is confined to a wheelchair, is cared for by the Wolkenritter, who deliberately keep their battles hidden from her. She knows that completing the Book of Darkness would grant her immense power, but she refuses to accept that power at the cost of innocent lives. Unbeknownst to her, however, the Book is already feeding on her life force, causing her paralysis and slowly weakening her. If it is not completed, the Book will eventually consume her life entirely.

characters.name: Subaru Nakajima
characters.description: Mid-childa native, private 1st class with a mage rank of "B". Subaru was rescued from from a burning airport by Nanoha four years prior. This incident inspired Subaru to join the armed forces with aspirations of becoming a powerful mage. By chance she was transfered into Mobile Section Six's Stars squad commanded by the very same person who rescued her. On the field, she is equipped with the rollerblade-like intelligent device Mach Caliber and the armed device Revolver Knuckle. ~!Like her sister Ginga she is actually a cyborg created on base of genetical material of Quint Nakajima!~

characters.name: Teana Lanster
characters.original: ティアナ・ランスター
characters.description: Mid-childa native, private 2nd class with a mage rank of "B". Teana was raised by her older brother through most of her childhood up to his death. Because of a mission in which her brother had failed to apprehend a wanted mage, the Lanster name was shamed and Teana made efforts to redeem herself and her dead brother throughout her time at the academy. She was assigned into the Stars squad under the TSAB Mobile Section Six with Subaru Nakajima. She is armed with the intelligent device Cross Mirage. Has rare magic specialization is Illusionist and Gunslinger

characters.name: Lutecia Alpine
characters.original: ルーテシア・アルピーノ
characters.description: A Belkan Bug Summoner. Lutecia travels with Zest and Agito. The 3 works with Scaglietti on getting Relics, but Lutecia is only of the 3 that trusts Scaglietti and his Numbers. Zest and Agito have tried to convince that Scaglietti isn't worth trusting, but have been unsuccessful as Lutecia views Scaglietti as a kind man. Because of her trusting attitude, Scaglietti has been able to manipulate her actions to an extent. She and Zest have been referred to on one occasion as Relic Weapon Experiments by Scaglietti. And as it turns out, she and Zest have been searching for very specific Relics, Lutecia specifically in search of Relic number 11. ~!As revealed in Episode 24, she is the daughter of Megane Alpine, who was involved in the Combat Cyborg incident where Zest was presumed to have been killed. In the Epilogue she is seen living with her mother. She is named for the Renault Lutecia,

characters.name: Erio Mondial
characters.original: エリオ・モンディアル
characters.description: A boy whom Fate takes in and cares for, and the guard wing of the Lightning Squad. He uses an armed device named Strada. It is a spear (electricity attribute), similar to Signum's sword (flare attribute). He uses the modern-Belka magic system, but is also able to perform some Mid-Childa mobile magics like Sonic Move. Erio was adopted by Lindy Harlaown four years prior to StrikerS, as Fate was legally too young to do so. Erio shows signs of a romantic interest in Caro.

characters.name: Caro Ru Lushe
characters.description: A pink-haired little girl with jewels on her gloves (which may be a reference to Magic Knight Rayearth, as were the names of the Wolkenritter) that are actually a new type of device, a "Boost Device" named Kerykeion. She seems to have a magic circle that is light pink, but then it also shows that she has a magical square just like Lutecia. She first uses her magical square in episode 17 when she summoned the Dragon King to destroy. Though she is not proficient in attack magics, she is good at boost magics and can perform the unique summon magics. Her unique talent as a dragon summoner was frightening to the Ru Lushe clan, by which she was raised, and they banished her from their native land of Arzus. On the other extreme, the TSAB almost refused her because, though her talent was great, her skills were not refined. However, Fate T. Harlaown took her on herself. Caro appears to

characters.name: Ginga Nakajima
characters.description: (StrikerS), 21 (ViVid) __Eye color:__ Light blue __Hair color:__ Violet __Handedness:__ Left __Intelligent Device:__ Blitz Caliber __Rank:__ S Subaru's older sister. She belongs to Battalion 108 along with her father Major Genya Nakajima. When fighting, she uses the intelligent device Blitz Caliber which has the same dynamics as Subaru's Mach Caliber. She joined TSAB in order to further investigate the death of her mother.

title: Kankaku Kyouyuu Maid-san!
description: Chloe and Mia are twin maids who work for the Evans family. Actually, they share a thrilling secret...? A peek into the daily lives of two slightly naughty and very cute maids! (Source: Dengeki Daioh G, translated)

title: Watashi no Midarana Kairai
description: At work, you're the cold, strict senior colleague. At home, you're the gentle, sweet lover. Which one is the real you? The extraordinary Itsuki Tsutsui debuts with a 59-page one-shot about a secret, warped obsession no one can know about!! (Source: MANGA Plus)

characters.name: Sara Komura
characters.description: Sara is an office worker in love with her direct supervisor, Takatsuki.

characters.name: Kaho Takatsuki
characters.description: She is Sara's direct supervisor, as the leader of her design team. She is very strict and often belittles her subordinates.

title: Yuri Mekuru Hibi
description: A chance meeting blossomed to love between two girls. But it’s quite a peculiar couple: Sayuri is ordinary in every way, while her love interest, Yoriko, is a refined lady who seems to be completely lacking in common sense. Graceful attraction between two very different personalities, a sweet and slightly dazzling love story.

title: Lycoris Recoil Koushiki Comic Anthology: React
title_original: リコリス・リコイル 公式コミックアンソロジー リアクト
title_en: Lycoris Recoil Official Comic Anthology: React
description: Welcome to Café LycoReco! Join Chisato, Takina, and their Lycoris co-workers inside for a taste of their lives off-the-clock from Lycoris duty, whether it's devising new menu items or balancing the books! (Source: Yen Press)

characters.name: Takina Inoue
characters.description: Previously an exceptional Lycoris, but for some reason, she now works at Café LycoReco. A realistic person with a distaste for inefficiency, she can be dissatisfied with [Chisato](https://anilist.co/character/260329/Nishikigi-Chisato), who is not a typical Lycoris. She wants to see good results in her job at LycoReco.

characters.name: Chisato Nishikigi
characters.description: Chisato is said to be the strongest Lycoris of all time. She enjoys solving private-sector problems that the DA would not address. At Café LycoReco, she works joyfully and cheerfully as the self-proclaimed poster girl. ~!Chisato has an artificial heart which was developed by Alan Institute, and can be broken by applying high voltages directly to it.!~

characters.name: Mizuki Nakahara
characters.description: Previously a DA Intelligence Division member, she’s been with Chisato for a long time. In her desperate desire to marry, she took the job at the café in hopes of meeting her special someone. Her routine includes a nightly drink while reading wedding magazines.

characters.name: Kurumi
characters.description: A young runaway girl of unknown origins who loves all kinds of games. She’s a terrible employee who reluctantly works in exchange for lodging. She only looks forward to gaming parties with the café’s regulars come closing time. ~!In some later episodes, it is revealed that Kurumi is actually the hacker Walnut.!~

characters.name: Mika
characters.description: Lamenting the worsening of his eyesight as he grows older day after day, he is the surrogate parent gently overseeing his problematic employees. Ohagi mochi and coffee, Japanese clothing and a café. It’s all about expressing a mix of Japanese and Western styles. He is the manager of the café with a traditional Japanese twist, "Café LycoReco”. ~!In episode 7 of the anime, it is revealed that Mika is gay.!~

characters.name: Kusunoki
characters.description: DA Commander.

title: Rezu Fuuzoku Anthology
title_original: レズ風俗アンソロジー
description: This volume includes the following chapters: Cover Illustration: Homura Subaru 1. Iiko + Iikoto (イイコ+イイコト) [Homura Subaru] 2. Sugar Cigaret (Sugar cigaret) [Iwami Kiyoko] 3. PafuPafu (PafuPafu) [Kodama Naoko] 4. Madam Prince (ミダメ・プリンス) [Mashimaru] 5. Ichiban no Hito (いちばんのひと) [Nanatsu Fuji] 6. Guragura Platonic (ぐらぐらプラトニック) [Oosawa Yayoi] 7. Kaori ni Tsutsuma Rete (香りに包まれて) [Renjou Hani] 8. Sayonara, Shirayukihime (さよなら、白雪姫) [Katakura Ako]

title: GIRLS BAND CRY
title_original: ガールズバンドクライ
description: Feeling out of place in the countryside, high school dropout Nina Iseri moves to Tokyo. After a rough first day and getting locked out of her apartment, she meets her favorite guitarist, Momoka Kawaragi. The two put on a street performance together and decide to start a band with three other girls. While each girl faces her own struggles, their passion for music keeps their dreams alive. (Source: Crunchyroll)

characters.name: Nina Iseri
characters.description: __Height:__ 152 cm An ordinary girl who is a little shy. She attended school, but kept a low profile and had average grades. She didn't have any big dreams and lived her life going with the flow.

characters.name: Momoka Kawaragi
characters.description: __Height:__ 164 cm A young street musician. She is easy-going and firm. She does not like to dress typically feminine and chooses to keep her hair down, and keep her clothes plain. She is bright and caring and has the feeling of an reliable senior at an athletic club.

characters.name: Subaru Awa
characters.description: __Height:__ 158 cm A girl who attends an entertainment school. She's appeared in commercials and has a promising future ahead of her. She is a beautiful girl who could become a model, and is good at socialising and is very graceful. But, inside she is actually strong-willed and competitive.

characters.name: Tomo Ebizuka
characters.description: __Height:__ 148 cm Originally, she was a young lady from a wealthy family that was famous in their local area. However, she currently lives in a shared apartment. Her view on the world is cold and oblique. Like a hedgehog, she is very cautious and does not open up much.

characters.name: Rupa
characters.description: __Height:__ 169 cm A slightly tanned girl who has a South Asian father and a Japanese mother. She has an artistic sense, and a clear-headed mind. She is a so-called genius that everyone respects for her gentle and modest demeanor. Her only flaws is that she is a heavy drinker, and gets tunnel vision when she has a goal in mind.

title: Rezu Goukon to Mayoikonda Nonke no Musume
title_original: レズ合コンと迷い込んだノンケの娘

title: Glitch
description: Siblings Minato and Akira Lee have moved to a new town, and they’re expecting things to be different— but not this different! Ghostly figures tower over and pass through buildings, drawing no reaction from the locals, some of whom appear far from normal themselves. When Akira spots a strange creature outside her window, she and her new friends organize a search. If no one else can explain the uncanny appearances, the investigation club will get to the bottom of it! (Source: Yen Press)

title: γ: Gamma
description: It's an age where aliens, monsters and other dangers threaten the Earth, and various heroes have risen to protect it. Supporting these heroes are the human defense forces, of which the Kitajishi sisters Miyuki and Yuri are a part. Specifically, their office is for hero consultation, and they help heroes solve their problems, but they also help evacuation procedures during emergencies. Yuri was formerly an immensely powerful and popular magic girl, but now she helps protect people in a more human way. In their first case, they consult with a hero who has lost his powers, and is trying to find a way to live as an ordinary human. (Source: Mangahelpers)

title: Tou Xiang
description: Two women hidden away deep in a mansion, who save each other through their roller coaster of a relationship! Bai Yuetao, the wife of a rich businessman, blames herself for her husband's skirt-chasing. After getting all dressed up, only to spend another night alone in their lavish residence, she sees a graceful woman appear in her new mirror. This woman calls herself "Mengdie" and says that she can teach Bai Yuetao how to "hook" her husband's heart, but the price will be— Bai Yuetao's body. (Source: Bilibili, translated)

title: Gal Yuri
description: Erika is a normal student, who one day due to special circumstances will live with another girl named Yuri! But Yuri dreams of "marrying" her and will do anything to fulfill that dream. Includes a prologue chapter.

title: Koroshiya Yametai!
description: Rose became an assassin to survive as an immigrant refugee. Her lover, Benika, is an ordinary schoolgirl, who wanted to keep their homosexual romance hidden from her father, a priest at the church where Rose goes to confess her sins of murder. Rose's employer, the "Organization," is also on the move, as Rose's personal and professional relationships are about to get very, very messy!?! (Source: Comic Days, translated) Note: Chapter count includes one epilogue and five omake chapters.

characters.name: Benika
characters.description: Rose's girlfriend. She hides Rose's existence from her father (Father Shirahune) because she feels it is wrong for a priest's daughter to be homosexual.

characters.name: Shirafune
characters.description: Benika's father. He followed her on a date because he was worried about his daughter, which is how he met Rose. Without realising it, he wears a rosary containing sensitive information about an assassination organisation.

characters.name: Rose Madder Shinagawa
characters.original: ローズマダー 品川
characters.description: She is an ex-soldier refugee who still works as a hitman since she has no alternative for earning money, but she keeps this a secret from Benika, her girlfriend. She wants to give up her assassin job and become free so that she can have a future with Benika.

characters.name: Boss
characters.description: The head of an assassination organization that is in conflict with the church. They suspect Rose of being a traitor and are monitoring her movements.

characters.name: Hibai
characters.description: An agent dispatched on a mission from an assassination organization. She is attempting to get close to Benika, who is believed to be Rose's weak point.

characters.name: Ildebrand
characters.description: The head of the church that is hostile to the assassination organization. He suspects that Father Shifune, to whom he had entrusted a rosary important for the ongoing conflict, may actually be a traitor and is currently investigating.

title: Haru Natsu Aki Fuyu
description: Attention Girls! Is loving another worth it? As our play unfolds at Saint Theresa Girls Academy, this anthology is filled to the brim with young women's passion. She-wolf, Natsuki, and the transfer student, Fuyuka's, slapstick days are portrayed in "She-Wolf", Haruka who loves grabbing other girls' chests, and the best friend who is interested in her, Akiho, star in "Expressions of Love," Reiko and Ayano, two teachers who find adult love in "First Kiss" and more, these stories are full of breast-grabbing, kinda sexy fun! Three female couples' stories interweave in this Girl's Love Comic collection! (Source: JManga) 1. Aijou♥Hyougen (愛情♥表現, Expressions of Love) 2. Onna Ookami (オンナオオカミ, She-wolf) 3. First Kiss 4. Gyakushuu no Akazukin-chan (逆襲の赤ズキンチャン, Little Red Riding Hood Strikes Back) 5. Haru Natsu Aki Fuyu (Spring, Summer, Winter, Fall) 6. Kanojo (彼女, Her)

title: Isekai Tensei Yuri Anthology
title_original: 異世界転生百合アンソロジー
description: One day, when I woke up, I was in a world I didn't know about! A fantasy en solo appearance where girls foster new relationships in a different world! Story 1 - A Goddess' Blessing and a Convenient Life in Another World (Yuu Nonaka) Story 2 - I am a Princess for Just One Knight (merryhachi) Story 3 - The Case of Being Confined by a Yandere Girl in Another World (Doromaru Numachi) Story 4 - A Harem Skill Was Equipped by Default (Rio Ihara) Story 5 - The You I Met Reflected in Me (Kiyan) Story 6 - The Essence of the You I Met Once Again (Kiyan) Story 7 - A Succubus' Love (Sekihara) Story 8 - Starting Life as a Cat in Another World (Sumire)

title: Neukdaeneun Taeyangeul Humchinda
title_en: The Wolf Who Stole the Sun
description: Golden Toldran is the wealthiest realm on the continent. Princess Charlotte, after years of religious devotion, is thrust into a public courtship she never desired. When Skadi, a singular suitor from the distant land of Nuanar, enters her life, boredom gives way to something far more dangerous. (Source: Manta) Note: Includes three extra chapters.

title: Maou to Yuri
description: Princess, hero, priestess, witch, and maid. If you had to choose one to be your queen, who would it be? The war between humans and demons had just ended, but the world still feared more conflict. The only way to assure peace is for the Demon Lord (female) to take a human queen! Which heroine will you choose? Your choice will help guide the story to its conclusion! It's a new kind of reader-participation harem comedy! (Source: ComicWalker, translated)

title: Kidou Senshi Gundam: Suisei no Majo - Seishun Frontier
title_original: 機動戦士ガンダム 水星の魔女 青春フロンティア
description: This work is a spin-off comic of the TV anime Mobile Suit Gundam: Witch of Mercury that began broadcasting in October 2022. It is a parallel work set in a near-future Japan, depicting the encounter between high school girls Suletta and Miorine. (Source: Press Release, Translated)

characters.name: Suletta Mercury
characters.original: スレッタ・マーキュリー
characters.description: A second-year student in the piloting department, who transferred to the school from Mercury. Suletta is timid and somewhat lacks communication skills. She is the pilot of the Gundam Aerial developed on Mercury. ~!Suletta was one of the repli-children created from Ericht Samaya. However, according to official records, she had a deceased father. As Aliya Mahvash mentioned when she told her fortune, she learned that her father had passed away when she was a young child.!~

characters.name: Miorine Rembran
characters.original: ミオリネ・レンブラン
characters.description: An attractive and academically distinguished second-year student in the management strategy department. Miorine is the only daughter of Delling Rembran, the president of the Beneritt Group and chairman of the school's board. She has a strong rebellious feeling towards her father. Miorine has shown an interest in gardening in her spare time, with an apparent focus on tomatoes. (Source: Mobile Suit Gundam: The Witch from Mercury Official Site)

characters.name: Elan Ceres
characters.description: A pilot fielded by Peil Technologies—one of the "Big Three" corporations within the Benerit Group. A third-year student in the Piloting Department at the Asticassia School of Technology (Student ID: KP002), he is also a member of the Duel Committee. He pilots the Zowort and the Gundam Pharact. Although he is the top-ranked student in the Peil dormitory, he remains a solitary figure who does not open up to anyone at the academy. Perhaps due to this, his only real point of contact was [Shaddiq Zenelli](https://anilist.co/character/279509/Shaddiq-Zenelli)—a fellow member of the Duel Committee with strong communication skills. Later, however, he developed an interest in [Suletta Mercury](https://anilist.co/character/279507/Suletta-Mercury), and upon seeing the mobile suit Suletta pilots—the Aerial—he correctly identified it as a GUND-ARM. As noted above, he embodies a sense of "solitary deta

characters.name: Guel Jeturk
characters.description: An heir to Jeturk Heavy Machinery, one of the group's three branches, and a third-year student in the piloting department. Guel has a rough temperament and is quick to anger. As the ace pilot of Jeturk House, he has absolute confidence in his own skills. (Source: Official Website)

characters.name: Shaddiq Zenelli
characters.description: An adopted child of the CEO of Grassley Defense Systems, one of the group's three branches. A third-year student in the piloting department who leads Grassley House. Although still a student Shaddiq has shown his skill in business too, he is a candidate for next generation executive. (Source: Official Website)

characters.name: Cardo Nabo
characters.description: She was a researcher who represented the Vanadis Institute. As a leading proponent of the "GUND FORMAT" theory, she had earned the respect of her fellow researchers

characters.name: Nika Nanaura
characters.description: A second-year student in the mechanical department, who belongs to Earth House. She loves mecha and is very curious about Suletta's Gundam Aerial. Nika has outstanding maintenance skills and is proud of herself for customizing Chuchu's Demi Trainer. ~!At some point, Nika was acquainted with Dawn of Fold and become part of the group, with [Naji](https://anilist.co/character/307149/Hija-Geor-Naji) acting as a Father figure for her.!~~!Nika joined the Asticassia School of Technology under a promise of [Shaddiq](https://anilist.co/character/279509/Zenelli-Shaddiq) with the condition of be a go-between agent between Dawn of Fold and his Faction.!~

characters.name: Chuatury Panlunch
characters.original: チュアチュリー・パンランチ
characters.description: Chuchu is a troubled young girl, who is an Earthian facing discrimination from a significant portion of the Spacians who look down on Earthians as underlings. Being in the same school as many Spacians, she along with her Earthian friends has been the subject of regular abuse and harassment. This along with her home people being the subject of Spacian oppression and exploitation has given Chuchu a profoundly negative impression of all Spacians often deriding them as "Shitty Spacians" and lashing at them at the first opportunity. Because of the harsh circumstances of her growth and her present situation, Chuchu is rather hot-headed and prone to pick fights, especially with Spacians who harass or torment others for fun or classism. Chuchu sees herself as someone who carries the burdens and hopes of her home people and is sympathetic to those who carry similar struggles.

characters.name: Lauda Neill
characters.description: Lauda Neill is in his third year of the pilot program. He is the deputy head of the Jeturk House. He is a half-brother to Guel, and although they are in the same grade, he is the younger brother. Unlike his older brother, he is calm and rational.

characters.name: Felsi Rollo
characters.description: She is a second-year pilot in the Jeturk House. The type of person who is a reckless, headstrong pilot. She respects Guel as a pilot.

characters.name: Petra Itta
characters.description: She is a second-year mechanic student in the Jeturk House. She is the cool, intelligent, honor student type. Much like Felsi, she adores Guel.

characters.name: Secelia Dote
characters.description: She is a second-year student in the Business Strategy Department at Burion House. She is a member of the Dueling Committee. Secelia is a sarcastic person with a foul mouth. No one is better than her when it comes to sarcasm.

characters.name: Martin Upmont
characters.original: マルタン・アップモント
characters.description: He is the head of the Earth Dormitory and a third-year student in the Department of Business Strategy. He is an indecisive and somewhat unreliable leader. He has a hard time dealing with the dorm members who have strong personalities.

characters.name: Ojelo Gabel
characters.description: He is a second-year mechanic student in the earth dormitory. He is a mood-maker with a cheerful personality. A gambler who spends the dormitory's living expenses on dueling games.

characters.name: Nuno Kargan
characters.description: He is a second-year mechanic in the Earth dormitory. He is a geek who is well versed in software, and he and Ojero work together as partners in crime.

title: Her
description: HER is a series of character portraits, loosely strung together by everyday circumstances. The story begins with a woman who wants to be loveable - and loved - and who has a fixation on shoes. Her hairdresser's fear of the future is the subject of the second chapter. A schoolgirl whose hair she cuts sees her older female neighbor kissing her female lover goodbye. In the past, the neighbor had a difficult relationship with her mother. The neighbor's lover was rejected by her first love. The couple sitting next to them at the cafe have their own issues. (Source: Okazu)

title: Slow Starter
description: A guy who is satisfied with his 2D wife and anime and games. One night he ended up nursing a girl. Unexpectedly, the girl’s lover… is another girl! With this going on, what’s going to happen to Midori?!

title: Oosaki-san to Komori-san
description: A pure love story between two people with a 50cm height difference and mismatched appearances and personalities. The new part-timer is... a child!?!? Osaki-san is tall and has a poker face, making her seem intimidating at first glance, but she's actually shy and kind. The new employee who comes to Osaki-san's workplace is Komori-san, who is only 147cm tall and very friendly. These two, who are complete opposites in appearance and personality, find themselves drawn to each other...!? Osaki-san is clumsy and a crybaby, yet a go-getter, and Komori-san is oblivious, laid-back, and a gentle, introverted type. What will become of the love between these two, who are complete opposites and have a 50cm height difference...? This is the first installment of a hilarious and heartwarming survival-of-the-fittest (?) romantic comedy about these two quirky girls. (Source: Kadokawa, translated) Note: Originally self-published on the author's Twitter, it was later acquired by Kadokawa who released the first volume on May 11, 2026.

title: Fumikiri Jikan
description: This is a collection of slice-of-life omnibus shorts about various girls and what happens to them at railroad crossings. Various dramatic pieces that occur while you hear “Clank, clank, clank” in the background. The bittersweet conversations that high school girls have, strange tales of the occult discussed by grade schoolers, or a boy being head over heels over a sexy girl... A series that’s all railroad crossings all the time that’ll be filled with situations that railroad crossing fans can’t resist (Source: Crunchyroll) Note: Chapter numbering differs slightly from Japanese and English versions with a English version being a chapter short. Chapter 33 in English version (or 35 in Japanese) is not published in Crunchyroll.

title: Motto Hanjuku Joshi
description: Yae and Chitose have been dating for one year. Their relationship continues in this sweet and fluffy slice-of-life story.

title: Nei You Equan Qing Xiaoxin
description: By chance, the exorcist Xiaoyu was forced into a living arrangement with Heiyao, the succubus who killed her foster-father. But Heiyao seemed to have lost her memories!? Xiaoyu didn't trust Heiyao, so she decided to stay and keep an eye on her. Heiyao didn't mind, as she tried to tease and seduce Xiaoyu in order to feed her hunger… They might fight all the time, but they both know there are other dangers lurking, with whoever was behind Xiaoyu's father's murder, whoever sealed away Heiyao's memories, and something else… (Source: Bilibili, translated)

title: TS Tensei Bishoujo Netora Reiko wa Netoraretai
title_original: TS転生美少女 音虎玲子は寝取られたい
description: A man who drove countless couples to ruin in his past life is reborn as the angelic beauty Netora Reiko! But this girl has only one desire and it's "to experience the ultimate NTR!?"

title: Koushaku Reijou no Rouraku Mission: Maou to no Seiryaku Kekkon ga, Jinrui Saigo no Kirifuda desu!... tte, Maou ga Onnanoko no Baai wa Dou Sureba Ii no desu ka!?
title_original: 公爵令嬢の籠絡ミッション～魔王との政略結婚が、人類最後の切り札です！…って、魔王が女の子の場合はどうすればいいのですか！？～
title_en: The Duke’s Daughter Must Seduce the Demon King… But the Demon King’s a Girl?!
description: Cecilia, the duke's daughter, has been given a critical mission to maintain peace between humanity and the Demon King. To do this, she must win over the Demon King's heart and avert her people's destruction. But when she arrives to meet her betrothed, the Demon King isn't at all what she anticipated! Rather than a terrifying beast, Cecilia is engaged to a beautiful and innocent-looking young woman! (Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: Yumemiru Prima Girl!
title_original: 夢見るプリマ・ガール！
description: Miyu is an amateur ballerina who wants to become a real star of the stage in the future. Unfortunately, not only the school club is empty but also Miyu's loneliness and lack of skill is a tall wall between her and her goal. But suddenly, there are people who want to join the club...! Yet, the problem is that both their styles and personalities are the exact opposites. Are they capable enough to stand and support each other?

characters.name: Safi
characters.description: Safi is half-egyptian and enjoys doing belly dance.

characters.name: Miyu
characters.description: Miyu is a young girl who loves ballet.

characters.name: Ai
characters.description: Ai enjoys dancing to hip-hop.

characters.name: Natsu
characters.description: Natsu is an otaku. Due to her poor health she has found strength in idols. To show them love, she performs otagei.

characters.name: Akane Suguri
characters.description: Akane is Miyu's ballet teacher and a close friend of Reika. After her mother retired from teaching, she took over the classes.

characters.name: Reika Nakamiya
characters.description: Reika is the dance club's advisor. She is a children's anime fan, especially Precure.

characters.name: Miyu's Mom
characters.description: She's actually 34 years old and is often mistaken as Miyu's little sister (used to be the other way around, before Miyu grew taller than her). She likes dressing up in costumes.

title: Shuumatsu, Kimi to
description: Gourmet BL. Two people peacefully enjoying meals together against the backdrop of a mysterious zombie outbreak. Shuuhei is consumed by the promise he made with Tomoya back in middle school. "Would you eat me?" (Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Joshikousei to Ouji-chan
title_original: 女子高生と王子ちゃん

title: Tonari no Robot
description: The series is about a robot and her high school student neighbour, the only one who knows her secret. (Source: Okazu)

title: Mouryou no Hako
description: Manga adaptation of the second novel in Kyougoku Natsuhiko's award-winning Kyougokudou Series. Right after the war, Showa era in Japan. Kusumoto Yoriko and Yuzuki Kanako who attend an all girls school plan to take the last train to go to the lake. However, Kanako ends up getting run over by the train. Tokyo Metropolitan Police Department's Detective Kiba who happened to be there when it happened, is asked to watch the confused Yoriko. Kiba goes with the worried Yoriko to the hospital Kanako is taken to, and there Kiba meets a woman who calls herself Kanako's sister; Yuzuki Youko. That happened to be the actress Kiba had been admiring, Minami Kinuko.

characters.name: Akihiko Chuuzenji
characters.description: An antique book dealer christened "Kyougokudou" after the name of his store. Also a part-time Shinto priest who performs pseudo "exorcisms" to solve psychological problems, despite the fact that he himself does not believe in the supernatural. He is fond of spouting knowledge on a variety of obscure subjects, and enjoys philosophical discussion.

characters.name: Shutarou Kiba
characters.description: Detective from Metropolitan Police Department in Tokyo. He is friends with [Kyougokudou](https://anilist.co/character/19393), [Enoki](https://anilist.co/character/17495) and [Sekiguchi](https://anilist.co/character/16903). In Mouryou no Hako, ~!He has feeling for [Youko Yuzuki](https://anilist.co/character/28381) and swears to protect her.!~

characters.name: Tatsumi Sekiguchi
characters.description: He's a novelist but, as his short stories don't allow him to live properly, he often works for the press. He was in the same college as Kyougokudou and hangs around with him. He's often teased by his friends in regards to his poor social skills. During the war, Sekiguchi fought with Kiba in the same regiment. While the details about this period are unknown, it is implied that Sekiguchi is a deserter who suffers from psychological disorders because of what he saw and did during the war. He has a wife named Yukie.

characters.name: Reijirou Enokizu
characters.description: When he was young, he was in the same college as [Kyougokudou](https://anilist.co/character/19393) and [Sekiguchi](https://anilist.co/character/16903). Despite being their senior, he quickly became friends with Kyougokudou thanks to their common natural weirdness. He is also a childhood friend of [Kiba](https://anilist.co/character/16912). During the war when he was a child, Reijirou practically lost his sight that resulted in gaining in him a special ability to see the floating memories of the people around him. In order to exploit this gift, he became a private detective at the "Rose and Cross" agency he founded himself. He had a hard time remembering people's names and often teases Sekiguchi for looking like a Turtle.

characters.name: Yoriko Kusumoto
characters.description: She is the main character in the first episode. She goes to an all girls high school and is on the same class with Yuzuki Kanako who she admires. They become friends later. And Kanako says Yoriko is her reincarnation. ~! At the end, it is revealed that the one who pushed Kanako to the rails was not a man dressed in black with white gloves as Yoriko said. The man dressed in black was a character from Sekiguchi´s novel witch Yoriko read. She lied to the police. Kyogokudou reveals that Yoriko idealized Kanako and when she saw her crying she felt disappointed and was possessed by a toorimono which made her attempt to kill her friend. But it is shown that she regretted it. Also she becomes another victim of Kubo when she accepts to pose for him and goes to his house. He dismembered and put her into a box as he did with the other girls he killed.!~

characters.name: Kanako Yuzuki
characters.description: She is friends with [Yoriko Kusumoto](https://anilist.co/character/17482) and sees Yoriko as her reincarnation. ~!She was then pushed by Yoriko at the train station and severely injured. Later, she is revealed to be involved in an experiment where her head is put into a small box where she is somehow still alive for at least a few days after being taken away by [Amemiya](https://anilist.co/character/66437), who is in love with her. [Youko](https://anilist.co/character/17239), who at first claimed to be her sister, is actually her mother. She is the result of the incestuous relationship between Youko and her father, Koushirou Mimasaka.!~

characters.name: Atsuko Chuuzenji
characters.description: [Akihiko's](https://anilist.co/character/19393) younger sister, a reporter for [Toriguchi's](https://anilist.co/character/28382) magazine.

characters.name: Noriyuki Masuoka
characters.description: The lawyer for Kanako's grandfather.

characters.name: Youko Yuzuki
characters.description: The older sister of [Kanako Yuzuki](https://anilist.co/character/17239).

characters.name: Morihiko Toriguchi
characters.description: A young reporter and a friend of Sekiguchi that begins to investigate the dismemberment case.

characters.name: Koushirou Mimasaka
characters.description: Mimasaka Koushirou is the doctor that took care of Kanako after her surgery. ~! Kyogokudou said that Profesor Mimasaka was a scientist who had been doing experiments during the Second World War. He wanted to create a 'mechanical human' in order to make Japan succeed in the war. But, because it cost too much money, he finally was not able to do it. It is revealed that his wife was Mimasaka Kinuko, the mother of Yuzuki Youko. Kinuko, even thought professor Mimasaka took care of her, wanted to get a divorced. Then Youko, who was in love with her father, tempted him and they had a daughter: Yuzuki Kanako, although this was never told to her, to avoid her from suffering. Also that giant box with machines around it was the mechanical human that Mimasaka made. A human´s head was put into a box and them all the other building did the rest of the functions that are normally done by a human body.

characters.name: Noritada Amemiya
characters.description: Kanako´s guardian.

characters.name: Torakichi Yasukazu
characters.description: [Reijiro Enokizu's](https://anilist.co/character/17495/Reijiro-Enokizu) secretary who lives and works at the "Rose and Cross" detective agency.

characters.name: Fukumoto Junsa
characters.description: Policeman working at Musashino train station.

title: You Bei Houbei Xia Ke Shang
description: On the outside, Lu Meihe appears to be a strict boss, dubbed "The Cobra" by her subordinates, but she nurses a soft spot for her intern Lin Wenjing. As she has a reputation to maintain, she is confined to expressing her feelings within the pages of her personal notebook... only for Lin Wenjing to discover it! Since then, Lu Meihe realized that despite her mild manners and soft-spoken attitude, Lin Wenjing was really anything but! Since then, Lu Meihe has been getting bullied every day, but it feels like pure bliss! What will she do?! (Source: Bilibili, edited) Note: Includes four extra chapters.

title: Eve to Eve
description: Eve and Eve begins with a provocative story: a science fiction tale about the apocalypse, and two women who love each other through the rebirth of Earth and beyond. The Eve and Eve collection showcases six short stories by the up-and-coming creator Nagashiro Rouge, exploring the more intimate side of women loving women in different lives. (Source: Seven Seas Entertainment) 1. Kiseki no Suki wo Nokoshitai: Chuu 2. Eiko to Leeza no Baai 3. Seme? Uke? Sanbon Shoubu 4. Nidome no Uwaki 5. Noroi no Atotsugi: Yakusoku 6. Eien Ichigou Nigou wa Eve to Eve 7. Eve to Eve (extra)

title: Takarakuji de 3-oku Yen Atattanode Himo Bishoujo Kai Hajimemashita
title_original: 宝くじで3億円当たったのでヒモ美少女飼い始めました
description: One day, Hino Mariya, an ordinary office lady, casually bought a lottery ticket, won the grand prize, and suddenly became a millionaire! While dreamily thinking about how to spend her 300-million yen windfall, she accidentally dropped her bankbook. A beautiful girl named Tenma Tsujido happened to pick up the bankbook, and then asked Hino to become her sugar mommy in exchange for returning the bankbook...? (Source: Manga Yomonga, translated) Note: Includes one bonus chapter.

title: Venus Versus Virus
description: "Welcome to Venus Vangard. We've been expecting you." Sumire Takahana is a seemingly normal school girl cursed with the ability to see malevolent ghosts known as "Viruses." Her life hits a crossroads after a run-in with a "gothic lolita" clad monster killer for hire, Lucia Nahashia. Not content to stay on the sidelines while these "Viruses" prey on the weak, Sumire decides to join forces with the mysterious eyepatch-wearing Lucia to hunt down these "Viruses" before they can hurt anyone else. (Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

characters.name: Lucia Nahashi
characters.description: Lucia is a strong, young girl who lead the fights against Viruses alongside the other members of the Venus Vanguard, sworn to fight and kill all Viruses. Her left eye holds a mysterious powers, though is almost always covered with an eye patch. Use of her powers is taxing and wears her out, but can often be disastrous to her enemy in many ways. Birthday: July 7th

characters.name: Sumire Takahana
characters.description: Sumire is a young high school girl and the newest member of the Venus Vanguard, despite being terribly scared of Viruses. While initially she cannot be of much help to Lucia, they eventually find out that whenever her body reacts to the special chemical used to defeat Viruses (the so called Vaccine), she transforms into a "Berserker Mode", or a living Anti-Virus. With this strange ability, she becomes stronger and violent, and is capable of defeating Viruses with her bare hands, though when under the influence of this power, she cannot discern friend from foe.

characters.name: Lola
characters.description: Voiced by: Ayumi Tsuji (Japanese), Kim-Ly Nguyen (English) A mysterious blonde girl who lives with Lucia and Nahashi. She loves chocolate and is often seen eating it. She has a twin named Layla and in the anime neither of them seem to age since they are soulless dolls created by Lucif and Nahashi's teacher. She is a major character right from the beginning in the anime, but in the manga she does not arrive right away. In the English version of the anime, her name is rendered as "Laura". (wikipedia)

characters.name: Souichirou Nahashi
characters.description: Souichirou, who is always referred to by his surname (as per Japanese standard), is the guardian of Lucia, who loves her as if he were her real father. Before Lucia was born, Nahashi was studying to become a mage, along with Lucia's mother Lilith and Lucia's father Lucif. He harbored an unrequited love for Lilith, but never got close with her as she was in love with Lucif. (wikipedia)

characters.name: Yoshiki Kusanagi
characters.description: Yoshiki is a young man Sumire met one day in a park while he was reading a book. After a few more meetings together while exchanging books to read, Yoshiki starts to develop romantic feelings for Sumire. ~!However, it is later discovered that he is actually one of Lucif's followers named Aion, he tries to take Sumire's fragment but stops because he truly cared for her, thus, he betrays Lucif, but Lucia, not knowing of his betrayal, kills him. !~

characters.name: Layla
characters.description: Layla is Lola's twin. In the anime, after Lucif left to find the True World, Layla went with him and Lola stayed with Nahashi and Lilith. Layla loves konpeito candy as much as Lola loves chocolate. Like Lola, she does not seem to age. (wikipedia)

characters.name: Ruka
characters.description: Ruka is a young girl who serves under Sonoka. She has a sadistic personality and has the power to control water and wind, however she states her specialty is electricity. In the English version of the anime, her name is rendered as "Luca". (Source: Wiki)

characters.name: Gai
characters.description: One of Sonoka's henchmen. He has a fairly sadistic personality, and is skilled in both controlling fire and earth.

characters.name: Riku Mikumo
characters.description: Riku is Nene's younger brother who has a crush on Sumire. Multiple times, Riku attempts to ask Sumire out on a date, but something always interferes, leaving him heartbroken each time. He has a timid personality, which makes it even more difficult to ask Sumire out. (Wikipedia)

characters.name: Youji
characters.description: In episode three of the anime, and chapter 4 of the manga. Yohji's sister, Tsukuyo, goes to Venus Vanguard to request helping in getting Yohji out of his room, which he has locked himself inside. ~! The real problem is that his sister is a virus and wants attack him. After beating Tsukuyo, Lucia gives Yohji a necklace of the sun and the moon, which represent him and his departed sister. !~

characters.name: Lucif
characters.description: Lucif is Lucia's father who, before she was born, left to find the path to the True World. His past is filled with mysteries, and Nahashi refuses to talk about the subject with Lucia. In the anime, it is thought he turned himself into a Virus so he could obtain the True World. In the manga, it appears he was possessed by Aion. (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Nene Mikumo
characters.description: Nene is Riku's older sister, and Sumire's cousin. She has a very loud and cheerful personality, and always tries her best to look out for Sumire. She also often encourages Riku on his attempts to ask Sumire out.

characters.name: Tsukuyo Nogami
characters.description: Tsukoyo Nogami is the twin sister of Youji. She requested the help of Venus Vanguard to protect her brother from the 'monster'. ~!She became a virus, but managed to somewhat restrain her violent urges to protect him.!~

characters.name: Mika
characters.description: Mika is one of Sumire's good friends and classmates. She has a tomboyish personality, and the other girls have a habit of calling her a "cougar", to which she hates. (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Kyouko
characters.description: Voiced by: Noriko Shitaya (Japanese), Kira Vincent-Davis (English), Emiri Katō (first drama CD) Kyōko is another one of Sumire's good friends and classmates. Source: Wikipedia.

title: Nabisori
description: Bullied at school and abused at home, Sul-Bi, a high school senior struggling with her interest in other girls and her dull life, is on the verge of ending it all. That is, until she runs into an odd girl, wandering the streets with no memory of who or where she is. Instantly falling for this mysterious girl who has no memories and doesn't feel any pain or hunger, Sul-Bi gives her a new name, Gu Seju, meaning "Savior". The only clue of Seju's identity is a mysterious note that appears in her pocket each day. Sul-Bi sticks with her, determined to help and solve the mystery that is Seju. However, as the mystery unfolds... Sul-Bi discovers a secret beyond anything she could imagine: Seju is her future girlfriend who has traveled back in time to see her??!!!! (Source: Pocket Comics)

title: Monwres: Ishu Kakutou Monster Musume
title_original: もんれす -異種格闘モンスター娘-
description: It's claws versus tentacles as monstrous beauties grapple with one another in the global sensation that is monster wrestling! A young Cerberus girl named Tirol dreams of stardom in the squared circle, but can she stand up to all the thirsty predators ready to dominate her into submission? Winning in the ring means walking a fine line between pain and pleasure...and unleashing the beast inside! (Source: Yen Press)

characters.name: Tirol
characters.description: __Race:__ Cerberus __Height:__ 155 cm A rookie monwrestler for Bellezza, Tirol is extremely attached to Kayla, who picked her up off the street-she follows Kayla around like a pet dog. She has a strong sense of smell and hates the stench of sweet potato shochu on Urus's breath whenever she's drunk. Each of her three heads has a will of their own. Bero, the dog head on her left shoulder, is a glutton and a slob, while Beru, the one on her right, is kind but timid. While they share a stomach, both Bero and Beru want to do some eating too, and Tirol gets an earful from them if she doesn't properly split up their food.

characters.name: Kayla
characters.description: __Race:__ Kraken __Height:__ 263,5 cm (including tentacles) Bellezza's top star. The elusive maneuvers she performs using her eight tentacles have captivated many fans, making her the engine driving Bellezza's current momentum. She has an extreme focus on charming audiences through 1 beautiful monwrestling, and she acts in beautiful ways even during her regular life. However, her aesthetics can sometimes diverge from what's commonly accepted as beautiful, causing those around her to simply snicker. Her tentacles can grow back with time, even if severed.

characters.name: Dolly
characters.description: __Race__: Dryad __Height__: 149 cm __Her Monwres Principles__: To always fight with everything she has and to wrestle as a Bellezza monwrestler would __Special Moves__: Dryads Jail One of Bellezza's monwrestlers, she has a long life span due to her arboreal nature, and she is the second most senior member of Bellezza after Elizabeth. She is able to grow branches from her body and turn parts of herself into a tree Dolly has a peaceful demeanor most of the time, kindly watching over the other members of Bellezza as one of its eldest wrestlers. However, she'll snap if you mention the size of her chest. She is a twenty-two-year monwres veteran, making her knowledgeable about the industry. This is why commentary is one of her strengths. She and Urus seem to get along very well, and it seems they shared some sort of experience in the past. Her hobbies include sunbathing (photosynthesis) and wa

characters.name: Urus
characters.description: __Race__: Centaur __Height__: 186cm __Moves__: Chiron's Branding A young monwrestler in Bellezza. One of the few sensible members of the highly individualistic federation, she's often the one pointing out the flaws in her fellow monwrestlers' harebrained ideas. However, she's an annoying drunk to deal with because of her centaur blood, causing lots of trouble with everyone she sees, whether it's trying to get them in a fight or in bed. Inside the monwres ring, she specializes in an all-out attacking style, continuing to charge head-on even against enemies who use more sneaky techniques against her. She's extremely friendly with Dolly, perhaps because of something in their past. She likes head-on fights and alcohol. She dislikes roundabout things and abstinence. Her hobbies include evening drinks and running her monwres. Her principles are "Bust through head-on, no matter what! Special".

characters.name: Pippy
characters.description: __Race__: Harpy __Height__: 153cm __Special Moves__: Harpy Knee Drop A young, masked Bellezza monwrestler. Powerful aerial attacks using her flight ability are her specialty. Not only a harpy, she is of a species similar to birds of prey, making her proud and quick to fight. However, because of her stupidity, she usually finds the tables turned on her, or she's punished by her friends. She also quickly forgets things and repeats her mistakes because she's birdbrained. She wears a plague doctor's mask because she likes the design, but she doesn't know what it was originally used for. She likes the sky and meat. She dislikes being punished by Kayla and Dolly, and having to be patient. Her hobbies include flying as she looks down on other species.

characters.name: Ryuuka
characters.description: __Race__: Dragon __Height__: 162 cm __Her Monwres Principles__: Money over everything __Special moves__: Guillotine Wing One of Bellezza's young monwrestlers. Though she's Tirol's senior, the two don't get along. As a proud dragon, one of the strongest species around, her combat abilities are also some of the best in Bellezza. Thanks to her experience working abroad in international rings where breaking the rules is commonplace, she's even formidable when the going gets rough. It seems that something in her past has left her unusually obsessed with her finances, and she openly states that she's in monwrestling for the money. She cherishes her little sister, fawning over her to the point that she'll lie to her face in order 2 to keep up appearances. She likes money and her little sister. She dislikes poverty. Her hobbies include counting stacks of cash.

characters.name: Nacha
characters.description: __Race__: Arachne __Height__: 190 cm (With legs fully extended) __Her Monwres Principles__: Tangle them in sticky silk until they submit __Special moves__: Arachne Lovushka A monwrestler who is Tirol's senior. As an arachnid, her specialty is restraining her opponent. She's a monster of few words, and the eccentric type who will laugh at the jokes she mumbles to herself. However, she's also a complete sadist who loves to get her opponents tangled in her sticky spider silk. She once worked at a handicraft store but then became a monwrestler in order to fulfill her desire to put others in bondage. She's also a heavy drinker capable of consuming large amounts of high-proof liquor, but she'll get wasted if you sneak some coffee into her drink. She likes restraining others and alcohol. She dislikes coffee. Her hobbies include drinking.

title: Still Life
description: This is an after-story of the commercial manga series Still Sick . It is about the cohabitation life of a manga artist, Maekawa-san, and a yuri geek, Shimizu-san, who live with and love each other. (Source: Melonbooks, translated)

characters.name: Makoto Shimizu
characters.description: __Height__: 168cm Works in R&D software design department.

characters.name: Akane Maekawa
characters.description: __Height__: 152cm Works in the Administration Department.

title: Bakajo 26-ji
description: “Hey, Atsuko…why did you kill my husband?” Atsuko and Yuri were classmates in high school, but that’s about as close as they’ve ever been. They rarely spoke, never hung out, and belonged to completely different social circles—they couldn’t have been more different. Fifteen years after graduation, they meet once again at a class reunion…and both of their lives are changed forever. Two women. One dead husband. An irreversible act and a desperate escape. But are they headed for ruin…or redemption? (Source: MANGA MILLION)

title: Koe ga Dasenai Shoujo no Hanashi
title_original: 声がだせない少女の話
description: The story of a mute girl and the girl who befriends her.

characters.name: Oto Mashiro
characters.description: She cannot speak due to her aphonia.

characters.name: Kikuno Kokosaki
characters.description: She can read minds.

title: Honto wa Motto, Shitai dake
title_original: ほんとはもっと、したいだけ
description: Note: Released at Comiket 105.

title: Vivarium de Choushoku wo
description: The manga centers on three friends who meet up at morning to get to the bottom of their town's "seven mysteries."

title: Totsuzen Nantonaku Tonari no Seki no Douryou to Sex Shitaku Narimashita
title_original: 突然何となく隣の席の同僚とセックスしたくなりました
description: A girls' love anthology consisting of five chapters: 1. I Don't Know Why, but I Suddenly Wanted to Have Sex with My Coworker Who Sits Next to Me (突然何となく隣の席の同僚とセックスしたくなりました) 2. Bedroom Telepathy (ベッドルームテレパシー) 3. girls complex a la mode 4. Ashen Days and the Lucky Cat of Happiness (灰色の日々と幸せの招き猫) 5. I Don't Know Why, but I Suddenly Wanted to Make Out with My Lover (突然何となく隣の恋人とイチャつきたくなりました)

title: Vacation Maou to Pet
title_original: ばけーしょん魔王とペット
description: A Demon Lord of another world is on vacation, searching for a precious someone... and she has finally found her! Her name is Nio, and her mother has sold her as a pet to the aforementioned Demon Lord. Follow Nio and her life living under the same roof with a Demon Lord.

title: Watashi no Onaka no Sekinin Totte!
title_original: わたしのお腹の責任取って！
description: A girl that loves food, and the girl that enjoys feeding her manage the battle of overeating vs delicious food in this romantic comedy! Note: Includes two extra chapters.

title: Zankou Noise
description: A collection of yuri romance one-shots by Kodama Naoko. 1. Zankou Noise (残光ノイズ, Afterglow Noise) Story features a girl whose secret place to be alone is discovered by a popular girl from school. (Source: MangaHelpers) 2. Kaikou Effect (邂逅エフェクト) At a class reunion, Kiwa runs into her old girlfriend Ririko, who just got engaged. Cue flashback. (Source: Yuri Project) 3. Girls Talk (ガールズトーク) 4. Renai no Dekinai Oshigoto (恋愛のできないお仕事) 5. Summer♥Splash (サマー♥スプラッシ) 6. Heavy Rotation★Lingerie (ヘビロテ★ランジェリー)

title: Dare ni mo Ienai Futarigoto
title_original: 誰にも言えないふたりごと
description: The story of best friends Haruno and Chikaki who discover their feelings for each other may not be the simple, enduring friendship they assumed it to be.

title: Futari no Arcadia
description: After being coerced into attending a mixer by her friends, Kotoko finds herself enamoured with another girl there, the mysterious and radiant Tsutsuji. 1. The Girls' Arcadia: Erosion 2. The Girls' Arcadia: Elysium 3. The Girls' Arcadia: Emotional 4. Ribbons Untie, Frills Melt (リボンはほどけるフリルは溶ける) 5. What is Love? (愛とか恋とかわからない) 6. Afterwards (その後) 7. Remembrance of Arcadia (追憶のアルカディア) 8. Becoming Cute, Becoming Clean (かわいくなって、きれいになって) 9. Narumi and Kashiwagi (なるみと柏木)

title: Maid in Heaven
description: An orphan, Sherl Watson, leaves her job in London to work at the Taylor Mansion. Rumors and a cloud of mystery surround the mansion as strange occurrences keep popping up. Will Sherl and the other maids be able to get out alive or were they all doomed, to begin with? (Source: Pocket Comics)

title: Twinstar Cyclone Runaway
title_original: ツインスター・サイクロン・ランナウェイ
description: Set 6,000 years after humanity has spread out across the stars, the story takes place inside a gigantic city ship orbiting a remote gas giant. The ship is home to a civilization of space fishers that catch valuable fish-like creatures known as Besshu. The society harvests the Besshu through ships operated by enforced male-female pairs of operator and pilot, who are seen by the male-dominated society as a married couple. The story centers on Terra, who is seeking a partner to operate a ship, and finds her in the mysterious runaway girl Diode, with both uniquely able to use the ship despite both being female. (Source: Anime News Network)

characters.name: Tera Endeavor
characters.original: テラ・インターコンチネンタル・エンデヴァ

title: Qtμt
title_original: qtμt キューティーミューティー
description: A startling collaboration between Fumi Fumiko and cultural commentator Sayawaka. Hana was blissfully enjoying the halcyon days of school life along with her friends, right up until the moment she received a mysterious letter emblazoned with the phrase "don't say a thing". Uncertain of its origins, Hana consults with her friends which sets off a disastrous chain of events - changing each of their lives for the worse.

characters.name: Hana Momozono
characters.description: Middle school, second year.

characters.name: Yotsuba Suzumori
characters.description: Middle school, second year, Hana's best friend.

characters.name: Honoka Kakegami
characters.description: Middle school, second year, student council chief secretary.

characters.name: Kokuri Naruru
characters.description: Middle school, second year, working as an idol.

title: Coo no Sekai
description: Seventh grader Hayashi Renei is troubled by a strange dream: Her dead brother, who was killed in an automobile accident, comes back to life as Coo. The dream comes again the following night and then every night thereafter. Coo's world is a cruel one--crueler than the real world, even--with its own share of pain, suffering, and sadness. Renei is searching for her house with her brother and others whom she meets in Coo's world so that she can return to reality and the land of the living... (Source: Kotonoha)

title: Konohanatei Kitan
description: Set in a village inhabited by Youkai, Konohanatei Kitan presents the lives of several fox mononoke working in a hot spring inn. The stories revolve around a new employee, Yuzu. Yuzu had always been living in the mountains, but now has to adjust to a new life working in a high class inn. She is oblivious and clumsy at first, but with her simple cuteness, she is able to get along with all the other foxes.

characters.name: Yuzu
characters.description: __Height:__ 130 cm The protagonist of the story. An innocent and hardworking country fox. She was brought up by Bikuni, and has a rather extensive knowledge of things.

characters.name: Satsuki
characters.description: __Height:__ 145 cm Yuzu's fellow attendant at Konohanatei; chosen to act as her mentor by head attendant Kiri. She's also Yuzu's roommate.

characters.name: Kiri
characters.description: __Species:__ Kitsune __Height:__ 147 cm The head attendant at Konohanatei. She has a relatively down-to-earth disposition.

characters.name: Sakura
characters.description: __Height:__ 125 cm One of Yuzu's fellow attendants at Konohatei. She's the quiet type, and has an unconventional way of doing her job.

characters.name: Ren
