characters.description: __Height:__ 130 cm One of [Yuzu](https://anilist.co/character/123777/Yuzu)'s fellow attendants at Konohatei. She's more cynical than she seems.

characters.name: Natsume
characters.description: __Height:__ 157 cm One of Yuzu's fellow attendants at Konohatei. She has the most lax attitude towards the job out of them all. The most energetic of the attendants, her appearance, body, personality and behavior are all boyish to the point where she is at times outright mistaken for a boy at first glance.

characters.name: Tsubaki
characters.description: The owner of Konohanatei.

title: Chimidoro Ice Cream
title_original: ちみどろアイスクリーム
description: A new transfer student just joined Hinata's class! However, Hinata witnesses the transfer student, Memone, eating bloody raw meat after school...? As the class president, Hinata will have to keep an eye on Memone!!! (Source: Manga Time Kirara, translated)

title: Eoseooseyo. 305-hoe!
description: Regular college freshman Kim Jeong-Hyeon and his roommate Kim Ho-Mo are polar opposites and friends. This is a story that deals with many sensitive topics with a dash of humor. (Source: Naver, translated)

characters.name: Jeong-I Kim
characters.description: Kim Jeong-Hyeon's younger sister.

characters.name: Seung-Ho
characters.description: Kim Ho-Mo's boyfriend.

title: Ashita mo Mata Yuusha no Tonari
title_original: 明日もまた勇者のとなり
description: Mao Kurose can't stop thinking about Kanade Momomiya, the classmate sitting next to her. Unable to sort out her feelings, Kurose discovered memories of her past life as the Demon Lord, and recalled the moment that the Demon Lord killed the Hero. The Hero with the exact same face as Momomiya. Here comes a girls-love story that transcends time! (Source: Kadokawa, translated) Note: Includes one extra chapter.

characters.name: Kanade Momomiya
characters.description: Former Hero, reincarnates a high school girl

characters.name: Mao Kurose
characters.description: Former Demon Queen, she reincarnated as a regular high school girl. Currently the Student Council President.

characters.name: Aoi Kobashiri
characters.description: Former general of the Demon Queen's army.

characters.name: Mine Taou
characters.description: Former magician of the Demon Queen's army.

title: Papa no Sexy Doll
title_original: パパのセクシードール
description: Living together under one roof is a girl seeking affection and a robot who has no feelings. Riona lost her mother at an early age and was raised by her father. She goes to an all-girls school where she has many friends and a special "girlfriend", but her busy father is always away from home, and she feels a little lonely. One day, Riona witnesses her father having sex with "Forti," a robot he purchased as a "maid" to do the housework.......? A gem of a dramatic story that explores the true nature of humanity and human emotions! (Source: Dengeki Daioh, translated)

title: GIRL x GIRL x BOY: Otome no Inori
description: High school story about the a love triangle between 2 girls and a boy. Fuuka likes Riri. Riri likes Itta. Itta likes Fuuka. This isn't a typical love triangle, though!

title: Nettai Shoujo
description: 1. Natsu no Hajimari (夏の始まり, The Beginning of Summer) 2. SUIKA 3. Yuudachi Kibun (夕立気分, Evening Rain Feeling) 4. sketch 5. Natsu no Ari (夏の蟻, Summer Ants) 6. Tainai Kaiki (体内回帰, Return to the Womb) 7. Himitsu no Seseragi (秘密のせせらぎ, The Secret Stream) 8. Natsu to Ieba (夏といえば, Summer Is All About) 9. Birthday (バースデイ)

title: Kuro-chan Chi no Oshiire ga Tsukaenai Riyuu
title_original: クロちゃん家の押入れが使えない理由〈わけ〉
description: One day a junior high school sophomore student Kuro-chan, discovers aliens coming out of her closet! Now, it's up to her to regulate these migrant aliens! (Source: Japanese Publisher, translated)

title: SHIBUYA: Gal Yuri Anthology
title_original: SHIBUYA ギャル百合アンソロジー
description: Fashionable girls fall for fashionable girls in this Yuri anthology from Ichijinsha! 1. Reverse Line by Yorumo 2. Oshiete ageru (I'll teach you) by Pesotaro 3. Romantic Delinquency by Mashimaru 4. Kino no tomo wa kyo no × × (Yesterday's friend is today's XX) by Ameno 5. Koisuru no usagi (Love Rabbits) by Neji 6. Suppin Kataomoi (Spin Love) by Mintaro 7. Shiranai watashi mo sukidesu ka? (Don't you like me too?) by Kashikaze 8. Anata no watashi (You&me) by Oriko Potos 9. Aien ki en (Predetermination) by Kabayama 10. Kimi wo Aisaba ana Futatsu (I love you too) by Haru Inabe 11. Haru wo Matsu aka Iro (I'll wait for the Spring) by Yoriko

title: Tokimeki Mononoke Jogakkou
title_original: ときめき☆もののけ女学園
description: Arare knows she's a rain fairy - her mother is clearly not entirely human but on her first day of high school she definitely does not expect to enter the Otherworld. Nor does she expect her teacher to have a ridiculously long neck, or her classmates to be a variety of ogres, snow demons, cyclops, ghosts, mist, or the twin-tailed cat, Kiri, and long-tongued girl, Pero, who befriends her. Nor does she expect the veil between the worlds to close behind her, leaving her stranded in this school for girl monsters. (Source: Okazu)

title: BlazBlue: Remix Heart
title_original: ブレイブルー リミックスハート
description: The 15th Hierarchical City of Torifune is best known as the Military Academy for the NOL. There, future librarians train and hone their skills for whatever challenges may await them outside. The story centers around Mai Natsume, a girl who had just arrived late due to a week absence, but there seems to be several phenomenons centering around her that could be more than just coincidence.

characters.name: Jin Kisaragi
characters.description: __Birth place:__ England __Height:__ 178 cm Jin Kisaragi is a Major in the NOL, and one of its elite commanding officers. He is always cool and calm, but is also jealous, ambitious, and possessive, with little care for others, treating them like they are mere obstacles. He displayed formidable actions to gain his rank during the Ikaruga Civil War. When he heard that Ragna the Bloodedge had arrived on the scene, he quickly abandoned his post to hunt him down by himself. He was adopted into the Kisaragi house, a highly powerful and respected family within the NOL. He possesses a notable psychosis, said to be caused by his sword, the Nox Nyctores "Yukianesa." While the sword grants him manipulation over ice, it also enhances primal feelings and is often blamed for "insanity." ~!The truth, however, is that Ragna is Jin's biological brother, and Jin's early feelings of rivalry were furthered

characters.name: Noel Vermillion
characters.original: ノエル・ヴァーミリオン
characters.description: __Race:__ Artificial Human __Height:__ 157 cm This young girl was found amidst the burning fields of Ikaruga where she was rescued, and then adopted by the family of Vermillion. It was because of her outstanding combat activity that she became a high-ranking member of the NOL using the Nox Nyctores "Arcus Diabolus Bolverk" revolver. She was made Jin's subordinate by the NOL, although Jin treated her poorly due to her resemblance of Saya. When Jin rushed off to hunt down Ragna without permission from the NOL, Noel was assigned to stop him and bring him back to his post at the Library. She is easily won over by small, cute animals (agreeing to be dressed up by Litchi if she could play with her panda, Lao Jiu, in one story path, and even shouts "Hands off the panda!" during battle with her) and has an inferiority complex with her bosom. ~! In truth, Noel suffers from amnesia. She is actuall

characters.name: Mai Natsume
characters.description: Mai Natsume is the main character of the manga BlazBlue: Remix Heart. Mai was the next heir of the Hazuki Family. One month prior to the events of Remix Heart, he somehow ended up as a girl and tried to turn back using various grimoires but without successes. As a woman she has pink eyes and aqua blue hair, tied into a waist-length pony tail by a yellow ribbon; she also has twin ahoge. Though claiming to be male, her physical body shows much femininity, with a fairly above-average large bust. She also has a small scar on her back. She claims that her tongue is so sensitive that she can even perceive the thoughts of the food when they were still alive. The thoughts of the one who made the food can also be perceived, which is why she is not only able to "survive" Noel's infamous death cooking, but also calls it a godly dish because Noel's single-mindedness in cooking only leaves her innoce

characters.name: Cajun Faycott
characters.original: カジュン＝ファイコット
characters.description: She is Mai Natsume's eccentric roommate at the Military Academy. Cajun has a princess-like attitude and an extreme thirst of knowledge. She tries to learn as much as possible, and has developed a habit of collecting information on anything new. The urge to know sometimes drives her into doing odd things, or making others do odd things for her; she even carries a small handbook around to write down everything she ever recorded. This fact does not mean that she is insensitive towards others' feelings, however. Despite having an odd habit, she is actually good-natured at heart, willingly ate Noel's death cooking with Mai and created a chance for Tsubaki to be together with Jin, being aware of her feelings. After the festival was over, Cajun began to take some hidden interest in Mai, albeit with a dark expression, for attracting grimoires.

characters.name: Ragna the Bloodedge
characters.original: ラグナ・ザ・ブラッドエッジ
characters.description: __Race:__ Artificial human __Height:__ 185 cm After destroying countless branches of the NOL and killing two Saya replicas, he was labeled as the most wanted criminal and received the largest bounty in NOL history on his head. He possesses a powerful form of Armagus called the Azure Grimoire, which is often either the secondary or primary target of those after his bounty. His ultimate goal is to destroy the Library for reasons unknown, although it probably has something to do with the Saya replicas. ~! He is Jin's biological brother, whose rivalry with him stems from an incident that happened with their sister, Saya, who is presumed to be dead. His right arm is mechanical because his real one was cut off by Terumi who took control of Jin's mind. He was resurrected by Rachel as a vampire, causing one of his green eyes to turn red, and his once blond hair to white. The Azure Grimoire he po

characters.name: Tsubaki Yayoi
characters.description: __Race:__ Human __Height:__ 160 cm

characters.name: Taro Sasagae
characters.description: He is a close friend of Mai Natsume, Jin Kisaragi, and Akane Teruhiko. He was Jin's bodyguard during his days at the Military Academy, and is a member of the Mutsuki family, being the cousin of Kagura Mutsuki. He fights using Ars Magus threads, and stays loyally by the sides of both Jin and Mai.

characters.name: Kagura Mutsuki
characters.description: __Height__: 187cm __Weight__: 83kg Kagura can be described to most people as a womanizer and an alcoholic. He often holds wild parties and is sometimes caught hungover from one. Women are his greatest weakness, as he will flirt at the drop of a hat and won't miss a beat even if they retaliate. He sometimes understands when to hold back, but this is not always the case. There are some women that are exempt of this treatment though, for example Tsubaki Yayoi, Kokonoe, and Rachel Alucard. Despite him being a womanizer, Kagura has shown actual respect to women, such as him being incredibly protective when Noel was attacked by Arakune, to the point that he was really enraged and wanted to kill Arakune, and noting that it was so unlike him.

characters.name: Relius Clover
characters.description: Relius is a genius alchemist known as the "Puppeteer". At some point before the start of BlazBlue: Calamity Trigger, he disappeared without a trace. Relius is known and feared by Tsubaki and Makoto. He also seems to know and dislike Jubei of the Six Heroes. Carl Clover, his son, hates him for taking Ada and Carl's mother away. Carl spends a majority of his travels in pursuit of Relius. During Noel's story in Continuum Shift, Relius attempted to kidnap Noel in order to 'examine' her, and he seems to have gotten a hold of Arakune at the end of his respective story. He did not hesitate to attack his own son, Carl, when confronted by him. His experiments include the creation of Nox Nyctores: Deus Machina Nirvana, which he harvested his daughter's body to create. He completed this project with help from Kokonoe of Sector Seven. His own puppet, the Fluctus Redactum: Ignis, was created from the

title: Cosmo Familia*
description: It’s been six years since Amakawa Alice’s family disappeared, and the cute but destructive creatures called Cosmofs invaded her world. Alice has been holding down the fort, fighting wild Cosmofs and protecting the few humans who have survived, in the hopes that her family will someday return. She refuses to give up on them…even when everyone believes her mother, Raika, caused the Cosmof invasion. (Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

characters.name: Alice Amakawa
characters.description: Alice is the 16-year-old protagonist of the story. On her 10th birthday, her mother and the family's servant take off, leaving Alice in charge of defending the house and Nemiki City from the Cosmofs, who'd previously been their pets but went on a rampage after Alice's mother left. Since her mother is considered responsible for this, the townspeople treat Alice coldly and she voluntarily sequesters herself from the outside world. After another Cosmof attack and the appearance of the Nix Force, Alice leaves her house to search for her mother.

characters.name: Laika Amakawa
characters.description: Laika is Alice's mother and the one considered responsible for the damage the Cosmofs cause to Nemiki City, leading to Alice being shunned by the townspeople. When she was younger, she suffered from a heart condition that made it impossible for her to engage in strenuous activities. After her mother dies, Laika has a strained relationship with her father, who throws himself into his work, and spends her time with Imori.

characters.name: Imori
characters.description: Imori is the Amakawa family's unflappable servant. She is very protective of Laika and strict with the household duties, but treats Alice affectionately.

characters.name: Spica
characters.description: Spica works for the Nix Force and arrives in Nemiki City, alongside Mira, Akane and Shizuki, to recruit Alice in order to eradicate Cosmofs. Unlike Mira, Spica is more level-headed and diplomatic.

characters.name: Mira
characters.description: Mira works for the Nix Force and arrives in Nemiki City, alongside Spica, Akane and Shizuki, to recruit Alice in order to eradicate Cosmofs. She fights ruthlessly and stops at nothing to achieve her mission objective, even if it means hurting innocent bystanders.

characters.name: Shizuki
characters.description: Shizuki is a member of the Nix Force tasked to recruit Alice, alongside Spica, Mira and Akane. Shizuki is quite flirty towards Akane.

characters.name: Akane
characters.description: Akane is a member of the Nix Force tasked to recruit Alice, alongside Spica, Mira and Shizuki.

title: He Jingling Gongzhu Qian Dinghunyue Le Wo Gai Zenmeban
title_original: 和精灵公主签订婚约了我该怎么办
title_en: What Should I Do If I've Signed a Marriage Contract with the Elven Princess
description: Nan Yue was only in transit in the Kingdom of Elven. But she found that she signed a marriage contract with Ah Sha, the elven princess. Wait, I am a girl! How could I marry the princess? Wait, why am I wanted by the world after I sign the marriage contract?? To survive, I have to take the princess for a leap of faith: "As expected of an uptown girl, you are pretty hot! "Get lost, you perv!"! (Source: Bilibili Comics) Note: Includes 20 extra chapters.

title: ANGEL/DUST
description: A mysterious creature has fallen from the sky and landed right at young Yuina's feet! Branded as the master of this new angelic being, Yuina is forced into an otherworldly pact, one that will take her beyond the clouds and into battle against a new and yet hauntingly familiar evil, one that patiently waits in the shadows. (Source: ADV)

characters.name: Yuina Hatori
characters.description: The main character of the story. She is withdrawn and doesn't want to trouble anyone. She enjoys singing, but she lacks confidence in her abilities.

characters.name: Akiho Kudoh
characters.description: Yuina's childhood friend. She makes a contract with Lucifer so that she can fight with Yuina. She is frustrated by what she perceives as Yuina throwing away her singing talents.

characters.name: Lucifer
characters.description: Known as the "black winged one" to Seraph. She is one of seven Emulates who refused to submit to humans and thus committed the most terrible of sins, in her words. She hates humans because she believes them to be arrogant, violent creatures. She is named after the fallen angel.

characters.name: Seraph
characters.description: An Emulate from another point in space and time. Like all Emulates, she is a battle android who can make contracts with humans and merge with them to give them great power. ~!Before she made a contract with Yuina, her former human was a beautiful woman who also enjoyed singing.!~

title: Maria-sama ga Miteru
description: The setting is Lillian Academy, a private Catholic all-girls school where the student council is known as the Yamayurikai (Mountain Lily Council) and younger students are taken under the wing of older students through a system known as the "soeur system" ("soeur" is French for "sister"). The main character, Yumi, who is basically a nobody, suddenly finds herself interacting with the members of the Yamayurikai and their soeurs, most notably her crush, the talented, beautiful, and withdrawn Sachiko...

characters.name: Yumi Fukuzawa
characters.description: She is the main character of the series. In the beginning of the series, Yumi is bashful beyond words, very timid and unsure of herself. She first met Sachiko, the star of Lillian School and had her tie fixed by Sachiko, which mortified Yumi. Yumi's friend, Tsutako Takeshima, took a cute picture of this and wanted to display it in the school festival. Tsutako got Yumi to ask permission from Sachiko. Other characters often comment on how her emotions 'show on her face'. ~!After Yumi first meets Sachiko, Sachiko is arguing with the Roses in the Rose Mansion. The Roses say that Sachiko cannot object to their plan, as she did not have a petite sœur. Sachiko runs out of the meeting and knocks Yumi over. She asks if Yumi has a grande sœur, and promptly offered Yumi her rosary. Sachiko thought that if she had a petite sœur, the Yamayurikai could not force her to play Cinderella alongside a male

characters.name: Rei Hasekura
characters.description: Rei, Yoshino's grande soeur, appears very tomboyish and "bishounen" on the outside but is in fact quite gentle despite her appearances. Her favourite books are shoujo, her favourite word is "sincerity" and her hobby is sightseeing. She is involved in kendo, but obsessively cares about Yoshino and prefers the domestic arts, like cooking. In the first season, Rei is Rosa Foetida en bouton, and her grande soeur was Torii Eriko. Her petite soeur is Shimazu Yoshino. In the second season, Rei becomes Rosa Foetida. (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Youko Mizuno
characters.description: Youko entered Lillian during her first year of middle school. Despite coming from an outside schooling system she was asked to give the welcome speech for first year students. She is characterized as being calm but sharp with a mischievous side, in the manga she is described to be "lily" like. Her greatest day was seeing the Rose Mansion filled with ordinary students during the Bouton's card hunt. During Youko's second year of high school, Rosa Gigantea and Rosa Chinensis (Sei and Youko's onee-sama's respectively) tricked Youko into taking an interest in Ogasawara Sachiko. Sachiko, Youko noted, always walked looked like she was fighting internally with something. With an endless desire to help (or meddle, as Sei put it) people Youko took Sachiko as her petite soeur. She had Sachiko quit her after school lessons (or in the novel, hinted about it) and once scolded her for not expressing he

characters.name: Sachiko Ogasawara
characters.description: Prim and elegant, Sachiko has a rough side and a very sweet side. She is very protective over Yumi and cares deeply about her. However, Sachiko often has the same problem as Yumi does — she does not share most of her problems with her sœur, causing many misunderstandings. Sachiko is slated to marry her cousin and fiancé Suguru after she graduates. This has caused her some distress since, because although she initially cared deeply for him, he did not reciprocate. They now have a complicated relationship. Sometimes, Yumi must teach Sachiko how to live informally, for example, helping her select her first pair of jeans. Despite her sometimes stern appearance, Sachiko has her own share of insecurities regarding her relationship with Yumi, not to mention emotional insecurities rising from her home life; both her father and grandfather openly have mistresses, unabashedly dividing their time b

characters.name: Sei Satou
characters.description: The exact opposite of most of the characters in the show: loud, rough-around-the-edges, she loves doing what she can to push other peoples' buttons. She enjoys mercilessly teasing or being mischievous, conducting most of her antics around Fukuzawa Yumi. Despite being a non-conformist in the ranks of the regular girls in Lillian Jogakuen, Sei is one of the wisest and caring characters on the show. Though seeming to have a playful and laid-back attitude, she has experienced many tragedies in her life, especially in her second year. Sei is known for doing things at her own pace, and dislikes being pressured into making decisions and taking action. She took Toudou Shimako as her soeur while in her third year. Her relationship with the first year is seen to one of mutual understanding and selective support. Sei however has an especially close relationship with Yumi. Sei becomes a source of co

characters.name: Yoshino Shimazu
characters.description: In the beginning of the series, Yoshino is a girl who was very ill and cared for constantly by her grande soeur, Rei. Yoshino, however, is very independent and in some ways tomboyish, despite her sickly status and feminine appearance. ~!After her heart surgery, she becomes more energetic through out the series. !~ In addition to being Rei's petite soeur, Yoshino is also her cousin and next-door neighbor. Theirs is a somewhat rocky relationship, since Yoshino is eager to spread her wings, whereas Rei would like to protect her from the world's hardships. In the first season, Yoshino is Rosa Foetida en bouton petite soeur, her grande soeur being Hasekura Rei. ~!In the second season, Yoshino becomes Rosa Foetida en bouton. She has no petite soeur yet. !~ (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Eriko Torii
characters.description: Rei's grande soeur; one of the most well-respected of the Yamayurikai. She is very gifted and good at almost everything, although she is also enigmatic and eccentric. She has a large forehead, which Sei made fun of when they were young, which began their rivalry. She said once that she chose Rei as her sœur to see if anything interesting would happen. She often has friction with Yoshino, as the younger girl is jealous of her bond with Rei. Eriko has four older brothers. After leaving Lillian, she studies Arts. She hates the dentist above all else. (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Shimako Toudou
characters.description: Prim, proper and very beautiful, Shimako is the most admired of the first-years. She is the petite soeur of Satō Sei at the beginning of the story and later her successor. Underneath Shimako's quiet, mannerly exterior lies a surprisingly strong resolve. However, Shimako is perhaps the most gentle of the three girls of her year in the Yamayurikai. In the first season, Shimako is Rosa Gigantea en bouton, her grande soeur being Satou Sei. In the second season, Shimako becomes Rosa Gigantea, her petite soeur being Nijou Noriko. (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Yuuki Fukuzawa
characters.description: The brother of Yumi (born one year apart), he loves her very much and tries to help her in everything he can. He has good relations with the students of Lillian and is somewhat popular. At the beginning of the series, he did not empathize with Suguru, but Suguru invites Yuuki to stay over for new year's in his house; subsequently Suguru begins to perturb Yuuki by giving him the nickname "Yukichi". Yuuki becomes the president of the Student Council of Hanadera due to his neutral personality. (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Shizuka Kanina
characters.description: Also known as Rosa Canina (for the Dog Rose), she is the star singer of the school choir. Yumi meets her without knowing that she was the candidate running against the Yamayurikai. She admired Sei greatly and it was revealed that she was in love with her schoolmate, yet she never tells Sei her feelings because she knows they will be met with rejection. Later on it is shown that she has also found an interest in Sei's petite soeur, Shimako. Possibly because she wanted to know what sort of girl the elusive and lonely Sei decided to choose as a soeur. Sei confronts her and asks Shizuka if she would have preferred to have been her soeur, and Shizuka sadly admits that she would not have, and wanted something else from Sei. She left Lillian at the end of her second year to pursue a singing career in Italy. Shizuka meets Yumi again in Italy during the Lillian school trip, and she takes her

title: Yamanko!
description: Though it was a bit strange, three people ended up meeting. One, who looks younger than her age and able to see the supernatural. Another who is possessed by a "Yamanko" which refers to "Yama no ko", or a mountain child. She was possessed due to her bloodline and due to the possession, she has superhuman abilities which she can call upon. Finally, an awkward person who enjoys writing poems.

characters.name: Makoto Watanabe
characters.description: A 16 years old high school girl. She is very tall and androgynous, and despite her appearence she isn't very good at sports. She likes to write poems. She has a strong shadow essence who can calm down the sun essence of Neneko, prior physical contact.

characters.name: Neneko Kaneko
characters.description: A 16 years old high school girl possessed by a Yamanko. When she is angry, scared or her emotions run high her tail and ears come out.

characters.name: Chimi Kitou
characters.description: A tiny high school girl who can see ghosts with her left eye. Despite her appearence, she is 16 years old.

title: Yoru no Kurage wa Oyogenai
title_original: 夜のクラゲは泳げない
description: Four girls, "Yoru Mitsuki", an illustrator who stops drawing, "Nonoka Tachibana", a former idol who wants to prove herself with singing, "Nox Ryūgasaki", a self-proclaimed "the strongest" VTuber, and "Kimura-chan", a mysterious composer who wants to support her favourite person, together form an anonymous artist group, "JELEE".

characters.name: Mahiru Kouzuki
characters.description: Mahiru is a typical high school girl who follows the philosophy of "nothing matters." Despite being sensitive, she often gets upset over small things, although she truly cares about others. When she was young, Mahiru used to draw illustrations under the pseudonym "Kurage Yoru." However, something happened that made her stop for a while. Now, she struggles with feeling different and tries to blend in with everyone else. But then, she meets Kano, and everything changes. Kano helps her see that it's okay to be unique, and Mahiru's life starts to feel special again.

characters.name: Kano Yamanouchi
characters.description: Meet Kano, a former idol who is determined to achieve her dreams! She's a strong-willed individual who knows what she wants and isn't easily swayed by others. Kano used to be part of the "Sunflower Dolls" idol group, where she performed as "Nonoka Tachibana." However, she decided to leave the group after a controversy and embarked on a journey to discover her true calling. During her journey, Kano meets Yoru Umitsuki, an artist who creates a beautiful jellyfish mural that inspires her to look at life in a new way. This encounter becomes a turning point for Kano as she redefines her values and explores new possibilities in her own unique way.

characters.name: Kiui Watase
characters.description: Kiui and Mahiru have been friends since childhood. Operating under the persona of the Vtuber "Nox Ryugasaki," Kiui consistently promotes their belief in being the strongest individual. Kiui is adept at swiftly mastering any task, and all the skills they display as a Vtuber are their own. However, these differences have led to them feeling somewhat out of place among peers. Mahiru is the only person with whom Kiui feels comfortable discussing the past without reservation, and is always willing to help dear friends.

characters.name: Mei Takanashi
characters.original: 高梨・キム・アヌーク・めい
characters.description: Mei attends a high school affiliated with the conservatory. She started her musical education at a young age and has earned numerous awards in competitions, demonstrating her exceptional talent. Despite her mixed German heritage, Mei's reserved demeanor and appearance often lead her to spend time alone, keeping her distance from others. However, by chance, she became a dedicated fan of Nonoka Tachibana and followed her activities passionately until the end. Feeling adrift after her favorite idol retired, Mei starts to feel a mix of emotions when she encounters Kano, who is being true to herself.

characters.name: Miiko
characters.description: An idol who claims to be forever 17 and the strongest in the galaxy. She has been active for a long time and is always full of motivation and perseverance. ~!In actuality, she is 31-years-old and mother to [Ariel](https://anilist.co/character/332268/).!~

title: 1 Ii ne de Skirt ga 0.1mm Mijikaku Naru Class no Jimi na Onnanoko, Gojitsudan-hen
title_original: 1いいねでスカートが0.1mm短くなるクラスの地味な女の子　ー後日談編ー
description: Continuation of 1 Ii ne de Skirt ga 0.1mm Mijikaku Naru Class no Jimi na Onnanoko , irregularly updated by the author. Includes the following comics and more: 1) Daigakusei ni Natta Jimiko to Gal (大学生になった地味子とギャル) 2) Iru Nokori de Ninin Sankyaku no Renshuu suru Jimiko to Gal (居残りで二人三脚の練習する地味子とギャル) 3-4) Gal to Machiawasechuu ni Koe wo Kakerareta Jimiko (ギャルと待ち合わせ中に声を掛けられた地味子) 5) Oyakusoku (お約束) 6) Gakkou Kaeri Issho ni Shitagi wo Minikita Jimiko to Gal (学校帰り一緒に下着を見に来た地味子とギャル)

title: Isekai Joshi Kangoku
description: When Eri Arisaki woke up, she found herself in a different world, and for some reason she was locked in a prison. The prison had its own rules, and Eri eventually got caught up in a big conspiracy within the prison....... A survival story that unfolds in a prison full of different female species, each with their own quirks! (Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Kunoichi no Ichi! no Ni
description: A high school student Ichi who visited a ninja residence on a school excursion was caught in a strange structure during the tour and time slipped to the ninja world. Along with his friends, Ichi who got the “Ninpocho”, a key to return to the present age, returns safely to the present age. However, suddenly an awakening appears in front of Ichi who lives a peaceful life ...!?

title: Between Summer and Fall
description: A teen who is worried about growth, love, and of friendship.

title: Chirizokonai no Hiraeth
title_original: 散り損ないのヒラエス
description: Sanayama Kazura, a girl who just wants to be loved, discovers that the girl she had been spending all of her money on to look her way has betrayed her. In her moment of despair, she is approached by Yoshibe Kinka, who asks if she would like to die with her. Together, they head to the top of a high-rise apartment bulding and jump off it. However... A story of two women at a crossroads in their lives, facing the feelings they've kept deep inside their hearts. (Source: TOKYOPOP)

title: Yuuki Yuuna wa Yuusha de Aru
title_original: 結城友奈は勇者である
description: The story takes place in the era of the gods, year 300. Yuuna Yuuki lives an ordinary life as a second year middle school student, but she's also a member of the "Hero Club," where club activities involve dealing with a mysterious being called "Vertex." (Source: Anime News Network)

characters.name: Yuuna Yuuki
characters.description: A second-year in middle school and member of the Hero Club. She prides herself on being a hero, helping out others in needs and always remaining optimistic. She fights the Vertex with her armored gauntlets and greaves. Her fairy familiar, Gyuuki, allows her to condense energy in her fist for her signature move "Hero Punch".

characters.name: Mimori Tougou
characters.description: [Yuuna](https://anilist.co/character/88636/Yuuna-Yuuki)'s best friend and fellow classmate and club member who lives next door to her and often prefers to be called by her family name. Mimori takes pride in her national heritage and is always ready to defend her country and protect its people. She has lost the use of her legs, along with some of her memories, allegedly due to a car accident. ~! Two years before the main story, Mimori was adopted by the Washio family because of her high aptitude as a Hero Candidate. She went by the name Sumi Washio for the entirety of her time adopted by the Washio family. After her Mankai caused her memory loss, she was promptly returned to the Tougou family and was conveniently relocated by the Taisha as a neighbor to Yuuna. !~

characters.name: Fuu Inubouzaki
characters.description: A third-year in middle school, president of the Hero Club, and older sister of [Itsuki](https://anilist.co/character/88639). She doesn’t bother with trivial issues, but she sees the big picture and inspires the others to follow her like a big sister. She loves her younger sister and friends very much. She is good at cooking and housekeeping, and loves eating. As a Hero, Fuu wields a large greatsword. The size of her blade allows her to use it as a shield just as often as a sword. She can also use the power of her fairy, Inugami, to increase her sword's size and attack a wide area.

characters.name: Itsuki Inubouzaki
characters.description: A first-year in middle school and member of the Hero Club. She is Fuu's younger sister and respects her dearly. Unlike her older sister, Itsuki is very shy and timid. However, she is very kindhearted and enjoys helping people. She also becomes less shy around people she knows, and can even be snarky at times. As a Hero, Itsuki fights with a tambourine-like ring lined with white flowers from which she can fire magical vines. These vines can ensnare and slice through enemies.

characters.name: Karin Miyoshi
characters.description: A second year in middle school, and member of the Hero Club. She is an experienced hero who transferred into [Yuuna](https://anilist.co/character/88636/Yuuki-Yuuna) and [Mimori](https://anilist.co/character/88637/Tougou-Mimori)'s class, joining the Hero Club to supervise the other heroes. Karin is depicted as a headstrong individual: stubborn, obstinate, and single-minded. She is very abrasive and finds it difficult when expressing her feelings towards others. However, she can't resist helping whenever someone is having trouble. She is rather self-confident and positive, initially believing her skills are far greater than the other members of the Hero Club. One could describe her as a "tsundere". As a Hero, Karin dual-wields twin katana. She is also able to throw her katana to strike at range while being able to generate new ones. Karin also has powerful physical abilities and can sense

characters.name: Sonoko Nogi
characters.description: __Height:__ 156 cm Sonoko Nogi is one of the three main characters of the light novel Washio Sumi is a Hero. At the time of the story taking place, she's an elementary school 6th-year student chosen by Taisha to fight Vertexes as a Hero, along with Gin Minowa and Sumi Washio. She is a very easygoing girl who has a habit of spacing out. However, her cloud cuckoo lander personality masks a truly staggering intellect, and she can formulate plans in mere seconds. Sonoko is also a successful novelist who specializes in romance novels, and she enjoys imagining her female friends in romantic situations with each other.

characters.name: Wakaba Nogi
characters.description: __Height:__ 163 cm __Grade:__ 2nd Year of Middle School A second-year middle school student and one of the Heroes of the first Hero Team and the ancestor of [Sonoko](https://anilist.co/character/88641/Sonoko-Nogi). Wakaba is a serious, strong-willed girl that believes in rewarding favors. She seeks revenge on the Vertexes and is willing to take risks to get it. She is a natural, charismatic leader who is wildly popular with the general public. However, she is also a kindhearted girl who is dismayed that her serious exterior sometimes scares people off, and she has a hidden soft side which enjoys being spoiled by [Hinata](https://anilist.co/character/126245/Uesato-Hinata). As a Hero, Wakaba fights using a sword named Ikutachi. It can cut through Vertexes with ease, even if the user is not transformed. Ikutachi is one-handed, meaning she has no need to hold onto it with both hands.

title: Yuri to Koe to Kaze Matoi
title_en: Lilies and Voices Born Upon the Wind
description: Mai had always thought of herself as asexual, uninterested in gossip and romance. Until one day Mai got a ride home from a beautiful stranger on her motorbike. As Mai put her arms around the stranger's waist and held on tight, she felt something for the first time…

title: Raubritter*
description: Three years ago, Karamura Neneko's father died. Since then, she's been living together with her older sister, Nanako. They've been living together happily until recently, when Nanako starts acting strangely. There will be nights that she doesn't sleep at home, and then one day she completely disappears. Not only that, but she quit her job at a company that she had been at for a long time. Worried about her sister, she remembers a place that her father told her to go to if she was ever in trouble, the Raubritter. Upon arrival, she meets Shinobu and Yokana, cousins that run a detective agency, more-so as a hobby than a career. Since they are both fairly wealthy they never ask for payment. They only help young maidens in need, and since their business is a secret, only people with connections come to them. It turns out that Neneko's father helped them out a lot in the past. The cousins are heart broken to find out that he died, so they are more than willing to help Neneko find her sister. What has happened to Neneko's sister? Will a special relationship develop between Neneko and the cousins?

title: Miru Tights Special Booklet
description: Special Booklet included with the Blu-Ray release.

characters.name: Ren Aikawa
characters.description: She is close to Yua Nakabeni and Homi Moegi where she attends a class together with them at Yaegasumi High School. Ren works at the bar. The Bar Master states that there weren't many clients before Ren started to work there. Now, when she works there, the place is extremely busy. Likes 60 denier tights (opaque).

characters.name: Yua Nakabeni
characters.description: Yua is an honor student who is great at sports. Although she doesn't speak that much, she has excellent communication skills. She has long back hair and black eyes. Yua loves cosplay and posts her images in costumes on social media. Ren follows her profile. Likes 30 denier tights (sheer).

characters.name: Homi Moegi
characters.description: She is a close friend with Ren Aikawa and Yua Nakabeni, she attends a class together with them at Yaegasumi High School. Homi is very carefree and clumsy. She has a brother, Rui Moegi. Homi is a bright and active teenage girl. Throughout the series, it's pointed out that Moegi is wealthy as she goes to school in a car with a driver. She also has a younger brother, Rui Moegi who is in junior high school. Moreover, she's a member of the school's swimming club. Her favorite tights are 110 denier.

title: Satou to Shio
description: The energetic Shiotani and the cool Satou like to play little games with each other. After playing in the snow, Shiotani warmed her hands by touching in Satou in some unusually intimate places. (Source: Comic ExE, translated)

title: Kyou Kara Yonshimai
description: Sakura Manabe is a 16-year-old high school student and is living with her 12-year-old sister Momiji and 27-year-old sister Botan, who works to support the three of them. Their 19-year-old brother Kashiwa has been away at college for two years and has suddenly decided to come back to live with them. However, when Kashiwa arrives, Sakura and the others discover that Kashiwa has now decided to live as a woman. Sakura and her two sisters now have to cope with the new reality of having another sister.

title: Dousei Seikatsu
description: A full color comic about the daily life of a office lady, Yuu-chan who works in small enterprise business, and a stay-at-home writer, Miyu-san!! Note: Originally self-published on Twitter, was then licensed by Kadokawa for serialization.

title: Yuru Oyako
description: First appearing in the fourth volume of the Yuri Drill anthology series, the continuing adventures of a daughter's attempts at winning over her stubborn mother. Note: First published as a doujin, it got licensed later on by Compass

characters.name: Yuuki Hanamura
characters.description: Daughter of Sayaka Hanamura

characters.name: Sayaka Hanamura
characters.description: Mother of Yuuki Hanamura

characters.name: Sumika Hanamura
characters.description: Mother of Sayaka Hanamura

title: Zettai Watashi no Koto Suki Daro
title_original: 絶対私のこと好きだろ
description: Sayaka's friend, Mako, is a bit weird. And she's totally in love with Sayaka. Or maybe not?

title: Mashou no Otome no Yakumawari
description: Kairan Girls’ Academy: a boarding school rich with history and tradition, attended only by orphans. It has a special system in which students are given “roles” that align with their individual goals. Hanako Shimura, a kind-hearted girl filled with dreams and expectations, enrolls into the academy hoping to make friends with everyone at school. But will she be able to? (source: Comic Gamma Plus, translated)

title: Aliens
description: Ami is an alien who worked for a large corporation in a distant galaxy, but because she bad-mouthed the company, she got demoted to the planet Earth. To make matters worse, she crashes her spaceship and loses all means of communication... she is rescued by Aoi, a sex android made to look exactly like an earthling, and reluctantly accepts her help while secretly looking down on her. This is the beginning of an everyday sci-fi yuri manga about a grumpy alien and a clumsy robot. (Source: Heroes, translated)

title: Watashi no Muchi na Watashi no Michi
title_original: 私の無知なわたしの未知
description: Minato was living an ordinary but slightly suffocating kind of life. The one who changes all that for her is her senpai at work, Maya Asami. When Minato is left bewildered by her boyfriend of 20 years' proposal, Maya sets Minato's heart free. What will come of this peculiar love triangle? (Source: Kodansha, translated)

title: Mikazuki no Carte
description: Touka Myoujouboshi is a girl who has been hospitalized her entire life due to a rare allergy to sunlight, and thus has not been able to experience love. To prevent Touka from ending it all, Doctor Yuki Tsukisi provides her with the ultimate prescription by acting as her girlfriend. Note: Chapter count includes two extras from the tankobon release.

title: Watashi no Tame ni Nuginasai!
title_original: わたしのために脱ぎなさいっ！
description: "The shy girl, Ninose Shizuku, is a high school student who makes a living out of drawing adult-oriented manga. Every day, in order to survive, she puts her heart into working on it, until she encounters a certain problem..." (Source: Japanese Publisher, translated)

title: Okisakisama to Ningyo Hime no Ohanashi
title_original: お妃様と人魚姫のお話

title: Mahou ga Tsukaenakutemo
description: Chiyo, who works as an animator in Tokyo, has a lover who is in a band.

characters.name: Tamaki Ookawa
characters.description: ~!Tamaki was revealed to be trans, saying that they are fine with being either a boy or girl.!~

title: Marshmallow♥Ecchi
description: An adult body, but childish heart. Heartrending, but sweet. A somewhat bitter high school love story.

characters.name: Momoka Fukuda
characters.description: Fukuda Momoka is the girlfriend of Mizutani Shirou. Since they went to different high schools, she started to worry that their relationship might drift apart.

characters.name: Shirou Mizutani
characters.description: Mizutani Shirou is an old-fashioned boy; he thinks people should only have sex after marriage. He wanted to keep his relationship with his girlfriend Momoka like it was before, but her sudden request to have sex stirred his mind. He started to notice her as a woman, and that caused conflict between his principles and body desires.

characters.name: Shouji Akiba
characters.description: Akiba Shouji is a love interest of Sayaka. He is a friend of Miki. He is a fan of Nishio Hikaru books.

characters.name: Ruko Kurihara
characters.description: Kurihara Ruko is a friend of Momoka and Sayaka. She is often asked by her friends to help them with their troubles; however, her words of advice can be quite merciless. She can read the quality of men by their "scent." She deeply cares about her friends and always checks out the boyfriends that Sayaka gets.

characters.name: Miki
characters.description: Miki is a student from Momoka's school. He falls in love with her, but she coldly declins all his advances. He understands that she won't return his feelings, but he just can't help how he feels.

characters.name: Miyata
characters.description: A friend of Mizutani Shirou. He is open-minded about having sex early; he even lost his virginity in middle school. He warned Shirou to stay away from Shiratama because she would bring him only trouble.

characters.name: Kako Mizutani
characters.description: The mother of Keiko and Shirou.

characters.name: Keiko Mizutani
characters.description: Mizutani Keiko is Shirou's older sister. She likes to make fun of him, especially teasing his innocent and old-fashioned notions of sex.

characters.name: Kojirou Mizutani
characters.description: Mizutani Kojirou is the strict, but understanding father of Shirou and Keiko. He is old-fashioned and taught his children that a relationship between a man and a woman must proceed in a specific order.

characters.name: Hikaru Nishio
characters.description: A novelist whom Ruko loved. He died in his thirties from a terminal disease.

characters.name: Sakamoto
characters.description: The ex-boyfriend of Toda Sayaka. He dumped her after she refused to go to a hotel with him.

characters.name: Saki
characters.description: A masochist friend of Shiratama Miyuki. She helps her gather information on boys that Miyuki targets to be the next prey. She takes joy in seeing Miyuki be sadistic.

characters.name: Hidenari Sasai
characters.description: Sasai Hidenari is the son of noble family and Keiko's boyfriend.

characters.name: Miyuki Shiratama
characters.description: The girl in Shirou's school that is known as the "Queen bee." She seduces men and sadistically toys with them. She drops her playthings when she gets bored of them.

characters.name: Sayaka Toda
characters.description: Toda Sayaka is a friend of Momoka and Ruko. She is an airhead and has a bad eye for men.

title: Tokidoki Kaettekuru Onna Tomodachi no Hanashi
title_original: ときどき帰ってくる女友達の話
description: Akira is a 32-year-old workaholic and Utako is a 24-year-old traveler who drops in to see Akira whenever she is in Japan.

title: Lily System
description: In the "mechanical girls" story, two high school girls discover a shabby machine in the back of a barn and it leads them to a strange world. (Source: Anime News Network)

title: Byeolsatang Yojeongui Chum
description: "This isn't the life that I wanted." On the day of her wedding, Eunha, who has hidden the fact that she's a lesbian her entire life, decides to jump off a building and end her life, not wanting to devote her life to a person she can't love. Just as she leaps, she closes her eyes and wistfully reminiscences her first love whom she never told her feelings for... only to find herself 10 years back in high school when she opens her eyes. As she is reunited with her first love, will Eunha be able to turn back her ill-fated life?

title: Dian Bo Ke Ji De Di Fang
description: Electromagnetic waves craft an illusionary world. Electromagnetic wave user Wei Xiaoran slips in and out of this world— saving others, as well as herself!

title: Suterare Elf-san wa Sekai de Ichiban Tsuyokute Kawaii!
title_original: 捨てられエルフさんは世界で一番強くて可愛い！
title_en: This Elf Will Not Be Shelved!
description: "To all top players: This game is a real fantasy world. Reincarnate there, save the world, and I will grant any wish you desire." Ayano, a former star voice actress, accepts the goddess's offer in hopes of shining once again as a voice actress. Reborn as a High Elf, one of the world's strongest races, she sets out on a quest to "clear" the game-like fantasy world using her player knowledge, joined by an irresistibly cute beast-eared heroine. But what awaits them beyond the game's scenario...!? (Source: Kadokawa)

title: Bakuretsu Tenshi: Angels' Adolescence
description: Meet Takeru, an ordinary boy who's always bullied because of his lack of self-confidence. What will happen when one day two mysterious girls show up in his room seeking shelter from a group of blood-thirsty thugs? Discover the changes in Takeru's life after meeting two girls that are definitely more than what meets the eye in Bakuretsu Tenshi.

characters.name: Jo
characters.description: Silver hair, red eyes, carries twin Desert Eagles and is known as "The Angel from Hell." She has superhuman abilities from her artificial creation, usually followed by the appearance of a purple glowing tattoo on her left arm and shoulder blade. They resemble wings and are often called "The Wings of the Devil" and will glow when Jo is put under a lot of stress when fighting. Jo also puts Meg over anything else, which she stated when telling Meg that she fights for her only. When she is not fighting, she enjoys watching horror or gore related movies. Ending spoiler: ~!Jo would eventually rediscover her past as a genetically engineered war machine in human form. After being forced to surrender with Meg and others held hostage, Jo returns to the secret labs for reprogramming and conditioning at RAPT R&D. Jo's counterpart, Maria, freed her to only prove who was the strongest; Jo managed

characters.name: Meg
characters.description: Meg has red hair, carries a small revolver, at times a large armor piercing rifle, and dresses like a cowgirl. Meg is highly prone to be captured and only to be rescued by Jo. She is the very best of friends with Jo and is 100% loyal to her only. It's suggestive throughout the series and manga that her feelings for Jo might be romantic, possibly bisexual since she's into men. She first met Jo in New York City, a year before the beginning of the series. Since then, Meg and Jo teamed up and became bounty hunters until Sei hired them. Meg enjoys eating and loves buffets. Her true hair color is not red, but actually black. She was once an orphan in New York City, but managed to encounter Jo. At first she was reluctant to keep Jo around because of her destructive capabilities, but after some time they learn to appreciate and trust each other. After they took Sei's offer as empl

characters.name: Sei
characters.description: Sei is the busty leader of the group and was the one who hired Jo and Meg to become members of it alongside Kyohei. She wears a long blue jacket, and has her black hair in a bun, but appears older than her stated age. Her grandfather runs Bai Lan and comes from a very powerful Chinese family. Born and raised as a traditional Chinese girl and trained in various ways of her clan/syndicate. After her grandfather stepped down as leader of the clan, their current clan members made a partnership with RAPT to preserve their clan. However such actions not only disgusted Sei, but she was forced to do many things for RAPT in Bai-Lan's name. She eventually rebelled against her own organization under the advice of her own grandfather. She was advised to walk her own path and so she chose to oppose RAPT and towards the end she was shot multiple times by a cyberoid. It is unknown if Sei survived the e

characters.name: Amy
characters.description: Amy is a Computer/Techno whiz. She was saved and recruited by Sei after Amy's hacking drew attention to the authorities. She often argues with Meg and also loves scarfing down Kyohei's various treats. She has a cult following in the cyberworld. She is often seen carrying what appears to be a pink stuffed animal that actually contains a laptop. ( Source : Wikipedia )

title: Tobacco-chan
description: The main focus of the story is Asano, an employee who just can’t quit smoking, and Tabako-chan, who is the anthropomorphized smoke of a cigarette and whose clothes start to dissolve the closer you get to finishing your cigarette. She clings to your clothes like the smell of cold smoke. Aside from Tabako-chan, there is also the menthol cigarette character Menko-chan, and the Golden Bat, born in 1906, who are all anthropomorphized cigarettes that have turned into beautiful girls.

title: Ami-chan no Nikki
description: "On June X, we switched over to the short-sleeve uniforms." Ami is the most beautiful girl at Tsubaki High school, who attracts looks from both boys and girls, but she has a secret that she can't tell anyone. That's all written in this diary...... (Source: Galette, translated)

title: Hayate x Blade
description: The all-girls boarding school Tenchi Academy isn't just known for its quality academics--it's also known for training the top sword fighters in the country. Students in the special "Sword Bearer" program compete in a school-wide battle known as the Star Stealing, striving to win both money and fame. Enter Kurogane Hayate. With her sister Nagi recovering from a lingering injury, the spunky and cheerful Hayate must take her place at the Academy until Nagi is well enough to return. When Hayate learns of the mountain of debt her old orphanage, the Dandelion Garden, owes to Yakuza loan sharks, she decides to become a sword-bearer and win the Star Stealing. There's just one problem...she needs a partner to compete and the one girl Hayate has her eye on wants nothing to do with her! (Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

characters.name: Ayana Mudou
characters.description: __Height:__ 159cm One of the best sword bearers in Tenchi Academy, but unable to fight at the beginning due to her status as a 'lone wolf'. After a lot of pestering, she agrees to pair up with Hayate.

characters.name: Jun Kuga
characters.description: Ayana's roommate, Jun is a rather playful girl who enjoys teasing Ayana though this usually earns her a beating. She cares very deeply for her shinyuu Yuho Shizuma, her half-sister. From Wikipedia

characters.name: Hitsugi Amachi
characters.description: The president of the student council, faculty director, and administrator. She cares very much about the academy's tradition of sword-fighting. As such, she is frustrated with Ayana's lack of desire to participate in the sword duels. She is also sadistic. Her shinyuu and childhood friend is Shizuku Miyamoto.

characters.name: Isuzu Inugami
characters.description: __Height:__ 153 cm __Class:__ 1-D

characters.name: Shizuku Miyamoto
characters.description: The partner of [Hitsugi](https://anilist.co/character/21435/Amachi-Hitsugi), Shizuku is also in charge of ringing the bell that signals the start and end of the hoshitori. She is always seen by Hitsugi's side, only leaving to ring the bell. She is also incredibly fast, though Hitsugi wonders who is faster between her and [Hayate](https://anilist.co/character/16660/Kurogane-Hayate).

characters.name: Yuho Shizuma
characters.description: Jun's half sister and shinyuu. She has a kuudere personality. She is also quite ill, so she is hospitalized. This is one of the reasons why Jun does not go into battle and her partner isn't around. When she and Jun were young, she decided to go to the Tenchi Academy and invited Jun to go with her. She cares for Jun deeply and challenged Ayana and Hayate to please her and allow her to have a good time before she is hospitalized again. She also has a fear of the dark.

characters.name: Akira Mikado
characters.description: __Height:__ 164cm

characters.name: Sae Inori
characters.description: __Height:__ 164cm

characters.name: Yukari Someya
characters.description: Middle School, Class 3-C Height: 156cm (5'1") Weight: 42kg (92lbs.) Birth Date: Aug. 5 Zodiac: Leo Favorite Phrase: Work and effort will never betray you.

title: Yashiro no Maou
description: Maou Shaitan Geneha, a demon lord whose powers were sealed away, seeks out the descendant of the one who sealed her; the office lady Shishibe Yashiro. Maou makes a contract with her, hoping to tempt Yashiro into undoing the seal. Note: Includes one extra chapter.

title: ShindoL no Bunka Jinruigaku
title_original: 新堂エルの文化人類学
description: College student Miyashita Naomi has it difficult as her cultural anthropology professor, Souichirou Itsuki, can't help but be interested in customs across the country. With this, she's taken along with another one of the professor's students, Sakura, to explore, survey and study those customs. However, these customs are quite suspicious. (Source: Japanese publisher, translated)

characters.name: Naomi Miyashita
characters.description: The main character of the story and a university student of the school Itsuki teaches at. After certain a event, Naomi slowly becomes unable to resist her sexual urges and because of that ends up going through various scenarios from being breeding with an octopus to being a treated as livestock and even giving birth to a child of god.

characters.name: Itsuki Souichirou
characters.description: A 9-year-old famous child genius who graduated from Oxford University. He is the cultural anthropology professor for the university Naomi and Sakura attend.

characters.name: Sakura
characters.description: A big busty girl who is very close to her Professor. She often acts more as an assistant and sometimes bodyguard to him. It was shown in a chapter that Sakura was from a group a genetically engineered humans that were trained for killing until she met Itsuki. In one chapter it shows off her strength when she unarms a man armed with a gun and in another she even makes a hole in a solid wall and even takes down a man twice her size in a single strike.

characters.name: Ariel Temple
characters.description: A friend of Professor Itsuki who attended the same university with him. Although Ariel looks like a girl, she's actually a boy.

characters.name: Mashyuu
characters.description: Mashyuu first appears when the gang decides to go a foreign island and she acts as a guide for Naomi to a village she was born in, although not raised in. With a slim body, flat chest and short hair, Mashyuu pretended to be a boy as she states that was the only way to keep her job. After the investigation on the island was solved, if she had stayed on the island after her pretending to be male was out by the village chief, she would have been stoned, as her village did not tolerate girls pretending to be boys. Instead, she came to live with the group as Naomi's spouse pretending to be the husband.

title: Hajimete, Kanojo to
title_en: The Conditions of Paradise: Our First Time
description: Hajimete, Kanojo to., by Morishima Akiko-sensei, takes a look back at the origins of some of our favorite couples from her previous works. First we look back at Rakuen no Joken. For Sarina and Sumi we learn how they got together and why they’ve never really been a steady item. The series ends as Sarina realizes that Sumi moving in isn’t the life she wants, but travelling the world together with her is. Shinobu and Lalaa have been living together for a while and Lalaa is inexpressibly happy. But, as she reminisces about how they got together, she misses, just a little, the crybaby Shinobu of her youth. We then move on to Sayaka and Ruri from Ruri-iro Yume. Sayaka’s dream has changed since we first met her, but she thinks it’s okay – and so do we. And last, we meet up once again with Mitsuki and Kaoru from Renai Joshika. With them, we travel back into their school years, how they met, became friends, became lovers and what went on between them during their first time dating

title: Kurai Mori, Shiroi Michi
title_original: くらいもり、しろいみち
description: In a small, lonely country town, a depressed young woman has a bittersweet encounter with a blind girl. (Source: Japanese Publisher, translated)

title: Ayame 14
description: Ayame is 14 years old. More than a child, but less than an adult. Ayame is quickly becoming more interested in sex and sexuality and her close friends are facing similar confusion. This is a coming of age story surrounding the rapid changes and challenges of adolescence.

title: Renai♥Joshika
description: Renai Joshika is about a group of women who all work in the same office.

title: Wagamama Chie-chan
description: Just before Saho Hanawa was about to matriculate into Seiran Middle School (her mother's alma mater), she meets a ghost girl, Chie, who's wearing the Seiran school uniform and standing in the rain. Saho assents when Chie asks to go to Saho's house, and they spend time talking and arguing with each other. Saho parents hear her talking to Chie and assume she must be talking on a cell phone—until they catch her talking to empty space in her room. Saho is forced to confess that she can see a ghost girl named Chie, which shocks her parents. They then reveal that Chie is the name of the stillborn baby that they had before Saho—Saho's dead older sister.

title: Hitori Mi Desu
description: A series of short stories that portray the mature single life of those who are members of sexual minorities. In the first chapter, we have Miyuki, who is single, female, and lesbian. She has no girlfriend, no life partner... and today is her 60th birthday. Note: Originally self-published, it was picked up for commercial serialization in 2025-06-07.

title: Kinjo no Yasashii Onee-san
title_original: 近所のやさしいおねえさん
description: Every day after leaving elementary school, Otone-chan visits the kind lady living near her home, since she can't play outside with her school friends due to her frail body. The two have a secret, though: They're lovers.

title: Watashi dake ga Miyaji Miyuki wo Aishiteiru
title_original: 私だけが宮地美雪を愛している
description: Miyaji Miyuki (16) had told various girls in elementary school that she would marry them when she grew up. But then she transferred away to a different school. A few years later, she returns to her hometown to start high school, where she is reunited with three girls she had proposed to marry way back when... (Source: Storia, translated)

title: Naisho no Ofutari-sama.
title_original: ないしょのおふたりさま。
description: Don't you think about anything else other than food…?? Eliza is a young lady who is only interested in "food." One day, a delinquent girl named "Misaki" shows up offering "delicious local specialties" for her. Misaki seems scary, but... Eliza just can't resist those delicious snacks! (Source: Comic Cune, translated)

title: Afternoon Tea wa Ikaga desu ka?: Watashi to Kanojo no Fujun de Ichizu na Futarigurashi
title_original: アフタヌーンティーはいかがですか？ 私と先輩の、不純で一途なふたり暮らし
description: Aozawa Kanata is a first-year university student. Upon entering university, she ends up sharing a room with Ichinose Yui, the daughter of her father’s friend and a third-year student at the same university. However, once they start living together, she learns a shocking truth: Yui is a lesbian, and is known for being a notorious womanizer. This is a university roommate story about a straight junior who is seduced by a beautiful, lesbian senior.

title: Koi no Zetsubou Koushinkyoku
description: "Hey, wanna try going out with me?" Rei has feelings for Ami, a girl in her class who's always been kind to her. So when she confesses to Ami, she fully expects to get turned down... until Ami says she likes her back! But now that they're officially a couple, Ami seems a little off. While Rei is head over heels for her, Ami is a player who isn't even sure how to love just one person. Rei is crushed by Ami's seemingly careless approach to their relationship, but even so, she won't give up. Will Rei's earnest but cumbersome feelings for Ami win out in the end? Or is the girl she loves simply too far out of reach? (Source: Yen Press)

characters.name: Takumi Musashino
characters.description: Takumi suffers from a terminal illness, agrees to try an experimental gene therapy and is changed into a girl.

title: Nyanko Days
description: It's an everyday life of a shy girl called Tomoko Konagai and three "cats" Maa, Roo, Shii. These cats are girls with cats' ears and can speak human language. Note: Includes 1 bonus chapter.

characters.name: Ro
characters.description: One of Yuko's cats. She is a level headed Russian Blue.

characters.name: Maa
characters.description: One of Yuko's cats. She is a mischievous Munchkin who loves to explore.

characters.name: Yuuko Konagai
characters.description: A fifteen-year-old girl who is shy by nature and has 3 cats (Maa, Shii and Ro).

characters.name: Shii
characters.description: One of Yuko's cats. She is a laid back Singapura cat. She is very shy and sweet, but can also be a bit of a crybaby.

characters.name: Azumi Shiratori
characters.description: Yuko's friend/classmate and a popular girl in their class. She is from a rich family and has a cat named Elza.

characters.name: Ran Iketani
characters.description: A gyaru-ish girl and Azumi's self-proclaimed rival, who often challenges her, and has a fear of cats.

characters.name: Elza
characters.description: Azumi's Turkish Angora cat.

characters.name: Iroha Sasase
characters.description: Yuuko's childhood friend.

characters.name: Nana
characters.description: An ex-stray cat who's a bit airheaded

title: Sugar Meets Girl!
title_original: しゅがー・みーつ・がーる！
description: Kanna is the daughter of the head of the gang, who is friendly and a little bit mischievous in appearance. And Miyako is the class president and the most popular girl in the school, the envy of everyone. What are the unexpected secrets that these two have discovered about each other? A sweet and juicy girls' comedy! (Source: Comic Fuz, translated)

title: Mahou Shoujo Madoka★Magica: Anthology Comic
title_original: 魔法少女まどか★マギカ アンソロジーコミック
description: The girls of the popular seinen magical girl series are reimagined in different scenarios across all sorts of genres by various mangaka.

characters.name: Madoka Kaname
characters.description: __Height:__ 152 cm (5'0") A 14-year-old girl whose life changes when she encounters the [Puella Magi Homura](https://anilist.co/character/38005/Akemi-Homura) and the familiar [Kyuubey](https://anilist.co/character/38566/Kyuubey), who offers to transform her into a Puella Magi herself. She sees herself as a person without special qualities or talents, and after seeing [Mami](https://anilist.co/character/38194/Tomoe-Mami) fighting against witches, wants to be a wonderful and cool Puella Magi like her. She is a rather selfless girl who wishes to be a magical girl simply so that she can help others. She allegedly has a large amount of magical potential within her.

characters.name: Homura Akemi
characters.description: __Height:__ 155 - 158 cm Homura is a magical girl who first appears in an apocalyptic nightmare of [Madoka's](https://anilist.co/character/37832). She transfers into her school the day after the dream. She is a beautiful, mysterious individual that performs exceptionally well in academics and athletics. This makes her instantly popular even though she is cold to others. She seems to know Madoka well and wishes to prevent her from becoming a magical girl. She attacks [Kyuubey](https://anilist.co/character/38566) in the first episode, only to be stopped by [Mami](https://anilist.co/character/38194).

characters.name: Sayaka Miki
characters.description: __Height:__ 158-160 cm __Weapon:__ Cutlass [Madoka's](https://anilist.co/character/37832/Kaname-Madoka) classmate who, after helping Madoka rescue [Kyuubey](https://anilist.co/character/38566/Kyuubey), ends up getting an offer to become a Puella Magi herself. She cares deeply for her friends, and wants to help an ill boy named [Kyousuke Kamijou](https://anilist.co/character/39835/Kamijou-Kyousuke), whom she has a crush on. Before becoming a Puella Magi, Sayaka wields a baseball bat that [Mami](https://anilist.co/character/38194/Tomoe-Mami) can enhance with magic to defend herself with while on witch hunts.

characters.name: Kyuubey
characters.description: Kyuubey is a familiar who can grant any wish to a certain girl, on the condition that she becomes a Puella Magi and fights against witches.

characters.name: Junko Kaname
characters.description: Junko is Madoka's mother. She's a successful business woman. She often goes out drinking with friends and co-workers, and comes home from a long day of work drunk. She's also friends with Madoka's homeroom teacher. She and Madoka are close, and she cares for her daughter very much, but ultimately lets her go when she tells her there's something she has to do on Walpurgis Nacht.

characters.name: Kazuko Saotome
characters.description: __Height:__ 155-157 cm Kazuko is Madoka's class teacher. Her relationships with guys don't last very long, and so she's extremely frustrated in these regards. Many of her classes involve her complaining about men. She also seems to be a friend of Junko Kaname, Madoka's mother.

characters.name: Kyouko Sakura
characters.description: __Height:__ 156-158 cm __Weapon:__ Spear Kyouko is a veteran magical girl who comes to the city later in the story. Amusingly, she is always seen eating something, even while she is battling. Having grown up in a poor family, she often has to steal food and hates people who waste it, a logic she also applies to Grief Seeds, as she only goes after fully grown witches. Kyouko has been a Puella Magi much longer than the others, and thus is more skillful; she wields a spear which can extend itself, split into multiple sections, and produce a ball at the end of a chain, which can constrict and hit others at the same time. She also has the ability to put up barriers to protect others or keep them from interfering. She initially clashes with Sayaka, but after learning the truth about Soul Gems, she sympathizes with her and tries to help her.

characters.name: Mami Tomoe
characters.description: __Height:__ 156-159 cm Mami Tomoe is a veteran magical girl and a third-year student at Madoka's school. She lives alone in a penthouse after her parents were killed in a car crash, which Mami survived after contracting with Kyuubey. Mami is particularly focused on saving, guiding, and protecting those around her, which is a traditionally selfless perspective on the role of magical girl. She is much like a maternal figure to Madoka and Sayaka, being the eldest among them. Her name could be considered a play on the word 'mommy', further supported in the third film, where she has a companion named "Bebe". Though Mami's outward disposition is cheery and confident, Mami feels deeply alone as she has no friends to confide in as she fights.

title: Philia to Eros no Aida
title_original: ピリアーとエロスのあいだ
description: Is it alright to not give up on these feelings...?

title: Salieri and Mozart
description: ... There is a girl, whose dream was to swim, but couldn't win with just her talent alone even if her life was on the line. There is another girl, who started swimming because her life wasn't fun, but then ended up showing genuine promise, even though swimming was just a joke to her. Like this, the two of them met each other, forming the worst relationship, akin to water and oil, the modern version of Mozart and Salieri, leading to the romance of dreams and youth. (Source: Bomtoon, translated).

title: Mikoto to Rei
description: Mikoto, the free-spirited gal, and Rei, the serious student council member. Rei is completely at the mercy of the free-spirited Mikoto…!? But it seems like she doesn’t mind it all that much. Take a peek into the cute—and slightly naughty—daily lives of these two? (Source: Kadokawa, translated) Note: Includes one extra chapter.

title: Hatsukoi Shimai
description: During a fateful visit to Tsunojo Girls' School, Chika Matsuzato meets the girl of her dreams--cool upperclassman Haruna Kizaki. Even though they spent only one short day together, Chika will never forget Haruna's kindness, and has made it her life's goal to study hard and get accepted into Tsunojo Girls' School so that they can be together. But will Haruna share Chika’s feelings...? (Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

characters.name: Touko Hiiragi
characters.description: The suave sensei who brought Chika and Haruna together who always finds time in her day to flirt with Akiho.

title: Destro 246
description: Billionaire Tono Ryuichi, the President of Tono Foods Group, a giant food company, recently acquired two young female assassins from the Mexican cartel. Sui and Ai came from unimaginably poor childhoods and was given a choice between killing people or selling their body. They chose the former and went through an inconceivably extreme training and, at 17 years old, they have become one of the deadliest assassins in the world. They are absolutely obedient to their master and they are given the task of finding the killer that poisoned Ryuichi’s wife and child. They begin attending high school to blend into society and, at the same time, read and study which helps them become even more deadlier on the field. Sui and Ai encounter Matoba Imari who is a high school assassin herself and may be more skilled than both of them. But unlike the two, Imari just wants to lead a normal life. Whatever Imari wishes for her life is not their problem because the only thing Sui and Ai feeds on are bloodthirst and a challenge. (Source: MangaHelpers)

title: Ohime-sama no Ohime-sama
description: Heidi Nanzan dreams of meeting the perfect girl. So she comes to the girls school with one goal, to be a princess for her princess. At Choyuri Gakuen, it's girls as far as the eye can see. A no-boys-allowed yuri comedy! (Source: Manga Cross, translated)

title: Joahaeyo, Seonsaengnim
description: Seon-Min seems like an ordinary college student, but behind closed doors, she lives a secret life as her professor's plaything. When Yu-Jin, the student she tutors, discovers her darkest secret, everything begins to fall apart. Seon-Min's campus life begins to unravel, plunging her once-stable existence into chaos. (Source: Lezhin US)

title: Heroine toka Yoku Wakannai kara, Akuyaku Reijou to Nigemasu.
title_original: ヒロインとかよくわかんないから、悪役令嬢と逃げます。
description: I should be dead but I'm lost in a world that's like an otome game!? The prince proposed to me, but the person I like is...! Note: First published in 'Nobody Told Me My Reincarnation Would Have a Condemnation Start! Anthology Comic' , re-edited and separately released as a one-shot.

title: Cider to Nakimushi.
description: A collection of short doujin stories by Canno. All slightly romantic, with open endings. 1. Hanamaru Happy End 2. Hikkyou Dead End 3. Hirahira Hiraku Himitsu no Tobira 4. Youkoso! Occult Kenkyuukai (Welcome to Occult Research Club) 5. Cinderella 6. Tada Haru wo Matsu 7. Natsu ga Owaru 8. Take ni Tora

title: Ichikoe, Nifuri, Tachiaoi
title_original: いちこえ、にふり、タチアオイ
description: Kataoka Aoi is a cram school teacher whose attractive face and demeanor has attracted attention from others since an early age. So much so that she tries to live an inconspicuous life in order to avoid unwanted drama. One day, she (reluctantly) accepts the principal’s request to appear in their school’s commercial. But it quickly goes viral, resulting in her becoming recognized in the school and out in public, drawing attention wherever she goes. Amidst the attention, the quirky girl Yamada, a clerk in the school's stationery shop, approaches her… (Source: GOTcorporation, translated)

title: Chou Kaguya-hime!
description: In a world just a little further in the future, one night, Iroha, a caring and highly skilled high school girl, picks up Kaguya, a princess from the moon. At Kaguya's invitation, the energetic and unconventional, the two decide to become live streamers (liver) in the virtual world "Tsukuyomi." As the girls deepen their bond through music, their destinies begin to unfold. This is the story of "Princess Kaguya" as no one has ever seen it before. (Source: Kadokawa, translated)

characters.name: Kaguya
characters.description: A mysterious girl from the Moon. Looking for fun, she decided to become a livestreamer in Tsukuyomi. She's energetic, outrageous and loves [Iroha](https://anilist.co/character/378972/Sakayori-Iroha).

characters.name: Iroha Sakayori
characters.description: A 17-year-old high school girl. A model student who excelles in both academics and sports. She works hard to pay her living expenses and tutition fees. She's a fan of [Yachiyo](https://anilist.co/character/378973/Runami-Yachiyo), Tsukuyomi's top livestreamer. She's also a talented musician, but doesn't compose anymore.

characters.name: Yachiyo Runami
characters.description: The top livestreamer of the virtual world "Tsukuyomi." A mysterious 8,000-year-old (allegedly) AI who can sing, dance, and even create clones.

title: Cheongjun Yeonswae
description: Jia is an average girl who, along with the majority of her classmates, has fallen head over heels for Yoona, a girl so pretty she's practically the school's idol. They're on two totally different levels, but Jia can ignore her feelings no longer! But who is Yoona, really? Stay tuned to see what romance unfolds between these two! (Source: Lezhin US)

title: By my side
description: Five stories of people and flowers. (Source: Pixiv, translated) Note: First published at COMITIA 128.

title: Shimaism
description: Haruka (14) and Sakura (12) are sisters. Yoshiko (14) and Mai (12) are sisters as well. So what happens when best friends Haruka and Yoshiko have an attraction to each others sisters of the Yuri kind?

title: Xi Yin Li Fa Ze
description: Nan Zhi's day life life is riddled with success and admiration. After work hours, however, her search for a romantic connection of any kind runs rampant. Bored by every encounter she's had, the entertainment company CEO is shocked when a one-night stand imprints itself on her mind. And she's even more shocked when she learns the subject of her infatuation is her best friend's younger sister. (Source: Tapas)

title: Fenhong Duandai
