characters.description: Ema Nonaka is a supporting character of _Hello Melancholic!_ She is tall, social, and busy. She plays a variety of instruments and is half Japanese and half Russian.

characters.name: Minato Asano
characters.description: She's tall, but awkward and shy. She prefers to stay hidden in the background at her new high school, until a certain classmate comes into her life.

characters.name: Hibiki Sugawa
characters.description: Hibiki Sugawa is one of the main characters of _Hello Melancholic!_ She is a 2nd year at Minato's high school and loves music.

title: Makoto-senpai no Mae de wa Kakko Tsukerarenai!
title_original: 真先輩の前ではかっこつけられない！
description: Jun, a good-looking tomboy, is a popular figure at her all-girls' school. She tries to always act in a stylish and gentlemanly manner to maintain her reputation, but when she gets into trouble, the “true handsome girl,” Makoto-senpai, is there to save the day…? A short romantic comedy between two handsome girls! (Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Aku no Meshitsukai
description: A vast kingdom called Lucifenia, whose popular name was the "Kingdom of Yellow", was ruled by a tyrannical princess named Rillianne and she was still only fourteen years old. Under her absolute monarchism, everything was exploited from people and the ones who did not obey her were executed without mercy. Allen, a servant who looked like her, was always beside the princess who was called "Daughter of Evil" by the people. The princess's selfishness caused a war and many deaths, and thus the secret clockwork of fate was going to spin madly. (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Riliane Lucifen d'Autriche
characters.original: リリアンヌ・ルシフェン・ドートゥリシュ
characters.description: Riliane Lucifen d'Autriche was the last Princess of the Kingdom of Lucifenia, regarded as The Daughter of Evil, and the twin sister of Prince Alexiel. Separated from her twin in a political dispute during childhood, Riliane grew up in a lavish lifestyle, ignorant of her past. The selfish Princess was unknowingly possessed by the Demon of Pride and, after her mother's death, became Lucifenia's monarch. An arrogant tyrant, Riliane became despised for her terrible regime, aided by her loyal servant, Allen, in exterminating any opposition.

characters.name: Allen Avadonia
characters.original: アレン・アヴァドニア
characters.description: Allen Avadonia, born Alexiel Lucifen d'Autriche and regarded as The Servant of Evil, was the last Prince of the Kingdom of Lucifenia and a servant to his twin sister, Princess Riliane. After the death of their father, the twins were separated in a political dispute. Pronounced dead and adopted by Leonhart Avadonia, "Allen" returned to the royal palace to serve as his sister's chamberlain, helping exterminate any opposition to Riliane's tyranny.

characters.name: Germaine Avadonia
characters.original: ジェルメイヌ・アヴァドニア
characters.description: Adoptive daughter of Leonhart Avadonia from the Three Heroes and foster sister of Allen. Following the assassination of her adoptive father, Germaine founded the Lucifenian Resistance to overthrow Princess Riliane's terrible regime.

characters.name: Elluka  Clockworker
characters.original: エルルカ・クロックワーカー
characters.description: Elluka Clockworker, regarded as the Sorceress of Time and the Eternal Sorceress, was a powerful mage. Awakening from Sin in the wake of the Levianta Catastrophe, the immortal accepted a quest from Held to collect the vessels of sin on a whim. She later became involved in numerous incidents and conflicts caused by the sin vessels over the centuries. ~!She was one of Levia and Behemo's reincarnations.!~

characters.name: Kyle Marlon
characters.description: The young King of Marlon and the son of Empress Dowager Prim. After falling in love with Michaela and breaking up his engagement with Princess Riliane, Kyle unwittingly sparked the Lucifenia-Elphegort War. Having lost his beloved to Riliane, Kyle secretly supports the Lucifenian Resistance seeking to overthrow the tyrannical Princess.

characters.name: Anne d'Autriche
characters.original: アンネ・ルシフェン・ドートゥリシュ

characters.name: Arth d'Autriche
characters.original: アルス・ルシフェン・ドートゥリシュ

characters.name: Uranaishi
characters.description: A fortune teller that helped the Yellow kingdom become the greatest.

characters.name: Ouji
characters.description: The prince of the Yellow country and the brother of the king. He was an ambitious man, aiming to become the next ruler of the country.

characters.name: Baaya
characters.description: The nanny taking care of princess Rin.

characters.name: Lord Gondor
characters.description: The third in line for the throne in the Yellow country.

characters.name: Prim Marlon
characters.description: Prim was born a HER in the Kingdom of Lucifenia on January 14, EC 457 as a noble of the esteemed Rogzé Family. She was the queen of Marlon and the mother of Kyle and Ney Marlon.

characters.name: Josephine
characters.description: Enif Yggdra was the child of renowned professor Held Yggdra. Through unknown means, Enif was reborn in the royal stables of the Lucifenian Royal Palace as a foal. Riliane Lucifen d'Autriche grew attached to Josephine and kept her in the royal stables as her favorite horse.

title: Narakarana
description: The male with the devil's name, Amon. In order to protect himself and the people around him, to gain back his memories, and in order to escape from hell, he must fight. The enemies that will come after him after having woken up from the dead, and the encounters with women that will leave him breathless. And of course, "Good luck this time around oppa♡" But wait, The condition of hell is...?! (Source: Lezhin, translated) Note: Includes one extra chapter.

title: Kono Kakegae no Nai Jigoku
title_original: このかけがえのない地獄
description: Collection of one-shots. 1. Kono Kakegae No Nai Jigoku (このかけがえのない地獄, This Irreplaceable Hell) 2. Shindeiru Kimi (死んでいる君, Dead You) 3. 4 Ban Me no Heroine (４番目のヒロイン, Fourth Heroine) 4. Damare NEET (黙れニート, Shut Up NEET) 5. Boku wa Kanojo no Kanojo (僕は彼女の彼女)

title: Kamisama bakari Koi wo Suru
title_original: 神さまばかり恋をする
description: Satoka is the daughter of a local shrine and lives together with Kotori, who may look like a normal and energetic girl, but is actually a matchmaker god in training. This series is about them, Satoka’s childhood friend Shiori and the mysterious Hiwa dealing with their everyday lives and the relationships around them.

title: Cross Ange: Tenshi to Ryuu no Rondo
title_original: クロスアンジュ 天使と竜の輪舞
title_en: Cross Ange: Rondo of Angels and Dragons
description: All humans in this world can use the power of the light of mana, and those who can't are considered to be subhuman 'Norma.' The world is like a peaceful utopia, and the celebrated princess Angelize leads a happy life. She believes that the only darkness left in the world is the existence of the horrible Norma. However, in a ceremony on her 16th birthday, the truth is revealed--Princess Angelize is a Norma. Now she is going to learn what her society does to Norma. She is sent to an isolated island full of others like her, who are taught that the only reason they are allowed to live is in order to fight to protect the peace of this world. Now "Ange" is part of a squad that pilots Paramails and fights invading extradimensional dragons. (Source: MangaHelpers)

characters.name: Angelise Ikaruga Misurugi
characters.original: アンジュリーゼ・斑鳩・ミスルギ
characters.description: She used to be a member of the nobility who had the title of "First Princess of the Misurugi Empire" until the day of her coronation when she was exposed as a "Norma" by her ambitious brother Julio. Stripped of her title and honor, and thrown into a remote island where her own kind are treated like tools for battling dragons, her once comfortable life of honor, privilege, and prestige now becomes a life of where everyday is a battle to stay alive as she struggles to accept her new life as one of the warriors of the First Troop.

title: Gonlanhaeyo, Yeosinnim!
description: Yoon Heeji is serving as the nation’s current goddess, granting wishes to those that pray to her. But being a goddess isn’t all it’s cracked up to be: there’s paparazzi, constant criticisms from the public, and, well... granting wishes isn’t so easy, either. As Heeji soon discovers, sometimes satisfying a wish client means having to go further than you ever planned... (Source: Lezhin US)

title: Anima Yell!
description: Kohane Hatoya is a girl who loves to be helpful to others. After she moves from middle school to high school, she becomes fascinated with cheerleading, and she starts a cheerleading club at her high school. Joining Kohane in her cheerleading activities is the experienced Hizume and Kohane's childhood friend Uki. (Source: Anime News Network)

characters.name: Kana Ushiku
characters.description: __Height:__ 159 cm Kana Ushiku is Hizume's former teammate. She looks up to Hizume affectionately, despite them being in the same year. She usually looks apathetic, but has a complete attitude change when it comes to talking about Hizume.

characters.name: Kotetsu Tatejima
characters.description: __Height:__ 154 cm __Favorite food:__ Sweets __Favorite color:__ Pink and brown __Favorite things:__ Piano, tea time Kotetsu Tatejima is Kohane's classmate. She is shy and constantly recedes from any risk of drawing attention, but is very frank about what she thinks. She doesn't think very highly of her given name.

characters.name: Uki Sawatari
characters.description: __Height:__ 160 cm Uki Sawatari is Kohane's childhood friend who always ends up bringing Kohane down to Earth, despite Kohane's constant antics. She may project a pragmatic and realistic front, but she actually likes cute things.

characters.name: Kohane Hatoya
characters.description: __Height:__ 151 cm Kohane Hatoya is a constantly optimistic person who loves to support others. She usually has more drive than others, but she is also clumsy and has poor reflexes. She began to be fascinated by cheerleading since a performance she saw toward the end of her middle school years.

characters.name: Hizume Arima
characters.description: __Height:__ 163 cm Hizume Arima is a girl experienced with cheerleading. She can be serious to a fault. Her stoic attitude distanced her from her former cheerleading teammates. She is usually expressionless, but can act out a good smile. (Source: ANN)

title: Ying Hou Cheng Shuang
description: When Lu Yinbing won the Golden Palm Best Actress Award for her performance in "Broken Snow," the popular actress Xia Yitong realized her defeat and broke down in tears on live television. A huge flame war erupted online between their fanbases. Yinbing's fans called Yitong a sore loser, while Yitong's fans claimed that she was just being real. Little did the fans know, behind the scenes the two women were already... (Source: Bilibili, translated) Note: Includes one extra chapter.

title: BLUE DROP: Tenshi no Bokura
description: The Arume, a dominating alien race of female humanoids (alien lesbians) has conquered Earth. With total control over the world they have begun live experiments on humans. One day, out of the blue, a girl that Shouta Yanami has never seen before in his life arrived at his house asking to have sex with him. How will this end for Shouta Yanami? Note: Includes the first two chapters of "BLUE DROP: Tenshi no Itazura".

title: Himitsu no Hanazono
description: A shoujo-ai manga about a girl named Misono who falls in love with a handsome "boy" one day as she was taking a break from her running. She believes that she shall never meet this "boy" ever again, but after warnings about problems with her foot, Misono decides to not run for a while and help out with the drama club. There she meets her "handsome prince" once again, but it turns out "he" is not who she thought he was...

title: Ashita Shinu nara Nani Shitai?
title_original: 明日死ぬなら何したい?
description: Sou is a God of Death, who's fallen behind on her quota. She looks through the 'Black Book' filled with dangerous souls. Though when she offers Ashiya Makoto anything she wants in exchange for her soul she gets an unexpected request!

title: Pie wo Agemashou, Anata ni Pie wo ne
title_original: パイをあげましょ、あなたにパイをね
description: Collection of one-shots. 1. My Unique Day (マイユニークデイ) Sorako joined a theater troupe entirely because of her admiration for Miki, the group's star. But is admiration really the only thing Sorako feels for her pretty brunette friend? 2. Pie wo Agemasho, Anata ni Pie wo ne (パイをあげましょ, あなたにパイをね, I Will Bring You Mille Feuille) 3. Sawako-san to Uchuu Ryokou (スワコさんと宇宙旅行, A Space Voyage with Suwako-san) A woman falls for a married woman. 4. Mou Suki nante Iwanai kara (もう好きなんて言わないから, I Won't Say I Love You Anymore) Hirasawa Eriko, a former teen idol, remembers the relationship she had with another idol, and how it ended painfully.

title: Cotton
description: One rainy day, the young woman Natsuki encounters a high school student in the street. Acting on an impulse, she gives the girl her umbrella and walks away. It turns out later that the girl, Michiko, is the younger sister of Natsuki’s sister’s newly-married husband. Even though Michiko has a difficult personality and doesn’t open herself to others easily, she seems to be attracted to Natsuki. Thus begins an unusual friendship between two unlikely characters who need each other more than they first realize. (Source: Kotonoha) Inlcudes bonus content/oneshots in 2010 reprint: Seibutsu (Creature) (生物) Asa no Kodomo (Morning's Child) (朝の子ども) Tegami (Letter) (手紙) Zange (Last days of summer) (残夏) telephone under the rose Houkago (放課後)

characters.name: Natsuki Kariya
characters.description: Despite being age 23, she does not act or look like an adult. She is the only person who managed to develop a deep relationship with Michiko. In the beginning of the story, she was just dumped by her boyfriend, while waiting for the traffic light Natsuki and Michiko shared an umbrella, after seeing Michiko's expression, she suddenly started crying, thus attracted Michiko's attention.

title: Yuri Anthology Dolce
title_original: 百合アンソロジー dolce
description: Volume 1: Dolce (2012/5/25) Cover illustration: Namori (front), Koume Keito (back) Color illustrations: Hibiki Reine, Kamo (加茂), Mizuno Moto, Soumatou, Yakusa (八色), Shirabi 1. Duet by Matsuzaki Miyuki 2. Yuri Seijin (百合星人, Alien from Yuri) by Manishi Mari Sae is in love with her senpai, Hitomi. When the time came to actually confess to her, however, she instead blurted out a ridiculous lie about being an alien. How will Sae correct her mistake, and what future is in store for the two. 3. Kaze, Sono Ato ni (風邪、その後に, A Cold, and After That) by Minase Ruruu Naho is having trouble keeping her feelings in check when taking care of her sick friend Mana. 4. Hanarerarenai Sekai (離れられない世界, Inseparable World) by Amezawa Koma 5. Otome-san and Shoujo-chan (乙女さんと少女ちゃん) by Nawoko 6. Kyoukaisen (境界線, Boundary Line) by Tamatsuu 7. Himitsu no Tobira (ヒミツのトビラ, Secret Door) by Pikachi 8. Tsudzuru Hime Koi (綴る秘め恋, Secret Love Spell) by Yurihara Aki 9. Izumi no Sentaku (いずみの選択, Izumi's Choice) by Mizumoto Tadashi 10. Salinity Girl (サリニティガール) by Mizutama 11. Wagamama na Sekai (ワガママなセカイ, Selfish World) by Watari Makana 12. Usotsuki Cigarette (嘘吐きシガレット, Cigarette Liar) by Yamamoto Mamo 13. LisBlanc by Kur

title: Houkago 2nd season
description: The story after Shiine and Ichika start dating.

title: Kotonoha no Miko to Kotodama no Majo to
title_original: ことのはの巫女とことだまの魔女と
description: Fujieda Miyabi's The Caged Miko and the Whimsical Witch depicts a romance between—you guessed it—a miko and a witch. In the first chapter, Letty, the witch, ends up playing the knight in shining armor to Tsumugi, a young woman magically bound to her family's shrine.

characters.name: Tsumugi Tokigami
characters.description: A sixteen-year old miko of Tokigami lineage. Because of this, she was bound to her family's shrine since she was six. She is kept caged within the shrine's parameters to act as a sort of safeguard in case something happens with Japan. Due to the lack of contact from the outside world, she is quite ignorant of matters such as love and innocent as well. She bound herself to Letty, once the latter freed her from the bonds that kept her tied to the shrine.

characters.name: Gretia Deetolihi
characters.description: A witch from Germany. She broke the ties that kept Tsumugi in the shrine. Tsumugi sees Letty as her "lover" because of various factors.

characters.name: Isuzu Suzushiro
characters.description: She watches over the members of the Tokigami family to protect them. She secretly loves Tsumugi .

characters.name: Mountain God
characters.description: She is the Tokigami Mountain God. She takes the form of Tsugami . She gave Letty some divine powers,so Tsugami can explore the outside world with Letty without any problems. The only difference you can tell between Tsugami and the God is that the God's hair is lighter.

characters.name: Seriho Inukai
characters.description: Inukai Seriho is a 25-year-old lady who is owner of the Amber Teahouse, a small tea shop she opened in Tokyo after winning a lottery. Although skilled in creating tea, she has trouble managing her shop, shown when she forgets to take down the "Closed" sign on the building. She takes on one of her regulars, Sarasa Kotoori, to work with her in the shop, and slowly begins falling for the younger girl. Has a short cameo appearance in chapter 2 of Kotonoha no Miko to Kotodama no Mahou to. Also appears in chapter 1 of Iono-sama Fanatics when Eto and Iono meet at the Amber Teahouse.

title: Sorairo Girlfriend
description: My name is Juliet, her name is Romeo... Enchanting rogue Juli puts a spell of love on Hiromi. Even though she relishes being tantalized by unhibited Juli, Hiromi's heart is filled with fragments of doubt. When two girls' feelings intersect, in which direction will they turn? (Source: JManga)

characters.name: Juri Kashiwagi
characters.description: The new transfer student at Hiromi's school.

title: Yellow Drops
description: Sato and Hiyoko reminisce the day they became close.

title: Bomgwa Gyeoul
description: Outed in high school?! In the middle of the night, high schooler Jung-Yoon sends a teary text to her ex-girlfriend in the hopes of winning her back. But much to her horror, she discovers that she's actually sent it to Do-Young, the most anti-social girl in her class! Will she be outed at school?! (Source: Manta)

title: Nukitashi R
description: The hit game Nukitashi returns with its second long-form manga adaptation!! “I Can’t Betray Rei-chan, Can I?” The story is set on Seiran Island, a paradise of lust where the “Perverted Law” was enacted to combat population decline. Being a virgin equals to punishment!? Hinami Watarai, a virgin unable to engage in lewdness even on such a twisted island, is approached by a secret organization aiming to dismantle the law: the anti-copulation front. However, her best friend is Rei Tadasugawa—the discipline committee president and a enforcer of the pervertion. Should she reject the organization… or betray her best friend? A new Nukitashi tale begins!!

characters.name: Junnosuke Tachibana
characters.description: __Height:__ 179 cm (5'10") A proud virgin who believes that there can't be sex without love. As he stays on Seiran Island and dodges the "SS" committee, he launches the "NLNS (No Love, No Sex)" campaign in order to rebel against the island's deranged laws and customs.

characters.name: Hinami Watarai
characters.description: __Height:__ 139 cm (4'7") Contrary to her young and loli appearance, Hinami is a third-year student. She is very kind and has a big heart, and hates constantly being referred to as a loli or a child. She also carries a chair around with her to help her reach high places due to her small stature.

characters.name: Rei Tadasugawa
characters.description: __Height:__ 166 cm (5'5") A third-year student who is the "military tactician" of the "SS" committee, or in other words, controls their members. She doesn't tolerate people who break rules, and always tells Junnosuke, who often runs away from Rei, that corridors are the perfect places to have sex at, among other things.

characters.name: Asane Tachibana
characters.description: Junnosuke's sister who understands him the most. She dislikes normal men but loves her older brother and women, especially older and perverted women. Most of the time Asane is relaxed but as soon as she sees a woman who is her type, she loses control of herself completely. Her dream is to have a threesome with her brother and his girlfriend.

characters.name: Ikuko Onabuta
characters.description: The "first commander" of the "SS" committee. She thinks about sex 24/7 every day of the year, and often slacks off from her duties due to this.

characters.name: Touka Reizeiin
characters.description: The student council president of the school and the leader of the "SS" committee. To Touka, sex is just a simple form of communication.

characters.name: Nanase Katagiri
characters.description: The most charismatic and popular "slut" of the school. There are a lot of rumors of Nanase being an uncontrollable sex queen, but in reality Nanase is a virgin and people base everything on her looks. She often uses this to her advantage when attempting to escape.

characters.name: Misaki Hotori
characters.description: __Height:__ 160 cm (5'3") A girl who has barely any presence and has a complex over her body, so people easily forget her. However because she was born on Seiran Island, she doesn't care about people staring at her chest during conversations.

characters.name: Fumino Kotoyose
characters.description: A mysterious girl who can often be seen aiding the NLNS with her sniping skills from a distance. Is not very talkative due to not interacting with people very often, but is a very earnest girl who has tremendous respect for those who have a strong conviction. ~!She is the illegitimate child of Governor Hitoura, which is the reason everyone belives she is the key to breaking the Perverted Ordinance.!~

title: Sono Uruwashiki Hito wa,
title_original: そのうるわしきひとは、
description: Koto, a very ordinary girl, is good friends with Fumi, the top student at an exclusive all-girls' school. Fumi is the perfect student, with her combination of talent and beauty, but after summer vacation, she suddenly disappears without a trace. Amidst the rumors circulating around the school, Koto discovers a diary. Hoping to solve the mystery of her friend's disappearance, what will Koto learn from the diary…? (Source: Hakusensha, translated) Note: Chapter count includes a volume-bonus chapter.

title: Neko ni Hakuchou, Hotaru ni Koban
description: Art teacher Hase Hotaru is confounded by one of her students, Nekome Yuna. Yuna fell in love at first sight with Shiratori Ako, a part-time teacher at the same school, and she is aggressive in her pursuit. However, Ako has quirks of her own, and her true feelings are inscrutable. The story of a student's unrequited love and the unexpected effects on the adults around her. (Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Kono Koi, Ittan Mochikaerasete Itadakimasu!
title_original: この恋、一旦持ち帰らせていただきます！

title: Honey & Honey: Onnanoko Doushi no Love Couple
title_original: ハニー＆ハニー 女の子どうしのラブ・カップル
description: Honey & Honey is a realistic look at an adult lesbian couple living in Japan; to be precise, it's autobiographical. The artwork is simple, but hopefully the plot (and the information the manga imparts) will be enough compensation for those who don't like that style of drawing. This manga is similar to Plica, though it's not a 4-panel manga.

characters.name: Sachiko
characters.description: Sachiko is a femme bian (bian=lesbian and femme means she plays the female role in the relationship). Masako is her girlfriend.

characters.name: Masako
characters.description: Masako is bi, she is also butch (bi=likes both men and women, butch means she plays the male role in the relationship). Her girlfriend is Sachiko.

title: Hone no Nazuki made Aisu
description: "I came back as promised, and I've become pretty just for you. That's why, with this, will you love me?"

title: Belladonna no Koibito
description: For everyone who has ever had their heart ache from love. A collection of three exquisite short stories. 1. Belladonna no Koibito (ベラドンナの恋人) 2. Ouji-chan no Suki na Hito (王子ちゃんの好きな人) 3. Ningyo Hime (人魚姫) (Source: Shogakukan, translated)

title: Shiawase Torimingu
description: Suzu, an art student in a creative rut, finds new inspiration when she meets a beautiful girl at the park who introduces her to the colourful world of birdwatching.

characters.name: Tsubasa Tokiniwa
characters.description: College student who runs a bird-related YouTube channel.

characters.name: Suzu Miyauchi
characters.description: Student at Michinoku University of Art.

title: Hime-sama Sore wa Seisui Desu ka?
title_original: 姫様それは聖水ですか？
description: Note: Released at Comiket 96.

title: Ame to Muchi
description: Mary does compensated dating but adamantly refuses to have sex. One day as she meets a client as usual, the client turns out to be a big breasted lady named Sayoko. After initial surprise, she goes on more and more dates with the woman that gives her plenty of money just for hanging out with her. She goes shopping with her and to all sorts of fun places like karaoke, game arcades and net cafes when she decides to invite her somewhere a bit more out there: A girls’ night at the love hotel.

title: KiraKira★Study: Zettai Goukaku Sengen
title_original: きらきら★スタディー ～絶対合格宣言～
description: Misaki Marei is a second year in high school, and she sucks at studying. She has no real goals in life, and has zero interest in taking the college entrance exam...until her childhood best friend, Micchan, says she's going to college. Now Marei has found her goal: pass the entrance exam for Akamon University, an elite college, and go to school with Micchan.

title: Kanojo no Sekai
description: Konno finds herself interested in an erotic tale created by her classmate Hikawa.

title: Hajimete no Otomodachi wa Zombie deshita
title_original: はじめてのお友達はゾンビでした
description: “The zombie world might not be so bad!” Eko-chan, a bullied girl, enjoys the devastated post-apocalyptic world with her first friend (who has become a zombie). It's a survival adventure with a friend who is slowly losing her humanity! (Source: Shueisha, translated)

title: Rutou-san ni wa Kanaimasen!
title_original: 瑠東さんには敵いません!
description: Chihiro Wamura is an unassuming otaku girl who happens to sit next to Kaname Rutou, the beautiful honor student. They don't have anything in common, until one day Rutou-san asked Wamura to take a selfie with her while in class?

characters.name: Kaname Rutou
characters.description: An honour student who's beautiful and popular, but secretly playful.

title: Guzu na Onna Bakari ja Nai Ze
title_original: 愚図な女ばかりじゃないぜ
description: A collection of one-shots by Minami Q-ta. 1-6. Guzu na Onna bakari ja Nai ze (愚図な女ばかりじゃないぜ) 3-4. Tanoshii Houkago (楽しい放課後; Fun After School) This is a two-part one-shot that tells about the relationship between Iwata Megumi, the idol of Chofu High School, and Midorikawa Mayuko, also known as Miss Chofu High School. When another student takes a picture of the two of them in an intimate moment, what lengths will Megumi go to to get the picture and negative? Note: contains non consensual sexual situations. 7. Ninpu-chan (にんぷちゃん) 8. Hikari-chan no Koibito (ひかりちゃんの恋人) 9. Koibito to Wakareru Hi (恋人と別れる日) 10. School Days (スクール・デイズ) This centers around a girl named Misaki who hates the co-ed school she was forced to transfer to and desperately misses her best friend from the girls' school she used to attend. Note: contains heterosexual sex. (Source: Lililicious)

title: Nyoroko no Namahousou!
description: "Uhm-uhm... N-Nice to meet you! I'm Nyoroko". A girl – not good at talking to people – is invited by her friend Matsuri and challenged into doing a live broadcast for her first time. A youthful 4-koma comedy!

title: Hatsukoi, Tokimeki Usuihon
title_original: はつ恋、ときめき うすいほん
description: Cheerleaders Hime and Itoha have recently become lovers. However, they are both sheltered girls who don't know the first thing about love. In a misguided attempt to be a better lover to Iroha, Hime takes the advice of her friend and uses... erotic doujin as a guide?! A yuri love comedy about two girls experiencing love using ero doujins!

title: Atashi no Senpai
description: Tsukamoto is an average girl who, for no particular reason, is drawn to Okazaki-senpai – a girl who might as well have a sign above her head that says “I am in an abusive relationship.”

title: Cutie Honey a Go Go!
title_original: キューティーハニー aGoGo!
description: Tokyo is under siege by the terrorist organization known as Panther Claw, and the beautiful superheroine android known as Cutie Honey arrives to take them on–and fails! Cutie Honey must now join forces with government agent Natsuko Aki, as the duo pose as student and teacher at St. Chapel Academy. But there is nowhere to hide from Panther Claw and its leader’s evil machinations! (Seven Seas Entertainment)

characters.name: Honey Kisaragi
characters.description: Honey Kisaragi is a regular Catholic schoolgirl, until the day her father is murdered by the "Panther Claw" Organization. After his death, she learns she is actually an android created by him and within her is the Fixed System of Air Elements. By saying "Honey Flash!" she can transform into the sword-wielding red-haired superhero, Cutie Honey.

characters.name: Natsuko Aki
characters.description: As with many of the supporting characters in Cutie Honey, Aki has taken on many different roles. In the original manga she is Honey's friend and roommate at the all girls school they go to. In Re: Cutie Honey Aki Natsuko is a lead Investigator for the National Police Security Task Force – Branch 9. She is cold and controlling and is an absolute perfectionist. While she is an exceptional police officer she also has the bad habit of getting “in over her head” into trouble. She is an expert marksman. She tends to wear black a lot and lives alone in a small apartment. She has a passion for Japanese Sake and when she gets drunk loves to sing Karaoke. Hides her beauty by wearing non-prescription eyeglasses.

characters.name: Seiji Hayami
characters.description: Depending on the story Seiji takes on different roles but two things always stay the same, one he has the hots for Honey, and two he is always willing to help her out.

characters.name: Sister Jill
characters.description: From story to story Sister Jill roles slightly differ, sometimes she is leader of Panther Claw and sometimes she is the head subordinate of the mysterious leader of Panther Claw.

characters.name: Daemon Abashiri
characters.description: Seiji and Junpei's father, Naojiro's uncle in Cutie Honey. He is skilled with martial arts, and ninja-like skills. He becomes quite helpful in battle. He's very old school, and overly dramatic. Danbei acts as a parental figure to Honey. He also appears in UFO Robo Grendizer under the name Danbei Makiba.

characters.name: Tarantula Panther
characters.original: タランチュラパンサー
characters.description: Member of Panther Claw with Spider Abilities.

characters.name: Bad Fly Claw
characters.description: Appears in episode 4

characters.name: Fire Claw
characters.description: Appears in episode 2

characters.name: Scissors Panther
characters.description: Appears in episode 6

title: Jigeumui Urineun
description: Former High School friends turned roommates, Ah-Young Jing and University arts student Nara Kwon have developed a close yet ambiguous relationship. What course will their desires and uncertainties take after Ah-Young Jing asks Nara Kwon about "Friendship Night"?

title: Gakkou no Sensei
description: Sakura (a down-to-earth chick), Akane (a loli), and Yuriko (an otaku) have been friends ever since they met in high school. They all wanted to become teachers and now that they've grown up somehow agreed on living together. The story depicts their lives as teachers.

title: R2R : Run to Red
description: Living in the slums of District Zero, Ban runs a small errand service, taking on jobs others would rather avoid. One day, he accepts a request from Shinwi, the boss of a rising criminal organization, and stumbles upon the existence of the mysterious “Project W.” While investigating the substance, Ban hopes to help Ray, the police officer who once took him in and whom he has secretly loved for years. But the deeper Ban digs, the more he uncovers a hidden truth Ray has long been keeping hidden. As secrets surface, Ban finds himself caught between loyalty, love, and a dangerous conspiracy. (Source: Lezhin US)

title: Haitoku no Finale
description: Despite her initial fears, the sweet and shy Moe Hozumi is adjusting wonderfully to her new life at boarding school, and has even developed a crush: The graceful school idol, Ran Iori. But under cover of night, a depraved nightly ritual goes on just outside the dorm… which Moe soon discovers, making it hard for her to see her friends or Ran the same way. If that weren’t enough, she discovers that the object of her affections is already taken. But none of that is going to stop Moe from following her heart! (Source: Irodori Comics)

title: TS☆Revolution
description: Part-goer Mikio meets a beauty on a nightly stroll and has some casual sex with her, but next morning he wakes up as a woman...

title: Sei Kaihou, Sorezore no Ai no Katachi
title_original: 性解放 それぞれの愛のカタチ
title_en: Sexual Liberation, The Shape of Each Love
description: At 27 years old, insurance broker Mio Sahara is the perfect age for marriage. Traumatized after a sexual encounter with a man, she's developed an intense phobia of being seen in a sexual light. One day, when she's put on a team of elite brokers, she meets a new boss who teaches her what it means to feel untameable passion. Emboldened by this encounter, Mio resolves to face her true sexual self that she had locked away in her heart, but it won't be easy... (Source: MangaPlaza)

title: Barrel
description: Eun-Oh Nam, a member of the corporate organization Jin Hong-pa, was a spy planted by the rival organization Deok-un-pa, and was working to steal items managed by Jin Hong-pa to secure funds and manipulate the ledger. Then, at the order of the boss of Jin Hong-pa, he was given the task of spying on his daughter Cheon Hee-Min. Eun-Oh is bewildered by the existence of Hee-Min, who is unknown to the outside world, but soon faithfully carries out the assigned task. In a wide, dry room with no human smell, the two develop a strange bond behind the firmly closed front door. However, their deepening feelings shake their reason, and the two eventually make an irreversible choice... (Source: Lezhin, translated) Notes: - The chapter count includes a prologue. - Part of Lezhin's Gwanggong Collection (광공단편선).

title: Gokujo. Gokurakuin Joshikou Ryou Monogatari
title_original: ゴクジョ。~極楽院女子高寮物語~
description: A story about the humorous misadventures of Akabane Aya, an arrogant high-school girl who's constantly trying to outdo her classmates in everything (especially sex appeal), only to make a fool of herself in the process. Since the story takes place in an all-girls school, expect lots of girls fanservice innuendos without much seriousness.

characters.name: Aya Akabane
characters.description: __Class__: 2-A __Height__: 158 cm She is a typical campus mean-girl with a flare for being fashionable, being popular, and doing what she wants. She has a short fuse and it is always her classmate Konatsu who gets to be on the receiving end of her tantrums, however she greatly fears her elder sister Saya and Kaname the school nurse whom are both feared bosozoku gang members. Even thought Aya fears Kaname, she would often loiter around her clinic, because Kaname is always not around. Only Minami can match her mean-girl attitude and it is suggested that the two may have some feelings for each other.

characters.name: Konatsu Toro
characters.description: __Class:__ 2-A __Height:__ 143 cm Aya's classmate who is always on the receiving end either by being pulled or dangle by her ponytail whenever Aya is in a bad mood or if any of the latter's schemes doesn't go as planned. Despite of it all she still admires her greatly, there is a running gag that she's easily attracted to cute little things such as puppies, kittens and butterflies.

characters.name: Ai Nanasato
characters.description: __Class:__ 2-A __Height:__ 164 cm She's one of Aya's friends along with Konatsu; she's sweet, calm and a levelheaded character; though she also admires Aya, she's very cautious in getting into her bad-side.

characters.name: Minami Kurihashi
characters.description: __Class:__ 2-B She was introduced in episode 8 as a returning transfer student from Los Angeles California. She has a habit of looking down on everyone of her classmates, often referring to each and everyone of them as "Potato Girl." She was selected by the teacher to be the class health officer and establishes her so called headquarters in Kaname's clinic much to Aya's chagrin. It is suggested that she may have some feelings for Aya, despite having engage her in some petty quarrel.

characters.name: Saya Akabane
characters.description: __Class:__ 3-D She's Aya's elder sister, who has a sweet and gentle outlook, but actually she's a sadistic and a feared delinquent who partners up with the equally sadistic bosozuko school nurse, Oku Kaname. There is a running gag where Saya cares more for Oku than her younger sister Aya, in fact both she and Oku would even pick on her, thus making Aya fearful whenever the two are around. It is also suggested that both she and Oku are in a relationship.

characters.name: Madoka Oowada
characters.description: __Class:__ 2-B __Height:__ 162 cm One of Aya's schoolmates, with a thing for yuri. She often suffers from a nosebleed whenever she is having sexual fantasies about Aya. She has big breasts (a G cup) which is why Aya calls her "Boob Monster."

characters.name: Asuka Utsunomiya
characters.description: __Class:__ 2-B (in chapter 6th, on her swimsuit is shown 2-A) __Height:__ 145 cm Another one of Aya's schoolmates, who is aloof, mysterious, and seldom smiles. She practices all forms of mysticism that ranges from fortune telling to black magic. It is suggested that she has feelings for Aya as well.

characters.name: Kaname Oku
characters.description: She is a school nurse in Gokurakuin Academy where Aya is studying , she also has a notorious reputation as a bosozoko top dog and infact she would be seen riding a Harley Davidson with Saya Akabane as her frequent passenger. The two form a fearsome duo who would always duke out with other bosozoko gangs and occasionally would roam the streets to cause mayhem, sometimes dragging Aya into their gigs. She also has a habit of barging into Aya's house to eat, since she and Aya's elder sister Saya are in a relationship, much to Aya's chagrin and just like Saya she is also feared by Aya whenever she's around.

Persona Karen Ch.1 (ペルソナかれん 第1話) by Kurogane Kenn 2. Poanto Ch.1 (ぽあんと 第1羽) by Nagatsuki Misoka 3. Noroi no Aoi-chan Ch.1 (呪いのあおいちゃん 1のろい) by Arata Iri 4. Practice Plus (プラクティス・プラス) by Higenamuchi 5. title: Kobayashi-san Chi no Maid Dragon Anthology
title_original: 小林さんちのメイドラゴン 公式アンソロジー
description: An official anthology of Miss Kobayashi's Dragon Maid.

characters.name: Kobayashi
characters.description: Kobayashi is a computer programmer and office worker. She finds herself living with a dragon named [Tohru](https://anilist.co/character/120970/Tohru). Even though Kobayashi maintains a cool demeanor, she has been regarded as kind-hearted and reliable among her friends and colleagues. Level-headed and pragmatic, she stands as the source of reason when dealing with her dragon friends. However, when intoxicated, she tends to become rowdy and aggressive, especially in her interests in maids, and is not above subjecting Tohru to her drunken whims. Before meeting Tohru, Kobayashi would don a stoic expression on her face. Now, she is more approachable and open to others, often seen smiling contentedly. Kobayashi often chastised Tohru for her lack of propriety on human standards. However, as time passes by, she grows accustomed to Tohru's quirks and would sometimes show small signs of affection

characters.name: Tohru
characters.description: __Faction__: Chaos __Relatives__: [Damocles](https://anilist.co/character/172721/Damocles) (father) Tohru is a female dragon with the ability to transform into a human girl. After [Kobayashi](https://anilist.co/character/120969/Kobayashi) rescues her, she falls in love with her and decides to work for her as a maid. As a Chaos Dragon, Tohru was raised to hate humans and was supposed to be a fierce and dangerous force of evil with nothing other than destruction in mind. However, this all changed when she met Kobayashi. She is now cheerful and kind to every human she meets, except for those who are real, or as it is in most cases, imaginary, threats to her love interest Kobayashi (such as [Makoto Takiya](https://anilist.co/character/120976/Makoto-Takiya)). She is also quickly influenced by what she sees on television or the internet and shares a fiery relationship with her rival, [Elma](ht

title_en: Éclair Blanche: A Girls' Love Anthology That Resonates in Your Heart

title: Cao Zong Wo Xin
description: It's been three years since she escaped from Ibella's control. She thought she could finally live a peaceful life, free from surveillance and manipulation. But her new life hasn't gone well at all. Her girlfriend cheated on her, work is stressful, and her parents are badgering her to get married. It's almost too much to bear, like she's just gone from one hell to another. And then Ibella reappeared in her life. Will she surrender her body and soul to become a plaything once again? (Source: Bilibili, translated)

title: Jeongnyeoni
description: Jeong-Nyeon has no money or education, but she is a Mokpo girl with a talent for singing! Her dream is to join a women's traditional theater company, and make it big. But she has a lot to learn and a long way to go before becoming a lead actor. Will Jeong-Nyeon achieve her dream of becoming a big star and getting rich? The story begins in 1956 (post-war Korea) in the southwestern port city of Mokpo.

title: Panty & Stocking with Garterbelt in Manga Strip
title_original: パンティ&ストッキング with Garterbelt
description: A Panty and Stocking manga drawn by director Hiroyuki Imaishi. Nearly drawn material appeared in the artbook Panty & Stocking with Garterbelt DATENCITY PAPARAZZI and was serialized in Animestyle.

characters.name: Panty Anarchy
characters.original: アナーキー・パンティ
characters.description: __Height:__ 164cm (5'4") Panty is Stocking's sister. She is an angel forced to kill evil spirits in order to earn her way back into Heaven. She is obsessed with sex and as such, spends a lot of her free time in love hotels with random men. She speaks with a traditional Tokyo dialect and bad girl's dialect. Her name is also the source of her power as she is able to transform her panties into a diamond handgun named Back Lace, that has amazingly destructive power against spirits but can't even bruise humans.

characters.name: Stocking Anarchy
characters.original: ストッキング・アナーキー
characters.description: __Height:__ 152 cm (4'11") The younger angel sister, banished to Earth along with her sister [Panty](https://anilist.co/character/32800/Panty-Anarchy). A goth girl with straight bangs and ultra-long hair. She fights by transforming her stockings into two katana-shaped heavenly weapons, Stripe I & II. Stocking enjoys eating various desserts and sugary food, but doesn't seem to gain weight. However, she acts quite enraged and sensitive whenever someone calls her fat. She is usually a level-headed and intelligent girl, though she can be rude if provoked, especially towards her older sister Panty.

characters.name: Garterbelt
characters.description: The priest of the Cemetery Hills Church on the outskirts of Daten City. He serves as the overseer of the angel sisters, but beneath his calm demeanor, he occasionally acts suspiciously and engages in dubious activities, making him a mysterious character. (Source: Official Site)

characters.name: Briefers Rock
characters.original: ブリーファス・ロック
characters.description: A self-proclaimed ghost hunter who has a crush on Panty. ~!His real name is Briefers Rock, and he happens to be quite handsome under his hair.!~

characters.name: Kneesocks Demon
characters.description: The younger of the Demon Sisters. She is completely inflexible and always acts according to the books. She is actually a little bit dorky and blushes easily, even if she has red skin. She is an intellectual that uses elaborate traps and trickery to fight against angel sisters Panty & Stocking. She is able to transform her knee socks into the demonic scythes Double Gold Spandex.

characters.name: Scanty Demon
characters.description: The older of the Demon Sisters. She places rules and etiquette above everything else. She is an extremely polite high-class lady, but she actually enjoys bringing pain and humiliation to others. She uses demonic artifacts to obstruct angel sisters Panty & Stocking. She is able to transform her scanties into the demonic guns Double Gold Lacytanga. (Source: Gainax Profile Page)

title: Akazukin ni Taberareta Ookami
title_original: 赤ずきんに食べられた狼
description: The Adorable, Adorable Wolf Was Eaten by Little Red Riding Hood...!? Luka, a wolf who only wanted to scare Little Red Riding Hood, somehow ended up having her words mistaken for a love confession—and was promptly ‘eaten’! But to make matters worse, Little Red Riding Hood is a true carnivore!? As Luka gets completely overwhelmed in this strange relationship, what will happen when the full moon rises...? A heartwarming and thrilling yuri fairy-tale comedy filled with romance and healing!

title: Reset!
description: The story is set in the same school as Yuru Yuri. Hiro is an ordinary first-year student who enjoys her quiet school life. One day, she picks up a drawing by Toshinou Kyoko which causes her classmate Aoi to mistake Hiro for the artist. Unable to clear up the misunderstanding, Hiro is persuaded to create a doujin game together with Aoi-chan. (Source: Anime News Network)

characters.name: Hiro Takaoka
characters.description: Chinatsu's classmate, who is an admirer Kyoko's doujin works

characters.name: Kumako Gondagawa
characters.description: She writes the scenario for Aoi and Hiro's doujin game. She doesn't like her name, so she goes by Kudryavka.

title: Kirakira
description: 1. Kirakira Saya is a huge fan of Ria, a model and a high school girl. One day, Saya feels something Ria-like from a girl she passed on the street. Mari, whom she met by coincidence, is Rias younger twin sister, but unlike Ria she has demure looks and a restrained atmosphere. Thinking it might get her closer to Ria, Saya tries to become friends with Mari, but she slowly finds herself attracted to the reserved but cute Mari. 2. Akogare no Itoshii Hito (憧れの愛しい人) 3. Utsutsu no Itoshii Hito (現の愛しい人) 4. Itoshii Hito (愛しい人) 5. Rinrin (リンリン)

title: Adachi to Shimamura Koushiki Comic Anthology
title_original: 安達としまむら 公式コミックアンソロジー
description: First official comic anthology for the much-discussed Adachi to Shimamura! Iruma Hitoma's popular novel series Adachi to Shimamura now in comic anthology form!

characters.name: Sakura Adachi
characters.description: Adachi Sakura is a high school student. She is found skipping class on the second floor of the gym by [Shimamura Hougetsu](https://anilist.co/character/144718/Hougetsu-Shimamura) one day. The two of them gradually became friends and began to spend a lot of time together. Adachi had an extremely introverted personality. Before meeting Shimamura, she never had someone whom she can call a friend. Adachi was said to be cold toward other people and didn't attempt to make friends with other people in the past. She also gets very jealous when Shimamura is together with her friends, and as a consequence usually ends up running away.

characters.name: Hougetsu Shimamura
characters.description: Shimamura Hougetsu is a high school student. She met [Adachi](https://anilist.co/character/144717/Sakura-Adachi) while skipping class on the second floor of the gym in her school when Adachi accidentally walks in on her one day. (In both manga adaptations, it was Shimamura who walked in on Adachi in the gym when they first met instead of the reverse.) The two instantly took a liking for each other and began to hang out together all the time. Shimamura has tail-bone length, dyed brown hair, which she keeps out of her face with two clips on the right side. Her eyes are also brown. Despite playing basketball in middle school, Shimamura is on the shorter side. She has a slim figure. Shimamura tends to think of interpersonal relationships as bothersome since she feels that it requires too much effort to maintain a balanced relationship. ~!During a summer break in their second year of high sch

characters.name: Akira Hino
characters.description: __Date of Birth:__ Unknown Akira Hino is a high school student and [Shimamura Hougetsu](https://anilist.co/character/144718/Hougetsu-Shimamura)'s friend. She is introduced in Chapter 2, where she is visiting a bookstore with [Shimamura Hougetsu](https://anilist.co/character/144718/Hougetsu-Shimamura) and [Nagafuji](https://anilist.co/character/167928/Taeko-Nagafuji). Hino has shoulder length hair, tied into low twintails. She is rather short, being shorter than Shimamura and Nagafuji. She also has big eyes. Hino has a bubbly personality and is known to add in sound effects, whether they're needed or not. She also enjoys fishing, though she often complains about not having any school fishing friends. (Source: Adachi and Shimamura Wiki)

characters.name: Taeko Nagafuji
characters.description: __Date of Birth:__ Unknown Taeko Nagafuji is a high school student and [Shimamura Hougetsu](https://anilist.co/character/144718/Hougetsu-Shimamura)'s friend. She is introduced in Chapter 2, along with [Hino Akira](https://anilist.co/character/167926/Akira-Hino), in a bookstore with [Shimamura](https://anilist.co/character/144718/Hougetsu-Shimamura). Nagafuji has straight, shoulder length hair and wears glasses. She has a very mature figure. Nagafuji is described as having a very laid back personality. Though she sometimes just seems to be out of it. (Source: Adachi and Shimamura Wiki)

title: Ochikobore Fruit Tart
title_original: おちこぼれフルーツタルト
description: Fourth dormitory of the Rat Production (commonly known as Nezumi-sou), the place were dropout idol girls live; the former child actor Sekino Roko, musician Nukui Hayu, and model Maehara Nina. Sakura Ino, who always dreamed of becoming an idol, moves in. At the same time the decision is made to demolish the dormitory. Due to the project launched by the manager Kajino Hoho, "Ochikobore Fruit Tart," occupants of the dormitory form a new idol group called "Fruit Tart," and start their activities in order to repay a one hundred million yen debt.

characters.name: Hemo Midori
characters.description: __Birth Place:__ Chiba, Japan __Height:__ 145 cm A third-year middle school student, Hemo was a former Cat Productions idol prospect, now signed on as a promising new addition to Rat Productions. She is intensely devoted to [Ino](https://anilist.co/character/164772/Sakura-Ino). Shy and soft-spoken, Hemo is a polite girl who looks up to the members of Rat Productions and is seemingly capable of performing her duties as a new idol. However, she also has a strong fixation on Ino and can be extremely defensive if anyone attempts to harm her, be it verbally or physically. In fact, her infatuation is so intense that she considers her morning ritual of helping Ino cook breakfast, and slowly taking in the same fresh morning air that Ino breathes, as a form of "lovemaking.

characters.name: Nina Maehara
characters.description: __Birth Place:__ Kanagawa, Japan __Height:__ 170 cm (Self-described) Nina is a member of Rat Production's idol group, Fruit Tart, and is in charge of costumes. Ever since she was a little girl, she had been a fashion model for western-style clothes. But now at age sixteen, Nina's height increased - and continues to increase - rapidly. This resulted in difficulty finding work as a model in Japan since such in-demand fashion clothes could barely fit her. She is sometimes the biggest draw of Fruit Tart, owing mostly to her physical appearance and not necessarily because of her singing or dancing. Somewhat the antithesis of [Roko](https://anilist.co/character/164773/Sekino-Roko), Nina is seen as timid and soft-spoken, and just as likely prone to tears whenever she is put on the spot. Like Roko, she is sensitive about her stature and had somehow developed a love for small things as a way to c

characters.name: Hayu Nukui
characters.description: __Height:__ 150 cm She is a a classmate of [Ino](https://anilist.co/character/164772/Sakura-Ino) at their high school. Coming from a wealthy family in Kanagawa, Hayu had decided to pursue becoming a musician against her father's wishes. As a result, she was forced to survive on her own at Nezumi House, and work as a talent for Rat Productions. Now a current member of Fruit Tart, Hayu helps write the group's song compositions along with Ino. While a terrible singer, Hayu is nevertheless passionate about working to become an idol. Charismatic and fun to be around, Hayu's tomboyish attitude perfectly matches her image as a rock musician. However, deep down she retains her feminine side, secretly reading comics for girls and holding on to her childhood dream of wanting to become a cute, blushing bride. Hayu's personality is thus a product of an overbearing mother and a father who had disowne

characters.name: Ino Sakura
characters.description: __Height:__ 155 cm She's a first-year in high school. One of her favorite things is cooking. She's not good at dieting. Raised in the countryside somewhere in Okayama, a prefecture some 350 miles west from Tokyo, Ino had always been surrounded by farm life. Like many children with humble upbringings, she had yearned to become someone big, and after watching Brocco perform on television, Ino knew she wanted to sing and dance just like her. Years passed, and when Ino turned fifteen, she finally made the move to Tokyo as a new idol for Rat Productions. Although far from being the stereotypical "girl from the sticks," Ino nevertheless holds a somewhat romanticized view of Tokyo, one where the scenery is filled with nothing but giant skyscrapers, and where high school girls flocking to karaoke parlors after school is the norm. Perhaps due to being raised in the laid-back environment of the co

characters.name: Roko Sekino
characters.description: __Height:__ 140 cm Roko is a second-year high school student and a former child actor who struggles to find work. She was once loved by many for her role in a popular series of broccoli commercials. Known by many TV viewers as "Brocco," Roko had joined Rat Productions after forcing herself out of the agency that kept pushing her to play the same character, which was already seven years passed its prime. After Fruit Tart was formed, Roko would eventually learn that she was in fact the group's leader. Roko has a younger sister named [Chiko](https://anilist.co/character/168416/Sekino-Chiko), who is a member of Cat Production's idol group, Cream Anmitsu. While her days of performing as a child actor are over, Roko has a tendency to still act rather childish and be brought to tears whenever something annoys her, such as the constant teasing from her sister, Chiko. She can be somewhat hostile

characters.name: Hoho Kajino
characters.description: __Height:__ 165 cm Hoho is a manager for Rat Productions and a totally unreliable adult. A twenty-five-year-old employee for the Rat Productions agency, Hoho is a manager who represents individuals wishing to make it big in the entertainment world. She is also the caretaker of a company dorm called Nezumi House, where her talents [Roko](https://anilist.co/character/164773/Sekino-Roko), [Hayu](https://anilist.co/character/164771/Nukui-Hayu), and [Nina](https://anilist.co/character/164770/Maehara-Nina) also live. However, because the three never found work while staying there, a decision was eventually made by the company to sell off the dorm. With even her own living situation at stake, Hoho quickly rounded up an idol prospect named [Ino](https://anilist.co/character/164772/Sakura-Ino) and brought her to Nezumi House. She would then reveal to the girls that they had to form a new idol gro

title: Sakimidareru wa Yuri no Hana
title_original: 咲き乱れるは百合の花
description: A (self-proclaimed) straight office lady around her thirties got into an intimate relationship with her high school aged niece. Note: Chapter count includes three volume-bonus chapters.

title: Jjaksarangeul Kkeunnaeneun Bangbeop
description: Kim Bok-Sil, is better known for having no success at love having gone with unrequited love for 20 years now. She's now on her 9th failure of unrequited love since graduating from high school. Bok-Sil, who vows that she will have a wonderful relationship when she becomes a college student, falls for her kind and handsome sunbae, Do-Yun. (Source: BOMTOON, translated)) Note: Includes 8 extra chapters.

title: Devil Drop
description: One day, Joan, a young and sexually frustrated jobseeker, wakes up from a highly erotic dream only to discover that the star of that dream, a she-devil, is lying on her living room floor. So what does she do? Ask her to be her roommate, of course! With Lakam, a civil servant from Hell, she gets to enjoy all the perks of having a beautiful and perfect roommate. Large breasts, a wonderful physique, she even helps with the chores! But Lakam seems a bit too perfect. Is this arrangement truly a match made in heaven…or the beginning of hell on Earth? (Source: Lezhin US)

title: Okujou Pikapika Romance
title_original: 屋上ぴかぴかロマンス
description: 1. Koigokoro Metronome A story about Kawai-san taking music classes to be together with the senpai she loves. The problem is that her life is made unbearable by the sullen and strict drummer Ichibashi-san. 2. Wagamama Fuzz to Pikapika-san 3. Double Bind 4. in secret...? 5. Koi-iro Etude After the incident where Kawai saw her senpai have feelings for another girl and broke down, Ishibashi has been unusually nice to her. Kawai decides to confront Ishibashi about it, to let her know that she doesn't have to force herself to make Kawai feel better.

title: Yume de Waratte
description: This is a cruel, gloomy, and bizarre story about a certain midsummer dream. "This feeling is unrequited that it made me suffered... So I kill that person." It was that kind of dream that Kanae had been witnessing... (Source: Manga Club)

title: Black Yagi to Gekiyaku Madeleine
title_original: ブラックヤギーと劇薬まどれーぬ
description: A collection of one shots. 1. Sotsugyou Kinshi 2. Black Yagi to Gekiyaku Madeleine 3. Sakashima Cinderella 4. Mayonaka Gravity (Midnight Gravity) 5. Yuugure, Orange, Saku Hana wa (Dusk, Orange, the Blooming Flowers) 6. Gekiyaku Madeleine to Black Yagi

title: Houseki-iro no Koi
title_original: 宝石色の恋 西UKO作品集
description: 1. Roulette 2. Mio Post 3. Parfum 4. P.V. 5. Mannequin 6. 777 7. Baby You 8. Demande 9. Au (To Meet) 10. Topaze 11. Nijuu-bun no Mugen (20 Over Infinite / 20/∞) 12. Hi no Jouzan (Multiplying Lights) 13. .925 (925permil) 14. Koi-Onna 15. Up & Down 16. Helter-skelter 17. The OL Café

title: Itsuka Minoreba
description: Minoru's parents want to move to Las Vegas so her father can have a last shot at his fighting career. Minoru has recently started at high school and doesn't really feel like leaving Japan, although she doesn't have much reason to stay either. While feeling down about the choice, she follows a girl from her school into an arcade out of curiosity. Minoru ends up playing against the girl at a fighting game. The girl introduces herself as Shijou and explains that she's aiming to become a pro-gamer. Shijou recognizes that Minoru has talent and invites her to team up with her. (Source: Batoto)

title: Bittersweet Con Panna
description: Graduate student Song-Ah thinks her girlfriend Yoo-Sung is the cutest girl in the world. It doesn't matter if she's actually more sophisticated than adorable; Yoo-Sung is number one in her heart! So how is she supposed to react when some hot childhood friend suddenly enters the mix?! (Source: Manta) Note: Includes 19 extra chapters.

title: Out Bride: Ikei Konin
title_original: アウトブライド-異系婚姻-
description: In this reverse harem isekai romance, a young woman named Mashiro is reborn in a fantasy world inhabited only by men–and suddenly finds herself with four supernatural suitors! These handsome men with fur, feathers, and horns call themselves gods. She’s now the sole human female in their world, so they all want her to bear their children. As if that’s not enough, the air of this new realm is permeated with a poison that only a god can suppress…with a kiss. (Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

characters.name: Mashiro
characters.description: The protagonist of the story

title: Knife Edge Girl
description: 1. Knife Edge Girl 2. Graffiti Two women who use the same desk at different times of the day communicate in drawings on the desk top. When they finally meet in real life—purely by accident—the attraction is instant on Kana's side...and maybe not on Rise's. Or maybe, it is. 3. Tourteau Fromage (トゥルトフロマージュ) In "Torte Fromage" Miwa's boring OL life is suddenly thrown into glamour and excitement when she meets avant garde actress Nakae-san. 4. No Title

title: Hajirai Break
description: 1. No Kon ♥ (のーこん♥) (No Control ♥); Comic Kairakuten 2010-03 Ayase Makoto is having trouble getting a job despite her special ability–being able to control anyone at her own will. 2. Hajirai Break (はじらいブレイク); Comic Kairakuten 2010-07 A guy tries to awaken a certain side of his extremely shy girlfriend. 3-4. Home Mate (ホームメイト); Comic Kairakuten 2011-04, 2011-05 5. Kouenji Natsume no Jikenbo (高円寺棗の事件簿) (Natsume’s Exciting Day and Night); Comic Kairakuten 2010-11 + kakioroshi Busty Detective Kouenji Natsume has been tasked to investigate a man who her client suspects to have been cheating on her. Messing up on this case means Natsume is done for. However, getting good results will get her promoted to full-time. Will she get the job done right? 6. Bird Cage (バードケージ); Comic Kairakuten 2011-02 + kakioroshi 7. Bathtub Crisis ; Comic Kairakuten 2010-05 Junpei is taking a bath when his is unintentionally intruded by his girlfriend's younger sister, Shiori. He notices that she's all grown up now. To make matters worse, Junpei's girlfriend returns. A sudden crisis occurs in the bathtub. 8. Fake! ; Comic Kairakuten 2010-02 9. Pay by Love ; Comic Kairakuten 2009-09 If ever you are offered

title: Heimin no Watashi desu ga Koushaku Reijou-sama wo Taburakashite Ikiteimasu
title_original: 平民の私ですが公爵令嬢様をたぶらかして生きています
description: Lilah, a commoner, is kicked out of the house where she grew up and finds herself on the street. But somehow Eva, the duchess, takes a liking to her and she ends up becoming her bodyguard. A fantasy of a commoner's rise to power against the aristocracy begins! (Source: Cmoa , machine translated)

title: Saki: Achiga-hen - episode of side-A
title_original: 咲-Saki- 阿知賀編 episode of side-A
description: The Achiga Girls' Academy in Nara once defeated regional mahjong powerhouse Bansei High School. It advanced into the national team semifinals but lost to the eventual champion, and the mahjong club was later disbanded. Six years later, elementary school student Shizuno Takakamo befriends transfer student Nodoka Haramura. The two eventually enter Achiga Girls', but Nodoka transfers out of the school in the second year. When Shizuno sees Nodoka on television the following year as the national middle school individual mahjong champion, she decides to revive Achiga's mahjong club.

characters.name: Shizuno Takakamo
characters.description: Shizuno Takakamo is a first-year high school student at Achiga Girls' Academy in Nara Prefecture and the main protagonist of the spin-off manga "Saki Achiga-hen episode of side-A". In her elementary school days, she befriended [Nodoka Haramura](https://anilist.co/character/17275/Haramura-Nodoka) and together played mahjong in Achiga's mahjong club. She was the club's second best player before it was disbanded. Upon seeing Nodoka on television as the middle school individual champion, she decides to re-establish the club upon entering high school. Her goal is to go to the national high school team tournament and play against Nodoka. ~!Her special ability allows Shizuno to block other players abilities. The more tiles is taken from the corner of the wall, the stronger her ability is. Literary "the deeper players go in the mountains, the closer they to her territory". That's why she was cal

characters.name: Kuro Matsumi
characters.description: Kuro Matsumi is a second-year high school student at Achiga Girls' Academy in Nara Prefecture and is a protagonist in the spin-off manga "Saki Achiga-hen episode of side-A". Before the club was disbanded, Kuro was its number one player. She kept the room clean in hopes that someone would eventually return to the club. She is the younger sister of Yuu Matsumi. ~!Kuro's abilities are briefly commented on. During a match with Nodoka Haramura, Ako states that it was never possible to her to get any dora because they all gather toward Kuro. Because of this she has earned the nickname The Dragon Lord. The downside to this is that she can't discard any dora. If she does, Kuro will not be able to get a single dora for several games.!~

characters.name: Ako Atarashi
characters.description: Ako Atarashi is a first-year high school student at Achiga Girls' Academy in Nara Prefecture and a protagonist in the spin-off manga "Saki Achiga-hen episode of side-A". She is an elementary school friend of Shizuno Takakamo and Nodoka Haramura. She was the third best player in Achiga's mahjong club as an elementary school student. When the club disbanded, she attended a different middle school in order to continue playing and intended on entering mahjong powerhouse Bansei High School. When Shizuno re-established the club, she decided to return to the school. ~! Ako likes to play fast and has a good sense for the flow of the game. Ako is the most skilled player on the Achiga team but is overlooked because of the upperclassmen's special abilites. !~

characters.name: Arata Sagimori
characters.description: Arata Sagimori is a second-year high school student at Achiga Girls' Academy in Nara Prefecture and a protagonist of the spin-off manga "Saki: Achiga-hen episode of side-A". She is a childhood friend of Kuro and Yuu Matsumi; her family owns a bowling alley in the area. As a kindergartener, she grew up playing mahjong with adults at the Matsumi inn but stopped playing after her first year of elementary school. She is an admirer of Harue Akado and thus lost interest in the game after Harue stopped playing following Achiga's loss in the national tournament. When Kuro informs her that Harue has begun playing mahjong again, Arata agrees to join Achiga's mahjong club. She was assigned on the position of Achiga mahjong club president by Harue as most level-headed member of the team.

characters.name: Yuu Matsumi
characters.description: Yuu Matsumi is a third-year high school student at Achiga Girls' Academy in Nara Prefecture and a protagonist in the spin-off manga "Saki Achiga-hen episode of side-A". She is Kuro Matsumi's older sister. When she was younger, she wanted to join others in Achiga's mahjong club but felt it would be awkward because she was older. Yuu is very sensitive to the cold and covers herself head to toe when she goes anywhere, even in the summer. ~! Yuu's ability is that she can draw alot of manzu and chun tiles, so her hand is manly composed of these tiles. She also draws these tiles because she feels warmer drawing in warm tiles. As a result, her tile possession distribution is generally skewed toward the character tiles. When that playing style fails, Yuu draws in all red tiles and becomes difficult to defend against. According to Kuro, Yuu is just as good as she is at mahjong. According to Toki

characters.name: Harue Akado
characters.description: Harue Akado is the mahjong club coach at her alma mater Achiga Girls' Academy in Nara Prefecture and is a protagonist in the spin-off manga "Saki Achiga-hen episode of side-A". Harue was once known as the "Legend of Achiga" for taking the school to the national high school team mahjong tournament. After the team's defeat, she lost confidence and stopped playing mahjong for some time, leading to the team's eventual disbandment. She was later scouted by a professional team but returns home several years later when the company decides break the team up. ~!Harue's defeat in the national semifinal came at the hand of Sukoya Kokaji, who would eventually become a professional player and commentator in subsequent national high school tournaments in the main "Saki" manga.!~

characters.name: Saki Miyanaga
characters.description: __Height:__ 155 cm (5'1") __Position:__ Captain Saki Miyanaga is a first-year student at Kiyosumi High School in Nagano Prefecture and the title character of the manga "Saki". She grew up playing mahjong with members of her family but came to dislike the game because she would lose her _otoshidama_ (New Year's money) if she lost and be scolded if she won. Because of this Saki, developed the ability to end her games with a net score of ±0 in order to avoid winning and losing against them. Over the years, this playing style became a subconscious habit, and she no longer attempts to win a mahjong match. After her parents separated, Saki remained with her father in Nagano while her older sister Teru moved to Tokyo with her mother. She eventually lost touch with her sister but is aware that Teru has become a top mahjong player in her high school. Upon entering Kiyosumi, Saki is invited by her

characters.name: Nodoka Haramura
characters.description: __Height:__ 154 cm (5'1") __Position:__ Vice captain Nodoka Haramura is a first-year student at Kiyosumi High School in Nagano Prefecture and a protagonist in the manga "Saki". She is also a supporting character in the spin-off manga "Saki: Achiga-hen episode of side-A". She has played online mahjong since a young girl and develops a eventually passion for it. Her father, who works as an attorney, disapproves of Nodoka's interest but does not prohibit it. Because of her mother's work assignment, her family usually moves to a different city every two to three years. Note: Their gender is swapped in [Saki re: King's Tile Draw](https://anilist.co/manga/116824/Saki-re-Kings-Tile-Draw/) and are named 原邑和加 instead

characters.name: Yuuki Kataoka
characters.description: __Position:__ Vanguard Yuuki is a high school first-year student who attends the same school as Saki and is a member of the mahjong club. She is highly skilled, though cannot stay focused and makes more mistakes as the game progresses, so she is made the first to play at the mahjong tournament. She is often seen eating tacos, which increases her skill when playing mahjong. Additionally, food with names similar to tacos, like takoyaki can increase her skill partially as well. Note: Their gender is swapped in [Saki re: King's Tile Draw](https://anilist.co/manga/116824/Saki-re-Kings-Tile-Draw/) and are named 片丘優季 instead

characters.name: Hisa Takei
characters.description: __Position:__ Lieutenant A third year student and the president of the Kiyosumi Mahjong Club. She is also the president of the Student Congress Coucil at Kiyosumi High School, heavily emphasizing the "Congress" part of the name. A very intelligent and confident girl, she is able to effectively read the weaknesses and strengths of people, inside and outside of Mahjong, and apparently is a seasoned veteran of Mahjong, even to the point of being on friendly terms with a Professional Mahjong player. She is also able to comprehend concepts quicker than most, ~!the most prominent example being that she mostly, if not fully, understood what was going on behind Touka's misplays against Momoko in the finals sooner than most of her fellow players.!~ Her playstyle revolves around taking chances; while risky, she takes her time, waiting for effective hands that often come out of nowhere, surprising

characters.name: Mako Someya
characters.description: __Position:__ Sergeant A second year student and member of the Kiyosumi Mahjong Club, being the first member to join under Takei Hisa's leadership. Her family runs a mahjong cafe, which was former mahjong parlor. Being surrounded by Mahjong ever since she was young, Mako is familiar with many scenarios during the course of a game and is able to recall them during gameplay when taking off her glasses. Note: Their gender is swapped in [Saki re: King's Tile Draw](https://anilist.co/manga/116824/Saki-re-Kings-Tile-Draw/) and are named 染屋真工 instead

characters.name: Mihoko Fukuji
characters.description: A third year student serving as the Captain of the Kazekoshi Mahjong Club as well as being the team's ace player. She has a very kind nature, being nice to everyone she meets regardless of who they may be; her kindness extends even to the point where she offers Yuuki, an opposing player from the contending school team, Kiyosumi, her bento so that she would calm down. She even becomes very teary when her teammates help her out, as she feels that it was her fault that her teammates had to work in her place because it was her responsibility. She has been revealed to be very ineffective when working with technology. ~!She keeps her right eye closed to hide her heterochromia from others; while her left eye is reddish-gold, her right eye is actually sapphire blue. She never opens her right eye unless confronted with a dire situation during a Mahjong game. With both eyes open, she is shown to a

characters.name: Koromo Amae
characters.description: Premier member of the reigning champion Mahjong team, Ryuumonbuchi, and one of the most idolized yet feared players in the game. She is said to be possessed by a demon when playing; she even outranked a professional Mahjong player at a previous tournament. She is also the key player that brings an end to Kazekoshi's winning streak. She has a bad habit of wanting to crush her opponent's pride. ~!Her mahjong playing style pressures her opponents and her abilities can prevent them from reaching tenpai. This, together with the mahjong move she favors most, Haitei Raoyue or "last tile win" is a combination that slowly drives her opponents into despair. Haitei Raoyue's literal meaning is "to scoop up the moon from the seabed." Her abilities include being able sense when her opponents are in tenpai and the approximate value of their hands. She usually goes for big hands.!~ She is Touka's cousin

characters.name: Jun Inoue
characters.description: One of Ryuumonbuchi's four heavenly kings. Plays the game by reading the flow and manipulating it. Note: Their gender is swapped in [Saki re: King's Tile Draw](https://anilist.co/manga/116824/Saki-re-Kings-Tile-Draw/) and are named 井丿上惇 instead

characters.name: Tomoki Sawamura
characters.description: One of Ryuumonbuchi's four heavenly kings. Note: Their gender is swapped in [Saki re: King's Tile Draw](https://anilist.co/manga/116824/Saki-re-Kings-Tile-Draw/) and are named 澤村智貴 instead

title: JUNK LAND
description: 1) Omae to Atashi no Escape (オマエとアタシのエスケプ); kakioroshi 2) Omae ni wa Atashi ga Oniai da♥ (オマエにはアタシがお似合いだ♥); Comic Megastore H 2012-01 3) Finder-goshi no Kimi (ファインダー越しのキミ, You Behind the Viewfinder); 2011-09 4) Benkyou suru yori Baka ni Naru (勉強するよりバカになる); 2011-05 5) SEXYSTREAM ; 2011-01 6) Shikaeshi Kids (しかえしキッズ); 2011-11 7) Bishoujo Tantei Chouraku no Kiki (美少女探偵凋落の危機); 2011-07 8) Kochira koso Yoroshiku (こちらこそよろしく); 2011-03 9) Shiryou ja Shikata nai ne? (資料じゃ仕方ないね？, For the Data, Okay?); 2010-11 10) Meitei☆Free Time (酩酊☆フリータイム); kakioroshi

title: Ano Ko ni Yasashii Sekai ga Ii
title_original: あの子に優しい世界がいい
description: 1. An no Niwa 2. Futari de Akete 3. Kanojo no Hahen 4. Ame 5. After the Fuschia

title: Serenade
description: A professor living a successful life with a secret. Two students who each have a hold on their mentor: one who knows her secret and another who reminds her of her first love... A romantic thriller that will leave you hanging for more. (Source: Lezhin) Note: Includes 1 extra chapter.

title: Touko-san wa Kaji ga Dekinai.
title_original: 塔子さんは家事ができない。
description: When Akari is sent to live with her mom's old friend, she's surprised to find that the hard-working Touko-san she's heard so much about is actually a reckless adult with no knowledge of housekeeping whatsoever! What's to become of Akari now that she's a highschooler with the world's most unreliable roommate?

title: Iono-sama Fanatics
title_original: いおの様ファナティクス
description: There's one small kingdom ruled by a Queen Iono, who has a rather peculiar ambition: to establish a harem with 1000 pretty GIRLS from around the world. Now, the Queen has arrived Japan, looking for girls with beautiful black hair. (Source: Anime News Network)

characters.name: Iono Archeline
characters.description: The queen of a small unknown European country. She likes cute girls and has surrounded herself with a harem of sobame. She travels to Japan in search of black-haired girls to add to her harem.

characters.name: Seriho Inukai
characters.description: Inukai Seriho is a 25-year-old lady who is owner of the Amber Teahouse, a small tea shop she opened in Tokyo after winning a lottery. Although skilled in creating tea, she has trouble managing her shop, shown when she forgets to take down the "Closed" sign on the building. She takes on one of her regulars, Sarasa Kotoori, to work with her in the shop, and slowly begins falling for the younger girl. Has a short cameo appearance in chapter 2 of Kotonoha no Miko to Kotodama no Mahou to. Also appears in chapter 1 of Iono-sama Fanatics when Eto and Iono meet at the Amber Teahouse.

title: Kimi no Kaori
description: When a girl passes by her classmate in a corridor, she notices a sweet fragrance she's never smelled before. She asks the other girl about her shampoo but still can't find the scent's origin. Just where did it come from?

title: Koi no Kaori
description: Collection of one shots: 1. Tsuushin Omachishite Orimasu (I Await Your Reply) 2. Ki ni Nacchatte Gomen Nasai (Sorry I'm Obsessed) 3. Sweet Temptation 4. Sweet Desire 5. love*aroma 6. love*preparation 7. love*aroma:2 Note: love*aroma and love*preparation continue in the steps collection.

title: Tae-chan to Jimiko-san
title_original: たえちゃんとじみこさん
description: In the second volume is included the one-shot "Okaasan Yubi" (おかあさんゆび), previously published in the yuri anthology "My Sweet Home"

title: Chijeong
description: The royal palace is no place for fun and games—here, only the most cunning and powerful survive. After Soon-ock becomes queen consort thanks to the machinations of her scheming father and his allies, she finds herself in the middle of a bloody fight between the king and the crown prince.
