characters.description: **Height:** 166 cm (5'5") She got her hair styled like [Shiina Ringo](https://anilist.co/staff/103213) in order to fuel her creative process. Likes the fine arts and literature, but also enjoys more niche, sub-cultural hobbies.

characters.name: Tamaki Shishio
characters.description: A first-year who came to the band club's welcome party, she kind of resembles Shiho

characters.name: Saeko Sawatari
characters.description: Whether concerts or theme parks, she just like things that stimulate her. She dresses like she doesn't really care. Despite that, women love her.

title: Oogami-san to Keru Bero Suu!
title_original: 大上さんとケルベロスゥ!
description: The shy dog-girl Suu wants to confess love for the beautiful but aloof Oogami, and her sisters Keru and Bero will do anything to help! A fluffy romance between a lone-wolf human girl and an identical triplet of dog-ear girls with different personalities.

title: Sweet Lovin' Baby
title_original: スウィート・ラヴィン・ベイビー
description: 1. Sweet Lovin' Baby (スウィート・ラヴィン・ベイビー) 2. Ame ga Futteita (雨が降っていた, Rain Was Falling) 3. Koi ni Naranai (恋にならない, Doomed Love) 4. Miyuki (美雪) 5. Konya Aeru (今夜逢える) 6. Mata Aeta (また逢えた) 7. Juzutsunagi (じゅずつなぎ) 8. Iwarenakutemo Koishiteru (言われなくても恋してる) 9. Boku no Chisai Luna (僕の小さいルナ)

title: Jue Bu He Huli Zuo Pengyou de Tuzi
title_original: 绝不和狐狸做朋友的兔子
description: One is a rabbit girl with a congenital defect, and the other is a fox girl that's super popular but has a lonely heart. Despite their differences, they are each other's precious 'The Other Me in This World'. When they meet, a story of mutual healing and mutual growth begins... (Source: Kuaikan, translated)

title: Oshi ga Imouto ni Narimashite
title_original: 推しが妹になりまして。
description: Kazuka Kojima is a pretty and popular high school girl secretly obsessed with the idol "Kane-chan". When her parent remarried, she found out her new step-sister Akane is the "everyone's sister" - the "Kane-chan" of her dreams! Hyper yuri love comedy begins! (Source: Comic Boost, translated)

title: Danzaisha: Tetragrammaton Labyrinth
description: When darkness falls on the foggy streets of London, demons and monsters emerge to prey on human life. But demons aren't the only ones prowling the streets. Two women have picked up the fight as humanity’s front line defense against the darkness—a young gun-toting nun named Sister Meg and her mysterious, eternally youthful partner Angela. Together, they have made it their life’s work to spend their nights hunting the vile demons that stalk mankind. (Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

characters.name: Margaret Cross
characters.description: Meg is a demon hunter and a nun. She tends to use a variety of firearms when in combat, and has access to ammunition specifically designed to inflict immense damage and pain to demons. She cannot physically exist without her partner Angela.

characters.name: Angela
characters.description: Angela is a demon hunter. Little is known about her origins, age or real name. She fights using a scythe known as 'The Scythe of Agla', which is a special weapon designed to destroy demons. She is also skilled in other forms of melee weaponry.

characters.name: Hisame
characters.description: Hisame, a Japanese priestess, first appears in the later chapters of the first volume, when she is searching for a cursed sword fallen into the hands of Westerners. She fights Meg and Angela for it, all the while using some sort of giant demonic hand that reaches out from another dimension, and eventually leaves with it, saying, "Out of all the places for a demon to reside...a church?" (Referring to Angela) She's later revealed to be a part of Meg and Angela's organization and assists them in the fights against Gilles de Rais.

title: Yeying Yu Meigui
description: One day, the game streamer Bai Xinxin transmigrated into the role of the princess Bai Yueguang in the mystery game "Nightingale and the Rose". But all the characters in this game were out to kill her, and only Lan Sha, the player character, could protect her. Amongst all the jealous yanderes and murderous rivals, Bai Yueguang has to use all her wits to fight off enemies known and unknown, while finding a way to survive with Lan Sha by her side. However, this main character "Lan Sha" also seems a bit...?! (Source: Bilibili, translated)

title: Kimiiro Shoujo
description: 1. Kore wa, Nisemono (これは、にせもの) 2. Suki no Kyori (好きの距離) 3. Ichinichi Hakushi (一日白紙) Mizuki is secretly in love with her best friend Honoka, but thinks Honoka is uninterested in love. 4. Kuchibiru ni Himitsu wo (唇に秘密を) Mizuki is secretly in love with her best friend Honoka, but thinks Honoka is uninterested in love. 5. Kono Machi ni Ningyo wa Inai (この街に人魚はいない) Yoshizaki Erina just transfered into town and is generally avoided by her classmates because of her taciturn nature until Toyoda tries to approach the girl. 6. Kore wa, Sotsugyou Kinen (これは、卒業記念) (Source: Yuri Project)

title: Koiiro no Kyoukai
description: Based on characters from the Touhou Project series. A new serialization has begun for a story brimming with emotion and lingering impressions that offers a glimpse into the casual interactions of fantasy girls. (Source: Kadokawa, translated)

characters.name: Reimu Hakurei
characters.description: She is the miko of the Hakurei Shrine, a remote building far in the east where the boundaries of Gensōkyō and the human world overlap. It is believed that she is the 13th of her line. Reimu is very easygoing — some would say lazy — and hates to train. As such, even though she's naturally talented, her offensive and magical abilities are only average. However, she has a strong sense of duty, and if it's for the sake of Gensokyo she can overcome almost any obstacle through sheer perseverance. Her main abilities are flying in the sky, good intuition, and getting along with everyone; even those who were once her enemies. In the games, she is characterized by her homing amulets and yin-yang orbs.

characters.name: Marisa Kirisame
characters.description: Marisa is a human witch who lives in a cluttered house in the Forest of Magic. She is friends with Reimu and visits her often, but otherwise is solitary and spends most of her time researching magic. She is also an avid collector stuffing her house with various items, and would go "borrowing" things from others without returning them. She is selfish, sometimes violent, and has a disagreeable manner. Underneath, though, she is honest and a hard worker. This makes it strange that she is friends with Reimu, whose powers are purely from talent while she had to work very hard to get her own to the same level. Her ability is high-level destructive magic.

characters.name: Remilia Scarlet
characters.original: レミリア・スカーレット
characters.description: __Species:__ Vampire __Abilities:__ Manipulation of fate __Occupation:__ Mistress of the Scarlet Devil Mansion __Location:__ Scarlet Devil Mansion Remilia is the owner and head of the Scarlet Devil Mansion, the mistress of [Sakuya](https://anilist.co/character/5570/Izayoi-Sakuya) and Meiling, friend of Patchouli, and the older sister/guardian of Flandre. Though her appearance (and often behavior) is childlike and seems nonthreatening, she has fearsome magical powers and a reputation to match, being known throughout Gensokyo as the dangerous "Scarlet Devil." Like all vampires she is photosensitive and weakens when exposed to sunlight, so she typically remains inside her mansion (which has few windows to prevent light getting in) during the day and emerges during the night. While she is naturally known to drink human blood, her light appetite means her victims almost never die from their w

characters.name: Kaguya Houraisan
characters.description: Kaguya was once the princess of the Lunarians, a race of people living on the Moon. She was exiled to Earth over a thousand years ago for the crime of using the forbidden Hourai Elixir to make herself immortal. Arriving on Earth in what is today central Japan, she was found by a bamboo cutter and dwelt among the humans she had once despised. Though the Lunarians looked upon humans with contempt, Kaguya came to love her new home. Her unearthly beauty led men from all across Japan to seek her hand in marriage, but none could successfully complete her trial of the Five Impossible Requests. After years of exile, emissaries arrived from the Moon; Kaguya had been forgiven of her crime and it had been decided that she should return. Kaguya, however, had grown to love life on Earth and had no desire to return to the lunar capital. Enlisting the help of her friend Eirin, Kaguya escaped from the e

characters.name: Fujiwara no Mokou
characters.description: __Species:__ Human __Abilities:__ Eternal youth and immortality, resistance to and manipulation of fire __Occupation:__ Rescues lost people, Bamboo forest guide, Claims to run a yakitori stand __Location:__ Somewhere in the Bamboo Forest of the Lost Formerly an ordinary human, Mokou became an immortal being after drinking the Hourai Elixir about 1300 years ago. Now she is never able to die, though she still feels the pain of injuries as normal. She's considered to be very powerful because she has lived for many years and earned that power, and because she doesn't die and can therefore keep fighting until she can no longer stand the pain. She has hated Kaguya ever since the moon princess humiliated Mokou's father by turning down his marriage proposal after he failed her trial of the Impossible Requests. Though the slight happened over a thousand years ago, she continues to detest Kaguya,

characters.name: Flandre Scarlet
characters.original: フランドール・スカーレット
characters.description: Flandre is the younger sister of Remilia and the "dirty little secret" of Scarlet Devil Mansion. Because of her unstable personality and incredible destructive power, her sister has ordered her not to leave the mansion for nearly 500 years. She really respects her older sister Remilia, but her raw destructive power far exceeds that of her sister's. Although she is usually docile, her insanity makes it difficult for others to understand her.When vampires attack humans, they generally try to take their prey alive in order to suck its blood afterward, but Flandre has always been fed with cooked dishes, and thus doesn't know how to properly attack a human. Whenever she tries to attack a human, she loses control of herself and blows them away without leaving a spot of blood. Her apparent age is about the same as Remilia Scarlet (who looks to be around 10, even though Remilia is 5 years older

characters.name: Sakuya Izayoi
characters.description: Sakuya is the only human living in the Scarlet Devil Mansion, yet she is also the head maid. The official fanbook suggests she had been a vampire hunter before she began working in the mansion, but she was defeated by Remilia Scarlet who pitied her and gave Sakuya her current name. Though she looks about sixteen like the other girls, Sakuya has the ability to slow, stop and possibly reverse time. She seems to have been serving Remilia for a long time and may be far older then she looks. Socially, she interacts mainly with the others in the Scarlet Devil Mansion. Her talents are cooking, knife throwing and time manipulation. The latter two abilities characterize her appearances in-game, and led to frequent parodies in reference to Dio Brando of JoJo's Bizarre Adventure, who also controls time and throws knives. This reference goes so far as Sakuya using some of his poses in a game. She is

title: Geunyeomanui Mannequin
description: A walking, talking mannequin. Is this an opportunity to use, or an opportunity to be used? Bo-Ra simply wants a chance to get close to the fashion designer, Hong-Rin Da. Yet it would seem that Hong-Rin wants something more from Bo-Ra. Will Bo-Ra’s struggles to become a fashion designer pull at Hong-Rin’s heartstrings? If she even has any to begin with... (Source: WEBTOONS)

title: Renai Kinshi Gakuen
description: At a prestigious school where love is banned, an ordinary boy discovers the student council President's secret.

title: Zhima Yu Mi Gao
description: Sesame saves Rice Cake in the park, and they part ways. Rice Cake saves Sesame in the park, and this time, they become friends after Rice Cake's owner takes in Sesame. They become friends, but will that friendship progress to something more? Oh, and they're cats.

title: Copy Room Yuugi
description: Aoi’s stuck working overtime, and her senior Maika decides to make things more interesting with some risqué misuse of office equipment. (Source: Irodori Comics)

title: Zanki x 99
description: Out of nowhere, 99 girls were sent to a large room, where they are inadvertently transferred to the other side of the screen. There, strange creatures live, which begin to hunt the girls who cross the monitor.

title: Futanari Shufu no Onaho
title_original: ふたなり主婦のオナホ
description: Asako and Yuko are futanari wives who think about sex 24/7. Luckily for them, they might have found a new fuck toy who can keep up with the two of them! (Source: Irodori Comics)

title: SM Yuri Ecchi Anthology
title_original: SM百合えっちアンソロジー
description: 1. Matenai Kanojo no Shitsukekata (待てない彼女の躾け方) [Kuro Itsuki] 2. Akai Ribbon de Gyu (赤いリボンでぎゅっ) [Hiyori Mitsumoto] 3. Jirashi Jirasare (じらしじらされ) [Fuki Hinohara] 4. Maid to Ojou-sama no Himitsu no Lesson (メイドとお嬢様の秘密のレッスン) [Mori] 5. Zutto Miteru ne (ずっと見てるね) [Teishoku Yakiniku] 6. Sunao ni Narenai Futari no Yoru (素直になれない二人の夜) [Arashi Hino] 7. Sarakedashita Numa no Soko de (さらけ出した沼の底で) [Chiri Yuino] 8. Kagamiawase (カガミアワセ) [Subaru Homura] 9. Naisho no Oshioki (ナイショのオシオキ) [sorani]

title: Kaichou to Fukukaichou
description: The student council president is gaga over the vice president, but her feelings may or may not be returned. In the meantime, it's up to the serious and by-the-book vice president to keep the flaky (but surprisingly effective) president on track. Published in Comic Yuri Hime S. Chapter 2 was published as “人を寄せる人,” chapter 3 as “会長と副会長 雨の日晴れの日,” and chapter 4 as “会長と副会長 白昼夢.”

title: Tonari no Kanata
description: Collection of short stories. 1. Nostradamus to Sakaki-kun A girl meets a boy who can see the future—what will happen? 2. Himitsu Mittsu The tumultuous friendship between three girls who were seated next to each other on the first day of middle school. 3. Tonari no Kanata Aya loves her childhood friend, Ryouta, but she's not sure how to keep him with her. 4. Keep a Diary A pair of best friends share a diary until one of them starts to get obsessed with the other... but is that really what happened?

title: Kamitsuki Gakuen
description: The story is Shizuka’s awakening to life as a vampire, while she befriends classmates and fellow Epicureans, and tries to befriend Ichi-gou. Shizuka, on account of never feeding directly from a person is runty, and her bat wings are little, but with help she learns to find the idea of sucking Ichi-gou’s blood alluring. (Source: Okazu)

title: Hana no Asuka-gumi!
description: The story of Kuraku Asuka, a tough junior high student who gets involved with the gang scene in the Kabuki Chou Ichibangai, a rough area of Tokyo.

title: Michiwarikusa Monogatari
description: Lovely days of vampires in a post-apocalyptic world exempt from humans.

title: Lu Ming Yan
description: Inside the luxurious pavilion, human desires flow like water, and morals are extinguished like ashes. The courtesan Qin You receives a lady visitor, who offers her a large sum to buy her freedom. She claims that she can see the future, and she asks Qin You to come with her to help save the world. (Source: Tencent, translated)

title: VTuber nanda ga Haishin Kiri Wasuretara Densetsu ni Natteta
title_original: VTuberなんだが配信切り忘れたら伝説になってた
description: Twenty-year-old former wage slave Yuki Tanaka now works among her idols: the streamers of Live-On, one of Japan’s top VTuber companies. As the gorgeous, polite Awayuki Kokorone, she delivers only the most ladylike content. Unfortunately, her subscriber count and savings are at rock bottom. One evening, after Yuki thinks she’s ended her stream, she cracks a few cold ones—and more than a few crude jokes—while watching Live-On’s video archives. But her viewers hear it all, and clips of her bawdy, drunken commentary go viral overnight. Yuki thinks her career is over...until her manager reveals that everyone at Live-On has been waiting for her to snap all along and gives her free rein to drink on-stream. Now free of all feigned purity, she jumps right into her new “rowdy drunk” character and is welcomed into the fold by her fellow Live-On VTubers, who turn out to be just as crazy as she is! With her views and finances skyrocketing, Yuki’s work—for the first time in her life—is actually fun! (Source: J-Novel Club) Note: In the September 2025 issue of Comp Ace magazine, it was announced that due to various circumstances, the manga has been discontinued.

characters.name: Awayuki Kokorone
characters.description: __Fanbase name:__ Marshmallows (マシュマロ ) __Affiliation:__ LiveOn (ライブオン) __Illustrator:__ [Noko Shiokazu](https://anilist.co/staff/197988) __Generation:__ 3rd Gen (LiveOn) [Twitter](https://twitter.com/kokoroneawayuki)

characters.name: Sei Utsuki
characters.description: A member of Live-On's second generation who lives up to her Succubus persona with her love of eroge and dirty jokes.

characters.name: Chami Yanagase
characters.description: A member of Live-On's third generation with a cheerful older sister persona despite her extreme social anxiety. Her core fanbase comes from her ASMR content.

characters.name: Hikari Matsuriya
characters.description: A member of Live-On's 3rd generation who is brimming with energy. She is always cheerful and innocent to the point that a lot of [Shuwa-chan's](https://anilist.co/character/317062/Awayuki-Kokorone) jokes go over her head.

characters.name: Mashiro Irodori
characters.description: Another member of Live-On's 3rd generation and [Awayuki's](https://anilist.co/character/317062/Awayuki-Kokorone) character illustrator. She is passionate about her artwork and came up with the nickname "Shuwa-chan."

characters.name: Nekoma Hirune
characters.description: A member of Live-On's second generation who is a cat girl with heterochromia. She is an avid player of terrible games.

characters.name: Shion Kannari
characters.description: A member of Live-On's second generation who acts as the team mom of the Live-On members. Her character concept is of a Nine-tailed fox shrine maiden with an older sister personality.

characters.name: Hareru Asagiri
characters.description: Live-On's founding member and an active staff member in the company. She is seen as the shining light who laid the foundations of the company, and all of the other members look up to her.

title: You Long Shou Hu De Xiao Zhen
description: Hua Dai found herself with an illness - whenever she touches something she wants/likes, her hands will get stuck to it until she buys it. Due to this illness, she is in great debt. Without choice, she decided to go back to her grandpa's house with this secret key her grandpa gave her in search of treasure, hoping to pay off her debts. As Hua Dai arrived at Bai Lin Village, she found a girl namd "Long" who claimed to be a disciple of her grandpa. With this, Hua Dai started living with this strange girl...

title: Kanamemo
description: Nakamachi Kana is a junior high school girl. Her grandmother passed away and she was left all alone. She finds a newspaper carrier station and starts working as a live-in carrier. Her room has a hole in the wall. Other female workers living next doors come in through the hole and start a wild merrymaking.

characters.name: Kana Nakamachi
characters.description: Kana is forced to leave the house when her grandma dies. (Her parents passed away a long time ago.) While looking for a place to stay, she ends up at an newspaper carrier office. Hesistant and overwhelmed at first, she decides to stay and starts working as a newspaper carrier since it seems like it's the only place that's willing to take her in. Kana likes to cook and enjoys watching sumo-wrestling and drama shows and is scared easily.

characters.name: Saki Amano
characters.description: Saki is the assistant chief at the newspaper carrier office, but everyone calls her 'Chief'. Even though she is only in grade school, she seems to be the most serious one of the bunch. She is also in charge of the office's administrative work.

characters.name: Yume Kitaoka
characters.description: Yume is the mood maker of the group. Always bright and lively, but sometimes clumsy, she is definitely a free spirit and one of the warmer and friendly persons Kana meets. She is a bit immature and ignorant but has a very innocent heart. For example, she earnestly thinks that the "teru teru bozu" monk does in fact exist (this is the equivalent to someone thinking that Santa Claus is real). She is an apprentice at a local patisserie, hence her fondness of everything sweet. She tends to sweeten every meal she cooks with heaps of sugar or chocolate, much to the disgust of everyone (however, only Yuuki willingly eats her food). Her love for sweets even extends to her wanting to be a pâtissier as a full time job. She seems to be dating Yuuki who she happily and openly loves. Yume is not afraid to express open affection for Yuuki, kissing her goodbye in public and hugging her w

characters.name: Yuuki Minami
characters.description: Yuuki is a cool, calm and collected beauty. While being serious at most times, she has her despairing moments, most of which happen when she thinks Yume is going to leave her or when she thinks Yume is ignoring her. She is very, very deeply in love with Yume and seems to be a bit insecure about Yume's feelings for her. Despite Hinata's warnings that coddling Yume is a bad thing, Yuuki explains (with a rather sly and sinister expression) that as long as Yume is dependent on her in some way, she will be fine. Unlike the rest of the workers, she does not have a hard time dealing with the pushy customers, an attribute which Yume seems to find attractive.

characters.name: Hinata Azuma
characters.description: Hinata is a bit of a selfish person and tends to be stingy. She is addicted to everything that involves money, and spends a lot of her money on horse gambling tickets, stocks and the sorts. She wishes to go to college, but so far has managed to fail the entrance exam three times. Hinata is also very cheap. She will try to find any way to cut corners and save money, such as going so far as to bring her laundry to a bathhouse to both bath herself and wash her clothes, thus saving money from going to a laundromat. However, the only times she seems to splurge is when it comes to her family. She has a lot of siblings and buys things for them without even thinking twice about the cost.

characters.name: Haruka Nishida
characters.description: While Haruka is the oldest one in the bunch, it doesn't mean she's the most mature one. She often acts like a drama queen and when she's intoxicated, she gets very rowdy and lecherous. She's currently studying bio-chemistry in college. Despite being wasted most of the time, it seems she puts at least some effort into her work and into her studies. She often likes to ferment alcohol in school, trying new techniques. Sometimes she brings home her projects for the older girls to try out. She likes to harass Saki and Kana, especially when she had a drink or two too much. (She's always in for a drink, and has a preference for sake.) Haruka has a gigantic fetish for anything cute. She often gets very excited when it comes to thinking of girls having a clichéd moe appeal to them (such as seeing Kana in a school swim suit and calling Mika a "loli" becaus

characters.name: Mika Kujiin
characters.description: Mika is a newspaper deliverer at another center, although she won't admit it unless directly confronted. She is quick to blame others, and frequently turns her mistakes into inconveniences. When she becomes lost during a route, she literally runs into Kana, then forgives her by "allowing" her to escort her to her next stop. (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Nao-chan
characters.description: Kana and Mika's classmate. Wears glasses.

characters.name: Marimo
characters.description: Marimo is a minor character who appears in the eighth and twelfth episodes. She is a former Fuhshin Gazette employee before she graduated from college, and has a reputation as the worst employee the newspaper company ever had. Nevertheless, she was well liked by everyone. She and Saki shared a special friendship; they were so close that Saki started calling her nee-san (big sister), which the rest of the Fuhshin staff picked up, as well. Marimo was the first person with whom Saki had truly opened up and revealed her true feelings (and as far as the series has shown, the only person). She is also the only staff member, overall, to call Saki by her name, instead of addressing her as chief. Before the events of the anime (roughly the most recent spring season), the day before Marimo's graduation, there was a snow storm with record low temperatures, and on that day Marimo was late returning

title: Jujeong Gwangye
description: "Unnie… I really like you." Those were the words that Fine Arts student, Shi-Bi tells Ye-Ju, her former teacher and current sunbae. Only having eyes for Ye-Ju, she blurts out a drunken confession, and the two of them later spend the night together, but a rumour that a girl named Jay is trying to approach Ye-Ju begins to circulate and reaches Shi-Bi's ears, which complicates her love life. A romance between two art students that get intoxicated with drunken love commences.

title: Battle Royale: Tenshitachi no Kokkyou
title_original: バトル・ロワイアル 天使たちの国境
description: The Program is a brutal military experiment that pits junior high students against each other every year in a brutal battle to the death. Most of the students from Shiroiwa Junior High scatter as soon as they reach the remote island where they must participate in the latest round of the Program. But Yukie Utsumi and five of her friends lock themselves in the lighthouse, clinging to a desperate hope of survival. They all trust each other, but they also know that only one can survive the Battle Royale… (Source: VIZ Media)

characters.name: Yukie Utsumi
characters.description: Girl #2 Yukie Utsumi is an intelligent, caring girl. She is best friends with Haruka. In the novel she is a member of a non-distinct group of girls referred to by the novel as "the neutrals." ~!During the game, she gathers Haruka and several other girls and hides in an abandoned lighthouse. Hiroki delivers Shuuya and brings him in. Yukie admits that she is in love with him. Another girl, Yuko Sakaki, is suspicious of Shuuya (she witnessed Ooki's accidental death and assumed Shuuya meant to kill him). Yuko decides to poison his food, but the food meant for him is instead eaten by Yuka Nakagawa, who quickly dies. The girls quickly turn on each other. In the novel and manga, Yukie is gunned down by Satomi when she fires a warning shot. Yukie is the thirtieth to die.!~ (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Haruka Tanizawa
characters.description: Girl #12 Haruka Tanizawa is Yukie's best friend. The novel describes Haruka, a member of a non-distinct group of girls referred to by the novel as "the neutrals," as "exceptionally tall." ~!She hides with Yukie and several other girls in an abandoned lighthouse. However, soon they turn against each other, and kill each other in a violent gun fight. Haruka does not participate until Satomi kills Yukie, and is shot several times in the side when grabbing her friend's gun. She finishes Satomi off by shooting her in the eye, while she herself lay dying. Haruka dies thirty-second.!~ (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Chisato Matsui
characters.description: Girl #19 Chisato Matsui is one of the class of third-year students at Shiroiwa Junior High School in Shiroiwa, Kagawa Prefecture. The novel describes Chisato, a member of a non-distinct group of girls referred to by the novel as "the neutrals," as "always quiet and withdrawn." Chisato is a petite girl with long hair. She had a crush on Shinji Mimura and in the Manga, she and Yuka were apparently "Boy crazy". ~!Chisato was one of the girls who teamed up with Yukie Utsumi and the others at the lighthouse. She cooked the meal, along with Haruka Tanizawa, which made the others suspicious of her when Yuka Nakagawa was poisoned. When the girls all became paranoid and panicked, Satomi Noda grabbed the uzi, and when Chisato moved to get Yuka's gun, Satomi shot her three times in the back. In the film, she also accuses Yukie of poisoning the meal in order to run off with Shuya Nanahara alone befo

characters.name: Yuka Nakagawa
characters.description: Girl #16 Yuka Nakagawa is a chubby, cheerful girl who hides in an abandoned lighthouse with Yukie Utsumi, Haruka Tanizawa, Chisato Matsui, Yuko Sakaki and Satomi Noda. ~!They then find Hiroki holding Shuuya. Shuuya's injured.They take in Shuuya and prepare a stew. Yuko, however, thinks Shuuya intentionally killed Tatsumichi Ooki, even though it was an accident. While Yuko is preparing soup for Shuuya, she slips Cyanide Acid into it. Yuka says she'll take the food to Shuuya. She eats the poisoned food meant for Shuuya and dies. This sparks a gunfight be tween the girls in the lighthouse.!~ (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Satomi Noda
characters.description: Girl #17 Satomi Noda is a model student. Satomi wears wire-rimmed glasses which the novel says fits her "calm, intelligent face." ~!Satomi hides in a lighthouse with several other girls. After Yuko Sakaki tries to poison Shuuya Nanhara, but accidentally kills Yuka Nakagawa, the girls turn on each other. Satomi is the first to become panicked and starts the gunfight. She succeeds in killing the other girls, but a dying Haruka kills her. Satomi dies thirty-first.!~ (Source: Wikipedia)

title: Shoujo no Mayu
description: A trilogy of beautiful, dangerous, and cruel truth between adolescent girls... (Source: Manga Club)

title: Boku wa, Onnanoko
description: A collection of one-shot stories by Takako Shimura, the author of Hourou Musuko ( Wandering Son ) and Aoi Hana ( Sweet Blue Flowers ). Originally published between 1997 and 2001, these stories deal with issues relating to gender, romance, ideals of beauty, and relationships with parents. 1. Boku wa, Onnanoko (He Said, "I Am a Girl") 2. Rakuen ni Ikou (Let's Go to the Paradise) 3. Shounen no Musume (Boy's Daughter) 4. The Theme of Akemi ver. Teruo 5. The Theme of Akemi ver. Yoshio 6. The Theme of Akemi ver. Haruo 7. Hana (The Flower) 8. Sweet 16

characters.name: Yuki
characters.description: Yuki, born Hiroyuki Yoshida, is a tall and attractive trans woman living with her boyfriend Shiina. She takes an early interest in Yoshino when she believes Yoshino to be a boy, though remains on good terms with Yoshino even after learning of Yoshino's assigned sex, and gives Shuichi and Yoshino helpful advice when they are troubled. Despite the differences between their situations, Yuki sees much of herself in Shuichi: when they were growing up, Shiina was the only friend who stood by the young Hiroyuki, as she was called then, while girls teased her and the boys bullied her to change. Yuki always keeps up a positive attitude, and runs a gay bar. Since her transition, she has not been on good terms with her parents, who run a uniform store. Yuki is the main character of Takako Shimura's short story "Hana", in the collection Boku wa, Onna no Ko, in which her family—which consists of her

title: Kono Yo de Ichiban Suteki na Owarikata
title_original: この世で一番素敵な終わり方
description: There is a funeral home that has seen better days, operated by Huo Fa, a human girl who inherited the business when she lost her family, and Hei Xiong, a girl with a dead but unnaturally strong body. With Huo Fa tending to her partner's body, and Hei Xiong seeking the truth behind her impossible existence, the two of them strive to keep the business, and each other, from succumbing to the forces of decay.

title: Shoujo Holic
description: A girl's father is relocated by his job. She's recently found the "boy of her dreams" and decides that she's staying no matter where her parents move to! She's sent to live with her grandmother and enters the same high school her mother attended. It's a religious school run by nuns. She meets a very strange girl who thinks she’s cute and shows quite an interest in her.

title: Shuuden de Kaesanai, Tatta Hitotsu no Houhou
title_original: 終電で帰さない、たった1つの方法
description: Nanako Morito fell in love with her senpai Ayaka Segawa when Ayaka led Nanako's new employee orientation session. Morito kept her feelings to herself until she was jolted by the news that Segawa-san was quitting the company.

characters.name: Nanako Morito
characters.description: **Height:** 161cm A gentle and cheerful office lady. She fell in love at first sight with a senior colleague and confessed her feelings to her. She's a little shy, but she has a heart of gold.

characters.name: Ayaka Segawa
characters.description: **Height:** 166cm A cheery, dependable, industrious office lady. She's had multiple boyfriends in the past, but she's currently dating a female junior colleague. She's simply a caring woman who acts older than her age.

characters.name: Yoshida
characters.description: She has a tendency to cry easily. Hanae is her first love, and she would die without her.

characters.name: Hanae
characters.description: She is bright and cheerful, and she has a lot of piercings. She loves Yoshida.

title: Isso, Koi Dattara Yokatta no ni
title_original: いっそ、恋だったらよかったのに
title_en: I Wish it Had Just Been Love
description: Nina had always admired Mao, her senpai from high school. Mao was a diehard rock fan and talented musician who was as gentle as she was strong-willed. When it came time for Nina to pick universities, of course she wanted to follow Mao. But when the two finally reunite, Mao is almost a completely different person...and she's quit music! While Nina is happy to learn about how her precious senpai has grown, there's one problem: the guy who causes Mao to look so soft and tender. But this nice-looking-guy isn't treating Mao the way Nina believes she deserves. Her solution? Show Mao-senpai just how she deserves to be treated by taking her out! (Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: Hebi-onna to Kumotsu-chan
description: A snake-spirit queen becomes entangled with a docile girl offered as a sacrifice.

title: &Dropout
description: Momose Anzu , a second year middle schooler, is made popular to girls accidentally. What will now happen to the ordinary life she yearns for?

title: Resonant Blue
description: I'm so frustrated that I can't express this feeling you give me. The color of this feeling you gave me must be... Nagi, a high school girl who loves the sound of the human voice, and Michiru, a classmate with a clear and beautiful voice. It started as an exchange of notes in class that no one else knows about. Clumsy, but honest. The title story Resonant Blue depicts the relationship between two girls. This is the author's first long-awaited yuri short story collection. (Source: Comic Medu, translated)

title: Geunyeoui Sinbuga Doeeotda
description: In a world of money, fame, and secrets, Sherry finds herself being the bride of a wealthy family... However, it's far from simple. (Source: Toomics)

title: Amefuri Harete Hana Hikaru
title_original: 雨降り晴れて花ひかる

title: Ichiya de Ochiru Koi nante
title_original: 一夜で堕ちる恋なんて
description: Yorisue, who works at a lesbian bar, falls in love with a beautiful customer, Wasa. Yorisue tries to tempt her into a one-night stand, and Wasa is willing to go with the flow. The next morning, after a very satisfying night together, Yorisue is shocked to see Wasa's different appearance in the morning! This is a romantic comedy about falling love while accepting the gap between the day and night faces! (Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Organ Divider
title_original: オーガン・ディバイダー
description: Who are they, and where did they come from? "Toda" is a female-type manufactured bionic human who can take down a flock of strong cyborgs with their special Armed Combat Techniques. Power up and strap in for this thrilling dark Sci-fi action series! (Source: Alpha Manga)

characters.name: Toda
characters.description: Toda is the main protaganist of Organ Divider.

title: Penlight yori Hikatte: Encore
title_original: ペンライトより光って-アンコール-
description: One day, Miharu, a plain and seemingly honor student, is approached by Fujii Yua, a gyaru from the class next door. She gets closer with Yua, but, Miharu has a secret hobby… An easy-going GL about idols and two totally opposite high school girls.

title: Harassment ga Kowai Maki-senpai!
title_original: ハラスメントが怖いマキ先輩！
description: The editor-in-chief, Maki Ishikawa, is kind to co-workers, good at her job, and acts like the ideal boss! But in front of her junior colleague, Nodoka Minami, she starts acting strangely. "Maki-senpai, I can always count on you!" Minami says with a big smile. Maki wants to get to know Minami better, but she is worried, "Would it be harassment to ask for her phone number?" “Is it be too much if I ask her out to lunch?" she wonders… Aah!!! She definitely doesn't want come across like a creep, but she wishes they could be be friends! (Source: forcs, translated)

title: Okujou no Yurirei-san Side B: Nakayoshi Quiz
title_original: 屋上の百合霊さんSIDE B 仲良しクイズ
title_en: Kindred Spirits on the Roof SIDE B: Friendly Quiz
description: Hase Chiharu loves seeing yuri romance play out. For that reason, she becomes enamored by two senior classmates, Natsuki and Rika, a power couple in the school’s Quiz Show Club. When Chiharu joins the club so she can be closer to them, she meets the adorable Tokino. Tokino can’t take her eyes off their beautiful upper classmates either, and as Chiharu and Tokino observe the couple together, their own sweet relationship begins! (Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: Biancheng Ke Xi Chushou Guai Hou, Tamen Geng Fengkuangle!
title_original: 变成克系触手怪后，她们更疯狂了!
description: For unknown reasons, Xiao Zheng would transform into a tentacle monster when he became excited. Even if he longed for love, he would disguise himself as being cold. But suddenly he was summoned by Bai Anan, who was usually serious but secretly loved drawing. He signed an agreement and became Bai Anan’s “familiar”. He was threatened to help her – to draw the Manhua that would top the list! (Source: Bilibli Comics, translated)

title: Tokyo Alice: Fuu no wo Kaimono Nikki
title_original: 東京アリス －ふうのお買い物日記－
description: There are so many things she wants, but she still hasn’t found out what she’s looking for … That’s Fu Arisugawa, an office worker too busy with her shopping spoils and whose motto is “Shopping is Living.” Meanwhile, for reasons she doesn’t yet understand, she’s interested in her cool-tempered and reserved boss. And there are her friends, too. Rio, who keeps her feelings towards Fu a secret; Mizuho, who always ends up dating losers; and Enjoji, who keeps interviewing University of Tokyo grads for an arranged marriage … Each are lost in their own way while searching for happiness. These four Alices wander through their lives of love … and shopping!! (Source: Kodansha USA)

characters.name: Fu Arisugawa
characters.description: A free-spirited office worker at a design production company. She loves shopping and is usually thinking about the latest styles at fashion boutiques.

characters.name: Shinji Okuzono
characters.description: Fu's boss, nicknamed "Iceman Okuzuno."

title: Ta De Huang Yan
description: Zhao Fugui, a high school girl who can see everybody's score in life, puts herself at the frontline every day to find the perfect boyfriend. However, she never imagined that someone by her side already held a perfect score, and that she's deeply in love with her... (Source: Bilibili Comics) Note: Includes eight extra chapters.

title: Lolicon Saga
description: Dojigiri city is a city surrounded by mountains, and the population is only 9000 people... But this city has one thing that different than other cities... ALL WOMEN FROM THIS CITY ARE LOLIS!! (Source: Lolitannia)

title: Banhamyeon An Dwae!
description: Helplessly falling in love at first sight. Jeong-Hyeon is a girl who easily gets carried away by her feelings. On her first day of work as a manager for actress Hee-Ra Ju, she falls head over heels for her! Jeong-Hyeon can't afford to lose her job, but her heart melts every time she sees Hee-Ra's face. Will she be able to hide her feelings? (Source: Manta, edited)

title: Satsuriku no Queen Dead: Nananin no Onna Shikeishuu
title_original: 殺戮のクインデッド -7人の女死刑囚-
description: Death row inmates– Those who have committed heinous crimes and have been sentenced to death by the law. A woman, Akari is on her way to "Deep Palace," a death-row prison island where these inmates are held, with a mysterious purpose. She thought she could successfully complete her mission, but to her surprise, the condemned prisoners have started killing each other! They were divided into male and female teams, and a battle royale called the "Killing" was being held, where the winning team could escape! Can Akari survive the "Killing" and escape from the prison? A prison battle royale featuring blood, eroticism, and bad guys, where all the characters are scum!!!!! (Source: Takeshobo, translated)

title: Nosewasure
description: A collection of hentai stories from Shiwasu no Okina's past works dating since 1999. A great cosplay themed title involving sex with female police officers, girls with glasses, sexy women in kigurumi (full body) costumes, and many times in their normal skin tight street wear making them all the more delectable. Contents: 1-2. Jokyoushi Chuuzenji Ayano no Inutsuna Korekara (女教師中善寺綾乃の淫鬱なこれから); Comic Aun 2005-10, 11 3. Kyokon wa Shoubai nari! (巨根は商売なり！); Comic Aun 1999-04 4. Sousa e-gakari Ishihara Miina!! (捜査e係石原魅奈！！); Comic Aun 2003-11 5. Yoshimoto! (ヨシモト！); Comic Aun 2003-01 6. Shohousen (しょほぅせん); Comic Aun 2001-05 7. LOVERINTH ; Comic Aun 2000-02 8. PEACH Kateikyoushi (PEACH家庭教師); Comic Aun 1999-11 9. Omake (おまけ); kakioroshi

title: Tamayomi
description: In her Junior High years, the pitcher Yomi Takeda was not able to get very far in a cross-school baseball tournament. Since the catcher on her team wasn't at her level, she couldn't use her signature move, the "Magic Throw," and eventually regretted not being able to use it. After Junior High, she decided to stop playing baseball and went to Shin Koshigaya High School, a school without a baseball club. There, she found her long lost childhood friend, Tamaki Yamazaki, who used to play catch ball​ with her when they were kids. Tamaki also played baseball during her Junior High years as a catcher, and could even catch Yomi's "Magic Throw!" Their promise with each other during their childhood could now be fulfilled! Walking together on the road of baseball once again... The story of the girls who love baseball will begin!

characters.name: Kyouka Fujii
characters.description: A teacher at Shin-Koshigaya High School who teaches Home Economics. She serves as the baseball team's manager and is, in fact, a graduate of Shin-Koshigaya and a former member of the baseball team herself.

title: Gohoubi ni Kiss Shite yo
title_original: ごほうびにキスしてよ
description: "I will kiss you once for each basket you score," Shiki promised Hinami for a reward at Shiki's house the day after the game. Does that means she's going to kiss me 15 times? (Source: Number Nine, translated) Note: Released at Comiket 97.

title: Asa Okitara Onnanoko ni Natteita Danshi Koukouseitachi no Hanashi
title_original: 朝起きたら女の子になっていた男子高校生たちの話
description: Note: Chapter count includes one extra chaper.

title: Bunnie's Quest
description: On the moon, there is an advance civilization of bunny people who used to be identical to humans, but after incorporating themselves with bunny genes, transformed into docile creatures. The result is a society where AI are entrusted with all choices, from the content of meals to how each minute of leisure time should be spent. Amongst this society is a bunny girl named Uko who dislikes this lifestyle, complaining "Let me choose for myself!!". One day, Uko decides to flee the moon and head to Earth where she meets Hane, a bunny girl investigating life on Earth. On this planet with many strange customs, these two will...!? (Source: Kodansha, translated) Note: Includes 1 extra chapter.

characters.name: Uko Uumoto
characters.description: A rabbit-like alien from the moon, Uko flees to the Earth in an attempt to find freedom and self-expression. She's independent and adventurous to a fault, and often needs Hane's help to bail her out of awkward social situations. Her eager naivety is infectious, however, and those around her end up appreciating her company. Her unique rabbit-like trait is having an herbivorous stomach, which causes stomach issues whenever she eats any meat.

characters.name: Hane Unokawa
characters.description: Hane is a bunny-like alien from the moon, working to study human life on Earth. Referred to as a tsundere by Norimi, Hane is usually cold and professional. She takes her job seriously, and isn't afraid to get confrontational when something or someone jeopardizes her mission. However, beneath this cold exterior is someone who yearns for companionship. She may not say it, but she's happiest when she's surrounded by friends. Hane also has an interest in human history, and harbors a deep appreciation for the craftsmanship that goes into many human creations. Hane's rabbit-like trait is "chin rubbing." She feels compelled to rub her chin on all her possessions to scent them.

characters.name: Norimi Hasegawa
characters.description: The representative of Hane's landlady (and the landlady's grand daughter). She's a shut-in who feels trapped as an adult. She struggles to make friends, and her anxiety around strangers is so disruptive that she struggles to hold down a job. She cries easily, and has a habit of fixating on small emotional gestures. And Norimi is jealous of Hane and Uko's connection, as she wishes she had something similar.

characters.name: Omochi
characters.description: Omochi is a sentient AI assistant to Hane. While he's meant to assist her with her work, the two develop a casual friendship with one another. He's able to display holographic projections, create stomach medicine, and analyse the health of both Hane and Uko. Omochi is also implied to have emotions, blushing when praised and getting depressed when abandoned.

characters.name: Okiko Nete
characters.description: A sales clerk at the futon store that Hane and Uko visit. She tries to sell the two an expensive futon, and helps them navigate the different kinds of pillows and sheets available. She's fully devoted to the bedding department, and the number one sales clerk in the company.

title: Trans Star
description: Shizuku has a crush on Yuu-kun; however, the day she mustered the courage to finally confess, Yuu appears transformed into a girl because of the rare TS Disease.

title: Surechigai Kyodai Kanjou Yuri Anthology
title_original: すれ違い巨大感情百合アンソロジー
description: Happiness is not the only thing yuri has to offer. A yuri anthology about one-sided love that doesn't communicate is finally here! 1. Wagamamadatta ne, Watashitachi (わがままだったね、私たち。, We Were Selfish) by Chimiyu 2. Koukai Sakinitazazu (後悔先に立たず, No Regrets) by Manio 3. Watashi wa Koizuru Heroine (私は恋するヒロイン, I Am the Heroine in Love) by Ichigo Ichie 4. Doru Ukabu Tsuki (泥浮かぶ月, Mud Floating Moon) by Tsutsuki 5. Suki Janai ko to Tsunagu te wa Ningen no Katachi o Shite iru (好きじゃない子とつなぐ手は人間の形をしている) by Takahashimako 6. Snowdrop (スノードロップ) by Tsukiako Kashiwagi

title: Mad Summer School
title_original: マッドサマースクール
description: It is a scorching summer in Japan and Hiromi is studying hard for her exams to enter her university of choice. She was raised by just her mother since her father, a well-known researcher had gone missing when she was young. One day on her way to school she is attacked by a man with a knife… is this the end or a new beginning?

title: Wakeatte Shachou Reijou ni Hirowaremashita
title_original: ワケあって社長令嬢に拾われました
description: Haruka Nagashima is an OL who had nothing to show for her life despite her hard work. She was caught in a marriage scam and lost her savings, and at the same time she made a terrible mistake at work. Just when she thought she was about to lose her job, the president's daughter, Ichijo Manyo, offered to take care of her? Will she be able to turn her life around? Or will she fall into a bottomless pit of despair? With their differences and secrets, they begin a turbulent life together! (Source: Comic Days, translated)

title: Mushi to Medama to Teddy Bear
title_original: 蟲と眼球とテディベア
description: Usagawa Rinne, a normal female high-school student, spent happy days with her lover, Sakaki Guryuu. However their peaceful days were suddenly shattered. On the night of Sakaki's birthday, Sakaki witnessed Rinne's death after her eyeball was gouged out by a girl named "Gankyuu Eguriko"... (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Rinne Usagawa
characters.description: A cheerful girl that is going out with her sensei after he saved her from a suicide attempt. During that suicide attempt Rinne saw an apple of eden and ate one, thus giving her immortality at when she grows to a certain age.

characters.name: Guryu Sakaki
characters.description: The boyfriend of Rinne and the heir of a prosperous family. He is a teacher at Rinne's school where everyone knows that Rinne and he are going out.

title: Reblooming
description: Dinner with friends takes a turn when Yeon-Ji’s coldhearted college ex shows up. After all those years, Hwa-Jo wants to try again… and to date like they used to. Should Yeon-Ji give it a second chance, when all Hwa-Jo did was leave her broken and humiliated? And why is Hwa-Jo reaching out now, just as their old college friend, Mo-Ju, has returned from abroad? The timing’s peculiar, but something’s different about Hwa-Jo. Will the two rekindle a broken love? Or will dark secrets of the past stand in their way? (Source: Tapas, edited) Note: The prologue included in the English version in Tapas is exclusive of that version and will not be taken into account for the total chapter count once the series is over.

title: Kinsei no Rivere
description: Kugami Sugara just wants to lead a peaceful school life. But being chosen by the beautiful and talented Shirasagi Yui to be her pseudo 'sister', her life is anything but peaceful. And to make things even more interesting, Yui's cold but capable identical twin sister (and also student council president), Shirasagi Ui, also takes an interest in Sugara. Note: Includes 1 extra chapter.

title: Neoneun Anirago Haetjiman
description: "Why didn't you accept my bouquet?", she asked years later like it was the simplest thing. Chance brought Ju-Na back into Yun-Seo's life but things were much more complicated now. They were no longer in college where the only obstacle between them were the truth yet spoken. Luna was married with a child, what could Yun-Seo do? As Sae-Ha chases after Yun-Seo, Yun-Seo discovers even after all these years she'd still love Ju-Na at the drop of a hat. The three women navigate through their feelings for another, each desperate and yearning for a chance to be accepted. (Source: Pocket Comics)

title: Atashitachi tte Tsukiatteru yo ne?!
title_original: あたし達って付き合ってるよね?!

title: Hajimari no Joshi Kouishitsu
title_original: 我慢できなかった委員長とピュアギャル百合マンガ
description: Mio and the Class President are alone in the changing room and find out that they have a thing in common... and then they start finding more interesting things in the mean time...

title: Bloody Mary
description: A full color manga about Mary, a demon who gets her strength from sucking the very life from her unsuspecting lovers, and is embroiled in an all out demonic war in Shibuya.

title: Hugi
description: What would you do if you discovered that the third-rate story in your free daily newspaper was actually an account of someone’s murder? As Hae-Su Choi goes through his daily morning newspaper, “Rotary N,” to look for jobs, he stumbles across an ongoing serial thriller called “Epilogue.” At first glance it just seems like pulp fiction, but as the story progresses, the characters turn out to be real-life victims. Get ready for a series full of twists and turns, with murder around every corner. (Source: WEBTOON, edited)

title: Chotto Kawaii Iron Maiden
title_original: ちょっとかわいいアイアンメイデン
description: Muto Yuzuki was ready for a whole new life and a different self when she got to middle school but she didn't expect it to be literally torturous. Yuzuki is “persuaded” by an upper classman named Funaki Aoi to join the Torture Club on campus which has been secretly training students to enter the field of military and police organizations as interrogation experts. Aoi sees something inside Yuzuki and thinks she might be a prodigy in torture methods. Naturally, Yuzuki wants nothing to do with such vulgar conduct but the more she spends time with the club, the more she starts to realize her own dark potential. (Source: MangaHelpers)

title: Lovers' Kiss
description: There's a series of sultry days for the girls and boys at a public high school in Kamakura. This dramatic romance depicts the complicated relationships between these young men and women.

title: Oshiegoto: Doujin Kyoushi to Tensai Gal
title_original: おしえごと 同人教師と天才ギャル
description: Sachi Kurokawa, a doujin artist in her private life, is hired to be the new art teacher at a high school, where she meets Koihaku, a gal who happens to be a talented portrait artist. Koihaku is a fan of Kurokawa's doujinshi work, and her praises make Kurokawa happy, but trying to keep her doujin work a secret, she lies and tells Koihaku that it is her older sister "Sachi" who draws the doujinshi. Now Koihaku wants Sachi to teach her how to draw like "Sachi"? (Source: Akita Shoten, translated)

title: Aibuka! (Kari)
description: Sukai loves idols so much, he’ll dedicate his extracurricular career to producing the sexiest idols there’s ever been! (Source: HMarket) Included one-shot: You're My Idol (ゆあまいあいどる); Comic Aun 2012-12

title: Truth
title_original: なもり百合姫表紙画集 truth
description: People can make themselves happy by lying to themselves. But eventually they have to confront the truth about their feelings, as these three girls are suddenly forced to do.

title: Imouto ga Dekimashita.
description: A collection of stories from the author: 1. Imouto ga Dekimashita. (I Got Myself a Little Sister.) 2. Sotsugyou no Hi 3. Soushite Watashitachi wa 4-5. Watashi no Suki na Anoko no Koto 6. Watashi no Aisuru Kawano-san (My Beloved Kawano-san) 7. Tayuminaku Ikiyo

title: My Sweet Home
title_en: Mother x Daughter Yuri Anthology "My Sweet Home"
description: It's cold and I don't want to go to school! As she rubs her cheek against her mother's back. The daughter invites her mother to spend the day at home because it's raining and she can't go outside to play.... Enjoy wonderful parent-child yuri stories by a stunning array of 13 authors! (Source: Melonbooks, translated) Note: Includes three extras.

title: Reliance
description: A spin-off of Love at Fourteen that tells the story of Aoi-chan and Haijima-sensei when they meet again in the same class after a one-year break, told from the perspective of Tachibana-san, a classmate with a crush on Aoi. Is "curiousity" the beginning of love? (Source: Rakuen, translated)

title: Zhe Hunjun De Hei Yueguang Wo Dang Ding Le
title_original: 这昏君的黑月光我当定了
description: Duan Weiying transmigrated into the body of a new concubine on a harem mission. Her goal was suppose to beat out all the other girls to become the Emperor's favorite. But she had no interest in some unfaithful playboy Emperor, and she was going to just go through the motions and abuse her cheats to finish her assignment. That was until she found out the Emperor was actually a cool, beautiful Empress, who fell in love with Duan Weiying at first sight. Now both are caught up in each other… (Source: Kuaikan, translated)

title: Nishizawa 5milli Tanpenshuu: Motokano ni Gensou wo Idaku na Baka
title_original: 西沢5ミリ短編集 元カノに幻想を抱くなバーカ
description: A volume of short stories collection of the mangaka 5miri Nishizawa. This volume includes the following chapters: 1-2. Moto Kano ni Gensou wo Daku na Baka (元カノに幻想を抱くなバーカ) 3-4. Tanin no Sekkusu wo Souzou Suru na (他人のセックスを想像するな) 5-6. Otaku♥️Kimo♥️♥️♥️ (オタク♥️キモ♥️♥️♥️) 7. Kareshi ga Iru Onnanoko to Tsukiau Houhou (彼氏がいる女の子と付き合う方法) 8. Konna Toki no Tameni (こんな時の為に) 9. Koredakara Kawaii Onna wa (これだからかわいい女は) 10. Karuika Omoika (軽いか重いか) 11. Dame ni Shite Koyou to Suru Nenjiou 5-bai Kanojo to Dame ni Naritakunai Kaji Zenpan Tokui Otoko (ダメにしてこようとする年収5倍彼女とダメになりたくない家事全般得意男) 12. Chokusetsu Ienai, Valentine's Day (直接言えない、バレンタインデー) 13. Anata no Chinchin Kashite Kudasai (あなたのちんちん貸してください)

title: Lian Ai Rang Wo You Le Chao Neng Li
description: Art student Zhong Shenxiu runs into a problem during a portrait sketching class. She couldn't "truly see" Xu Ke, a top student and the subject of the portrait session… She can't draw her subject if she can't see her clearly. Zhong Shenxiu puts down her pencil and wonders, maybe if she became a better student, she would be able to get closer to her, right? And if she could get closer to her, then she could truly see her, right? Until she gets so close that the distance between them is almost zero — like they're almost face-to-face. Phew! Now she can truly see her clearly! But! This is... a little too close! Help! What should she do now!!! (Source: Bilibili, translated) Note: Includes 14 extra chapters.

title: Kuroyome
description: Ikeda Mitsuko is a successful business woman, who made a wish to Santa to have a wife. And here it fits the phrase "Be careful what you wish for..." A series of inter-related short stories including: 1-4. Kuroyome 5-6. Metoraba 7. Mitsuko-san's Agony 8. Fuji-sensei's Lie

title: Sukumizu!
description: A 4-koma illustrating the lives of cute girls doing cute things in school swimsuits.

title: Hana Monogatari
description: "I have unforgettable memories with this flower..." Memories that will forever sparkle in my heart. Sweet, slightly painful, thorn-like youth. The timeless masterpiece of girls' novels, Flower Story , has been turned into a manga with soft, dainty brushstrokes.

title: Éclair Rouge: Anata ni Hibiku Yuri Anthology
title_original: エクレア rouge あなたに響く百合アンソロジー
title_en: Éclair Rouge: A Girls' Love Anthology That Resonates in Your Heart
description: A collection of yuri one-shots by various authors. Cover illustration: Yuikawa Kazuno #Illustration : Fly #Illustration : U35 #Illustration : Hiiragi Yutaka 1. Na mo naki Hana e (名も無き花へ), Yuikawa Kazuno 2. sub rosa (sub rosa), Musshu 3. Mushoku to JK (無職とJK), Canno 4. Hajimemashite, Hisashiburi (はじめまして、久しぶり), Kabocha 5. Watashi Custom Maid (わたしカスタムメイド), Nakatani Nio 6. Hyaku no Deai yori (百の出合いより。), Kobachi Ruka 7. Otome no Saezuri to Mezame (乙女の囀りと目覚め), Itou Hachi 8. Gomi mo Tsumoreba Ai to Naru (塵も積もれば愛となる), Kiriyama Haruka 9. Awasetara Saigo (あわせたら最後), Tadano Kagekichi 10. Donzoko no Koiwazurai (どん底の恋わずらい), Hiroichi 11. Legend to Shinjin to Watashi (レジェンドと新人と私), Kitao Taki 12. Suki no Saki ni Aru (好きの先にある), Fumio Aya 13. Atashi, Kanojo, Tomodachi (あたし、かのじょ、ともだち), Amano Shuninta 14. Kanojo no Botan wo Hazusu Toki (彼女のボタンをはずすとき), Morishima Akiko 15. VTuber ni Narou! (VTuberになろう！), Hirao Auri

title: Otaku ni Yasashii Gal ni Watashi wa Naru!
title_original: オタクに優しいギャルに私はなる！
description: A former lonely otaku becomes a gal and wants to make lots of friends!! A comedy about make-up friends, full of ups and downs that otakus will understand and enjoy! (Source: Kodansha, translated)

title: Senki Kanshoku Symphogear: Shirabe Meshi
title_original: 戦姫完食シンフォギア～調めし～
description: An official spin-off for the Senki Zesshou Symphogear series! The divas' next battlefield is a warm gourmet comedy by the chief kitchen maid, Shirabe! Please enjoy another Symphogear story, told through cooking! ♪

characters.name: Kirika Akatsuki
characters.description: Kirika is another one of the mysterious Symphogear users. Although she has a very straightforward, cheerful, and cooperative personality, she harbors a shadowy past as one of the "Receptor Children" who was treated as an observation subject at a certain research facility along with Maria, Serena, Shirabe and others. The bonds between Kirika and her friends are so strong that she feels no fear from fighting against the entire world. ~!She cares very much for her teammates and is willing to do whatever it takes to save humanity. Her relationship with Shirabe in particular borders on the romantic, and she is extremely protective of her. After falsely coming to believe that she is the reincarnation of Finé, Kirika became increasingly unhinged out of panic at the loss of her identity, to the extent that she's driven to attempt suicide when she realized her mistake. She uses "death" (デス desu)

characters.name: Shirabe Tsukuyomi
characters.description: Shirabe is a quiet and reserved, yet passionate and stubborn young girl. She is fiercely protective of who and what she holds dear, particularly Kirika. She claims to not be good at talking to other people, so she intentionally avoids getting too close to people who aren't Kirika. ~!At a very young age, Shirabe was caught in a traffic accident that took both her parents' lives, and she was the only survivor. Due to that accident, she lost most of her memories and any documents that explained who she was. Shirabe was then kidnapped by the F.I.S. and placed in the White Orphanage, as one of the Receptor Children who could potentially host Finé's soul. Her current name of 'Shirabe Tsukuyomi' was given to her by the FIS, as Shirabe could not remember how the kanji of her name was originally read; AXZ Episode 9 implies her first name was originally read as 'Tsuki'. After the death of Ryōko Sa

characters.name: Tsubasa Kazanari
characters.description: __Symphogear:__ Ame no Habakiri (天羽々斬, lit. "Blade of Heavenly Wings", holy sword of Susanoo) A popular idol singer and part of the Zwei Wing unit. When she's not singing, she's fighting Noise with her partner, [Kanade](https://anilist.co/character/51735/Amou-Kanade). ~!She first appeared as a pop star and student with a cold personality. This was due to the fact that her previous partner, Kanade, lost her life two years prior to the series after a Noise attack at their concert. His area of specialty is biology, and he is currently using those talents to uncover the true identity of the holy relics. He admires Hibiki, Tsubasa, and Chris, who saved the world, and overlaps his own dreams with theirs.

title: Coppelia-ui Gwan
description: On a snowy day, a beautiful transfer student named Anna, joined the boarding school. With Anna's captivating beauty, she became the object of everyone's envy. While Colette, who was the opposite of Anna in every way, builds a delicate love-hate relationship with her. All of a sudden, Anna leaves the school. description: In a gloomy town, where three girls have gone missing, high school girl Shizue witnesses an attack on a fellow classmate. The assailant appears to be none other than fellow student Endo Yasuko, a striking beauty who declares to Shizue that she is starving, and only Shizue can sate her hunger! Is Endo Yasuko a vampire, a serial killer–or just plain weird? And what does she really want from Shizue…? (Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: Seonbae Silgyeok
title_en: Ladies at Her Service: A Very Naughty Girl
description: Despite being a pretty and talented film student, Yeo-Woo is brutally rejected after flirting with her cocky underclassman, Jin-Yeong. As if that wasn't humiliating enough, Jin-Yeong accidentally sees Yeo-Woo's racy video of herself wearing a dog collar when they're exchanging files for a film project! What Yeo-Woo doesn't expect is for this to turn on Jin-Yeong's dominant side and spur a series of secret BDSM hookups between them. And Yeo-Woo soon finds out that there's more to their relationship than their heated master-dog dynamic... (Source: Tappytoon) Note: Part of Ridi's Jujonggwangye GL Danpyeonseon (주종관계 GL 단편선) Collection.

Backshot Suffering the smoldering summer heat, Ema finds herself preoccupied with the bra of the girl she is sitting behind in math class. 5. Sanmanen de wa Kaemasen (Not for Sale) 6. Hatsukoi Kouzoushiki (The Structural Formula of First Love) The protagonist is suffering the consequences of a curse she cast 13 years prior.

title: Shitsuji Shoujo to Ojousama
description: Hinata is a student at a prestigious all girls private school and looks up to Tsugeyama Saki, the shining star of the school. As the younger sister of Saori, the head mistress of the school, Saki is the most popular girl at school with her warm personality, beauty, top academic skills and is pretty much the perfect girl. Hinata suddenly learns that her parents got extremely into debt, fled the country and pretty much left her out to dry. The headmistress Saori, out of compassion and seeing Hinata's importance to the school, makes Hinata an offer to become a butler in return for providing room and board for her. Not having much choice, she accepts and is assigned to none other than Saki. Hinata soon finds out that Saki puts on a façade at school and is not the perfect girl everyone thinks she is.

Omegas are oppressed, their status determined by whether or not they successfully bear alpha children. An omega named Saimon marries into the prolific Hanabusa family, a major conglomerate, but is unable to produce an heir for his alpha husband Seijuro, and is shunned as a “Megaera,” a creature that brings ill fortune. One day, Saimon is summoned by the family patriarch Zenjiro and ordered to locate the man’s illegitimate son. Saimon finds the boy, Mamiya, who has been making a life for himself on the streets while hiding the fact that he’s an omega. Desperate to regain his position as Seijuro’s top spouse, Saimon proposes an audacious plan: pass Mamiya off as an alpha heir and try to gain the headship of the Hanabusa family. (Source: Kodansha USA) Notes: - All chapters were split into two parts in the original serialization and later combined in the volume releases. - Volume 11 is digital-only which includes three extra chapters.

title: Yumemiru Maid no Tea Time
title_original: 夢見るメイドのティータイム
description: In the spring of her second year of high school, Fuyuka Yukinoshita starts working part-time at a maid cafe. She dreams of becoming someone who can make people smile, like the manager she admired, but she is always getting flustered by her idiosyncratic co-workers! It is the magic that makes you smile. A fluffy and sweet moment. (Source: Comic Cune, translated)

title: Honey Crush
description: A young girl dies while stalking a girl. Her ghost continues to follow her around, interfering with anyone who tries to confess their love. An old childhood friend of the subject also has a crush and can see the ghost. They battle each other and all newcomers for her affections.

title: Kawasemi-san no Tsuri Gohan
title_original: カワセミさんの釣りごはん
description: High school student, Kawasemi, who has transferred to the countryside, spends her days alone due to her shyness. One day, she is approached by her classmate Misago, a so-called 'countryside Yankee', and was taken to the mountains. Kawasemi was afraid of what she would do, but then MIsago starts fishing!? A Cooking lover JK Meets Fishing lover JK's outdoor life manga!

title: Koisuru Meiga
description: The mangakas' imaginary take on the yuri stories behind famous paintings. Note: Includes an extra chapter.

title: Hayeoga
description: A zombie apocalypse has begun...! Survivors are starting to expose their dirty desires in the face of death...! (Source: TOPTOON+)

title: Mugen no Minamo ni
description: A story of love and drama between a girl whose body grows faster than her mind, and a girl who lives forever by killing others.

title: Yuri no Tsubomi ga Saku Koro ni
description: Rena and Manami originally planned to have a romantic Christmas date, but when Manami catches a cold, their happy holiday is put on hold. Fast forward to New Year’s Eve - Rena heads to Manami’s to make up for lost time, but once she arrives questions start swirling around in her head. This is their first night together, and Rena’s face heats up wondering if Manami ever has “adult” things on her mind. Despite her doubts, Rena still wishes to give her the best night of her life. To Rena’s surprise, Manami has a Christmas miracle in store for her! Decked head to toe in holiday cheer with decorations everywhere, Manami beams with excitement, gifting her a beautiful necklace. Rena is grateful for the gift, but -oh no!- she didn’t get a gift for her! No worries for Manami, because Rena is the gift she wants to unwrap. (Source: FAKKU!)

title: Vampire Girl
title_original: Vampire girl ヴァンパイアガール
description: After reading a popular cell phone novel, Manami becomes obsessed with vampires. When she meets the new substitute teacher for her class who is very similar to the vampires in her novel, she obsesses with her as well. After going on a "date" with Shishido-sensei, she goes home with her but quickly finds that she has bitten off more than she can chew...

title: Shiroki Otome no Werewolf
description: Hakurai Private Academy, a boarding school where young ladies receive a higher education in bridehood. Should the maidens lose their “purity” during the three year course, they are immediately expelled, losing any chance at their dreams of becoming brides. For the girls living at this school, it is a future they consider worse than death. One day, something happens in the dormitory of the student council! In their midst is a two-faced wolf aiming for their purity - and it is up to them to pull back the mask!

title: Jangmigateun Soli
description: Up-and-coming idol group member Rose goes on a secret date with her boyfriend for her birthday, only to be kidnapped and demanded money for their freedom. Her abductors seem far from stable, and her boyfriend seems to be more invested in his own freedom than her safety. Now that she realizes that she is completely on her own, Rose must outsmart her captors and fight for her freedom. (Source: WEBTOONS)

title: Okawari Itadaketa Darouka?
title_original: オカワリいただけただろうか?
description: Suzu Yotsuya is a high school girl who loves to eat. While eating by herself in the cafeteria like usual, she is invited to eat with Majima-san, a tall and popular classmate. However, there are some suspicious rumors going around about Majima-san…⁉ (Source: Comic Action, translated)

title: Kudaranakute, Kirei de.
description: Juri and Hana have been best friends since university. Lately, it feels like their relationship is slightly off...!? (Source: Mystery Bonita, translated)

title: Otogi no Machi no Rena
description: Rena Misaki was a normal girl in high school in the small town of Otogi. But lately she has been tormented by little hamster like imps that cause greatly increased sexual desire. They had been banished from the village long ago by a priest, but somehow they have returned and have taken an interest in Rena. And if that wasn't enough trouble, they are starting to spread. Rena has to find away to get rid of them and have a normal life, before she ends up sleeping with all the guys around her!

title: Flower Flower
title_original: ふらわー ふらわー
description: Princess Nina has been sent to a foreign country to marry the prince only, she'd prefer the princess instead. Shuurei's not sure about this - especially when Nina turns out to be more than a little cruel and sadistic. When Shuurei shows Nina kindness, Nina breaks down in her arms. (Source: Okazu)

She's having dreams and fantasies about having sex with her, but in reality she doesn't have the courage to speak with her. Somehow, they still end up going out. That's how the "Angelic Girl" series starts out, soft and innocent. All in all. This is a book of girls touching and embracing each other a lot. A collection of short stories: 1. Onnanoko Awase (Girls' Union) 2. Koi no Iinari (Slave to Love) 3. Omoide Musubi (Full of Memories) 4. Seiya no Agape (Christmas Eve Agape) 5. Umikaze ga Kaoru (The Fragrant Sea Breeze) 6. Angelic Girl 7. Cherry na Kanojo (Cherry Girl) 8. Kanojo no Kanojo (Her Girlfriend) (Source: Ichijinsha, translated)

description: Bella, a girl with poor magic skills attends the magic academy Anziffollon. Desperately following the footsteps of a certain person's dream, she eventually gets her hands on a forbidden magic... Includes Chapter 0 and 2 bonus chapters.

In truth, the girl in room 13, Herazato Shie, is just unable to fall asleep at night unless she tells someone a story about the movies she has watched. So every night, she invites anyone willing to come in her room and listen to another of her stories about movies. (Source: Japanese Publisher, translated)

description: After the death of her mother, Ruby is taken in by her mother's friend, Mrs. Watson, as a maid for the Bell family. She meets Grace, a young lady of different origins. She thinks she's just a bad girl, but Grace is the only one in the Bell household who cares about her. She becomes the only one who cares about Ruby, and a strange feeling grows between them... Ruby's feelings for Grace are either envy or love. (Source: Lezhin, translated) Note: Chapter count includes a prologue

title: Hui Jin Hua Yuan
description: In the Inquisitor Panel of medieval witch hunts, a military leader who only slaughters alien races is assigned to take care of an experimental subject, a vampire who is suspected to kill her father... (Source: Mojoin) Note: Includes six extra chapters.

title: Wo Zui Te Bie De Ta
description: When Ru Yun Yum sees Hao Yue at a university concert, she is enchanted by her style and admires the girl for being so “cool”. But after night, Hao Yue disappears without a trace. Three years have passed and they meet again, now as roommates. What does the future hold for them? (Source: yman.ga)

title: 100-Nichi Go ni Saku Yuri
description: This full-color manga features one hundred different yuri scenarios, all from the artist Muromaki's #100DaysofYuriChallenge! Packed full of high-school, adult, and age-gap couples in cute, funny, and spicy scenarios alike, this book has plenty for readers to enjoy! (Source: Yen Press)

title: Tagai no Guardian
description: Trained fighters known as Bastioners battle against invaders from another world using a mysterious power called Aegis. Aegis can grant people and objects tremendous strength, but people are unable to use it on themselves and must therefore always fight in pairs to give each other power. Yorino Aratsugu and Yoko Kaminoi are two young girls training to become Bastioners. Yorino used to protect the timid Yoko from bullies, but now Yoko has surpassed her at everything other than combat skills. As the two of them become full-fledged Bastioners, Yorino must fight to keep herself from becoming fully eclipsed by Yoko's talents, while also struggling to understand the more complicated feelings she has for her childhood friend.

title: Vanilla: Jingai x Jingai Yuri Anthology
title_original: バニラ Vanilla 人外×人外百合アンソロジー
description: Story 1 - Oni x Yamagami - Demon and Mountain Goddess (Yukiko) Story 2 - Welcome to the Zoo Bar (Mintarou) Story 3 - The Sacrificial Bride (Nekotarou) Story 4 - Room "2" (Tsugumi Nanamiya) Story 5 - "I wish I could fly" (Yuzu Mizutani & Tooru Kaede) Story 6 - A Candle for the Grim Reaper (Shin Takekawa) Story 7 - Kisses in Wonderland (Subaru Homura) Story 8 - Daughters of The Demon Queen (Mochi Au Lait) Story 9 - Alice please, I'm worried about you (Hachi Itou)

title: Double Dating
description: Rule #1 of confessing to your crush: Make sure she isn’t gay first. When Jae-Won’s plan to ask out his dream girl backfires as she suddenly comes out to him, he panics and rambles out an absolute lie: Actually, I'm gay too! Roped into an impossible double date, Jae-Won begs his best friend, Yu-Won, to play the ultimate loving boyfriend for just one night. The plan seems surprisingly foolproof—until the date actually begins. After overhearing a tense private moment between Yu-Won and his crush's new girlfriend, Hyeon-A, Jae-Won makes a horrifying realization: his fake boyfriend and his crush's girl have a history. Caught in a tangled web of exes, lies, and unexpected feelings, Jae-Won’s quick cover-up rapidly devolves into a complete relationship battlefield. (Source: Lezhin US)

title: Kimochi no Katachi
title_original: きもちのかたち 桜井家作品集
description: Takenaka Satsuki, first year high school student and Library assistant, is secretly attracted to her Senpai, Kitamura Kano. With the help of an accepting friend, Satsuki must learn to overcome her own sense of what is 'normal' in order to embrace her feelings for the one she loves.

title: Shi Wen Lun Xian
description: In a world populated by beastmen, the down-and-out actress, Shen Youqing, happens to be a chinchilla-girl. During an audition, she was nearly sexually assaulted by the assistant director. But she's saved in the nick of time by someone she hadn’t seen in years: Shi Ruolin, who was her first love, arranged marriage partner, fiancée, and mortal enemy. Shen Youqing was looking for a chance to escape, not even bothering to thank her savior, but Shi Ruolin makes her an unexpected offer. Facing dire straits, Shen Youqing gives in to temptation and agrees to endure the humiliation of becoming the pet of the cold-blooded snake, in exchange for a large sum of money. As they spend more time together, they manage to resolve their long-standing misunderstandings, and their mutual feelings grow until they finally agree to spend the rest of their lives together. (Source: Bilibili, translated)

title: Lemonade
description: Youko has a complex from being compared to her older sister her entire life, so middle school is off to a bad start when the tennis club is trying to recruit “Aiko-senpai’s younger sister” and her best friend Maki. She is shocked to find out that Maki is interested in both the club and its leader Keita, whom Youko immediately disliked, and unfamiliar feelings of jealousy soon threaten to cause a rift between them.

title: Mahou Shoujo Lyrical Nanoha A's
title_original: 魔法少女リリカルなのはＡ’ｓ
description: A manga adaptation of a thirteen episode sequel to Magical Girl Lyrical Nanoha, a magical girl alternate universe spinoff of the Triangle Heart series of games and OAVs.
