characters.original: フェイト・テスタロッサ
characters.description: __Intelligent Device:__ [Bardiche](https://anilist.co/character/220250/Bardiche) Fate is introduced as an antagonist and rival to Nanoha Takamachi, she first encounters Nanoha during the Jewel Seed Incident while collecting the Lost Logia known as the Jewel Seeds on behalf of her abusive mother, Presea Testarossa. Despite their initial conflict, the two develop a close friendship that evolves into a lifelong partnership.

characters.name: Nanoha Takamachi
characters.description: __Intelligent Device:__ Raising Heart Excelion. Strike Cannon, Fortress __Rank:__ S+ __Rank (StrikerS):__ Captain of Stars Squad, part of the mobile sixth division __Code name (StrikerS):__ Stars 1 In Mahou Shoujo Lyrical Nanoha, Nanoha Takamachi is sweet if naive third-grader. However, she has always felt like she is missing something in her life: all the people around her have someone there​ are very close to but she lacks this. However, Nanoha is no longer an "ordinary" third grader when she meets and helps the wounded ferret, who just happens to be a mage from another planet, Yuuno Scrya. He has come to Earth to gather the "Jewel Seeds," mysterious artifacts containing great power. Nanoha agrees to help him, but the task seems harder than presented when she meets Fate Testarossa, another girl searching for the Jewel Seeds. In A's, six months after the first season, Nanoha still remai

characters.name: Signum
characters.description: __Nanoha A's__ Signum enters the story when Vita has attempted to steal Nanoha Takamachi's Linker Core (a mage's source of magic) for the Book of Darkness. Since the arrival of Nanoha's cavalry, Fate Testarossa and Yūno Scrya, Vita is cornered and Signum must come to her rescue with Shamal. The Wolkenritter overpower the TSAB troupe with their use of high-powered magical cartridges, and Signum manages to snap Fate's staff, Bardiche, in half. The battle ends with Shamal finally managing to get Nanoha's Linker Core and Nanoha breaking Vita's barrier. Signum refuses to take a bath that night for fear of Hayate seeing the injuries sustained in her battle with Fate. Signum may appear emotionless, but she is completely dedicated to Hayate, and as the leader of the Wolkenritter, fights for the others as well. The Wolkenritter attack mages to steal their Linker Cores, their sources of magic, to

characters.name: Vita
characters.description: __Vita in Mahou Shoujo Lyrical Nanoha A's__ Vita enters A's on a hunt with Zafila for strong Linker Cores to absorb into the Book of Darkness. She targets Nanoha Takamachi, which she deems to be a juicy target, unlike the usual TSAB "redshirts" which can barely fill up a single page of the Book of Darkness. Nanoha puts up a decent fight, but Vita tilts the deck with two cartridges (bullet shaped things that contain high-pressure magic) manages to overpower her, obtaining a power superiority so vast that she heavily damaged the Raising Heart. However, before she could get the Linker Core, Fate Testarossa and Yūno Scrya come to the rescue. Vita fights them off with her fellow Wolkenritter, Signum and Shamal, and they declare themselves enemies. The battle ends with Shamal finally managing to get Nanoha's Linker Core and Nanoha breaking Vita's barrier. ~! Vita fights for the sake of protect

characters.name: Hayate Yagami
characters.description: __Intelligent Device(s):__ Buch der Nachthimmel/Book of Darkness (Storage/Tome), Schwertkreuz (Rod), Reinforce II (Unison Device) A sweet and gentle orphan who is confined to a wheelchair, is cared for by the Wolkenritter, who deliberately keep their battles hidden from her. She knows that completing the Book of Darkness would grant her immense power, but she refuses to accept that power at the cost of innocent lives. Unbeknownst to her, however, the Book is already feeding on her life force, causing her paralysis and slowly weakening her. If it is not completed, the Book will eventually consume her life entirely.

characters.name: Shamal
characters.description: Shamal, being Yuuno's counterpart, does not actually fight, but uses her ring devices to defend, create portals, absorb victims' Linker Cores into the Book of Darkness, and the like. Shamal acts as the 'mother' of the group, doing the shopping, worrying excessively over the others' well-being, and constructing excuses to Hayate as to why they're out so often ("The grocery store doesn't have our brand of olive oil"). She knows that Hayate does not want them to fight anyone for her, but it is still no question that they must. Now in StrikerS She is A soft-spoken member of the Wolkenritter that specializes in defense and healing. She is a medical officer.

characters.name: Arf
characters.description: Fate's outspoken dog-woman familiar. Her distaste of Precia is mutual, but she cannot do anything to protect Fate from her mother. Arf instead takes out her anger on her enemies. She is very kind to Fate and rather protective of her. (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Yuuno Scrya
characters.description: Before the start of the series, Yūno lived in Mid-childa, a magical world, as an archaeologist. He had no parents, so was raised by his entire tribe, the Scrya, from which he took his surname. He also obtained or created the intelligent device Raising Heart around this time, but his talents lay as a support mage, and so his attack abilities were low and he never made the device into a weapon. Yūno first appears running from a gigantic monster in the woods and attempting to seal the Jewel Seed inside it with Raising Heart. He fails, letting the monster get away, and collapses wounded on the ground. Yūno uses his remaining power to call out to the nearest magic user and turns into a ferret. His call was heard in Nanoha Takamachi's dream, and later that day, she found the ferret in the woods and took him to the veterinary hospital. He quickly recovered, taking a liking to Nanoha and recogni

characters.name: Lindy Harlaown
characters.original: リンディ・ハラオウン
characters.description: Lindy, the kind-spirited captain of the spaceship Asura, works for the Time-Space Administration Bureau. She enjoys drinking green tea with sugar (and sometimes cream) added, which is ironic given her appreciation of Japanese culture. She is Chrono's mother.

characters.name: Zafila
characters.description: Zafila is dark skinned, only male, member of Wolkenritter, Guardians of the Book of Darkness. He is, like Arf, able to transform into a wolf, and he was called Familiar many times, although he negates it, saying that he is "Guardian Wolf" of his master. When not battling, Zafila is almost always in his wolf form, because his ears and tail stays visible while in human form. Zafila is original counter part of Arf, Fate's familiar. Later, Arf teaches him how to change to "Puppy form".

characters.name: Chrono Harlaown
characters.description: Chrono is a young officer of the Time-Space Administration Bureau and wields the S2U,a storage device in the first season and an ice-type Intelligent Device named Durandal in A's. His personality is usually one who looks at things from a logical approach, but he has made jokes on occasion. His mother Lindy is his commanding officer and the Admiral of the Asura, while his father isn't mentioned (revealed in A's to be deceased.) Together they used thier influence within the TSAB to aid in Fate's trial,afterwhich he trained Fate in combat before her return in A's where she became his adopted sister. In the first season Chrono displays his control over shooting-type spells when he aids Nanoha during the attack on the Garden of Time,so much so that Nanoha is speechless at his skill. As of StrikerS he has become the Admiral of his own ship,the Claudia while his mother lives on Earth next to Na

characters.name: Reinforce I
characters.description: Reinforce is a key character in Magical Girl Lyrical Nanoha A's, who reveals herself near the end. She does not appear in either Magical Girl Lyrical Nanoha or the alternate universe shown in the Triangle Heart series. She is voiced by Sanae Kobayashi. The former Book of Darkness and creator of the Wolkenritter (Signum, Vita, Shamal and Zafira), Reinforce was reformed by Hayate Yagami and became her partner. Reinforce is a Lost Logia and an intelligent creation of Belkan mages whose names have been lost to time. In Magical Girl Lyrical Nanoha StrikerS, she is reformatted into the much smaller Reinforce II. Hayate, inside a void in the Book's separate dimension, opens her eyes, but the Book tells her to go back to sleep and escape the tragic reality. She could stay with her friends forever, but it would not be real... Hayate cries out that she did not want this at all. Absorbing the knowl

characters.name: Suzuka Tsukimura
characters.description: Suzuka Tsukimura is a minor character of the Magical Girl Lyrical Nanoha series. The younger sister of Shinobu Tsukimura, Suzuka is a civilian and best friends with Nanoha Takamachi and Alisa Bannings. In Magical Girl Lyrical Nanoha A's, she befriends Hayate Yagami, not knowing of the war between Hayate's protectors the Wolkenritter and the Time-Space Administration Bureau, for which Nanoha works. Suzuka does not exist in Triangle Heart. Suzuka is a grade three student in the same class as Nanoha and Alisa, and already sure what she wants to do with her life: continue on her family tradition of rich, successful engineers. She lives in a huge mansion with her maids Noel and Farin K. Ehrlichkeit, sister Shinobu and many cats, one of which is affected by a Jewel Seed. As a small child, she was bullied by the more aggressive Alisa, but Nanoha stood up to Alisa and the trio became friends. Wh

characters.name: Alisa Bannings
characters.description: Alisa Bannings is a minor character of the Magical Girl Lyrical Nanoha series. Best friends with Nanoha Takamachi and Suzuka Tsukimura, Alisa is the daughter of two successful company owners and has plans of succeeding them. Alisa was adapted from the character of Alisa Lowell in Triangle Heart, but besides being a living being, is much friendlier and holds no such grudge against the world. Alisa is an outspoken, dog-loving Anglophone and multimillionaire heiress. She gets angry at Nanoha halfway through the series for keeping secrets from her friends. Despite this, she cares deeply for her friend. She is a strong-willed person the apparent leader in her small circle of friends. When she has bursts of rage at not fully understanding what's going on, Suzuka is usually there to calm her down. Alisa is proficient with English and loves dogs, owning about ten at her large mansion. Similarly

characters.name: Amy Limietta
characters.original: エイミィ・リミエッタ
characters.description: In Magical Girl Lyrical Nanoha, Amy works on the Arthra as the Chief of Operations, and is a good friend to Chrono and Lindy. She is an officer cadet, often tasked with research and intelligence gathering, which are her specialties. In StrikerS: ~! she and [Chrono](https://anilist.co/character/4179/Chrono-Harlaown) are married with twins, a boy and a girl.!~

title: Koibito Play
description: Okuno Ryouko and Saeki are quiet normal students. But only at the surface. At university, they both feel out of place; so, Okuno visits a S&M club after classes. Saeki happens to visit this club as well; rather than participating in the activities like Okuno, he is there to play music. When they both meet there, they seem somewhat attracted to each other. But will this attraction last, when they come to know about each other better? Will love be able to bloom?

title: Ashi no Aji
description: Ever since she was little, Ishihara has had a "thing" for women's legs. In fact, she became vice-president of the student council just so she could spend more time admiring president Kurosaki's shapely, kissable limbs. But when the worshipper and the worshipped are locked in a room with one another, a misunderstanding gives way to unspeakable desire... (Source: Anime-Planet)

characters.name: Ishihara
characters.description: The main character and Student Council vice-president.

title: Cosplay Yuri Ecchi Anthology
title_original: コスプレ百合えっちアンソロジー

title: Out of the Cocoon
title_original: アウト・オブ・ザ・コクーン
description: Yuriko Hara, author of the atmospheric, eerily beautiful yuri Cocoon Entwined, brings us five haunting stories of love and attachment. Ranging from horrific to wistful, these captivating tales, featuring both yuri and Boys Love, are sure to ensnare readers. Fans of her previous work will be especially delighted by the final piece, which provides an extra chapter of Youko and Hana's story. (Source: Yen Press) Sweet Dreams Zombie (スウィート・ドリームス・ゾンビ); Comic Beam 2023-12, 2024-01 Moshimo, Ashita Sekai ga Owaru nara (もしも、明日世界が終わるなら); Comic Beam 2019-04 Dog Eat Dog (ドッグ・イート・ドッグ); J.GARDEN 45 52 Hertz no Kujira (52ヘルツの鯨); Éclair Orange Out of the Cocoon (アウト・オブ・ザ・コクーン); COMITIA 145

title: Kanaete! Yuri Yousei
title_original: かなえて！ゆりようせい
description: When you wish for a Yuri love with all your heart, your wish might be granted by the Yuri Fairy. Just don’t forget to stamp her card. (Source: Yuricon)

title: Yuri-zukushi no Kyoushitsu de
description: Class 1 of the 2nd grade at an average girls' high school, filled with 30 students with rich personalities, is always lively and never boring. If you take a closer look, you'll see the thoughts and feelings of each of the 30 students.... A "yuri-flavored" school-life omnibus story about a class full of individuality! (Source: Ichijinsha, translated)

title: Kaii-bu: M-ken Y-shi no Kaigenshou ni Tsuite
title_original: 怪異部～M県Y市の怪現象について～
description: When transfer student Sakura Sakuraba arrives in Yuuyamichou, she discovers a place steeped in bizarre, ancient customs. The children there all have strange names and are bound by a curse that prevents them from leaving the city until they graduate high school. Caught in an escalating nightmare, Sakura must navigate curses, summonings, and betrayals. To break the curse and free the children, Sakura teams up with Uzu Andou, the mysterious president of the Paranormal Club. Their strange "club activities" are about to begin! (Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Love Live! School idol diary
title_original: ラブライブ! School idol diary
description: Love Live! School idol diary is a collection of side stories that happen concurrently alongside the TV anime's events! With each new story told from the point of view of a different member of the beloved idol group μ's, who knows what to expect!? Come along once again to Otonokizaka High, and experience all-new never before seen stories about the legendary school idols!

characters.name: Rin Hoshizora
characters.description: __Height:__ 155cm Rin appears to be a bit of a tomboy, though with a girly streak. She likes sports and is arguably the most athletic member of μ's, on par with Eli. Like Honoka, Rin is very energetic, hard-working and active. One key difference between her and Honoka, however, is that Rin is known for being very mindful of other people's opinions, as she puts their feelings first before taking action into something.

characters.name: Kotori Minami
characters.description: __Height:__ 159 cm Kotori is known for having her head in the clouds. Despite this, she is μ's designer along with [Nico Yazawa](https://anilist.co/character/46163/Yazawa-Nico). Kotori has a very huge aptitude for fashion and is very good at drawing costumes for the group. Kotori is shown to be very kind and supportive to her friends and genuinely cares about them, especially their feelings. However, this can go too far as Kotori usually backs [Honoka](https://anilist.co/character/46171/Kousaka-Honoka) up when she is scolded by [Umi](https://anilist.co/character/46167/Sonoda-Umi). Kotori is also shown as the most indecisive person among all nine members and tends to have her friends make decisions for her. She also has a hard time expressing her feelings, since she always takes other people's feelings into consideration.

characters.name: Hanayo Koizumi
characters.description: __Height:__ 156 cm A shy girl who dreamed of being an idol since she was very young; Rin and Maki finally convince her to join µ's.

characters.name: Nico Yazawa
characters.description: __Height:__ 154 cm Nico has been observing [Honoka's](https://anilist.co/character/46171/Kousaka-Honoka) new Idol group for a while but eventually joins them. She has past experiences as an amateur school idol. At first, she was secretly the President of the school's unknown Idol Research Club, but after an incident, the club was later joined together with Honoka's Idol Club. She likes bossing people around and acting superior, but she also has an energetic and cheeky personality.

characters.name: Maki Nishikino
characters.description: __Height:__ 161 cm Maki Nishikino is a first-year​ high school student in Otonokizaka High School. She has a beautiful voice and loves jazz music more than anyone else in the group. At first, she didn't want to join µ's because she had decided to inherit their family's hospital and take up medicine in college, but after joining forces with Rin to push Hanayo to join, she decides to follow the same path and join along with her two fellow first years.

characters.name: Umi Sonoda
characters.description: __Height: __159cm Umi is normally a shy girl, but she has a strong will and some qualities of a leader. Despite this, she is content to stay reserved and always thinks logically. Umi is uncomfortable with wearing short skirts but gets used to it after their first live. Although Umi tends to be hard on others, she is especially hard on herself. She doesn't do anything criminal and despises laziness.

characters.name: Nozomi Toujou
characters.description: __Height:__ 159 cm Nozomi is the vice-president of Otonokizaka High School. She is the best friend of [Eli](https://anilist.co/character/46173/Ayase-Eli). She is also a Shrine Maiden in a temple because she believes that a shrine is the source of people's faith. Eventually she will join the school idol club with Eli and will be one of the most successful school idols. (Source: Character Book)

characters.name: Honoka Kousaka
characters.description: __Height:__ 157 cm Honoka is the main character, who is a second-year student at Otonokizaka Academy. Her family works in a japanese sweet shop named Homura. When Otonokizaka Academy is planned to be shut down due to lack of applicants, Honoka becomes determined to save it by starting up a school idol group. Honoka also has a knack for finding loose change on the ground. Since she was young, she has been friends with [Kotori](https://anilist.co/character/46013/Minami-Kotori), and she befriended [Umi](https://anilist.co/character/46167/Sonoda-Umi) after inviting her to play hide and seek. ~!In Season 2, she becomes the new Student Council President by everyone's recommendation.!~

characters.name: Eli Ayase
characters.description: __Height:__ 162 cm Eli Ayase is the student council president of the Otonokizaka High School. Along with her best friend, [Nozomi](https://anilist.co/character/46169/Toujou-Nozomi), they do plans so the closure of the school could be prevented. She is partly Russian because her grandmother is a Russian. Alongside Nozomi, they join the school idol group for the prevention of their schools closure.

title: 11-banme no Neko wa Nene
description: Pointy ears, check. Furry tail, check! Here goes nothing—Nene’s life as a cat starts now! A meek little mouse from the rodent island of Konoshima, Nene smuggled herself into the land of catfolk and arrived at Rairai Teahouse looking for work…but found it already staffed by ten older cat girls! Surrounded by pretty faces, sharp claws, and even sharper eyes, Nene’s ready to give work all she’s got—after all, she can’t afford to be one paw out of place! (Source: Yen Press)

title: BUTTERFLY 69
description: 1. Butterfly 69 (Butterfly69); Comic Yuri Hime 2007-09 Agetha and Maria are two music students striving for the same dream, Maria's successful music career. Agetha supports Maria by always saying "My dream is your dream" but it isn't until Maria gets her big break that she realizes she has to drop out and most importantly, leave Agetha behind. Will their relationship be able to last? or will it crumble under the pressure? 2. Butterfly 69: Instant Summer 3. Quilt Queen (Quilt Queen); Comic Yuri Hime 2008-12 A promise between high school sweet hearts flourishes, at least for top model Dahlia it does. While Sakura is left as a nobody fashion designer still trying to get her start. It isn't until Dahlia's manager demands that Sakura give up her love for Dahlia does she work harder to be on equal footing with Dahlia. Will their love over come this crisis? 4. Quilt Queen+ 5. Beautiful Pain (Beautiful Pain); Comic Yuri Hime S 2009-02 6. Okujo no Kiseki (屋上のキセキ, Rooftop Miracle); Comic Yuri Hime 2009-05 7. Spicy Sweets (Spicy Sweets); Comic Yuri Hime 2007-03 8. Butterfly Effect It's difficult balancing a relationship when work is so hectic, at least that's how it is for Agetha and Maria. W

title: Yuta-san wa Mamanaranai!
title_original: ゆたさんはままならない！
description: Contents: 1-5. Ponkotsu no Uta 6. Ponkotsu no Uta Extra 7. Usotsuki wa

title: Tomodachi Ijou?
description: Kasumi and Akari are friends. They will learn together the meaning of love. Meanwhile Kasumi's sister is having a surprising conversation with her female co-worker Sasano Ayumu. Included chapters: 11.5, 16.5

title: Uso no Tsukenai Otoshigoro
description: In Japan, a mysterious and bizarre disease called "dissociative true feelings" has become epidemic among adolescents. The disease is not particularly life-threatening, but when one becomes excited, an alter ego will appear to express one's true feelings without any pretense. Sayoi's twin sister, Satsuki, a second-year high school girl, developed the syndrome after an incident in junior high, which also caused her to lose her voice. Since then, Sayoi has strictly avoided contact with the opposite sex in order to protect her sister, who can no longer speak with anything other than her true feelings. One day, however, she meets a boy, Shougo, who also suffers from the same disease, and the relationship between the sisters begins to change...? (Source: Comico, translated) Note: Includes four extra chapters.

title: Kodoku no Mori no Majo
description: In the lonely center of a lonely, snow-laden forest lies a small cabin where two witches dwell. A meditation on their love, hatred, and loneliness.

title: Ikenai Ano Ko to Ikenai Basho de
title_original: いけないあの子といけない場所で

title: TS Gakuen no Nichijou
description: TS Gakuen is a boys' school where several students with OTMS syndrome, which causes them to temporarily become female for various reasons, are enrolled, The story depicts the daily life of these students and their thrilling school life. (Source: Nico Nico Seiga, translated)

title: Hatshepsut
title_original: ハトシェプスト―古代エジプト王朝唯一人の女ファラオ
description: A collection of oneshots. 1. Hatshepsut Beginning in 1511 B.C. Egypt, where two sisters -- the clever Menou and the beautiful but spacey Seshen -- are taken in by the family of the pharaoh for their ability to heal wounds. There, they meet Hatshepsut, the beautiful androgynous daughter of the pharaoh and future queen, who is said to be more suited to rule than her husband. She and Seshen quickly take a liking to each other, much to Menou's displeasure. 2. Hatshepsut II A look into Hatshepsut's childhood, as she grew from a simple tomboy to a girl determined to become pharaoh. Other oneshots: Chimaera, Wadatsumi no Irokonomiya, Sphinx.

title: Yuri Danshi
description: Hanadera is a high school boy who loves yuri to the point he constantly watches his female classmates and just lets his imagination run wild. He’s living the fabulous life of a man obsessed with yuri, but this is also source of personal conflict: if a yuri-filled world is so perfect, where does he fit in as a man? Note: Includes five extra chapters.

title: Sweet Little Devil
description: A collection of stories by Nanzaki Iku (better known by the circle name Doropanda Tours), mostly from Yuri Hime Wildrose. Sweet Little Devil Heart and Soul Moment Like Fireworks Love Prep Room Our Future Plans Starting Over One And Only Girls Don't Cry Another Sweet Field (Source: Lililicious)

title: Yuri ni Tanpopo
description: Fujii Kanae just broke up with her boyfriend, when her older sister Mizuho calls her to ask for her hospitality for her and... her girlfriend. How will Kanae, who hadn't ever imagined her sister to be a lesbian, cope with this cohabitation?

title: Koisuru Sugar Cotton
title_original: 恋するシュガーコットン
description: A woman steps in when she sees a girl being bullied. Note: Originally published in Tsubomi magazine vol. 11.

title: Adaru Toys!
description: Akane Oguri, a JK. Her curiosity got the better of her one day and she goes in to a sex shop. The rest is history. In this series, Akane, together with her friends, will teach us about masturbation in hilarious, silly and playful stories.

title: Rainy Song
description: 1. Aru Shoujo no Gunjou (或る少女の群青が, A Girl in Ultramarine) 2-3. Kurayami no Asterisk (くらやみのアスタリスク, Asterisk's War) 4. Snowflakes (スノーフレイクス) 5. Rainy Song (レイニーソング)

title: Doukyonin ga Fuantei deshite
title_original: 同居人が不安定でして
description: A story about the daily lives of two roommates, Fuantei-san, a slightly unstable illustrator, and Shikkari-san, a capable career woman.

title: Apricot Fuzz
description: Every day, after school, that's when the secret talk between girls start. The popular girl, Nanba Rinon, confides to the introvert Furutsuji about the abuse she suffers daily at the hands of her father... to indulge herself in the pleasure of self-pity. While Furutsuji comforts Rinon with deep compassion, there is malice lurking behind that smile... She realizes Rinon's XX. (Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Sasayaku You ni Koi wo Utau: Koushiki Comic Anthology
title_original: ささやくように恋を唄う　公式コミックアンソロジー
description: The first official "Sasayaku You ni Koi o Utau'" comic anthology is here! Talented authors with unique styles tell stories that begin with a crush at first sight. [Participating Authors] COVER: Aono Nachi. ILLUSTRATIONS: Yosuke Kaneda, Miman. MANGA: Aotsubaki Toto, Aono Shimo, Ito Hachi, Inui, Utatane Yuu, Sikusiku, Torii Shizuku, Nekotarou, Haruhana Aya, Mukunoki Nanatsu, Yuama, Yukiko. (Source: Amazon, translated)

characters.name: Himari Kino
characters.description: Himari is a very joyous, cheerful girl and often likened to a puppy by other characters. She is able to instantly befriend anyone, even hard to approach characters like [Shiho](https://anilist.co/character/215602/Izumi-Shiho). Himari is always wanting the best for her friends and cheering them on in whatever they pursue.

characters.name: Yori Asanagi
characters.description: A third year high school student who sings while playing guitar at the school rooftops and loves collecting cat merchandise. She is also a part of the "SS Girls" band in which she is positioned as the guitarist and vocalist.

characters.name: Miki Mizuguchi
characters.description: She is part of the brass band club who indirectly helps [Himari](https://anilist.co/character/167670/Kino-Himari)'s and [Yori](https://anilist.co/character/167671/Asanagi-Yori)'s relationship by collecting information.

characters.name: Shiho Izumi
characters.description: She is a third-year high school student and the main vocalist for the band Laureley.

characters.name: Momoka Satomiya
characters.description: She is a second year and President of the Culinary Research Club, she is also Laureley's bassist.

characters.name: Mari Tsutsui
characters.description: She is a third-year student and drummer in SS GIRLS.

characters.name: Kaori Tachibana
characters.description: She is a third-year student and keyboardist in SS GIRLS.

characters.name: Aki Mizuguchi
characters.description: Aki is a third year high school student and the bassist for the SS Girls. She is best friends with [Yori](https://anilist.co/character/167671/Asanagi-Yori) and was one of the first people to encourage her to pursue [Himari](https://anilist.co/character/167670/Kino-Himari). ~!Yori and Aki are best friends. Aki sometime after they became friends fell in love with her, having wanted several times to take an "extra step" but decided to not confess her feelings and only stay by her side as a friend in fear of losing their current relationship.!~

characters.name: Hajime Amasawa
characters.description: She is a third year high school student and Laureley's drummer.

title: Swing!!
description: Miyasato Haruka, lover of video games and sweets, was going to spend her school days immersed in video games, when Ibuki, determined to bring back the Golf Club, appeared! Ibuki then dragged Haruka into playing golf.... And so, the story of the high school girls of the Golf Club unfolds, a cute and youthful slice-of-life comedy! Note: Chapter count includes five volume-bonus chapters.

characters.name: Haruka Miyasato
characters.description: Member of the golf club, she is a cheerful and laid-back person with an honest and friendly personality. She gets along with everyone. She loves sweets and games. She is not good with the driver.

characters.name: Ibuki Yokomine
characters.description: President of the Golf Club, reviving the club after it had been closed down. Contrary to her public persona of academic excellence and good behavior, she has a mischievous side, She is a caring person and a good leader of the club.

characters.name: Natsuhi Okamoto
characters.description: Golf club member. She is bright and active, an athletic prodigy who can do anything, so she is always being recruited by various sports clubs. She loves to hit the ball and make it fly far with her driver.

characters.name: Kaede Higuchi
characters.description: A member of the golf club. She is serious buy shy. She has been friends with Natsuhi since kindergarten. They were separated in junior high school, but reunited in high school. She is not good at sports.

title: Maou-sama, Re Re Revenge!
title_original: 魔王さま、リリリベンジ！
description: The junior-high girl Mada Ooma recalls a past life as the Demon Lord. She (he) has but one lingering regret about her previous life: that she wasn’t able to confess her love to Lili, her attendant. A love that would never come true... or so she thought, until Lili somehow appeared in front of her eyes in her new life...!? A bright and pure romantic comedy weaving together the past and present lives of a former Demon Lord, who’s now being taken for a ride by the one she loves! (Source: Shogakukan, translated)

title: Bu Zhi Bixia Shi Nülang
description: The new emperor, Qi Nian, acceded to the throne many years ago. He kept refusing the requests by his officials to choose a consort, brushing them off by saying "I am busy with work. The affairs of state are more important." But Qi Nian finally relented as rumors that "the emperor is impotent" began to spread. Yu Dingdang is a rather dim-witted girl, but born to a prestigious family. This led many to say: "Miss Yu exchanged her brain for her looks". Nobody expected that she would be chosen by the emperor to be his empress consort? Yu Dingdang acted surprised on the outside, "Who? What? Me?" But inside she was thrilled, because she has wanted to become Qi Nian's bride ever since she was little. When she successfully marries her crush, that is when a slapstick comedy breaks out in the palace, when she finds out that the haughty emperor is actually a woman?! (Source: Bilibili, translated)

title: Android wa Jirai-kei no Yume wo Miru.
title_original: アンドロイドは地雷系の夢を見る。

title: Cutie Honey Vs. Devilman Lady
title_original: キューティーハニー対デビルマンレディー
description: Fudou Jun (Devilman Lady) heads to St. Chapel School in order to track down a Devil Beast.

characters.name: Jun Fudo
characters.description: Jun is a successful supermodel in Tokyo when the story begins. She is found by a woman, Lan Asuka who forces her to confront a werewolf-like monster called a Devil-beast. As it tears into Jun, her own powers awaken within her and she becomes a Devil-beast herself. She defeats the beast with her new powers and reverts back to her human form. Asuka then tells her that she is a member of a military unit known as the Human Alliance whose purpose is to hunt down and kill all those who are affected with Devil Beast Syndrome. Asuka gives Jun an ultimatum; if Jun doesn't hunt for them, she will be hunted by them. Jun has no choice but to obey Asuka from that point on. Jun is a very quiet and timid person who seems to avoid most social interactions, with two exceptions. She is generally open with her manager and outright friendly with an aspiring teen model named Kazumi. As the series progresses

characters.name: Honey Kisaragi
characters.description: Honey Kisaragi is a regular Catholic schoolgirl, until the day her father is murdered by the "Panther Claw" Organization. After his death, she learns she is actually an android created by him and within her is the Fixed System of Air Elements. By saying "Honey Flash!" she can transform into the sword-wielding red-haired superhero, Cutie Honey.

characters.name: Asuka Lan
characters.description: Asuka is the woman who scouted Jun for the Human Alliance, and is a high-ranking government official. As far as her personality goes, she is a cold, aggressive, and manipulative woman, who cares nothing for the people who work under her. When she forced Jun to confront the Devil-beast Wolver, she had no concern for Jun's survival, her theory that Jun was a Devil-beast was based only on a hunch. As the series progresses, even though she is cruel to Jun, she cares about Jun's safety. She acts as Jun's liaison and tells her when and where a beast will appear. She seems to have different intentions from her organisation and does a great deal of work without their knowledge.

characters.name: Natsuko Aki
characters.description: As with many of the supporting characters in Cutie Honey, Aki has taken on many different roles. In the original manga she is Honey's friend and roommate at the all girls school they go to. In Re: Cutie Honey Aki Natsuko is a lead Investigator for the National Police Security Task Force – Branch 9. She is cold and controlling and is an absolute perfectionist. While she is an exceptional police officer she also has the bad habit of getting “in over her head” into trouble. She is an expert marksman. She tends to wear black a lot and lives alone in a small apartment. She has a passion for Japanese Sake and when she gets drunk loves to sing Karaoke. Hides her beauty by wearing non-prescription eyeglasses.

characters.name: Sister Jill
characters.description: From story to story Sister Jill roles slightly differ, sometimes she is leader of Panther Claw and sometimes she is the head subordinate of the mysterious leader of Panther Claw.

title: Sayonara Folklore
title_original: さよならフォークロア
description: Hayase has gone to the same school for years, so she knows that you do *not* touch anyone on Monday, and if you do, there's a little incantation that must be recited. But Mashiro has just transferred in, and does not know these things. Hayase explains that we do not touch on Monday, because not too long ago two girls did - and they fell in love, became lovers and tried to die together. Therefore, if you don't recite the charm, you might fall in love with whomever touched you...and that would be bad. Of course Hayase explains this after Mashiro has touched her...on a Monday. Notes: - Includes three extras. - Includes the one-shot "Hakase no Koneko to Ame no Asa"

title: Hei Yueguang Nü Zhu Zong Xiang Biaoji Wo
title_original: 黑月光女主总想标记我
description: A manipulative and calculating Alpha (Disguised as an Omega) × A cold-on-the-outside fearful Omega (Disguised as an Alpha)! When designer Gu Yu transmigrates into an ABO romance, she becomes the villain who will be killed by the protagonist, Su Yue. In order to survive, she decides to flatter the 'fragile Omega', creating stunning looks and helping her dominate showbiz. But Su Yue is not an Omega… she is an Alpha in disguise! And now, with intoxicating wine pheromones, she demands: 'Ready to be marked and be mine?'" (Source: Bilibili, translated)

title: Mahou Shoujo no Majo Saiban
description: The Beautiful Yet Cruel Witch Trial Begins!! Ema, a high school girl, finds herself imprisoned in a jail. When the warden’s voice echoes through the prison, the curtain rises on a cruel game. (Source: Kadokawa, translated)

characters.name: Ema Sakuraba
characters.description: __Height:__ 156cm __Prisoner Number:__ 658 A friendly girl who refers to herself using the self-pronoun 'boku'. She's a clumsy failure, often taken care of by others in many ways. She's a lonely person who loves the warmth of others, the reason she acts cheerful is because she's scared of being alone. Being quite smart, she has a sound sense of judgement, but she purposely makes mistakes due to a fear of being hated. When she wants to help others, she shows surprising deductions skills. She has the perseverance to not give up or be discouraged.

characters.name: Hiro Nikaidou
characters.description: __Height:__ 157cm __Prisoner Number:__ 659 A girl with excellent grades and seemingly no faults. Polite and serious, a "Yamato Nadeshiko". She has a strong sense of justice. She shows no tolerance to that which she deems "not right".

characters.name: Leia Hasumi
characters.description: __Height:__ 172 cm __Prisoner Number:__ 662 Leia is a aspires to become a star actress and is the top performer in her theater troupe. Her androgynous appearance makes her extremely popular with women. She is often perceived as arrogant but she is hard-working, has a strong sense of responsibility, and always feels she must be at the center of things and protect those around her. Because she is unable to rely on others, she usually carries a lot of pressure.

characters.name: Anan Natsume
characters.description: __Height:__ 145 cm __Prisoner Number:__ 660 Anan is a reclusive girl who rarely speaks and primarily communicates through writing in a sketchbook.

characters.name: Noa Jougasaki
characters.description: __Height:__ 150 cm __Prisoner Number:__ 661 Noa is a street artist with a laid-back and elusive personality. Her art is popular all over the world but no one has ever known that she is the artist behind it. She wishes to bring her ideal painting to life, depicting her own happiness in her art, but it seems she has never completed a work that she is satisfied with.

characters.name: Arisa Shitou
characters.description: __Height:__ 154 cm __Prisoner Number:__ 666 Arisa is a delinquent runaway. She has a very foul mouth, is intimidating and quick to pick a fight. She hasn't been home or in school for two years and has never made any close friends. She hangs out in the city center at night and likes being in underground areas but doesn't commit any crimes other than fighting. She dislikes many things but more than anything, she hates herself the most.

characters.name: Margo Housho
characters.description: __Height:__ 160 __Prisoner Number:__ 664 Margo is a con-artist who treats everyone in a friendly and kind manner. Because she doesn't truly trust anyone, she doesn't take anything seriously and always behaves with a carefree attitude.

characters.name: Nanoka Kurobe
characters.description: __Height:__ 161 cm __Prisoner Number:__ 665 Nanoka harbors intense hostility towards the prison. She is not very talkative and often acts in a way that pushes others away. She is emotionally stable and calmly accomplishes her goals, regardless of the means. She is more familiar with the the rules and structure of the prison than the other prisoners but prefers to act alone rather than cooperate with others since she dislikes being a burden. Due to this, she is often lost or missing. Her cool, detached attitude towards others doesn't seem to reflect her true personality.

characters.name: Sherry Tachibana
characters.description: __Height:__ 162 cm __Prisoner Number:__ 667 Sherry calls herself a great detective. She has a cheerful and free-spirited personality, readily jumping into anything fun without hesitation. She believes being a detective is her true calling. She has a lot of curiosity but she possesses absolutely no sense of morality. She has a side to her that is almost completely oblivious to the atmosphere of a situation.

characters.name: Miria Saeki
characters.description: __Height:__ 163 cm __Prisoner Number:__ 663 Miria has a white-skinned gyaru-style appearance. She likes old movies. Despite her flashy appearance, she is quiet and timid, as well as clumsy but kind-hearted. In every word she says, there is a hint of melancholy that is beyond her years.

characters.name: Hanna Toono
characters.description: __Height:__ 148 cm __Prisoner Number:__ 668 Hanna speaks in a refined, ladylike manner. She is completely detached from reality and behaves arrogantly. She pretends to be the daughter of a prestigious family but in reality, she comes from a very poor background. She often speaks boastfully and quickly becomes confrontational when criticized. However, she seems to have a kind heart and her good nature is evident to those she is close to.

characters.name: Meruru Hikami
characters.description: __Height:__ 158 cm __Prisoner Number:__ 670 Meruru is extremely timid and anxious but also exhibits stalker-like behavior, following anyone who catches her attention. She is sensitive to the feelings of others and tends to hide in the shadows, worrying about what others think. She is always half-crying, and tears start flowing at the slightest provocation. She is extremely negative about herself and very self-deprecating but she also always respects other people.

characters.name: Coco Sawatari
characters.description: __Height:__ 158 cm __Prisoner Number:__ 669 Coco is a streamer. While she appears positive and cheerful during live streams, her true nature is extremely sharp-tongued, and her mood swings are very intense. She hates everything in the world except for herself and her favorite idol.

characters.name: Gokuchou
characters.description: The warden of the prison. A mysterious owl who manages the trials, the prisoners, and the entire estate.

title: Kanojo no Kanojo to Fujun na Hatsukoi
title_original: 彼女のカノジョと不純な初恋
description: "In exchange for my help with your studies, you must stay let me stay at your house until summer vacation." If I get a failing mark again, my chance to live by myself will be over. So I'm forced to go along with the proposal from Tsukasa, the smartest and most beautiful girl in school. But then I saw them. I saw Tsukasa kissing a girl in the park. Tsukasa, who often annoys me with her abnormal invasions of my personal space, has a “girlfriend." Her yuri friend is against this arrangement because she thinks it's “cheating” even if it's between two girls, but Tsukasa is having none of it. After a while, my grades are improving and I'm beginning to enjoy living with Tsukasa. I know that “it's not cheating if you're not in love with them,” but… I'm okay with it. If I don't think about love, we can all get along and be happy, right? (Source: Dengeki Bunko, translated)

title: Gurenki
description: Suou is just a normal high school student. One night, she dreams about a red-haired demon girl... who shows up the next day in the middle of class and "claims" her as her property.

title: Assault Lily: League of Gardens -full bloom-
title_original: アサルトリリィ League of Gardens -full bloom-
description: When the enigmatic life-forms called the Huge appeared, they nearly brought the world to ruin. But humanity studied the energy called magie and created CHARMs, potent weapons against the Huge. Teenage girls, who proved to resonate the most with CHARMs, became the vanguard in the war with the Huge. There is a name for these girls who fight against humankind's end. They are known as elegant flowers of battle—as Lilies. A manga adaptation of the stage play "Assault Lily: League of Gardens."

characters.name: Riri Hitotsuyanagi
characters.description: __Height:__ 156 cm __Charm:__ Gungnir A refugee who was deprived from her home by the Huge. When her life was saved by [Yuyu](https://anilist.co/character/148366/Yuyu-Shirai), she pursued her dream to be miraculously enrolled at Yurigaoka Jogakuin. Riri has the belief that even people with different opinions can understand each other. From this philosophy, she will fight with many Lilies and gradually emerge in the battle against the Huge. She a hard worker and works hard on everything. A little natural but bright and gentle personality. Her favorite food is Ramune juice.

characters.name: Yuyu Shirai
characters.description: __Charm:__ Dainsleif __Height:__163 cm __Rare Skill:__ Lunatic Trancer The Lily who represents all of Yurigaoka. She has fought the Huge in the front lines and has stood victorious across many battlefields. Being one of the most prominent Lilies at Yurigaoka Jogakuin and wielding incredible combat power, Yuyu holds a rare skill called 'Lunatic Transer,' and has garnered many fans because she fights hard with mental instability. Although she was nicknamed 'Shinigami,' having lost her friend from her negligence, Yuyu overcomes many trials and grows into a great Lily.

characters.name: Fumi Futagawa
characters.description: __Charm:__ Gungnir __Height:__ 152 cm With an overwhelming quality and quantity, this 'Lily Otaku' has a wide range of knowledge not only about individual Lillys but also about CHARMs and tactical strategies. Although she does not normally assert herself, she becomes very excited when it comes to Lily-related topics.

characters.name: Thi Mai Yoshimura
characters.description: __Charm:__ Thuân Thiên __Height:__ 156 cm __Rare Skill:__ Shukuchi A genius Lily from Vietnam who dislikes strict training. She has a bubbly, upbeat personality that is unobtrusive and will never get angry even if she is ridiculed. A natural moodmaker, she can be relied upon by her peers.

characters.name: Tazusa Andou
characters.description: __Age:__ 15 __Height:__ 158 cm __Rare Skill:__ Phantasm Because she has lived a harsh life, she has a cold and rebellious attitude towards others because of human distrust. Originally, she was someone that could care for people's hearts, but she has hardly trusted anyone since being betrayed and abused many times. The side effects of Magi Sensitivity, which has been applied as a reinforced lily (boosted lily), can often lead to mental instability, causing Tazusa to be aggressive and never rely on anyone. However, Lily disregards her and deepens the relationship during practical training.

characters.name: Miliam Hildegard von Guropius
characters.original: ミリアム・ヒルデガルド・V・グロピウス
characters.description: __Nationality:__ German __Height:__ 153 cm __Rare Skill:__ Phase Transcendence A bright and friendly personality, but a genius-like troublemaker that causes trouble. Miriam can't control her curiosity and the feeling of playing games, and she loves people and loves talking to people. She has a cute side, so she's not disliked by her peers, but she tends to be shunned by serious people.

characters.name: Kaede Johan Nouvel
characters.description: __Height:__ 164 cm __Nationality:__ French-Japanese __Charm:__ Gungnir __Rare Skill:__ Register A prodigy who ranked number one in the high school transfer examination at Yurigaoka Jogakuin. Kaede is half-French and half-Japanese, and comes from a family who carries the bloodline of both Japanese and French nobility. She boasts high intelligence, a good personality, and a high combat ability that overwhelms the Huge. Known as an impeccable Lily, Kaede has an over-the-top personality of 'loving cute girls.

characters.name: Yujia Wang
characters.description: __Charm:__ Asterion __Height:__ 163 cm Yujia is a self-confident girl thanks to growing up as the middle child of three sisters. Because she is quiet and not good at showing her emotions, she is often misunderstood as "angry". She is roommates with Kuo Shenlin.

characters.name: Shenlin  Kuo
characters.description: __Charm:__ Masolelic __Height:__ 165 cm __Nationality:__ Taiwanese An elegant young lady from Taipei who attends Yurigaoka. Shenlin will speak out against what she believes is wrong, but is usually a very kind girl. She is roommates with Wang Yujia. (Source: Assault Lily Wiki)

characters.name: Shiori Rokkaku
characters.description: __Height:__ 154 cm She has a careless and gentle personality, but has an indomitable nature that never gives up. In a battle with Huge, her clan left her and was annihilated, and she was alone. She has a battle-specific rare skill "Hand of the Ring" that can handle two CHARMs at the same time, and has two names, "Fudokenhime". She has lost feeling in her left arm, which is her dominant arm, due to past injuries. The work on the battlefield is wonderful and is expected to play the future of Yurigaoka. (Source: Assault Lily Wiki)

title: Zhuang Po Huangdi Nüer Shen
description: After transmigrating to another world as a wealthy young master, Su Changqing only wanted to live a low-profile life as a rich second-generation heir and enjoy his days in comfort. However, his plans are suddenly disrupted when his family faces an unexpected crisis, and he accidentally discovers the Emperor's secret - that she is actually a woman. While he initially feared the female Emperor would stop at nothing to silence him, to his surprise, she instead becomes interested in his mysterious ability to transform his appearance. She wants him to become her male body double. What Su Changqing never expected was that being the female Emperor's male substitute would mean he has to visit the imperial harem on his very first day. His peaceful life completely falls apart from that moment on... (Source: Bilibili, translated)

title: Park Gwajang Jugigi
description: "Let's kill your husband... so you can come live with me." (Source: Manta)

title: Hirari, Bessatsu: Bukatsu Joshi Anthology - Houkago!
title_original: ひらり、別冊 部活女子アンソロジー『ほうかご!』
description: Special comic anthology from Hirari focusing on club activities. Volume 1 (2012/10/30) 1. Ryokuka Iinin to Kase-san. (緑化委員と加瀬さん。) [Takashima Hiromi] 2. Hana Kui (花喰い) [Watashiya Kaworu] 3. Houkago no Kanojo (放課後の彼女, Afterschool Girl) [Morinaga Milk] 4. Yubisaki de Skip (ゆびさきでスキップ) [Fukasaku Emi] 5. [Hakamada Mera] 11. Manager no Oshigoto (マネージャーのお仕事) [Kumichou] 12. Wabisabi (わびさび) [Hirao Auri] 13. Zatsudan Chaos (雑談カオス) [Wata Noriko] 14. Nekobu (ねこぶ) [Maeda Tomo] 15.
