title: Wei Huimie Shijie er Jiaban Ba!
title_en: Working Overtime to Destroy the World!
description: Limbo is a shut-in girl who doesn't care for anything except her tentacle comics. Aside from that, everything else is meaningless. On her birthday she wished for the "destruction of the world" and was instead met with a demonic female programmer! The two instantly hit it off, bonding over their common goal of world destruction, the two "project partners" hustle hard everyday to bring the world to an end with hilarious effect. (Source: Bilibili Comics)

title: Soshite Kaede wa Hanayaka ni Saku
title_original: そして楓は華やかに咲く
description: The story of a slave and the girl with missing body parts who bought her.

title: Chao Xia
description: After her parents divorced, Lu Yang lived at her mother's best friend's house and lived with her daughter, Su Gui. Su Gui, bright and gentle, like the warm winter sun, easily illuminated Lu Yang's life, but also her heart. Lu Yang looked at her, like a sister, like a friend... Later, Lu Yang didn't want to be her sister, she wanted to be with her. But after discovering that her feelings for Su Gui had deteriorated, Lu Yang did not want to break the harmony of the moment, and even more afraid of losing her "sister" identity, she could only tolerate dependence and move away from Su Gui. However, after reuniting with Su Gui because of her work, the feelings she had been suppressing grew wildly, like branches of roses, wrapping herself and Su Gui tightly. Is it a long-planned plan or is it fate? (source: Billibilli, translated)

title: Campanella no Tou
description: After painstaking effort, fashion model Ars has achieved immense popularity. However, a genius named Meiko appears next to her. Her overwhelming natural talent captures the world's attention. She doesn't want to lose. Ars is eager to compete, but Meiko's body has a certain problem... Aiming for the top, she walks down the shining runway. To grasp glory. To leave proof that she lived. The girls' fiery radiance pierces their hearts, hot and cold!

title: Voiceful
description: They say no one's ever heard her voice in person... Meet Kanae, an introvert about to have her life transformed in the most unusual way--through music. Kanae's transformation begins when she accidentally bumps into Hina, an independent singer who releases her music via the Internet. As the girls become good friends, they quickly find that they've become one another's inspiration--in more ways than one! (Source: Seven Seas Entertainment) Included one-shots: Tokubetsu na Hito (Someone Special), Tobira (Opening)

title: Apple Parfait: Onee-Loli Yuri Anthology
title_original: アップルパルフェ おねロリ百合アンソロジー
description: The relationship between "girls" and "women". A completely new yuri anthology of "onee-and-loli" stories, created by a total of nine authors! 1. Mashiro-chan no Mirai no Koibito (ましろちゃんの未来の恋人), Hachi Itou 2. Zettai ni Bare te wa Ikenai Soushiki 24-ji (絶対にバレてはいけない葬式２４時), Canno 3. Kaori to Kaze (香りと影), Den Terayama 4. Futari no Ibasho (ふたりの居場所), Hazuki 5. Imouto-chan no Daisuki na Mono (妹ちゃんの大好きなもの), Kirifu Izumi 6. Koma-chan to Sensei no Jikan (こまちゃんとせんせいのじかん), kurimo. 7. Dame na Hito (だめなひと), Masanaga 8. Ichi-jou Shunmu (一畳春夢), Sakasana

title: Cinderella Cosplaytion
title_original: シンデレラコスプレイション
description: Tsukiko, a woman in her twenties, and Hinata, a mysterious girl, meet through their common hobby of cosplay. Tsukiko had quit cosplaying, but still attends events to take photos, while Hinata is just entering this world. How will their relationship develop? Note: Chapter count includes two bonus chapters.

title: Love Flag★Girls!!
description: A manga about pirates, from Yuri Hime's cell phone line. A young woman infiltrates a band of pirates to try and get back a treasure that they stole from her mother.

title: Sentimental Beach Side
title_original: センチメンタル ビーチサイド
description: A lonely girl named Nanami loses her only companionship, her beloved cat. To try and move on from this terrible phase in her life, she tries to go to a resort to relax, but its not working at all, with the pain of loss still very much alive inside of her. Until, she meets a woman that greatly reminds her of what she once lost.

title: Devil Shot
description: The moment I looked Death in the eye, I made a contract with the Lord of the Underworld.

title: Lang Xiaojie He Ta De Huli Meimei
title_original: 狼小姐和她的狐狸妹妹
description: The setting is a modern world populated with beast-people, ruled by the law of the jungle. Twenty-year-old Yu Wenxi is a wolf-woman who stands at the top of the food chain. She fought her way to the top with her bare hands with a fierce attitude and no respect for the weak. Until one day, when her stepsister dumped a fox cub on her. From then on, the wild wolf turned into a gentle guard dog. She vowed to raise the crybaby cub to become a good student and a good citizen! However, the fox-girl's good-girl appearance hides a dark side. Little Fox: "Sister, I've been a good girl, can you… do something nice for me?" (Blinking back tears) Now that the crybaby fox cub is all grown up, her first order of business is to find and capture the gray wolf that abandoned her. She'll chain that wolf to her territory, and never let her escape… (Source: Bilibili, translated) Note: Includes five extras.

title: Girlish Sweet
description: A collection of connected standalone oneshots by Takemiya Jin. - Truffle Nature - Thyme Orange - Sweet Acid - Best Friends - Good Faith - Be Connected - Hands - Be jealous of - April 2/3 - May 3/3 - Tee hee hee - July 1/3 - 3/3 Memories - Happiness (Source: Okazu)

title: Umibe no Cain
description: Nobuko Mori is a tomboyish young woman who has just moved into a town by the sea. Through a chance encounter, she comes to know Sano, an older woman who is a fashion designer for children's clothing and lives in the same town. As the two become good friends, complicated matters deeply rooted in Mori's heart begin to surface... An unflinching, frank drama between women centered on the growth of a woman.

characters.name: Nobuko Mori
characters.description: A masculine presenting girl who works part-time at a café. She has a poor relationship with her mother leading her to feel like her childhood has been "prolonged".

characters.name: Sano
characters.description: A fashion designer who designs girls' clothes. Her parents passed away when she was very young.

title: Omote demo Ura demo Ijimerareteru
title_original: 表でも裏でもイジメられてる

title: Love Love Shitai Tatsunomiya-san wa Jouriku Shimashita
title_original: 結婚したい竜宮さんは上陸しました
description: A romantic fable between an undersea princess and a handsome college girl. (Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Ari no Manma no Anata
title_original: ありのまんまのあなた
description: Kaede, a young woman, has given herself a much more masculine haircut. Despite her insistence that it was merely out of her own preference, she still receives some hassle for it. On her way home from work, frustrated, she stumbles upon Yoshino, a battered young woman - and one that seems to have had problems with men.... A 'girl meets girl' one-shot that gazes upon "our real selves".

title: Hiiragi-chan to Tomikawa-chan
title_original: 柊ちゃんと富川ちゃん

title: Lily & Ivy: Ken-Couple Yuri x Seiai Anthology
title_original: リリー＆アイビー 〜ケンカップル百合×性愛アンソロジー〜
description: This volume contains the following chapters #Cover Illustration: Kuwabara Tamotsu 1. Omae Igai, Dou demo Ii. (お前以外、どうでもいい。, I Don't Care About Anyone But You) by nipi 2. Cooling (クーリング) by Moekichi. 3. Yamauchi-san Umino-san no Baai (山内さん・海野さんのバアイ。, The Case of Ms. Yamauchi and Ms. Umino) by Ree 4. Mahou Shoujo Pastel Feather: Usagi Hime no Koi shita Hitomi (魔法少女☆パステルフェザー うさぎ姫の恋した瞳, Magical Girl Pastel Feather: The Eyes The Bunny Princess Loves) by Tanaka Ahiru 5. Koushiki ni Nouhakai Sareta Onna-tachi (公式に脳破壊された女達, Officially Brain-Burst Girls) by Tachi 6. Domestic Adultery (Domestic Adultery) by Kodama Naoko 7. Itsumo no Himegoto (いつものヒメゴト, The Usual Secret) by Homura Subaru 8. MODE:CROWN (MODE:CROWN) by Sumire 9. Shio-kun to Satou-san (シオくんとサトウさん) by Risu-kun 10. Bitter Sweet Purin (ビタースイートプリン) by Bonryuu 11. Inu mo Kuwanai (犬も食わない, Dogs Don't Bite Either) by Kuwabara Tamotsu 12. Scary Lily Party (スケアリー・リリー・パーティー) by Piroya

title: Ohitsuji-chan wa Sawaritai
title_original: 御羊ちゃんは触りたい
description: A docile lamb who is going out with her childhood friend. She wants to do naughty things with her… but is too embarrassed to say anything. This is the story of a troubled lamb. (Source: Author's Twitter, translated) Note: Originally published in Comic Yuri-Hime 2025 Jan. issue.

title: Imadoki no Joshikousei ga Nani wo Kangaeteru ka Wakaranakute Tsurai
title_original: 今どきの女子高生が何を考えてるかわからなくてつらい
description: 28-year old OL and 17-year old high-schooler living together can be complicated. Yu Yoshioka was asked to take care of her niece Sachi. But Sachi's expressionless face and mumbling talk has Yu at a loss for what to do?

title: Syrup PURE: Onee-Loli Yuri Anthology
title_original: シロップ PURE おねロリ百合アンソロジー
description: This volume contains the following chapters: Cover illustration: En Morikura 1. Otonaninaritai (大人になりたい) by Hamuro Kei 2. Yakusoku (やくそく) by Maeya Susumu 3. V to Hatsukoi (vと初恋) by Yuzuki Ryota 4. Suriel (スーリール) by Tsuzura Ryo 5. Ohayou kara Oyasumi made (おはようからおやすみまで) by Mikan Uji 6. Moto JK to mi JK (元JKと未JK) by Tachi 7. CANDY GUILTY (CANDY GUILTY) by Yoshidamaru Yuu 8. Para ni Kiss (パラにキス) by Akitsu Kio 9. Tsumugu no Mahou (ツムグの魔法) by Itou Hachi 10. Kodomo no Mama de (こどものままで) by Iwami Kiyoko

title: Magic Mushroom
title_original: マジック・マッシュルーム
description: A boy's penis turns into a girl. Once another boy at school discovers this, he reveals that his penis, too, is a girl! Their penises then have yuri sex. (Source: bakabt.me)

title: Watashi no Suki na Senpai
description: A short one-shot about the love between a young girl at her senpai at an all-girls school.

title: Bulmyeolui Naldeul
description: Mankind has discovered the secret to immortality. As humans can no longer die, violence abounds. Living among the immortals is Myeol. Careful and conscientious, he’s a street-smart fighter who’s trained himself to survive. Why? Because he’s mortal; a mutant. Upon meeting Phill, a money-grubbing “Troubleshooter” short on morals, Myeol is thrown into a life full of guns, bombs and death cults. But Myeol and Phill have more in common than meets the eye... (Source: Lezhin US)

characters.name: Phill
characters.description: __Height:__ 191cm He is a calculating egoist who hides this side of himself thoroughly, but he lets his guard down around his fellow clan member, Myeol, causing his true nature to slip out time and again. He is well aware of his good looks and often uses his face as a weapon. He is obsessed with Myeol in a strange way.

characters.name: Myeol-Mang
characters.description: __Height:__ 182cm He is a mortal who starts working as the assistant of Phill, a troubleshooter.

characters.name: Ernest Storm
characters.description: __Height:__ 175 cm Works as a detective for the police department.

characters.name: Banachet
characters.description: __Height:__192cm __Occupation:__ Troubleshooter

characters.name: Matilda
characters.description: __Height:__ 180cm __Occupation:__ Troubleshooter

characters.name: Kan Onix
characters.description: __Height:__ 183cm __Occupation:__ Prison warden / Retired soldier

characters.name: Billion Diamond
characters.description: __Height:__ 210 cm __Occupation:__ UM Fighter

characters.name: Doctor North
characters.description: __Height:__ 154cm She is the mad scientist that gifted immortality to humanity. Looks 55 years old ~!but her actual age is close to 200 years old!~

title: 30-sai Made Doutei de Itara Mahou Shoujo ni Narimashita
title_original: 30歳まで童貞でいたら魔法少女になりました
description: "When you are a virgin until you are 30, you will become a wizard." A famous joke around the Internet... is what I thought, but to think that it actually happened to me! Wait, but this isn't a wizard? Eh? Magical girl? Why? Comedy manga about magical girls who used to be old virgin guys! Note: Nominated for the Tsugimanga 2020 Award in the Web Manga Category.

title: Mikagura Gakuen Kumikyoku
description: Eruna Ichinomiya is preparing to enter high school, but there's just one problem—none of the schools interest her! The uniforms are all too boring, until she discovers Mikagura Academy. After Eruna miraculously passes the entrance exam, she discovers that Mikagura Academy isn't a typical school. Mikagura Academy only allows students to form culture-themed school clubs, participation in those clubs is compulsory, and there is a battle system where students must compete with each other as representatives of their clubs. Now Eruna must discover her own power and win her first battle! (Source: One Piece Books)

characters.name: Seisa Mikagura
characters.description: Seisa is the representative of the Going-Home Club, and the granddaughter of Mikagura Academy's principal. Seisa is a second-year at school, and is a hikikomori. She was once a member of the Art Club, and was known to possess the strongest power in the school. The Going-Home Club is not actually registered in the school, and does not participate in battles. Her ability is known as "Killing Art", which allows her to reshape space by her will.

characters.name: Eruna Ichinomiya
characters.description: Eruna is a somewhat dimwitted girl who has a romantic interest in girls and as a result spends much of her time playing dating simulation visual novels on her portable device. She enrolls into Mikagura Private Academy after her cousin Shigure recommends it to her, largely due to wanting to be able to meet [Seisa](https://anilist.co/character/88977/Mikagura-Seisa) whom she developed a strong interest in. Her abilities are "Toy Gun", which allows her to shoot a powerful laser from her fingertips, and "Toy Bayonet", a bayonet made out of light, in addition to possessing incredible speed.

characters.name: Shigure Ninomiya
characters.description: Eruna's cousin, a third-year who is the representative of the Manga Research Club. He is very attached to Eruna, and tries all sorts of ways to get closer to her, but he has not succeeded even once, and it seems that she is only avoiding him more and more.

characters.name: Bimii
characters.description: Bimii is a mysterious winged creature, largely resembling a cat, who can only be seen by those eligible to attend Mikagura Academy and often ends his sentences with "ryui".

characters.name: Himi Yasaka
characters.description: Representative of the Calligraphy Club, Himi is a very small second-year, and has the appearance of a young child. She is extremely innocent, positive, and always has a smile on her face.

characters.name: Yuuto Akama
characters.description: Yuuto is a second-year who is the representative of the Drama Club. He is always smiling, and he is adored by the Drama Club members, who are known for being like a large family.

characters.name: Asuhi Imizu
characters.description: Asuhi is a first-year who is part of the Astronomy Club. He came directly from Mikagura Academy's junior high school, and it is said that he may become the next representative. He has a very cute appearance which often causes him to be mistaken for a girl.

characters.name: Kyouma Kuzuryu
characters.description: Kyouma is a third-year who is representative of the Art Club. His blunt attitude has caused most to fear him, but he can also be kind and is good at taking care of others; he also loves to drink milk. Both his face and uniform are always covered in paint.

characters.name: Nyamirin
characters.description: A third-year student who belongs to the Drama Club. She gave all the Drama Club members (except Yūto) animal inspired names.

characters.name: Usamaru
characters.description: A freshman and member of the Drama Club. Often seen together with Tonkyun.

characters.name: Tonkyun
characters.description: A freshman and member of the Drama Club who is often seen together with Usamaru. Every time he tries to say his real name is interrupted.

characters.name: Kumano
characters.description: A second-year student and member of the Drama Club who, like Himi, is very short.

characters.name: Rumina Rikyu
characters.description: Representative of the Newspaper Club.

characters.name: Kurumi Narumi
characters.description: Eruna's teacher and Seisa's maid. Her serious and deadpan demeanor doesn't hide her dislike for Eruna's antics, but she can be soft to Seisa.

title: Futago Yuri
description: A short story about the blossoming love between two sisters.

title: Mowang Qie Zhiliao
description: "Wanna sign a contract with me to become that destined one?" Devil Jekaterina is summoned and saved by a cultivator girl Yuchi Yue. To Yue surprise, the first thing Jekaterina wants to do when she wakes up is to ask her sign a contract with her with a kiss? "Kissing on the lips is the thing that can only be done between those who likes each other!", Yue shouts and refused. But it seems that Jekaterina doesn't understand what does she mean... (Source: Webcomics)

title: Chichi Yuri Girls
description: 1, 3, 5, 7, 9. Sakunyuu Inma Lily (搾乳淫魔リィリ, Milky Succubus Lilly) 2, 4. Momoyuri Gakuen - Himitsu no Soap-bu (桃百合学園 ひみつのソープ部, The Secret Soap Club of Momoyuri Academy) 6. Kichiku Yousei (キチクヨウセイ) 8. Dokidoki Beach Pudding (どきどきびーちぷでぃんぐ)

title: 4-jihan, Coin Laundry nite.
title_original: 4時半、コインランドリーにて。
description: That special time, just between the two of us, just before the dawn.

title: Sentimental Journey
title_original: センチメンタル・ジャーニー
description: At sixteen years old, Saki was violated by her father. Mai has been abused by her mother since childhood. Both longed for death, unable to find meaning in life in the world they were thrust into. After meeting on the street, they take a drive to the sea together in a car stolen from Saki's father, until... (Source: Big Comic Superior, translated) Notes: - Winner of the Special Jury Award 'Asano Inio Award' in the 2nd Big Comic Superior Next Generation Newcomer Manga Awards. - Published in Big Comic Superior (Digital edition exclusive) 2023 #4 issue .

title: Tenshi no Drop
description: Botan Ichige has just enrolled in St. Asmaria All-Girl's School where angels are said to live. It turns out that angels do indeed live there, and after an accident, an angel named Un offers Botan her halo as a snack. After eating it, Botan discovers it had some bizarre side-effects, causing her to regularly "give birth" to colorful mushrooms. Is this the life of an angel!?

title: Uso de Ii node.
description: A girl is approached on the street by a strange black-haired girl who claims to be a stray cat named “Meat-kun.” The girl finds Meat-kun's tearful pleas suspicious and she leaves without responding. However, when she goes to the place where the stray cat hangs out, she finds the girl Meat-kun there waiting for her, and the two gradually become friends… (Source: Melonbooks, translated) Note: Released at Comitia 119.

title: Tenkiame to Houbutsusen
description: A doujin by Morinaga Milk and Hakamada Mera released at COMITIA 122 featuring sequel chapters to their respective series, Girl Friends and Fuwa Fuwa Futashika Yume Mitai .

title: Okashi na Elf to Joshikousei
title_original: おかしなエルフと女子高生
description: Japanese sweets save a debt-ridden elf! Alice, an elf, runs a confectionery shop in the forest of Auin to pay off the debt left by her parents. One day, however, when she is worried that her sweets are not selling, she suddenly falls into the "Fountain of Wishes. When she opens her eyes, she finds herself in a strange world... Note: Chapter count includes 2 extra chapters.

characters.name: Alice Iolite
characters.original: アリス・アイオライト
characters.description: __Height:__ 170cm

characters.name: Ruri Aisaki
characters.description: __Height:__ 156cm

title: Gongjunimeun Im Jun-Saeng
description: The son of a brave warrior is pursued by an elf princess and a dwarf princess, each determined to secure his seed as the key to ruling their world. (Source: Toomics)

title: Nega Saneun Iyu
description: "Congratulations on being born." Once I opened my eyes, I was in a cold laboratory. I wasn't born because I wasn't human, I was created, but she still celebrates it nevertheless. I learned how to live by drinking coffee together, smelling the scent, hearing the sound of decoration shaking due to the wind, and becoming close to the rabbit who often came to visit the garden. However... "Actually, in a week from now, I'm going to die." She, who neither complains about pain or reveals her pain, is calm, but why does my heart hurt so much? I was also a person who could shed tears. "Why did you create me? Why did you make me like you?" (Source: Ridibooks, translated)

title: NEW GAME! Anthology Comic
title_original: NEW GAME! アンソロジーコミック
description: NEW GAME! anthology by various mangaka.

characters.name: Aoba Suzukaze
characters.description: __Birth Place:__ Tokyo, Japan __Height:__ 149 cm A high school graduate who joins the Eagle Jump game company as a character designer, as they made her favorite game, Fairies Story. Due to her small stature, she is often mistaken for a middle school student.

characters.name: Kou Yagami
characters.description: __Birth Place:__ Tokyo __Height:__ 164 cm The lead character designer of Eagle Jump. She spends a lot of time at the office, often sleeping there overnight in her underwear, and has a laid-back but stern attitude. She was the character designer for the game that inspired [Aoba](https://anilist.co/character/89641/Suzukaze-Aoba) to become one herself.

characters.name: Hifumi Takimoto
characters.description: __Height:__ 162 cm Takimoto Hifumi is a character designer ~!(currently character team leader)!~ for Eagle Jump, a gaming studio located in Tokyo. Hifumi is especially shy to the point of avoiding talking to people or looking at them directly. As a result, in order to not make her feel uncomfortable, the other employees interact with her through the company's computer messenger system. Although, in later seasons she becomes more lively and goes out of her way to try to improve talking to people. Contrary to her normal personality, she becomes very lively, outgoing, and cheerful while texting or messaging, often using emoticons in chat. She secretly enjoys cosplay and owns a pet hedgehog named [Sojiro](https://anilist.co/character/158503/Sojiro). Some trivia about Hifumi: - Her favorite colors are Blue and Pink - Her favorite clothing style is "Sweet Lolita"

characters.name: Rin Tooyama
characters.description: __Birth Place:__ Aichi prefecture, Japan __Height:__ 158 cm An art director and head of the background department. She joined the company at the same time as Kou whom she is very close friends with.

characters.name: Hajime Shinoda
characters.description: __Birth Place:__ Tokushima Prefecture, Japan __Height:__ 167 cm A motion designer who works in the character design department as there are no open seats in the animation department. She enjoys sentai shows and owns various prop weapons.

characters.name: Yun Iijima
characters.description: __Birth Place:__ Mie Prefecture, Japan __Height:__ 151 cm A character designer who designs monsters and often dresses in gothic clothing. She has two younger siblings.

characters.name: Nene Sakura
characters.description: **Birthplace:** Tokyo **Height:** 144 cm Aoba's friend from high school who is currently in university. She took an interest in programming and eventually became an intern at Eagle Jump after beta testing Fairies Story 3. Nene is described as childish, selfish, and goofy by Aoba, who can't stay focused on the task given to her, which is why she's often seen leaving her post. She is also an otaku and a fan of Faries Story Series.

characters.name: Umiko Ahagon
characters.description: __Birth Place:__ Okinawa Prefecture, Japan __Height:__ 162 cm A programmer who often gets annoyed when she has to fix errors and is embarrassed by her surname. She is a military fan and has several airsoft weapons in her workspace.

characters.name: Shizuku Hazuki
characters.description: __Birth Place:__ Tokyo, Japan __Height:__ 161 cm A game director with a strong interest in cute girls, hence why her department is entirely female. She owns a cat named [Mozuku](https://anilist.co/character/127138/Mozuku).

characters.name: Momiji Mochizuki
characters.description: A rookie at Eagle Jump who joins the character team. Joins at the same time as and is friends with [Tsubame Narumi](https://anilist.co/character/123370/Tsubame-Narumi).

characters.name: Tsubame Narumi
characters.description: A rookie at Eagle Jump who joins the programming team. Joins at the same time as and is friends with [Momiji Mochizuki](https://anilist.co/character/123368/Momiji-Mochizuki).

title: Cinnamon: Jingai x Ningen Yuri Anthology
title_original: シナモン Cinnamon 人外×人間百合アンソロジー
description: Story 1 - Birds singing at night (Neji) Story 2 - My Sister is a rotten girl (Asagao) Story 3 - Freeloading Demon Lord (Eku Takeshima) Story 4 - Love Demon (Jin Takemiya) Story 5 - Wild Baby (Saki Amano) Story 6 - Flower room share (Sekihara) Story 7 - Confession (Mizuasou) Story 8 - My Housemate is a fish (Saku Takano)

title: Dong Hai Xun Mei Ren
description: In a past life, the mountain goddess took in a quiet child, only to find that the little one didn't want to be her servant, but instead aspired to become her intimate companion! But fate played its cruel hand, turning the once inseparable pair into bitter enemies? In this life, a cute, water-fearing mermaid happens upon an aloof beauty with no memories of her past. A chance kiss during their first meeting is just the start of their chaotic relationship. However, what had seemed to be a serendipitous meeting turns out to be a long-fated reunion with roots reaching deep into the past... From lifetimes past to present, an obsessive love flourishes... (Source: Bilibili, translated) Note: Includes five extra chapters.

title: SOIREE
description: Sato and Hiyoko do homework together, but things escalated quickly.

title: Akaneiro no Kisu wa Okujou de
description: 1. Natsu no Doukasen 2. Samuzora ni Netsu Shisen 3. Kimi Shudou no Koi 4. Drunken Night 5-6. Ecchan to Mai-chan no Koi Moyou 7. Akaneiro no Kioku

title: Ni Shi Wo De Mingyun
description: Yuan Bao, a sweet hardworking girl and Zhao Qingwen, a genius girl with high coldness, got married because of taekwondo. The two of them are like Mozart who is dazzling talented and Salieri who is inferior to Mozart, attracking and repelling each other, and gradually developed a deep bond from the initial disgust of two things. Just when the feelings are quietly budding, the successive changes have caused them to fall into unpredictable distress...

title: Musume no Kanojo
description: Keiko is a divorced single mother in her mid-forties, who lives a good, normal life with a stable job. That is, until she catches her only daughter, Mayu, having sex with her girlfriend, Saori. She pretends she hadn't seen them, but she can't help but see Saori in a different light. While she ponders how to deal with the situation as Mayu's mother, Saori is about to make that decision for her.

title: Kouhai ni Otosaretakunai Senpai
title_original: 後輩に堕とされたくない先輩
description: A kouhai confesses to a senpai who doesn't want to date them.

title: Huli Zong Shi Zai Shuo Huang
description: Tang Ran is a sunny and cheerful little fox spirit. In order to graduate from youkai school, she transformed into a college student to try to seduce a human. However, what she didn't know was that Su Qingci, the cool lady professor she had her eyes on, was actually…? One lie begets more lies, as each girl tries to seduce the other, that is the way of the "lying" fox. (Source: Billibilli, translated)

title: Touchuukasou
description: Mariko is kind and motherly. Yuina is sassy with a tight body. The two sisters will cry out like cicadas, during the sweltering summer... (Source: Fanza, translated)

title: Shunrai Takkyuu
description: Mirai Todoroki, a freshman at Arashino Girls' High School, is petite but has a deep passion for table tennis. She once had the skill to compete at the national level, but after suffering a crushing defeat against a player with overwhelming talent during her middle school years, she gave up the sport. Then one day, a transfer student named Oka Harusaki joins the table tennis club... (Source: MANGA Plus)

title: Aoi Honoo Kaoru Tsuchi
description: Impressed by a vase she saw in the hallway, Mokako decided to join the pottery club so she could meet the person who made it. There she meets the artist, Shuri, and she teaches Mokako pottery. It isn't long, however, before Mokako starts hearing rumors about Shuri and the things she's done with past members of the pottery club. (Source: BakaBT)

title: Glass no Kutsu wo Nugisutete
title_original: ガラスの靴を脱ぎ捨てて
description: A series of one-shots published in Yurihime surrounding the lives of working women.

title: Shen Xian Tao Niang: Kyuutei no Nie
title_original: 神仙桃娘 宮廷の贄
title_en: A Peach Offering for the Imperial Court
description: Far removed from the capital, in the village where immortals reside...there grow fragrant fruits filled with divine Qi. Only beautiful girls, blessed with the Qi most holy, are selected to consume it daily. They will become vessels for heaven's blessings whose supple skin radiates the scent of the peach. They are the "Immortal Peach Princesses". Sons of the Emperor couple with one of them, seeking divine favor through the union of man and woman. Zha're was chosen to be the White Peach Princess, the White Prince's bride. She was honored to be chosen, but the prince didn't come to her bed on the First Night...when she was supposed to give divine blessing to him. Both of them didn't know what love was... A sweet and beautiful Chinese fantasy. (Source: MangaPlaza)

title: Koumakan no Onnatachi
description: Based on characters from the Touhou Project series. Koumakan is a Western-style mansion by the lake with few windows. The house is inhabited by a vampire master and a group of beautiful women, each with her own unique personality. (Source: ComicWalker, translated)

characters.name: Sakuya Izayoi
characters.description: Sakuya is the only human living in the Scarlet Devil Mansion, yet she is also the head maid. The official fanbook suggests she had been a vampire hunter before she began working in the mansion, but she was defeated by Remilia Scarlet who pitied her and gave Sakuya her current name. Though she looks about sixteen like the other girls, Sakuya has the ability to slow, stop and possibly reverse time. She seems to have been serving Remilia for a long time and may be far older then she looks. Socially, she interacts mainly with the others in the Scarlet Devil Mansion. Her talents are cooking, knife throwing and time manipulation. The latter two abilities characterize her appearances in-game, and led to frequent parodies in reference to Dio Brando of JoJo's Bizarre Adventure, who also controls time and throws knives. This reference goes so far as Sakuya using some of his poses in a game. She is

characters.name: Remilia Scarlet
characters.original: レミリア・スカーレット
characters.description: __Species:__ Vampire __Abilities:__ Manipulation of fate __Occupation:__ Mistress of the Scarlet Devil Mansion __Location:__ Scarlet Devil Mansion Remilia is the owner and head of the Scarlet Devil Mansion, the mistress of [Sakuya](https://anilist.co/character/5570/Izayoi-Sakuya) and Meiling, friend of Patchouli, and the older sister/guardian of Flandre. Though her appearance (and often behavior) is childlike and seems nonthreatening, she has fearsome magical powers and a reputation to match, being known throughout Gensokyo as the dangerous "Scarlet Devil." Like all vampires she is photosensitive and weakens when exposed to sunlight, so she typically remains inside her mansion (which has few windows to prevent light getting in) during the day and emerges during the night. While she is naturally known to drink human blood, her light appetite means her victims almost never die from their w

characters.name: Patchouli Knowledge
characters.original: パチュリー・ノーレッジ
characters.description: __Species:__Magician __Location:__ Scarlet Devil Mansion __Occupation:__ Librarian A witch who has settled down in the Scarlet Devil Mansion. Unlike the mistress of the house, she is not weak against sunlight; however, she does not go out much. She spends her days in a library where the sunlight cannot reach. This is so that the books won't be damaged, but the unhealthy atmosphere is bad for her health. She doesn't have a very proactive personality, but rather always walks her own path. However, she is always interested where knowledge is concerned and will proactively go and try to acquire it. She completely depends on her books, but still makes a lot of mistakes. Although she is quite skillful, her complete lack of physical fighting ability can't be helped. She pretty much never attempts to directly punch or kick her opponent. She makes up for this with her knowledge of a great variety

characters.name: Hong Meiling
characters.description: Hong Meiling is a youkai, though it isn't known to which specific category she actually belongs. She guards the entrance to the Scarlet Devil Mansion along with her henchmen. She is known for her mastery of the martial arts, part of which can be seen from her movement which is performed with Shin-Kyaku (a move in Chinese martial arts). During the events of Embodiment of Scarlet Devil, she bravely fought against the intruding heroines but ultimately failed to complete her job. (Source: Touhou Wiki)

characters.name: Flandre Scarlet
characters.original: フランドール・スカーレット
characters.description: Flandre is the younger sister of Remilia and the "dirty little secret" of Scarlet Devil Mansion. Because of her unstable personality and incredible destructive power, her sister has ordered her not to leave the mansion for nearly 500 years. She really respects her older sister Remilia, but her raw destructive power far exceeds that of her sister's. Although she is usually docile, her insanity makes it difficult for others to understand her.When vampires attack humans, they generally try to take their prey alive in order to suck its blood afterward, but Flandre has always been fed with cooked dishes, and thus doesn't know how to properly attack a human. Whenever she tries to attack a human, she loses control of herself and blows them away without leaving a spot of blood. Her apparent age is about the same as Remilia Scarlet (who looks to be around 10, even though Remilia is 5 years older

characters.name: Koakuma
characters.description: Patchouli's helper. Appears briefly in Touhou Bougetsushou and Strange and Bright Nature Deity.

title: Yuri Hime Selection
description: A selection of steamy yuri one-shots. Volume 1 (2007/5/25) Cover illustration: Eiki Eiki 1. under the rose [Konno Kita] 2. Izuko to mo Naku (いずこともなく, Nowhere to Go) [Konno Kita] 3. Hirusagari no... (昼下がりの..., In the Afternoon...) [Konno Kita] 4. 24, 25. (24、25。) [Techno Samata]; Yuri Shimai Vol.3 5. Hoshi ni Negai wo (星に願いを, Wishing on a Star) [Himawari Souya] 6. Kanojo no Neko wa Yume no Bannin (彼女の猫は夢の番人, Her Cat Wards Off My Bad Dreams) [Hakamada Mera] 13. Nanami to Misuzu (南波と海鈴) [Minakata Sunao] 14. Maple Love [Otsu Hiyori] 4. Sandals (サンダル) [Takahashi Mako] 5. Delicious Time [Takemiya Jin] 6. Cosmos no S

title: Liming You Xingchen
description: A funny but dramatic story about the growing romantic relationship between Li Ziming and Xin Cheng.

title: Hana ga Haeta Ko no Hanashi
Love Countdown!
description: Yoo Min-hee, who just witnessed her boyfriend cheating on her, returns home crying and runs into her childhood friend Park Hee-min. After seeing Minhee crying, Heemin proposes to Min-hee that the two of them make a love contract…?! These two people were once best friends, but as time passed, they drifted away from each other. What will happen to this love countdown that started? (Source: Bomtoon, translated)

title: Fuwafuwa, Futashika, Yumemitai
title_original: ふわふわ・ふたしか・夢みたい
description: "I don't understand why she's always so kind." Chiyo has loved and admired her sempai since the first time she saw her in a production by the drama club. What is the nature of sempai's kindness towards her? Is her love returned?

title: Qingmei Huacao Cha
description: Gu Gu, a shy girl, meets Xing Xing, an extroverted basketball girl. Xing Xing is everything Gu Gu wants to be - have lots of friends and live a happy, carefree life with dreams. Gu Gu is organized; she lists out a long to-do list for herself. But how does that help her get closer to Xing Xing? Wait, maybe Xing Xing is trying to get closer to Gu Gu too... (Source: Webcomics)

title: Siktamgwabu
title_en: Ladies at Her Service: Hungry Widow
description: Cheong-Hwa is married off to a wealthy old man who starves her to "keep her figure trim." Once he dies, she's finally free to satisfy her raging hunger and eat to her heart's content. And now that she's been left alone with her pretty servant, Oh-Weol, food isn't the only thing Cheong-Hwa has a ravenous appetite for... (Source: Tappytoon) Note: Part of Ridi's Jujonggwangye GL Danpyeonseon (주종관계 GL 단편선) Collection.

title: After Life
description: Sano wanted to be close to Koga and thought her chance was lost when Koga died in a car accident. However, Koga's soul is not as distant from Sano as it may seem.

title: Shi Ye Hou Wo Zai Hai Bian Yu Jian Le Renyu Xiaojie
title_original: 失业后我在海边遇见了人鱼小姐
title_en: The Mermaid I Met by Getting Fired
description: After the pandemic passed, our protagonist lost her job and decided to join a tour group to the seaside to relax. Only to meet a mermaid in the ocean?! The mermaid acted strangely and quickly disappeared. But the next day, she saw the mermaid again, and her jaw dropped in astonishment… (Source: Bilibili, translated)

title: Game
description: A transfer student who's also a secret writer has a crush on a classmate lookalike who happens to be an artist, team up together. 1. game1st 2. game2nd 3. game3rd 4. Nakushi Mono/Okuri Mono 5. Acchi/Kocchi/Docchi 6. Kiss Chu Chu 7. Nanika? Nanimo?

title: Imoutotachi ga Watashi no Koto wo Sukisugiru!
title_original: 妹たちが私のことを好きすぎる!
description: After her mother's re-marriage, Misaki now has four younger step-sisters. All of whom seem to love Misaki far too much! (Source: Amazon, translated)

characters.name: Misaki
characters.description: The eldest daughter in the second-year of high school. Everything about her is ordinary, including her thoughts, appearance, and grades. Her cheerful attitude is her strong point. She now has four younger sisters who love her.

characters.name: Kasumi
characters.description: The second oldest sister, in the second-year of high school. She is a firm but gentle girl who addresses everyone, including her younger sisters, with honorifics. She is Misaki's classmate. She is beautiful, gets good grades, and is popular in class. She is good at hiding her emotions, so you can't see her "arrow of love" in her. She usually treats everyone equally, but she is possessive of Misaki and gets more jealous than anyone else, including her other sisters. Misaki is very special to her.

characters.name: Asuka
characters.description: The third oldest sister, in the third-year of junior high. She is a gal with a mischievous personality. She's the type whose "arrow of love" towards Misaki is obvious. She might seem like a seductive young lady, but she is not as bold as you might think; in fact, she is quite shy.

characters.name: Suzuka
characters.description: The fourth oldest sister, in the first-year of junior high. She is a tall, slender, and athletic girl. She acts like the youngest in terms of maturity, and she doesn't know much about love yet. She has a straightforward personality. She is a member of the track team and is treated like "prince charming" at school. She gets along with everyone and has been close to Misaki since the beginning.

characters.name: Luna
characters.description: The fifth and youngest sister, currently in fifth grade. She is an odd little sister. Despite being so young, she has a very mature attitude. She is the type of person who says few words but expresses herself clearly. Her expressions of affection for Misaki can be somewhat unique.

title: Love Flicker
description: Collection of one shots: 1. Adorable to Me 2. Delicious Time 3. Spike Girls 4. Seiippai no Suki to Uso to (All My Love and Lies) 5. Always 6. Sweet Sweet Sweet 7. Worrying (Adorable to Me Extra)

title: Manatsu no Spica
description: Manatsu and Hoshiko are childhood friends. However, the shy Hoshiko becomes a popular idol, and Manatsu cannot accept the changes in Hoshiko's new life and new surroundings, so she becomes unfriendly toward Hoshiko.... Things change and things stay the same. A story of "change" and "conflict" spun between two girls. (Source: Comic Ogyaaa!!, translated)

title: Bullisugeo Hadaga Jeonyeochin Majuchineun Manhwa
description: What are the odds of running into an ex-lover at a recycling center? A new story written by two women who reunite as apartment residents. (Source: Bomtoon, translated)

title: Mondlicht: Tsuki no Tsubasa
description: The Mondlicht (German for Moonlight) are vampires who are unable to go out in daylight and are only able to live by feeding on the blood of humans. However, they're also mostly just frightened children on their own, trying to survive without killing anyone or being hunted out of existence. Doing this was hard enough, before an artificial human created by Dr. Frankenstein named F08 started to find them and tried to destroy them all. However, in F08's first fight, the girl she calls her big sister turns on her after killing the boy leading the Mondlicht. Whose side is she on? Why does she have wings just like the vampires she's supposed to be hunting? Can the Mondlicht ever live in peace? (Source: MangaHelpers)

title: Gwibuinui Eunmilhan Sasaenghwal
description: Beatriz is a duchess with a well-earned reputation for a deviant sex life. Well, she used to be a duchess. When she’s stabbed to death, she wakes up as Jae-young, an ordinary college student in modern times. With a whole new world at her disposal, Beatriz decides to enjoy herself. And there is so much to enjoy: modern technology, education she used to be barred from, and plenty of sex. As Jae-young, she’s going to conquer not only her new life, but also as many men and women as she wants. (Source: Lezhin US)

title: Mahou Tsukai no Hako: Starlit Marmalade
title_original: まほうつかいの箱 スターリット・マーマレード
description: Manga adaptation of Type-Moon's Mahou Tsukai no Hako project.

characters.name: Hibiki Hibino
characters.description: __Height:__ 154 cm Hibiki Hibino is a student attending Kagamisaki High School in Mahou Tsukai no Hako. ~!She is the Holy Scripture Triten of [Caubac Alcatraz](https://anilist.co/character/244645).!~ ~!Hibiki is stronger than normal humans as such with being the Holy Scripture Triten. While as Triten, she is capable of flight, levitation, creating energy barriers of light, destroying parasitic familiars, and much more. Triten was created as a replica of all three components of a human being in text form, and by accident ended up being a model of the universe!~

characters.name: Chikagi Katsuragi
characters.description: Chikagi Katsuragi is a student attending Kagamisaki High School in Mahou Tsukai no Hako. She is one of the mascots of the now defunct TYPE-MOON mobile site along with Hibiki Hibino. Chikagi's family consists of her father, mother, and older sister Chidori Katsuragi. __In Carnival Phantasm:__ Chikagi cameos in the 12th episode helping at Ahnenerbe, and is seen at the party at the end. The 2013 Hibichika Special of Carnival Phantasm has a large majority of the episode revolving around Chikagi and her partner, Hibiki Hibino during another one of their workdays at Ahnenerbe. She acts rather hostile to the people around her, except Hibiki. Cellphone-san teases her over various subjects, notably the moments when she does not act hostile, to which she promptly breaks him.

characters.name: Sunao Sugata
characters.description: Sunao Sugata is an Executor-in-training of the Holy Church and student attending Kagamisaki High School in Mahou Tsukai no Hako. Sunao uses Black Keys, but she can also modify her body to bring out - variety of guns so to shoot down her foes.

characters.name: Serena Sarashina
characters.description: Serena Sarashina is a student attending Kagamisaki High School in Mahou Tsukai no Hako. Serena was given the experimental Galgen Mainleinn by Lorenz Trendel, a parasitic flower Familiar that allows her to sprout vines for both offense and defense.

characters.name: Kiyomi Kodama
characters.description: Kiyomi Kodama is a member of Class 1-A in Kamamisaki High School.

characters.name: Chidori Katsuragi
characters.description: Chidori Katsuragi is a graduate of Kagamisaki High School and Chikagi Katsuragi's sister in Mahou Tsukai no Hako.

characters.name: Hiroko Yamauchi
characters.description: Hiroko Yamauchi is a member of Class 1-A in Kamamisaki High School.

characters.name: Nozomi Kuroi
characters.description: She’s a teacher at Kagamisaki High School in Mahou Tsukai no Hako.

characters.name: Clara Kurieda
characters.description: Clara Kurieda is a student attending Kagamisaki High School in Mahou Tsukai no Hako.

characters.name: Ciel
characters.description: __Height:__ 165 cm (5'5") Ciel is first presented as a senior attending the same school as the main protagonist [Shiki Tohno](https://anilist.co/character/2212/Tohno-Shiki), where she is the president and only member of the tea ceremony club, and also good friends with [Arihiko Inui](https://anilist.co/character/8830/Inui-Arihiko), [Satsuki Yumizuka](https://anilist.co/character/3263/Yumizuka-Satsuki) and Shiki himself. Her outward demeanor is that of a calm, friendly, and peaceful person. However, Ciel's true character is later revealed as the story progresses. She is a member of the Burial Agency, a secret organization within the Catholic Church made up of skilled assassins, feared even within the Church itself, known for showing no mercy and willing to do whatever it takes to get their task done even to the point of using forbidden magics and creatures. Her objective in Tsukihime is t

characters.name: Momota
characters.description: Momota is the homeroom teacher of Chikagi Katsuragi and Hibiki Hibino in Kamamisaki High School.

characters.name: Lorenz Trendel
characters.original: ロレンツ・トレンデル
characters.description: The magus thought to be the mastermind behind the events of Starlit Marmalade. Lorenz is a former priest who used to run his own church as a priest until ten years ago, when the Holy Church destroyed it.

title: Ero♡Pippi
description: None of these girls are dating the boys they’re screwing, but that just makes it more exciting! (Source: HMarket) 1. Kanojo Kareshi Kanojo (彼女彼氏彼女); Comic Aun 2013-03 2. Hokeniin Survival (保健委員・サバイバル); Comic Aun 2012-08 3-4. Daremo Okite wa Naranu (誰も起きてはならぬ); Comic Aun 2015-12, 2016-01 5-10. Boku no Bokki Penis wo Rokuga Shite Ikina yo (僕の勃起ペニスを録画していきなよ); Comic Aun 2016-03, 06, 07, 09, 11, 12

title: Tsuyoki na Watashi no Semeta Ichinichi
title_original: 強気なわたしの攻めた一日
description: Note: Originally published in Comic Yuri-Hime 2021 April issue.

title: Sylph no Hanahime
description: After the commercial serialization of Sylph no Hanahime ended with three volumes, the mangaka decided to self-publish a continuation of the story, with the approval of the publisher.

characters.name: Sara Lumière
characters.description: A nun from the royal capital. She approaches [Natalia](https://anilist.co/character/308677/Natalia) with a bright, mysterious smile, but for what purpose?

characters.name: Natalia
characters.description: Queen of the Imperial City of Van Fleur. She relies on the royal sword for emotional and spiritual support.

title: Kimi no Tame nara Shineru
description: Sei Shonagon (age: 27) has become the private tutor of Princess Teishi-sama (age: 13). But in her fantasies she is more than just a mere tutor for her precious Hime-sama.

characters.name: Benkan
characters.description: Benkan lives with Shounagon since childhood (Shounagon's mother dead when Shounagon was 3 years old), she is just like Shounagon's big sister and mother. Benkan often try to prevent Shounagon from doing wild things. Benkan is also a court lady, who serve Takako, Teishi's mother.

characters.name: Teishi Fujiwara
characters.description: Shounagon's master, Ichijou Tenno's wedded wife. Teishi has always wanted a private tutor, that's the reason she hire Shounagon. Although Teishi adores Shounagon, she doesn't know how to show her feeling.

characters.name: Shoushi Fujiwara
characters.description: Teishi's cousin, care for Teishi, and wants to become an Empress like her. Shoushi hates Shounagon because she thinks Shounagon possess Teishi. Shoushi and Murasaki Shikibu consider each other as an important person in life.

characters.name: Murasaki Shikibu
characters.description: Murasaki Shikibu is best known for her literary work "The Tale of Genji." She serves Shoushi, cousin of Teishi. Murasaki Shikibu considers Shounagon as a rival, and has a complicate feelings about her. She often get groped by others.

characters.name: Shounagon Sei
characters.description: The historical Sei Shounagon was an author and a court lady who served the Empress Teishi during the middle Heian period. She is also known for her literature work "The Pillow Book", which include her personal observations and thought. In the series: Sei Shounagon was a home-stay neet who spent most of her time at writing. One day, she was asked to attend the interview of Empress Teishi's private tutor, and get recruited. Shounagon fell in love with Teishi at the first sight. Swearing to keep watch for Teishi for whole life, Shounagon capture everything about Teishi in her diary (that is, The Pillow Book).

characters.name: Fuji
characters.description: Fuji was Murasaki's close friend, but being aloof to Murasaki after a long-time separation.

characters.name: Michinaka Fujiwara
characters.description: Shoushi's father, Michitaka's younger brother, a lusty man. He often doing peeking and stalking with Michitaka.

characters.name: Michitaka Fujiwara
characters.description: Teishi's father, being cold-shouldered by his wife and daughter, and is depressed about it. Worrying about his daughter, Michitaka often doing things such as peeking and stalking.

characters.name: Takako Fujiwarano
characters.description: Teishi's mother. She is active and likes to molest her court lady.

characters.name: Noriko Fujiwarano
characters.description: Shoushi's mother and Takako's sister in law who hates Benkan and Shounagon.

characters.name: Ichijou Tenno
characters.description: The Emperor/Empress of Japan ("Tenno" means "Emperor" or "Empress" in Japanese). In the series, the gender of Tenno is unrevealed and remain a question. Because of Tenno's superior personality, he/she can't get closed to Teishi despite that they have already got married. Tenno hates Shounagon for she possess Teishi.

characters.name: Shikibu Izumi
characters.description: Age: around 20 One of Shoushi's server who is experienced with men.

characters.name: Munendou Kiyowara
characters.description: Shounagon's older brother, a rogue who left home long time ago.

characters.name: Kou Shikibu
characters.description: Shounagon's roommate, who has a crush on her, but doesn't know how to express it.

characters.name: Kosakon Shirogane
characters.description: One of Teishi's server, has a smile on face most of the time.

title: Anata to Watashi no Shuuhasuu
description: A collection of yuri one-shots by Kuwabara Tamotsu. 1. Anata to Watashi no Shuuhasuu (あなたと私の周波数) 2. Omae ni Kikasetai Uta ga Aru (お前に聴かせたい歌がある) 3. Anta ga Senaka wo Miseta kara (あなたが背中を見せたから) 4. Kimi no Subete (君のすべて) 5. Watashi-tachi no Nagasugiru Yoru (私たちの長すぎる夜)

title: Futanari-san to Nonke-san♀
title_original: フタナリさんとノンケさん♀
description: Maaya is a bitchy kogal who’s initiated an “non-consensual relationship” with her own teacher in order to squeeze him for his paycheck. She also really likes having her way with him. Uraraka is a straight-laced rich girl... on the surface. Beneath the surface, her libido is off the charts. She masturbates daily, sometimes even in the school. The reason for this is her absolute infatuation with Maaya. She’s also secretly a futanari. Find out what happens when you put these two ticking bombs together in a room in this doujin. (Source: FAKKU)

title: Futari de Okashi na Kyuujitsu wo
title_original: ふたりでおかしな休日を
description: Toshimitsu Yamamura owns a real estate company and loves baking delicious, healthy snacks in his spare time. When his coworker comes to him one day with the idea of advertising their real estate agency as LGBT-friendly, Toshi realizes this little change could really help people who often face discrimination in his industry. He's terrified, though, because he worries this move will out him as gay. Joined by his boyfriend Gonta who inspired him to bake in the first place, Toshi navigates a changing world that's slowly becoming more accepting, faces his fears and discomfort, and bakes some incredibly lovely treats along the way. (Source: TOKYOPOP)

characters.name: Gonta Tsubakisaka
characters.description: Works at a hospital as a caregiver. He enjoys eating the food his boyfriend Toshi bakes.

characters.name: Toshimitsu Yamamura
characters.description: A closeted gay man who runs a real-estate business and lives with his boyfriend Gonta. He enjoys baking in his spare time.

characters.name: Kozue
characters.description: A straight employee at Toshi's real-estate company who has various preconceived notions about the LGBTQ community. She starts attending a support group to learn more about LGBTQ struggles.

characters.name: Pororin
characters.description: The owner of a gay bar. He is very flamboyant.

characters.name: Shingo
characters.description: Pororin's partner who formerly identified as straight.

title: Darenimo Ienai
description: A series of disparate but interwoven stories. - A woman struggles with her attraction to her adult male cousin, haunted by the games they played as a child. - Her sister finds love where she least expects it, and views her surroundings through different eyes. - Two women find their secret lesbian relationship threatened by the world around them.

title: Incubus
description: Included one-shots: Maid no Kokoroe (Knowledge of Maid), Shinshun! Hime Hajime, Iyashi no Onsen Ryokan: Omokage (Soothing Hot Spring Resort: Omokage)

title: Kago no Shoujo wa Koi wo suru
description: Ace student Chizuru transfers to a boarding school where elegant and gorgeous girls are gathered. It is a school where special health check-ups and top-level curriculum are seen as the ordinary.

title: "Duo Duosuo Suo" Taoli Ni
description: An Ultimate Showdown Between an Introvert and an Extrovert. Ai Xu, a designer of trendy toys, suffers from extreme social anxiety and despises socializing and teamwork. Once she became an adult, she did her best to find a job where 90% of the time, she only has to be accountable to herself. However, there is one drawback to being a designer for original IP: She still has to attend and speak at a weekly team meeting. Thankfully, she could simply play a presentation without saying much. Today, however, she was paired with the beautiful and dazzling extrovert Zhiyi from marketing to work as partners on a project. (Source: Bilibili, translated)

title: Cheolgwa Sok
description: Love and survival beneath the sand. Baekgi awakens in a world engulfed in sand after being cryogenically frozen. She joins Spear and Shield, a unit entrusted with protecting the bunker, and begins training under her senior officer, Ibaek. They must fight to survive in this new world amidst sudden epidemics and monster attacks... (Source: Manta) Note: Includes one extra chapter.

title: Anata no Tame no Happy End
title_original: あなたのためのハッピーエンド

title: Othello
description: Otsu Hiyori's two-part one-shot "Othello" is about two girls who are opposites. In the first part, one confesses her love to the other.

title: Dong Qu Xia Lai
description: An American girl who has educated herself on Japan has moved to the country with the culture she loves so much. She even joins a Japanese high school, which she is late to on her first day. A fellow Japanese classmate shows her a way in and soon the two girls become friends and perhaps even more.

title: Girlfriend
description: I've always… always… liked you. Even now— Note: Morning Getsurei-sho April 2021 Honorable Mention

title: Sareul Seokda
description: Sharing flesh for lunch? Very normal. A world where people share their flesh. I give mine to others, and they carve a piece for me. It’s toxic corporate culture on another level — how long could you last in a workplace like this? (Source: Manta)

title: Suki ja Nai kedo Suki na Hito
title_original: 好きじゃないけど好きな人
title_en: I don't love her but I love her
description: A collection featuring new works by four different authors on the theme of "scum × yuri". (Source: Booth, translated) Cover Illustration: Tamifull 1. Mekurumeku, Kuzu (めくるめく、くず) [Kuwabara] 2. Sore dake no Hanashi (それだけの話) [Sal Jiang] 3. Nito Ou Mono wa (二兎追うものは) [Yuni] 4. Fuhoni na Kankei (不本意な関係, An Undesirable Relationship) [Tamifull] Note: Released at Comiket 94.

title: Yuridori Midori
description: A mixed bag of school stories, adult life, animal-eared girls, fairy tales and school mysteries. 1. Himesama Ringo wo Meshiagare (姫さま林檎を召し上がれ) 2. Atashi to Anata to Kanojo no Sofa (あたしとあなたと彼女のソファ) 3. Gakuen Kinkyori Renai Kaidan (学園近距離恋愛怪談) 4. Sekai wa Yuri de Michiteiru (世界は百合で満ちている) 5. Kisa to Saki to Akaiito to (キサとサキとあかいいと) 6. Watashi no Hero-san (私のヒーローさん) 7. Ganpeki ni Yuri no Hana wa Saku ka (岸壁に百合の花は咲くか) (Source: Yuricon)

title: Koudou Ryou no Seiza na Hibi
description: One day, a girl visits the "Ecliptic Dormitory," a girls' dorm full of secrets, where the residents address each other by their zodiac signs. She meets the girls, each with such a unique personality: the steadfast Aries, a crybaby Pisces, the yandere Scorpio… And the Gemini who led the tour, who seems to be aware of "my" secret...? (Source: ComicWalker, translated)

characters.name: Virgo
characters.description: Earnest and fastidious, but a little cynical. The most recent student to join the dorm, she is sharing a room with Gemini

characters.name: Gemini
characters.description: In general, she is cheerful and friendly. Her footwork is agile but she gets bored easily. She is a naive person at heart. She is roommates with Virgo.

characters.name: Taurus
characters.description: She is laid-back and calm. She enjoys tasty food. She shares a room with Scorpio.

characters.name: Scorpio
characters.description: She is frequently referred to as mysterious, despite the fact that she has no desire to appear out of the ordinary. She shares a room with Taurus.

characters.name: Aries
characters.description: She has a strong sense of justice and is very passionate. Her favorite saying is "victory goes to the one who makes the first move." She despises anything crooked. She shares a room with Libra.

characters.name: Cancer
characters.description: A gentle and caring person with a motherly personality. But when she gets angry, she can be very scary. Capricorn shares a room with her.

characters.name: Capricorn
characters.description: Stubborn and serious; she is a hardworking person. Cancer is her roommate.

characters.name: Pisces
characters.description: She is pampered and a romanticist. Shares a room with Leo.

characters.name: Aquarius
characters.description: She has no particular reason for dressing in men's clothing. She is intelligent, but her time is spent researching questionable topics. Sagittarius and she share a room.

characters.name: Sagittarius
characters.description: A free spirit who despises restrictions. Positive. Her shortcomings include boredom and general clutter. Aquarius shares a room with her.

characters.name: Libra
characters.description: She is a beautiful girl with a pleasant personality. She appears to be able to handle everything with ease, but she really just wants to take it easy. She is roommates with Aries.

characters.name: Leo
characters.description: She is an attention seeker who wants to be praised. She has a royal disposition and wants to be relied on. She shares a room with Pisces.

title: Futakaku Kankei.
description: Twin sisters Airi and Himari have always been very close, and worn identical hairstyles, clothing and accessories. But after they enter high school, Himari starts to drift away from her sister. When cornered by Airi, she explains that she has "a promise with senpai to fulfill," no matter what.

title: Strange Babies
title_original: ストレンジベイビーズ
description: Sequel to the oneshot story "Black Yagi to Gekiyaku Madeleine" included in the anthology of the same name. Yagi and Madeline are finally together after confessing to each other on a live broadcast. They're now a modern internet celebrity couple that shares their love both on screen and off it, but who is the person who left a message in Yagi's locker warning her to meet them after school?

title: Kanojo no Koi ga Kanaeba Ii noni
title_original: 彼女の恋が叶えばいいのに
description: The high school girl Yoh Nanase supported her best friend Misaki Watano's unrequited love. But Yoh was actually in love with Misaki... She is her dearest friend and the love of her life. If Misaki's love could come true, Yoh can give up these feelings for her... A coming-of-age love triangle between three people who are torn between friendship and love! (Source: Kodansha, translated)

title: Mayonaka Punch
description: Mayonaka Punch centers on Masaki, a member of the NewTuber group "Harakiri Sisters", who gets fired because of a certain incident. Aiming for a comeback, Masaki meets Live. The two girls have different goals, but together, they make a high-tension comeback and aim to reach 1 million subscribers on NewTube. (Source: Anime News Network, edited)

characters.name: Masaki Sonoue
characters.description: Producer of the Mayonaka Punch channel. She is in charge of planning, filming, and editing the videos single-handedly. Her biggest problem is her selfish nature, which caused her falling out with her previous channel "Hyped-up Sisters."

characters.name: Live
characters.description: Mayonaka Punch's leader, who recently woke up from a 20 year supernatural slumber. She feels like she has a fated connection to [Masaki](https://anilist.co/character/329072/Masaki-Sonoue) and agrees to collaborate on a channel in order to drink her blood.

characters.name: Ichiko
characters.description: Member of Mayonaka Punch channel, who lives with the other members inside Banpai Manor, which she has a strong attachment to as a place. She has a childlike demeanor but sees herself as an older sister type.

characters.name: Fu
characters.description: Member of the Mayonaka Punch channel with a shy personality who often acts as the most sensible person in Mayonaka Punch. She has a part time job at a bathhouse and enjoys music.

characters.name: Tokage
characters.description: Member of the Mayonaka Punch channel who loves gambling and money. She is a wild and free person who often causes problems for others.

characters.name: Yuki
characters.description: A cool beauty who monitors the other vampires on behalf of an entity known as ["Mother."](https://anilist.co/character/343294/Mother) Part of her responsibilities are providing the vampires with their blood supply.

title: Ashita Mata Aimashou
title_original: 明日また会いましょう
description: A love story of two girls who met on the train to school.

title: Swin! Ilgeum Gimil Bogoseo
description: A new employee, Ah-Young, has been secretly in love with her boss, Cheon Seung-Hee. Then one day, while secretly masturbating on Seung-Hee's desk, Ah-Young discovers her secret diary and discovers the shocking truth... "What? My love, manager Cheon Seung-Hee, actually scolds people with sex every night?!"

title: Inko-Sensei
description: Sequel to Tadokoro-san.

characters.name: Kageko Tadokoro
characters.description: Tadokoro is a high school student, who was bullied for her gloomy looks as a child and thus became introverted and developed an interest for manga with cool looking guys. When her classmates started bullying her for her hobby again, Sakurako, the person adored by everyone, stands up for her and they start befriending each other.

characters.name: Sakurako Nikaidou
characters.description: A smart and beautiful girl adored by others. She stands up for Tadakoro, when their classmates ridicule Tadakoro for drawing manga. She starts developing an interest for the reclusive girl.

characters.name: Hinata Suzuki
characters.description: Assistant mangaka for Inko.

title: Kimi ni Naretara
description: A girl-meets-girl story about an idol and an otaku high school girl who switch bodies.

title: Ao ga Cool Nante Dare ga Kimeta!?
title_original: 青がクールなんて誰が決めた!?
description: High school student Azusa Gujo is a magical girl. She makes a contract with Pollu, a Gem Setter with mysterious powers, to fight the powerful enemies that threatens the peace as the magical knight Pure Azurite... but! (Source: Author's Twitter, translated)

title: Goodnight Cinderella
description: Hong Jin-Ju and Ji Su-Jeong couldn't be any more different. Jin-Ju is bubbly, popular, and more interested in hanging out with friends and chasing women than worrying about school. On the other hand, Su-Jeong is quiet and reserved, relying on her good grades to earn her scholarship money to afford her tuition. Contrary to her closed off and frigid appearance, Su-Jeong is secretly the model and muse for the lingerie company, “Goodnight Cinderella.” Jin-Ju is drawn to the mysterious nature of Su-Jeong and wants to get to know her better, meanwhile Su-Jeong is keen to stay away and protect her secrets. Watch as the juicy drama unfolds on campus. (Source: Lezhin US, edited)

title: Cheers!
description: Kenta wants to join his new employer's cheering squad, but he finds it's been dissolved. What he finds instead is a cheerLEADING squad (in the prototypical H-Manga fashion) which only accepts female members. After showing a lot of perseverance, he is finally accepted as the manager. You can probably guess what follows: large group of sexy cheer-girls, one male protagonist...

title: Sakura*Nadeshiko
description: Two girls who want to become idols are entering into their long dreamed school—Kiraboshi-juku—Kiraboshi Nadeshiko and her close friend Mangetsu Sakurako. These two are so close that despite both being girls, they're often compared to a married couple by people around them. And so begins their life in the dormitory as roommates. However, on their first night, an unusual, illicit impulse strikes Nadeshiko... Chapter count includes four extras

title: Mikubon
description: Hatsune Miku and her friends Rin, Len, and Luka are not only back in manga... they're back to school, enrolling at the St. Diva Academy for Vocaloids! They're going to give it their best at St. Diva, as a wonderland of friendship, determination, and even love unfolds! But can they stay out of trouble, especially when the mad professor of the Hachune Miku Research Lab is nearby? (Source: Dark Horse)

characters.name: Miku Hatsune
characters.description: __Height:__ 158 cm (5'2") The first Japanese VOCALOID to be both developed and distributed by Crypton Future Media, Inc.. She was initially released in August 2007 for the VOCALOID2 engine and was the first member of the Character Vocal Series, as well as the seventh VOCALOID overall and the second VOCALOID2 vocal released to be released for the engine. Her voice is provided by the Japanese voice actress [Saki Fujita](https://anilist.co/staff/95504/Saki-Fujita). There have since been numerous installments, such as additional voice libraries dubbed 'Append', as well as an upgrade for the VOCALOID3 engine, which contained an English vocal release. She received a VOCALOID4 update to her Japanese and English voicebanks in August 2016, as well as a Mandarin Chinese voicebank in September 2017. Miku is considered the most popular and well known Vocaloid and the first to become a pop idol. The

She (along with her counterpart, [Len](https://anilist.co/character/9274/Kagamine-Len)) is the second set of vocals for Crypton's Character Vocal Series and are both Character Voice VOCALOIDs. During their Append's production, Wataru Sasaki (aka. Wat) described Rin & Len as two bodies with one soul. She has had umerous installments since such as additional voice banks dubbed 'Append', an update to the VOCALOID4 engine, and an English vocal. Rin is designed to be a deep sounding teenage female, and the female counterpart for the Len vocal also supplied within the package. When the K

characters.name: Len Kagamine
characters.description: __Languages:__ Japanese and English __Company:__ Crypton Future Media __Release Date:__ December 27, 2007 Len Kagamine, codenamed CV02, is Japanese VOCALOIDs developed and distributed by Crypton Future Media, Inc., and were initially released in December 2007 for the VOCALOID2 engine. He (along with his counterpart, [Rin](https://anilist.co/character/9272/Kagamine-Rin) is the second set of vocals for Crypton's Character Vocal Series and are both Character Voice VOCALOIDs. During their Append's production, Wataru Sasaki (aka. Wat) described Rin & Len as two bodies with one soul. He has had numerous installments since such as additional voice banks dubbed 'Append', an update to the VOCALOID4 engine, and an English vocal. When the Kagamines were being recorded in 2007, their names were not yet decided. Their given names of Rin and Len were said to be based on "right" and "left" according to

characters.name: KAITO
characters.description: KAITO is the second vocaloid that Crypton released. He is often portrayed as a gentle, kind-hearted, easy-going, and somewhat oblivious young man. KAITO has no official given age but he and [Meiko](https://anilist.co/character/14076/Meiko) are often referred as "Nenchou-gumi" (年長組, The Seniors) compared to Vocaloid2s. He is 5'10" tall. His character item is ice cream. His voice was provided by the Japanese singer [Naoto Fuuga](https://anilist.co/staff/270355/Naoto-Fuuga).

characters.name: Meiko
characters.description: __Height:__ 170 cm (5'7") MEIKO is the first of the Japanese VOCALOID voice synthesizers released by Crypton Future Media. Her voice was provided by Japanese singer [Meiko Haigo](https://anilist.co/staff/102892/Haigou-Meiko). MEIKO is seen as a complementary voicebank to [KAITO](https://anilist.co/character/10807/KAITO). She is often portrayed with alcoholic beverages (most notably sake) due to her original VOCALOID1 voicebank having slurred pronunciation, causing her to sound drunk. It is a common misconception that her surname is "Sakine", however, MEIKO does not have a surname. Sakine Meiko is a fan-made derivative character created to portray a younger version of MEIKO. While she is officially recognised by Crypton, Sakine Meiko is not considered a canon version of MEIKO.

characters.name: Luka Megurine
characters.description: __Height:__ 162 cm (5'4") Luka Megurine is the third Vocaloid2 in Crypton's character series. Unlike the previous Vocaloids, Luka can sing in both Japanese and English. The name "Megurine" can be read in Japanese as the "sound that travels (the whole wide world)," and the name Luka invokes the homonymous Japanese words of "nagare" (flowing) and "ka" (song) or "kaori" (scent). [Yuu Asakawa](https://anilist.co/staff/95119/Asakawa-Yuu) provides Luka's 'cool, yet husky feminine voice'. Luka was designed by the Japanese illustrator [Kei](https://anilist.co/staff/98661/KEI), who had previously created the designs for [Hatsune Miku](https://anilist.co/character/7156/Hatsune-Miku) and [Kagamine Rin](https://anilist.co/character/9272/Kagamine-Rin) and [Len](https://anilist.co/character/9274/Kagamine-Len). However, unlike previous mascots in the series, her costume is not based on a school uniform

characters.name: Miku Hachune
characters.description: __Release date:__ September 4th 2007 Hachune is a mispronunciation of Hatsune, which shows her childishness and foolishness. She is essentially a [Miku Hatsune](https://anilist.co/character/7156/Hatsune-Miku) clone, so she shares her characteristics, but with a rather comedic twist. Hachune is one of the Vocaloid derivatives officially recognized by Crypton Future Media, the publisher of the Character Vocal Series for VOCALOID2. She is intended primarily as a mascot, rather than a singing derivative. Her first song was Ievan Polkka (at the time the name Hachune Miku was n't decided). This video made Vocaloid world-famous and also started the fanmade setting of Vocaloids having character items. In Hatsune Mix, Hachune often appears out of nowhere, upsetting the main characters and generally getting herself into trouble. She usually only comes up to the other characters knees in height, bu

characters.name: Teto Kasane
characters.description: __Height:__ 157.5 cm Teto is a 31-year-old chimera girl who was born as a joke from NicoNicoDouga forum users. She loves eating baguettes, and she has a close relation with Ted Kasane and Ruko Yowane. Depicted as more innocent than [Miku Hatsune](https://anilist.co/character/7156/Hatsune-Miku) is, Teto is cheerful and eager - though may be naughty at times - perhaps inspired by her mischievous roots from [Doraemon](https://anilist.co/character/4304/Doraemon). Depicted also as a Tsundere, but to more gentler extent. She gets very angry or sad if someone has bread and does not share with her. Teto enjoys teasing people just to show she cares about them since she doesn't want to show her love. She can get out of control if not eaten bread for one day. Obviously, she doesn't act and sound for her age, for a 31-year-old girl, thus her human age (15) is more believed; the depiction as a 31-yea

characters.name: Kuma Uta
characters.description: Large, but timid; he cracks under pressure and gives in to puppy-dog eyes easily. Rumor has it that he's a very good singer because he is only and mostly known from the game Kumauta. He's a real virtual singer; a voice before even Miku, Meiko and Kaito.

characters.name: Sweet ANN
characters.description: Sweet ANN is an English VOCALOID.

characters.name: Gojira
characters.description: __Height:__ 50-100 Meters (164-328 Feet) Viewed as both an enemy and ally, Gojira has roamed the Earth for more than fifty years! He has saved the Earth countless times, but has also always devastated Japan with his rampages! He has had children, friends, enemies and everything in between. He has also been in America, Australia, other dimensions and even outer space! He has battled against all threats from Earth or from outside of it. Godzilla has existed since his creation by the H-Bomb. His adventures continue even to this day as the world he protects, continually, tries to destroy him.

title: Nappeun Jjogeuro
description: Instead of holding her accountable, Marie makes a strange suggestion to Seon, who is falsely being accused to have stolen the class' money. Was it a helping hand? (Source: Naver, translated)

title: Giniro no Kami no Arisa
description: As a child, the eponymous heroine is betrayed by three jealous friends who throw her into a pit and leave her to die. But Arisa perserveres: She trains herself to be smarter, faster, and more beautiful than any of them and returns for revenge. Years of living underground have left her with the silver hair of the title, so her victims can't be sure whether the resemblance is real or only the product their guilty consciences...

title: Mikarun X
description: Somebody wants the Earth! After being invaded for 6 times by monsters and aliens, Tokyo was damaged and almost destroyed. When Runna Minami meets an honor student, Mika Kujiraoka, the bishojo fighters of justice, Mikarun X, are born. They transform themselves in two giants and, without wearing anything, the two heroines fight against the various enemies.

title: Nijiiro Secret
title_original: にじいろシークレット
description: 1. Mayoeru Kohitsuji wa Madoroi nagara mo (まよえる子羊はまどろいながらも) 2. Hajikete Tansan, Natsu Moyou. (はじけて炭酸、夏模様。) 3. Sugarcraft wa Yuuten wo Shiranai (シュガークラフトは融点を知らない) 4. Shiroi Toiki wa Yakedo ni Nite (白い吐息は火傷に似て) 5. Anata wa, Watashi no (あなたは、わたしの)

title: Kowaku no Kowai no
description: Note: Originally published in Comic Yuri-Hime 2026 July issue.

title: Husky and Medley
description: A manga adaptation based on an internet thread in which a girl attempts to reveal her "perfect" classmate's weak point by confessing her love for her - and the development of their relationship from there on out.

title: Rental Shop de Onee-san wo Rental Suru Hanashi
title_original: レンタルショップでお姉さんをレンタルする話
description: Wakamiya fell in love at first sight with Tsukioka, a clerk at a video rental store. She went to the store every day to approach the older girl, but...... This is a love comedy about the cool but humorous older girl teasing an admirer who's trying to express her feelings. Love is not easy to get! That's why it's fun! The original web series "Rental Shop" and the sister story "Skinship" are collected and expanded with more than 50 newly drawn pages. (Source: Kadokawa, translated) Collected Stories: - Title Story - Honto ni Atta Kamoshirenai Yuri na Hanashi (本当にあったかもしれない百合な話) - 11-Sai Toshishita no Onnanoko ni Skinship Sareru Hanashi (11歳年下の女の子にスキンシップされる話)

characters.name: Tsukioka
characters.description: A dry, dense girl who works at Tatsuya Way, a video rental shop. Many of the customers flirt with her, particularly Wakamiya, but she deflects their interest with deadpan jokes.

characters.name: Wakamiya
characters.description: A black-haired girl who is infatuated with the cashier at video rental shop Tatsuya Way, Tsukioka. Despite constant pranks and teasing from the subject of her affections, she remains persistent in her attempts to woo her.

title: Boku ni shika Furenai Succubus San Shimai ni Shiborareru Hanashi
title_original: 僕にしか触れないサキュバス三姉妹に搾られる話
title_en: Hands-On Draining with Three Succubus Sisters
description: What do you get when a sex-deprived succubus meets the first man she can finally touch? A full contact, whole body, day-long banging session. The three Amaki sisters are untouchables at their school, and not just because of their perfect looks or standoffish personalities; anyone they touch immediately has an orgasm that will kill them if touched too long. While lamenting never being able to have a normal school life, Lamy, the middle sister, finally finds someone she can touch in her classmate Yuuki Subaru. And he's soon going to find out he can't keep her off him! (Source: Irodori Comics)

title: Violence Jack
title_original: バイオレンスジャック
description: September 11, 197x, In the whole Kantou region a magnitude 8-9 violent earthquake occurred. Scholars called it the great destruction of the Showa Era, but the people called it the earthquake from hell! Volcanoes erupted, buildings crumbled, Tokyo became decimated in a single day. The government, after failing to recover the city, abandons Tokyo and moves the capital. The survivors form a society with no laws.
