In this harsh lawless world emerges Jack, a 10 foot giant who annihilates anyone and anything in his path. The manga details his journey. Note: This was the serialization in the magazine Weekly Manga Goraku.

characters.name: Violence Jack
characters.original: バイオレンスジャック
characters.description: Half-man, half-giant; Jack is large and incredibly strong and wields a large jack knife. Jack scours the underworld and lends his strength to good causes, protecting the weak and bringing justice to the post-apocalyptic world. ~!In CB Chara Go Nagai World, it is revealed that Jack is Akira Fudo (Devilman) after his battle versus Satan.!~

characters.name: Slum King
characters.description: Slum King is the ruler of earthquake-devastated Kanto. He has two children, Zubaban and Jannu.

characters.name: Himiko
characters.description: Loyal assistant of Garan

characters.name: Zubaban
characters.description: A boy from the Warring States period who loves to battle.

characters.name: Akira Fudou
characters.description: __Height:__ 182 cm Akira is a shy, soft spoken, and somewhat cowardly teen. His father has recently went to work in America so he is currently living with his friend Miki's family. He hasn't seen his best friend Ryo in over a month since moving in with Miki's family. When they reunite he is in for a big surprise that will forever change him, his life, and all of mankind. ~!Devilman is Akira Fudo after he merged with Amon in order to save mankind from the demons. While he usually stays in his human form, he turns into Devilman when he needs to fight seriously. Akira still retains his human heart after he becomes Devilman, meaning he can feel love and empathy unlike demons, but his personality changes drastically as a result of the merge.!~

characters.name: Ryo Asuka
characters.description: The best friend of Akira Fudo, the main character of Nagai Go's classical horror manga Devilman. As Akira is the strength, Ryo is the brain. His father discovered the existence of demons in our world and decided to fight them. He asked his friend Akira for help. Ryo knew that to be able to beat a demon, one had to become a demon. He and Akira went through a ritual to fuse with demons, but in the end, only Akira was able to do so and became Devilman, leaving Ryo remain as a normal human. ~!Ryo's true identity was much more horrible, much more terrifying than he or Akira could've ever imagined. Ryo turned out to be Satan himself, who sought to destroy the world. Satan is depicted as a beautiful hermaphroditic Seraphim angel with twelve wings. However, it is later revealed by Zenon that Satan is in fact in love with Akira. The Devil's love for Akira was developed through the human relations

characters.name: Honey Kisaragi
characters.description: Honey Kisaragi is a regular Catholic schoolgirl, until the day her father is murdered by the "Panther Claw" Organization. After his death, she learns she is actually an android created by him and within her is the Fixed System of Air Elements. By saying "Honey Flash!" she can transform into the sword-wielding red-haired superhero, Cutie Honey.

characters.name: Natsuko Aki
characters.description: As with many of the supporting characters in Cutie Honey, Aki has taken on many different roles. In the original manga she is Honey's friend and roommate at the all girls school they go to. In Re: Cutie Honey Aki Natsuko is a lead Investigator for the National Police Security Task Force – Branch 9. She is cold and controlling and is an absolute perfectionist. While she is an exceptional police officer she also has the bad habit of getting “in over her head” into trouble. She is an expert marksman. She tends to wear black a lot and lives alone in a small apartment. She has a passion for Japanese Sake and when she gets drunk loves to sing Karaoke. Hides her beauty by wearing non-prescription eyeglasses.

characters.name: Kekkou Kamen
characters.description: The superheroine protector of Sparta Academy's students who fights in the nude, covering only her face, arms and legs. Her signature finishing move is the "Oppiroge Jump" (おっぴろげジャンプ), which involves her jumping on her opponent's face groin-first. ~!Her real identity isn't a single person, but a group of six different women - anytime one of them gets exposed, the rest provide each other with an alibi.!~ Note: Initially created by Go Nagai as a joke pitched to his editor, being a parody of the first Japanese tokusastsu superhero, [Gekkou Kamen](https://ja.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E6%9C%88%E5%85%89%E4%BB%AE%E9%9D%A2).

characters.name: Satan no Ashi no Tsume
characters.description: The perverted principal of the school.

characters.name: Mayumi Takahashi
characters.description: The unfortunate student who has to deal with all the unjust penalties for either falling asleep in class or used as bait to lure out Kekko Kamen

characters.name: Kouji Kabuto
characters.description: Mazinger Z: Kouji Kabuto is the protagonist of the show, an average student with great skill in driving motorcycles. He lived with his brother Shiro and his grandfather Juuzo, after his parents were apparently killed in a lab accident caused by his grandfather. One day, Koji receives a call from his grandfather to meet him at his mountain cabin. Just as Kouji arrives however, the cabin explodes. Searching the remains, he uncovers a hidden doorway into the mountain and inside, he finds his dying grandfather who tells him with his dying wish to pilot "Mazinger Z" and stop a man named Dr. Hell. Kouji continues into the hidden lab and discovers the huge, humanoid robot Mazinger Z, and the hover pilder which is used to control it. Honoring his grandfather's last wish, he joins up with the Photon Power Labs and fights the forces of Dr. Hell with his Mazinger Z. Shin Mazinger: The protagonist o

title: Tyra to Cera
description: A herbivorous dinosaur cricket that has encountered a horrible carnivorous dinosaur.

title: Chan Zhi
description: In order to prevent the villainous princess from bringing doom upon this world, Jiang Xu—who transmigrated into her imperial sister-in-law—does her very best to nurture Her Highness into a virtuous and well-behaved ruler, despite her own frail health. However, when she grew up, the haughty yet alluring princess unexpectedly pins Jiang Xu down onto the bed. "If you can love my brother, why not me, too? Won’t you have a look my way, my dear sister-in-law?" Jiang Xu: …If you think I’ve lived long enough and want to drive me mad, just say so! (Source: Bilibili, translated)

title: Chishiryou no Koufuku
description: A collection of sometimes tender and sometimes sad short stories depicting different forms of love. 1. Chishiryou no Koufuku (致死量の幸福) As long as you’re alive, I will always suffer. My older childhood friend is a hopeless jerk, and on top of that, he wants to die. He attempted many times, over and over again. I want to leave him. I know I can’t be happy if I stay with him… Why can’t I leave him? 2. Kurokami no Omoide (黒髪の思い出) 3. Me ni wa Me wo (目には目を) 4. Chalk no Ie (チョークの家) 5. Dekisokonai Robot (できそこないロボット) 6. Share Happy ! (シェア・ハピ !)

title: Kamisama Onegai
description: A composition of oneshots by Minami Q-ta. 1) Shoujo no Yume 2) Tomodachi 3) Kamisama Onegai 4) Kimi ni Muramura 5) Switch 6) Lunch wa Itsumo Issho 7) Sayuri-san no Nayami 8) Shinjuku Deluxe 9) Sayonara 3-gatsu 10) Apron to Sunglass 11) Noppo no Sally 12) Yuurei 13) Time After Time

title: Tandem Lover
description: Short manga volume with soft yuri stories. The action takes place in the near future in a pilot training school full of girls only. They train on robots named Tandemine which are controlled by two users.

title: Robot Izonkei Joshi no Meiwaku na Nichijou
title_original: ロボット依存系女子のメーワクな日常
description: Hagane Takashina is a high school girl and a genius mecha pilot. For some reason, she confines herself to the cockpit of her robot. She doesn't even like to get out to go to the bathroom, so she wears diapers most of time. She loves her only friend, Kotoha-chan, so much that she would run through fire and water for her. Hagane is a clumsy girl who can't do anything on her own except pilot robots, but in order to pay off the huge debt from the damage she caused, she ends up doing handyman jobs ranging from finding lost dogs to exterminating ghosts with her robot...! (Source: Kodansha, translated)

title: Tong Lei
description: The abuses suffered as a child will be inflicted again as an adult. Some people will take it out on others, but some people only harm themselves. (Source: Bilibili, translated)

title: Mai no Heya
description: 18-year-old old Mai Sugimoto is a college student starting this year. She was looking forward to the “college life”, but she ends up living with two women because of a realtor’s mistake. Furthermore, they are all 18-years-old and share the exact same name, Mai Suigimoto. Hence a life story of three Mai(s) full of fun and erotic excitement begins. Can these three girls get along? Perhaps even become friends, only time will tell in Mai’s Room.

title: Jiao Yang Le Ge Feng Pi Mei Ren Er
description: Upon being reborn, Bai Man is singularly focused on killing the tyrant Emperor and claiming the throne for herself. In her quest for power, she decides she must first win over the Grand Marshall Zhou Rong. But the first time they meet, Zhou Rong slams Bai Man to the bed and asks her if she remembers the pleasures from last night? Oh no! That cool lady general turns out to be a crazed yandere in private!! (Source: Bilibili, translated) Note: Includes two extra chapters.

title: 2-shuukan no Adventure
description: 1-3. 2-shuukan no Adventure 4. Himeko-chan 5. His Left Eye A story detailing an encounter between Gerry and Eugene from Barairo no Hoo no Koro, as adults. 6. Belgian Waffle Andrew, from Barairo no Hoo no Koro, takes a stroll with his old father, bringing about some surprising discoveries, aside from the fact that Belgian Waffles can be sweet.

title: Hare no Kuni no Apparedan
title_original: 晴れの国のあっぱれ団
description: After moving to Okayama, Momozaki Koharu met a splendid trio that called themselves friends of Momotaro. Because she has "momo" (peach) in her name and had a kibi dango with her, Koharu was recognized as Momotaro (by the group). In order to protect the peace of Okayama alongside them, they went to an amusement park, participated in a festival and many other things... isn't that just playing around?! A relaxing life of Okayama stories begins ♪ Note: Includes 1 extra chapter.

title: Ojou-sama to Sono Shiyounin no Ojouji
title_original: お嬢様とその使用人のお情事
description: Note: Originally published in Comic Yuri-Hime 2020 October issue.

title: Kouhai ga Nigate Datta Yuri no Hanashi
title_original: 後輩が苦手だった百合の話
description: The story of a sharp, bad-mannered office worker and the popular-type junior she can't stand.

title: Lens Goshi ni Oni wa Inai
title_original: レンズ越しに鬼はいない

title: Onna Doushi de Kodomo wo Umukoto ni Shimashita
title_original: 女どうしで子どもを産むことにしました
description: Koyuki Higashi and Hiroko Masahara's story of their decision to have a baby together, as a lesbian married couple. They previously chronicled their romance and wedding in Lesbian-teki Kekkon Seikatsu.

title: Mandarin Gypsy Cat no Roujou
title_original: マンダリン・ジプシーキャットの籠城
description: An elegiac manga about gender, community, family, control, class, love, and what makes life worth living at the end of the world. In Akane Torikai's Wandering Cat's Cage , it is the near future. Only a few women are still able to menstruate, and even fewer men will be born to them. Reproduction is limited to medical intervention controlled from on high, and the structures and lives of the past hold no weight: they are only hinted at through the remaining scraps of a world that no longer exists. Life can be good, though, if you fall in line, and the women of The City live bright, happy, tightly controlled lives. But complete obedience isn't for everyone. For the women across the river, who live in a rundown shantytown, viewing the opulence of the city from afar each night, life is different. It is humble, and often dangerous, but it is free. It is here that Sanada, a young acupuncturist, lives with the mysterious Reiho, the only male she's ever met, and who sells himself to the rich women who sneak across the river for something they've never experienced… The two form a small "family," taking in other young women ousted from the city. But a real, living, breathing male might be too

title: Kedamono no Uta
description: Miharu has a crush on her friend Nina but keeps her feelings to herself. However, when Nina gets a yet another boyfriend, Miharu's feelings begin to spiral out of control....

characters.name: Miharu Uchikawa
characters.description: Miharu is a teenage girl in love with her best friend, Nina.

characters.name: Nina
characters.description: Nina is Miharu's best friend. She has gone through many relationships and always seems to have a new boyfriend.

characters.name: Hasumi
characters.description: Miharu's classmate and childhood friend who has a crush on her.

characters.name: Fuuta
characters.description: Nina's current boyfriend.

title: Itsuka Shinu Shoujo
description: A story about an ordinary girl who makes a suicide attempt.

title: Seijou Kouchakan no Jijou
description: This tale begins with Shino who was in love with a girl called Maruyama. Shino asked his best friend, Akira, to set him up with Maruyama, but instead Akira betrayed Shino. Depressed, Shino goes to spend the rest of his day binging on cakes at the Seijou Black Tea House which is run by two mental cases by names of Shuuji and Keisuke. Mix a magical tea leaf, homosexuals, and various other things for ensuing hilarity. (Source: Taruby's Paradox)

title: Menmen Musubi
description: 1. Men Men Musubi (麺面むすび) 2. Osorosoroi (おそろそろい) 3. Fuusen Kazura wa Kyou mo Tobanai (風船カズラは今日も飛ばない) 4. Kuiki-gai Kandan-ryou (区域外閑談料) 5. Flying Cosmos (フライングコスモ) 6. Hatsu Arashi no Tsumugi Uta (初嵐のつむぎ歌) 7. Kuramujii Call (クラムジーコール)

title: Tanin no Sex wo Souzou Suru na
title_original: 他人のセックスを想像するな
description: A girl who works on a coffee shop encounters with her ex-girl friend, and the rumor of she being a lesbian spreads. Then, she meets with an homophobic person.

title: Yuri de Tero wo suru Manga
title_original: 百合でテロをする漫画
description: In a world where the power of yuri is so powerful, it can be used as a weapon! Two girls, Yu and Ri, set out to stop corrupt government officials from completing their evil plan. The minister was soon stopped by one simple book but what should the girls do when they are held at gun point unable to run or defend themselves?

characters.name: Yu
characters.description: Yu is one of the two Yurorist or yuri terrorists. She seems like a stern teamleader but that act is dropped as soon as her partner Ri makes some advanced towards her.

characters.name: Ri
characters.description: Ri is one of the two Yurittorist or Yuri terrorists. She feels like the bratty new co-worker of the team. She is however a true flirt talking about her adventures with Yu and actively putting the moves on her if the situation required. You could say she is on top outside of missions.

title: Himitsu.
description: 1. A Passing Story A school doctor recounts a romance from her own school days. 2. Pink A love triangle. It's set in the same school as "A Passing Story." 3. Romance A couple from the same school as "A Passing Story" and "Pink." 4. Lover Continues "A Passing Story" story in the present. 5. Himitsu. (Secret Love) A girl deals with heartbreak. 6. Toiki (Sigh) Shiratori, now in college, despairs of ever finding love. (Source: Lililicious)

characters.name: Monayo
characters.description: Mayu's girlfriend and the schoolnurse of the "West Yuri Gir'ls Gigh School".

characters.name: Shiratori
characters.description: In love with Ogata and part of the drama club.

characters.name: Kanako
characters.description: China's girlfriend.

characters.name: China
characters.description: Kanako's girlfriend.

characters.name: Nimura
characters.description: In love with Shiratori and part of the drama club.

characters.name: Ogata
characters.description: Is in love with Nimura and part of the drama club.

characters.name: Kaede
characters.description: Satsuki's grilfriend.

characters.name: Satsuki
characters.description: Kaede's girlfriend.

title: Renai Log
description: A collection of Takemiya Jin's doujinshi, published in tankoubon by Yuri Hime. 1~2. Otonari-san (The Woman Next Door) 1 3. Chocolat Orange 4~5. Anta Miteru to Muramura Sunda Kedo (Looking at You Kinda Turns Me On) 6. Kimikoishi-uta (A Song About Missing You) 7. Chocolat Orange 2

title: Sakura Trick: Happy Days
description: Sakura Trick Happy Days takes place a few years after the original Sakura Trick and the story starts with Haruka doing fine in college, and then gets an unexpected reunion with her friends back at Misato West. Though the main question is: Is Haruka doing fine with her girlfriend Yuu?

characters.name: Haruka Takayama
characters.description: **Height:** 158 cm Haruka is a student at Misato West High School and [Yuu's](https://anilist.co/character/86387/Yuu-Sonoda) best friend. Haruka also has a tendency to become jealous, especially when it comes to Yuu.

characters.name: Yuu Sonoda
characters.description: __Height:__ 149 cm Yuu is a student at Misato West High School and [Haruka](https://anilist.co/character/86385/Haruka-Takayama)'s best friend. She tends to slack off at school. Her older sister is [Mitsuki](https://anilist.co/character/87710/Mitsuki-Sonoda).

characters.name: Kotone Noda
characters.description: __Height:__ 162 cm Kotone is a student at Misato West High School and comes from a rich family. She gave [Haruka](https://anilist.co/character/86385/Haruka-Takayama) the nickname "Harupoppo".

characters.name: Shizuku Minami
characters.description: __Height:__ 156 cm Shizuku is a shy student at Misato West High School, who currently lives together with [Kotone](https://anilist.co/character/87706/Kotone-Noda).

characters.name: Kaede Ikeno
characters.description: __Height:__ 165 cm Kaede is a student at Misato West High School, and also the class president. Her best friend is [Yuzu](https://anilist.co/character/87709/Yuzu-Iizuka). ~!Later in the manga it’s confirmed that Kaede has feelings for Yuzu.!~

characters.name: Yuzu Iizuka
characters.description: __Height:__ 165 cm Yuzu is a student at Misato West High School. She goes to school on her moped. Her best friend is [Kaede](https://anilist.co/character/87708/Kaede-Ikeno).

title: Vignette Dropout
title_original: ヴィネットドロップアウト
description: This doujin was released on August 12, 2019 at Comiket 96 by Ukami under the circle name "Resort Ukami."

characters.name: Gabriel Tenma White
characters.original: 天真・ガヴリール・ホワイト
characters.description: __Height:__ 144 cm Gabriel is the main protagonist of the story and an angel who was the top of her class but turned into a 'Faillen Angel' after her newfound addiction to video games.

characters.name: Satanichia Kurumizawa McDowell
characters.original: 胡桃沢・サタニキア・マクドウェル
characters.description: __Height:__ 157 cm The self proclaimed "Future Queen of Hell". Satanichia is a dimwitted demon who often thinks of petty ways to cause mischief which usually end in failure. She is often pestered by both [Raphiel](https://anilist.co/character/120938) and [a dog](https://anilist.co/character/133465).

characters.name: Vignette Tsukinose April
characters.original: 月乃瀬・ヴィネット・エイプリル
characters.description: __Height:__ 155 cm The complete opposite of [Gabriel](https://anilist.co/character/120937/Tenma-White-Gabriel), Vignette is very responsible and often has to look after Gabriel, who lives in the same building as her, contrary to her actual role as a demon.

characters.name: Raphiel Shiraha Ainsworth
characters.original: 白羽・ラフィエル・エインズワース
characters.description: __Height:__ 160 cm Raphiel is the second-ranked angel in Gabriel's class, who has since become a sadistic stalker who takes delight in teasing Satanichia and causing chaos for entertainment. (Source: Gabriel DropOut Wiki)

title: Houkago Nijigenme!
description: A girls' club for pursuing the cuteness of girls, known as "Love Club", engaged in fierce debate day after day! "Ane vs Imouto", "School swimsuit vs bikini"... etc. confrontations between members Aoi and Ouka, representing each faction! Aimi and Yumi forced to act as demonstrations against their will!? Plenty of fanservice and exposure, big tits and flat chests, please enjoy this cheerful school comedy!

title: Carneades
description: A world with five tribes… Angels, Demons, Beastfolk, Vampires, and Humans. Elle is an angel and a member of the police force who boasts powerful abilities. With her strong sense of justice, she is strict on herself and others while dedicating herself to her duties. Elle, who is well on her way to a promotion, is assigned to capture a timid demon named Eve. Although Eve has been arrested many times before, she has somehow managed to escape every time. Now tasked with catching the troublemaker, Elle finds that due to her summoning power and elusive nature, apprehending Eve is far from easy! On top of that, while pursuing Eve, Elle finds herself getting into all sorts of other troubles…!? (Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Oshikoi Capriccio
description: Mitsu Hikawa, a second-year high school student, and her best friend Rui Majima secretly love BL, and Mitsu spends her days fantasizing about the boys in her class. One day, one of the people she is observing, Shou Kagomiya, asks Mitsu, "Hikawa, you like Rui Majima don't you?" and Mitsu is shocked――!? A chaotic love triangle (?) between a fujoshi gyaru and a handsome himedanshi!! (Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Sayonara Alter
description: The funeral of an identical twin: which girl died? Sayonara Oruta won the gold prize in the 21st Dengeki Comics Grand Prix in 2014.

title: Princess Principal
title_original: プリンセス・プリンシパル
description: Artist and manga creator Ryou Akizuki launched a manga adaptation of the Princess Principal original anime on Tokuma Shoten's Comic Ryū manga website. Akizuki handled prop design in the original anime. (Source: Anime News Network)

characters.name: Ange le Carré
characters.description: Ange is a genius spy with artistic skills. She is adept in telling lies and she can tell when someone is lying to her. She also possesses a special device that allows her to fly for short periods of time. Despite her lying nature, Ange can be shown to be a nice and kind person ~!In Episode 2, it Ange is shown to show her personality only to the [Princess](https://anilist.co/character/122804/Princess).!~ ~!It is revealed that her real name is Charlotte.!~ ~!During episode 9 it is revealed that Charlotte was accidentally switched with Ange during the start of the revolution. Thus, Charlotte, who is the actual princess took Ange's name and lived on the other side of the wall.!~

characters.name: Beatrice
characters.description: A noblewoman who serves as Princess' aide and close friend. She can mimic voices of other people using a mechanism that her father implanted in her throat. Her father has treated her as a test subject for his experiments.

characters.name: Chise Toudou
characters.description: An exchange student from Japan. She is highly proficient in samurai-style swordsmanship. She often acts naive and has a hard time adapting to the culture differences. She is a spy for Japan tasked with observing the Commonwealth and Kingdom so that her superiors can determine which country to ally with.

characters.name: Dorothy
characters.description: An undercover student. She is actually 20 years old and acts as a leader to the spies. She is good at shooting, seducing and driving vehicles.

characters.name: Princess
characters.description: The niece of the [Duke of Normandy](https://anilist.co/character/123069/Duke-of-Normandy) and a princess of Albion Kingdom who is fourth in the line of succession for the throne. She has an oddball personality, but she gets along well with others. ~!She knew [Ange](https://anilist.co/character/122800/le-Carr-Ange) from ten years ago. She works with Ange in hopes that she will help her ascend to the throne. Princess's true name is Ange.!~ ~!During episode 9 it is revealed that Ange, the current "Princess" was switched with the real princess when the revolution started. Thus, she had to learn all the etiquette and mannerisms of being a princess on her own and adopted the role of "princess" in place of Charlotte.!~

title: Lady Black-eun Uulhada
description: All Margo wanted was some peace and quiet, even if she had to kill her husband to get it. She thought she’d gotten away with it too. She never expected the snowstorm or to be trapped in her house with suspicious eyes watching her every move. Margo’s fate lies in the hands of a strange maid, Peggy, who catches her in the act of destroying evidence. But what will Margo do when the touch of those hands makes her tremble with pleasure? Will she find her respite, or be forced to kill again? (Source: Tapas)

title: Juuza no UIna
description: Ulna Trop Jonk is a sniper who assumes her first military job on the front line of a remote island. There, the soldiers must fight against a wild village of monstrous aspect. Note: Won the 21st Japan Media Arts Festival Excellence Award's Manga Division in 2018. Nominated for the 24th Tezuka Osamu Cultural Award.

title: Megarosalia
description: This is a real villainess: she’ll mercilessly kill anyone who stands in the way of her glory. Deceive and manipulate a witch with the power to turn back time over and over—and kill all your rival young ladies! A fantastical suspense story of social climbing, where a woman rises from the lowest ranks to claim the throne as queen. (Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Neoui Gulle
description: Sun-Hee is intrigued by the arrival of the indifferent new girl from Seoul and wants to befriend her. Eun-Byeol puts up a cold exterior and ignores Sun-Hee, who attempts to make friends! When the two finally become friends, Sun-Hee soon starts to question her own feelings for Eun-Byeol (Source: INKR, edited) Note: Includes 1 extra chapter.

title: Haru no Hikari ni Nomarete mo
description: As the last freshmen at a high school scheduled to close, Narumi and Anzu are asked to make a graduation album. In contrast to Narumi, who reluctantly enrolled after failing to get into her preferred school and studies obsessively, Anzu has no particular dream and feels out of place, acting hit-or-miss. These two gradually get to know each other through the graduation album production... This is a story about the four seasons of girls who are torn between anxiety and hope for the future. (source: Ichijinsha, translated) Note: Includes one extra chapter.

title: Sore ga Kimi ni Naru
description: Twenty-six year old Amane is still getting over the bad breakup she had with a girl named Yuki back when she was in high school. One day, she bumps into a high school girl who looks exactly like Yuki and bursts into tears. This high school girl, who is named You, takes Amane out for lunch to try and help her feel better. As the two grow closer to one another, feelings begin to stir in both of their hearts, but will they be able to overcome the burden Yuki has placed upon Amane? Note: You is a character from Hakamada Mera's other work "If This Wish Comes True". Also contains the one-shot The Black-Eyed Witch published in Comic Yuri Hime S.

title: Salomelic
description: Salome moves around a lot with her mother. She's learned not to get too close to anyone at each new school, or to let them find out her secret: she's a witch! When the sunny Hikari tries to make friends with her, Salome thinks she's just being nice out of obligation, so she decides to find out what Hikari really thinks of her...

characters.name: Rikka Takarada
characters.description: The sole female member of Gridman Alliance and Yūta's classmate, who found the amnesiac boy in front of her house. Out of her teammates, she desires a normal life but wishes Yūta to keep fighting as Gridman to save her friends. ~!Once discovering Akane's double life as the creator of the monsters, Rikka becomes committed to reason with her friend despite the former's insistence that their friendship was not genuine. Before Akane leaves for her world, Rikka gives her a purse case as a departure gift.!~

characters.name: Akane Shinjou
characters.description: Akane is noted to be a kind and popular girl, liked by all her classmates, and especially admired by Utsumi. ~!However, behind that facade lies a mentally troubled individual with sociopathic tendencies, easily harboring petty grudges against anyone who wrongs her, even if it was an accident. She is also shown to be extremely manipulative and violent. Alongside Alexis Kerib, she serves as a central antagonist in SSSS.Gridman.!~

characters.name: Yuuta Hibiki
characters.description: Yuuta has amnesia at the beginning to the extent of not even remembering where he lives. He fuses with Junk to become Gridman. ~!It is later revealed that the Yuuta we have seen throughout the show has been Gridman inside of Yuuta's body the entire time, except he had forgotten who he was (explaining the amnesia).!~

characters.name: Gridman
characters.description: Gridman (グリッドマン, Guriddoman) is a Hyper Agent from the Hyper World and the titular hero of SSSS.GRIDMAN and GRIDMAN UNIVERSE. ~!In SSSS.GRIDMAN, he chose Yuuta Hibiki as his host to stop Alexis Kerib in order to save Akane Shinjou. However, the injuries he sustained from the fight against Alexis resulted Gridman split into six fragments. Whereas Gridman's master fragment resided within an old computer aptly named "Junk", Four of the fragments spawned new Hyper Agents that became both hosts of said fragments and new assist weapons at the simulated city while the last one ended up possessing his new partner Yuuta, resulting the latter's seemed amnesia.!~ ~!In GRIDMAN UNIVERSE, his power of creation was being manipulated by a sentient kaiju named Mad Origin, which resulted in the creation of Kaiju using the Hyper Agent's thoughts for the purpose of harvesting the negative thoughts of humank

characters.name: Samurai Calibur
characters.original: サムライ・キャリバー

characters.name: Namiko
characters.description: __Height:__ 150 cm Namiko is one of Rikka Takarada's closest friends.

characters.name: Alexis Kerib
characters.description: He is the main antagonist of SSSS.GRIDMAN and is the spiritual successor of Khan Digifier.

characters.name: Anti
characters.description: A sentient kaiju created by Akane that is able to copy his opponent's abilities. Anti displays an irrational hatred for the Hyper Agent in both his human and kaiju forms. His hatred is so great, Anti will even attack a fellow kaiju if they stand between him and Gridman. ~!During the tenth episode, Anti's obsession with defeating Gridman evolved into a desire to protect him. This, combined with Anti's own copy ability, transformed Anti's kaiju form into a Gridman-like form dubbed Gridknight!~

characters.name: Orie Takarada
characters.description: She is Rikka's mother and the owner of Junk Shop Aya.

characters.name: Anosillus 2-daime
characters.description: She is a mysterious girl who somehow knows of the secrets of the world. Similar to Anti, she is really a kaiju in human form. However, unlike the other kaiju, she was not created by Akane Shinjo.

title: Just You and I
description: Three short stories involving the end of the Heisei era, hopes for positive change in the next era, and gay women talking with heterosexual women. 1. Baby Don't Cry by Canno 2. Girl Talk by Nega 3. The Meaning of Us by Kawauchi

title: Tomodachi ni Nante Modorenai.
title_original: 友達になんて戻れない。
description: When the assholish Ucchi comes to her gay friend Acchan with one hell of a request, the two of them come to some very strange realisations about each other. A funny, off-kilter comedy story from yuri up-and-comer Suzuki-senpai.

title: Kimi to Nara, Ashita wo Utaeru no
title_original: 君となら、明日を歌えるの
description: That day, when I met you, my world, where I couldn't even speak, was filled with music. High school student Fujieda Yuzuki is a kind girl who is liked by everyone. She prioritizes the people around her - her friends and her boyfriend - and hides her true feelings. She's not good at using her own voice. Putting others first had been Yuzuki's way of life up until then. That is, until she met you. One day, Yuzuki comes across a girl singing and playing the guitar on the street. Unable to forget the voice, she was humming a tune alone in the classroom after school when the girl from that time, Terada Hinata, appeared. It turned out to be a student at the same high school. What's more, she spoke to him, saying, "I've come from the future to save you" --!? A girl meets girl x school youth story!! (Source: Young Ace Up, translated)

title: Valkyrie Drive Bhikkhunism
title_original: ヴァルキリードライヴ ビクニズム
description: This spin-off tells the story of the girls who have the VR-Virus and live on the island of Bhikkhuni.

characters.name: Rinka Kagurazaka
characters.description: The oldest of the Kagurazaka sisters. Though she’s one to be constantly smiling and has a gentle disposition at heart, her sheer rampaging prowess born from her pure heart strikes fear even in the heart of her younger sister Ranka. She fights with a Japanese sword and leaves a very nice scent in her tracks as she moves. Her sword also transforms into an upgraded, ancient-like sword when she kisses anybody that will perform a drive with her.

characters.name: Ranka Kagurazaka
characters.description: The younger of the Kagurazaka sisters. Determined and whimsical, she’s a hot-blooded girl who stands out thanks to her boyish behavior. She fights with her fists and goes head-first into battle. Both she and her sister are very sensitive when it comes to their bodies being touched. Her weapons are two huge beast-face gauntlets after she kisses anyone that can perform a drive with her.

characters.name: Momo Kuzuryuu
characters.description: Momo is a reserved girl with a low voice, and wields a spear in battle. She is one of the new arrivals to Bhikkhuni, with the rare VR strain of the A Virus, much like the others.

characters.name: Mana Inagawa
characters.description: __Height:__ 167 cm __Type:__ Hybrid (VR-Virus) A calm, loving girl, Mana serves as the group’s mediator. She can transform her hair into arrows one strand at a time, making her an especially dangerous opponent to face off against knowing her hair can slip through any crack in the enemy’s defenses. Her greatest weapon, however, may be her ability to make people around her crack a smile no matter whether she’s complimenting them or telling them off.

characters.name: Viola
characters.description: Viola is the 5th generation queen who overwhelms her surroundings with her arrogant behaviour and flashy appearance. All valkyries will kneel down to her and battle with stylish swords and guns while the male will do nothing but bow down to her beauty. She's wrapped in a sweet aroma opposite to the cool appearance.

characters.name: Manpukumaru-Chan
characters.description: Manpukumaru simply loves food. Though her perpetually cheerful attitude makes her seem harmless, don't be fooled: in her eyes, the difference between friend and foe is a simple as who has more food to offer. Perhaps a full stomach is her only ally. She uses dual cleavers in battle.

title: Sayuri Hime
description: A special mini-edition of Yuri Hime magazine with extremely short manga by Fujieda Miyabi, Takahashi Mako, Shinonome Mizuo, Chi-Ran, Sunao Minakata, and Hakamada Mera and illustrations by Hibiki Reine, Hoshino Lily, Nangoku Banana, Morishima Akiko, Hakamada Mera, and Hayase Hashiba. This book was a special send-away item and is not available in stores. (Source: Lililicious) Sayuri Hime (2006) Kotonoha no Miko to Kotodama no Majo to Extra: Kotohana no Saku (Fujieda Miyabi) Nagoriyuki (Takahashi Mako) Hatsukoi Shimai Extra (Shinonome Mizuo) Yuri Kago no Nazo (CHI-RAN) Minami to Misuzu Extra (Minakata Sunao) Akuma no Umai Wana (Hakamada Mera) Sayuri Hime Vol. 2 (17-08-2007) Gurenki (Takewakamaru) Epitaph (Shouoto Aya) Magical Chocolate (Otsu Hiyori) Honey Crush Extra (Asu Tsubaki) Minami to Misuzu Extra (Minakata Sunao) Manatsu no Koibito (Morishima Akiko) Dream Trip (CHI-RAN) Kaichou to Fukukaichou Extra (Hakamada Mera) Junsui Adolescence: Natsu Mado Yawa (Kazuma Kowo) Butterfly 69 Instat Summer (Natsuneko) Umai Memai (Yuzuha Seiro) Apple Day Dream Extra (Jounouchi Nene) Sayuri Hime Vol. 3 (2008) Another Sweet Field (Nanzaki Iku) Hanasaku Uraniwa no Densetsu (Hakamada Mera) Summer Nu

title: Onnanoko no Sekkeizu
description: 1-3. Onnanoko no Sekkeizu (女の子の設計図); Hirari, Vol.6~8 (2011~2012) 4. Shounen (少年); Hirari, Vol.9 (2012/11) Miyaji is suddenly approached by Hayama, her senpai, who tells her "Inside me lives a boy, and he's fallen in love with you." 5. wicca ; Wings 2012-12 6. Onna no Karada (おんなのからだ); Comic Yuri Hime 2011-01 A love story between a sister and sister-in-law.

title: Yume no Naka de Kimi wo Sagashite
description: Yume Hanayama is an ordinary school girl who longs for love. An ordinary school girl who love hair accessories making and chocolate chip cookies. Except for one thing, "I can not forgive liking anyone." After several years, Yume reunites with her childhood friend, Yukino, who supports her dream. Three people's past, secrets, twisted and and stagnated... a story about distorted love and "a girl who can not like anyone." (Source: Amazon, translated)

title: Koi ni Wazurai
description: 1. Koi-iro Cocktail (恋色カクテル; Love-colored Cocktail) 2. SCANDAL 3. Kateikyoushi to Imouto-chan (家庭教師と妹ちゃん; A Tutor and a Little Sister) 4. Mousou Diary (妄想ダイアリー; Delusion Diary) 5. Renai Wars (恋愛ウォーズ; Love Wars) 6. Missing Link Side: Rina 7. Missing Link Side: Syuri

title: Majime Girl to Seishun Lingerie
title_original: 真面目ガールと青春ランジェリー
description: The high school girl Ran Umemiya visits an unfamiliar place by herself for the first time: a lingerie boutique. There, she meets a high school girl who is very particular about her underwear, and the store's saleslady who loves lingerie in all its forms. Ran will learn many new things about lingerie that she never knew before. (Source: ComicWalker, translated)

characters.name: Ran Umemiya
characters.description: High school student. Before she met Gerry, her underwear was always chosen by her mother.

characters.name: Geraldine Kosaka
characters.original: 小阪ジェラルディーン
characters.description: High school student. She loves underwear and goes to Sorara's lingerie boutique every day.

characters.name: Sorara Kandori
characters.description: A shopkeeper with a great obsession for lingerie.

characters.name: Oriko Toufu
characters.description: Everyone's big sister

characters.name: Rino Marushige
characters.description: A carefree spirit. Everybody calls her Ganmo.

characters.name: Riku Shirataki
characters.description: Ran's best friend.

characters.name: Umimi Kandori
characters.description: Sorara's little sister

title: Inotte Tamaruka
description: Yokoyari Mengo depicts the intense emotions of women × women!! This is the story of that beautiful girl who I loved and wanted to protect. (Source: Shueisha, translated)

title: Yurika to Sayuri wa Koibito Doushi
title_original: ゆりかとさゆりは恋人同士
description: Yurika loves cute things and goes at her own pace. Sayuri is shy and soft-spoken, but beautiful and honest. They are a couple of high school girls who just started dating. It is a heartwarming slice-of-life manga. (Source: Melonbooks, translated)

title: Onedari Shitemite
description: 1. Onedari Shitemite 2. Mahou Shoujo ga Shourai Naritai Shokugyou Dai 1-i ni Narimashita. 3. No.105 4. Takenoko to Hotate no Harusame Salad Yuzukoshou Fuumi 5. Nakitai Hito wa Dokonimo Inai 6. Hachimitsubiyor 7. Futaribeya

title: Koboreta Milk ga Kawaku Mae ni. Sairoku Tanpenshuu
title_original: こぼれたミルクが乾く前に。再録短編集
description: A collection of stories from Shinoa's Twitter account compiled for COMITIA 137. 1-2. Koboreta Milk and bonus chapter 3. Poolside nite 4. Kimi wa Unmei no Hito 5. Densha Monogatari 6. Natsu ga Kitara 7. Saitei no Koi wo Shiteiru 8. Okisaki-sama to Ningyo-hime 9. Shimi

title: Tsun Hime-sama to Dame Ouji-chan
title_original: ツン姫さまとダメ王子ちゃん
description: A certain school has an elegant girl known as Hime (princess), and another girl so handsome she's known as Ouji (prince). They live their school life always following these roles, but in reality these girls are nothing like their names, with one having a bad temper and one always crying. Can they fool their classmates?

title: Shoujo☆Kageki Revue Starlight Comic Anthology: Nine Stories
title_original: 少女☆歌劇 レヴュースタァライト コミックアンソロジー ナイン・ストーリーズ
description: Cover Illustration Ayasugi Tsubaki Illustration: Sakuraba Yuuki, Mobile Iwashi, Hamburger, Hara Yuriko 1. Daiba Nana no Daitai 77-bu Cooking (大場ななのだいたい77分クッキング) [Imai Tetsuya] 2. Tameiki to Namida de Dekita Basho (ため息と涙でできた場所) [zinbei] 3. Butai Shoujo to Shoutengai no Kaidan (舞台少女と商店街の怪談) [Kobara Yuuko] 4. Yumemiru Futaba (ユメみる双葉) [Itagaki Komari] 5. Kaoruko Maid ni Omakase! (香子メイドにおまかせ！) [Hiba] 6. Watashi no Hoshi (私の星) [Kusada] 7. Mahiru no Horegusuri Daisakusen (まひるのほれ薬大作戦) [Hami] 8. Hoshi to Waltz wo (星とワルツを) [Haruhana Aya] 9. Point of No Return (ポイント・オブ・ノ―・リタ―ン) [Kabocha]

characters.name: Futaba Isurugi
characters.description: Futaba Isurugi is a character in the Shōjo☆Kageki Revue Starlight franchise. She is a second-year student from the Actor Training Department at Seisho Music Academy's 99th Graduating Class. A highly unorthodox Stage Girl who came to Seisho Music Academy along with her childhood friend Kaoruko. Kind-hearted despite her rough words, she takes care of Kaoruko while always griping. Tiny but athletic, she shows deadly aptitude for staged swordfights.

characters.name: Nana Daiba
characters.description: Nana Daiba is a second-year student from the Actor Training Department at Seisho Music Academy's 99th Graduating Class. This Stage Girl is the de facto mother of the 99th class, kind and caring to her classmates. Nicknamed "Banana". Talented not only in singing and dancing but also as a director. Still delighted by the group performance of "Starlight" back in her first year.

characters.name: Kaoruko Hanayagi
characters.description: Kaoruko Hanayagi is a character in the Shōjo☆Kageki Revue Starlight franchise. She is a second-year student from the Actor Training Department at Seisho Music Academy's 99th Graduating Class. Granddaughter of the head of a traditional Japanese dance school, this Stage Girl has refined skills in traditional song and dance. Raised in privilege, she is all too reliant on Futaba Isurugi. While she is always smiling, she is more calculating than anyone else. Speaks in the elegant Kyoto dialect.

characters.name: Junna Hoshimi
characters.description: Junna Hoshimi is a character in the Shōjo☆Kageki Revue Starlight franchise. She is a second-year student from the Actor Training Department at Seisho Music Academy's 99th Graduating Class. A top student who serves as the class representative. Has great decision-making and analytical skills, but is prone to overthinking. After choosing to pursue acting against her parents' wishes, she now frets over the gap in skill between herself and those with natural talent like Maya.

characters.name: Claudine Saijou
characters.description: She is a character in the Shōjo☆Kageki Revue Starlight franchise. She is a second-year student from the Actor Training Department at Seisho Music Academy's 99th Graduating Class, as well as the second seat in the class. Born to a Japanese father and a French mother, this talented Stage Girl already has a long career as a child actress. Upon entering the school, she meets the brilliant [Maya Tendou](https://anilist.co/character/126666/Tendou-Maya) and immediately begins a staunch rivalry.

characters.name: Maya Tendou
characters.description: She is a second-year student from the Actor Training Department at Seisho Music Academy's 99th Graduating Class, as well as head of the class. Practically born for the theater world, with a renowned stage actor and a prima donna for parents. Blessed with a good physique and a carrying voice, she refuses to rest on her laurels and always strives to reach greater heights.

characters.name: Mahiru Tsuyuzaki
characters.description: Mahiru Tsuyuzaki is the tritagonist in the Shōjo☆Kageki Revue Starlight franchise. She is a second-year student from the Actor Training Department at Seisho Music Academy's 99th Graduating Class. Though she sings and dances her heart out on stage, this Stage Girl is normally withdrawn and contemplative. She admires her roommate Karen's cheery and outgoing nature, but her feelings are put in a difficult place when Karen's old friend Hikari shows up.

characters.name: Hikari Kagura
characters.description: Hikari Kagura (神楽 ひかり, Kagura Hikari) is the deuteragonist of the Shōjo☆Kageki Revue Starlight franchise. She is a second-year student from the Actor Training Department at Seisho Music Academy's 99th Graduating Class. Karen's childhood friend. A born performer who studied at an acting school in England. Her fate has been linked with Karen's since viewing a performance of "Starlight". Reuniting with her old friend, she is driven by a strong desire to join the mysterious Revue. (Source: Revue Starlight Wiki)

characters.name: Karen Aijou
characters.description: The protagonist of the Shōjo☆Kageki Revue Starlight franchise. She is a second-year student from the Actor Training Department at Seisho Music Academy's 99th Graduating Class. She set out on the road to becoming a Stage Girl after being captivated by a performance of "Starlight" she saw as a child. She is always boisterous and cheerful but hates early morning lessons. She joins the mysterious Revue with Hikari Kagura, who crossed fates with her when they were young girls.

title: Stella☆Record
description: Kyoko and Ritsu are college girls who moved to Tokyo from the countryside and are sharing a room. Their feelings for each other have blossomed, and they are now in a romantic relationship, but for Ritsu, who is confused by all the new things she is experiencing, new problems seem to be arising...? Note: Includes the one-shot "Honto no Kimochi (ホントのキモチ)".

title: Honto wa Issho ni, Itai dake
title_original: ほんとは一緒に、いたいだけ
description: Note: Released at Comiket 106.

title: Tefure.
description: Kagura already has a girlfriend. But Hosoya, the girl who sits next to Kagura, offers him a "tefure" relationship. What kind of relationship is this? (Source: Magapoke, translated)

title: Midareta Futari no Mitasare Gohan
title_original: みだれたふたりのみたされごはん
description: The office lady who decided she wouldn't eat too much no matter how hungry she is, Hikami Runa. The high school girl who eats whenever she feels like it regardless of the time or place, Koizumi Ichika. Runa's restraint means she won't make any compromises when it comes to eating delicious things. Ichika isn't fussy when it comes to eating and doesn't know anything about ways to make things tastier. When these two eat together, it becomes an "obscene meal"! Note: The chapter count includes three extra chapters.

title: Emo Nüpu Zhi Xiang Bei Eyi Qianjin Qifu
title_original: 恶魔女仆只想被恶役千金欺负
description: Sharan, a pious girl, found a high-paying job as a maid. Her task is to serve a haughty and sadistic noble lady named Lynette. However, her job won't be an easy one… (Source: Billibilli, translated)

title: Shoujo Bigaku
description: Collection of short stories: 1. Kanojo no Naritai (彼女になりたい, I Want to Become Her!) A girl ends up living with a model she admires. 2. Kanojo no Hatsukoi (彼女の初恋, Her First Love) 3. Kanojo no LOVE-un (彼女のLOVE運, Her Luck in Love); formerly titled Beginner's Luck!? (ビギナーズ・ラック！？) 4. Kanojo no Yuuwaku (彼女の誘惑, Her Temptation); formerly titled Shoujo Bigaku: Kanojo no Ketsui Hyoumei (少女美学 -彼女の決意表明-) 5. Kanojo no Kokuhaku (彼女の告白, Her Confession); formerly titled Shoujo Bigaku (少女美学) 6. Uka: Aufbluhen (初花-Aufbluhen-, First Bloom) A short, full-color, smutty Plot What Plot manga. 7. Love Nori (らぶのり, Love Ride)

title: Ijiwaru na Kamisama
description: Kei is interested in a woman at the gym. Imagine her surprise when she sees her in a lesbian bar!

title: Baku Ai
description: Two girls, Sara and Youko, were once childhood friends, but they've since grown apart not only in intimation but in status. Sara shines while Youko is completely unspectacular at their Catholic high school. Suddenly, Sara wants to renew old bonds with Youko... and foster new ones. But her motives aren't as pure as simple (girl x girl) love...

title: Koi Nanka Daikirai
description: Story about two childhood friends. Sweetness and fluff all around.

title: Ichigo no Haitta Soda-sui
title_original: いちごの入ったソーダ水
description: Mannenrou Ladies' Academy is famous for its upper class and posh students. Despite knowing how out-of-place she'd be, the former yankee, Hanaizumi Luna, decides to enroll there. Moreover, according to her underling: "Girls' schools means yuri!! Add in school dormitories? Now that's a world of girl on girl action!!" And with those words in mind, Luna's new school life begins with a rough start. And how exactly will her relationship develop with her socially inept roommate, Miyota Kohime...?

title: Majo Maid wa Joou no Himitsu wo Shitteiru
title_original: 魔女メイドは女王の秘密を知っている
description: Liz, who has the ability to see the future, lost her fiancee for fear of her mysterious power. That was when Her Noble Majesty Queen Shuriez of Linfilia came along and hired her as a maid! Around Her Majesty, who has never married and has no heir, a struggle for succession has already begun among her five brothers. But then Liz finds out... that the queen, who needs to get married as soon as possible to maintain peace in the kingdom, has a big secret! (Source: Kodansha, translated)

title: Bamora!
description: At school, Kamazaki feels as though there is a circle drawn around her, a line that no one will cross. Part of it is because her face looks mean, part of it is because she's pretty socially awkward, and a large part of it is that she has earned a reputation for being really bad-tempered and violent to the people around her. However, this all changes in her second year of high school, when the cute, friendly, and popular Kume Asami crosses that invisible line and decides to be her friend. Kume introduces "Kama-chan" to friendship and to the 5-man soccer club that meets on the school roof. As Kama cautiously enters Kume's club, she may find herself able to grow past the bad expectations people have of her, and enter into a new, happier, high school life. (Source: MangaHelpers)

title: Watashi no Kanojo
description: Kiyomi is quiet and prefers reading books alone as opposed to the popular, flirtatious Miu who seems to always be hanging out with the boys of the class. When Kiyomi overhears some boys talking about how attractive she is, Miu gets mad. Is Miu jealous of the attention Kiyomi is now getting, or something else...?

title: Sore wa Marude Shunsetsu no Gotoki
title_original: それはまるで春雪のごとき
description: In the winter of her first year in college, Haru visits her aunt's town and meets a snow maiden in the forest.

title: Houtai Shoujo Kikan
description: During summer break, Juri goes to school to attend to committee meeting and happens to meet her schoolmate Nami. Nami is covered in bandages with a crutch, injuries she says she got from a fall; this meeting leads Juri and Nami to become closer than ever as the once boring summer quickly turns into a fun game with Juri playing as Nami's personal caretaker.

title: Jeonhak Saeng
description: Their friendship seems stronger than anything. But will it resist the appearance of a beautiful student? For Nare and Minsu, nothing is less certain. No need to lie, one thing is obvious for the two friends : Nare is completely captivated by her new classmate. So when the pretty stranger tries to become friends with Nare, the latter does nothing to stop her...

title: GAME OVER
description: This is not an one-shot as it was previously believed. Game Over is a full book by Uziga Waita. As usual his stories contain heavy doses of violence, mutilation, rape and cannibalism. The stories are: 01. News 02. Mai-chan's Secret (This is the prototype for what eventually became "Mai-chan's Daily Life") 03. Mai-chan's Daily Life (The story of a 17 year old maid/slave who is immortal and has impressive regenerative properties) 04. Hao Chi Feng Jiao (The name is Chinese, and it means something like "Good Eats! Feng Jiao.) 05. Song Of The Dull Knife 06. Dining Table Banquet 07. Game Over 08. The Lawless Area Of Oz (A retelling of the classic story) 09. Jingle Bells 10. Guts Marin

title: Kotonoha
description: When Fujita was in high school, she had but one romantic encounter - and it was with another girl. It happened one day when they ended up kissing. However, somewhere inside her, she knew a girl kissing another girl was wrong, so she chose to remain as just friends. Even when graduation came, she could not confess her feelings, and so the two girls split ways. Five years later, Fujita still thinks back to that romantic encounter. Meanwhile at work, due to one of her colleagues going on maternity leave, a new designer is brought into the company... and who does that designer turn out to be? None other than her high school crush! (Source: MangaPlaza)

title: Yuusha wa Osorezu
title_en: The Bound Hero Knows No Fear
description: Elizaveta dreams of becoming a hero. To chase that dream, she enrolls in the Hero Training Academy and spends every day honing her swordsmanship. But her male rivals shun her for being a woman, urging her to abandon her ambition. Refusing to give up, Elizaveta presses forward—until a devastating tragedy strikes... Now stripped of everything, her journey of justice begins. (Source: Manga UP!) Note: The serialization is concluded prematurely due to the mangaka's health issues.

title: Boyish²
description: Volume 1: 1. Locusta in the Skyscraper by Sumire Nekobungi 2. Beware the Wolf by Jackie 3. Can't Catch You off Guard With Love by Mirin 4. Yuriran! by Sumire 5. We're Just Close, Is All. by Edakichi 6. Moon in the Water by Toukichirou Nerikomi 7. Portrayal by Shimako Chiruda 8. La Coneja Blanca y su Santa María by Sumire Nekobungi 9. Seafoam by Mint 10. All-Inclusive Feelings by noe 11. Bad Butch Bad Boy by Natsuo Mutsumi 12. Coffee Time by Natsuo Mutsumi 13. I'll Sculpt My Abs!! by Alt Hanakage

title: Majigawa! Mahou Shoujo no Kigurumi
title_original: マジガワ！～魔法少女のきぐるみ～

title: Twin Cake
description: Kaede is inspired to become an idol when she sees the popular cover girl Susuran. Kaede is scouted for the same talent agency as Susuran but fails to sell during her debut, she doesn't meet Susuran either. Since she is not doing well as an idol, Kaede is given menial tasks around the office. That is, until she is asked to be a replacement for Susuran's manager. Ecstatic, Kaede accepts the job but her admiration for the model may be crushed when they actually meet...

title: Wo Zai Lianzong Bei Yinghou Houma Qiangzhi Ai Le
title_original: 我在恋综被影后后妈强制爱了
description: Ruan Tao wanted to make a name for herself in the entertainment world, but she was blocked by her stepmother right at the start. Her stepmother is a superstar actress well-known in the scene, so Ruan Tao can only play nice while trying to find a way around her wicked stepmother! Finally, Ruan Tao gets a chance to participate in a reality dating show, along with her stepmother. But aren't these shows supposed to be about young people finding romance with each other? Why is her stepmother holding her hand and being all overprotective all of a sudden? (Source: Bilibili, translated)

title: Untitled Flowers: Tamago wo Umanai Watashitachi
title_original: Untitled Flowers ～卵を産まないわたしたち～
description: Miwa and Akane. A new addition to the lives of these two women living under the same roof is... (Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Kurogane Pukapuka Tai
description: An epic yuri romance in the carefully reconstructed WW2 setting... not! The story follows the adventures of a Japanese battleship, the crew of which consists solely of girls for some reason. This is pure fan-service and the historical details could perhaps be questioned, but as long as you like ships, tough girls and comedy, you're still gonna enjoy it.

characters.name: Mifuyu Obama
characters.description: Obama Mifuyu is the gunnery officer of the Imperial Japanese Navy heavy cruiser Unebi. As quite possibly its only heterosexual crewmember - certainly out of the main cast - her job is full of Freudian symbolism. She's a glamorous blonde with princess curls who is prone to getting too hot and removing rather more of her uniform than regulation permits. She seems to end up working the nighttime watch a lot, and getting very grumpy about getting her sleep; you do NOT want to cross her when sleepy. Prone to uttering the words, "I need a MAN!" Her behavior in Chapter 8 when she does find a man may indicate why she's been put on an all-woman warship in the first place - to keep her out of trouble. For all her complaining otherwise, she's lethal at her job.

characters.name: Commander Kuki
characters.description: The de facto commander of the Imperial Japanese Navy cruiser 'Unebi' and lead character of the series, Kuki is a conscientious and proper young naval officer who is competent and capable - except when it comes to matters romantic or sexual. The center of an unwanted harem of admirers, as well as the more respectful admiration of her crew, Kuki denies that love between women is possible, but her denials don't quite ring true, especially given how flustered she gets when the women pursuing her make advances upon her.

characters.name: Executive Officer Mamiya
characters.description: Mamiya is the Executive Officer (XO) of the Imperial Japanese Navy heavy cruiser "Unebi", responsible for ensuring that the Captain and First Officer's orders are carried out, managing the crew, and ensuring the well-being and battle-readiness of the entire ship. She is a woman of few words who is effective at her job except for her habit of spacing out in daydreams, most of which center on her romantic obsession with the First Officer, Commander Kuki, the deaths of her rivals for Kuki's affections, and her performing impossible feats of daring to impress Kuki. Mamiya wears a katana and is unparalleled at iai-nuki, the art of the fast draw. Her feats of improbably good swordswomanship include being able to slice someone's clothes off without touching their skin, being able to deflect bullets, and being able to slice clean through opponents' weapons, including swords and guns. H

characters.name: Navigator Chiga
characters.description: Chiga is the navigator and helmswoman of the Imperial Japanese Navy heavy cruiser 'Unebi'. Level-headed and unflappable, Chiga keeps the crew as well as the ship on a steady course. She has served with Commander Kuki, XO Mamiya and gunnery officer Obama for a long time, and they are a solid team. She does not appear to have any romantic or sexual interest in anyone on the crew or off it, although she clearly admires Kuki a lot.

characters.name: Nina Stortebeker
characters.description: Nina Stortebeker is the captain of the all-girl crew of the German Kriegsmarine U-boat U-800, a Type IX-C boat operating in the Indian Ocean against British and Allied shipping in consort with the Imperial Japanese Navy. She is a skilled commander, with sinkings exceeding 100,000 combined tons; this would put her in about the top thirty U-boat commanders of the Second World War. She's instantly in lust with Commander Kuki after she visits the 'Unebi', and therefore inspires simmering jealousy in Executive Officer Mamiya. She's always immaculately dressed in Kriegsmarine full dress uniform but with rolled-up sleeves, and her peaked cap turned to the side; however, her personal hygiene leaves much to be desired, partly because there's simply no way to keep clean on a U-boat that has little in the way of washing facilities, but also because she has a fetish for bodily smells. Her stench wak

characters.name: Ann
characters.description: Captain Ann of the Royal Navy is the third member of the unwanted harem pursuing Commander Kuki in "Kurogane Pukapuka Tai". A tall, leggy, striking redhead, she aggressively pursues romantic as well as military victory, and has been Captain Nina Stortebeker's rival in both love and war through many encounters. Nina calls her "Red-Headed Cobra". She falls for Commander Kuki when the Japanese officer leads her crewmembers to repel Ann's boarding sailors with a dramatic display of unarmed combat; when Kuki tries to strike Ann, Ann kisses her instead until Kuki swoons; she is, it seems, a "devil kisser". Nina and Mamiya, and the 12" guns of Unebi directed by Obama Mifuyu, drive Captain Ann off, and she narrowly escapes in a ruined HMS "Cutlass". Not dissuaded from her pursuit by such a setback, Captain Ann trades up to a light cruiser, the HMS &qu

title: Last Waltz
description: The name of the hero is KageKon (Kagechika-Shinobu) and her missions come from the student council president who is her lover as well. KageKon's role is to solve the various problems of the school while keeping her identity secret.

title: Lan Yao Shi Zhi Shou
description: In the year 3574 of the Lista calendar, the world started moving toward destruction. In this already decaying world, 500 years later, the black-robed-elf Ariman Campbell takes over an Orc-female beast, Eve, by accident. Their meeting set the wheel of fate in motion, which could lead to a major storm... (Source: INKR)

title: Sugar wa Otoshigoro
description: Hatanaka Keiko's an odd girl with odd aspirations(I mean, REALLY weird), but she tries her best to fit in with the other girls in her class... she still sucks at it, though. One day, she meets Asami, a girl who's even more of an outcast than she is... but unlike Keiko, Asami's own "outsider" status doesn't seem to bother her in the slightest. As they grow closer, what's going to happen to Keiko's standing among the other girls? And what about Asami's own issues? (Source: MangaHelpers)

characters.name: Keiko Hatanaka
characters.description: Keiko's a girl who doesn't fit in with the rest of her class, and who has some rather strange aspirations. For example, she told the attendees at her primary school's parents day, "In the future, I don't want to become anything!", and eight years later she posts on her blog that she thinks she wants to become a prostitute. She loves to sing, often finding herself doing it unselfconsciously in the middle of the street, and also when she finds that simple words aren't quite enough - specifically with her new friend Asami, the outcast of her school, who heard her shouting at a passing train, "I want to have sex!"

title: Ano Umi no Mieru Basho de.
title_original: あの海の見える場所で。
description: For another chance, to stay with her this time. Note: Originally published in Comic Yuri-Hime 2021 May issue.

title: Kage to Hana
description: Deep in the mountains in western Tokyo, there sits the hidden Gekka girls' high school. All the students attending are actually...ninjas! Kasane Hattori and Saika Kirigakure are two of the very ninja girls enrolled to Gekka. Kasane sees Saika as a rival to surpass, and is working every day to improve her ninja arts. But first, she'll have to finish her homework...in seduction?! It's school rules to train your seduction skills with the girl you're rooming with, but how is Kasane supposed to practice when her roommate is none-other than Saika Kirigakure?! (Source: TOKYOPOP)

title: Lost Girl
description: Two high-school girls have an obvious attraction to each other, but one struggles with returning those feelings due to how others react to the possibility of them being together.

title: Akogare no Onee-san
description: Young Risa-chan is eager to grow up. Feeling no connection with her classmates, she becomes close friends with her older neighbor Megumi-san, who is kind, beautiful and 'several' years older. As they spend more time together, Risa starts to wish for a more adult relationship with her. Then her Mom goes out of town for a few days, what opportunities will a 3-day sleepover present? Note: Published in Comic X-Eros #50

title: You Jian Xing Huo
description: Through an old camera in the club's storage room, Gu An saw something that should not exist. She was a shooting star from three years ago named "Xinghuo." Why do you stay in the night sky? Why am I the only one who can see you? Gu An, who usually follows the crowd, wants to investigate and take the initiative for the first time in her life. As an observer and "the most important friend," Gu An and Xinghuo set on a journey to find the former club members and fulfill their dreams from three years ago. "It's... been exposed." "But, I'm really happy. Thank you, Gu An." (Source: Bilibili Comics)

title: S-musaeneun Salangeul Tago
description: Nagyung couldn't contain her anger at the sound of moans coming from the next room every day. Let's knock on the door where continuous groans keep coming from. A naked neighbour greets us! A hot roco GL with a neighbour!

title: Ikisuru Koto Sura Yurusanai
title_original: 息することすら許さない
description: Machida falls in love with Kitayama, a senior who makes her laugh. Machida confesses her feelings to Kitayama, but Kitayama quickly rejects her, telling her that she already has a boyfriend who aspires to be a comedian. Trying to impress Kitayama, Machida becomes a comedian herself, but she is unsuccessful, until one day when she runs into Kitayama again...? (Source: Shonen Jump Plus, translated)

title: Bruges: Applause
title_original: ブルージュ －アプローズ－
description: A love story between two dancers: Junaque, a relative of the Belgian royal family and Shara, a Japanese transfer student. The story begins at St. Maria's, a private Catholic school in Belgium, but later the action switches to the show business life in New York. Notes: Also includes the one-shots Voyage: Tabi (Voyage-旅-), and San Fransisco Monogatari (サンフランシスコ物語)

title: Alignment You! You!
title_original: あらいめんとゆーゆー
description: Oohara is lovely, full-figured and in love--and a ghost. Death has thrown a huge crimp into her plans to confess to the boy she loves. But this is hentai....Oohara can do what she wants, including getting off in the middle of her classroom. But no one can see her exhibitionist frenzy, not even the boy she loves. Then she meets Sakurako, the ghost girl who haunts the boys' bathroom. She seems to take pity on Oohara and says she'll help fulfill Oohara's wish...

characters.name: Toilet no Hanako-san no Sakurako-san
characters.original: トイレの花子さんの櫻子さん

title: Jal Ja Nae Kkum Kkwo
title_en: Good Night, See You in My Dreams
description: A long corridor bathed in red… A ghostly figure lurking in the shadows… Dozens of hands, their long, spindly fingers grasping at your throat… Sounds like the stuff of nightmares, right? But it’s not the kind of thing that troubles Seongha. She’s just your average high-school kid with a head full of exam stress. Her classmate Isu, on the other hand, has been plagued by that very dream for years. And it’s taken its toll, leaving her exhausted and alone. So one day, when Seongha finds herself inside Isu’s dream, both girls know that something seriously freaky is going down. Can Seongha save Isu from her nightmares? (Source: Lezhin US)

title: Yakyuujou de Itadakimasu
title_original: 野球場でいただきます
description: Tsubame Sakamoto is a single woman, 25 years old. She finds relief from the daily stress of life by indulging in food and drink at baseball games, trying out the variety of offerings at different stadiums, with the crowd loudly cheering around her. It might be a little pricey, but nothing tastes better than a cold beer after a win. Freed from the pressure of society, she can truly enjoy the best of stadium food! (Source: Kadokawa, translated) Note: Includes three extra chapters.

title: Akuyaku Reijou to Ai no Tame Nara Nandemo Suru Onna: Aneido Yuri Sakuhin-shuu
title_original: 悪役令嬢と愛のためならなんでもする女 姉井戸・百合作品集
description: "I won't let her die." A woman is summoned into the world of her favorite otome video game where she meets Gerda Fafnir, the villainess whom she has loved for a long time. In order to save Gerda, who is destined to die, the woman keeps looping through the game's world. Included in this volume are three stories that have gotten a lot of buzz on social media, including a new epilogue to the title story that is over 20 pages long. There are 30 pages of new manga in total. This is the author's first collection of girls' love stories, weaving together various forms of love. (Source: Kadokawa, translated) 1–3. Akuyaku Reijou to Ai no Tame Nara Nandemo Suru Onna (悪役令嬢と愛のためならなんでもする女) 4–5. Doku no Aru Onnanoko wa Yasashii (毒のある女の子はやさしい) 6. Ichigo Ichie ja nakatta Yuri (一期一会じゃなかった百合)

title: Ouji-chan no Suki na Hito
title_original: 王子ちゃんの好きな人
description: Himeko loves the character Kitaoji-kun from the shoujo manga Ice Princess . She dreams of the day when a boy like Kitaoji-kun will call her "princess." Tamako Ichinose, also known as Ouji-chan, is a popular classmate who looks a bit like Kitaoji-kun. One day, Himeko bumps into Ouji-chan during a classroom change and discovers their secret… (Source: Ciao, translated)

title: Ibara no Namida
description: The thorn inside the apple that made a princess sleep pricks inside Maki's heart. Even while carrying that thorn as an adult, Maki has a premonition of a new love…. that girl who looks a little like her first love makes Maki's heart beat a little faster. However… in the end it was futile… again. That time, this time, it's always the same. Why can't she grab on to love? But, there may be another love that waits for her... Rikachi crafts a whole new fairy-tale for Romeo's best friend Maki in Ibara no Namida. Will she ever find a princess of her own? (Source: ALC)

title: Owari no Futari
description: In a world where humanity is all but wiped out in a war, two survivors, Yuno and Alice, live happily together. They may be the only two people left, but they are very, very happy… (Source: MANGA Plus)

title: Epitaph
description: Astarte and Touwa are two girls who act as "Undertakers," people who deliver the final messages of the departed to their loved ones. In addition to trying her best at her job, Touwa is also attempting to deal with her growing feelings for Astarte, and there's also the question of their shared past... (Source: Horobi no Michi)

characters.name: Touwa
characters.description: Towa is Astarte’s clumsy and timid work partner. She works as an undertaker, but also takes courses in a correspondence school (though she is terrible at it and often fails her grades). She looks up to and respects Astarte, and always tries to be useful to her. Later in the series, it is revealed that Towa has amnesia and does not remember her home, her parents, or her previous life at all. She lived in a hospital, and although the doctors said she was cured she still didn’t regain her memory. One day, Astarte suddenly appeared before her and said, “Come with me”, which led to Towa’s employment at the Cradle Last Trust. Even though she denies it at first, Towa cares deeply for Astarte and becomes jealous when other girls, namely Linna, are friendly with her. Eventually, she realizes that she is in love with her.

characters.name: Astarte
characters.description: Nicknamed Asche. She is responsible and has, as Touwa describes, an “adult face”. Astarte is agile enough to fight grown men and carries a small pistol with her at all times for defense. She is beautiful, strict, cold, always in dark clothing, and is very mysterious; practically nothing is known about her past. Based on her mature behavior, beauty, and knowledge of families and lineages of the nobility, she might have been born in high society. She says she is not a virgin. Despite her coldness, she occasionally shows concern and care for Touwa. Astarte was the one who first picked up Touwa and brought her to the Cradle Last Trust. Apparently, she is searching for someone called the “Thorn Witch”. There are heavy hints that Astarte was somehow involved with Towa’s past, but in a bad way.

title: Hina-chan ga Ikiteru nara
title_original: ひなちゃんが生きてるなら
description: High school student Sora Ueno lives in a small mountain town, but she has never truly felt comfortable there. The only person she could open her heart to was her childhood friend, Hinako. However, on the night of the Minazuki Festival in 1984, Hinako mysteriously disappeared. Everyone in the village claimed it was a “kamikakushi”—a divine abduction—and they made little effort to search for her. Years passed, and in 1988, Hinako suddenly returned… looking exactly the same as she did four years earlier. After her “return,” Hinako faces fear and rejection from the villagers and slowly becomes isolated. Determined to protect her no matter what, Sora stays by her side. But soon, disturbing mysteries surrounding the town and Hinako’s disappearance begin to surface… (Source: Yuri-hime, translated)

title: Joshi Chuugakusei x Hitozuma
description: Here comes a yuri anthology containing settings, illustrations, manga, etc. between junior high school girl x married woman! A married woman who is played by her daughter's friend, and an high-class mother who is attracted to a delinquent girl who is friends with her son! Please enjoy to your heart's content the slightly dangerous scent of beautiful girls and women intertwining with each other. (Source: Melonbooks, translated) 1. Netsubyou (熱病) 2. Douyara Osananajimi ga Boku no Okaa-san wo Neratte Irurashii (どうやら幼馴染が僕のお母さんを狙っているらしい) 3. Silence (サイレンス) Note: A preview was released at COMITIA 120. Chapters 1 to 3 were released at Comiket 93, COMITIA 124, and Comiket 95, respectively.
